hindi: देखने जाना — किसी इमारत, संग्रहालय या शहर का दर्शन करना
definition: to visit and look around a building, museum, castle or city as a sightseer or tourist (hat besichtigt)
example: Morgen besichtigen wir das Schloss. — Tomorrow we are visiting the castle.

hindi: मुआयना — किराये पर लेने से पहले मकान देखने की मुलाक़ात
definition: a viewing, the appointment to look around a flat before deciding whether to rent it (die Besichtigung, plural Besichtigungen)
example: Die Besichtigung ist morgen um sechs Uhr. — The viewing is tomorrow at six o'clock.

hindi: मालिक होना — किसी चीज़ का स्वामी होना
definition: to own or possess something, to have property, a vehicle, money or a quality as one's own (inseparable, irregular: besitzt, hat besessen)
example: Meine Eltern besitzen ein kleines Haus am See. — My parents own a small house by the lake.

hindi: विशेष रूप से — ख़ास तौर पर, औरों से ज़्यादा
definition: especially or particularly, to a greater degree than usual or than others, singling something out
example: Der Kuchen war besonders lecker. — The cake was especially tasty.

hindi: धीरज भरी सूझबूझ — दबाव में भी ठंडा दिमाग
definition: level-headed judgement under pressure, the calm of someone who thinks before the room reacts
example: The captain's Besonnenheit during the storm was worth more than any drill.

hindi: जुटाना — ज़रूरी चीज़ ख़रीदकर या ढूँढ़कर लाना
definition: to get, obtain or procure something needed, buying or fetching an item for yourself or for someone else (regular: besorgt, hat besorgt)
example: Kannst du Brot besorgen? — Can you get some bread?

hindi: चिंतित — किसी की फ़िक्र में
definition: worried and concerned about someone or something, anxious and fearful that harm may come (besorgt um + Akkusativ)
example: Die Eltern waren besorgt um ihren Sohn. — The parents were worried about their son.

hindi: चर्चा करना — किसी विषय पर साथ बैठकर बात करना
definition: to discuss or talk over a topic, plan or problem with other people in order to settle it (irregular: hat besprochen, + Akkusativ)
example: Das besprechen wir am besten persönlich. — We had best discuss that in person.

hindi: बैठक — काम के मुद्दों पर सहकर्मियों की चर्चा
definition: a meeting or discussion at work, where colleagues gather to talk over tasks and decisions (die Besprechung, plural Besprechungen)
example: Die Besprechung beginnt um zehn Uhr. — The meeting starts at ten o'clock.

hindi: सब जानने का दावा करने वाला — हर बात में अपनी बेहतर जानकारी जताने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a pedantic know-it-all who constantly corrects other people and insists on knowing everything better, literally a better-knower, mildly insulting (der Besserwisser, plural Besserwisser)
example: Mein Bruder ist ein Besserwisser und korrigiert jeden Satz. — My brother is a know-it-all and corrects every sentence.

hindi: अंत्येष्टि प्रबंधक — दफ़न और दाह की व्यवस्था करने वाला पेशेवर
definition: an undertaker or funeral director who professionally organises the burial or cremation for a family (der Bestatter, plural Bestatter)
example: Der Bestatter kümmert sich um alle Formalitäten. — The undertaker takes care of all the formalities.

hindi: अंतिम संस्कार — दफ़न या दाह की औपचारिक व्यवस्था
definition: the interment or funeral arrangements, the official word for burying or cremating a dead person (die Bestattung, plural Bestattungen)
example: Die Familie wünscht eine Bestattung im Familiengrab. — The family wants a burial in the family grave.

hindi: छुरी-काँटा-चम्मच — खाने के औज़ारों का पूरा सेट
definition: cutlery, the knives, forks and spoons together that are laid on the table for a meal (das Besteck, plural Bestecke)
example: Das Besteck liegt in der Schublade. — The cutlery is in the drawer.

hindi: उत्तीर्ण होना — परीक्षा में सफल होना
definition: to pass an examination or test, to achieve the required standard and succeed in the assessment (irregular: hat bestanden)
example: Ich habe die Fahrprüfung bestanden. — I passed the driving test.

hindi: किसी बात पर अड़े रहना — अपनी माँग या राय से पीछे न हटना
definition: to insist firmly on something, refusing stubbornly to give way on a demand, condition or opinion (auf + Dativ, besteht, hat bestanden)
example: Der Kunde besteht auf einer schriftlichen Bestätigung. — The customer insists on a written confirmation.

hindi: किन चीज़ों से बना होना — किसी चीज़ के हिस्से या घटक क्या हैं
definition: to consist of or be composed of certain parts, materials, members or ingredients that together make the whole (aus + Dativ, besteht, hat bestanden)
example: Die Gruppe besteht aus zehn Personen. — The group consists of ten people.

hindi: आरोहण करना — पहाड़ या चोटी पर चढ़ना, गाड़ी में सवार होना
definition: to climb a mountain or tower to its summit, or to board a ship, train or horse (irregular: bestieg, hat bestiegen; + Akkusativ)
example: Sie haben den höchsten Berg des Landes bestiegen. — They climbed the highest mountain in the country.

hindi: फ़रमाइश करना — रेस्तराँ में खाना-पीना या दुकान से सामान मँगवाना
definition: to order food, drink or goods, asking a waiter or shop to bring what you want (regular: hat bestellt)
example: Ich bestelle einen Milchkaffee und ein Stück Kuchen. — I order a milky coffee and a slice of cake.

hindi: फ़रमाइश — रेस्तराँ या दुकान में माँगी गई चीज़ों की सूची
definition: an order placed with a waiter or shop, the request naming exactly which food, drink or goods you want brought (die Bestellung, plural Bestellungen)
example: Die Bestellung kommt gleich, sagt der Kellner. — The order is coming right away, says the waiter.

hindi: ज़रूर — निश्चित रूप से, पक्का
definition: certainly, definitely, surely; expressing strong confidence that something is true or will happen
example: Sie hat das bestimmt vergessen. — She has surely forgotten that.

hindi: दंड देना — ग़लती या अपराध के लिए सज़ा देना
definition: to punish someone for an offence or wrongdoing, whether by a court, a teacher or a parent (regular; für + Akkusativ)
example: Die Lehrerin bestrafte ihn für die Lüge. — The teacher punished him for the lie.

hindi: खंडन करना — किसी दावे को गलत बताना
definition: to dispute or contest a claim publicly, saying that it is untrue, also to cover living costs or expenses (irregular: bestreitet, hat bestritten)
example: Niemand bestreitet, dass sie fleißig ist. — Nobody disputes that she is hard-working.

hindi: सर्वाधिक बिकने वाली किताब — जो बाज़ार में बहुत बड़ी संख्या में बिकी हो
definition: a bestseller, a book that sells in very large numbers and tops the sales lists of bookshops (der Bestseller, plural Bestseller)
example: Ihr erster Roman wurde sofort ein Bestseller. — Her first novel immediately became a bestseller.

hindi: पुष्टि करना — किसी बात या समय को सही और तय बताना
definition: to confirm an appointment, receipt or piece of information as correct and agreed, usually in writing (regular, + Akkusativ)
example: Hiermit bestätige ich den Termin am Freitag. — I hereby confirm the appointment on Friday.

hindi: पुष्टि — किसी बात या समय के सही होने की लिखित मंज़ूरी
definition: a confirmation, the written or spoken reply that verifies an appointment, order or piece of information as correct and agreed (die Bestätigung, plural Bestätigungen)
example: Die Bestätigung für den Termin kam heute Morgen. — The confirmation for the appointment arrived this morning.

hindi: मिलने जाना — किसी के घर या जगह पर जाना
definition: to visit a person or a place, to go there and spend time with someone or look around (regular, hat besucht)
example: Wir besuchen am Sonntag meine Oma. — We are visiting my grandma on Sunday.

hindi: आगंतुक — किसी जगह या व्यक्ति से मिलने आया व्यक्ति
definition: a visitor, a person who comes to see a place, an event or someone at their home, whether briefly or for several days (der Besucher, plural Besucher)
example: Das Museum hatte gestern viele Besucher. — The museum had many visitors yesterday.

hindi: प्रार्थना करना — ईश्वर से मन ही मन या बोलकर बात करना
definition: to pray, to speak to God silently or aloud in worship, asking for help or giving thanks (für + Akkusativ for praying for someone; regular)
example: Sie betet jeden Abend für ihre Familie. — She prays every evening for her family.

hindi: सीमेंट-गिट्टी का पक्का मसाला — सीमेंट, रेत और पानी से बना इमारती पदार्थ
definition: concrete, the grey building material mixed from cement, sand, gravel and water that hardens into walls, bridges and floors (der Beton, no plural)
example: Das neue Parkhaus ist ganz aus Beton. — The new car park is entirely made of concrete.

hindi: ज़ोर देना — किसी बात को खास तौर पर महत्व देकर कहना
definition: to emphasise or stress an important point while speaking, also to put stress on a syllable when pronouncing a word (regular: betont, hat betont)
example: Sie betonte, wie wichtig Pünktlichkeit sei. — She emphasised how important punctuality is.

hindi: निरीक्षण करना — शांति से ध्यानपूर्वक देखना
definition: to contemplate or study something visually with calm attention, to look at a painting or view thoughtfully (regular)
example: Wir betrachteten lange das Gemälde im Museum. — We contemplated the painting in the museum for a long time.

hindi: विषय — ईमेल या चिट्ठी की शीर्ष पंक्ति में लिखा मुद्दा
definition: the subject line of an email or formal letter, the short heading that says what the message is about (der Betreff, plural Betreffe)
example: Bitte schreiben Sie einen klaren Betreff. — Please write a clear subject line.

hindi: प्रवेश करना — किसी कमरे, इमारत या मैदान में कदम रखना
definition: to enter or step into a room, building or piece of ground, somewhat formal and common on signs (inseparable, irregular: betritt, hat betreten; + Akkusativ)
example: Bitte betreten Sie den Rasen nicht. — Please do not walk on the lawn.

hindi: प्रतिष्ठान — कारखाना, कंपनी या कोई कामकाजी संस्थान
definition: a business establishment, factory or company where people work, also the running of operations (der Betrieb, plural Betriebe)
example: Im Betrieb arbeiten fünfzig Leute. — Fifty people work at the company.

hindi: आदत का अंधापन — एक ही जगह लंबे काम से खामियाँ न दिखना
definition: the blindness to obvious flaws that comes from working inside the same operation for far too long
example: It took a new hire to point out the broken form; the rest of us had Betriebsblindheit.

hindi: कर्मचारी परिषद — कंपनी में कर्मचारियों की चुनी हुई प्रतिनिधि समिति
definition: a works council, the elected body of employees that represents staff interests toward the management of a German company (der Betriebsrat, plural Betriebsräte)
example: Der Betriebsrat hat der Kündigung widersprochen. — The works council objected to the dismissal.

hindi: धोखाधड़ी — झूठ बोलकर पैसा या फ़ायदा हड़पना
definition: fraud or deception, the crime of tricking someone with lies in order to gain money or advantage (der Betrug, no plural)
example: Der Betrug fiel erst nach Monaten auf. — The fraud was only noticed after months.

hindi: नशे में — शराब पीकर धुत
definition: drunk and intoxicated after drinking too much alcohol, walking unsteadily and slurring words while talking
example: Er war nach der Party ziemlich betrunken. — He was quite drunk after the party.

hindi: धोखा देना — झूठ बोलकर ठगना या बेवफ़ाई करना
definition: to cheat or defraud someone with deception, also to be unfaithful to a partner (betrog, hat betrogen; um + Akkusativ)
example: Er hat viele Kunden um ihr Geld betrogen. — He cheated many customers out of their money.

hindi: पलंग — सोने का बिस्तर
definition: a bed, the piece of furniture with a mattress that a person sleeps in at night (das Bett, plural Betten)
example: Ich gehe früh ins Bett. — I am going to bed early.

hindi: भीख माँगना — पैसे या खाने के लिए गिड़गिड़ाना
definition: to beg for money or food from strangers on the street, or to plead insistently for something wanted (regular, um + Akkusativ: bettelt, hat gebettelt)
example: Vor dem Bahnhof bettelt ein alter Mann um Kleingeld. — In front of the station an old man begs for change.

hindi: मूल्यांकन — किसी व्यक्ति या काम के बारे में निर्णय
definition: an assessment or evaluation, the considered judgement of a person, performance or situation, also a written appraisal (die Beurteilung, plural Beurteilungen)
example: Die Beurteilung des Lehrers war sehr positiv. — The teacher's assessment was very positive.

hindi: थैला — कपड़े या प्लास्टिक का पाउच या छोटा बोरा
definition: a bag or pouch, a soft sack of cloth or plastic that holds small things such as tea, laundry or coins (der Beutel, plural Beutel)
example: Ich nehme den Beutel mit zum Einkaufen. — I take the bag along to go shopping.

hindi: अधिकृत करना — किसी को अपनी ओर से कार्य करने का अधिकार देना
definition: to authorise someone formally with written power to represent you, decide or sign documents on your behalf (regular, inseparable: hat bevollmächtigt)
example: Ich bevollmächtige meinen Anwalt, den Vertrag zu unterschreiben. — I authorise my lawyer to sign the contract.

hindi: से पहले — एक काम को दूसरे से आगे रखने वाला शब्द
definition: before; the everyday conjunction placing one action ahead of another in time, verb at the end
example: Wasch dir die Hände, bevor du isst. — Wash your hands before you eat.

hindi: तरजीह देना — कई विकल्पों में एक को ज़्यादा पसंद करना
definition: to prefer one thing or person over others, to give it preference, also to favour someone unfairly (regular)
example: Ich bevorzuge Tee statt Kaffee am Morgen. — I prefer tea instead of coffee in the morning.

hindi: जनसंख्या — किसी इलाक़े के सभी लोग मिलकर
definition: the population, all the people living in a country, region or town considered together as one group (die Bevölkerung, plural Bevölkerungen)
example: Die Bevölkerung der Region wächst langsam. — The population of the region is growing slowly.

hindi: सँजोना — किसी चीज़ को सुरक्षित बनाए रखना
definition: to preserve or keep something safe, to protect a tradition, memory or object from being lost (regular, hat bewahrt)
example: Das Museum bewahrt alte Briefe und Fotos. — The museum preserves old letters and photos.

hindi: हरकत — शरीर की गति या व्यायाम
definition: movement or exercise, the physical activity of moving the body, and any single motion or gesture (die Bewegung, plural Bewegungen)
example: Kinder brauchen viel Bewegung an der frischen Luft. — Children need plenty of exercise in the fresh air.

hindi: सबूत — किसी बात को सच साबित करने वाला प्रमाण
definition: a piece of evidence or proof that shows something is true, especially in a court case or investigation (der Beweis, plural Beweise)
example: Das Video ist der wichtigste Beweis. — The video is the most important evidence.

hindi: साबित करना — सबूत देकर सच दिखाना
definition: to prove something, to show with evidence that a claim is true, especially in court (bewies, hat bewiesen)
example: Die Polizei konnte seine Schuld nicht beweisen. — The police could not prove his guilt.

hindi: आवेदक / उम्मीदवार — नौकरी या जगह के लिए आवेदन करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an applicant or candidate, a person who has formally applied for a vacant position, training place or university place (der Bewerber, plural Bewerber)
example: Der Bewerber hat einen sehr guten Eindruck gemacht. — The applicant made a very good impression.

hindi: आवेदन — नौकरी पाने के लिए भेजा गया पत्र और दस्तावेज़
definition: a job application, the covering letter and documents someone sends to apply for an advertised position (die Bewerbung, plural Bewerbungen)
example: Ich schicke meine Bewerbung heute ab. — I am sending off my application today.

hindi: स्वीकृत करना — छुट्टी, धन या लाभ का अनुरोध औपचारिक रूप से मानना
definition: to grant or approve a request formally, especially money, leave or a benefit (regular, inseparable: hat bewilligt)
example: Der Chef hat mir drei Tage Urlaub bewilligt. — The boss granted me three days of leave.

hindi: स्वीकृति — ख़ासकर धन या लाभ के आवेदन की मंज़ूरी
definition: formal approval or grant of an application, especially of money or a benefit, by an authority (die Bewilligung, plural Bewilligungen)
example: Die Bewilligung für das Stipendium kam nach drei Wochen. — The approval for the scholarship came after three weeks.

hindi: सराहना — किसी की खूबी पर मुग्ध होकर प्रशंसा करना
definition: to admire someone or something greatly, to feel respect and wonder at a quality, achievement or beauty (regular)
example: Alle bewundern ihren Mut. — Everyone admires her courage.

hindi: सचेत, जानबूझकर — पूरी जागरूकता के साथ
definition: conscious or aware of something, knowing it clearly, and as an adverb deliberately or on purpose (sich + Dativ, thing in Genitiv: ich bin mir einer Sache bewusst)
example: Ich bin mir des Risikos bewusst. — I am aware of the risk.

hindi: बेहोश — चोट या बीमारी से होश खोया हुआ
definition: unconscious, having lost awareness and the ability to respond because of injury, illness or shock
example: Der Fahrer war nach dem Unfall bewusstlos. — The driver was unconscious after the accident.

hindi: पार पाना — कठिन काम या संकट से निपट लेना
definition: to cope with, master or manage a difficult task, workload or crisis successfully (inseparable: bewältigt, hat bewältigt)
example: Sie hat die schwere Zeit gut bewältigt. — She coped well with the hard time.

hindi: बादलों से घिरा — जब आसमान बादलों से ढका हो
definition: cloudy, describing a sky largely covered with clouds so that the sunshine is hidden
example: Morgen wird es stark bewölkt. — Tomorrow it will be heavily cloudy.

hindi: भुगतान करना — किसी चीज़ का दाम चुकाना
definition: to pay for something, to make the payment and hand over the money owed for goods, a meal or a service (regular: bezahlt, hat bezahlt, + Akkusativ)
example: Ich bezahle mit Karte. — I'll pay by card.

hindi: रिश्ता — दो लोगों के बीच संबंध, ख़ासकर प्रेम संबंध
definition: a relationship, the connection between two people, most often a romantic partnership, but also any personal or professional connection (die Beziehung, plural Beziehungen)
example: Sie sind seit zwei Jahren in einer Beziehung. — They have been in a relationship for two years.

hindi: रिश्ते का संकट — जोड़े के बीच गंभीर कठिन दौर
definition: a relationship crisis, a serious troubled period when a couple doubts whether to stay together (die Beziehungskrise, plural Beziehungskrisen)
example: Nach dem Umzug steckten sie in einer Beziehungskrise. — After the move they were in a relationship crisis.

hindi: अथवा, यानी — बात को सुधारने या स्पष्ट करने वाला शब्द
definition: or rather, respectively; a conjunction that corrects or specifies a term, abbreviated bzw. in writing
example: Das Treffen ist am Montag beziehungsweise Dienstag. — The meeting is on Monday or rather Tuesday.

hindi: ज़िला — प्रशासनिक रूप से बँटा शहर का क्षेत्र
definition: an administrative district of a city or region, a formally drawn area with its own local office (der Bezirk, plural Bezirke)
example: Berlin ist in zwölf Bezirke aufgeteilt. — Berlin is divided into twelve districts.

hindi: संदर्भ — जिस पिछले पत्र या बात का हवाला दिया जाए
definition: a reference or connection to an earlier letter, conversation or topic, also used in the formal phrase in Bezug auf meaning regarding (der Bezug, plural Bezüge)
example: Den Bezug zu unserem Thema sehe ich hier nicht. — I do not see the connection to our topic here.

hindi: शक करना — किसी दावे को सच न मानना
definition: to question or doubt a specific claim, taking a direct object rather than a preposition (regular: bezweifelt, hat bezweifelt)
example: Ich bezweifle, dass das stimmt. — I doubt that is true.

hindi: के संबंध में — किसी विषय या मामले के बारे में
definition: regarding, concerning a certain matter or topic under discussion, formal business register (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Bezüglich Ihrer Frage melden wir uns morgen. — Regarding your question we will contact you tomorrow.

hindi: बाइबिल — ईसाइयों का पवित्र ग्रंथ
definition: the Bible, the holy scripture of Christianity, the collection of sacred books containing the Old and New Testaments (die Bibel, plural Bibeln)
example: Auf dem Tisch liegt eine alte Bibel. — An old Bible lies on the table.

hindi: पुस्तकालय — पढ़ने और किताबें उधार लेने की जगह
definition: a library, the building where books and journals are kept for students to read, borrow and study quietly (die Bibliothek, plural Bibliotheken)
example: Die Bibliothek hat bis Mitternacht geöffnet. — The library is open until midnight.

hindi: मधुमक्खी — शहद बनाने वाला भिनभिनाता कीट
definition: a bee, the buzzing striped insect that collects nectar from flowers and makes honey in a hive (die Biene, plural Bienen)
example: Die Biene fliegt von Blüte zu Blüte. — The bee flies from blossom to blossom.

hindi: जौ की शराब — जौ और हॉप से बनी हल्की नशीली मदिरा
definition: beer, the alcoholic drink brewed from malt and hops, ordered by the glass in every German tavern (das Bier, plural Biere)
example: Das Bier hier kommt aus der Region. — The beer here comes from the region.

hindi: खुला मधुशाला-बाग़ — पेड़ों के नीचे बीयर पीने की खुली जगह
definition: a beer garden, the open-air tavern under chestnut trees where guests may bring their own food (der Biergarten, plural Biergärten)
example: Bei schönem Wetter sitzen alle im Biergarten. — In fine weather everybody sits in the beer garden.

hindi: पेश करना — किसी को कुछ देने का प्रस्ताव रखना
definition: to offer or provide something to someone, such as a service, a price or an opportunity (irregular: bietet, bot, hat geboten)
example: Die Firma bietet gute Arbeitsbedingungen. — The company offers good working conditions.

hindi: तुलन-पत्र या लेखा-जोखा — कंपनी की संपत्ति और देनदारी का सालाना हिसाब
definition: the balance sheet that sets a company's assets against its debts at the end of a financial year, also a summing up of results in general (die Bilanz, plural Bilanzen)
example: Die Bilanz zeigt ein kleines Plus. — The balance sheet shows a small surplus.

hindi: तस्वीर — दीवार पर टँगा चित्र या फ़ोटो
definition: a picture or image of any kind, whether a painting, drawing, photograph or the picture on a screen (das Bild, plural Bilder)
example: Das Bild über dem Sofa ist von meiner Tante. — The picture above the sofa is by my aunt.

hindi: बनाना, गठित करना — समूह, वाक्य या राय तैयार करना
definition: to form or constitute something such as a group, a sentence, a government or an opinion, also to educate the mind (regular: hat gebildet)
example: Bitte bilden Sie Gruppen von vier Personen. — Please form groups of four people.

hindi: परदा — संगणक या फ़ोन का वह हिस्सा जिस पर चित्र और लेख दिखते हैं
definition: a screen, the display surface of a computer, phone or television where text and pictures appear; literally the picture shield (der Bildschirm, plural Bildschirme)
example: Der Bildschirm ist plötzlich schwarz geworden. — The screen suddenly went black.

hindi: परदे की छवि — परदे पर उस पल दिख रही चीज़ की तस्वीर
definition: a screenshot, a picture captured of exactly what is currently shown on a phone or computer screen; the borrowed word Screenshot is equally common (das Bildschirmfoto, plural Bildschirmfotos)
example: Schick mir bitte ein Bildschirmfoto von der Fehlermeldung. — Please send me a screenshot of the error message.

hindi: संस्कारयुक्त शिक्षा — केवल पढ़ाई नहीं, समूचा व्यक्तित्व-निर्माण
definition: formation of the whole person through learning and culture, far broader than schooling or training
example: A degree is not Bildung, as he discovered the first time the conversation left his field.

hindi: टिकट — यात्रा या कार्यक्रम में प्रवेश का कागज़, स्विस शब्द
definition: a ticket for a train, bus, concert or cinema, the Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Fahrkarte or Eintrittskarte (das Billett, plural Billette)
example: Haben Sie ein gültiges Billett für diesen Zug? — Do you have a valid ticket for this train?

hindi: सस्ता — कम दाम का, कभी-कभी घटिया भी
definition: cheap, costing little money, often with a hint that the quality is poor as well (billig, billiger, am billigsten)
example: Die Schuhe waren billig und sind schon kaputt. — The shoes were cheap and are already broken.

hindi: दस खरब — एक के बाद बारह शून्य वाली संख्या
definition: a trillion, the number one followed by twelve zeros, one thousand times larger than the English billion (die Billion, plural Billionen)
example: Die Schulden liegen bei über einer Billion Euro. — The debts stand at over a trillion euros.

hindi: शहरी पटरी गाड़ी — शहर की पटरी पर चलने वाली बिजली की गाड़ी, विएना का बोलचाल नाम
definition: the tram or streetcar, the electric rail vehicle running through city streets, in the affectionate colloquial Viennese name taken from its bell (die Bim, plural Bim)
example: Ich nehme die Bim bis zum Ring. — I am taking the tram to the Ring.

hindi: के भीतर — किसी तय समय-सीमा के अंदर
definition: within a stated period of time, before that deadline runs out, formal or official register (preposition, + Dativ or Genitiv)
example: Die Ware wird binnen drei Tagen geliefert. — The goods are delivered within three days.

hindi: जैविक कचरा — रसोई और बग़ीचे का सड़ने वाला कचरा
definition: organic waste, kitchen scraps and garden material that rot and go into the brown compost bin (der Biomüll, no plural)
example: Kaffeesatz kommt in den Biomüll. — Coffee grounds go in the organic waste.

hindi: नाशपाती — नीचे से चौड़ा, ऊपर से पतला मीठा फल; बोलचाल में बल्ब भी
definition: a pear, the sweet soft fruit that is narrow at the stem and wide at the bottom, colloquially also a light bulb (die Birne, plural Birnen)
example: Die Birne ist weich und sehr süß. — The pear is soft and very sweet.

hindi: तक — किसी काम के ख़त्म होने का समय बताने वाला शब्द
definition: until; a conjunction or preposition marking the point in time at which an action ends (preposition with Akkusativ)
example: Warte hier, bis ich zurückkomme. — Wait here until I come back.

hindi: जल्द मिलेंगे — जल्दी मिलने की उम्मीद वाली विदा
definition: the friendly goodbye that hopes for another meeting soon, warmer than a plain farewell
example: Bis bald, wir telefonieren nächste Woche. — See you soon, we will phone next week.

hindi: तब तक — बिना तय समय की सहज विदा
definition: the casual goodbye said when people expect to meet again without naming a fixed time
example: Ich muss los, bis dann! — I have to go, see you then!

hindi: कल मिलेंगे — अगले दिन मिलने की विदा
definition: the goodbye spoken when the speakers will see each other again tomorrow, common at work and school
example: Schönen Abend noch, bis morgen! — Have a nice evening, see you tomorrow!

hindi: बाद में मिलते हैं — उसी दिन फिर मिलने की विदा
definition: the casual goodbye used when the speakers will meet again later the same day
example: Ich hole dich ab, bis später! — I will pick you up, see you later!

hindi: गले तक — किसी मुसीबत, कर्ज़ या काम में पूरी तरह डूबा होना
definition: up to the neck, describing someone thoroughly swamped, overwhelmed or fed up with debts, work or trouble (colloquial; etwas steht mir bis zum Hals)
example: Die Arbeit steht mir bis zum Hals. — I am up to my neck in work.

hindi: पूरी तरह डूबा हुआ — ख़ासकर प्यार या कर्ज़ में सिर तक
definition: up to over both ears, describing someone completely immersed, usually head over heels in love or deep in debt (adverbial phrase)
example: Sie ist bis über beide Ohren verliebt. — She is head over heels in love.

hindi: अब तक — इस समय तक, अभी तक
definition: so far, up to now, until the present moment, often implying that things may still change
example: Bisher hat niemand geantwortet. — So far nobody has answered.

hindi: कौर या निवाला — एक बार में मुँह में लिया गया खाना
definition: a bite or mouthful of food, the small piece eaten at one time, often in the phrase keinen Bissen for eating nothing (der Bissen, plural Bissen)
example: Ich habe heute noch keinen Bissen gegessen. — I have not eaten a bite today.

hindi: कृपया — विनती, स्वागत या पेश करने का शब्द
definition: the politeness word meaning please, you are welcome, or here you are, depending on the situation
example: Ein Wasser, bitte. — A water, please.

hindi: कोई बात नहीं — धन्यवाद के जवाब या चीज़ थमाते समय
definition: the phrase spoken when handing something over or as the polite answer to thanks
example: Bitte schön, Ihr Kaffee. — Here you are, your coffee.

hindi: विनती करना — विनम्रता से कुछ माँगना
definition: to ask or request something politely from a person, pleading for a favour or help (irregular: bittet, bat, hat gebeten; um + Akkusativ)
example: Darf ich Sie um Hilfe bitten? — May I ask you for help?

hindi: किसी चीज़ के लिए विनती करना — विनम्रता से कुछ माँगना
definition: to request something politely from somebody, asking courteously for help, permission, advice or a favour (+ Akkusativ, um + Akkusativ, bittet, hat gebeten)
example: Darf ich Sie um einen Gefallen bitten? — May I ask you for a favour?

hindi: कड़वा — कॉफ़ी या डार्क चॉकलेट जैसा तीखा स्वाद; दुखद भी
definition: bitter, having the sharp unpleasant taste of strong coffee or dark chocolate, also used for painful experiences (regular comparison: bitterer, am bittersten)
example: Die dunkle Schokolade schmeckt etwas bitter. — The dark chocolate tastes a little bitter.

hindi: बदनामी वाला — शर्मिंदा कर देने वाला, अपमानजनक
definition: disgraceful, embarrassing, humiliating; describes a failure or result that brings shame on someone
example: Die Niederlage gegen den Tabellenletzten war blamabel. — The defeat against the bottom team was disgraceful.

hindi: फीका, पीला पड़ा — रंग या चेहरे में चमक की कमी
definition: pale, lacking strength of colour, describing a washed-out shade or a face that has lost its healthy colour
example: Du siehst heute sehr blass aus. — You look very pale today.

hindi: पत्ता — पौधे का हरा चपटा हिस्सा
definition: a leaf, the flat green part of a plant or tree that turns colour and falls in autumn (das Blatt, plural Blätter)
example: Im Herbst fällt jedes Blatt vom Baum. — In autumn every leaf falls from the tree.

hindi: नीला — साफ़ आसमान और समुद्र का रंग
definition: blue, the colour of a clear daytime sky and deep water, also colloquially meaning drunk
example: Der Himmel ist heute blau. — The sky is blue today.

hindi: रहना — जहाँ हो वहीं टिके रहना
definition: to stay or remain in a place or in the same condition without leaving or changing (irregular: bleibt, blieb, ist geblieben)
example: Heute bleibe ich zu Hause. — Today I am staying at home.

hindi: पेंसिल — लकड़ी में ग्रेफ़ाइट वाली लिखने की छड़ी
definition: a pencil, the writing instrument with a graphite core inside a wooden casing that can be erased (der Bleistift, plural Bleistifte)
example: Der Bleistift muss gespitzt werden. — The pencil needs sharpening.

hindi: नज़र/दृष्टि — किसी ओर देखने की क्रिया या अंदाज़
definition: a glance or look, the act of directing the eyes at something and the expression the eyes carry (der Blick, plural Blicke)
example: Sie warf einen kurzen Blick auf die Uhr. — She cast a quick glance at the clock.

hindi: नज़र डालना — किसी दिशा में देखना
definition: to glance or direct one's eyes toward something, a slightly more literary word for looking in a direction (regular)
example: Sie blickte kurz aus dem Fenster. — She glanced briefly out of the window.

hindi: अंधा, नेत्रहीन — देखने की शक्ति से रहित
definition: unable to see, lacking the sense of sight, also figuratively for trusting or acting without looking
example: Mein Nachbar ist seit seiner Geburt blind. — My neighbour has been blind since birth.

hindi: मोड़-संकेत बत्ती — मुड़ने का संकेत देने वाली टिमटिमाती बत्ती
definition: an indicator or turn signal, the flashing lamp that shows other drivers which way you will turn (der Blinker, plural Blinker)
example: Setz den Blinker, bevor du abbiegst. — Put on the indicator before you turn.

hindi: बिजली — आँधी में आसमान में चमकती कौंध
definition: a flash of lightning, the sudden bright electrical discharge that splits the sky during a thunderstorm (der Blitz, plural Blitze)
example: Der Blitz schlug in den alten Baum ein. — The lightning struck the old tree.

hindi: बिजली चमकना — आसमान में कौंध होना
definition: to flash with lightning, used impersonally with es when lightning lights up the sky (regular: es blitzt, hat geblitzt)
example: Es blitzt und donnert schon seit Stunden. — There has been lightning and thunder for hours.

hindi: गति-जाँच यंत्र — तेज़ गाड़ियों की तस्वीर खींचने वाला यंत्र
definition: a speed camera that flashes and photographs vehicles driving faster than the limit, colloquial (der Blitzer, plural Blitzer)
example: Vorsicht, hinter der Kurve steht ein Blitzer. — Careful, there is a speed camera behind the bend.

hindi: बिजली-सा तेज़ — पलक झपकते ही हो जाने वाला
definition: lightning fast, happening in an instant, quicker than anyone could expect or react
example: Sie hat die Frage blitzschnell beantwortet. — She answered the question in a flash.

hindi: सिर्फ़ — बस, केवल (बोलचाल)
definition: only, merely, just; a colloquial restrictive adverb, also an intensifier in warnings and urgent wishes
example: Das war bloß ein Scherz. — That was just a joke.

hindi: फूल — पौधे का रंगीन सुगंधित हिस्सा
definition: a flower, the colourful blossoming plant that people grow in gardens and give as gifts (die Blume, plural Blumen)
example: Sie pflückt eine Blume auf der Wiese. — She picks a flower in the meadow.

hindi: फूलगोभी — सफ़ेद फूल जैसे गुच्छों वाली सब्ज़ी
definition: cauliflower, the vegetable with a compact white flowering head surrounded by green leaves, usually boiled or baked with sauce (der Blumenkohl, no plural)
example: Heute gibt es Blumenkohl mit heller Soße. — Today there is cauliflower with white sauce.

hindi: गमला — पौधा लगाने का मिट्टी भरा बर्तन
definition: a flowerpot, the clay or plastic container filled with soil in which a single plant grows (der Blumentopf, plural Blumentöpfe)
example: Der Blumentopf auf dem Balkon ist umgefallen. — The flowerpot on the balcony fell over.

hindi: ज़नाना कमीज़ — महिलाओं का हल्का ऊपरी वस्त्र
definition: a blouse, the light shirt-like upper garment worn by women, often with skirt or trousers (die Bluse, plural Blusen)
example: Die weiße Bluse passt zu jedem Rock. — The white blouse goes with every skirt.

hindi: ख़ून/रक्त — शरीर की नसों में बहने वाला लाल द्रव
definition: blood, the red liquid that flows through the veins and arteries carrying oxygen around the body (das Blut, no plural)
example: Der Arzt nimmt mir etwas Blut ab. — The doctor takes a little blood from me.

hindi: रक्तचाप — नसों में ख़ून का दबाव
definition: blood pressure, the force of the blood against the vessel walls that a doctor measures with a cuff (der Blutdruck, no plural)
example: Ihr Blutdruck ist etwas zu hoch. — Your blood pressure is a little too high.

hindi: ख़ून बहना — घाव से रक्त निकलना
definition: to bleed, to lose blood from a wound, cut or injury in the skin or inside the body (regular)
example: Die Wunde blutet noch ein wenig. — The wound is still bleeding a little.

hindi: बेवकूफ़ — मूर्खतापूर्ण, कष्टकर; बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: stupid, dumb, annoying; the colloquial everyday word for something foolish or irritating
example: Wie blöd, ich habe den Schlüssel vergessen. — How stupid, I forgot the key.

hindi: बकवास — मूर्खतापूर्ण बात या हरकत
definition: nonsense or stupidity, a foolish statement or silly action dismissed impatiently in colloquial speech (der Blödsinn, no plural)
example: Mach keinen Blödsinn mit dem Feuerzeug! — Do not do anything stupid with the lighter!

hindi: खिलना — फूल का पूरी तरह खुलना; फलना-फूलना भी
definition: to bloom or flower, to open blossoms as a plant does in its season; also to flourish (regular: blüht, hat geblüht)
example: Die Rosen blühen im Juni am schönsten. — The roses bloom most beautifully in June.

hindi: बौर — पेड़-पौधे का खिला हुआ फूल; चरम काल भी
definition: a blossom or bloom, the flowering part of a plant or tree, and by extension a peak period (die Blüte, plural Blüten)
example: Die Blüte des Kirschbaums ist im April wunderschön. — The blossom of the cherry tree is beautiful in April.

hindi: मन होना — बोलचाल में किसी काम की इच्छा होना
definition: to fancy doing something or be up for it, colloquial phrase for wanting or feeling like an activity, often negated (+ auf + Akkusativ)
example: Hast du Bock auf Kino? — Are you up for the cinema?

hindi: मिट्टी, ज़मीन — जिस पर हम चलते और जिसमें पौधे उगते हैं
definition: the ground or soil, the earth surface people stand on and plants grow in; also a floor (der Boden, plural Böden)
example: Der Boden hier ist sehr fruchtbar. — The soil here is very fertile.

hindi: सेम या फली — फली में उगने वाला बीज, हरी सेम या सूखी दाल के रूप में
definition: a bean, the seed that grows inside a pod, eaten as green beans or as dried beans in stews, also a coffee bean (die Bohne, plural Bohnen)
example: Die grüne Bohne ist frisch vom Feld. — The green bean is fresh from the field.

hindi: छेद करना — दीवार या लकड़ी में घुमाकर छेद बनाना
definition: to drill a hole into a wall, wood or metal with a spinning tool, boring through the material (regular: bohrt, hat gebohrt)
example: Er bohrt ein Loch für das Regal. — He drills a hole for the shelf.

hindi: छेद करने की मशीन — दीवार या लकड़ी में छेद करने वाला बिजली का यंत्र
definition: an electric drill, the power tool that bores holes into walls, wood or metal for screws and plugs (die Bohrmaschine, plural Bohrmaschinen)
example: Die Bohrmaschine ist zu laut für den Sonntag. — The drill is too loud for a Sunday.

hindi: रसीद — काउंटर से मिली छोटी पर्ची
definition: a till receipt or voucher slip, the short colloquial word for the paper printed at the checkout (der Bon, plural Bons)
example: Möchten Sie den Bon mitnehmen? — Would you like to take the receipt?

hindi: मीठी गोली — चूसने के लिए चीनी की छोटी कठोर मिठाई
definition: a boiled sweet or hard candy, the small sugary drop that you suck slowly, often fruit or mint flavoured (das Bonbon, plural Bonbons)
example: Die Oma hat immer ein Bonbon in der Tasche. — Grandma always has a sweet in her pocket.

hindi: नाव — पानी पर चलने वाला छोटा जलयान, जूता नहीं
definition: a boat, a small vessel that carries people across water, never footwear (das Boot, plural Boote)
example: Das Boot liegt am kleinen Steg. — The boat lies at the small jetty.

hindi: विमान-प्रवेश पत्र — विमान में चढ़ने की अनुमति वाला कार्ड
definition: a boarding pass, the card or digital code that lets a passenger board a specific flight (die Bordkarte, plural Bordkarten)
example: Bitte halten Sie Ihre Bordkarte bereit. — Please have your boarding pass ready.

hindi: माँगकर लेना — बिना पैसे थोड़े समय को उधार लेना या देना
definition: to borrow or lend something informally without payment, a slightly old-fashioned twin of leihen (regular: borgt, hat geborgt)
example: Ich habe mir sein Auto für einen Tag geborgt. — I borrowed his car for a day.

hindi: सनसनीखेज़ अख़बार — बड़ी सुर्ख़ियों वाला चटपटा टैब्लॉइड
definition: a tabloid newspaper, the popular sensational paper with huge headlines, celebrity gossip and short articles (die Boulevardzeitung, plural Boulevardzeitungen)
example: Die Boulevardzeitung schreibt wieder über den Skandal. — The tabloid newspaper is writing about the scandal again.

hindi: अग्निकांड — इमारत या जंगल में फैली विनाशकारी आग
definition: a fire in the sense of a destructive blaze that burns a building, forest or vehicle, often the formal word in news reports (der Brand, plural Brände)
example: Bei dem Brand wurde niemand verletzt. — Nobody was injured in the fire.

hindi: तलना या भूनना — तवे या ओवन में गरम तेल में पकाना
definition: to fry in a frying pan or roast in the oven, cooking meat or vegetables in hot fat until they are browned (irregular: brät, hat gebraten)
example: Ich brate das Fleisch in Butter. — I am frying the meat in butter.

hindi: भुना भरवाँ गोश्त — तवे या ग्रिल पर सिंकी ताज़ी भरवाँ आँत, सरसों के साथ
definition: a grilled or fried sausage of fresh pork, sold in a roll with mustard at every fair and football ground in Germany (die Bratwurst, plural Bratwürste)
example: Eine Bratwurst mit Senf, bitte. — One grilled sausage with mustard, please.

hindi: रिवाज़ — किसी क्षेत्र या त्योहार की पारंपरिक रीति
definition: a custom, a traditional practice or ritual tied to a region, a season or a festival (der Brauch, plural Bräuche)
example: Der Maibaum ist ein alter Brauch. — The maypole is an old custom.

hindi: काम का — इस्तेमाल के लायक, ठीक-ठाक
definition: usable, serviceable or reasonably useful, describing something good enough to work with even if not perfect
example: Das Ergebnis ist brauchbar, aber nicht perfekt. — The result is usable but not perfect.

hindi: ज़रूरत होना — किसी चीज़ की आवश्यकता पड़ना
definition: to need or require something, often used with nicht like a modal verb meaning need not (regular: braucht, brauchte, hat gebraucht)
example: Ich brauche mehr Zeit für die Arbeit. — I need more time for the work.

hindi: भूरा — मिट्टी, लकड़ी और चॉकलेट का रंग
definition: brown, the colour of earth, wood, chocolate and coffee, also describing tanned skin after sunshine
example: Er hat braune Augen. — He has brown eyes.

hindi: दुल्हन — शादी के दिन की स्त्री
definition: a bride, the woman on her wedding day or shortly before it, traditionally in a white dress (die Braut, plural Bräute)
example: Die Braut trug ein langes weißes Kleid. — The bride wore a long white dress.

hindi: आज्ञाकारी — कहना मानने वाला और शांत, बहादुर नहीं
definition: well-behaved and obedient, describing a good child or a docile animal, never brave or courageous
example: Der Hund war heute sehr brav. — The dog was very well-behaved today.

hindi: चौड़ा — एक किनारे से दूसरे तक ज़्यादा फैला हुआ
definition: wide or broad, measuring a large distance from one side to the other, describing a broad street, river or pair of shoulders
example: Der Fluss ist hier sehr breit. — The river is very wide here.

hindi: चौड़ाई — किसी वस्तु का एक ओर से दूसरी ओर का नाप
definition: width or breadth, the measured distance of something from one side to the other, the shorter dimension beside the length (die Breite, plural Breiten)
example: Die Breite der Tür ist neunzig Zentimeter. — The width of the door is ninety centimetres.

hindi: रोक-यंत्र — गाड़ी की रफ़्तार रोकने वाला पुर्ज़ा
definition: a brake, the device that slows down or stops a moving vehicle when pressed (die Bremse, plural Bremsen)
example: Die Bremsen quietschen, das ist nicht normal. — The brakes are squeaking, that is not normal.

hindi: रफ़्तार थामना — वाहन की गति धीमी करना या रोकना
definition: to brake, to slow down or stop a moving vehicle by pressing the brake (regular: hat gebremst)
example: Der Fahrer bremste plötzlich sehr stark. — The driver suddenly braked very hard.

hindi: जलना — आग की लपटों में होना या आग पकड़ना
definition: to burn, to be alight with flames or to be consumed by fire, also used of a light being switched on (irregular: brennt, brannte, hat gebrannt)
example: Das alte Haus brannte die ganze Nacht. — The old house burned all night.

hindi: तख़्ता — आरी से कटी लकड़ी की चपटी पटरी
definition: a board or plank, the flat sawn piece of wood used for shelves, floors and fences (das Brett, plural Bretter)
example: Das Brett ist zwei Meter lang. — The board is two metres long.

hindi: पट खेल — बोर्ड पर गोटियों से खेला जाने वाला खेल
definition: a board game, a tabletop game played with pieces on a marked board (das Brettspiel, plural Brettspiele)
example: Ein neues Brettspiel liegt unter dem Weihnachtsbaum. — A new board game lies under the Christmas tree.

hindi: गाँठ के आकार की नमकीन डबलरोटी — मोटे नमक वाली भूरी चमकदार परत की बेकरी पनीर
definition: a pretzel, the knot-shaped bread with a dark shiny crust and coarse salt, sold at every bakery and beer garden (die Brezel, plural Brezeln)
example: Zum Bier gehört eine große Brezel. — A large pretzel belongs with the beer.

hindi: चिट्ठी — काग़ज़ पर लिखा संदेश जो डाक से भेजा जाता है
definition: a letter, a written message on paper that is put in an envelope and sent through the post to someone (der Brief, plural Briefe)
example: Heute kam ein Brief von der Versicherung. — A letter from the insurance company came today.

hindi: डाकपेटी — घर की चिट्ठियाँ आने वाला डिब्बा
definition: a letterbox or mailbox, the metal box at a house where the postman leaves letters and post (der Briefkasten, plural Briefkästen)
example: Schau mal in den Briefkasten. — Have a look in the letterbox.

hindi: डाक-टिकट — लिफ़ाफ़े पर चिपकाया जाने वाला डाक शुल्क का टिकट
definition: a postage stamp, the small printed sticker you attach to an envelope or parcel to pay for sending it (die Briefmarke, plural Briefmarken)
example: Ich brauche noch eine Briefmarke für diesen Umschlag. — I still need a stamp for this envelope.

hindi: डाकिया — घर-घर चिट्ठियाँ और पार्सल पहुँचाने वाला
definition: a postman or mail carrier, the person who delivers letters and parcels to homes, the traditional word (der Briefträger, plural Briefträger)
example: Der Briefträger kommt meistens gegen elf Uhr. — The postman usually comes around eleven.

hindi: चश्मा — आँखों पर पहने जाने वाले काँच के शीशे
definition: glasses or spectacles, the pair of lenses in a frame worn on the nose to correct eyesight (die Brille, plural Brillen)
example: Meine Brille liegt auf dem Tisch. — My glasses are on the table.

hindi: पहुँचाना — कोई चीज़ या व्यक्ति किसी जगह तक ले जाना
definition: to bring or take something or someone to a place, the general verb for carrying items to where they belong (brachte, hat gebracht)
example: Der Kellner bringt uns die Speisekarte. — The waiter brings us the menu.

hindi: मंद समीर — हल्की सुहावनी हवा
definition: a breeze, a light pleasant wind that cools the skin on a warm day, especially near the water (die Brise, plural Brisen)
example: Eine leichte Brise weht vom Meer herüber. — A light breeze blows over from the sea.

hindi: रोटी — आटे से बना सिंका हुआ मुख्य आहार, पाव या डबलरोटी
definition: bread, the baked staple made from flour and yeast that every German meal seems to circle around, typically sold as a dark loaf (das Brot, plural Brote)
example: Das Brot vom Bäcker ist noch warm. — The bread from the baker is still warm.

hindi: हल्का भोजन — बवेरिया में रोटी, सॉसेज, पनीर और बीयर का ठंडा नाश्ता
definition: the Bavarian cold snack meal of bread, sausage, cheese and radish eaten between main meals, often with a beer in the garden (die Brotzeit, plural Brotzeiten)
example: Nach der Wanderung machen wir eine Brotzeit. — After the hike we have a bread-and-sausage snack.

hindi: भिन्न — अंश और हर से लिखी आधी-पौनी जैसी संख्या
definition: a fraction in mathematics, a number written as one quantity above another to express part of a whole, also a physical break or fracture (der Bruch, plural Brüche)
example: Der Bruch drei Viertel ist größer als ein Halb. — The fraction three quarters is larger than one half.

hindi: भाई — एक ही माता-पिता का पुरुष सहोदर
definition: the brother, a male sibling who shares the same parents within the family (der Bruder, plural Brüder)
example: Mein Bruder ist zwei Jahre älter als ich. — My brother is two years older than me.

hindi: फ़व्वारा — चौक में पानी उछालने वाली सजावटी रचना; कुआँ
definition: a fountain in a town square or park where water spouts for decoration, also a well from which drinking water is drawn (der Brunnen, plural Brunnen)
example: Die Kinder spielen am Brunnen auf dem Marktplatz. — The children are playing by the fountain in the market square.

hindi: छाती — गर्दन और पेट के बीच शरीर का अगला भाग
definition: the chest or breast, the front upper part of the trunk between the neck and the belly (die Brust, plural Brüste)
example: Ich habe einen Druck auf der Brust. — I feel pressure on my chest.

hindi: दूल्हा — शादी के दिन का पुरुष
definition: a bridegroom, the male partner on his wedding day or shortly before it, waiting at the altar for the bride (der Bräutigam, plural Bräutigame)
example: Der Bräutigam wartete nervös vor dem Altar. — The groom waited nervously in front of the altar.

hindi: छोटा पाव — नाश्ते की गोल कुरकुरी डबलरोटी
definition: a bread roll, the small crusty individual bread bought fresh for breakfast, the standard northern German term for it (das Brötchen, plural Brötchen)
example: Die Brötchen vom Bäcker sind noch warm. — The rolls from the baker are still warm.

hindi: पुल — नदी या सड़क के ऊपर बना पार करने का ढाँचा
definition: a bridge, a structure carrying a road or path across a river, valley or another road (die Brücke, plural Brücken)
example: Über die Brücke kommt man in die Altstadt. — You reach the old town over the bridge.

hindi: पुल-दिवस — छुट्टी और सप्ताहांत के बीच पड़ने वाला अकेला कार्यदिवस
definition: a single working day bridging a public holiday and the weekend, taken off by very nearly everyone
example: The office was empty on Friday because the whole team booked the Brückentag.

hindi: दहाड़ना — गुस्से में बहुत ज़ोर से चिल्लाना
definition: to roar or bellow, shouting extremely loudly, used of angry people and of lions (regular: brüllt, hat gebrüllt)
example: Der Trainer brüllte über den ganzen Platz. — The coach bellowed across the whole pitch.

hindi: लड़का — छोटी उम्र का बालक, दक्षिणी और ऑस्ट्रियाई शब्द
definition: a boy, a young male child or youngster, the everyday southern German, Austrian and Swiss word where the north says Junge (der Bub, plural Buben)
example: Der Bub spielt im Hof Fußball. — The boy is playing football in the yard.

hindi: किताब — छपे हुए पन्नों की जिल्दबंद रचना जिसे पढ़ा जाता है
definition: a book, the bound volume of printed pages that people read for pleasure, study or reference (das Buch, plural Bücher)
example: Ich lese gerade ein spannendes Buch. — I am reading an exciting book right now.

hindi: पहले से तय करना — कमरा, सीट या यात्रा अग्रिम में ख़रीदकर पक्का कर लेना
definition: to book, to reserve and usually pay for a hotel room, flight, ticket or holiday in advance (regular)
example: Ich habe das Hotel schon im Januar gebucht. — I already booked the hotel in January.

hindi: मुनीम — कंपनी की आय-व्यय और हिसाब-किताब रखने वाला
definition: a bookkeeper or accountant, the person who records a company's income, expenses and accounts (der Buchhalter, plural Buchhalter)
example: Der Buchhalter prüft alle Rechnungen am Monatsende. — The bookkeeper checks all invoices at the end of the month.

hindi: किताबों की दुकान — जहाँ किताबें बेची जाती हैं
definition: a bookshop, the retail store where new books are sold and where authors sometimes give readings (die Buchhandlung, plural Buchhandlungen)
example: In der Buchhandlung am Markt gibt es eine große Kinderabteilung. — The bookshop on the market square has a large children's section.

hindi: खाड़ी — तट का समुद्र की ओर मुड़ा घेरा
definition: a bay or cove, a curved inlet of the sea where the coastline bends inward and boats find shelter (die Bucht, plural Buchten)
example: Das Boot liegt ruhig in der Bucht. — The boat lies calmly in the bay.

hindi: अग्रिम आरक्षण — कमरा, सीट या यात्रा पहले से तय कर लेना
definition: a booking, the reservation made in advance for a room, seat, flight or holiday (die Buchung, plural Buchungen)
example: Ihre Buchung wurde per E-Mail bestätigt. — Your booking was confirmed by email.

hindi: कमरा — बोलचाल में अपना फ़्लैट या ठिकाना
definition: a pad or place, colloquial for someone's flat or room, also a simple stall or shack (die Bude, plural Buden)
example: Komm mit auf meine Bude, wir schauen einen Film. — Come to my pad, we will watch a film.

hindi: आय-व्यय योजना — तय अवधि में ख़र्च की योजना या सीमा
definition: a budget, the plan or limit for how much money may be spent in a given period (das Budget, plural Budgets)
example: Unser Budget für den Urlaub ist knapp. — Our budget for the holiday is tight.

hindi: हल्की मोड़ने वाली बच्चागाड़ी — बैठ सकने वाले बच्चे के लिए सफ़र में आसान गाड़ी
definition: a lightweight folding stroller for a toddler who can already sit, handier than a pram for buses and travel (der Buggy, plural Buggys)
example: Für den Urlaub nehmen wir nur den leichten Buggy mit. — For the holiday we only take the light stroller.

hindi: कीमे की टिक्की — बर्लिन में तली हुई मांस की टिक्की
definition: the Berlin word for a fried flat meatball of minced meat, the same dish that the west calls Frikadelle, sold at every snack stand (die Bulette, plural Buletten)
example: Die Bulette mit Senf kostet drei Euro. — The meatball with mustard costs three euros.

hindi: मटरगश्ती करना — आराम से घूमना या बाज़ार में टहलना
definition: to stroll or wander idly through streets and shops, taking a leisurely walk without hurry; colloquially also to dawdle (regular: ist gebummelt)
example: Samstags bummeln wir gern durch die Innenstadt. — On Saturdays we like to stroll through the city centre.

hindi: गुच्छा — बाँधी हुई हरी सब्ज़ी या फूलों की गड्डी
definition: a bunch or bundle of herbs, radishes or carrots tied together and sold as one unit at the market (das Bund, plural Bunde)
example: Ein Bund Petersilie, bitte. — A bunch of parsley, please.

hindi: संघीय राज्य — जर्मनी को बनाने वाले सोलह प्रदेशों में से एक
definition: one of the sixteen federal states that together make up Germany, each with its own parliament and government (das Bundesland, plural Bundesländer)
example: In welchem Bundesland wohnst du jetzt? — Which federal state do you live in now?

hindi: रंग-बिरंगा — कई चमकीले रंगों वाला
definition: colourful or multicoloured, having many bright colours together, said of clothes and patterns
example: Die Kinder tragen bunte Mützen. — The children wear colourful hats.

hindi: क़िला — मध्ययुगीन मज़बूत दीवारों वाला दुर्ग
definition: a castle or fortress, a fortified medieval stronghold with thick walls usually built on a hill (die Burg, plural Burgen)
example: Die Burg steht seit achthundert Jahren auf dem Hügel. — The castle has stood on the hill for eight hundred years.

hindi: यात्री-वाहन — कई यात्रियों को तय रास्ते पर ले जाने वाली बड़ी सड़क गाड़ी
definition: a bus, the large road vehicle that carries many passengers along a fixed route (der Bus, plural Busse)
example: Der Bus kommt jeden Morgen um sieben. — The bus comes every morning at seven.

hindi: झाड़ी — ज़मीन से शाखाएँ निकालने वाला छोटा पौधा
definition: a bush or shrub, a low woody plant with many branches growing from near the ground (der Busch, plural Büsche)
example: Die Katze versteckt sich hinter dem Busch. — The cat hides behind the bush.

hindi: यात्री-वाहन का ठहराव — बड़ी सड़क गाड़ी के रुकने की निश्चित जगह
definition: a bus stop, the marked place where a bus halts so passengers can board and alight (die Bushaltestelle, plural Bushaltestellen)
example: An der Bushaltestelle steht eine Bank. — There is a bench at the bus stop.

hindi: मक्खन — मलाई से मथा हुआ ठोस वसा
definition: butter, the solid yellow fat churned from cream and spread thickly on bread at nearly every German breakfast and supper (die Butter, no plural)
example: Die Butter ist noch zu hart zum Streichen. — The butter is still too hard to spread.

hindi: जुर्माना — नियम तोड़ने पर सरकार को चुकाई जाने वाली राशि
definition: a fine, the sum of money the authorities demand for a traffic or minor legal offence (das Bußgeld, plural Bußgelder)
example: Für zu schnelles Fahren gibt es ein hohes Bußgeld. — There is a heavy fine for driving too fast.

hindi: नानबाई — रोटी बनाने वाला कारीगर, बोलचाल में बेकरी
definition: a baker, the person who bakes bread for a living, colloquially also the bakery shop itself as in going to the baker (der Bäcker, plural Bäcker)
example: Ich gehe kurz zum Bäcker. — I am going to the baker quickly.

hindi: नानबाई की दुकान — रोटी और मिठाई वाली डबलरोटी बनाने-बेचने की जगह
definition: a bakery, the shop where bread, rolls and pastries are baked and sold fresh every morning, found on nearly every German street (die Bäckerei, plural Bäckereien)
example: Die Bäckerei öffnet schon um sechs Uhr. — The bakery opens already at six o'clock.

hindi: भालू — भारी फ़र वाला बड़ा जंगली जानवर
definition: a bear, the large heavy wild animal with thick fur that sleeps through the winter (der Bär, plural Bären)
example: Der Bär schläft den ganzen Winter. — The bear sleeps the whole winter.

hindi: उल्टा नुकसान — मदद के इरादे से किया गया काम जो हानि पहुँचाए
definition: a well-meant favour that actually harms the person it was meant to help, literally a bear's service (der Bärendienst, plural Bärendienste)
example: Mit dem Lob hast du ihm einen Bärendienst erwiesen. — With that praise you did him a disservice.

hindi: ज़बरदस्त भूख — भालू जैसी बड़ी भूख
definition: a huge appetite, being extremely hungry, literally the hunger of a bear (der Bärenhunger, no plural)
example: Nach der Wanderung hatten wir alle einen Bärenhunger. — After the hike we were all ravenously hungry.

hindi: हवा का झोंका — अचानक आया तेज़ हवा का झटका
definition: a gust of wind, a sudden short strong blast of air that comes and passes within seconds (die Böe, plural Böen)
example: Eine Böe riss mir den Hut vom Kopf. — A gust tore the hat off my head.

hindi: पटाखा — ज़ोर की आवाज़ करने वाला बम जैसा पटाखा
definition: a firecracker or banger, the loud exploding firework that people light in the streets around midnight on New Year's Eve (der Böller, plural Böller)
example: Die Böller knallen die ganze Nacht. — The firecrackers bang all night long.

hindi: शेयर बाज़ार — जहाँ शेयरों की ख़रीद-बिक्री होती है; छोटा बटुआ
definition: the stock exchange where shares and securities are traded, also a small purse for coins (die Börse, plural Börsen)
example: An der Börse fielen die Kurse stark. — Prices fell sharply on the stock exchange.

hindi: सार्वजनिक पुस्तकालय — जहाँ से किताबें उधार ली जाती हैं
definition: a public lending library, usually a smaller town or neighbourhood one where people borrow books free of charge (die Bücherei, plural Büchereien)
example: Die Kinder leihen sich jede Woche Bücher aus der Bücherei. — The children borrow books from the library every week.

hindi: किताबी कीड़ा — किताबों में खोया रहने वाला उत्साही पाठक
definition: an avid reader who spends every free hour buried in books and enjoys reading above all else, a bookworm, affectionate and slightly teasing (der Bücherwurm, plural Bücherwürmer)
example: Als Kind war ich ein Bücherwurm und saß immer in der Bibliothek. — As a child I was a bookworm and always sat in the library.

hindi: टिन का डिब्बा — खाने की चीज़ रखने का बंद धातु का डिब्बा
definition: a tin or can, the sealed metal container for preserved food, slightly older word than Dose and common in the south (die Büchse, plural Büchsen)
example: In der Büchse sind Bohnen. — There are beans in the tin.

hindi: घोटा लगाना — थकाऊ ढंग से लंबे समय तक पढ़ना
definition: to swot or grind away at studying, to learn something with dogged effort, colloquial (regular)
example: Er büffelt jeden Abend Vokabeln. — He swots vocabulary every evening.

hindi: इस्तरी की मेज़ — कपड़े प्रेस करने का गद्देदार तख़्ता
definition: an ironing board, the narrow padded folding table on which clothes are laid to be ironed (das Bügelbrett, plural Bügelbretter)
example: Das Bügelbrett steht zusammengeklappt hinter der Tür. — The ironing board stands folded up behind the door.

hindi: इस्तरी — कपड़े प्रेस करने का गर्म होने वाला उपकरण
definition: an iron, the heated flat-bottomed appliance pressed over clothes to remove creases and wrinkles (das Bügeleisen, plural Bügeleisen)
example: Das Bügeleisen ist noch heiß, pass auf. — The iron is still hot, be careful.

hindi: इस्तरी करना — गर्म इस्तरी से कपड़ों की सिलवटें हटाना
definition: to iron clothes, pressing shirts, trousers or sheets with a heated iron to smooth out creases (regular)
example: Er bügelt seine Hemden jeden Sonntagabend. — He irons his shirts every Sunday evening.

hindi: मंच — थिएटर में जहाँ कलाकार प्रदर्शन करते हैं
definition: a stage, the raised platform in a theatre or hall on which actors, singers and musicians perform (die Bühne, plural Bühnen)
example: Die Kinder stehen zum ersten Mal auf der Bühne. — The children are standing on stage for the first time.

hindi: संकीर्ण सोच वाला आदमी — नियमों और साफ़-सुथरे बगीचे का दीवाना घरेलू नागरिक
definition: a narrow-minded petty bourgeois person obsessed with rules, order and a tidy lawn, the mocking Swiss word for a small-town conformist (der Bünzli, plural Bünzli)
example: Mein Nachbar ist ein echter Bünzli mit seinem Rasen. — My neighbour is a real square with his lawn.

hindi: नागरिक — किसी राज्य या शहर का हक़दार और दायित्ववान सदस्य
definition: a citizen, a person who belongs to a state or town and holds its rights and duties (der Bürger, plural Bürger)
example: Die Bürger dürfen den Bürgermeister direkt wählen. — The citizens may elect the mayor directly.

hindi: नागरिक सेवा कार्यालय — पंजीकरण और पहचान पत्र के काम वाला स्थानीय दफ़्तर
definition: the citizens' office, the local government service point for registration, identity cards and permits (das Bürgeramt, plural Bürgerämter)
example: Ich habe einen Termin im Bürgeramt um zehn. — I have an appointment at the citizens' office at ten.

hindi: महापौर — शहर या क़स्बे का चुना हुआ प्रमुख
definition: the mayor, the elected head of a town or city who leads the local administration from the town hall (der Bürgermeister, plural Bürgermeister)
example: Der Bürgermeister eröffnet heute die neue Brücke. — The mayor is opening the new bridge today.

hindi: पटरी — सड़क के किनारे पैदल चलने का ऊँचा रास्ता
definition: the sidewalk or pavement, the paved walkway beside the road for pedestrians, a slightly more colloquial word than Gehweg (der Bürgersteig, plural Bürgersteige)
example: Auf dem Bürgersteig standen viele Fahrräder. — There were many bicycles standing on the sidewalk.

hindi: दफ़्तर — जहाँ बैठकर कागज़ी और कंप्यूटर का काम होता है
definition: an office, the room or building where administrative and desk work is done during working hours (das Büro, plural Büros)
example: Ich bin heute bis sechs im Büro. — I am in the office until six today.

hindi: कहवाघर — कहवा, मीठे पकवान और हल्का खाना मिलने वाली जगह
definition: a café or coffee house, the place serving coffee, cake and light meals where people meet in the afternoon (das Café, plural Cafés)
example: Wir treffen uns um drei im Café am Markt. — We meet at three in the café by the market.

hindi: शिविर-स्थल — तंबू और गाड़ी-घर लगाने की जगह, जहाँ शौचालय और पानी मिलते हैं
definition: a campsite, a fenced ground where people pitch tents or park caravans and share toilets and water (der Campingplatz, plural Campingplätze)
example: Der Campingplatz liegt direkt am See. — The campsite is right beside the lake.

hindi: परिसर — विश्वविद्यालय की इमारतों और मैदानों का पूरा क्षेत्र
definition: a campus, the grounds and buildings of a university where students study, eat and meet (der Campus, plural Campus)
example: Auf dem Campus gibt es ein neues Café. — There is a new café on campus.

hindi: मौक़ा — सफल होने की संभावना या अवसर
definition: a chance, the opportunity or likelihood of success in something, pronounced in the French manner and very common in everyday speech (die Chance, plural Chancen)
example: Gib ihm noch eine Chance! — Give him one more chance!

hindi: चरित्र — व्यक्ति के स्वभाव और नैतिक गुणों का समूह
definition: the moral nature and stable combination of traits that make a person who they truly are, their character (der Charakter, plural Charaktere)
example: Er hat einen starken Charakter und gibt nie auf. — He has a strong character and never gives up.

hindi: लिखकर बतियाना — अंतरजाल पर लिखित संदेशों से बातचीत करना
definition: to chat online, to exchange written messages in real time with someone through an app or website (regular)
example: Ich chatte jeden Abend mit meiner Schwester. — I chat with my sister every evening.

hindi: समझना — बोलचाल में बात पकड़ना, जाँचना
definition: to understand or twig, also to check something, youth and everyday colloquial borrowed from English (regular)
example: Ich check das einfach nicht. — I just do not get it.

hindi: मालिक — काम पर आदेश देने वाला प्रमुख या अधिकारी
definition: the boss, the person in charge at work who gives orders and runs the team or company, everyday register (der Chef, plural Chefs)
example: Der Chef will uns um zehn Uhr sprechen. — The boss wants to speak to us at ten o'clock.

hindi: महिला अफ़सर — कंपनी या विभाग की महिला प्रमुख
definition: a female boss, the woman who heads a company or department and gives the orders (die Chefin, plural Chefinnen)
example: Unsere Chefin ist sehr fair. — Our boss is very fair.

hindi: आराम फ़रमाना — बिना काम के सुकून से समय बिताना
definition: to relax, hang out and take it easy without doing anything in particular, the youth-slang verb borrowed from English (regular: hat gechillt)
example: Wir chillen heute einfach zu Hause. — We are just chilling at home today.

hindi: आरामदेह, सुकूनभरा — तनावरहित माहौल
definition: relaxed, laid-back or pleasantly calm, youth slang for a mellow atmosphere, an easy evening or gentle music
example: Der Abend am See war richtig chillig. — The evening by the lake was really chilled.

hindi: गायक मंडली — साथ मिलकर गाने वाला समूह
definition: a choir, a group of people who sing together, often as a leisure club (der Chor, plural Chöre)
example: Meine Mutter singt im Chor der Gemeinde. — My mother sings in the parish choir.

hindi: क्रिसमस का पेड़ — दक्षिणी जर्मनी और ऑस्ट्रिया में प्रचलित नाम
definition: the Christmas tree, a decorated evergreen fir placed in the house during the festive holiday season, the usual southern German and Austrian word (der Christbaum, plural Christbäume)
example: Der Christbaum wird bei uns erst am Heiligabend geschmückt. — At our house the Christmas tree is only decorated on Christmas Eve.

hindi: बाल ईसा — दक्षिणी जर्मनी में क्रिसमस पर उपहार लाने वाली देवदूत जैसी आकृति
definition: the Christ Child, the angel-like figure that brings the Christmas presents in southern Germany and Austria instead of Father Christmas (das Christkind, plural Christkinder)
example: Das Christkind bringt die Geschenke am Heiligabend. — The Christ Child brings the presents on Christmas Eve.

hindi: क्रिसमस बाज़ार — दक्षिणी जर्मनी और ऑस्ट्रिया में इसका पारंपरिक नाम
definition: the Christmas market with wooden stalls selling mulled wine, sweets and handmade gifts, the traditional southern German and Austrian name for it (der Christkindlmarkt, plural Christkindlmärkte)
example: Der Christkindlmarkt öffnet Ende November. — The Christmas market opens at the end of November.

hindi: इतिवृत्त — घटनाओं का क्रमवार लिखित ब्योरा
definition: a chronicle, a written record of events in the order they happened, often of a town or family (die Chronik, plural Chroniken)
example: Die Chronik des Dorfes reicht bis 1450 zurück. — The chronicle of the village goes back to 1450.

hindi: लगभग — तक़रीबन, अंदाज़ से
definition: circa, approximately, roughly; a borrowed Latin adverb placed before numbers and dates in estimates, usually abbreviated to ca in writing
example: Die Fahrt dauert circa zwei Stunden. — The journey takes about two hours.

hindi: चतुर, होशियार — व्यावहारिक समझदारी वाला
definition: smart, shrewd or cleverly resourceful, a borrowed English adjective for people and ideas that solve things skilfully
example: Das war eine clevere Lösung. — That was a clever solution.

hindi: नाई — बाल काटने और सँवारने वाला, स्विस शब्द
definition: a hairdresser or barber who cuts and styles hair, the Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Friseur (der Coiffeur, plural Coiffeure)
example: Ich habe morgen einen Termin beim Coiffeur. — I have an appointment at the hairdresser tomorrow.

hindi: संगणक — काम, लेखन और गणना की बिजली से चलने वाली मशीन
definition: a computer, the electronic machine used for work, writing, calculation and going online; borrowed from English and pronounced almost the same (der Computer, plural Computer)
example: Sie sitzt den ganzen Tag am Computer. — She sits at the computer all day.

hindi: बढ़िया, शानदार — पसंद आने वाला या शांत-सधा हुआ
definition: excellent, impressive or admirably relaxed, the everyday colloquial word of approval borrowed from English and used by every generation
example: Das neue Café ist echt cool. — The new café is really cool.

hindi: गद्देदार दीवान — बैठक का लंबा आरामदेह आसन
definition: a couch, the everyday word for the long upholstered sofa people relax on in a living room (die Couch, plural Couches)
example: Wir sehen auf der Couch einen Film. — We are watching a film on the couch.

hindi: चचेरा या ममेरा भाई — चाचा-मामा या मौसी-बुआ का बेटा
definition: the male cousin, the son of one's uncle or aunt, a word borrowed from French and pronounced that way (der Cousin, plural Cousins)
example: Mein Cousin kommt zu Weihnachten zu Besuch. — My cousin is coming to visit at Christmas.

hindi: चचेरी या ममेरी बहन — चाचा-मामा या मौसी-बुआ की बेटी
definition: the female cousin, the daughter of one's uncle or aunt, also written Kusine (die Cousine, plural Cousinen)
example: Meine Cousine und ich sind gleich alt. — My cousin and I are the same age.

hindi: वहाँ, यहाँ — उस जगह पर; मौजूद होना
definition: there or here, at the place being pointed at or talked about, also meaning present, available or attending, the most common everyday location word
example: Ist Frau Müller heute da? — Is Mrs Müller here today?

hindi: लो, हो गई गड़बड़ — जिस मुसीबत का डर था वही आ गई
definition: now we are in a mess, exactly the trouble someone predicted has arrived and things have gone wrong (colloquial exclamation, literally there we have the salad)
example: Der Akku ist leer, da haben wir den Salat! — The battery is dead, now we are in a fine mess!

hindi: कुछ गड़बड़ है — काम में कोई छिपी खराबी बार-बार अड़चन डाल रही है
definition: something keeps going wrong and a hidden fault spoils the whole project (colloquial, literally the worm is inside)
example: Seit Wochen funktioniert nichts, da ist der Wurm drin. — Nothing has worked for weeks, something is rotten here.

hindi: यही असली बात है — समस्या की असली जड़ या कारण यहीं छिपा है
definition: this is the real cause or crux of the problem, the hidden reason behind a difficulty
example: Das Kabel war locker, da liegt der Hund begraben! — The cable was loose, that is the root of the trouble!

hindi: जबकि, हालाँकि — विरोधाभास या साथ की परिस्थिति बताने वाला शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning at the same time or yet, pointing out a fact that contradicts what was just described
example: Er sieht müde aus, dabei hat er lange geschlafen. — He looks tired, yet he slept long.

hindi: छत — इमारत की ऊपरी ढकने वाली संरचना
definition: a roof, the covering structure on top of a building that keeps out rain and snow (das Dach, plural Dächer)
example: Das Dach ist undicht. — The roof is leaking.

hindi: अटारी — छत के नीचे का ऊपरी भंडार कक्ष
definition: the attic or loft, the space directly under the roof of a house, often used for storage (der Dachboden, plural Dachböden)
example: Auf dem Dachboden stehen alte Kisten. — There are old boxes in the attic.

hindi: छत बनाने वाला — खपरैल या स्लेट से छत ढकने और सुधारने वाला
definition: a roofer, the tradesperson who covers and repairs roofs with tiles, slates or metal sheets (der Dachdecker, plural Dachdecker)
example: Nach dem Sturm ruft sie sofort den Dachdecker. — After the storm she calls the roofer immediately.

hindi: छत के नीचे की मंज़िल — छत के ठीक नीचे ढलवाँ दीवारों वाला तल
definition: the attic storey, the top floor directly under the roof with sloping walls (das Dachgeschoss, plural Dachgeschosse)
example: Im Dachgeschoss ist es im Sommer sehr heiß. — It is very hot on the attic floor in summer.

hindi: लंबे बदन का छोटा कुत्ता — छोटी टाँगों वाली, बिज्जू के शिकार के लिए पाली गई नस्ल
definition: a small breed of hunting dog with a long body and short legs, the everyday word for what English calls a dachshund, a name Germans rarely use (der Dackel, plural Dackel)
example: Der kleine Dackel gräbt gern im Garten. — The little dachshund likes digging in the garden.

hindi: उसके द्वारा — उस कारण या साधन से
definition: through that means, because of it, as the result of the thing just mentioned (prepositional adverb from durch + das)
example: Dadurch sparen wir viel Zeit. — Through that we save a lot of time.

hindi: उसके लिए — उस चीज़ के पक्ष में या उसके बदले में
definition: for that purpose, in favour of that thing, or in return as compensation for something else (prepositional adverb from für + das)
example: Ich habe dafür kein Geld. — I have no money for that.

hindi: इसके उलट — तुलना में विपरीत बात या किसी चीज़ के ख़िलाफ़
definition: on the other hand, against that; an adverb contrasting two things, also meaning against it
example: Ich mag Tee, mein Bruder dagegen trinkt nur Kaffee. — I like tea, my brother on the other hand drinks only coffee.

hindi: घर पर — अपने घर में, विशेषकर दक्षिणी बोली में
definition: at home, inside one's own house or flat, the warm southern German, Swiss and Austrian word for being where one lives
example: Am Sonntag bleiben wir gemütlich daheim. — On Sunday we stay cosily at home.

hindi: अतः — थोड़ा औपचारिक ढंग से परिणाम बताने वाला शब्द
definition: hence, therefore; a slightly more formal adverb stating a consequence or the origin of something
example: Der Laden ist geschlossen, daher kaufen wir morgen ein. — The shop is closed, hence we shop tomorrow.

hindi: उस ओर — उस जगह तक, बोलचाल में
definition: to that place, toward there, the everyday spoken direction word for heading somewhere already mentioned
example: Ich fahre morgen mit dem Zug dahin. — I am going there by train tomorrow.

hindi: उन दिनों — बीते समय के उस दौर में
definition: back then, at that earlier time in the past which the speaker is remembering or talking about
example: Damals gab es noch kein Internet. — Back then there was no internet yet.

hindi: ताकि — किसी काम का उद्देश्य बताने वाला शब्द
definition: so that, in order that; a conjunction stating the purpose or intended result of an action when the subjects differ, verb at the clause end
example: Sprich lauter, damit alle dich hören. — Speak louder so that everyone hears you.

hindi: उसके बाद — किसी घटना के पश्चात
definition: afterwards, after that event or point in time, following something that was just mentioned
example: Danach waren alle sehr müde. — Afterwards everyone was very tired.

hindi: उसके बगल में — उस चीज़ के पास, साथ में
definition: beside it or next to that thing, at the place directly alongside something already mentioned
example: Hier ist der Bahnhof, das Hotel steht daneben. — Here is the station, the hotel stands next to it.

hindi: की बदौलत — किसी की मदद या अच्छे कारण से
definition: thanks to, owing to the helpful cause or person credited with a good outcome (preposition, + Dativ or Genitiv)
example: Dank deiner Hilfe habe ich die Prüfung bestanden. — Thanks to your help I passed the exam.

hindi: आभारी — कृतज्ञता से भरा
definition: grateful and thankful, appreciating help, kindness or generosity received from another person (dankbar für + Akkusativ)
example: Wir sind für Ihre Hilfe sehr dankbar. — We are very grateful for your help.

hindi: कृतज्ञता — मदद करने वाले के प्रति आभार का भाव
definition: gratitude, the warm thankful feeling toward someone who has helped or given something (die Dankbarkeit, no plural)
example: Die Dankbarkeit der Gäste war groß. — The guests' gratitude was great.

hindi: धन्यवाद — आभार जताने का सबसे आम शब्द
definition: the everyday word of thanks, spoken alone or with an intensifier such as vielen or schön
example: Danke für deine Hilfe! — Thanks for your help!

hindi: किसी चीज़ के लिए धन्यवाद कहना — मिली मदद या तोहफ़े पर आभार जताना
definition: to thank somebody for help, a gift or a favour, expressing gratitude and appreciation to them (+ Dativ, für + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Ich danke Ihnen für Ihre Hilfe. — I thank you for your help.

hindi: धन्यवाद — आभार का शब्द या छोटा उपहार
definition: a thank-you spoken warmly, or a small present given to express gratitude to someone (das Dankeschön, no plural)
example: Das Dankeschön für die Nachbarn steht schon bereit. — The thank-you gift for the neighbours is ready.

hindi: फिर, तब — उसके बाद, अगले चरण में
definition: then, next in a sequence of events, after that step, the most common word for ordering actions in a story
example: Wir essen zuerst und dann gehen wir spazieren. — We eat first and then we go for a walk.

hindi: उस पर — उस चीज़ से लगकर, या उसके बारे में सोचते हुए
definition: on that thing, attached to it, or about it when thinking, remembering or working on something (prepositional adverb from an + das)
example: Ich erinnere mich gut daran. — I remember it well.

hindi: उस पर — उसके ऊपर, या उसके बाद, या उसकी प्रतीक्षा में
definition: on top of that thing, following after it, or referring to something waited for or relied upon (prepositional adverb from auf + das)
example: Wir freuen uns schon darauf. — We are already looking forward to it.

hindi: उसमें से — उस चीज़ से बाहर या उससे बनाकर
definition: out of that, from inside it, or made or concluded from something just mentioned (prepositional adverb from aus + das)
example: Daraus lernen wir für das nächste Mal. — We learn from that for next time.

hindi: कर्ज़ — औपचारिक शब्द, किस्तों में लौटाई जाने वाली उधार रकम
definition: a loan, the formal word for money lent by a bank that is repaid in instalments (das Darlehen, plural Darlehen)
example: Das Darlehen läuft über zehn Jahre. — The loan runs for ten years.

hindi: आँत — पेट के अंदर की लंबी नली जिसमें भोजन पचता है
definition: the bowel or intestine, the long tube inside the belly where digested food passes through (der Darm, plural Därme)
example: Ballaststoffe sind gut für den Darm. — Fibre is good for the bowel.

hindi: किरदार निभाने वाला — किसी खास भूमिका का अभिनेता
definition: a performer or actor playing a particular role in a film or stage production, often used in credits (der Darsteller, plural Darsteller)
example: Alle Darsteller kamen nach der Aufführung auf die Bühne. — All the performers came onto the stage after the performance.

hindi: इसीलिए — कही गई बात का नतीजा बताने वाला शब्द
definition: that is why, therefore; a common spoken adverb stating the consequence of what was just said
example: Er hat keine Zeit, darum kommt er nicht mit. — He has no time, that is why he is not coming along.

hindi: उसके नीचे — उसके तले, या उनमें शामिल
definition: underneath that, below it, or among them as part of a group just mentioned (prepositional adverb from unter + das)
example: Viele Gäste kamen, darunter auch mein Lehrer. — Many guests came, among them my teacher.

hindi: उसके बारे में — उस विषय पर, या उसके ऊपर
definition: about that topic, concerning it in talk or thought, or physically above or across it (prepositional adverb from über + das)
example: Wir reden später darüber. — We will talk about it later.

hindi: इसके अलावा — बताई बात से आगे कुछ और जोड़ना
definition: beyond that, furthermore; a formal connector adding something that goes further than what was mentioned
example: Das Hotel bietet darüber hinaus ein Schwimmbad. — Beyond that, the hotel offers a swimming pool.

hindi: बेकार का व्यक्ति — जिसकी किसी समूह में ज़रूरत न हो
definition: a person who feels superfluous or unwanted in a group, especially beside a couple, the useless extra member nobody needs
example: Bei den beiden Verliebten fühlte ich mich wie das fünfte Rad am Wagen. — With the two lovebirds I felt like a third wheel.

hindi: सबसे उम्दा चीज़ — आदर्श या बेहतरीन समाधान
definition: the very best part or ideal solution, often used negatively to say something is far from perfect (colloquial)
example: Die Lösung ist nicht das Gelbe vom Ei, aber sie funktioniert. — The solution is not exactly perfect, but it works.

term: das Haar in der Suppe finden
hindi: हर चीज़ में खोट निकालना — छोटी-सी कमी ढूँढ़ निकालना
definition: to find fault with everything, spotting a small flaw in something otherwise good
example: Sie findet immer das Haar in der Suppe, egal wie gut es läuft. — She always finds something to complain about, no matter how well things go.

term: das Herz auf der Zunge tragen
hindi: मन की बात खुलकर कहना — जो महसूस हो वह तुरंत कह देना
