definition: to wear one's heart on one's sleeve, openly saying whatever one feels without holding anything back (hat das Herz auf der Zunge getragen)
example: Sie trägt ihr Herz auf der Zunge. — She wears her heart on her sleeve.

hindi: मुझे कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता — जो हो, चलेगा
definition: used to say that you really do not care either way, a colloquial idiom for complete indifference to a choice, literally that is sausage to me
example: Pizza oder Pasta? Das ist mir Wurst. — Pizza or pasta? I do not mind.

hindi: यह मेरा मामला नहीं — इससे मेरा कोई सरोकार नहीं
definition: this is not my business or responsibility, meaning the speaker refuses to worry about the matter or become involved (colloquial)
example: Wer die Rechnung zahlt, ist nicht mein Bier. — Who pays the bill is not my concern.

hindi: यह सही है — किसी की बात को सच मानकर सहमति जताना
definition: the everyday spoken phrase that confirms another person is right, meaning that is correct or true
example: Das stimmt, du hast recht. — That is right, you are correct.

hindi: सत्-अस्तित्व — भीतर से जिया जाने वाला मानव होना
definition: human existence regarded as something that must be lived, questioned and answered from the inside
example: Heidegger asks what it means to be, and answers only from within Dasein.

hindi: कि — कही, सोची या चाही गई बात जोड़ने वाला शब्द
definition: that; the essential conjunction introducing a reported statement, thought, feeling or wish after verbs like sagen, glauben, hoffen, with the verb sent to the clause end
example: Ich glaube, dass er morgen kommt. — I believe that he is coming tomorrow.

hindi: संचिका — संगणक में नाम से सहेजा गया दस्तावेज़, चित्र या आँकड़े
definition: a computer file, a stored document, picture, video or program saved under a name on a computer, phone or in the cloud (die Datei, plural Dateien)
example: Die Datei ist leider zu groß für eine E-Mail. — Unfortunately the file is too large for an email.

hindi: तारीख़ — पंचांग में किसी दिन का नाम और संख्या
definition: the date, the day, month and year that identify a particular calendar day (das Datum, plural Daten)
example: Das Datum steht oben auf dem Brief. — The date is at the top of the letter.

hindi: स्थायी आदेश — बैंक को नियमित तय रकम भेजने का निर्देश
definition: a standing order, an instruction to the bank to send a fixed amount to the same recipient regularly (der Dauerauftrag, plural Daueraufträge)
example: Ich habe einen Dauerauftrag für die Miete eingerichtet. — I have set up a standing order for the rent.

hindi: समय लेना — किसी काम या घटना में देर लगना
definition: to last or take a certain amount of time, said of events, journeys and processes (regular, hat gedauert)
example: Der Film dauert zwei Stunden. — The film lasts two hours.

hindi: लगातार, हर समय — बार-बार, झुँझलाहट के साथ
definition: continually, all the time, over and over again, colloquial and usually complaining about something repeated
example: Er unterbricht mich dauernd. — He keeps interrupting me all the time.

hindi: अँगूठा — हाथ की सबसे मोटी छोटी उँगली
definition: the thumb, the short thick first finger of the hand set apart from the other four (der Daumen, plural Daumen)
example: Ich drücke dir die Daumen für die Prüfung. — I am keeping my fingers crossed for your exam.

hindi: शुभकामना देना — किसी की कामयाबी के लिए मन से दुआ करना
definition: to press the thumbs, the German gesture of wishing someone luck before an exam or match (jemandem die Daumen drücken, + Dativ; hat gedrückt)
example: Ich drücke dir morgen die Daumen! — I will keep my fingers crossed for you tomorrow!

hindi: उससे — उस चीज़ से, उसका हिस्सा, या उसके बारे में
definition: of that, from it, some portion of it, or away from that thing or place (prepositional adverb from von + das)
example: Ich habe nichts davon gewusst. — I knew nothing about it.

hindi: उसके साथ — उस चीज़ में जोड़कर, या उस उद्देश्य के लिए
definition: in addition to that, along with it, or for that purpose, also giving one's opinion about it (prepositional adverb from zu + das)
example: Dazu gibt es Reis und Salat. — With that there is rice and salad.

hindi: बहस — संसद या जनता में विरोधी विचारों की औपचारिक चर्चा
definition: a debate, a formal discussion of opposing views in parliament or in public about a question (die Debatte, plural Debatten)
example: Die Debatte im Bundestag dauerte fünf Stunden. — The debate in the Bundestag lasted five hours.

hindi: कंबल / छत — ओढ़ने की चादर या कमरे की ऊपरी सतह
definition: a blanket or duvet that covers a sleeping person, and also the ceiling, the upper surface of a room (die Decke, plural Decken)
example: Die Decke ist warm und weich. — The blanket is warm and soft.

hindi: ढक्कन — बर्तन या डिब्बे को ऊपर से ढकने वाला हिस्सा
definition: a lid or cover, the flat removable piece placed over a cooking pot, glass jar or cardboard box to close it (der Deckel, plural Deckel)
example: Leg den Deckel auf den Topf. — Put the lid on the pot.

hindi: मेज़ लगाना — खाने से पहले थाली, बर्तन सजाना; ढकना
definition: to set the table with plates, glasses and cutlery before a meal, and in general to cover something (regular: deckt, hat gedeckt)
example: Deckst du bitte den Tisch? — Will you please set the table?

hindi: लड़की — उत्तरी जर्मनी में लड़की या युवती के लिए बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: the northern German and Low German word for a girl or young woman, warm and homely, the coastal counterpart of Mädchen (die Deern, plural Deerns)
example: Die Deern kommt aus einem Dorf bei Hamburg. — The girl comes from a village near Hamburg.

hindi: ख़राब — तकनीकी रूप से दोषपूर्ण, काम न करने वाला
definition: defective or faulty, the slightly formal or technical word for a device or machine that is broken and does not work properly
example: Der Aufzug ist leider defekt. — The elevator is unfortunately out of order.

hindi: खींचना — मांसपेशियों को तानकर लचीला बनाना
definition: to stretch, to lengthen the muscles slowly before or after exercise to stay flexible and avoid injury (regular, hat gedehnt; often reflexive sich dehnen)
example: Nach dem Laufen dehne ich meine Beine. — After running I stretch my legs.

hindi: तटबंध — बाढ़ से बचाने के लिए बनाया मिट्टी का ऊँचा बाँध
definition: a dike or levee, a raised earthen embankment built along the coast or a river to hold back flood water (der Deich, plural Deiche)
example: Wir spazieren auf dem Deich entlang. — We walk along the top of the dike.

hindi: तेरा / तुम्हारा — अनौपचारिक सम्बोधन का स्वामित्व
definition: the possessive determiner meaning belonging to the informally addressed person, declined like the indefinite article before a noun (deine Tasche, deinen Schlüssel)
example: Ist das dein Fahrrad vor der Tür? — Is that your bicycle in front of the door?

hindi: लज़ीज़ व्यंजन — चुनिंदा, महँगा और स्वादिष्ट खाने का सामान
definition: a fine or rare food regarded as a special treat, the plural of which gave English its delicatessen shops (die Delikatesse, plural Delikatessen)
example: Frische Trüffel sind eine teure Delikatesse. — Fresh truffles are an expensive delicacy.

hindi: अपराध — क़ानून का उल्लंघन, ख़ासकर दंडनीय कृत्य
definition: an offence or delict, a punishable violation of the criminal law, somewhat formal legal term for a crime (das Delikt, plural Delikte)
example: Ladendiebstahl ist ein häufiges Delikt. — Shoplifting is a common offence.

hindi: मनोभ्रंश — बुढ़ापे में याद और समझ खोने की बीमारी
definition: dementia, the illness of old age in which memory and thinking gradually fade away (die Demenz, plural Demenzen)
example: Die Demenz seiner Mutter wird langsam schlimmer. — His mother's dementia is slowly getting worse.

hindi: शीघ्र ही, निकट भविष्य में — आने वाले दिनों में
definition: shortly, in the near future, before long, often used for planned events that are coming soon
example: Der neue Film kommt demnächst ins Kino. — The new film is coming to cinemas shortly.

hindi: लोकतंत्र — जनता का स्वतंत्र चुनावों से शासन करने की व्यवस्था
definition: democracy, a system of government in which the people rule through free elections and representatives (die Demokratie, plural Demokratien)
example: Die Demokratie lebt von der Beteiligung der Bürger. — Democracy lives on the participation of citizens.

hindi: लोकतांत्रिक — जनता के शासन के सिद्धांतों पर चलने वाला
definition: democratic, following the principles of rule by the people through elections and equal rights
example: Die Entscheidung wurde demokratisch getroffen. — The decision was made democratically.

hindi: प्रदर्शन — विरोध या समर्थन में सार्वजनिक जुलूस
definition: a demonstration, a public march or gathering held to protest against or support a cause (die Demonstration, plural Demonstrationen)
example: Tausende kamen zur Demonstration in der Innenstadt. — Thousands came to the demonstration in the city centre.

hindi: प्रदर्शन करना — सार्वजनिक विरोध जुलूस में भाग लेना
definition: to demonstrate, to take part in a public protest march for or against something (regular, hat demonstriert, für/gegen + Akkusativ)
example: Die Schüler demonstrieren für besseren Klimaschutz. — The pupils are demonstrating for better climate protection.

hindi: विनम्रता — अहंकार-रहित, नम्र भाव
definition: humility, the modest attitude of not thinking oneself better than others, valued in religion and ethics (die Demut, no plural)
example: Seine Demut hat alle beeindruckt. — His humility impressed everyone.

hindi: चोर को चौकीदार बनाना — गलत व्यक्ति को ज़िम्मेदारी सौंप देना
definition: to give a task to exactly the wrong person, one who will abuse or ruin what they are meant to protect
example: Den Bankräuber zum Kassierer machen? Das heißt den Bock zum Gärtner machen. — Making the bank robber a cashier? That is setting the fox to guard the henhouse.

term: den Kopf in den Sand stecken
hindi: सच्चाई से मुँह मोड़ना — मुसीबत से आँख चुराना, उसे अनदेखा करना
definition: to bury one's head in the sand, refusing to face an unpleasant problem or danger (hat den Kopf in den Sand gesteckt)
example: Du kannst nicht ewig den Kopf in den Sand stecken. — You cannot bury your head in the sand forever.

hindi: होश खो बैठना — घबराहट में सूझ-बूझ गँवा देना
definition: to lose one's head, panicking and losing the ability to think clearly in a crisis (hat den Kopf verloren)
example: Bleib ruhig und verlier jetzt nicht den Kopf! — Stay calm and do not lose your head now!

hindi: खरी-खोटी सुनाना — किसी को कड़ी डाँट लगाना
definition: to give someone a severe scolding, a harsh telling-off for mistakes or thoughtless behaviour (jemandem den Kopf waschen; hat gewaschen)
example: Die Chefin hat ihm gründlich den Kopf gewaschen. — The boss gave him a proper dressing-down.

hindi: चल बसना — बोलचाल में मर जाना
definition: to pass away or die, a very casual and slightly irreverent expression for death, used about people or pets (colloquial, literally to hand in the spoon; perfect: hat den Löffel abgegeben)
example: Der alte Kater hat letzte Woche den Löffel abgegeben. — The old tomcat kicked the bucket last week.

hindi: मुँह बंद रखना — चुप रहना, बोलने से बाज़ आना
definition: to keep quiet or shut up, a blunt colloquial expression for holding your tongue (irregular: hält den Mund, hat den Mund gehalten)
example: Halt jetzt bitte den Mund! — Please be quiet now!

term: den Nagel auf den Kopf treffen
hindi: सटीक बात कहना — बिल्कुल सही निशाने पर लगना
definition: to describe or judge something exactly right, hitting the nail on the head
example: Mit deiner Bemerkung hast du den Nagel auf den Kopf getroffen. — With your remark you hit the nail on the head.

hindi: सबसे बढ़कर करना — सबसे बढ़िया या सबसे बुरी हरकत करना
definition: to outdo everyone else, either with the best achievement or, ironically, with the most outrageous blunder
example: Mit dieser Ausrede hast du wirklich den Vogel abgeschossen. — With that excuse you really took the cake.

hindi: सोचना — मन में विचार करना या राय रखना
definition: to think, to employ the mind to form thoughts, opinions, plans or ideas about something or someone (irregular: hat gedacht; an + Akkusativ)
example: Ich denke oft an meine Kindheit. — I often think about my childhood.

hindi: किसी को याद करना — किसी व्यक्ति या बात को मन में रखना
definition: to think of somebody or something, keeping a person, event or matter present in your mind (an + Akkusativ, denkt, hat gedacht)
example: Ich denke oft an meine Großmutter. — I often think of my grandmother.

hindi: स्मारक — किसी व्यक्ति या घटना की याद में बनी प्रतिमा
definition: a monument or memorial, a statue or structure erected to honour a person or remember an event (das Denkmal, plural Denkmäler)
example: Vor dem Denkmal liegen frische Blumen. — There are fresh flowers in front of the memorial.

hindi: आख़िर, भला — सवाल को सहज और रुचि भरा बनाने वाला शब्द
definition: a particle placed inside questions to make them sound natural, curious or slightly surprised instead of blunt and abrupt; as a conjunction it also means because
example: Was machst du denn hier? — What are you doing here, then?

hindi: फिर भी — बाधा के बावजूद बात पूरी होने का शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning nevertheless that says something holds true despite the obstacle just mentioned
example: Es regnete, dennoch gingen wir spazieren. — It was raining, yet we went for a walk.

hindi: अवसादग्रस्त — मन बुझा हुआ, निराशा में डूबा
definition: depressed and downcast, feeling gloomy, hopeless and without energy or motivation for a longer stretch of time
example: Nach der Absage war sie tagelang deprimiert. — After the rejection she was depressed for days.

hindi: वह (जो) — जिसकी बात आगे बताई जाएगी
definition: a demonstrative pronoun pointing forward to a relative clause, meaning the person or thing that, slightly formal and declined in both halves (diejenige, dasjenige, denjenigen)
example: Derjenige, der zuletzt geht, schließt die Tür ab. — Whoever leaves last locks the door.

hindi: वही / एक ही — अलग नहीं, बिल्कुल वही
definition: a demonstrative determiner or pronoun meaning the identical one already mentioned, written as one word whose first half declines like the article (dieselbe, dasselbe, denselben)
example: Wir wohnen im selben Haus, sogar auf derselben Etage. — We live in the same house, even on the same floor.

hindi: वर्तमान में, इस समय — आजकल, औपचारिक कथन में
definition: at present, currently, during the present period, a somewhat formal word often heard in news and official notices
example: Derzeit gibt es keine freien Plätze. — There are currently no places available.

hindi: इसलिए — परिणाम बताने वाला रोज़मर्रा का शब्द
definition: therefore, that is why; the everyday adverb that states a consequence and puts the verb right after it
example: Es regnet, deshalb bleiben wir drinnen. — It is raining, that is why we stay inside.

hindi: उतना ही — जितना-उतना वाली तुलना की जोड़ी का दूसरा शब्द
definition: the more, all the more; the second half of je ... desto linking two comparatives that change together
example: Je mehr du übst, desto besser wirst du. — The more you practise, the better you become.

hindi: इस वजह से — इसलिए का बोलचाल वाला रूप
definition: for that reason, that is why; a colloquial everyday synonym of deshalb stating the consequence of something just mentioned
example: Ich war krank, deswegen kam ich nicht. — I was ill, that is why I did not come.

hindi: अर्थ-निर्धारण — किसी चीज़ के मायने बताना
definition: an interpretation or reading, the meaning someone attributes to a text, dream, sign or event through explanation (die Deutung, plural Deutungen)
example: Jede Deutung des Gedichts ist ein bisschen anders. — Every interpretation of the poem is slightly different.

hindi: संयत — हल्का, ध्यान न खींचने वाला और सुरुचिपूर्ण
definition: subtle, understated or discreet, describing colours, perfume or behaviour that does not draw attention, never decent
example: Sie trägt ein dezentes Parfüm. — She wears a subtle perfume.

hindi: निदान — रोग की पहचान
definition: a diagnosis, the doctor's identification of which illness is causing the symptoms after an examination (die Diagnose, plural Diagnosen)
example: Die Diagnose war zum Glück harmlos. — Fortunately the diagnosis was harmless.

hindi: घना — कसकर भरा हुआ, जिसमें दरार न हो
definition: dense or thick with little space between parts, describing forests, fog, crowds and traffic, also watertight for seals
example: Der Wald ist sehr dicht. — The forest is very dense.

hindi: कवि — कविताएँ रचने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a poet, a person who writes poems and verse, often used for the great classical writers of a language (der Dichter, plural Dichter)
example: Goethe gilt als der berühmteste deutsche Dichter. — Goethe is considered the most famous German poet.

hindi: मोटा — चौड़ाई या गोलाई में ज़्यादा, पतला नहीं
definition: thick or fat, having a large distance between two surfaces, describing a thick book, a thick coat or a plump person
example: Das Buch ist sehr dick. — The book is very thick.

hindi: ज़िद्दी — अड़ियल इंसान; बच्चों के लिए प्यार से भी
definition: a stubborn and headstrong person who refuses to listen or budge, also the stubbornness itself, said fondly of children (der Dickkopf, plural Dickköpfe)
example: Mein Bruder ist ein echter Dickkopf. — My brother is a real stubborn mule.

hindi: हठी — मोटे सिर वाला यानी अड़ियल और ज़िद्दी
definition: pig-headed and stubborn, literally thick-headed, obstinately insisting on one's own way, often said of children
example: Das Kind ist dickköpfig und will nicht schlafen. — The child is stubborn and refuses to sleep.

term: die Beine in die Hand nehmen
hindi: सिर पर पाँव रखकर भागना — सरपट भाग खड़ा होना
definition: to take the legs in hand, meaning to flee, running away or hurrying off as fast as possible (colloquial; nimmt die Beine in die Hand, hat genommen)
example: Als der Hund kam, nahm er die Beine in die Hand. — When the dog came, he ran for it.

hindi: शुभकामना देना — किसी की सफलता के लिए दुआ करना
definition: to wish someone luck and hope things go well for them, the German equivalent of crossing fingers
example: Morgen ist die Prüfung, drück mir die Daumen! — The exam is tomorrow, keep your fingers crossed for me!

hindi: हार मान लेना — निराश होकर प्रयास छोड़ देना
definition: to give up in discouragement and abandon an effort before reaching the goal, throwing in the towel after setbacks (literally to throw the rifle into the grain)
example: Nach der dritten Absage wollte sie die Flinte ins Korn werfen. — After the third rejection she wanted to throw in the towel.

hindi: पूरी ज़मानत लेना — किसी की ईमानदारी की पक्की गारंटी देना
definition: to vouch completely for someone, being so sure of their honesty that one would risk a hand in fire (für + Akkusativ; hat gelegt)
example: Für ihn lege ich die Hand ins Feuer. — I would vouch for him with my life.

term: die Hände in den Schoß legen
hindi: हाथ पर हाथ धरे बैठना — कुछ न करना, निठल्ले बैठे रहना
definition: to sit idle with folded hands instead of doing anything about a situation (hat die Hände in den Schoß gelegt)
example: Wir dürfen jetzt nicht die Hände in den Schoß legen. — We must not sit back and do nothing now.

hindi: रूखा बर्ताव करना — किसी की जान-बूझकर उपेक्षा करना
definition: to give someone the cold shoulder, snubbing, ignoring and deliberately treating them with coldness (jemandem die kalte Schulter zeigen; hat gezeigt)
example: Seit dem Streit zeigt sie mir die kalte Schulter. — Since the argument she has been giving me the cold shoulder.

term: die Katze aus dem Sack lassen
hindi: राज़ खोल देना — छिपाई हुई बात या इरादा आखिरकार बता देना
definition: to finally reveal a secret plan or hidden intention that people had been waiting to hear about
example: Lass endlich die Katze aus dem Sack: Wer hat die Stelle bekommen? — Finally spill the beans: who got the job?

hindi: बिना देखे-परखे खरीदना — जोखिम उठाकर अनजानी चीज़ स्वीकार करना
definition: to buy or accept something without checking its quality first, taking a risk on an unseen purchase or agreement
example: Ich möchte das Auto erst sehen, ich kaufe keine Katze im Sack. — I want to see the car first, I will not buy a pig in a poke.

hindi: बात को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर न देखना — संयम और अनुपात बनाए रखना
definition: to keep a sense of proportion and not exaggerate, overreacting to something minor that deserves only calm attention (colloquial)
example: Es war nur ein kleiner Fehler, lass die Kirche im Dorf. — It was only a small mistake, let us not blow it out of proportion.

hindi: मुश्किल हल करना — फँसी हुई स्थिति को सुलझा लेना
definition: to resolve a tricky or dangerous situation and bring a problem back to safety (colloquial)
example: Mit dem Kompromiss haben wir die Kuh vom Eis geholt. — With the compromise we got ourselves out of the fix.

hindi: नाक सिकोड़ना — किसी चीज़ पर घृणा या हिकारत जताना
definition: to wrinkle one's nose in disdain or disgust at something considered beneath one (hat die Nase gerümpft; über + Akkusativ)
example: Über das billige Essen rümpfte er nur die Nase. — He just turned his nose up at the cheap food.

hindi: तंग आ जाना — किसी बात से ऊब जाना
definition: to be fed up with something, colloquial idiom for having had enough of a person or situation (+ von + Dativ)
example: Ich habe die Nase voll von diesem Wetter. — I am fed up with this weather.

hindi: आगे रहना — मुकाबले में सबसे आगे निकलना
definition: to be ahead of the competition, leading narrowly in a race, contest, election or market (colloquial; hat die Nase vorn)
example: Beim Preis hat der kleine Laden die Nase vorn. — On price the small shop is ahead.

hindi: कान खड़े करना — उत्सुकता से ध्यान लगाकर सुनना
definition: to prick up one's ears and listen closely because something interesting has been mentioned (hat die Ohren gespitzt)
example: Als sein Name fiel, spitzte er die Ohren. — When his name came up, he pricked up his ears.

hindi: नाक में दम होना — किसी बात से बेहद तंग आ जाना, खुरदुरा बोलचाल
definition: to be completely fed up, annoyed and weary of something, a coarser everyday version of having the nose full (very colloquial; hat die Schnauze voll)
example: Er hat die Schnauze voll von den ständigen Überstunden. — He is sick of the constant overtime.

hindi: अपनी करनी का फल भुगतना — खुद बनाई मुश्किल झेलना
definition: to bear the consequences of a problem, usually one that you or someone else caused (colloquial)
example: Er hat den Fehler gemacht, aber ich muss die Suppe auslöffeln. — He made the mistake, but I have to face the music.

hindi: दाँत भींच लेना — तकलीफ़ सहकर बिना शिकायत डटे रहना
definition: to grit one's teeth and endure pain or hardship bravely without complaining, however difficult things become (hat die Zähne zusammengebissen)
example: Beim Marathon musste ich die Zähne zusammenbeißen. — In the marathon I had to grit my teeth.

hindi: चोर — दूसरों की चीज़ चुराने वाला
definition: a thief, a person who steals property that belongs to someone else (der Dieb, plural Diebe)
example: Der Dieb entkam durch die Hintertür. — The thief escaped through the back door.

hindi: चोरी — किसी की चीज़ चुपके से ले लेने का अपराध
definition: theft, the crime of taking property that belongs to someone else without permission (der Diebstahl, plural Diebstähle)
example: Sie meldete den Diebstahl ihres Fahrrads. — She reported the theft of her bicycle.

hindi: प्रवेश कक्ष — घर के दरवाज़े के ठीक अंदर का हॉल
definition: the entrance hall, the hallway area just inside the front door of a home where coats and shoes are left (die Diele, plural Dielen)
example: Stell die Schuhe bitte in die Diele. — Please put the shoes in the entrance hall.

hindi: कार्यालयीन यात्रा — कंपनी के काम से की गई यात्रा
definition: a business trip, travel undertaken on behalf of the employer for work purposes (die Dienstreise, plural Dienstreisen)
example: Nächste Woche bin ich auf Dienstreise. — Next week I am on a business trip.

hindi: विभागीय कार्यालय — सरकारी प्राधिकरण का कोई एक दफ़्तर या शाखा
definition: a specific office or department within a public authority where officials handle cases (die Dienststelle, plural Dienststellen)
example: Wenden Sie sich bitte an die zuständige Dienststelle. — Please contact the responsible department.

hindi: सरकारी रास्ता — निर्धारित आधिकारिक क्रम से गुज़रती अर्ज़ी
definition: the prescribed chain of official channels a request must climb before anyone is allowed to act
example: You can email the director, but the Dienstweg runs through your section head first.

hindi: इस संबंध में — इसी विषय या मामले के बारे में
definition: regarding this matter or in this respect, the formal adverb that ties a sentence back to the topic just mentioned
example: Diesbezüglich habe ich noch eine Frage. — Regarding this I still have a question.

hindi: यह / यही — पास वाला या अभी बताया गया
definition: a demonstrative determiner or pronoun meaning this one here, the nearer or the most recently mentioned person or thing, declined like the definite article (diese, dieses)
example: Dieser Tisch ist zu klein für uns. — This table is too small for us.

hindi: इस पार — किसी सीमा या नदी के इसी तरफ़
definition: on this side of, on the near side of a river, border or limit from the speaker's viewpoint (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Diesseits des Flusses gibt es keinen Bahnhof. — On this side of the river there is no station.

hindi: अंकीय — कंप्यूटर और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक आँकड़ों पर आधारित
definition: digital, working with electronic data and computers rather than with paper, film or mechanical parts
example: Die Zeitung gibt es auch in digitaler Form. — The newspaper is also available in digital form.

hindi: श्रुतलेख — शिक्षक बोलता है, छात्र वर्तनी की जाँच के लिए लिखते हैं
definition: a dictation, a spelling exercise in which the teacher reads a text aloud and pupils write it down word for word (das Diktat, plural Diktate)
example: Im Diktat hatte ich nur zwei Fehler. — I made only two mistakes in the dictation.

hindi: तानाशाही — एक व्यक्ति या दल का निरंकुश शासन
definition: a dictatorship, rule by one person or party with total power and without free elections (die Diktatur, plural Diktaturen)
example: Die Diktatur endete mit der friedlichen Revolution. — The dictatorship ended with the peaceful revolution.

hindi: संचालक — वाद्यवृंद या गायक मंडली का निर्देशन करने वाला
definition: a conductor, the person who stands in front of an orchestra or choir and directs the performance with gestures (der Dirigent, plural Dirigenten)
example: Der Dirigent hebt die Hand, und alle werden still. — The conductor raises his hand and everyone falls silent.

hindi: पारंपरिक पोशाक / लड़की — बवेरियन-ऑस्ट्रियाई महिलाओं का चोली-लहंगा-एप्रन वाला पहनावा
definition: the traditional Bavarian and Austrian dress with bodice, full skirt and apron worn at festivals, and in dialect also a young girl (das Dirndl, plural Dirndl)
example: Zum Oktoberfest trägt sie ein blaues Dirndl. — She wears a blue dirndl to the beer festival.

hindi: चर्चा — किसी विषय पर विचारों की बहस
definition: a discussion or debate, an exchange of opinions and arguments about a topic between several people (die Diskussion, plural Diskussionen)
example: Nach dem Vortrag gab es eine lebhafte Diskussion. — After the talk there was a lively discussion.

hindi: चर्चा करना — किसी विषय पर तर्क-वितर्क के साथ बात करना
definition: to discuss or debate a topic, exchanging arguments and viewpoints with other people (regular: diskutiert, hat diskutiert; über + Akkusativ)
example: Wir diskutieren seit Stunden über Politik. — We have been discussing politics for hours.

hindi: किसी मुद्दे पर बहस करना — अलग-अलग राय के साथ विचार-विमर्श करना
definition: to discuss or debate a topic with other people, exchanging different opinions about it (über + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Die Studenten diskutieren über den Klimawandel. — The students are discussing climate change.

hindi: परहेज़ी भोजन — वज़न या सेहत के लिए नियंत्रित खान-पान
definition: a diet, a controlled way of eating followed to lose weight or for medical reasons (die Diät, plural Diäten)
example: Er macht seit Januar eine strenge Diät. — He has been on a strict diet since January.

hindi: फिर भी / हाँ तो — इनकार को पलटने या बात पर ज़ोर देने वाला छोटा शब्द
definition: a flavouring particle that contradicts a negative statement, softens a command into a friendly nudge, or reminds the listener of something they should already know
example: Komm doch mit ins Kino! — Come along to the cinema, why don't you!

hindi: शोध-प्रबंध — डॉक्टर की उपाधि के लिए लिखा गया बड़ा शोध ग्रंथ
definition: a doctoral thesis, the long piece of original research written to earn a doctorate degree (die Doktorarbeit, plural Doktorarbeiten)
example: Er schreibt seit vier Jahren an seiner Doktorarbeit. — He has been writing his doctoral thesis for four years.

hindi: दस्तावेज़ — लिखित या डिजिटल आधिकारिक काग़ज़
definition: a document, a written or digital file containing official information, text or records (das Dokument, plural Dokumente)
example: Das Dokument muss noch unterschrieben werden. — The document still has to be signed.

hindi: दुभाषिया — बोली जा रही बात को तुरंत दूसरी भाषा में कहने वाला
definition: an interpreter, the person who translates spoken language live between speakers, at meetings or in court (der Dolmetscher, plural Dolmetscher)
example: Der Dolmetscher übersetzt die Rede ins Deutsche. — The interpreter translates the speech into German.

hindi: महागिरजाघर — शहर का बड़ा और प्रमुख गिरजा
definition: a cathedral, the large principal church of a city, often its most famous historic landmark (der Dom, plural Dome)
example: Der Kölner Dom ist jedes Jahr voller Besucher. — Cologne Cathedral is full of visitors every year.

hindi: गरज — बिजली के बाद बादलों की गड़गड़ाहट
definition: thunder, the loud rumbling sound that follows a lightning flash during a storm (der Donner, plural Donner)
example: Der Donner war so laut, dass die Fenster klirrten. — The thunder was so loud that the windows rattled.

hindi: गरजना — बादलों का गड़गड़ाना
definition: to thunder, used impersonally with es when the loud rumble follows a lightning flash (regular: es donnert, hat gedonnert)
example: Es donnert, wir sollten reingehen. — It is thundering, we should go inside.

hindi: मूर्ख — बेवकूफ़, नीरस; बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: dumb, daft, silly; a colloquial and mildly childish word for something stupid or tiresome
example: Das Spiel ist total doof. — The game is totally dumb.

hindi: हमशक्ल — किसी जीवित व्यक्ति का रहस्यमय प्रतिरूप
definition: a living person's uncanny double, whether an eerie apparition or merely a stranger wearing your face
example: A waiter in Lisbon was such a Doppelgänger of my brother that I nearly hugged him.

hindi: दुगुना — दो गुना मात्रा या दो बार
definition: double or twice, describing an amount that is two times as large or something that exists or happens twice
example: Ich habe die Rechnung doppelt bezahlt. — I paid the bill twice.

hindi: दोहरा कमरा — दो व्यक्तियों के लिए बना होटल का कमरा
definition: a double room in a hotel intended for two guests sharing one large bed or two beds (das Doppelzimmer, plural Doppelzimmer)
example: Das Doppelzimmer mit Meerblick kostet hundert Euro. — The double room with sea view costs one hundred euros.

hindi: गाँव — ग्रामीण इलाक़े की छोटी बस्ती
definition: a village, a small rural settlement where everyone knows each other, the opposite of the city (das Dorf, plural Dörfer)
example: Meine Oma lebt in einem kleinen Dorf. — My grandma lives in a small village.

hindi: वहाँ — उस जगह, बोलने वाले से दूर
definition: there, at that place away from the speaker, the basic location word for a spot some distance from oneself that one can point at or name
example: Dort hinten steht mein Auto. — My car is parked over there at the back.

hindi: वहाँ तक — उस जगह की ओर, उधर को
definition: to there, moving toward that place away from the speaker, the direction word that answers wohin
example: Wie kommt man am besten dorthin? — What is the best way to get there?

hindi: डिब्बा — धातु का बंद कनस्तर या टिन, खुराक नहीं
definition: a tin or can of food or drink, also a small lidded container, never a dose of medicine (die Dose, plural Dosen)
example: Kannst du die Dose bitte öffnen? — Can you please open the tin?

hindi: व्याख्याता — विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ाने वाला शिक्षक
definition: a university lecturer, any academic teacher who gives courses at a higher education institution without necessarily being a professor (der Dozent, plural Dozenten)
example: Unser Dozent erklärt schwierige Themen sehr verständlich. — Our lecturer explains difficult topics very clearly.

hindi: मनाने का तोहफ़ा — नाराज़ी भाँपकर पहले से लाया गया उपहार
definition: a peace offering carried home in advance by someone expecting thoroughly deserved domestic anger
example: He bought tulips on the way back, pure Drachenfutter for a missed anniversary.

hindi: तार — धातु का पतला लचीला धागा जो बाड़ और बिजली में लगता है
definition: wire, the thin flexible strand of metal used for fences, electrical lines and fastening things (der Draht, plural Drähte)
example: Der Draht ist zu dünn für den Zaun. — The wire is too thin for the fence.

hindi: बाहर — खुले में, इमारत के बाहर
definition: outside or outdoors, in the open air beyond a building or enclosed space, the everyday word for being out under the sky
example: Die Kinder spielen draußen im Garten. — The children are playing outside in the garden.

hindi: मैला — बहुत गंदा, बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: filthy or grubby, very dirty, the colloquial and slightly stronger everyday word beside schmutzig (regular adjective)
example: Nach dem Fußball war die Hose richtig dreckig. — After football the trousers were really filthy.

hindi: पटकथा — फ़िल्म के संवाद और दृश्यों की लिखित योजना
definition: a screenplay or film script, the written text of dialogue and scenes from which a movie is shot (das Drehbuch, plural Drehbücher)
example: Das Drehbuch basiert auf einem bekannten Roman. — The screenplay is based on a well-known novel.

hindi: फ़िल्मांकन करना — कैमरे से दृश्य उतारना; घुमाना भी
definition: to shoot or film a movie or scene with a camera, and also simply to turn or rotate something (regular: hat gedreht)
example: Sie drehen den Film in den Bergen. — They are shooting the film in the mountains.

hindi: तीन — गिनती की तीसरी संख्या
definition: the cardinal number three, used in counting things, people, prices and clock times in everyday speech
example: Wir treffen uns um drei vor dem Kino. — We meet at three in front of the cinema.

hindi: त्रिभुज — तीन भुजाओं और तीन कोनों वाली आकृति
definition: a triangle, a flat shape with three straight sides and three corners, the shape of many warning signs (das Dreieck, plural Dreiecke)
example: Das Warnschild hat die Form eines Dreiecks. — The warning sign has the shape of a triangle.

hindi: तीन पनीर ऊँचा — छोटा-सा मगर आत्मविश्वासी बच्चा
definition: a tiny cheeky child who acts bigger than his small size, literally three cheeses high, affectionate and humorous (der Dreikäsehoch, plural Dreikäsehochs)
example: Der Dreikäsehoch wollte unbedingt selbst den Koffer tragen. — The little squirt insisted on carrying the suitcase himself.

hindi: तिपहिया साइकिल — तीन पहियों की पैडल वाली बच्चों की गाड़ी
definition: a tricycle, the three-wheeled pedal vehicle that toddlers ride before they can manage a bicycle (das Dreirad, plural Dreiräder)
example: Der Kleine fährt stolz mit dem roten Dreirad. — The little one proudly rides the red tricycle.

hindi: अत्यावश्यक — जिसे फ़ौरन निपटाना ज़रूरी हो
definition: urgent and pressing, needing immediate attention because it cannot wait, said of calls, cases and requests
example: Ich muss dringend mit dir sprechen. — I urgently need to speak with you.

hindi: अंदर — घर या इमारत के भीतर
definition: inside or indoors, within a building or enclosed space rather than outdoors, the colloquial everyday word for being under a roof
example: Bei Regen bleiben wir lieber drinnen. — When it rains we prefer to stay inside.

hindi: तिहाई — तीन बराबर हिस्सों में से एक
definition: a third, one of three equal parts of a whole, used for fractions of amounts, groups and periods of time (das Drittel, plural Drittel)
example: Ein Drittel der Klasse fehlt heute. — A third of the class is absent today.

hindi: सौंदर्य-सफ़ाई सामान की दुकान — शैम्पू, साबुन, कॉस्मेटिक्स
definition: a drugstore selling toiletries, cosmetics, cleaning products and baby goods but no prescription medicines (die Drogerie, plural Drogerien)
example: Shampoo und Zahnpasta hole ich in der Drogerie. — I get shampoo and toothpaste at the drugstore.

hindi: छापना — दस्तावेज़ को काग़ज़ पर निकालना
definition: to print a document, photo or book onto paper using a printer or printing press; not to be confused with drücken, to press (regular)
example: Ich drucke dir die Fahrkarte schnell. — I will quickly print the ticket for you.

hindi: मुद्रक — काग़ज़ पर लेख और चित्र छापने वाली मशीन
definition: a printer, the machine connected to a computer that puts documents and pictures onto paper (der Drucker, plural Drucker)
example: Der Drucker hat kein Papier mehr. — The printer is out of paper.

hindi: नीरस — उत्तरी जर्मनी में सूखा, उबाऊ और फीका
definition: dry, dull and boring in the northern German sense, said of a tedious speech, a lifeless party or a piece of stale cake
example: Der Vortrag war ziemlich dröge. — The lecture was pretty dull.

hindi: उस पार — सड़क, नदी या कमरे के दूसरी ओर
definition: over there on the other side of a street, river or room, the colloquial location word for a place across from where the speaker stands
example: Der Kiosk ist drüben auf der anderen Straßenseite. — The kiosk is over there on the other side of the street.

hindi: दबाना — बटन पर या किसी चीज़ पर ज़ोर डालना
definition: to press or push a button, a switch or a door with the hand, and to squeeze or hug someone warmly (regular: hat gedrückt)
example: Drücken Sie bitte den roten Knopf. — Please press the red button.

hindi: दबाव भरा — भारी, दम घोंटने वाली गर्मी
definition: oppressive, describing heavy humid heat that weighs on people and makes the air feel thick
example: Die Luft ist heute drückend heiß. — The air is oppressively hot today.

hindi: तू / तुम — घनिष्ठ, अनौपचारिक सम्बोधन
definition: the informal second person singular pronoun used when speaking to a friend, family member, child or fellow student rather than a stranger (Akkusativ dich, Dativ dir)
example: Kommst du heute Abend mit? — Are you coming along this evening?

hindi: सुगंध, ख़ुशबू — भली लगने वाली महक
definition: a pleasant fragrance or scent that spreads through the air, such as that of flowers, perfume or fresh baking (der Duft, plural Düfte)
example: Der Duft der Blumen erfüllt das Zimmer. — The scent of the flowers fills the room.

hindi: महकना — सुगंध फैलाना
definition: to smell pleasantly or give off a lovely fragrance, used for flowers, food and perfume (regular, nach + Dativ)
example: Die Rosen duften wunderbar. — The roses smell wonderful.

hindi: मूर्ख — समझ की कमी वाला; या बेवकूफ़ी भरा
definition: stupid or foolish, lacking intelligence or common sense, also said of a silly situation or annoying mishap (comparative dümmer)
example: Stell keine dummen Fragen! — Don't ask stupid questions!

hindi: मूर्खता — समझ की कमी; या कोई बेवकूफ़ी भरा काम
definition: the stupidity or lack of intelligence and common sense of a person, also a foolish act or silly mistake (die Dummheit, plural Dummheiten)
example: Das war eine große Dummheit von mir. — That was a really foolish thing for me to do.

hindi: गहरा, अँधेरा — रोशनी की कमी वाला या गाढ़े रंग का
definition: dark, lacking light, or describing a deep heavy shade of a colour such as dark green or dark blue
example: Im Winter wird es früh dunkel. — In winter it gets dark early.

hindi: से होकर — किसी जगह के बीच से गुज़रते हुए, या किसी साधन के ज़रिए
definition: through, passing from one side of a place to the other, or by means of some cause or agent (preposition, + Akkusativ)
example: Wir fahren durch den Tunnel. — We are driving through the tunnel.

hindi: पूरी तरह — बेशक, हर लिहाज़ से
definition: quite, definitely, perfectly well; a slightly formal adverb affirming that something is entirely possible or true
example: Das ist durchaus möglich. — That is quite possible.

hindi: दस्त — बार-बार पतला मल आना
definition: diarrhoea, the stomach upset with frequent loose bowel movements, often from spoiled food or infection (der Durchfall, plural Durchfälle)
example: Der Durchfall hat nach zwei Tagen aufgehört. — The diarrhoea stopped after two days.

hindi: अनुत्तीर्ण होना — परीक्षा में फेल हो जाना
definition: to fail an examination, to fall below the required standard and not pass the test (separable: fällt durch, ist durchgefallen)
example: Er ist leider in Mathe durchgefallen. — Unfortunately he failed in maths.

hindi: डटे रहना — मुश्किल में भी हिम्मत न हारना, टिके रहना
definition: to hold out, persevere or keep going through a hard stretch until the end (separable: hält durch, hat durchgehalten)
example: Halte durch, es ist bald vorbei! — Hang in there, it's almost over!

hindi: उद्घोषणा — स्टेशन या गाड़ी में ध्वनि-यंत्र से दी गई सूचना
definition: an announcement spoken over a loudspeaker at a station, inside a train or in an airport (die Durchsage, plural Durchsagen)
example: Achtung, eine Durchsage: Der Zug fährt heute von Gleis vier. — Attention, an announcement: the train leaves from track four today.

hindi: भाँप लेना — किसी की चाल या झूठ को समझ लेना
definition: to see through a person, trick or lie and understand what is really going on behind it (inseparable: durchschaut, hat durchschaut)
example: Ich habe seinen Plan sofort durchschaut. — I saw through his plan immediately.

hindi: औसत — कई मानों का मध्यम मान
definition: the average, the middle value obtained by adding figures together and dividing by their number, also the ordinary standard of anything (der Durchschnitt, plural Durchschnitte)
example: Im Durchschnitt schlafe ich sieben Stunden. — On average I sleep seven hours.

hindi: औसत — साधारण, सामान्य स्तर का
definition: average, ordinary, of typical level; neutral description of something neither above nor below the norm
example: Seine Noten sind durchschnittlich. — His grades are average.

hindi: पारदर्शी — जिसके आर-पार देखा जा सके, काँच जैसा
definition: transparent, clear enough that you can see straight through it, describing glass, clean water and thin plastic film
example: Die Folie ist durchsichtig. — The film is transparent.

hindi: फ़ोन मिलाना — आई हुई बात को सही व्यक्ति तक पहुँचाना
definition: to put a telephone call through to another person or extension inside the office (separable: stellt durch, hat durchgestellt)
example: Einen Moment, ich stelle Sie durch. — One moment, I am putting you through.

hindi: सीधी लाइन — दफ़्तर में किसी व्यक्ति का निजी फ़ोन नंबर
definition: a direct telephone extension number that reaches a particular person in an office without going through reception (die Durchwahl, plural Durchwahlen)
example: Meine Durchwahl steht unten in der Signatur. — My extension number is at the bottom in the signature.

hindi: प्यास — कुछ पीने की ज़रूरत का एहसास
definition: thirst, the physical feeling of needing something to drink, which in German you have rather than are (der Durst, no plural)
example: Der Durst nach der Wanderung war groß. — The thirst after the hike was great.

hindi: प्यासा — जिसे कुछ पीने की ज़रूरत महसूस हो
definition: thirsty, feeling the need to drink something, the adjective used less often than the noun phrase with Durst
example: Nach der Wanderung waren alle durstig. — After the hike everyone was thirsty.

hindi: फुहारा — खड़े होकर नहाने की पानी की बौछार
definition: a shower, the bathroom fitting that sprays water from above so a person washes standing (die Dusche, plural Duschen)
example: Ich gehe morgens unter die Dusche. — I take a shower in the morning.

hindi: शावर लेना — फव्वारे के बहते पानी के नीचे खड़े होकर नहाना
definition: to take a shower, standing under running water to wash the whole body quickly (regular: duscht, hat geduscht)
example: Er duscht jeden Morgen kalt. — He showers cold every morning.

hindi: दर्जन — बारह चीज़ों का समूह
definition: a dozen, a group or quantity of twelve items, common for eggs and bread rolls and used loosely for a fair number (das Dutzend, plural Dutzende)
example: Ich kaufe ein Dutzend Eier auf dem Markt. — I buy a dozen eggs at the market.

hindi: तुम कहकर बुलाना — अनौपचारिक संबोधन अपनाना
definition: to address another person with the informal you, the smallest grammatical step into friendship
example: After the second beer the professor finally invited us to duzen him.

hindi: झुटपुटा होना — सुबह उजाला या शाम अँधेरा शुरू होना
definition: to grow light at dawn or grow dark at dusk, and colloquially to slowly begin to dawn on someone (regular, es dämmert, hat gedämmert)
example: Es dämmert schon, bald wird es dunkel. — Dusk is falling, soon it will be dark.

hindi: झुटपुटा — सुबह या शाम की धुँधली रोशनी का समय
definition: twilight or dusk, the dim half-light between daylight and darkness at dawn or evening (die Dämmerung, plural Dämmerungen)
example: In der Dämmerung gingen wir am Fluss spazieren. — At dusk we walked along the river.

hindi: दीवार की खूँटी — छेद में डाली जाने वाली खोली जिसमें पेच मज़बूती से पकड़ता है
definition: a wall plug or dowel, the small plastic sleeve pushed into a drilled hole so a screw holds firmly (der Dübel, plural Dübel)
example: Der Dübel hält die Schraube in der Wand. — The wall plug holds the screw in the wall.

hindi: खाद डालना — मिट्टी में पोषक तत्व मिलाना
definition: to fertilise, to add manure or nutrients to the soil so that plants grow stronger (regular: düngt, hat gedüngt)
example: Im Frühling dünge ich den Rasen. — In spring I fertilise the lawn.

hindi: खाद — पौधों को पोषण देने वाला मिश्रण
definition: fertiliser, the manure or chemical mixture added to soil to feed plants and improve the harvest (der Dünger, plural Dünger)
example: Dieser Dünger ist gut für Tomaten. — This fertiliser is good for tomatoes.

hindi: पतला — कम मोटाई या दुबला-पतला
definition: thin or slim, having little distance between two surfaces, describing thin paper, thin slices or a slender person
example: Das Eis auf dem See ist noch zu dünn. — The ice on the lake is still too thin.

hindi: भाप या थोड़े पानी में पकाना — ढककर हल्की आँच पर सब्ज़ी गलाना
definition: to steam or braise vegetables or fish gently in a little liquid with the lid on until tender (regular: dünstet, hat gedünstet)
example: Ich dünste das Gemüse mit etwas Butter. — I am steaming the vegetables with a little butter.

hindi: अनुमति होना — किसी काम की इजाज़त पाना
definition: to be allowed or permitted to do something, the modal verb of permission that someone else grants (irregular: darf, durfte, hat gedurft)
example: Hier dürfen Sie nicht parken. — You are not allowed to park here.

hindi: सूखा — लंबे समय तक बारिश न होने की हालत
definition: a drought, a long period without rain that dries out fields, rivers and reservoirs (die Dürre, plural Dürren)
example: Die Dürre hat die Ernte zerstört. — The drought destroyed the harvest.

hindi: धुँधला-उदास — मद्धम रोशनी वाला या निराशाजनक माहौल
definition: dim and gloomy, dark in mood or lighting, used of weather, rooms and bleak outlooks
example: Die Stimmung im Büro war düster. — The mood in the office was gloomy.

hindi: विद्युत डाक — अंतरजाल से भेजा जाने वाला संदेश
definition: an email, the electronic message sent over the internet to someone's mail address; feminine in Germany, neuter in Austria and Switzerland (die E-Mail, plural E-Mails)
example: Ich schreibe dir morgen eine E-Mail. — I will write you an email tomorrow.

hindi: समतल — बिना उतार-चढ़ाव वाला, चिकना
definition: level or even without bumps or slopes, describing flat ground, smooth surfaces and easy terrain for walking
example: Der Boden ist nicht ganz eben. — The floor is not quite level.

hindi: मैदान — बिना पहाड़ों की सपाट विस्तृत ज़मीन
definition: a plain, a wide stretch of flat level land without hills or mountains (die Ebene, plural Ebenen)
example: Die Ebene erstreckt sich bis zum Horizont. — The plain stretches to the horizon.

hindi: असली — सच्चा, नक़ली नहीं
definition: genuine, real and authentic rather than fake, used of leather, gold and feelings, also colloquially meaning really or truly
example: Ist die Tasche aus echtem Leder? — Is the bag made of genuine leather?

hindi: कोना — जहाँ दो सड़कें या दीवारें मिलती हैं
definition: a corner, the point where two streets or two walls meet, often used to say something is close by (die Ecke, plural Ecken)
example: Der Kiosk ist gleich um die Ecke. — The kiosk is just around the corner.

hindi: कोनेदार — सीधे किनारों और नुकीले कोनों वाला
definition: angular or square-cornered, having straight edges and sharp corners rather than curves, also describing stiff clumsy movements
example: Die neue Lampe ist eckig, nicht rund. — The new lamp is angular, not round.

hindi: हिम-कुसुम — ऊँचे पहाड़ों पर खिलने वाला सफ़ेद रोएँदार तारे जैसा फूल
definition: a small white woolly star-shaped flower that grows high in the Alps and became a symbol of the mountains (das Edelweiß, plural Edelweiße)
example: Das Edelweiß steht unter Naturschutz und darf nicht gepflückt werden. — The edelweiss is protected and must not be picked.

hindi: कोई फ़र्क नहीं — बात मायने नहीं रखती
definition: not mattering, all the same; spoken alone it means never mind or that it makes no difference which option
example: Tee oder Kaffee? Ist mir egal. — Tea or coffee? I do not mind.

hindi: स्वार्थी — सिर्फ़ अपने फ़ायदे की सोचने वाला
definition: selfish and self-centred, caring only about one's own advantage and ignoring the needs of others
example: Es ist egoistisch, alles für sich zu behalten. — It is selfish to keep everything for yourself.

hindi: वैसे भी — बोलचाल में 'हर हाल में' कहने का शब्द
definition: a very colloquial particle, especially southern and Austrian, meaning anyway or in any case regardless of the circumstances
example: Das weiß eh jeder. — Everyone knows that anyway.

hindi: विवाह — पति-पत्नी का क़ानूनी बंधन
definition: the marriage, the lawful union of two people as husband and wife or spouses, the formal word for wedlock (die Ehe, plural Ehen)
example: Ihre Ehe hält schon dreißig Jahre. — Their marriage has lasted thirty years already.

hindi: पत्नी — विवाहित स्त्री, किसी पुरुष की बीवी
definition: the wife, the married woman to whom a man is wedded, formal beside the everyday Frau (die Ehefrau, plural Ehefrauen)
example: Seine Ehefrau ist Lehrerin von Beruf. — His wife is a teacher by profession.

hindi: पूर्व — जो पहले कुछ था पर अब नहीं
definition: former, describing someone or something that once held a role or state and no longer does
example: Die ehemalige Grenze ist heute ein Radweg. — The former border is a cycle path today.

hindi: पति — विवाहित पुरुष, किसी स्त्री का शौहर
definition: the husband, the married man to whom a woman is wedded, formal beside the everyday Mann (der Ehemann, plural Ehemänner)
example: Ihr Ehemann arbeitet bei der Bahn. — Her husband works for the railway.

hindi: दंपति — विवाहित पति-पत्नी
definition: a married couple, a husband and wife regarded together as one household unit in everyday speech (das Ehepaar, plural Ehepaare)
example: Das Ehepaar wohnt seit dreißig Jahren hier. — The married couple has lived here for thirty years.

hindi: शादी की अँगूठी — विवाह में पहनाई जाने वाली अँगूठी
definition: a wedding ring exchanged at the ceremony and worn on the finger as a sign of marriage, in Germany traditionally on the right hand (der Ehering, plural Eheringe)
example: Sie trägt ihren Ehering an der rechten Hand. — She wears her wedding ring on her right hand.

hindi: स्वयंसेवा — बिना वेतन निभाया गया सामाजिक पद
definition: voluntary work, an unpaid position held in a club, charity or community body (das Ehrenamt, plural Ehrenämter)
example: Sein Ehrenamt bei der Feuerwehr kostet viel Zeit. — His volunteer post at the fire brigade takes much time.

hindi: स्वैच्छिक — बिना वेतन, सेवा भाव से किया गया
definition: voluntary and unpaid, done as an honorary service for a club, charity or local community
example: Sie arbeitet ehrenamtlich im Tierheim. — She works as a volunteer at the animal shelter.

hindi: महत्वाकांक्षा — सफलता और ऊँचा लक्ष्य पाने की प्रबल चाह
definition: the strong ambition and driving desire to succeed, achieve and reach high goals in life or work (der Ehrgeiz, no plural)
example: Sein Ehrgeiz treibt ihn jeden Morgen um fünf aus dem Bett. — His ambition drives him out of bed at five every morning.

hindi: महत्वाकांक्षी — सफलता और ऊँचे लक्ष्य के लिए जी-जान से जुटा हुआ
definition: ambitious, driven by a strong desire to succeed, achieve and reach demanding goals (regular adjective)
example: Meine Schwester ist sehr ehrgeizig und will Chefin werden. — My sister is very ambitious and wants to become the boss.

hindi: ईमानदार — सच बोलने और धोखा न देने वाला
definition: honest and truthful, telling the truth openly and never cheating, deceiving or hiding anything from others (regular adjective)
example: Sei ehrlich: Gefällt dir das Kleid? — Be honest: do you like the dress?

hindi: सच कहूँ तो — खुलकर अपनी राय देने से पहले कहा जाने वाला वाक्यांश
definition: a set phrase meaning to be honest that prefaces a frank opinion the listener might not want to hear
example: Ehrlich gesagt, gefällt mir das nicht. — To be honest, I don't like it.

hindi: ईमानदारी — सच बोलने और धोखा न देने का गुण
definition: the honesty and truthfulness of a person who tells the truth openly and never cheats, deceives or hides the facts (die Ehrlichkeit, no plural)
example: Ich schätze deine Ehrlichkeit sehr. — I greatly value your honesty.

hindi: अंडा — मुर्गी का खोलदार भोजन
definition: an egg, the oval shelled food that hens lay, boiled, fried or scrambled at breakfast, with hens' eggs going into every kind of baking (das Ei, plural Eier)
example: Ich hätte gern ein weiches Ei. — I would like a soft-boiled egg.

hindi: बलूत — बलूतफल देने वाला मज़बूत धीमा बढ़ने वाला पेड़
definition: an oak, the strong slow-growing tree with acorns that Germans treat as a symbol of strength (die Eiche, plural Eichen)
example: Die Eiche im Dorf ist dreihundert Jahre alt. — The oak in the village is three hundred years old.

hindi: गिलहरी — पेड़ों पर उछलने वाला झाड़ीदार पूँछ का जानवर
definition: a squirrel, the small bushy-tailed animal that leaps through trees and buries nuts for the winter (das Eichhörnchen, plural Eichhörnchen)
example: Ein Eichhörnchen klettert den Baum hinauf. — A squirrel climbs up the tree.

hindi: सर्वगुणसंपन्न चीज़ — हर काम एक साथ करने वाली असंभव-सी वस्तु या व्यक्ति
definition: a humorous name for an all-purpose product or person expected to satisfy every wish at once, an impossible ideal (die eierlegende Wollmilchsau, plural Wollmilchsäue)
example: Der Chef will eine eierlegende Wollmilchsau, aber so ein Gerät gibt es nicht. — The boss wants a do-everything miracle device, but no such thing exists.

hindi: जलन — प्रिय व्यक्ति को किसी और से खोने का डर
definition: jealousy, the anxious possessive fear of losing a loved person to a rival (die Eifersucht, no plural)
example: Die Eifersucht macht ihre Beziehung schwierig. — Jealousy makes their relationship difficult.

hindi: ईर्ष्यालु — प्रेम में जलन महसूस करना
definition: jealous and possessive, fearing to lose a partner or friend to someone else (eifersüchtig auf + Akkusativ)
example: Er ist eifersüchtig auf ihren Kollegen. — He is jealous of her colleague.

hindi: निराला — अनोखा, अजीब, अपनी ही तरह का
definition: peculiar, odd, idiosyncratic; describes something strange in its own particular way, often slightly unsettling
example: Der Käse hat einen eigenartigen Geschmack. — The cheese has a peculiar taste.

hindi: गुण — किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु की विशेषता या लक्षण
definition: a quality, trait or characteristic that a person or thing possesses and that marks it out from others, such as patience or strength (die Eigenschaft, plural Eigenschaften)
example: Geduld ist seine beste Eigenschaft. — Patience is his best quality.

hindi: स्वेच्छाचार — अपनी ही राह पर अड़े रहने का स्वभाव
definition: a self-willed streak that insists on its own way, closer to independence than to plain obstinacy
example: Her Eigensinn made her impossible to manage and impossible to replace.

hindi: असल में — दरअसल, वैसे तो
definition: actually, really, strictly speaking; softens a statement or introduces what is true in principle rather than in practice
example: Eigentlich wollte ich früher gehen. — Actually I wanted to leave earlier.

hindi: स्वामित्व वाला फ़्लैट — किराये के बजाय ख़रीदा हुआ फ़्लैट
definition: an owner-occupied flat, an apartment bought rather than rented, often called a condominium (die Eigentumswohnung, plural Eigentumswohnungen)
example: Sie haben sich eine Eigentumswohnung am Stadtrand gekauft. — They bought themselves a flat on the edge of town.

hindi: स्वामी — संपत्ति का क़ानूनी मालिक
definition: the owner, the person who legally holds a property, building or other valuable object (der Eigentümer, plural Eigentümer)
example: Der Eigentümer will das Haus verkaufen. — The owner wants to sell the house.

hindi: जल्दी जाना — तेज़ी से किसी जगह पहुँचने की कोशिश करना
definition: to hurry or hasten somewhere quickly, a slightly formal verb for rushing to a place (regular: ist geeilt)
example: Der Arzt eilt sofort zum Patienten. — The doctor hurries to the patient at once.

hindi: जल्दी का — जिसे तुरंत करना ज़रूरी हो, जल्दबाज़ी में
definition: hurried or urgent, needing to happen quickly because time is short, often used as es eilig haben, to be in a hurry
example: Ich habe es heute sehr eilig. — I am in a big hurry today.

hindi: बाल्टी — पानी भरने का हत्थेदार बर्तन
definition: a bucket, the round open container with a handle used to carry water for mopping and cleaning (der Eimer, plural Eimer)
example: Füll bitte den Eimer mit warmem Wasser. — Please fill the bucket with warm water.

hindi: नज़रअंदाज़ करना — जान-बूझकर छोटी गलती अनदेखी कर देना
definition: to turn a blind eye and let a small offence or mistake pass without punishment (hat ein Auge zugedrückt)
example: Der Polizist drückte diesmal ein Auge zu. — The policeman turned a blind eye this time.

hindi: थोड़ा सा — ज़रा, कम मात्रा में
definition: a little or a bit, a small amount or slight degree of something, the friendliest everyday softener
example: Ich spreche ein bisschen Deutsch. — I speak a little German.

term: ein Brett vor dem Kopf haben
hindi: समझ में न आना — साफ़ बात भी न सूझना
definition: to be unable to grasp something obvious, being slow or dense at that moment (colloquial)
example: Heute habe ich ein Brett vor dem Kopf und verstehe die Aufgabe nicht. — Today I am totally dense and cannot understand the task.

hindi: कुछ / दो-चार — अनिश्चित छोटी संख्या
definition: an everyday fixed expression meaning a few or a couple of, with lowercase paar, unlike ein Paar which means a matched pair of two
example: Ich brauche noch ein paar Minuten. — I still need a few minutes.

hindi: एक-दूसरे को — परस्पर क्रिया
definition: the reciprocal pronoun meaning each other or one another, slightly formal, often glued to a preposition as in miteinander or voneinander
example: Die beiden Schwestern helfen einander immer. — The two sisters always help each other.

hindi: साँस लेना — हवा फेफड़ों में भीतर खींचना
definition: to breathe in, to inhale, drawing fresh air into the lungs deeply or calmly (separable: atmet ein, hat eingeatmet)
example: Atmen Sie tief ein und langsam aus. — Breathe in deeply and out slowly.

hindi: एकमार्गी सड़क — जिस पर गाड़ियाँ सिर्फ़ एक दिशा में चलें
definition: a one-way street, a road on which vehicles may drive in a single direction only (die Einbahnstraße, plural Einbahnstraßen)
example: Achtung, das ist eine Einbahnstraße! — Careful, that is a one-way street!

hindi: बनी-बनाई रसोई — फ़्लैट में जड़ी हुई अलमारियाँ और उपकरण
definition: a fitted kitchen, cupboards and appliances built into the flat, often sold on by the departing tenant (die Einbauküche, plural Einbauküchen)
example: Die Einbauküche gehört noch dem Vormieter. — The fitted kitchen still belongs to the previous tenant.

hindi: सेंधमार — घर में घुसकर चोरी करने वाला
definition: a burglar, a criminal who breaks into houses or shops in order to steal (der Einbrecher, plural Einbrecher)
example: Der Einbrecher kam durchs Kellerfenster. — The burglar came in through the cellar window.

hindi: सेंधमारी — चोरी के लिए ताला तोड़कर घर में घुसना
definition: a burglary or break-in, the crime of forcing entry into a house or shop in order to steal (der Einbruch, plural Einbrüche)
example: Nach dem Einbruch fehlte der Laptop. — After the burglary the laptop was missing.

hindi: पंजीकरण कराना — हवाई अड्डे या होटल पर पहुँचकर अपना नाम दर्ज कराना
definition: to check in at an airport or hotel, to register on arrival and receive a boarding pass or key (separable: checkt ein, hat eingecheckt)
example: Wir checken online ein und sparen Zeit. — We check in online and save time.

hindi: गला बैठा होना — बोलने में आवाज़ अटकना या भर्राना
definition: to have a hoarse or croaky voice, to need to clear the throat before speaking
example: Entschuldigung, ich habe heute einen Frosch im Hals. — Sorry, I have a frog in my throat today.

hindi: दिमाग़ खराब होना — सनकी या पागल-सा व्यवहार करना
definition: to be crazy or slightly mad, to behave foolishly and say absurd things that nobody sensible would suggest (colloquial, mildly insulting, often with a finger tapped to the forehead)
example: Du willst bei Regen zelten? Du hast doch einen Vogel! — You want to camp in the rain? You must be nuts!

hindi: कोई एक — समूह में से एक व्यक्ति या चीज़
definition: an indefinite pronoun standing alone without a noun to mean one particular person or thing out of a group, often followed by von (eine, eines)
example: Einer von euch muss die Rechnung bezahlen. — One of you has to pay the bill.

hindi: एक ओर — किसी मामले के दो पहलू तौलने वाली जोड़ी का पहला शब्द
definition: on the one hand; the first half of a pair with andererseits that weighs two sides of a matter
example: Einerseits ist die Stadt schön, andererseits sehr teuer. — On the one hand the city is beautiful, on the other very expensive.

hindi: आसान, सरल — बिना कठिनाई का, सीधा-सादा
definition: easy or simple, requiring little effort and having no complications, also used as an adverb meaning simply
example: Die Aufgabe war ganz einfach. — The task was quite easy.

hindi: प्रवेश मार्ग — गाड़ी से अंदर जाने का रास्ता या ड्राइववे
definition: an entrance for vehicles, the driveway or slip road where cars enter a property or motorway (die Einfahrt, plural Einfahrten)
example: Bitte die Einfahrt nicht zuparken. — Please do not block the driveway.

hindi: सूझ — अचानक मन में आया विचार
definition: a sudden idea or bright notion that occurs to someone unexpectedly while thinking or talking (der Einfall, plural Einfälle)
example: Das war ein guter Einfall von dir! — That was a good idea of yours!

hindi: सूझना, याद आना — कोई बात अचानक मन में आना
definition: to occur to someone, to come to mind suddenly as an idea or a recalled name (separable: fällt ein, ist eingefallen; + Dativ)
example: Mir fällt sein Name gerade nicht ein. — His name doesn't come to me right now.

hindi: एक-परिवार का मकान — अपने बगीचे वाला अलग घर
definition: a detached single-family house with its own garden, the classic suburban dream home (das Einfamilienhaus, plural Einfamilienhäuser)
example: Sie träumen von einem Einfamilienhaus mit Garten. — They dream of a detached house with a garden.

hindi: जमाना — खाना फ़्रीज़र में रखकर लंबे समय तक बचाना
definition: to freeze food in the freezer so that leftovers, bread or meat keep fresh for weeks or months (separable: friert ein, hat eingefroren)
example: Ich friere die Hälfte der Suppe ein. — I am freezing half of the soup.

hindi: चिपकाना — नक़ल किया हुआ लेख या चित्र दूसरी जगह डालना
definition: to paste or insert copied text, a picture or a file into a document at the chosen place on a computer (separable: fügt ein, hat eingefügt)
example: Ich füge das Bild in die Präsentation ein. — I am inserting the picture into the presentation.

hindi: प्रवेश द्वार — इमारत के भीतर जाने का रास्ता
definition: an entrance, the door or gateway through which people enter a building or grounds (der Eingang, plural Eingänge)
example: Der Eingang ist auf der Rückseite des Gebäudes. — The entrance is at the back of the building.

hindi: दर्ज करना — कंप्यूटर में पासवर्ड या आँकड़े टाइप करना
definition: to enter or type information, a password, a number or other data into a computer, phone or machine (separable: gibt ein, hat eingegeben)
example: Geben Sie bitte Ihr Passwort ein. — Please enter your password.

hindi: अहंकारी — अपने आपको बहुत बड़ा समझने वाला
definition: conceited and stuck-up, having an inflated opinion of one's own looks, talent or importance
example: Sie ist eingebildet und redet nur über sich. — She is conceited and talks only about herself.

hindi: पालन करना — नियम, समय-सीमा या वादा निभाना
definition: to keep to a rule, deadline or promise, to observe and respect an agreement faithfully (separable: hält ein, hat eingehalten)
example: Wir müssen die Frist einhalten. — We have to meet the deadline.

hindi: एकमत — किसी बात पर सबकी एक ही राय
definition: in agreement or united in opinion, used when people share the same view about something
example: Wir sind uns in dieser Frage einig. — We agree on this question.

hindi: कुछ — थोड़ी, अनिश्चित संख्या में
definition: some or a few, describing an unspecified small number of people or things, or a fair amount of something uncountable
example: Einige Gäste sind schon gegangen. — Some guests have already left.

hindi: कुछ हद तक — ठीक-ठाक, किसी हद तक
definition: reasonably or to some extent, a moderate degree that is acceptable without being impressive
example: Mir geht es einigermaßen gut. — I am doing reasonably well.

hindi: सहमति — बातचीत के बाद बनी आम राय
definition: an agreement or settlement reached after negotiation between parties that disagreed (die Einigung, plural Einigungen)
example: Nach langen Gesprächen kam es zu einer Einigung. — After long talks an agreement was reached.

hindi: ख़रीदारी — ख़रीदी गई चीज़ें या ख़रीदने का काम
definition: a purchase or shopping trip, also the collective goods someone has bought and carries home (der Einkauf, plural Einkäufe)
example: Kannst du mir mit dem Einkauf helfen? — Can you help me with the shopping?

hindi: ख़रीदारी करना — सामान लेने बाज़ार जाना
definition: to go shopping, to visit stores and purchase the groceries and everyday things a household needs (separable: kauft ein, hat eingekauft)
example: Ich kaufe heute Abend noch schnell ein. — I'm going to do some quick shopping this evening.

hindi: ख़रीदारी की टोकरी — हाथ में उठाने वाली छोटी टोकरी
definition: a shopping basket carried by hand through the store for a small purchase instead of a trolley (der Einkaufskorb, plural Einkaufskörbe)
example: Für drei Sachen reicht ein Einkaufskorb. — A shopping basket is enough for three things.

hindi: ख़रीदारी का थैला — बार-बार इस्तेमाल होने वाला कपड़े का थैला
definition: a shopping bag, usually a reusable cloth or woven bag brought from home to carry purchases (die Einkaufstasche, plural Einkaufstaschen)
example: Nimm die Einkaufstasche mit, Tüten kosten extra. — Take the shopping bag along, plastic bags cost extra.

hindi: ख़रीदारी गाड़ी — पहियों वाली धातु की बड़ी टोकरी
definition: a shopping trolley or cart, the wheeled metal basket pushed around a supermarket, usually unlocked with a coin (der Einkaufswagen, plural Einkaufswagen)
example: Hast du eine Münze für den Einkaufswagen? — Do you have a coin for the shopping trolley?

hindi: ख़रीदारी परिसर — एक छत के नीचे कई दुकानें
definition: a shopping centre or mall, a large complex of many stores and cafés under one roof (das Einkaufszentrum, plural Einkaufszentren)
example: Am Samstag ist das Einkaufszentrum immer voll. — The shopping centre is always crowded on Saturday.

hindi: ख़रीदारी की सूची — क्या-क्या लाना है, उसकी पर्ची
definition: a shopping list, the slip of paper or phone note with everything that must be bought (der Einkaufszettel, plural Einkaufszettel)
example: Ich habe den Einkaufszettel zu Hause vergessen. — I left the shopping list at home.

hindi: आय — वेतन, किराये या व्यापार से होने वाली कुल आमदनी
definition: income, the total money a person receives from salary, wages, business or other sources (das Einkommen, plural Einkommen)
example: Das Einkommen muss man versteuern. — Income has to be taxed.

hindi: न्योता देना — किसी को घर या आयोजन में बुलाना
definition: to invite someone to your home or to an event, and often also to treat them by paying the bill (separable: lädt ein, hat eingeladen)
example: Ich lade dich zum Essen ein. — I am inviting you to dinner.

hindi: किसी को न्योता देना — भोजन, पार्टी या आयोजन में बुलाना
definition: to invite somebody to a meal, party or other event as your guest (+ Akkusativ, zu + Dativ, separable: lädt ein, hat eingeladen)
example: Sie lädt uns zum Abendessen ein. — She is inviting us to dinner.

hindi: निमंत्रण — बैठक या कार्यक्रम में आने का लिखित आमंत्रण
definition: an invitation, the written or spoken request asking someone to attend a meeting, event or celebration (die Einladung, plural Einladungen)
example: Die Einladung zur Sitzung kommt per E-Mail. — The invitation to the session comes by email.

hindi: दायर करना — आपत्ति या अपील औपचारिक रूप से दर्ज करना
definition: to lodge or file a formal objection or appeal, as in the fixed phrase Widerspruch einlegen (separable: legt ein, hat eingelegt)
example: Mein Nachbar legt gegen den Bescheid Widerspruch ein. — My neighbour is lodging an objection against the decision.

hindi: एक बार — एक ही दफ़ा, या कभी किसी समय
definition: once, one single time, and also meaning at some time in the past or future as in once upon a time
example: Ich war einmal in Hamburg. — I was in Hamburg once.

hindi: आमदनी — व्यापार या किराये से आने वाली रकम; दवा लेना
definition: the income or takings that flow into a business or household from sales, rent or fees, also the taking of medicine (die Einnahme, plural Einnahmen)
example: Die Einnahmen aus dem Verkauf decken die Miete. — The income from the sale covers the rent.

hindi: पैक करना — सामान थैले में रखना या तोहफ़ा लपेटना
definition: to pack items into a suitcase or bag, or to wrap up a gift or purchase in paper (separable: packt ein, hat eingepackt)
example: Hast du den Regenschirm eingepackt? — Did you pack the umbrella?

hindi: गाड़ी सटाकर लगाना — तंग जगह में वाहन को ठीक से खड़ा करना
definition: to manoeuvre a vehicle into a parking space, especially a tight gap between other cars (separable: parkt ein, hat eingeparkt)
example: Sie parkt perfekt rückwärts ein. — She reverse-parks perfectly.

hindi: जमा करना — आवेदन या दस्तावेज़ दफ़्तर को औपचारिक रूप से सौंपना
definition: to submit or hand in an application, documents or a complaint formally to an office or institution (separable: reicht ein, hat eingereicht)
example: Die Unterlagen müssen bis Montag eingereicht werden. — The documents must be submitted by Monday.

hindi: सजाना-बसाना — कमरे या घर में फ़र्नीचर लगाना
definition: to furnish and arrange a home or room, choosing and placing furniture so people can live there (separable: richtet ein, hat eingerichtet)
example: Wir richten das Kinderzimmer neu ein. — We are furnishing the children's room anew.

hindi: जमाकर रखना — अलमारी या डिशवॉशर में चीज़ें भरना
definition: to put things away into a cupboard or to load the dishwasher with dirty dishes (separable: räumt ein, hat eingeräumt)
example: Ich räume die Spülmaschine ein. — I load the dishwasher.

hindi: एक — गिनती की पहली संख्या, अकेले बोलने का रूप
definition: the cardinal number one, the single first unit when it stands alone in counting, arithmetic or telling the time; before a noun it becomes ein or eine
example: Es ist schon eins, wir sollten essen. — It is already one o'clock, we should eat.

hindi: अकेला — साथ के अभाव में उदास; सुनसान जगह के लिए भी
definition: lonely, feeling sadly alone without company, also describing a remote deserted place
example: Seit dem Umzug fühlt sie sich oft einsam. — Since the move she often feels lonely.

hindi: अकेलापन — बिना अपनों के सूना और उदास लगना
definition: loneliness, the sad empty feeling of being alone and without close company (die Einsamkeit, no plural)
example: Die Einsamkeit nach dem Umzug machte ihm zu schaffen. — The loneliness after the move troubled him.

hindi: बटोरना — कई लोगों से चीज़ें उठाकर एक जगह करना
definition: to collect items in from a group of people, such as a teacher gathering exam papers or someone picking up litter (separable: sammelt ein, hat eingesammelt)
example: Der Lehrer sammelt die Hefte ein. — The teacher collects the exercise books.

hindi: चालू करना — किसी यंत्र का बटन दबाकर उसे शुरू करना
definition: to switch on a device, machine, light or computer so that it starts running; the opposite of ausschalten (separable: schaltet ein, hat eingeschaltet)
example: Schalte bitte den Computer ein. — Please switch on the computer.

hindi: सो जाना — जागते से नींद में चले जाना
definition: to fall asleep, passing from being awake into sleep at night or during a nap (separable: schläft ein, ist eingeschlafen)
example: Ich schlafe meist sofort ein. — I usually fall asleep immediately.

hindi: पंजीकृत डाक — ऐसी चिट्ठी जिसकी सुपुर्दगी पर हस्ताक्षर लिए जाते हैं
definition: registered mail, a letter sent with proof of posting and a signature on delivery, used for important documents and deadlines (das Einschreiben, plural Einschreiben)
example: Die Kündigung habe ich per Einschreiben geschickt. — I sent the notice of termination by registered mail.

hindi: स्कूल-प्रवेश — बच्चे के पहले स्कूली दिन का उत्सव और समारोह
definition: the ceremony marking a child's first day at primary school, celebrated with family, photos and the sweet cone (die Einschulung, plural Einschulungen)
example: Zur Einschulung kamen auch die Großeltern. — The grandparents came to the first-day-of-school ceremony too.

hindi: आकलन — किसी स्थिति का अनुमानित मूल्यांकन
definition: an estimation or appraisal, a considered judgement of how a situation stands or how something will develop (die Einschätzung, plural Einschätzungen)
example: Nach meiner Einschätzung wird es länger dauern. — In my estimation it will take longer.

hindi: मान लेना, समझ जाना — अपनी ग़लती स्वीकार करना
definition: to realise and accept a truth after resisting it, often admitting that one was wrong about something (separable: sieht ein, hat eingesehen)
example: Er sieht endlich ein, dass er einen Fehler gemacht hat. — He finally admits he made a mistake.

hindi: विरोध-याचिका — किसी निर्णय या कर-निर्धारण के विरुद्ध औपचारिक अपील
definition: a formal objection or appeal against a decision, court ruling or taxation assessment (der Einspruch, plural Einsprüche)
example: Der Einspruch gegen den Steuerbescheid war erfolgreich. — The objection against the tax assessment was successful.

hindi: कभी — बहुत पहले, बीते ज़माने में
definition: once upon a time, long ago in the distant past, a slightly literary word for former days
example: Hier stand einst eine mächtige Burg. — A mighty castle once stood here.

hindi: चढ़ना — गाड़ी, बस या विमान में सवार होना
definition: to board or climb into a train, bus, car or plane before the journey starts (separable: steigt ein, ist eingestiegen)
example: Bitte alle einsteigen, der Zug fährt gleich ab. — All aboard please, the train is about to leave.

hindi: नियुक्त करना — किसी को नौकरी पर रखना
definition: to hire or take on an employee, to give someone a position at a company, also to adjust a device or setting (separable: stellt ein, hat eingestellt)
example: Wir stellen im Herbst zwei Praktikanten ein. — We are hiring two interns in autumn.

hindi: प्रवेश करना — कमरे में क़दम रखना; संस्था में शामिल होना
definition: to enter a room or building by stepping in; to join a club or party; an event happening (separable: tritt ein, ist eingetreten)
example: Bitte treten Sie ein! — Please come in!

hindi: प्रवेश — किसी जगह में जाने की अनुमति या उसका शुल्क
definition: admission or entry, the right to enter a museum, concert or event, and the price charged for it (der Eintritt, plural Eintritte)
example: Der Eintritt ist für Kinder unter sechs Jahren frei. — Admission is free for children under six.

hindi: प्रवेश टिकट — संग्रहालय या शो में जाने का पर्चा
definition: an admission ticket, the printed or digital ticket that lets a visitor enter a museum, concert, cinema or event (die Eintrittskarte, plural Eintrittskarten)
example: Ich habe zwei Eintrittskarten für das Konzert gekauft. — I bought two tickets for the concert.

hindi: एकरस — बिना बदलाव का, नीरस, उबाऊ
definition: monotonous, uniform, tediously boring; describes work, landscape or life without variety
example: Die Arbeit am Fließband ist sehr eintönig. — Work on the assembly line is very monotonous.

hindi: राज़ी — किसी बात या योजना से सहमत
definition: in agreement or willing to accept a proposal, the everyday word for saying that someone consents to a plan
example: Bist du mit dem Termin einverstanden? — Do you agree with the appointment?

hindi: आपत्ति — किसी योजना या तर्क पर उठाई गई शंका
definition: an objection or reservation raised against a plan or argument in a discussion, usually a polite one (der Einwand, plural Einwände)
example: Haben Sie noch einen Einwand gegen den Plan? — Do you still have an objection to the plan?

hindi: एक बार की बोतल — जो एक उपयोग के बाद फेंकी या पिघलाई जाती है
definition: a single-use bottle, a disposable bottle that is used once and then crushed and recycled rather than refilled (die Einwegflasche, plural Einwegflaschen)
example: Die Einwegflasche benutzt man nur ein einziges Mal. — You use the single-use bottle only once.

hindi: आपत्ति उठाना — किसी बात के विरुद्ध तर्क देना
definition: to raise an objection or point out a problem against a proposal or argument during a discussion (separable: wendet ein, hat eingewandt)
example: Dagegen lässt sich nichts einwenden. — There is nothing to object to that.

hindi: निवासी — किसी शहर या देश में रहने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an inhabitant or resident, a person who lives permanently in a particular town, region or country (der Einwohner, plural Einwohner)
example: Ein Einwohner hat sich beim Rathaus beschwert. — One resident complained to the town hall.

hindi: निवासी पंजीकरण कार्यालय — जहाँ पता दर्ज या हटाया जाता है
definition: the residents' registration office where people register or deregister their home address (das Einwohnermeldeamt, plural Einwohnermeldeämter)
example: Das Einwohnermeldeamt hat heute nur bis zwölf geöffnet. — The residents' registration office is open only until twelve today.

hindi: जमा करना — बैंक खाते में पैसा डालना
definition: to deposit cash money into a bank account at the counter or a machine (separable: zahlt ein, hat eingezahlt)
example: Sie zahlt das Geld auf ihr Sparkonto ein. — She deposits the money into her savings account.

hindi: अकेला या एक-एक — अलग-अलग करके, एक इकाई
definition: single or individual items taken separately one at a time, describing individual pieces and separate cases
example: Die Socken werden einzeln verkauft. — The socks are sold individually.

hindi: एकल कमरा — होटल का एक व्यक्ति के लिए बना कमरा
definition: a single room in a hotel or guesthouse intended for exactly one guest, furnished with one narrow bed (das Einzelzimmer, plural Einzelzimmer)
example: Ich hätte gern ein Einzelzimmer für drei Nächte. — I would like a single room for three nights.

hindi: नए घर में आना — किसी मकान में रहने के लिए प्रवेश करना
definition: to move into a flat or house and start living there as its new resident occupant (separable: zieht ein, ist eingezogen)
example: Am Montag ziehen die neuen Mieter ein. — The new tenants are moving in on Monday.

hindi: कुल्फ़ी, बर्फ़ — जमी हुई ठंडी मीठी मलाई; जमा हुआ पानी भी
