definition: ice cream, the frozen sweet cream dessert sold in cones and cups, and also plain frozen water ice (das Eis, no plural)
example: Im Sommer essen wir jeden Tag ein Eis. — In summer we eat an ice cream every day.

hindi: हिमशैल — समुद्र में तैरता बर्फ़ का विशाल पहाड़
definition: a huge mass of ice floating in the ocean with most of its bulk hidden below the surface, calqued into English as iceberg (der Eisberg, plural Eisberge)
example: Das Schiff fuhr langsam an einem Eisberg vorbei. — The ship sailed slowly past an iceberg.

hindi: लोहा — भारी मज़बूत धातु, जिसमें ज़ंग लगता है
definition: iron, the heavy strong grey metal that rusts, used for tools and railings, also the mineral in blood and food (das Eisen, no plural)
example: Das alte Tor ist aus Eisen. — The old gate is made of iron.

hindi: हिम-संत दिवस — मई के मध्य की अंतिम पाला-रातें
definition: the mid-May saints' days when German gardeners expect one last frost before planting anything out
example: She keeps the tomatoes indoors until the Eisheilige are safely past.

hindi: बर्फ़ीला — हड्डी तक ठंड पहुँचाने वाला
definition: icy and freezing, describing bitterly cold wind or weather that cuts through clothing and numbs the skin
example: Ein eisiger Wind weht durch die Straßen. — An icy wind blows through the streets.

hindi: आत्ममुग्धता — अपने रूप-रंग और छवि पर ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा ध्यान
definition: the vanity of someone excessively concerned with their appearance, image and the admiration other people show them (die Eitelkeit, plural Eitelkeiten)
example: Seine Eitelkeit kostet ihn jeden Morgen eine Stunde vor dem Spiegel. — His vanity costs him an hour in front of the mirror every morning.

hindi: घृणित — घिन पैदा करने वाला, वीभत्स
definition: disgusting, revolting, nauseating; strong disapproval of something that causes physical or moral disgust
example: Der Geruch aus dem Kühlschrank ist ekelhaft. — The smell from the fridge is disgusting.

hindi: गंदा-घिनौना — घिन दिलाने वाला; बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: gross, icky, disgusting; the colloquial everyday word for something that makes you feel revulsion
example: Igitt, die Spinne ist total eklig! — Yuck, the spider is totally gross!

hindi: नाज़ुक जगह पर अनाड़ी — जो संवेदनशील स्थिति में बेढंगा व्यवहार करे
definition: a clumsy or tactless person who blunders through a delicate situation and causes damage, like an elephant in a china shop
example: Bei den Verhandlungen benahm er sich wie ein Elefant im Porzellanladen. — In the negotiations he behaved like a bull in a china shop.

hindi: बिजली मिस्त्री — बिजली की तारें, सॉकेट और बत्तियाँ लगाने वाला
definition: an electrician, the tradesperson who installs and repairs electrical wiring, sockets and lights (der Elektriker, plural Elektriker)
example: Der Elektriker installiert eine neue Steckdose im Flur. — The electrician is installing a new socket in the hallway.

hindi: बिजली का — बिजली से चलने वाला या उससे जुड़ा
definition: electric or electrical, powered by electricity or relating to electric current, said of appliances, vehicles and lighting
example: Wir haben eine elektrische Zahnbürste gekauft. — We bought an electric toothbrush.

hindi: ग्यारह — दस से एक अधिक की संख्या
definition: the cardinal number eleven, used in counting people and things and for the late morning hour; a football team is also called this
example: Um elf trinken wir zusammen Kaffee. — At eleven we drink coffee together.

hindi: दंड-प्रहार — फ़ुटबॉल में ग्यारह मीटर से सीधा गोल पर शॉट
definition: a penalty kick in football, the free shot at goal from eleven metres awarded after a foul in the penalty area (der Elfmeter, plural Elfmeter)
example: Der Schiedsrichter gab einen Elfmeter. — The referee awarded a penalty.

hindi: कोहनी — बाँह के बीच का जोड़ जहाँ हाथ मुड़ता है
definition: the elbow, the joint in the middle of the arm where the forearm bends against the upper arm (der Ellbogen, plural Ellbogen)
example: Ich habe mir den Ellbogen am Tisch gestoßen. — I banged my elbow on the table.

hindi: माता-पिता — बच्चे के माँ और पिता दोनों
definition: the parents, the mother and father of a child spoken of together as one pair, always plural in German (die Eltern, plural only)
example: Die Eltern holen die Kinder von der Schule ab. — The parents pick the children up from school.

hindi: अभिभावक-सभा — शाम को कक्षा के माता-पिता और शिक्षक की बैठक
definition: a parents' evening, a meeting at school where the class teacher informs the parents and discusses issues with them (der Elternabend, plural Elternabende)
example: Der Elternabend ist am Donnerstag in der Schule. — The parents' evening is on Thursday at school.

hindi: अभिभावक भत्ता — जन्म के बाद घर रहने वाले माँ-बाप को सरकारी वेतन-पूर्ति
definition: the state parental allowance paid to a parent who stays home after a birth, replacing part of the lost salary (das Elterngeld, no plural)
example: Das Elterngeld muss man rechtzeitig beantragen. — You have to apply for the parental allowance in time.

hindi: अभिभावक अवकाश — छोटे बच्चे की देखभाल के लिए नौकरी से क़ानूनी छुट्टी
definition: parental leave, the legally protected period a parent takes away from their job to care for a young child (die Elternzeit, plural Elternzeiten)
example: Die Elternzeit von meinem Kollegen dauert ein Jahr. — My colleague's parental leave lasts a year.

hindi: स्वागत — होटल का स्वागत-काउंटर, या किसी का स्वागत-सत्कार
definition: the reception desk or front counter of a hotel or office, also the act of welcoming guests (der Empfang, plural Empfänge)
example: Am Empfang wartet schon ein Brief für Sie. — A letter is already waiting for you at reception.

hindi: स्वागत करना — मेहमान या संदेश ग्रहण करना
definition: to receive a guest, a signal or a message, formally welcoming a visitor or picking up a broadcast (irregular: empfängt, hat empfangen)
example: Der Chef empfängt die Gäste persönlich am Eingang. — The boss receives the guests personally at the entrance.

hindi: सिफ़ारिश करना — किसी चीज़ को चुनने की सलाह देना
definition: to recommend a restaurant, a book or a course of action to someone as worth choosing (irregular: empfiehlt, hat empfohlen, + Dativ)
example: Können Sie mir ein gutes Restaurant empfehlen? — Can you recommend a good restaurant to me?

hindi: अनुभव करना — किसी भावना या संवेदना को भीतर महसूस करना
definition: to feel or perceive an emotion or sensation such as pain, gratitude or fear, a somewhat formal word for inner experience (irregular: empfindet, empfand, hat empfunden)
example: Sie empfindet tiefe Dankbarkeit für die Hilfe. — She feels deep gratitude for the help.

hindi: नाज़ुक — हल्की चोट या बदलाव से भी प्रभावित होने वाला
definition: sensitive, touchy or delicate, describing skin, instruments or people that react strongly to small things
example: Meine Haut ist sehr empfindlich gegen Sonne. — My skin is very sensitive to sun.

hindi: प्राप्तकर्ता — जिसे संदेश या डाक भेजी गई हो
definition: a recipient, the person or address that receives an email, letter, parcel or payment; the opposite of Absender (der Empfänger, plural Empfänger)
example: Der Empfänger hat die E-Mail nicht bekommen. — The recipient did not receive the email.

hindi: आक्रोश — अनुचित बात पर जगा नैतिक रोष
definition: indignation or outrage, the loud moral anger people express when something offends their sense of fairness (die Empörung, plural Empörungen)
example: Die Entscheidung löste eine Welle der Empörung aus. — The decision set off a wave of outrage.

hindi: अंत — किसी चीज़ का समापन या आख़िरी हिस्सा
definition: the end, the final part or closing point of something in time or space, as in am Ende meaning in the end (das Ende, plural Enden)
example: Am Ende des Monats habe ich kein Geld. — At the end of the month I have no money.

hindi: आख़िरकार, अंततः — लम्बे इंतज़ार के बाद
definition: finally, at last, after a long wait or delay, expressing relief that something has happened
example: Endlich ist der Sommer da. — Summer is finally here.

hindi: अंतहीन — जो कभी ख़त्म न हो
definition: endless or interminable in length or duration, describing long waits, meetings and roads that seem never to finish
example: Die Warterei war endlos. — The waiting was endless.

hindi: अंतिम स्टेशन — वह जगह जहाँ लाइन ख़त्म होती और सब उतरते हैं
definition: the terminus or last stop of a line, where the train or bus ends its journey and everyone gets off (die Endstation, plural Endstationen)
example: Die Endstation dieser Linie ist der Hauptbahnhof. — The terminus of this line is the main station.

hindi: ऊर्जा — काम करने, चलाने या गरम करने की शक्ति
definition: energy, the power needed to heat, move or run things, whether from fuel, sunlight or electricity (die Energie, plural Energien)
example: Die Energie für unser Haus kommt vom Dach. — The energy for our house comes from the roof.

hindi: तंग — शरीर से कसकर चिपका हुआ
definition: tight or narrow, said of clothes that fit closely and leave little room around the body (eng, enger, am engsten)
example: Die Jeans ist mir zu eng. — The jeans are too tight for me.

hindi: देवदूत — ईश्वर का पंखधारी संदेशवाहक; बहुत भला व्यक्ति
definition: an angel, a winged heavenly messenger of God, also affectionately a very kind and helpful person (der Engel, plural Engel)
example: Du bist ein Engel, danke für die Hilfe! — You are an angel, thanks for the help!

hindi: पोता या नाती — बेटे या बेटी का बेटा
definition: the grandson, the male child of one's own son or daughter, also used for grandchildren generally (der Enkel, plural Enkel)
example: Der Enkel besucht seine Oma im Krankenhaus. — The grandson visits his grandma in the hospital.

hindi: पोती या नातिन — बेटे या बेटी की बेटी
definition: the granddaughter, the female child of one's own son or daughter, the next generation down in the family (die Enkelin, plural Enkelinnen)
example: Seine Enkelin heißt Lena und geht schon zur Schule. — His granddaughter is called Lena and already goes to school.

hindi: अत्यधिक — बहुत बड़ा या बहुत ज़्यादा
definition: enormous or extremely large in size, amount or degree, often used of costs, effort and pressure rather than objects
example: Der Aufwand war enorm. — The effort was enormous.

hindi: खोजना — पहले से मौजूद पर अनजानी चीज़ का पता लगाना
definition: to discover something that existed but was unknown before, from a distant planet to a hidden mistake (regular: hat entdeckt)
example: Die Forscher haben einen neuen Planeten entdeckt. — The researchers discovered a new planet.

hindi: खोज — पहले से मौजूद पर अनजानी चीज़ का पता लगाना
definition: a discovery, the finding of something that already existed but was unknown before, such as a planet or a law of nature (die Entdeckung, plural Entdeckungen)
example: Die Entdeckung des Penicillins hat viele Leben gerettet. — The discovery of penicillin saved many lives.

hindi: बत्तख़ — तालाब में तैरने वाला पक्षी
definition: a duck, the water bird with webbed feet that swims on ponds and quacks (die Ente, plural Enten)
example: Wir füttern die Ente am Teich. — We feed the duck at the pond.

hindi: याद से निकल जाना — कोई नाम या बात अचानक भूल जाना
definition: to slip someone's mind, a slightly formal way to say a name or detail has escaped memory (irregular: entfällt, ist entfallen; + Dativ)
example: Der Name der Straße ist mir leider entfallen. — The name of the street has slipped my mind.

hindi: हटाना — किसी चीज़ को जगह से दूर करना
definition: to remove something from a place, taking away a stain, a file or an object (regular: hat entfernt)
example: Bitte entfernen Sie die alten Aufkleber. — Please remove the old stickers.

hindi: दूर — किसी निश्चित दूरी पर स्थित
definition: distant or located a certain measured distance away from a place, the adjective used after kilometres or minutes to state how far something is
example: Der See ist zwei Kilometer entfernt. — The lake is two kilometres away.

hindi: के विपरीत — किसी अपेक्षा या नियम के उलट
definition: contrary to an expectation, rule or advice, or moving towards someone approaching (preposition, + Dativ, before or after the noun)
example: Entgegen allen Erwartungen gewann er das Spiel. — Contrary to all expectations he won the match.

hindi: ग्रहण करना — औपचारिक रूप से कोई चीज़ या संदेश प्राप्त करना
definition: to formally receive or accept something being handed over, such as a delivery, a prize or a telephone message (separable: nimmt entgegen, hat entgegengenommen)
example: Die Sekretärin nimmt die Pakete entgegen. — The secretary receives the parcels.

hindi: पलटकर कहना — किसी बात का विरोध या जवाब देना
definition: to retort or reply to someone, often with a contrary or defensive point, mainly in written narrative (regular: entgegnet, hat entgegnet; jemandem entgegnen)
example: Er entgegnete, das sei nicht sein Problem. — He retorted that that was not his problem.

hindi: शामिल होना — किसी चीज़ के भीतर मौजूद होना
definition: to contain or include something as an ingredient or component, said of food, packages and prices (irregular: enthält, hat enthalten)
example: Der Preis enthält bereits das Frühstück. — The price already includes breakfast.

hindi: के साथ-साथ — किसी सड़क या नदी की लंबाई में चलते हुए
definition: along the length of a street, river or wall, following its course, a preposition that usually stands after the noun (+ Akkusativ, placed after the noun: die Straße entlang)
example: Gehen Sie den Fluss entlang bis zur Brücke. — Walk along the river until the bridge.

hindi: बर्ख़ास्त करना — कर्मचारी को नौकरी से निकाल देना
definition: to dismiss or lay off an employee, to release someone from their job, also to discharge a patient from hospital (entlässt, hat entlassen)
example: Die Firma hat zwanzig Leute entlassen. — The company laid off twenty people.

hindi: फ़ैसला करना — विकल्पों में से चुनाव करना
definition: to decide a question or make a choice between options, reflexively for choosing something for yourself (irregular: entschied, hat entschieden; sich entscheiden für + Akkusativ)
example: Ich habe mich für das blaue Hemd entschieden. — I decided on the blue shirt.

hindi: निर्णायक — जिस पर सारा नतीजा निर्भर करे
definition: decisive or crucial, being the factor that determines the outcome of a question or contest
example: Der entscheidende Punkt ist die Finanzierung. — The decisive point is the funding.

hindi: निर्णय — विकल्पों में से एक को चुनने का फ़ैसला
definition: a decision, the act of making up one's mind and choosing between possibilities after consideration (die Entscheidung, plural Entscheidungen)
example: Die Entscheidung fällt mir schwer. — The decision is hard for me.

hindi: क्षमा — माफ़ी माँगने या ध्यान खींचने का शब्द
definition: an apology or excuse, also the word spoken to get someone's attention or squeeze past (die Entschuldigung, plural Entschuldigungen)
example: Die Entschuldigung kam leider zu spät. — The apology unfortunately came too late.

hindi: विकराल — भयावह, दहला देने वाला; बहुत बुरा
definition: appalling, horrifying, dreadful; disapproval of something shocking or unbearably unpleasant
example: Der Lärm auf der Baustelle ist entsetzlich. — The noise at the building site is appalling.

hindi: निपटान करना — कचरे को सही तरीके से ठिकाने लगाना
definition: to dispose of waste properly, to get rid of rubbish or old items through the correct official channel (regular: hat entsorgt)
example: Batterien muss man getrennt entsorgen. — Batteries must be disposed of separately.

hindi: तनावमुक्त — ढीला और आराम में
definition: relaxed and at ease, calm and free from tension, worry and stress after rest, holidays or leisure
example: Nach dem Urlaub war er richtig entspannt. — After the holiday he was really relaxed.

hindi: तनावमुक्ति — शरीर और मन का ढीला पड़ना
definition: relaxation, the loosening of tension in body and mind during quiet leisure (die Entspannung, no plural)
example: Yoga ist gut für die Entspannung. — Yoga is good for relaxation.

hindi: उत्पन्न होना — कोई चीज़ बनना या पैदा होना
definition: to come into being, arise or develop, said of buildings, ideas, problems and costs (irregular: entstand, ist entstanden)
example: Hier entsteht ein neues Einkaufszentrum. — A new shopping centre is being built here.

hindi: निराश करना — किसी की उम्मीद तोड़ना
definition: to disappoint someone by failing to meet their hopes or expectations, leaving them let down (regular: hat enttäuscht)
example: Das Ergebnis hat uns alle enttäuscht. — The result disappointed us all.

hindi: निराशाजनक — उम्मीद से कमतर, मन तोड़ने वाला
definition: disappointing, falling short of hopes or expectations; disapproval of a result or performance
example: Das Ergebnis war leider enttäuschend. — The result was unfortunately disappointing.

hindi: निराश — उम्मीद टूटने से दुखी
definition: disappointed, feeling let down because something or someone turned out worse than hoped
example: Er war enttäuscht von dem Film. — He was disappointed by the film.

hindi: निराशा — उम्मीद के मुताबिक़ न होने पर मन का टूटना
definition: disappointment, the sad let-down feeling when something turns out worse than expected (die Enttäuschung, plural Enttäuschungen)
example: Die Absage war eine große Enttäuschung für ihn. — The rejection was a great disappointment for him.

hindi: या तो — दो विकल्पों में से एक चुनने की जोड़ी का पहला शब्द
definition: either; the first half of the pair entweder ... oder presenting two mutually exclusive alternatives
example: Entweder gehen wir ins Kino oder wir bleiben hier. — Either we go to the cinema or we stay here.

hindi: मुहर लगवाना — यंत्र में यात्रा-पत्र पर मुहर लगाकर उसे वैध बनाना
definition: to validate a ticket by stamping it in the machine before the journey, marking it as used (regular: hat entwertet)
example: Sie müssen den Fahrschein vor der Fahrt entwerten. — You must validate the ticket before the journey.

hindi: विकसित करना — किसी चीज़ को धीरे-धीरे बनाना और बेहतर करना
definition: to develop a product, method or idea step by step, also to grow and change over time as a reflexive verb (regular: hat entwickelt)
example: Die Firma entwickelt ein neues Medikament. — The company is developing a new medicine.

hindi: विकास — किसी चीज़ का धीरे-धीरे आगे बढ़ना और बनना
definition: a development or gradual progress of something over time, from a child's growth to a new product or a political situation (die Entwicklung, plural Entwicklungen)
example: Die Entwicklung des Projekts dauert zwei Jahre. — The development of the project takes two years.

hindi: युग — इतिहास का एक विशिष्ट लंबा काल
definition: an epoch or era, a distinct long period of history with its own character and style (die Epoche, plural Epochen)
example: Das Barock war eine prächtige Epoche. — The Baroque was a magnificent epoch.

hindi: वह (पुल्लिंग) — किसी पुरुष या पुल्लिंग संज्ञा के लिए
definition: the third person singular pronoun standing for a male person or for any grammatically masculine noun such as a table or a computer (Akkusativ ihn, Dativ ihm)
example: Er arbeitet als Lehrer in Berlin. — He works as a teacher in Berlin.

hindi: विरासत — पूर्वजों से मिली संपत्ति या संस्कृति
definition: an inheritance or heritage, whether money and property left by the dead or the cultural legacy of the past (das Erbe, no plural)
example: Die Altstadt ist ein wertvolles kulturelles Erbe. — The old town is a valuable cultural heritage.

hindi: विरासत में पाना — किसी के मरने पर उसकी संपत्ति मिलना
definition: to inherit money, property or a family trait from a relative who has died (regular: erbt, hat geerbt)
example: Sie hat das Haus von ihrer Tante geerbt. — She inherited the house from her aunt.

hindi: अचानक देख लेना — नज़र में आ जाना
definition: to catch sight of something or suddenly see someone, a slightly formal or literary word for spotting (regular)
example: Plötzlich erblickte sie ihren Bruder in der Menge. — Suddenly she spotted her brother in the crowd.

hindi: विरासत की संपत्ति — मृत्यु के बाद मिलने वाला धन या माल
definition: an inheritance as a concrete sum of money or property received after a relative's death (die Erbschaft, plural Erbschaften)
example: Mit der Erbschaft kaufte er eine kleine Wohnung. — With the inheritance he bought a small flat.

hindi: मटर — फली में उगने वाला छोटा हरा गोल दाना
definition: a pea, one of the small round green peas or seeds that grow in a pod and are cooked as a vegetable or in soup (die Erbse, plural Erbsen)
example: Die Erbsen rollen vom Teller auf den Boden. — The peas roll off the plate onto the floor.

hindi: मटर गिनने वाला — छोटी-छोटी बातों में उलझने वाला कंजूस और नुक़्ताचीन व्यक्ति
definition: a pedantic petty person who fusses over trivial details and tiny amounts, a nitpicking bean-counter, literally someone who counts peas (der Erbsenzähler, plural Erbsenzähler)
example: Unser Buchhalter ist ein Erbsenzähler, er prüft jeden Cent. — Our accountant is a nitpicker, he checks every cent.

hindi: आलू — मिट्टी के नीचे उगने वाला कंद, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: a potato, the starchy tuber vegetable grown underground, in its Austrian and southern name where Germany says Kartoffel (der Erdapfel, plural Erdäpfel)
example: Der Erdapfel wird mit Schale gekocht. — The potato is boiled with its skin on.

hindi: भूकंप — ज़मीन का अचानक ज़ोर से हिलना
definition: an earthquake, a sudden violent shaking of the ground that can destroy buildings and injure people (das Erdbeben, plural Erdbeben)
example: Das Erdbeben war auch in der Hauptstadt zu spüren. — The earthquake could be felt in the capital too.

hindi: लाल रसीला झाड़ी-फल — दिल के आकार का छोटा मीठा फल, गर्मियों की शुरुआत में
definition: a strawberry, the small red heart-shaped summer fruit with tiny seeds on its skin, loved on cakes and with cream (die Erdbeere, plural Erdbeeren)
example: Die Erdbeere liegt oben auf dem Kuchen. — The strawberry sits on top of the cake.

hindi: धरती, मिट्टी — हमारा ग्रह या ज़मीन की ऊपरी परत
definition: the earth, both the planet people live on and the loose brown soil that plants grow in (die Erde, plural Erden)
example: Sie pflanzt die Blume in die Erde. — She plants the flower in the soil.

hindi: भूमंडलीय तापन — पूरी धरती के औसत तापमान का बढ़ना
definition: global warming, the steady rise of the average temperature of the planet caused by greenhouse gases (die Erderwärmung, no plural)
example: Die Erderwärmung lässt die Gletscher schmelzen. — Global warming is making the glaciers melt.

hindi: प्राकृतिक गैस — ज़मीन से निकली जलने वाली गैस
definition: natural gas, the fossil fuel gas piped from underground and burned for heating and cooking (das Erdgas, no plural)
example: Das Erdgas ist diesen Winter sehr teuer. — Natural gas is very expensive this winter.

hindi: भूतल — इमारत की ज़मीन वाली मंज़िल
definition: the ground floor, the level of a building at street height, which Germans count as floor zero (das Erdgeschoss, plural Erdgeschosse)
example: Der Laden ist im Erdgeschoss. — The shop is on the ground floor.

hindi: भूगोल — देशों, नदियों और जलवायु का स्कूली विषय
definition: geography as a school subject, the study of countries, landscapes, climate and where people live (die Erdkunde, no plural)
example: In Erdkunde lernen wir die Hauptstädte Europas. — In geography we learn the capitals of Europe.

hindi: कच्चा तेल — ज़मीन से निकला तेल जिससे पेट्रोल बनता है
definition: crude oil or petroleum, the fossil fuel pumped from underground and refined into petrol, diesel and plastic (das Erdöl, no plural)
example: Das Erdöl wird in der Raffinerie zu Benzin verarbeitet. — The crude oil is refined into petrol at the refinery.

hindi: पता चलना, अनुभव करना — किसी बात की ख़बर मिलना
definition: to find out or learn news from someone, and also to experience something oneself (irregular: erfährt, erfuhr, hat erfahren)
example: Ich habe erst gestern von der Hochzeit erfahren. — I only learned about the wedding yesterday.

hindi: अनुभव — जीवन या काम में ख़ुद देखकर-करके सीखी हुई बात
definition: experience, the practical knowledge and skill a person gains from living through and doing things over time (die Erfahrung, plural Erfahrungen)
example: Die Erfahrung im Beruf hilft ihr jeden Tag. — The experience from her job helps her every day.

hindi: आविष्कार करना — कोई नई चीज़ पहली बार बनाना, या कहानी गढ़ना
definition: to invent something new that did not exist before, also to make up a story or excuse (irregular: erfindet, hat erfunden)
example: Wer hat das Telefon erfunden? — Who invented the telephone?

hindi: आविष्कारक — नई चीज़ें या युक्तियाँ बनाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an inventor, a person who creates a new device, machine or method that did not exist before (der Erfinder, plural Erfinder)
example: Der Erfinder zeigt seine neue Maschine. — The inventor shows his new machine.

hindi: आविष्कार — पहले न रही कोई नई चीज़ या युक्ति बनाना
definition: an invention, a new device, machine or method that somebody created for the first time (die Erfindung, plural Erfindungen)
example: Das Rad war eine wichtige Erfindung. — The wheel was an important invention.

hindi: सफलता — कोशिश का अच्छा नतीजा, कामयाबी
definition: success, the good result of effort, also used in wishes before exams and ventures (der Erfolg, plural Erfolge)
example: Der Erfolg hat ihn nicht verändert. — Success did not change him.

hindi: सफल — जिसे कामयाबी मिली हो, कारगर
definition: successful, achieving the desired result or enjoying recognition in work and business
example: Sie ist eine sehr erfolgreiche Unternehmerin. — She is a very successful entrepreneur.

hindi: परिणाम — मुक़ाबले का अंतिम स्कोर या किसी काम का नतीजा
definition: a result or score, the final outcome of a match or competition, and more generally the outcome of any effort (das Ergebnis, plural Ergebnisse)
example: Kennst du schon das Ergebnis vom Spiel? — Do you know the result of the match yet?

hindi: थाम लेना — मज़बूती से पकड़ना या अवसर पर लपकना
definition: to seize or take hold of something firmly, also used for grasping an opportunity or taking measures (inseparable: ergriff, hat ergriffen)
example: Er ergriff die Chance und wechselte den Job. — He seized the chance and changed jobs.

hindi: प्राप्त करना — औपचारिक ढंग से कुछ मिलना
definition: to receive or obtain something, the formal written equivalent of bekommen, also to preserve or keep something intact (irregular: erhält, erhielt, hat erhalten)
example: Sie haben unsere Nachricht erhalten. — You have received our message.

hindi: विश्राम — थकान के बाद ताज़गी लौटाने वाला आराम
definition: recovery and rest, the restful recreation that restores strength after strain or illness (die Erholung, no plural)
example: Die Erholung am Meer hat ihr gutgetan. — The rest by the sea did her good.

hindi: याद — बीती बात की स्मृति; या याद दिलाने वाली चीज़
definition: a memory or recollection of a person, place or event from the past, also a reminder or keepsake that brings it back (die Erinnerung, plural Erinnerungen)
example: Ich habe schöne Erinnerungen an diese Reise. — I have lovely memories of this trip.

hindi: स्मरण-संस्कृति — समाज का अपने इतिहास को याद रखने का तरीका
definition: the culture of remembrance, the way a society publicly remembers its history through memorials, days and education (die Erinnerungskultur, plural Erinnerungskulturen)
example: Die Erinnerungskultur prägt viele Debatten im Land. — The culture of remembrance shapes many debates in the country.

hindi: पहचानना — देखकर या समझकर किसी को जान लेना
definition: to recognise a person or thing seen before, and to realise or perceive a truth clearly and suddenly (irregular: erkennt, erkannte, hat erkannt)
example: Ich habe dich auf dem Foto sofort erkannt. — I recognised you in the photo immediately.

hindi: बोध — सूचना से आगे बढ़कर भीतर उतरी समझ
definition: knowledge arrived at by insight, the moment when information stops being data and becomes understanding
example: After a decade of practice came the quiet Erkenntnis that technique was never the obstacle.

hindi: कठिन चढ़ाई पूरी करना — मेहनत से ऊँचाई या शिखर तक पहुँचना
definition: to scale or climb something high and difficult with effort, reaching a summit or top step (irregular: erklomm, hat erklommen; + Akkusativ)
example: Mühsam erklimmen wir den steilen Gipfel. — With effort we scale the steep summit.

hindi: समझाना — किसी बात को साफ़ शब्दों में स्पष्ट करना
definition: to explain something clearly with words so that another person understands it, also to declare something officially (regular: erklärt, hat erklärt; jemandem etwas erklären)
example: Kannst du mir diese Regel erklären? — Can you explain this rule to me?

hindi: व्याख्या या घोषणा — किसी बात को समझाना या औपचारिक बयान
definition: an explanation that makes something understandable by giving reasons, also a formal declaration or official statement (die Erklärung, plural Erklärungen)
example: Gibt es eine Erklärung für dieses Verhalten? — Is there an explanation for this behaviour?

hindi: सफ़ाई का संकट — जवाब देना ज़रूरी, पर देने को कुछ नहीं
definition: the cornered position of owing an explanation you cannot honestly give, where silence looks guilty
example: The minister was in Erklärungsnot the moment the receipts surfaced.

hindi: ज़ुकाम-ग्रस्त — सर्दी लगी हुई
definition: having caught a common cold, suffering from a runny nose, coughing, sneezing and a sore throat
example: Ich bin erkältet und bleibe heute zu Hause. — I have a cold and am staying home today.

hindi: ज़ुकाम — नाक बहने, खाँसी और हल्की थकान वाली आम बीमारी
definition: a common cold, the mild infection that brings a runny nose, sneezing, sore throat and tiredness (die Erkältung, plural Erkältungen)
example: Ich habe eine Erkältung und bleibe heute zu Hause. — I have a cold and am staying home today.

hindi: अनुमति देना — किसी काम की इजाज़त देना
definition: to allow or permit someone to do something, giving official or parental permission (regular: hat erlaubt, + Dativ)
example: Meine Eltern erlauben mir, länger wegzubleiben. — My parents allow me to stay out longer.

hindi: अनुमति — कुछ करने की इजाज़त, ख़ासकर लिखित
definition: permission or a licence to do something, given by a person in charge or by an authority, often in writing (die Erlaubnis, plural Erlaubnisse)
example: Ohne Erlaubnis darf man hier nicht parken. — You may not park here without permission.

hindi: अनुभव-घटना — कोई ख़ास बात जो किसी के साथ घटी और याद रह गई
definition: an experience as a single memorable event, something exciting or striking that happens to a person and stays in memory (das Erlebnis, plural Erlebnisse)
example: Die Reise war ein unvergessliches Erlebnis. — The trip was an unforgettable experience.

hindi: निपटाना — कोई काम पूरा कर देना
definition: to get a task done and finish it off, dealing with errands, paperwork or chores (regular: hat erledigt)
example: Ich muss noch ein paar Einkäufe erledigen. — I still have to do some shopping.

hindi: राहत पाया हुआ — चिंता या बोझ हटने पर हल्का महसूस करता
definition: relieved, feeling light and freed after a worry, fear or burden has finally passed
example: Ich bin erleichtert, dass alles gut gegangen ist. — I am relieved that everything went well.

hindi: राहत — बोझ या डर हटने पर मिला हल्कापन
definition: relief, the light easy feeling when a burden, fear or pain finally passes (die Erleichterung, plural Erleichterungen)
example: Die Erleichterung war groß, als der Anruf kam. — The relief was great when the call came.

hindi: विस्तार से समझाना — किसी कठिन बात को और स्पष्ट करना
definition: to elucidate or explain something in more detail, a formal word typical of lectures and reports (regular: erläutert, hat erläutert)
example: Der Professor erläuterte seine Theorie ausführlich. — The professor explained his theory in detail.

hindi: स्पष्टीकरण — विस्तार से समझाने वाली टिप्पणी
definition: a clarifying explanation or commentary that spells out details so that a text, rule or plan becomes fully understandable (die Erläuterung, plural Erläuterungen)
example: Die Erläuterungen zum Formular stehen auf der Rückseite. — The explanatory notes for the form are on the back.

hindi: तफ़्तीश करना — अपराध की पुलिस जाँच करना
definition: to investigate a crime as the police or prosecutor, also to determine or find out a value (regular; gegen + Akkusativ for the suspect)
example: Die Polizei ermittelt gegen den Manager. — The police are investigating the manager.

hindi: छूट — छात्रों, बुज़ुर्गों आदि के लिए किराये में कमी
definition: a discount or reduction in price, especially the reduced fare for students, children or seniors (die Ermäßigung, plural Ermäßigungen)
example: Studenten bekommen eine Ermäßigung auf die Fahrkarte. — Students get a discount on the ticket.

hindi: नवीकरणीय — जो प्रकृति में फिर से बनती रहे, जैसे सूरज या हवा की ऊर्जा
definition: renewable, describing energy sources like sunlight, wind and water that replenish themselves and never run out
example: Erneuerbare Energien werden jedes Jahr billiger. — Renewable energies get cheaper every year.

hindi: नया करना — पुरानी चीज़ की जगह नई लगाना या नवीनीकरण करना
definition: to renew or replace something worn out with something new, such as a roof, a passport, a contract or a promise (regular: hat erneuert)
example: Wir müssen das Dach erneuern lassen. — We have to get the roof renewed.

hindi: फ़सल की कटाई — मौसम में काटी गई उपज
definition: a harvest, the crops gathered from the fields in one season, or the act of gathering them (die Ernte, plural Ernten)
example: Die Ernte war dieses Jahr sehr gut. — The harvest was very good this year.

hindi: फसल-धन्यवाद पर्व — अक्टूबर में फसल के लिए आभार का चर्च उत्सव
definition: the harvest thanksgiving festival in early October when churches are decorated with fruit, vegetables and grain (das Erntedankfest, plural Erntedankfeste)
example: Zum Erntedankfest schmücken wir die Kirche. — For the harvest festival we decorate the church.

hindi: फ़सल काटना — पकी उपज इकट्ठा करना
definition: to harvest, to gather ripe crops or fruit from the field, orchard or garden (regular: erntet, hat geerntet)
example: Im September ernten wir die Äpfel. — In September we harvest the apples.

hindi: आहार — जो कोई नियमित खाता है और उसका पोषण
definition: nutrition, the whole pattern of what a person eats and drinks and how it nourishes the body (die Ernährung, no plural)
example: Eine ausgewogene Ernährung hält den Körper fit. — A balanced diet keeps the body fit.

hindi: सही अंदाज़ा लगाना — बूझकर ठीक उत्तर पा लेना
definition: to guess something correctly, to arrive at the right answer or solution by guessing rather than knowing (irregular: errät, erriet, hat erraten)
example: Du hast mein Geheimnis sofort erraten. — You guessed my secret right away.

hindi: पहुँचना या पकड़ना — गाड़ी समय पर पकड़ लेना, या किसी जगह तक पहुँचना
definition: to reach a place or catch a train in time, also to reach someone by telephone (regular: hat erreicht)
example: Wenn wir laufen, erreichen wir den Zug noch. — If we run we will still catch the train.

hindi: नकली विकल्प — असली की जगह रखा घटिया बदल
definition: a substitute standing in for the real thing and worse for it, as wartime acorn coffee was for coffee
example: The apology was Ersatz, assembled from phrases a lawyer had approved.

hindi: सृष्टि करना — कुछ भव्य या नया रचना
definition: to create something great or entirely new, an elevated word used for artists, inventors and divine creation (irregular: hat erschaffen)
example: Der Künstler hat eine ganz neue Welt erschaffen. — The artist has created an entirely new world.

hindi: छपकर आना — किताब या अख़बार का प्रकाशित होना; प्रकट होना
definition: to be published or come out, of a newspaper, magazine or book, and also to appear or turn up somewhere (irregular: erschien, ist erschienen)
example: Die Zeitschrift erscheint jeden Freitag. — The magazine comes out every Friday.

hindi: चौंक जाना — अचानक डर से सहम उठना
definition: to be startled or frightened suddenly by a noise, sight or surprise, the intransitive sense with a strong past (irregular: erschrickt, erschrak, ist erschrocken)
example: Ich bin bei dem lauten Knall richtig erschrocken. — I was really startled by the loud bang.

hindi: सहमा हुआ — अचानक डर से चौंका
definition: startled and frightened, shocked and shaken by something sudden, loud or alarming
example: Sie sah mich erschrocken an. — She looked at me, startled.

hindi: निढाल — पूरी तरह थककर चूर हो जाना
definition: exhausted and completely drained of energy after heavy effort, unable to continue without rest
example: Nach dem Marathon war sie völlig erschöpft. — After the marathon she was completely exhausted.

hindi: थकावट — शक्ति पूरी तरह चुक जाने की अवस्था
definition: exhaustion, the state of having completely used up all physical or mental energy and strength (die Erschöpfung, no plural)
example: Die Erschöpfung nach der Reise war groß. — The exhaustion after the journey was great.

hindi: बदले में लगाना — किसी चीज़ की जगह दूसरी चीज़ रखना
definition: to replace one thing or person with another that takes over its place or function, also to reimburse a cost (regular: hat ersetzt; durch + Akkusativ)
example: Wir ersetzen die alte Lampe durch eine neue. — We are replacing the old lamp with a new one.

hindi: बचत — समय के साथ जमा की गई रकम
definition: savings, the money a person has put aside over time, nearly always used in the plural (die Ersparnis, plural Ersparnisse)
example: Sie hat ihre ganzen Ersparnisse in das Haus gesteckt. — She put all her savings into the house.

hindi: अभी केवल — अपेक्षा से देर से; सबसे पहले
definition: only, not until, later than expected, and also meaning first of all
example: Der Bus kommt erst um zehn. — The bus does not come until ten.

hindi: लौटाना — किसी का खर्च किया पैसा वापस देना
definition: to reimburse or refund money that someone spent, as a company repays travel costs or a shop returns a price (regular: erstattet, hat erstattet)
example: Die Firma erstattet mir die Fahrtkosten. — The company reimburses my travel costs.

hindi: आश्चर्यजनक — चकित कर देने वाला, अप्रत्याशित
definition: astonishing, amazing, remarkable; describes something that surprises through being better than expected
example: Für sein Alter ist er erstaunlich fit. — For his age he is astonishingly fit.

hindi: अचंभित — हैरानी से भरा, विस्मित
definition: astonished and amazed, struck with wonder and disbelief at something remarkable or unexpected
example: Die Zuschauer waren erstaunt über das Ergebnis. — The audience was astonished by the result.

hindi: पहला — क्रम में सबसे आगे वाला
definition: the ordinal number first, describing whoever or whatever comes before all others in a sequence, race or list
example: Das ist mein erster Tag im neuen Büro. — This is my first day in the new office.

hindi: प्राथमिक उपचार — डॉक्टर आने से पहले घायल को दी गई शुरुआती देखभाल
definition: first aid, the immediate basic medical treatment and care given to an injured or sick person before professional help arrives (die Erste Hilfe, no plural)
example: Jeder Autofahrer sollte Erste Hilfe leisten können. — Every driver should be able to give first aid.

hindi: नीलामी में ख़रीदना — सबसे ऊँची बोली लगाकर पाना
definition: to buy something at an auction by making the highest bid, including online auction websites (inseparable, regular: ersteigert, hat ersteigert)
example: Ich habe die Lampe im Internet ersteigert. — I bought the lamp at an online auction.

hindi: दम घुटना — हवा न मिलने से मरना या साँस रुकना
definition: to suffocate or choke, to die or struggle because no air reaches the lungs, for example in smoke (regular: erstickt, erstickte, ist erstickt)
example: Viele Menschen ersticken bei Bränden am Rauch. — Many people suffocate from smoke in fires.

hindi: प्रथम श्रेणी — सबसे ऊँचे दर्जे का, बेहतरीन गुणवत्ता का
definition: first-class, top-quality, excellent; praise for goods, service or performance of the highest standard
example: Das Hotel bietet erstklassigen Service. — The hotel offers first-class service.

hindi: सहना — कष्ट या अप्रिय स्थिति को धैर्य से झेलना
definition: to bear or endure something painful or unpleasant with patience, often used negatively for what one cannot stand (irregular: erträgt, ertrug, hat ertragen)
example: Ich kann diesen Lärm nicht mehr ertragen. — I cannot bear this noise any longer.

hindi: डूबना — पानी में साँस न ले पाने से मरना
definition: to drown, to die under water because breathing becomes impossible, whether in a lake, river or swimming pool (irregular: ertrinkt, ertrank, ist ertrunken)
example: Das Kind wäre fast im See ertrunken. — The child almost drowned in the lake.

hindi: वयस्क — पूरी तरह बड़ा हो चुका व्यक्ति
definition: the adult, a fully grown person who is no longer a child, declined like an adjective (der/die Erwachsene, plural Erwachsenen)
example: Die Erwachsenen sitzen am großen Tisch. — The adults are sitting at the big table.

hindi: उम्मीद करना — किसी के आने या कुछ होने की प्रतीक्षा करना
definition: to expect something to happen or someone to arrive, also to await a baby or look forward to news (regular: hat erwartet)
example: Wir erwarten heute Abend Besuch. — We are expecting visitors this evening.

hindi: विस्तार करना — दायरा, ज्ञान या सुविधा को और फैलाना
definition: to expand or extend something so that it covers more, such as knowledge, an offer, a road or a building (regular: hat erweitert)
example: Ich möchte meinen Wortschatz erweitern. — I want to expand my vocabulary.

hindi: अर्जित करना — औपचारिक ढंग से ख़रीदना या हासिल करना
definition: to acquire or purchase something, the formal written word for buying property, rights or skills (irregular: erwirbt, hat erworben)
example: Die Familie hat das Grundstück vor zehn Jahren erworben. — The family acquired the plot of land ten years ago.

hindi: प्रत्युत्तर देना — किसी बात के जवाब में कुछ कहना
definition: to reply or respond to what someone has said, a written and slightly literary word for answering (regular: erwidert, hat erwidert)
example: Sie erwiderte, dass sie keine Zeit habe. — She replied that she had no time.

hindi: विचार में लेना — किसी विकल्प पर गंभीरता से सोचना
definition: to consider a possibility seriously as an option before deciding, somewhat formal in tone and register (irregular: erwägt, erwog, hat erwogen)
example: Wir erwägen, einen zweiten Laden zu eröffnen. — We are considering opening a second shop.

hindi: ज़िक्र करना — किसी बात का बीच में हल्का-सा उल्लेख करना
definition: to mention something briefly in passing during conversation or writing without going into any further detail about it (regular: erwähnt, hat erwähnt)
example: Er hat deinen Namen kurz erwähnt. — He briefly mentioned your name.

hindi: उत्पन्न करना — बिजली, माल या भाव पैदा करना
definition: to generate or produce something such as electricity, farm products, heat or a feeling and mood (regular: hat erzeugt)
example: Die Windräder erzeugen Strom für das ganze Dorf. — The wind turbines generate electricity for the whole village.

hindi: पालना-पोसना — बच्चे को सिखाकर और सँभालकर बड़ा करना
definition: to raise or bring up a child, teaching behaviour and values as a parent or teacher does (erzieht, hat erzogen)
example: Sie erzieht ihre Kinder sehr liebevoll. — She raises her children very lovingly.

hindi: बाल-शिक्षक — बालवाड़ी में बच्चों की देखभाल और शिक्षा देने वाला प्रशिक्षित व्यक्ति
definition: a trained childcare worker or nursery teacher who looks after and educates children in daycare centres and kindergartens (der Erzieher, plural Erzieher)
example: Der Erzieher liest den Kindern jeden Tag eine Geschichte vor. — The nursery teacher reads the children a story every day.

hindi: बालशिक्षिका — किंडरगार्टन में छोटे बच्चों की देखभाल और शिक्षा करने वाली
definition: a female nursery teacher or childcare worker who looks after and educates young children in a kindergarten (die Erzieherin, plural Erzieherinnen)
example: Die Erzieherin singt mit den Kindern ein Lied. — The nursery teacher sings a song with the children.

hindi: परवरिश — बच्चों को पालने और संस्कार देने का तरीका
definition: the upbringing, the way parents raise and educate their children in behaviour and values (die Erziehung, no plural)
example: Die Erziehung der Kinder ist Aufgabe beider Eltern. — Raising the children is the job of both parents.

hindi: हासिल करना — नतीजा, गोल या मुनाफ़ा पाना
definition: to achieve, score or obtain a result, goal or profit through effort (regular: erzielt, hat erzielt)
example: Die Mannschaft hat zwei Tore erzielt. — The team scored two goals.

hindi: सुनाना — कोई कहानी या घटना विस्तार से बताना
definition: to tell or narrate a story, event or personal experience to a listener, usually at some length and with detail (regular: erzählt, hat erzählt; jemandem etwas erzählen)
example: Oma erzählt uns jeden Abend eine Geschichte. — Grandma tells us a story every evening.

hindi: किसी बात के बारे में सुनाना — अपने अनुभव या घटना का क़िस्सा कहना
definition: to tell somebody about an experience, event or person, narrating what happened (+ Dativ, von + Dativ, regular)
example: Erzähl mir von deiner Reise nach Indien! — Tell me about your trip to India!

hindi: कथा — छोटी या मध्यम लंबाई की गद्य कहानी
definition: a narrative or short story, a fictional prose tale shorter than a novel that recounts events (die Erzählung, plural Erzählungen)
example: Die Erzählung handelt von einer Kindheit im Dorf. — The story is about a childhood in the village.

hindi: यह / वह (नपुंसक) — निर्जीव या नपुंसक संज्ञा के लिए; मौसम-वाक्यों का कर्ता
definition: the third person singular pronoun for a grammatically neuter noun, also the empty subject in weather and impersonal sentences about raining or being late (Akkusativ es, Dativ ihm)
example: Es regnet schon den ganzen Tag. — It has been raining the whole day.

hindi: किसी बात का विषय होना — मामला किस चीज़ के बारे में है
definition: it is about or concerns a particular matter, the impersonal fixed expression used to state what the topic, issue or subject really is (+ Akkusativ, es ging um, es ist um … gegangen)
example: In dem Film geht es um eine große Liebe. — The film is about a great love.

hindi: किसी बात का मामला होना — यह स्पष्ट करना कि चीज़ असल में क्या है
definition: it is a matter of or a case of something, the impersonal fixed expression used to identify what a thing actually is, often in formal writing (+ Akkusativ, es handelte sich um, es hat sich um … gehandelt)
example: Bei dem Fund handelt es sich um eine alte Münze. — The find is an old coin.

hindi: मुझे खेद है — माफ़ी या सहानुभूति का वाक्य
definition: the everyday sentence for saying sorry, used both for apologising and for expressing sympathy
example: Es tut mir leid, dass ich zu spät bin. — I am sorry that I am late.

hindi: गधा — बोझ ढोने वाला लंबे कानों का जानवर
definition: a donkey, the patient long-eared farm animal that carries loads, also a mild word for a stubborn fool (der Esel, plural Esel)
example: Der Esel trägt die schweren Körbe. — The donkey carries the heavy baskets.

hindi: याद रखने की तरकीब — कठिन बात याद रखने का आसान सूत्र
definition: a memory trick or mnemonic that helps someone remember a difficult fact or rule (die Eselsbrücke, plural Eselsbrücken)
example: Für die Artikel habe ich mir eine Eselsbrücke gebaut. — For the articles I made myself a little mnemonic.

hindi: खाना — भोजन मुँह में लेकर निगलना
definition: to eat, taking food into the mouth, chewing and swallowing it as a meal or snack (irregular: isst, hat gegessen)
example: Wir essen heute Abend Nudeln. — We are eating pasta tonight.

hindi: सिरका — खट्टा तरल, सलाद और अचार में
definition: vinegar, the sour liquid made from fermented wine or fruit and used in salad dressing, pickles and potato salad (der Essig, plural Essige)
example: Der Essig gehört in den Kartoffelsalat. — The vinegar goes into the potato salad.

hindi: खाने की मेज़ — जिस पर परिवार भोजन करता है
definition: the dining table, the large table at which the family sits down to eat meals together (der Esstisch, plural Esstische)
example: Am Esstisch haben sechs Personen Platz. — There is room for six people at the dining table.

hindi: अटारी — छत के नीचे सामान रखने की जगह, स्विस अर्थ
definition: the attic or loft under the roof used for storage, the Swiss meaning of the word where Germany says Dachboden and uses Estrich for a floor screed (der Estrich, plural Estriche)
example: Die alten Kisten stehen oben im Estrich. — The old boxes are up in the attic.

hindi: मंज़िल — इमारत का तल, थोड़ा शहरी शब्द
definition: a floor or storey of a building, a slightly more elegant word for one level of a house (die Etage, plural Etagen)
example: Wir wohnen in der zweiten Etage. — We live on the second floor.

hindi: आचारशास्त्र — नैतिक सिद्धांतों का अध्ययन
definition: ethics, the philosophical study of right and wrong conduct, also the school subject taught instead of religion (die Ethik, no plural)
example: Die Ethik fragt, was gut und richtig ist. — Ethics asks what is good and right.

hindi: शिष्टाचार नियम — औपचारिक मौक़ों के तय क़ायदे
definition: etiquette, the set of formal rules for proper behaviour at the table, in business and on official occasions (die Etikette, plural Etiketten)
example: Die Etikette verlangt, dass man wartet, bis alle sitzen. — Etiquette requires waiting until everyone is seated.

hindi: क़रीब — अंदाज़न, लगभग इतना
definition: about or roughly, placed before a number or amount to show that it is an estimate rather than an exact figure
example: Das Paket wiegt etwa zwei Kilo. — The parcel weighs about two kilos.

hindi: थोड़ा — कुछ हद तक, ज़रा सा
definition: somewhat, a little, slightly; used before adjectives and verbs to reduce the degree of a quality
example: Das Zimmer ist etwas klein. — The room is somewhat small.

hindi: तुम लोगों का — बहुवचन अनौपचारिक स्वामित्व
definition: the possessive determiner meaning belonging to the several people being informally addressed, losing its middle vowel when an ending is added (eure Kinder, eurem Haus)
example: Wo steht euer Auto? — Where is your car parked?

hindi: उल्लू — रात में शिकार करने वाला बड़ी आँखों का पक्षी
definition: an owl, the night bird with large round eyes and a silent flight that hunts mice in the dark (die Eule, plural Eulen)
example: Nachts hört man die Eule im Wald rufen. — At night you hear the owl calling in the forest.

hindi: खाली कराना — खतरे वाली जगह से लोगों को सुरक्षित बाहर निकालना
definition: to evacuate, to move people out of a building or area that has become dangerous to a safe place (regular: evakuiert, hat evakuiert)
example: Die Schule wurde wegen einer Bombendrohung evakuiert. — The school was evacuated because of a bomb threat.

hindi: संभवतः — शायद, हो सकता है; अंततः नहीं
definition: possibly or perhaps, marking something that might happen, never eventually or in the end
example: Ich komme eventuell etwas später. — I might possibly come a little later.

hindi: प्रयोग — नियंत्रित परिस्थितियों में किया गया वैज्ञानिक परीक्षण
definition: a scientific experiment, a controlled trial performed to test a hypothesis and observe the result (das Experiment, plural Experimente)
example: Die Schüler machen ein Experiment mit Wasser und Salz. — The pupils are doing an experiment with water and salt.

hindi: विशेष रियायत — दूसरों से अलग खास सुविधा की माँग
definition: a special treatment or exception that someone demands for themselves alone, literally an extra sausage (die Extrawurst, plural Extrawürste)
example: Hier bekommt niemand eine Extrawurst, die Regeln gelten für alle. — Nobody gets special treatment here, the rules apply to everyone.

hindi: अतिशय — हद से बहुत ज़्यादा, चरम
definition: extreme, sitting at the very far end of a scale, far beyond the usual or moderate level, and as an adverb a colloquial intensifier meaning extremely
example: Es war extrem heiß im Sommer. — It was extremely hot in summer.

hindi: कारख़ाना — मशीनों से बड़े पैमाने पर सामान बनाने की जगह
definition: a factory, the industrial building where goods are manufactured on a large scale with machines and workers (die Fabrik, plural Fabriken)
example: Die Fabrik produziert täglich tausend Fahrräder. — The factory produces a thousand bicycles daily.

hindi: विषय — स्कूल या विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ाया जाने वाला ज्ञान-क्षेत्र
definition: a school subject or academic discipline such as history, mathematics or biology that is taught in lessons (das Fach, plural Fächer)
example: Welches Fach magst du am liebsten? — Which subject do you like best?

hindi: व्यावसायिक विश्वविद्यालय — व्यवहारिक, पेशे से जुड़ी पढ़ाई वाला उच्च शिक्षा संस्थान
definition: a university of applied sciences, the practice-oriented higher education institution where students study engineering, business or design close to industry (die Fachhochschule, plural Fachhochschulen)
example: Er macht seinen Bachelor an einer Fachhochschule in München. — He is doing his bachelor's at a university of applied sciences in Munich.

hindi: विषय-अंधा विशेषज्ञ — अपने विषय में गहरा, बाकी सब में कोरा
definition: a specialist so deeply buried in one subject that ordinary judgement outside it has quietly withered
example: Brilliant on tax law and a complete Fachidiot on everything else.

hindi: फीका — स्वादहीन, नीरस, बिना रस का
definition: bland, insipid, dull; describes food that lacks flavour or a person and event that lack spark
example: Die Suppe schmeckt ziemlich fade. — The soup tastes rather bland.

hindi: गाड़ी-मार्ग — सड़क का वह हिस्सा जिस पर वाहन चलते हैं
definition: the carriageway or roadway, the part of the street on which motor vehicles actually drive, as opposed to the pavement (die Fahrbahn, plural Fahrbahnen)
example: Die Fahrbahn ist nach dem Regen sehr glatt. — The road surface is very slippery after the rain.

hindi: चलाना या सवारी करना — वाहन से कहीं जाना या उसे चलाना
definition: to drive a vehicle, or to travel and ride by car, train, bicycle or bus (irregular: fährt, ist gefahren; with a direct object hat gefahren)
example: Wir fahren am Wochenende ans Meer. — We are driving to the sea at the weekend.

hindi: चालक — गाड़ी चलाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a driver, the person who steers and controls a vehicle such as a car, bus or truck along the road (der Fahrer, plural Fahrer)
example: Der Fahrer des Busses war sehr freundlich. — The driver of the bus was very friendly.

hindi: यात्री — बस, ट्राम या रेल में सफ़र करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a passenger riding on a bus, tram or train, the travelling person carried who is not the driver (der Fahrgast, plural Fahrgäste)
example: Der Fahrgast muss einen gültigen Fahrschein haben. — The passenger must have a valid ticket.

hindi: यात्रा-पत्र — रेल या बस में सफ़र का अधिकार देने वाला काग़ज़
definition: a ticket for travel by train, bus or tram, the paper or digital pass that permits the journey (die Fahrkarte, plural Fahrkarten)
example: Ich habe die Fahrkarte am Automaten gekauft. — I bought the ticket at the machine.

hindi: यात्रा-पत्र यंत्र — स्टेशन पर खुद यात्रा-पत्र निकालने का यंत्र
definition: a ticket machine at a station or stop, the self-service device that sells tickets for cash or card (der Fahrkartenautomat, plural Fahrkartenautomaten)
example: Der Fahrkartenautomat nimmt leider keine Scheine. — Unfortunately the ticket machine does not take banknotes.

hindi: समय-सारणी — गाड़ियों के आने-जाने के समय की सूची
definition: a timetable, the printed or posted schedule of departure and arrival times for trains and buses (der Fahrplan, plural Fahrpläne)
example: Laut Fahrplan kommt der Bus um acht. — According to the timetable the bus comes at eight.

hindi: चालन परीक्षा — अनुज्ञप्ति पाने के लिए दी जाने वाली परीक्षा
definition: the driving examination a learner must pass to receive a licence, practical and theoretical (die Fahrprüfung, plural Fahrprüfungen)
example: Er hat die Fahrprüfung beim zweiten Versuch bestanden. — He passed the driving test on the second attempt.

hindi: द्विचक्र वाहन — पैडल से चलने वाली दोपहिया सवारी
definition: a two-wheeled vehicle driven by pedals that people ride for exercise and daily transport (das Fahrrad, plural Fahrräder)
example: Ich fahre jeden Tag mit dem Fahrrad zur Arbeit. — I ride my bicycle to work every day.

hindi: किराया-पर्ची — बस या रेल में सफ़र का प्रमाण
definition: a ticket for travel by public transport, the paper pass that a passenger shows on the bus or tram (der Fahrschein, plural Fahrscheine)
example: Bitte zeigen Sie mir Ihren Fahrschein. — Please show me your ticket.

hindi: चालन प्रशिक्षण विद्यालय — गाड़ी चलाना सिखाने वाली संस्था
definition: a driving school where learners take lessons and prepare for the licence examination (die Fahrschule, plural Fahrschulen)
example: Die Fahrschule ist teuer, aber gut. — The driving school is expensive but good.

hindi: उद्वाहक — ऊपर-नीचे ले जाने वाले डिब्बे का आम शब्द
definition: an elevator or lift, the everyday word for the cabin that carries people between floors of a building (der Fahrstuhl, plural Fahrstühle)
example: Nehmen wir den Fahrstuhl oder die Treppe? — Shall we take the elevator or the stairs?

hindi: वाहन — सड़क पर चलने वाली किसी भी तरह की गाड़ी
definition: any vehicle that moves people or goods on roads, the formal umbrella word used in laws and notices (das Fahrzeug, plural Fahrzeuge)
example: Dieses Fahrzeug darf hier nicht parken. — This vehicle may not park here.

hindi: संकाय — विश्वविद्यालय का एक बड़ा विषय-विभाग
definition: a faculty, one of the large academic divisions of a university that groups related subjects together (die Fakultät, plural Fakultäten)
example: Die Fakultät für Medizin liegt am Stadtrand. — The faculty of medicine is on the edge of town.

hindi: गिरना — ऊपर से नीचे की ओर आना
definition: to fall or drop downward from a height onto the ground, also said of prices and temperatures dropping (irregular: fällt, fiel, ist gefallen)
example: Das Glas fällt vom Tisch auf den Boden. — The glass falls from the table onto the floor.

hindi: अगर, यदि कहीं — संभावित शर्त बताने वाला शब्द
definition: in case, if; a conjunction introducing a condition that might or might not happen, verb at the end
example: Falls es regnet, nehmen wir den Bus. — In case it rains, we take the bus.

hindi: गलत — त्रुटिपूर्ण, या नकली
definition: wrong or incorrect, mistaken in fact or judgement, also meaning false, fake or insincere
example: Die Adresse war falsch. — The address was wrong.

hindi: झुर्री — उम्र के साथ चेहरे की त्वचा पर पड़ने वाली रेखा
definition: a wrinkle or crease in the skin that comes with age, also a fold in cloth (die Falte, plural Falten)
example: Ihre Falten erzählen von einem langen Leben. — Her wrinkles tell of a long life.

hindi: तह करना — कपड़े या काग़ज़ को मोड़कर सलीके से रखना
definition: to fold clothes, towels or paper neatly by bending them over on themselves so they take up less space (regular)
example: Nach dem Trocknen falte ich die Handtücher. — After drying I fold the towels.

hindi: परिवार — माता-पिता और बच्चों का घरेलू समूह
definition: the family, the group of parents and children living together as one household, the closest circle of relatives (die Familie, plural Familien)
example: Meine Familie wohnt in Hamburg. — My family lives in Hamburg.

hindi: प्रशंसक, दीवाना — किसी का ज़बरदस्त समर्थक
definition: a fan, an enthusiastic supporter of a team, singer or thing, the borrowed English word used for any devoted admirer (der Fan, plural Fans)
example: Ich bin ein großer Fan von dieser Band. — I am a big fan of this band.

hindi: लपकना — उछाली गई चीज़ को हवा में पकड़ना या शिकार करना
definition: to catch something thrown through the air with the hands, or to capture an animal or a fleeing person (fängt, fing, hat gefangen)
example: Der Hund fängt den Ball im Sprung. — The dog catches the ball in mid-air.

hindi: कल्पना — मन में नई और अनदेखी बातें गढ़ने की शक्ति
definition: the imagination and creative power to picture things that do not exist, also a fanciful idea (die Fantasie, plural Fantasien)
example: Kinder haben eine lebhafte Fantasie. — Children have a lively imagination.

hindi: कल्पनातीत — असाधारण रूप से बढ़िया, ज़बरदस्त
definition: fantastic, amazing, extraordinarily good; enthusiastic praise that something exceeds every expectation
example: Der Ausblick vom Turm ist fantastisch. — The view from the tower is fantastic.

hindi: रंग — जो आँख को लाल, नीला, हरा दिखता है, या दीवार पर पोतने वाला रोग़न
definition: a colour, the quality that makes something look red, blue or green, and also the paint used to coat a wall (die Farbe, plural Farben)
example: Welche Farbe hat dein neues Fahrrad? — What colour is your new bicycle?

hindi: रंगत, छटा — किसी रंग की हल्की-गहरी आभा
definition: a shade or tint, one particular lighter or darker variety of a colour, such as the many shades of blue (der Farbton, plural Farbtöne)
example: Dieser Farbton passt gut zum Sofa. — This shade goes well with the sofa.

hindi: वेशभूषा उत्सव — दक्षिणी जर्मनी और ऑस्ट्रिया में इसका नाम
definition: carnival, the festive season of costumes, parades and parties before Lent, the usual word in southern Germany and Austria (der Fasching, plural Faschinge)
example: Zum Fasching geht sie als Piratin. — For carnival she is going as a pirate.

hindi: पीपा — बीयर या शराब रखने का बड़ा बेलनाकार पात्र
definition: a barrel or keg, the large round wooden or metal container for storing beer, wine, cider, heating oil or collected rainwater (das Fass, plural Fässer)
example: Das Bier kommt frisch vom Fass. — The beer comes fresh from the barrel.

hindi: अग्रभाग — इमारत का सड़क की ओर दिखने वाला बाहरी मुख
definition: the facade, the front outer face of a building seen from the street, also figuratively a false outward show (die Fassade, plural Fassaden)
example: Die Fassade des Rathauses wurde frisch gestrichen. — The facade of the town hall has been freshly painted.

hindi: थामना — किसी चीज़ को पकड़ना या किसी को हिरासत में लेना
definition: to grasp or take hold of something with the hands; also to catch a criminal or to contain a certain volume (regular: hat gefasst)
example: Sie fasste das Kind fest an der Hand. — She took the child firmly by the hand.

hindi: लगभग — करीब-करीब, थोड़ा सा कम
definition: almost or nearly, very close to a state or amount but not quite reaching it, a false friend of the English word
example: Ich bin fast fertig. — I am almost finished.

hindi: वेशभूषा उत्सव — दक्षिण-पश्चिम जर्मनी और स्विट्ज़रलैंड में इसका पारंपरिक नाम
definition: carnival, the festive season of masks, costumes and parades before Lent, the traditional word in south-western Germany and Switzerland (die Fastnacht, plural Fastnachten)
example: Die Fastnacht in Mainz ist berühmt. — The carnival in Mainz is famous.

hindi: मोहक — मन को बाँध लेने वाला, अत्यंत दिलचस्प
definition: fascinating, captivating, intensely interesting; praise for something that holds attention completely
example: Die Dokumentation über die Tiefsee war faszinierend. — The documentary about the deep sea was fascinating.

hindi: आलसी — काम करने से बचने वाला; या सड़ा हुआ
definition: lazy and unwilling to work or make effort, also rotten or spoiled when said of fruit, eggs or teeth (regular adjective)
example: Am Sonntag bin ich gern ein bisschen faul. — On Sunday I like being a little lazy.

hindi: आलस्य — काम करने या हिलने-डुलने से बचने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the laziness and unwillingness to work or make any effort, often said with a smile (die Faulheit, no plural)
example: Die Faulheit siegt bei ihm jeden Sonntag. — Laziness wins out with him every Sunday.

hindi: आलसी — काम से जी चुराने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a lazybones or idle person who avoids work whenever possible, a colloquial and mildly teasing insult (der Faulpelz, plural Faulpelze)
example: Der Faulpelz liegt noch bis Mittag im Bett. — The lazybones stays in bed until noon.

hindi: सुस्त वृक्षवासी जानवर — पेड़ पर उल्टा लटका रहने वाला बहुत धीमा जानवर
definition: a sloth, the extremely slow tree-dwelling animal of South America that hangs upside down from branches, literally a lazy animal (das Faultier, plural Faultiere)
example: Das Faultier schläft fast den ganzen Tag im Baum. — The sloth sleeps in the tree almost all day.

hindi: मुट्ठी — कसकर बंद किया हुआ हाथ
definition: a fist, the hand closed tightly with the fingers bent into the palm for striking or gripping (die Faust, plural Fäuste)
example: Er ballte die Hand zur Faust. — He clenched his hand into a fist.

hindi: पेंसिल-बॉक्स — पेन, पेंसिल और रबड़ रखने का छोटा डिब्बा
definition: a pencil case, the small pouch or box in which pupils keep their pens, pencils, eraser and ruler (das Federmäppchen, plural Federmäppchen)
example: Ich habe mein Federmäppchen zu Hause vergessen. — I left my pencil case at home.

hindi: झाड़ू लगाना — झाड़ू से फ़र्श की धूल और कचरा बुहारना
definition: to sweep a floor, yard or pavement with a broom to gather up dust, crumbs and leaves (regular)
example: Er fegt jeden Morgen den Hof vor dem Haus. — He sweeps the yard in front of the house every morning.

hindi: ग़लती — लिखने या हल करने में हुई चूक
definition: a mistake or error, something done wrongly in writing, calculation or speech that a teacher marks in red (der Fehler, plural Fehler)
example: Der Aufsatz hat viele Fehler. — The essay has many mistakes.

hindi: त्रुटिपूर्ण — ग़लतियों वाला, दोषयुक्त
definition: faulty, flawed or full of mistakes, used of products with defects and of texts or calculations containing errors
example: Die Übersetzung ist leider fehlerhaft. — The translation is unfortunately faulty.

hindi: गलती-संस्कृति — संस्था गलतियों से कैसे पेश आती है
definition: the way an organisation handles mistakes: whether they are buried, punished, or openly examined
example: A team with a real Fehlerkultur writes the postmortem instead of hunting the culprit.

hindi: त्रुटि संदेश — कंप्यूटर की ओर से गड़बड़ी की सूचना
definition: an error message, the warning text a program or website shows on the screen when something has gone wrong (die Fehlermeldung, plural Fehlermeldungen)
example: Ich bekomme immer dieselbe Fehlermeldung. — I keep getting the same error message.

hindi: समारोह — किसी अवसर पर आयोजित जश्न या पार्टी
definition: a celebration or party held to mark an occasion such as a birthday, wedding or anniversary (die Feier, plural Feiern)
example: Die Feier beginnt um acht Uhr. — The celebration begins at eight o'clock.

hindi: काम की छुट्टी — दिन का काम खत्म, अब शाम अपनी
definition: the moment work ends and the evening becomes yours, marked as an event rather than a mere clock time
example: He shut the laptop at six and announced Feierabend to nobody in particular.

hindi: काम के बाद की बीयर — दिन का काम निपटाकर आराम से पी जाने वाली बीयर
definition: the relaxing beer drunk after finishing the working day, a small ritual marking the switch from work to leisure (das Feierabendbier, plural Feierabendbiere)
example: Nach der Schicht trinken wir zusammen ein Feierabendbier. — After the shift we drink an end-of-work beer together.

hindi: जश्न मनाना — किसी अवसर पर खुशी से उत्सव करना
definition: to celebrate, to mark an occasion or festival with a party, food and drinks (regular)
example: Wir feiern heute seinen Geburtstag. — We are celebrating his birthday today.

hindi: त्योहार की छुट्टी — सरकारी या धार्मिक अवकाश का दिन
definition: a public holiday, a day when shops and offices close for a religious or national celebration (der Feiertag, plural Feiertage)
example: Morgen ist ein Feiertag, die Geschäfte sind geschlossen. — Tomorrow is a public holiday, the shops are closed.

hindi: कायर — डर के मारे भागने या पीछे हटने वाला
definition: cowardly, lacking courage and running away from danger, conflict or responsibility instead of facing them (regular adjective)
example: Es ist feige, per Nachricht Schluss zu machen. — It is cowardly to break up by text message.

hindi: मोल-भाव करना — दाम कम कराने के लिए ज़िद से बहस करना
definition: to haggle stubbornly over a price, pushing the seller down euro by euro (regular, um + Akkusativ: feilscht, hat gefeilscht)
example: Er feilscht auf dem Flohmarkt um jeden Euro. — He haggles over every euro at the flea market.

hindi: महीन — बारीक कणों वाला, नाज़ुक
definition: fine or delicate in texture with tiny particles, also refined for manners and excellent in colloquial praise
example: Das Mehl ist sehr fein gemahlen. — The flour is very finely ground.

hindi: महीन धूल कण — हवा में तैरते बेहद छोटे हानिकारक कण
definition: fine particulate matter, the tiny harmful dust particles from traffic and heating that damage lungs (der Feinstaub, no plural)
example: Wegen des Feinstaubs gilt in der Innenstadt ein Fahrverbot. — Because of fine dust there is a driving ban downtown.

hindi: खेत — फ़सल उगाने की खुली ज़मीन
definition: a field, an open stretch of farmland where crops such as wheat or potatoes grow (das Feld, plural Felder)
example: Der Bauer arbeitet auf dem Feld. — The farmer works in the field.

hindi: पशु की रोयेंदार खाल — जानवर के शरीर पर बालों की मुलायम परत
definition: the fur or coat of an animal, the soft layer of hair that covers a cat, dog or bear (das Fell, plural Felle)
example: Die Katze hat ein weiches Fell. — The cat has a soft coat.

hindi: चट्टान — पत्थर का बड़ा ठोस खंड
definition: a rock or crag, a large solid mass of stone rising from the ground or a mountainside (der Fels, plural Felsen)
example: Auf dem Fels sitzt ein Adler. — An eagle sits on the rock.

hindi: खिड़की — दीवार में रोशनी-हवा का शीशेदार खुला भाग
definition: a window, the glazed opening in a wall that lets light and fresh air into a room (das Fenster, plural Fenster)
example: Mach bitte das Fenster auf. — Please open the window.

hindi: छुट्टियाँ — स्कूल या विश्वविद्यालय का लंबा अवकाश
definition: the school holidays, the longer breaks in the year when schools and universities close (die Ferien, plural only)
example: Die Ferien beginnen nächsten Freitag. — The school holidays begin next Friday.

hindi: छुट्टियों का मकान — समुद्र या पहाड़ के पास किराए का पूरा घर
definition: a holiday house or cottage rented whole for a vacation, often near the coast or mountains (das Ferienhaus, plural Ferienhäuser)
example: Wir mieten jeden Sommer dasselbe Ferienhaus in Dänemark. — We rent the same holiday house in Denmark every summer.

hindi: छुट्टियों का आवास — रसोई सहित पूरा किराए का घर, जहाँ खुद खाना बनाते हैं
definition: a holiday apartment rented for a vacation with its own kitchen, so guests cook and lodge themselves (die Ferienwohnung, plural Ferienwohnungen)
example: Die Ferienwohnung hat zwei Schlafzimmer und einen Balkon. — The holiday apartment has two bedrooms and a balcony.

hindi: सूअर का बच्चा — छोटा शावक; बोलचाल में गंदा हो जाने वाला बच्चा
definition: a piglet, a young pig, and colloquially an affectionate word for a messy child who gets dirty (das Ferkel, plural Ferkel)
example: Das Ferkel läuft hinter der Sau her. — The piglet runs after the sow.

hindi: दूर — बहुत फ़ासले पर, सुदूर
definition: far away or distant, remote in space or time, somewhat literary, used of foreign lands and distant memories
example: Sie lebt in einem fernen Land. — She lives in a distant country.

hindi: दूर-नियंत्रक — दूर से टीवी चलाने का छोटा यंत्र
definition: a remote control, the handheld device with buttons used to operate the television from the sofa (die Fernbedienung, plural Fernbedienungen)
example: Wo ist schon wieder die Fernbedienung? — Where is the remote control again?

hindi: दूरदर्शन — टेलीविज़न का माध्यम और उसका प्रसारण
definition: television as a medium, the broadcasting of programmes that people watch at home on a screen (das Fernsehen, no plural)
example: Im Fernsehen läuft heute ein guter Film. — There is a good film on television today.

hindi: दूरदर्शन यंत्र — कमरे में रखा टीवी सेट
definition: a television set, the actual device with a screen standing in the living room that shows programmes (der Fernseher, plural Fernseher)
example: Der neue Fernseher hängt an der Wand. — The new television hangs on the wall.

hindi: लंबी दूरी का यातायात — शहरों के बीच चलने वाली तेज़ गाड़ियाँ
definition: long-distance transport, the express trains and coaches that run between cities rather than within them (der Fernverkehr, no plural)
example: Im Fernverkehr braucht man meist eine Reservierung. — In long-distance travel you usually need a reservation.

hindi: दूर-देश की कसक — अनजानी जगहों को देखने की बेचैनी
definition: the ache to be somewhere far away, an inverted homesickness pulling you toward unfamiliar places
example: Every departure board gives her a fresh attack of Fernweh.

hindi: एड़ी — पैर का पिछला उभरा हिस्सा
definition: the heel, the rounded back part of the foot below the ankle that touches the ground first (die Ferse, plural Fersen)
example: Die neuen Schuhe reiben an der Ferse. — The new shoes rub at the heel.

hindi: तैयार — काम पूरा हो चुका, बना हुआ; बोलचाल में थका हुआ
definition: finished, ready or complete, said of work, food and people; colloquially also worn out and exhausted
example: Das Essen ist fertig, kommt bitte zu Tisch! — The food is ready, please come to the table!

hindi: बाँका — सजा-सँवरा, आकर्षक और चुस्त दिखने वाला
definition: smart, attractive and stylishly turned out in appearance, a warm Austrian and southern compliment for a person or an outfit
example: Du schaust heute richtig fesch aus! — You look really smart today!

hindi: बाँध लेने वाला — ध्यान जकड़ लेने वाला, अत्यंत रोचक
definition: gripping, absorbing, captivating; praise for a book, film or speaker that holds attention firmly
example: Der Roman ist von der ersten Seite an fesselnd. — The novel is gripping from the very first page.

hindi: उत्सव — बड़ा जश्न या पर्व
definition: a festival or celebration, a large festive occasion with food, music and many guests (das Fest, plural Feste)
example: Das Fest im Dorf dauert drei Tage. — The festival in the village lasts three days.

hindi: कसकर पकड़ना — छूट न जाए इसलिए मज़बूती से थामना
definition: to hold on to something tightly so it does not slip away, or to record something in writing (separable: hält fest, hat festgehalten)
example: Halt dich im Bus gut fest! — Hold on tight in the bus!

hindi: गिरफ़्तारी — पुलिस द्वारा संदिग्ध को पकड़ना
definition: an arrest, the act of the police taking a suspect into custody, the standard official term (die Festnahme, plural Festnahmen)
example: Die Festnahme erfolgte am Bahnhof. — The arrest took place at the station.

hindi: गिरफ़्तार करना — संदिग्ध को पकड़कर हिरासत में लेना
definition: to arrest or detain someone, to take a suspect into custody, the standard official police term (separable: nimmt fest, hat festgenommen)
example: Die Beamten nahmen zwei Männer fest. — The officers arrested two men.

hindi: स्थायी भंडार — संगणक में आँकड़े और कार्यक्रम रखने वाली मुख्य चक्रिका
definition: a hard drive, the storage disk inside or beside a computer where files, programs and the operating system are permanently kept (die Festplatte, plural Festplatten)
example: Die Festplatte ist voll, ich brauche eine neue. — The hard drive is full, I need a new one.

hindi: पता लगाना, निश्चित करना — जाँच करके किसी तथ्य को स्थापित करना
definition: to establish or ascertain a fact, to notice and determine something for certain after checking or examining (separable: stellt fest, hat festgestellt)
example: Der Arzt stellte fest, dass alles in Ordnung ist. — The doctor determined that everything is fine.

hindi: नम — हल्का गीला, सीलन भरा
definition: damp, moist or slightly humid, used of cellars, towels, soil and muggy summer air that hold some moisture
example: Der Keller ist immer etwas feucht. — The cellar is always a bit damp.

hindi: आग — जलती हुई लपटें और उनकी गर्मी, चाहे चूल्हे में हो या दुर्घटना में
definition: fire, the burning flames and heat produced when something combusts, whether controlled in a stove or destructive (das Feuer, plural Feuer)
example: Das Feuer breitete sich schnell im Dachstuhl aus. — The fire spread quickly through the roof timbers.

hindi: अग्निशामक यंत्र — छोटी आग बुझाने वाला लाल सिलेंडर
definition: a fire extinguisher, the portable red cylinder used to spray foam or powder onto a small fire (der Feuerlöscher, plural Feuerlöscher)
example: Der Feuerlöscher hängt neben der Küchentür. — The fire extinguisher hangs next to the kitchen door.

hindi: दमकल विभाग — आग बुझाने और लोगों को बचाने वाली सरकारी सेवा
definition: the fire brigade, the organised service that extinguishes fires and rescues people from burning buildings and accidents (die Feuerwehr, plural Feuerwehren)
example: Die Feuerwehr war in fünf Minuten vor Ort. — The fire brigade was on the scene within five minutes.

hindi: दमकलकर्मी — आग बुझाने और लोगों को बचाने वाला
definition: a firefighter, the trained rescue worker who extinguishes fires and rescues people from burning buildings and other emergencies (der Feuerwehrmann, plural Feuerwehrleute)
example: Der Feuerwehrmann rettet die Katze vom Baum. — The firefighter rescues the cat from the tree.

hindi: आतिशबाज़ी — आसमान में रंगीन धमाके, नए साल की आधी रात पर
definition: fireworks, the colourful rockets and bangs launched into the night sky at midnight on New Year's Eve (das Feuerwerk, plural Feuerwerke)
example: Um Mitternacht beginnt das Feuerwerk. — At midnight the fireworks begin.

hindi: बुख़ार — शरीर का तापमान सामान्य से ऊपर चढ़ना
definition: a fever, the raised body temperature that signals the body fighting an infection (das Fieber, no plural)
example: Das Fieber ist über Nacht gestiegen. — The fever rose overnight.

hindi: पात्र — कहानी या नाटक का कोई चरित्र
definition: a character in a novel, film or play, and also the shape of a body or a chess piece (die Figur, plural Figuren)
example: Die Figur der Mutter ist sehr gut geschrieben. — The character of the mother is very well written.

hindi: चलचित्र — सिनेमा या टीवी पर दिखाई जाने वाली कहानी
definition: a film or movie, the moving-picture story shown in the cinema or on television, and also the roll in a camera (der Film, plural Filme)
example: Der Film war viel besser als das Buch. — The film was much better than the book.

hindi: कर कार्यालय — कर वसूलने और विवरणी जाँचने वाला स्थानीय दफ़्तर
definition: the tax office, the local government authority that collects taxes and processes tax returns (das Finanzamt, plural Finanzämter)
example: Das Finanzamt hat mir Geld zurückgezahlt. — The tax office paid money back to me.

hindi: वित्त जुटाना — किसी चीज़ के लिए पैसा देना या क़र्ज़ से ख़रीदना
definition: to finance something, to provide the money for a project or to buy a large item with a loan (regular: finanziert, hat finanziert)
example: Die Bank finanziert unser neues Auto. — The bank is financing our new car.

hindi: पाना — खोई चीज़ मिल जाना; किसी बारे में राय रखना
definition: to find something you were looking for, and also to consider or judge something in a certain way (irregular: findet, fand, hat gefunden)
example: Ich finde den Film sehr spannend. — I find the film very exciting.

hindi: उँगली — हाथ के सिरे पर पाँच पतले अंगों में से एक
definition: a finger, one of the five slender movable digits at the end of the human hand used for pointing and gripping (der Finger, plural Finger)
example: Der Finger blutet ein bisschen. — The finger is bleeding a little.

hindi: नाख़ून — उँगली के सिरे पर कठोर पतली परत
definition: a fingernail, the hard thin plate growing on the tip of each finger that is trimmed and filed (der Fingernagel, plural Fingernägel)
example: Der Fingernagel ist beim Sport abgebrochen. — The fingernail broke off during sport.

hindi: उँगलियों की समझ — नाज़ुक मामले सधे हाथ से सँभालने की सूझ
definition: an intuitive delicacy of touch that lets someone handle people or awkward situations without bruising
example: Negotiations like this need Fingerspitzengefühl, not a louder voice.

hindi: घुप्प अँधेरा — बिल्कुल रोशनी-रहित, या डरावना, गंभीर चेहरा
definition: pitch dark and gloomy, without any light at all, also used of a grim, menacing expression or sinister intentions
example: Der Wald war finster und still. — The forest was pitch dark and silent.

hindi: व्यावसायिक संस्थान — व्यापार करने वाला और लोगों को रोज़गार देने वाला प्रतिष्ठान
definition: a firm or company, a business organisation that employs people and sells goods or services (die Firma, plural Firmen)
example: Die Firma hat ihren Sitz in Hamburg. — The company is based in Hamburg.
