hindi: मछली — पानी का जीव, खाने के रूप में
definition: fish, the water animal eaten fresh, smoked or pickled, traditionally served on Fridays and a staple of the northern coast (der Fisch, plural Fische)
example: Der Fisch ist ganz frisch. — The fish is completely fresh.

hindi: तंदुरुस्त — शारीरिक रूप से चुस्त और स्वस्थ
definition: fit or in good physical shape, healthy and full of energy, usually as a result of regular exercise (colloquial, very common)
example: Durch das Joggen bleibe ich fit. — Jogging keeps me fit.

hindi: व्यायामशाला — भार और मशीनों वाला कसरत केंद्र
definition: a gym or fitness centre, the commercial facility with weights and machines where people exercise for strength and fitness (das Fitnessstudio, plural Fitnessstudios)
example: Nach der Arbeit gehe ich ins Fitnessstudio. — After work I go to the gym.

hindi: सपाट, उथला — बिना उभार का समतल, या कम गहरा
definition: flat or shallow, level with no bumps or height, or describing water and dishes that are not deep
example: Das Land hier ist sehr flach. — The land here is very flat.

hindi: समतल प्रदेश — नीचा, सपाट भूभाग
definition: lowland or flat country, a region of level terrain with no significant hills (das Flachland, plural Flachländer)
example: Das Flachland im Norden ist weit und windig. — The flat country in the north is wide and windy.

hindi: लपट — जलती चीज़ से उठती चमकती आग की जीभ
definition: a flame, the visible glowing tongue of fire rising from something that burns (die Flamme, plural Flammen)
example: Die Flammen schlugen aus dem Fenster. — The flames leapt out of the window.

hindi: बोतल — पेय रखने का पतली गर्दन वाला बर्तन
definition: a bottle, the narrow-necked container for drinks, and the amount of beer or water it holds (die Flasche, plural Flaschen)
example: Bitte eine Flasche Mineralwasser für den Tisch. — A bottle of mineral water for the table, please.

hindi: धब्बा — कपड़े या सतह पर गिरा हुआ दाग
definition: a stain or spot, the mark left on cloth, carpet or a surface by spilled food, drink or ink (der Fleck, plural Flecken)
example: Der Fleck auf dem Hemd geht nicht raus. — The stain on the shirt will not come out.

hindi: चमगादड़ — रात में उड़ने वाला स्तनधारी जीव
definition: a bat, the small flying mammal that hangs upside down and hunts insects at night (die Fledermaus, plural Fledermäuse)
example: In der Dämmerung fliegt eine Fledermaus ums Haus. — At dusk a bat flies around the house.

hindi: माँस — खाने के लिए जानवर का गोश्त
definition: meat, the flesh of animals eaten as food, the centre of the traditional German hot midday meal alongside potatoes and vegetables (das Fleisch, no plural)
example: Das Fleisch muss noch eine Stunde schmoren. — The meat still has to braise for an hour.

hindi: क़साई — मांस काटकर बेचने वाला कारीगर, उत्तर जर्मनी का शब्द
definition: a butcher, the tradesperson who cuts and sells meat and sausages, the usual northern and eastern German word (der Fleischer, plural Fleischer)
example: Der Fleischer empfiehlt heute das Rindfleisch. — The butcher recommends the beef today.

hindi: कसाई — ऑस्ट्रिया में मांस बेचने वाला दुकानदार
definition: the Austrian word for a butcher, the shopkeeper who cuts and sells meat, standard in Vienna where Germany says Metzger or Fleischer (der Fleischhauer, plural Fleischhauer)
example: Der Fleischhauer schneidet den Schinken ganz dünn. — The butcher slices the ham very thin.

hindi: कीमे की टिक्की — बवेरिया में तली हुई मांस की टिक्की
definition: the Bavarian word for a fried flat meatball of minced meat and bread, served in beer gardens with potato salad, matching Frikadelle and Bulette (das Fleischpflanzerl, plural Fleischpflanzerl)
example: Ein Fleischpflanzerl mit Kartoffelsalat, bitte. — A meatball with potato salad, please.

hindi: परिश्रम — लगन से लगातार मेहनत करने की आदत
definition: the diligence and steady hard work of someone who applies effort patiently and constantly to a task (der Fleiß, no plural)
example: Der Fleiß hat sich gelohnt: Sie hat die Prüfung bestanden. — The hard work paid off: she passed the exam.

hindi: मेहनती — लगन से लगातार काम करने वाला
definition: hard-working and diligent, applying steady, patient effort to work, study or household tasks every single day (regular adjective)
example: Sie lernt jeden Abend fleißig Deutsch. — She studies German diligently every evening.

hindi: मक्खी — खाने पर बैठने वाला भिनभिनाता कीट; गले की तितली-गाँठ भी
definition: a fly, the buzzing insect that lands on food in the kitchen, and also the word for a bow tie, the knotted necktie (die Fliege, plural Fliegen)
example: Eine Fliege summt durch das Zimmer. — A fly is buzzing through the room.

hindi: उड़ना — विमान से यात्रा करना या हवा में उड़ना
definition: to fly, to travel by aircraft or to move high through the air like a bird or plane (irregular: fliegt, ist geflogen)
example: Wir fliegen im Sommer nach Indien. — We are flying to India in the summer.

hindi: चौका — फ़र्श और दीवार पर बिछाई जाने वाली चपटी चीनी-मिट्टी की पट्टी
definition: a tile, the flat piece of ceramic laid on floors and walls in bathrooms and kitchens (die Fliese, plural Fliesen)
example: Im Bad sind die Fliesen blau. — In the bathroom the tiles are blue.

hindi: बहना — पानी का धारा बनकर आगे बढ़ना
definition: to flow, of water or liquid moving steadily along a river, stream or channel (irregular: fließt, floss, ist geflossen)
example: Der Bach fließt durch das ganze Dorf. — The stream flows through the whole village.

hindi: चुस्त — हाथ-पैर से फुर्तीला और तेज़
definition: nimble and quick, moving fast with agile hands or feet, said of people and small animals
example: Die Katze ist flink über den Zaun gesprungen. — The cat nimbly jumped over the fence.

hindi: छेड़छाड़ भरी बातें करना — आकर्षण जताना
definition: to flirt, chatting playfully with somebody to show romantic interest, a borrowed English verb used since the last century (regular: hat geflirtet)
example: Er flirtet mit der Kellnerin. — He is flirting with the waitress.

hindi: हनीमून — शादी के बाद की छुट्टियाँ
definition: the honeymoon, the holiday a newly married couple takes right after the wedding, always used in the plural (die Flitterwochen, plural only)
example: Die Flitterwochen verbringen sie in Portugal. — They are spending their honeymoon in Portugal.

hindi: सर्राटे से भागना — बिजली की तेज़ी से दौड़ जाना
definition: to dash or whizz along very quickly and lightly, a colloquial verb for fast nimble movement (regular: ist geflitzt)
example: Die Kinder flitzen über den Spielplatz. — The children dash across the playground.

hindi: पुरानी चीज़ों का बाज़ार — इस्तेमाल किया सामान बेचने का खुला बाज़ार
definition: a flea market, an open market where people sell second-hand goods and collectors hunt bargains (der Flohmarkt, plural Flohmärkte)
example: Auf dem Flohmarkt habe ich eine alte Lampe gefunden. — At the flea market I found an old lamp.

hindi: फुर्तीला — जल्दी और उत्साह से होने वाला, चटपटा
definition: quick and lively, done with speed and energy, a colloquial word for fast or snappy, also meaning smart or stylish
example: Das ging aber flott! — That went quickly!

hindi: पलायन — ख़तरे से बचने के लिए घर छोड़कर भागना
definition: flight or escape, the act of running away from danger, war or persecution and leaving home behind (die Flucht, plural Fluchten)
example: Die Flucht über die Grenze war gefährlich. — The escape across the border was dangerous.

hindi: भागने का रास्ता — खतरे में इमारत से बाहर निकलने का निर्धारित मार्ग
definition: an escape route, the marked path through a building that people follow to reach safety during fire or danger (der Fluchtweg, plural Fluchtwege)
example: Der Fluchtweg darf nicht mit Kisten verstellt werden. — The escape route must not be blocked with boxes.

hindi: उड़ान — विमान से एक जगह से दूसरी जगह की यात्रा
definition: a flight, the journey made by aircraft through the air from one airport to another (der Flug, plural Flüge)
example: Der Flug nach Delhi dauert acht Stunden. — The flight to Delhi takes eight hours.

hindi: विमान परिचारक — उड़ान में यात्रियों की देखभाल करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: a flight attendant or steward, the cabin crew member who looks after passengers during a flight (der Flugbegleiter, plural Flugbegleiter)
example: Der Flugbegleiter bringt uns Wasser und Kaffee. — The flight attendant brings us water and coffee.

hindi: हवाई अड्डा — जहाँ से विमान उड़ते और उतरते हैं
definition: an airport, the place with runways and terminals where aircraft take off and land (der Flughafen, plural Flughäfen)
example: Wir fahren morgen früh zum Flughafen. — We are driving to the airport early tomorrow.

hindi: हवाई जहाज़ — हवा में उड़कर यात्रियों को ले जाने वाला विमान
definition: an aeroplane, the aircraft with wings and engines that carries passengers through the air (das Flugzeug, plural Flugzeuge)
example: Das Flugzeug landet pünktlich in Wien. — The plane lands on time in Vienna.

hindi: गलियारा — घर के भीतर कमरों को जोड़ने वाला रास्ता
definition: the hallway or corridor, the passage inside a home or building that connects the rooms and the front door (der Flur, plural Flure)
example: Die Jacken hängen im Flur. — The jackets are hanging in the hallway.

hindi: नदी — समुद्र या झील की ओर बहती बड़ी जलधारा
definition: a river, a large natural stream of water flowing across land towards a lake or the ocean (der Fluss, plural Flüsse)
example: Der Fluss fließt mitten durch die Stadt. — The river flows right through the city.

hindi: क्षेत्रफल — किसी सतह का नापा हुआ फैलाव
definition: an area or surface, the flat extent of a shape or piece of land measured in square units such as square metres (die Fläche, plural Flächen)
example: Die Wohnung hat eine Fläche von achtzig Quadratmetern. — The flat has an area of eighty square metres.

hindi: दूध की बोतल — शिशु को दूध पिलाने की निपल वाली छोटी बोतल
definition: a baby bottle, the small feeding bottle with a teat from which an infant drinks milk or formula (das Fläschchen, plural Fläschchen)
example: Das Baby bekommt alle vier Stunden ein Fläschchen. — The baby gets a bottle every four hours.

hindi: बाँसुरी — फूँक से बजने वाला लंबा पतला वाद्य
definition: a flute or recorder, the long thin wind instrument played by blowing across or into it while covering holes (die Flöte, plural Flöten)
example: Das Kind bläst leise in die Flöte. — The child blows softly into the recorder.

hindi: फुसफुसाना — बहुत धीमी आवाज़ में बोलना
definition: to whisper, speaking very softly and quietly so that only a person standing close beside you can hear the words (regular: flüstert, hat geflüstert)
example: Sie flüsterte ihm etwas ins Ohr. — She whispered something in his ear.

hindi: कड़ी — धारावाहिक का एक एपिसोड; किसी काम का परिणाम भी
definition: an episode of a series, and more generally a consequence or result that follows from something (die Folge, plural Folgen)
example: Die letzte Folge der Serie war spannend. — The last episode of the series was exciting.

hindi: पीछे चलना — किसी के पीछे जाना या निर्देश मानना
definition: to follow behind someone or something, to come after it, also to obey instructions (regular: ist gefolgt; + Dativ)
example: Folgen Sie mir bitte, ich zeige Ihnen den Weg. — Please follow me, I will show you the way.

hindi: निष्कर्ष निकालना — तथ्यों से तर्कपूर्वक नतीजा पाना
definition: to conclude or infer, to reach a judgement logically from given facts and premises (regular: hat gefolgert, aus + Dativ)
example: Daraus folgere ich, dass der Plan nicht funktioniert. — From that I conclude that the plan does not work.

hindi: फलस्वरूप — तर्क का नतीजा बताने वाला औपचारिक शब्द
definition: consequently, as a result; a formal written adverb drawing a logical conclusion from what was said
example: Er hat nicht gelernt, folglich fiel er durch. — He did not study, consequently he failed.

hindi: आकार, साँचा — किसी चीज़ की बाहरी बनावट, या केक का साँचा
definition: a shape or form, the outer outline of an object, also a baking tin or mould and a person's physical fitness (die Form, plural Formen)
example: Der Kuchen hat die Form eines Herzens. — The cake has the shape of a heart.

hindi: सूत्र — गणित या रसायन में संकेतों से लिखा नियम
definition: a formula, a rule written in mathematical or chemical symbols, also a fixed form of words (die Formel, plural Formeln)
example: Die Formel steht auf Seite zehn im Buch. — The formula is on page ten in the book.

hindi: आकार देना — मिट्टी, आटा या चरित्र को ढालना
definition: to form or shape material such as clay, dough or metal, also to mould a person's character over time (regular: hat geformt)
example: Die Kinder formen Tiere aus Ton. — The children are shaping animals out of clay.

hindi: प्रपत्र — खाली खानों वाला छपा काग़ज़ जिसे भरकर देना होता है
definition: a printed or online form with blank fields that you fill in with your details for an application or registration (das Formular, plural Formulare)
example: Bitte füllen Sie das Formular in Druckbuchstaben aus. — Please fill in the form in block letters.

hindi: शोध करना — नया ज्ञान पाने के लिए व्यवस्थित खोज करना
definition: to do research, to investigate a scientific question systematically in order to gain new knowledge (regular, hat geforscht)
example: Sie forscht seit Jahren über seltene Krankheiten. — She has been researching rare diseases for years.

hindi: शोधकर्ता — नए ज्ञान की खोज में लगा व्यक्ति
definition: a researcher or explorer, a person who investigates scientific questions or discovers unknown places (der Forscher, plural Forscher)
example: Die Forscher haben eine neue Art entdeckt. — The researchers discovered a new species.

hindi: शोध — नया ज्ञान पाने के लिए व्यवस्थित खोज
definition: research, the systematic scientific investigation that produces new knowledge at universities and institutes (die Forschung, plural Forschungen)
example: Die Forschung an diesem Institut ist weltweit bekannt. — The research at this institute is known worldwide.

hindi: दूर, चला गया — यहाँ से हटकर, थोड़ा औपचारिक
definition: away or gone, departed from this place, a slightly more formal or written companion to weg
example: Sie war schon fort, als ich ankam. — She had already gone when I arrived.

hindi: उन्नत प्रशिक्षण — पेशे में पहले से मौजूद कौशल को ताज़ा और गहरा करने वाला पाठ्यक्रम
definition: advanced professional training, a course that updates or deepens the skills someone already uses in their occupation (die Fortbildung, plural Fortbildungen)
example: Alle Lehrer müssen regelmäßig zur Fortbildung. — All teachers must attend advanced training regularly.

hindi: प्रगति — आगे बढ़ना, बेहतर स्थिति की ओर विकास
definition: progress or advance, the forward development of science, technology or a person's work towards something better (der Fortschritt, plural Fortschritte)
example: Der Fortschritt in der Medizin ist enorm. — The progress in medicine is enormous.

hindi: आगे बढ़ाना — रुके हुए काम या बातचीत को फिर से जारी रखना
definition: to continue, resume or carry on with something after a pause, somewhat formal (separable: setzt fort, hat fortgesetzt)
example: Wir setzen das Gespräch morgen früh fort. — We will continue the conversation tomorrow morning.

hindi: तस्वीर खींचना — कैमरे से छवि लेना
definition: to photograph, to take pictures with a camera as a leisure hobby or as a profession (regular: hat fotografiert)
example: Sie fotografiert am liebsten alte Gebäude. — She most likes photographing old buildings.

hindi: नियम-भंग — खेल में विरोधी के विरुद्ध गलत हरकत
definition: a foul, an unfair or illegal action against an opponent in a game that the referee punishes (das Foul, plural Fouls)
example: Das war ein klares Foul im Strafraum. — That was a clear foul in the penalty area.

hindi: पूछना — किसी से कोई सवाल करना
definition: to ask a question or request information from another person about something you want to know or understand (regular: fragt, hat gefragt; nach + Dativ)
example: Darf ich dich etwas fragen? — May I ask you something?

hindi: किसी के बारे में पूछना — रास्ता, समय या किसी व्यक्ति की जानकारी माँगना
definition: to inquire about or after somebody or something, asking questions and requesting information about it, such as directions (nach + Dativ, regular)
example: Ein Tourist fragte mich nach dem Weg zum Bahnhof. — A tourist asked me the way to the station.

hindi: शोध-प्रश्न — जाँच में जिस सवाल का उत्तर खोजा जाए
definition: a research question or problem statement, the precise question a study, essay or thesis sets out to answer (die Fragestellung, plural Fragestellungen)
example: Die Fragestellung der Arbeit ist klar formuliert. — The research question of the paper is clearly formulated.

hindi: स्त्री — वयस्क महिला; नाम से पहले श्रीमती या सुश्री का सम्मानसूचक
definition: a woman or wife, and the polite title placed before a woman's surname whatever her marital status (die Frau, plural Frauen)
example: Frau Müller wohnt im dritten Stock. — Mrs Müller lives on the third floor.

hindi: ढीठ — बदतमीज़ और मुँहफट, अक्सर बच्चों के लिए
definition: cheeky and impudent, rude in a bold way, often said of children who answer back (regular adjective)
example: Sei nicht so frech zu deiner Oma! — Don't be so cheeky to your grandma!

hindi: खुला तैराकी कुंड — गर्मियों में खुला रहने वाला बाहरी पूल
definition: an outdoor swimming pool, the open-air facility with lawns where people swim and sunbathe in summer (das Freibad, plural Freibäder)
example: Das Freibad öffnet im Mai. — The outdoor pool opens in May.

hindi: खुली छूट देना — किसी को अपनी मर्ज़ी से काम करने देना
definition: to give someone a free hand, letting them decide and act however they see fit (jemandem freie Hand lassen; hat gelassen)
example: Der Chef lässt uns bei dem Projekt freie Hand. — The boss gives us a free hand on the project.

hindi: स्वतंत्रता — बिना रोक-टोक बोलने और काम करने की आज़ादी
definition: freedom, the condition of being free to speak, move and act without unjust restriction (die Freiheit, plural Freiheiten)
example: Die Freiheit ist das höchste Gut in einer Demokratie. — Freedom is the highest good in a democracy.

hindi: बेशक / हालाँकि — मानते हुए शर्त जोड़ने वाला दक्षिणी शब्द
definition: an adverb, common in southern Germany and Austria, that concedes a point with admittedly or of course before a restriction follows
example: Freilich kostet das Zeit. — Admittedly, that takes time.

hindi: बरी करना — अदालत द्वारा निर्दोष घोषित करना
definition: to acquit someone, to declare a defendant not guilty and release them from the charge (separable: spricht frei, hat freigesprochen; von + Dativ)
example: Das Gericht sprach die Angeklagte frei. — The court acquitted the defendant.

hindi: शुक्रवार — कार्य सप्ताह का आख़िरी दिन, सप्ताहांत से पहले
definition: Friday, the last day of the working week just before the weekend begins (der Freitag, plural Freitage)
example: Am Freitag gehen wir nach der Arbeit essen. — On Friday we go out to eat after work.

hindi: फ़ुरसत — काम और पढ़ाई से बचा हुआ अपना समय
definition: leisure time, the free hours outside work or school that a person spends however they like (die Freizeit, plural Freizeiten)
example: In meiner Freizeit lese ich gern Krimis. — In my free time I like reading crime novels.

hindi: पराया — अनजान, अपरिचित या किसी दूसरे का
definition: strange, foreign or unfamiliar, describing a person, place or thing that is unknown to you or belongs to someone else
example: Die Stadt war mir völlig fremd. — The city was completely unfamiliar to me.

hindi: अजनबी — ऐसा व्यक्ति जिसे आप बिल्कुल नहीं जानते
definition: a stranger, a person you have never met before and whose name you do not know in a public place such as a street or train (der Fremde, plural Fremden)
example: Ein Fremder hat mich nach dem Weg gefragt. — A stranger asked me for directions.

hindi: पराए से संबंध रखना — साथी को धोखा देना, बोलचाल
definition: to cheat on a partner, to have an affair with someone outside the relationship, the colloquial everyday word (separable: geht fremd, ist fremdgegangen)
example: Sie glaubt, dass er fremdgeht. — She believes he is cheating on her.

hindi: दूसरे की शर्म — किसी और की बेवकूफ़ी पर खुद शर्मिंदा महसूस करना
definition: the vicarious embarrassment felt when watching another person behave awkwardly or foolishly, the cringe on someone else's behalf (die Fremdscham, no plural)
example: Seine Rede auf der Hochzeit war pure Fremdscham. — His speech at the wedding was pure second-hand embarrassment.

hindi: पराई शर्म — दूसरे की हरकत पर खुद शर्मिंदा होना
definition: to burn with embarrassment on behalf of another person who is feeling none of it themselves
example: The best man's speech made everyone at the table fremdschämen quietly.

hindi: ख़ुशी — मन का हल्का, प्रसन्न भाव जो किसी अच्छी बात से जागे
definition: joy, the warm happy feeling that something good brings, from small everyday pleasures to great celebrations (die Freude, plural Freuden)
example: Die Freude über das Geschenk war riesig. — The joy about the present was huge.

hindi: दोस्त — करीबी मित्र, या प्रेमी
definition: a friend, a person whom you like, trust and spend free time with, and after a possessive also a boyfriend (der Freund, plural Freunde)
example: Mein bester Freund wohnt in Hamburg. — My best friend lives in Hamburg.

hindi: मित्र-मंडली — किसी के सभी दोस्तों का समूह
definition: the circle of friends, all the friends a person spends time with as a group, meeting regularly for parties, dinners and outings (der Freundeskreis, plural Freundeskreise)
example: Sie hat einen großen Freundeskreis. — She has a large circle of friends.

hindi: सहेली — करीबी महिला मित्र, या प्रेमिका
definition: a female friend, a woman whom you like, trust and spend free time with, and after a possessive also a girlfriend (die Freundin, plural Freundinnen)
example: Ich gehe mit meiner Freundin ins Kino. — I am going to the cinema with my girlfriend.

hindi: मिलनसार — गर्मजोशी और दया से पेश आने वाला
definition: friendly and kind, warm and pleasant in manner towards other people (regular adjective)
example: Die Nachbarn sind sehr freundlich. — The neighbours are very friendly.

hindi: सौहार्द — दूसरों के प्रति मित्रवत और दयालु व्यवहार
definition: the friendliness and kindness shown in a warm, welcoming manner towards other people (die Freundlichkeit, no plural)
example: Die Freundlichkeit der Verkäuferin hat mich überrascht. — The friendliness of the shop assistant surprised me.

hindi: दोस्ती — दो लोगों के बीच का मैत्री भाव
definition: friendship, the bond of trust and affection between friends who like each other and support each other through difficult times (die Freundschaft, plural Freundschaften)
example: Unsere Freundschaft hält schon zwanzig Jahre. — Our friendship has lasted twenty years already.

hindi: दोस्ती का फ़र्ज़ — बिना मोल-भाव किया गया उपकार
definition: a favour done purely out of friendship, unbilled, and quietly expected to be returned someday
example: Carrying his piano up four floors was a Freundschaftsdienst he still brings up.

hindi: मिलकर ख़ुशी हुई — परिचय के समय का जवाब
definition: the polite phrase spoken when being introduced to someone, saying one is pleased to meet them
example: Freut mich, ich habe schon viel von Ihnen gehört. — Pleased to meet you, I have heard a lot about you.

hindi: शांति — युद्ध का अभाव, आपसी सौहार्द
definition: peace, the absence of war and the calm state of living together without conflict (der Frieden, plural Frieden)
example: Der Frieden in Europa ist nicht selbstverständlich. — Peace in Europe cannot be taken for granted.

hindi: क़ब्रिस्तान — मृतकों को दफ़नाने की जगह
definition: a cemetery or graveyard, the enclosed ground where dead people are buried and their graves are tended (der Friedhof, plural Friedhöfe)
example: Der Friedhof liegt hinter der Kirche. — The cemetery lies behind the church.

hindi: ठंड लगना — सर्दी से काँपना या पानी का जमना
definition: to feel cold and shiver, or of water to freeze into ice in frosty weather (irregular: friert, hat gefroren; ist gefroren for water turning to ice)
example: Ich friere ohne meine Jacke. — I am freezing without my jacket.

hindi: कीमे की टिक्की — तली हुई चपटी गोल मांस की टिक्की
definition: the standard and western German word for a fried flat meatball of minced meat, bread and onion, eaten hot or cold with mustard (die Frikadelle, plural Frikadellen)
example: Die Frikadelle schmeckt auch kalt sehr gut. — The meatball tastes very good cold too.

hindi: ताज़ा — हाल ही में तोड़ा या बनाया हुआ, बासी नहीं
definition: fresh, recently picked, baked or made and not yet stale or spoiled, also cool and clean when said of air (regular comparison: frischer, am frischesten)
example: Das Brot vom Bäcker ist noch frisch. — The bread from the bakery is still fresh.

hindi: ताज़ा मुलायम पनीर — रोटी पर लगाने वाला नरम फैलने वाला पनीर
definition: cream cheese, the soft spreadable fresh white cheese used on bread rolls and in dips, milder than quark (der Frischkäse, plural Frischkäse)
example: Der Frischkäse kommt aufs Brötchen. — The cream cheese goes on the roll.

hindi: नाई — बाल काटने, सँवारने और रंगने वाला
definition: a hairdresser or barber, the trained person who cuts, washes, styles and colours customers' hair in a salon (der Friseur, plural Friseure)
example: Ich gehe morgen zum Friseur. — I am going to the hairdresser tomorrow.

hindi: समय-सीमा — काम पूरा करने की आख़िरी तारीख़
definition: a deadline or time limit, the period within which something must be done (die Frist, plural Fristen)
example: Die Frist endet am Freitag. — The deadline ends on Friday.

hindi: समय-सीमा के भीतर — तय अवधि ख़त्म होने से पहले किया गया
definition: within the deadline, done or submitted in time before the official period expires
example: Die Unterlagen müssen fristgerecht eingehen. — The documents must arrive within the deadline.

hindi: समय-सीमा विस्तार — जमा करने की तारीख़ आगे बढ़ाना
definition: an extension of a deadline granted by an authority, giving more time to submit documents or make a payment (die Fristverlängerung, plural Fristverlängerungen)
example: Ich habe beim Finanzamt eine Fristverlängerung beantragt. — I applied to the tax office for a deadline extension.

hindi: प्रसन्न — राहत और हल्की ख़ुशी से भरा
definition: glad and pleased, quietly happy, often with relief that something worrying turned out well
example: Ich bin froh, dass du da bist. — I am glad that you are here.

hindi: क्रिसमस की शुभकामनाएँ — त्योहार पर कही जाने वाली बधाई
definition: the standard festive greeting wishing someone a merry Christmas, said and written from Christmas Eve onwards
example: Frohe Weihnachten und ein gutes neues Jahr! — Merry Christmas and a happy new year!

hindi: धर्मपरायण — ईश्वर के प्रति श्रद्धालु, भक्तिपूर्ण
definition: pious, devout, living in a quiet religious way with regular prayer and obedience to divine commandments
example: Sie führt ein frommes Leben. — She leads a pious life.

hindi: मेंढक — तालाब में टर्राने वाला उछलता हरा जीव
definition: a frog, the green jumping amphibian that croaks in ponds on summer evenings (der Frosch, plural Frösche)
example: Am Teich quakt ein Frosch laut. — A frog croaks loudly by the pond.

hindi: पाला — जमाव बिंदु से नीचे का तापमान
definition: frost, freezing temperature below zero that turns water to ice and coats the ground white (der Frost, plural Fröste)
example: Der Frost hat die Blumen im Garten erwischt. — The frost caught the flowers in the garden.

hindi: पाले जैसा — जमा देने वाला ठंडा
definition: frosty, describing freezing cold air and weather that leaves ice on windows and grass; also icy in manner
example: Der Morgen war klar und frostig. — The morning was clear and frosty.

hindi: फल — किसी पौधे का एक अकेला फल, जिसमें बीज होते हैं
definition: a single fruit, the seed-bearing part of a plant that people pick and eat, also used figuratively for a result or reward (die Frucht, plural Früchte)
example: Diese Frucht ist noch nicht reif. — This fruit is not ripe yet.

hindi: कुंठा — बार-बार अटकने या निराश होने की खीझ (बोलचाल)
definition: frustration, the colloquial sour feeling of being blocked or let down again and again (der Frust, no plural)
example: Nach der Niederlage war der Frust im Team groß. — After the defeat the frustration in the team was great.

hindi: प्रफुल्लित — हँसमुख, खिला हुआ मूड
definition: cheerful or merry, visibly in good spirits and spreading a lively happy mood around
example: Die Kinder sangen fröhlich im Bus. — The children sang cheerfully on the bus.

hindi: जल्दी — समय से पहले, सुबह के शुरुआती घंटे
definition: early, before the usual or expected time, also referring to the morning hours
example: Ich stehe morgens sehr früh auf. — I get up very early in the morning.

hindi: सुबह जल्दी उठने वाला — भोर में उठने का आदी व्यक्ति
definition: a person who habitually gets up very early in the morning and feels most awake and productive at dawn, an early riser (der Frühaufsteher, plural Frühaufsteher)
example: Mein Vater ist Frühaufsteher und steht um fünf auf. — My father is an early riser and gets up at five.

hindi: पहले — बीते ज़माने में, अब से पहले
definition: formerly, in earlier times, back in the past, used to compare an older situation with the present one
example: Früher war hier ein Bauernhof. — There used to be a farm here.

hindi: वसंत ऋतु — साल का आरंभिक गर्म होता हिस्सा, कुछ औपचारिक शब्द
definition: spring, the season after winter when plants bloom and days grow warmer, a slightly more formal word than Frühling (das Frühjahr, plural Frühjahre)
example: Im Frühjahr beginnt die Gartenarbeit. — In spring the garden work begins.

hindi: वसंत-आलस्य — बसंत आने पर छाने वाली सुस्ती
definition: the sluggish tiredness arriving with spring, when lengthening daylight leaves the body unconvinced
example: Nothing got finished in March, which he blamed entirely on Frühjahrsmüdigkeit.

hindi: वसंत — सर्दी के बाद फूल खिलने और दिन बढ़ने की ऋतु
definition: spring, the season after winter when plants bloom again and the days grow longer and warmer (der Frühling, plural Frühlinge)
example: Im Frühling blühen die Kirschbäume. — In spring the cherry trees bloom.

hindi: सुबह का नाश्ता — दिन का पहला भोजन, अकसर ब्रेड, मक्खन और कॉफ़ी
definition: breakfast, the morning meal of bread rolls, butter, cheese and coffee, often served in cafés until noon (das Frühstück, plural Frühstücke)
example: Das Frühstück gibt es bis zwölf Uhr. — Breakfast is served until twelve.

hindi: नाश्ता करना — सुबह का पहला भोजन खाना
definition: to have breakfast, eating the first meal of the day early in the morning, often together with family (regular: frühstückt, hat gefrühstückt)
example: Wir frühstücken am Wochenende sehr spät. — We eat breakfast very late at the weekend.

hindi: लोमड़ी — लाल फ़र और झाड़ीदार पूँछ वाला चालाक जानवर
definition: a fox, the cunning red-furred wild animal with a bushy tail that hunts at night (der Fuchs, plural Füchse)
example: Nachts schleicht ein Fuchs durch die Siedlung. — At night a fox sneaks through the neighbourhood.

hindi: काम करना — मशीन या योजना का ठीक से चलना
definition: to work or function properly, said of a machine, device, plan or system that does what it should (regular: hat funktioniert)
example: Der Aufzug funktioniert heute nicht. — The lift is not working today.

hindi: भय — किसी ख़तरे से डरने का कुछ औपचारिक शब्द
definition: fear, a somewhat more formal or written word for the feeling of being afraid of a specific danger (die Furcht, no plural)
example: Die Furcht vor Strafe ließ ihn schweigen. — The fear of punishment kept him silent.

hindi: भयंकर — बहुत बुरा, डरावना; बोलचाल में बहुत ज़्यादा
definition: awful, terrible, dreadful; strong disapproval of something frightening or very unpleasant, also an intensifier
example: Der Stau heute Morgen war furchtbar. — The traffic jam this morning was awful.

hindi: ठूँसकर खाना — बोलचाल में जमकर भोजन करना
definition: to eat heartily or stuff oneself with food, colloquial and playful, from the word for animal feed (regular)
example: Die Kinder futtern die ganze Pizza allein. — The kids polish off the whole pizza on their own.

hindi: पैर/पाँव — टाँग के सिरे का अंग जिस पर खड़े होते हैं
definition: the foot, the lowest part of the leg with heel, sole and toes on which a person stands and walks (der Fuß, plural Füße)
example: Der Schuh drückt am linken Fuß. — The shoe pinches on the left foot.

hindi: पैर-गेंद का खेल — पैरों से गेंद मारकर खेला जाने वाला खेल और उसकी गेंद
definition: football or soccer, the most popular sport in Germany, and also the ball itself that is kicked in the game (der Fußball, plural Fußbälle)
example: Samstags schauen wir zusammen Fußball. — On Saturdays we watch football together.

hindi: फ़र्श — कमरे की ज़मीन जिस पर चलते हैं
definition: the floor of a room, the flat surface underfoot made of wood, tiles or carpet (der Fußboden, plural Fußböden)
example: Der Fußboden ist aus Holz. — The floor is made of wood.

hindi: पैदल यात्री — पैरों से चलकर सड़क पार करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a pedestrian, a person travelling on foot through the streets rather than in a vehicle (der Fußgänger, plural Fußgänger)
example: Fußgänger haben hier immer Vorrang. — Pedestrians always have priority here.

hindi: पैदल क्षेत्र — शहर का वह भाग जहाँ गाड़ियाँ वर्जित हों
definition: a pedestrian zone, a shopping area in the centre of a town where motor vehicles are banned and people walk freely (die Fußgängerzone, plural Fußgängerzonen)
example: In der Fußgängerzone gibt es viele Geschäfte. — There are many shops in the pedestrian zone.

hindi: नौका सेवा — नदी या समुद्र पार यात्रियों और गाड़ियों को ले जाने वाली नाव
definition: a ferry, the boat that carries passengers and vehicles across a river, lake or stretch of sea on a regular route (die Fähre, plural Fähren)
example: Die Fähre nach Rügen fährt zweimal am Tag. — The ferry to Rügen runs twice a day.

hindi: रंगना — कपड़े या बालों को नया रंग देना
definition: to dye or colour something, giving cloth, hair or eggs a new colour with paint or dye, reflexive when leaves change colour in autumn (regular: färbt, hat gefärbt)
example: Ich färbe meine Haare rot. — I am dyeing my hair red.

hindi: गरम पहाड़ी हवा — आल्प्स से उतरती गरम सूखी हवा; बाल सुखाने की मशीन भी
definition: a warm dry wind that blows down from the Alps and gives people headaches, also the everyday word for a hairdryer (der Föhn, plural Föhne)
example: Wenn der Föhn weht, sieht man die Berge ganz klar. — When the foehn blows you see the mountains very clearly.

hindi: बढ़ावा देना — पैसे या सहयोग से किसी को आगे बढ़ाना
definition: to promote, support or encourage the growth of something, often with money, such as talent, research or young athletes (regular: hat gefördert)
example: Die Stadt fördert junge Künstler mit Stipendien. — The city supports young artists with grants.

hindi: महसूस करना, छूकर जानना — अनुभव करना
definition: to feel something by touch or emotionally, reflexively sich fühlen for how one feels in body or mood (regular)
example: Ich fühle mich heute viel besser. — I feel much better today.

hindi: चालक अनुज्ञप्ति — गाड़ी चलाने की सरकारी अनुमति का पत्र
definition: the official licence card that permits a person to drive a motor vehicle on public roads (der Führerschein, plural Führerscheine)
example: Sie hat mit achtzehn den Führerschein gemacht. — She got her driving licence at eighteen.

hindi: निर्देशित भ्रमण — गाइड के साथ संग्रहालय की सैर
definition: a guided tour of a museum, castle or city in which a guide walks a group around and explains what they see (die Führung, plural Führungen)
example: Die Führung durch das Schloss dauert eine Stunde. — The guided tour through the castle lasts one hour.

hindi: भरना — किसी बर्तन या जगह को पूरा भर देना
definition: to fill a container, glass or space with something until it holds as much as it should (regular: hat gefüllt)
example: Sie füllt die Vase mit frischem Wasser. — She fills the vase with fresh water.

hindi: फ़ाउंटेन पेन — स्याही वाला क़लम जिससे जर्मन स्कूलों में लिखना सीखते हैं
definition: a fountain pen, the writing instrument filled with ink cartridges that German primary pupils traditionally learn to write neatly with (der Füller, plural Füller)
example: Mein Füller hat keine Tinte mehr. — My fountain pen has run out of ink.

hindi: भराव शब्द — वाक्य में अर्थ से ज़्यादा लहजा जोड़ने वाला शब्द
definition: a filler word that adds little factual meaning but colours the tone of a sentence, the everyday label for modal particles (das Füllwort, plural Füllwörter)
example: Das Füllwort macht den Satz freundlicher. — The filler word makes the sentence friendlier.

hindi: पाँच — गिनती की पाँचवीं संख्या
definition: the cardinal number five, used for counting fingers, people, minutes and prices in ordinary conversation
example: Der Bus kommt in fünf Minuten. — The bus comes in five minutes.

hindi: के लिए — किसी के फ़ायदे, उद्देश्य या बदले में
definition: for, intended for the benefit or purpose of someone or something, or given in exchange for a price or reward (preposition, + Akkusativ)
example: Das Geschenk ist für dich. — The present is for you.

hindi: डरना — किसी चीज़ से भय महसूस करना
definition: to fear something or someone, to feel afraid of a danger or unpleasant possibility, also reflexive for being scared (regular, sich fürchten vor + Dativ)
example: Viele Menschen fürchten sich vor Spinnen. — Many people are afraid of spiders.

hindi: बहुत डरावना — भयानक, बुरा; बोलचाल में बेहद
definition: terrible, frightful, dreadful; strong disapproval of something horrible, also an intensifier meaning extremely
example: Es hat fürchterlich geregnet. — It rained terribly.

hindi: चारा खिलाना — जानवर या बच्चे को खाना देना
definition: to feed an animal or a small child, to give food to a creature that cannot fetch its own meal (regular, hat gefüttert)
example: Kannst du heute die Katze füttern? — Can you feed the cat today?

hindi: काँटा — नुकीले दाँतों वाला खाने का औज़ार
definition: a fork, the pronged eating tool used to lift food from the plate to the mouth (die Gabel, plural Gabeln)
example: Ich brauche noch eine Gabel. — I still need a fork.

hindi: कला दीर्घा — चित्र बेचने या दिखाने की जगह
definition: a gallery, a room or small business where works of art are displayed and often offered for sale (die Galerie, plural Galerien)
example: In der Galerie hängen nur Bilder von lokalen Künstlern. — Only pictures by local artists hang in the gallery.

hindi: गलियारा — कमरों के बीच का रास्ता; गाड़ी का गियर; भोजन का कोर्स
definition: a corridor or hallway, a gear in a vehicle, or a course of a meal, never a criminal group (der Gang, plural Gänge)
example: Die Toilette ist am Ende des Gangs. — The toilet is at the end of the corridor.

hindi: कलहंस — बड़ा सफ़ेद पानी का पक्षी, क्रिसमस पर भूनकर खाया जाता है
definition: a goose, the large white water bird with a long neck, traditionally roasted for Christmas dinner (die Gans, plural Gänse)
example: Zu Weihnachten gibt es bei uns eine Gans. — We have goose at Christmas.

hindi: पूरा — समूचा, बिना किसी हिस्से के छूटे
definition: whole or entire without any part missing, also used as an adverb meaning quite or completely in everyday speech
example: Ich habe den ganzen Tag gearbeitet. — I worked the whole day.

hindi: पूरे ध्यान से सुनना — सुनने को पूरी तरह तैयार होना
definition: to be all ears, listening with full attention and eager to hear what someone will say (ist ganz Ohr)
example: Erzähl mal, ich bin ganz Ohr. — Go on, I am all ears.

hindi: ज़रा भी — कतई नहीं, बिल्कुल नहीं
definition: at all, whatsoever, in the least; strengthens a negation in the fixed pairs gar nicht and gar kein, making the denial complete and emphatic
example: Das gefällt mir gar nicht. — I don't like that at all.

hindi: गाड़ीघर — गाड़ी खड़ी करने का बंद कमरा
definition: a garage, the enclosed building or room beside a house where a car or other vehicle is parked and kept (die Garage, plural Garagen)
example: Das Auto steht in der Garage. — The car is in the garage.

hindi: कोट जमा करने की जगह — थिएटर या संग्रहालय में
definition: the cloakroom where visitors to a theatre, museum or restaurant leave their coats and bags, and also a person's wardrobe of clothes (die Garderobe, plural Garderoben)
example: Bitte geben Sie Ihren Mantel an der Garderobe ab. — Please hand in your coat at the cloakroom.

hindi: झीना पर्दा — खिड़की का हल्का पारदर्शी पर्दा
definition: a net curtain, the light sheer cloth hung at a window that lets daylight in but blocks views (die Gardine, plural Gardinen)
example: Die Gardinen müssen gewaschen werden. — The net curtains need washing.

hindi: बग़ीचा — घर के पास फूल-सब्ज़ी उगाने की ज़मीन
definition: a garden, the piece of ground beside a house where flowers, vegetables and grass are grown (der Garten, plural Gärten)
example: Im Sommer essen wir oft im Garten. — In summer we often eat in the garden.

hindi: बाग़ की कैंची — टहनियाँ और बाड़ काटने की मज़बूत कैंची
definition: a pair of garden shears or secateurs, the strong scissors used to cut branches and hedges (die Gartenschere, plural Gartenscheren)
example: Die Gartenschere liegt im Schuppen. — The garden shears are in the shed.

hindi: गली — पुराने शहर की तंग, छोटी सड़क
definition: a narrow lane or alley between houses, typical of old towns, in Austria the usual word for a small street (die Gasse, plural Gassen)
example: Durch die enge Gasse passt kein Auto. — No car fits through the narrow lane.

hindi: अतिथि — घर, होटल या रेस्तराँ में आया मेहमान
definition: a guest, a person invited into your home or a paying visitor at a hotel or restaurant (der Gast, plural Gäste)
example: Wir haben heute Abend Gäste. — We have guests this evening.

hindi: मेहमाननवाज़ी — अतिथि-सत्कार का कर्तव्य
definition: hospitality understood as duty, where the guest is fed, warmed, and never permitted to help
example: Their Gastfreundschaft meant three helpings before anyone asked why we had come.

hindi: मेज़बान — मेहमानों की आवभगत करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a host, the person who invites guests and looks after them at a meal, party or stay (der Gastgeber, plural Gastgeber)
example: Der Gastgeber begrüßte alle an der Tür. — The host greeted everyone at the door.

hindi: सराय-भोजनालय — गाँव का पारंपरिक भोजनालय, कभी-कभी ठहरने के कमरों वाला
definition: an inn or traditional restaurant, often in a village, serving hearty regional food and sometimes offering rooms (das Gasthaus, plural Gasthäuser)
example: Im Gasthaus gibt es jeden Sonntag Braten. — At the inn there is roast every Sunday.

hindi: सराय — गाँव का भोजनालय जहाँ ऊपर ठहरने के कमरे भी हों
definition: a country inn with a restaurant downstairs and simple guest rooms upstairs, common in villages (der Gasthof, plural Gasthöfe)
example: Im Gasthof gibt es abends Schnitzel und ein Zimmer für die Nacht. — At the inn there is schnitzel in the evening and a room for the night.

hindi: भोजनालय — खाना-पीना मिलने वाली जगह का सरकारी-औपचारिक शब्द
definition: a restaurant or eating house, the neutral official word seen on signs and in regulations (die Gaststätte, plural Gaststätten)
example: Die Gaststätte ist montags geschlossen. — The restaurant is closed on Mondays.

hindi: प्रस्थान द्वार — हवाई अड्डे पर विमान में चढ़ने का द्वार
definition: a departure gate at an airport, the numbered exit from the terminal where passengers board their flight (das Gate, plural Gates)
example: Das Gate ist noch nicht geöffnet. — The gate is not open yet.

hindi: मस्ती — बवेरिया और ऑस्ट्रिया में शोर-शराबे वाली मौज-मस्ती
definition: the Bavarian and Austrian word for loud cheerful fun, merriment and high spirits at a festival, party or beer tent (die Gaudi, no plural)
example: Auf dem Volksfest war eine riesige Gaudi. — There was tremendous fun at the fair.

hindi: देना — किसी चीज़ को अपने हाथ से दूसरे के हाथ में सौंपना
definition: to give or hand something over to another person, the most basic verb of transfer in everyday German (gibt, gab, hat gegeben, + Dativ for the receiver)
example: Kannst du mir bitte das Salz geben? — Can you please give me the salt?

hindi: प्रार्थना — ईश्वर से बात करने के शब्द
definition: a prayer, the words spoken silently or aloud to God asking, thanking or praising in worship (das Gebet, plural Gebete)
example: Vor dem Essen sprechen wir ein Gebet. — Before the meal we say a prayer.

hindi: क्षेत्र — स्पष्ट सीमा वाला भूभाग, या विषय-क्षेत्र
definition: an area or territory, a stretch of land defined by clear boundaries or a purpose, also a field of knowledge (das Gebiet, plural Gebiete)
example: Dieses Gebiet steht unter Naturschutz. — This area is a protected nature reserve.

hindi: पर्वतमाला — कई पहाड़ों की लंबी शृंखला
definition: a mountain range, a connected chain of many mountains covering a wide region (das Gebirge, plural Gebirge)
example: Das Gebirge ist im Winter voller Schnee. — The mountain range is full of snow in winter.

hindi: सुरक्षा-भाव — अपनेपन की ऊष्मा और निश्चिंतता
definition: the warm security of being sheltered, protected and wholly belonging somewhere without fear
example: A child asleep across two laps is the picture of Geborgenheit.

hindi: आज्ञा — ईश्वरीय या नैतिक आदेश; नीलामी की बोली भी
definition: a commandment or rule, a binding moral or religious order such as the Ten Commandments, also a bid at an auction (das Gebot, plural Gebote)
example: Das erste Gebot kennt jeder. — Everyone knows the first commandment.

hindi: इस्तेमाल किया हुआ — पहले किसी और के पास रहा, पुराना
definition: second-hand or previously owned, describing goods such as vehicles, books and furniture that someone else has already used
example: Wir haben ein gebrauchtes Auto gekauft. — We bought a used car.

hindi: जर्जर, कमज़ोर — बुढ़ापे से शरीर का कमज़ोर और अस्थिर होना
definition: frail and physically weak, usually because of advanced age or long illness
example: Die alte Dame ist sehr gebrechlich geworden. — The old lady has become very frail.

hindi: जन्म — बच्चे का दुनिया में आना
definition: the birth, the moment a baby comes into the world, the start of a person's life (die Geburt, plural Geburten)
example: Nach der Geburt blieb sie eine Woche im Krankenhaus. — After the birth she stayed a week in the hospital.

hindi: जन्मदिन — हर साल जन्म की तारीख़ का उत्सव
definition: a birthday, the yearly anniversary of the day someone was born, usually celebrated with cake and gifts (der Geburtstag, plural Geburtstage)
example: Der Geburtstag meiner Schwester ist morgen. — My sister's birthday is tomorrow.

hindi: जन्म प्रमाण-पत्र — जन्म की तारीख़ और जगह का सरकारी दस्तावेज़
definition: a birth certificate, the official document issued by the registry office recording a person's date and place of birth and parents (die Geburtsurkunde, plural Geburtsurkunden)
example: Für die Hochzeit brauchen wir eine aktuelle Geburtsurkunde. — For the wedding we need a recent birth certificate.

hindi: बेकरी की मीठी चीज़ें — बिस्कुट, पेस्ट्री आदि का सामूहिक शब्द
definition: baked goods or pastries as a collective, the small sweet biscuits and pastries offered with coffee or sold at a bakery (das Gebäck, no plural)
example: Das Gebäck vom Bäcker ist noch warm. — The pastries from the baker are still warm.

hindi: इमारत — दीवारों और छत वाला कोई भी बड़ा निर्माण
definition: a building, any large permanent structure with walls and a roof, the general word for houses and offices alike (das Gebäude, plural Gebäude)
example: Das alte Gebäude wird bald renoviert. — The old building will soon be renovated.

hindi: शुल्क — किसी सेवा या सरकारी कार्रवाई के लिए तय भुगतान
definition: a fee, a fixed charge or levy paid for a service, an official procedure or the use of an account (die Gebühr, plural Gebühren)
example: Die Gebühr für das Konto beträgt fünf Euro im Monat. — The fee for the account is five euros a month.

hindi: विचार — मन में उठने वाली बात या सोच
definition: a thought or idea that passes through the mind, something a person thinks about or considers (der Gedanke, plural Gedanken)
example: Mir kam plötzlich ein guter Gedanke. — A good thought suddenly came to me.

hindi: विचार-प्रयोग — केवल कल्पना में चलाया गया परीक्षण
definition: an imagined scenario run purely in the mind to test whether a theory survives its own logic
example: Einstein chased a beam of light in a Gedankenexperiment long before anyone measured one.

hindi: फलना-फूलना — अच्छी तरह बढ़ना और पनपना
definition: to thrive or flourish, growing well and healthily, used for plants, children, animals and projects (irregular: ist gediehen)
example: Die Pflanzen gedeihen auf dem Balkon prächtig. — The plants are thriving beautifully on the balcony.

hindi: स्मरण — दिवंगत या बीती घटना को आदर से याद करना
definition: solemn remembrance of the dead or of a historic event, the formal act of honouring memory (das Gedenken, no plural)
example: Zum Gedenken an die Opfer brannten Kerzen. — Candles burned in remembrance of the victims.

hindi: स्मृति-स्थल — पीड़ितों की याद में रखा गया स्थान
definition: a memorial site, a place preserved and kept open so people can remember the victims of a historic event (die Gedenkstätte, plural Gedenkstätten)
example: Die Schulklasse besuchte die Gedenkstätte am Freitag. — The school class visited the memorial site on Friday.

hindi: स्मृति-दिवस — किसी घटना या पीड़ितों की याद का दिन
definition: a day of remembrance, a date set aside each year to honour victims or recall a historic event (der Gedenktag, plural Gedenktage)
example: Am Gedenktag wehten die Fahnen auf halbmast. — On the day of remembrance the flags flew at half mast.

hindi: कविता — छंद और लय में रची गई रचना
definition: a poem, a short piece of writing arranged in verses and lines with rhythm and often rhyme (das Gedicht, plural Gedichte)
example: Sie hat ein Gedicht für ihre Mutter geschrieben. — She wrote a poem for her mother.

hindi: धैर्य — बिना झुँझलाए शांति से प्रतीक्षा करने या सहने की क्षमता
definition: the calm ability to wait or endure something slow or annoying without losing your temper (die Geduld, no plural)
example: Die Geduld der Lehrerin ist wirklich bewundernswert. — The teacher's patience is truly admirable.

hindi: धैर्यवान — शांति से प्रतीक्षा करने और सहने वाला
definition: patient, able to wait calmly or endure something annoying without becoming angry (regular adjective)
example: Die Lehrerin erklärt alles sehr geduldig. — The teacher explains everything very patiently.

hindi: स्मरणशक्ति — बातें याद रखने की मानसिक क्षमता
definition: the memory as a faculty, the mental ability to store and recall information and past events (das Gedächtnis, plural Gedächtnisse)
example: Meine Oma hat noch ein sehr gutes Gedächtnis. — My grandma still has a very good memory.

hindi: खतरा — नुकसान या चोट होने की आशंका
definition: danger, the possibility that harm, injury or damage could happen to someone or something (die Gefahr, plural Gefahren)
example: Bei Gewitter ist die Gefahr durch Blitzschlag groß. — During thunderstorms the danger from lightning is high.

hindi: अच्छा लगना — किसी को पसंद आना
definition: to please or appeal to someone, used the other way round from English so the thing liked is the subject (irregular: gefällt, gefiel, hat gefallen; + Dativ)
example: Das Bild gefällt mir sehr. — I like the picture a lot.

hindi: जमाने की अलमारी — खाना बर्फ़ जैसा जमाकर लंबे समय तक रखने वाला यंत्र
definition: the freezer, the upright kitchen appliance that keeps food frozen solid for weeks or months (der Gefrierschrank, plural Gefrierschränke)
example: Das Brot liegt im Gefrierschrank. — The bread is in the freezer.

hindi: खतरनाक — जिससे चोट या नुकसान हो सकता है
definition: dangerous, likely to cause harm, injury or damage and therefore something to avoid or handle with care
example: Diese Straße ist bei Glatteis sehr gefährlich. — This road is very dangerous when it is icy.

hindi: जेल — जहाँ दोषी सज़ा काटते हैं
definition: a prison or jail, the building where convicted criminals are locked up to serve their sentence (das Gefängnis, plural Gefängnisse)
example: Er muss für zwei Jahre ins Gefängnis. — He has to go to prison for two years.

hindi: पात्र या बर्तन — तरल रखने का कोई भी बर्तन, थोड़ा औपचारिक शब्द
definition: a vessel or container, a somewhat formal word for any receptacle that holds liquid or loose contents, also a blood vessel in medicine (das Gefäß, plural Gefäße)
example: Füllen Sie das Gefäß bis zur Hälfte. — Fill the vessel halfway.

hindi: भावना — मन में उठने वाला एहसास या अनुभूति
definition: a feeling, emotion or inner sensation that a person experiences, also an intuitive sense for something (das Gefühl, plural Gefühle)
example: Ich habe ein gutes Gefühl bei dieser Entscheidung. — I have a good feeling about this decision.

hindi: के विरुद्ध — किसी के खिलाफ़, या लगभग किसी समय पर
definition: against, in opposition to or in physical contact with something, also approximately at a stated time (preposition, + Akkusativ)
example: Wir spielen morgen gegen die Nachbarn. — We are playing against the neighbours tomorrow.

hindi: इलाक़ा — किसी जगह के आसपास का क्षेत्र
definition: an area or region, the surrounding countryside or district around a particular place (die Gegend, plural Gegenden)
example: In dieser Gegend gibt es viele Seen. — In this area there are many lakes.

hindi: विरोध — दो बातों के बीच का उल्टा या भेद
definition: an opposite or contrast, the state of two things being contrary to each other, often in the phrase in contrast to (der Gegensatz, plural Gegensätze)
example: Im Gegensatz zu ihm mag ich Winter. — In contrast to him, I like winter.

hindi: सामने — सड़क या मेज़ के उस पार, आमने-सामने
definition: opposite or across from something, standing on the facing side of a street, table or room, used both as a preposition and an adverb (+ Dativ, often placed after the noun: dem Bahnhof gegenüber)
example: Das Café liegt direkt gegenüber der Kirche. — The café is directly opposite the church.

hindi: वेतन — कर्मचारी को हर महीने मिलने वाली तनख़्वाह
definition: a salary, the fixed monthly payment that an employee receives for work (das Gehalt, plural Gehälter)
example: Das Gehalt wird am Monatsende überwiesen. — The salary is transferred at the end of the month.

hindi: वेतन-वृद्धि — तनख़्वाह में बढ़ोतरी
definition: a pay rise, an increase in the monthly salary that an employee receives from the employer (die Gehaltserhöhung, plural Gehaltserhöhungen)
example: Ich habe um eine Gehaltserhöhung gebeten. — I asked for a pay rise.

hindi: गुप्त संख्या — कार्ड या खाते का चार अंकों वाला पिन
definition: the secret number, the four-digit personal code typed in to use a bank card (die Geheimzahl, plural Geheimzahlen)
example: Ich habe meine Geheimzahl vergessen. — I have forgotten my PIN.

hindi: चलना — पैदल एक जगह से दूसरी जगह जाना
definition: to walk on foot from one place to another, the basic everyday verb for moving somewhere (irregular: ging, ist gegangen)
example: Wir gehen jeden Morgen zu Fuß zur Arbeit. — We walk to work every morning.

hindi: मस्तिष्क/दिमाग़ — सिर के अंदर सोचने और नियंत्रण करने वाला अंग
definition: the brain, the organ inside the skull that controls thought, memory, movement and feeling (das Gehirn, plural Gehirne)
example: Das Gehirn braucht Schlaf, um zu lernen. — The brain needs sleep in order to learn.

hindi: फुटपाथ — सड़क के किनारे पैदल चलने की ऊँची पट्टी
definition: the pavement or sidewalk, the raised strip beside the road where pedestrians walk, the usual Austrian and southern word where the north says Bürgersteig (der Gehsteig, plural Gehsteige)
example: Die Kinder fahren mit dem Roller auf dem Gehsteig. — The children ride their scooters on the pavement.

hindi: छड़ी — चलते समय सहारे के लिए हाथ में रखी लकड़ी
definition: a walking stick that an elderly or unsteady person leans on for support when moving (der Gehstock, plural Gehstöcke)
example: Ohne seinen Gehstock geht Opa nicht aus dem Haus. — Grandpa does not leave the house without his walking stick.

hindi: पैदल पथ — सड़क के किनारे पैदल चलने की पटरी
definition: the pavement or sidewalk, the raised paved strip beside the road reserved for people walking (der Gehweg, plural Gehwege)
example: Fahrräder dürfen nicht auf dem Gehweg fahren. — Bicycles are not allowed to ride on the pavement.

hindi: श्रवण शक्ति — कानों से सुनने की क्षमता
definition: the sense of hearing, the ability of the ears to perceive sounds, voices and music clearly (das Gehör, no plural)
example: Mit dem Alter lässt das Gehör nach. — Hearing declines with age.

hindi: किसी का होना — किसी की मिल्कियत या समूह का हिस्सा होना
definition: to belong to a person as their property, or to be part of a larger group or category (regular: hat gehört, + Dativ; zu + Dativ)
example: Dieses Fahrrad gehört meinem Bruder. — This bicycle belongs to my brother.

hindi: किसी समूह का हिस्सा होना — किसी वर्ग या श्रेणी में शामिल होना
definition: to belong to or form part of a group, category, collection or larger whole (zu + Dativ, regular)
example: Der Bodensee gehört zu den größten Seen Europas. — Lake Constance is among the largest lakes in Europe.

hindi: बेला — गज से बजाया जाने वाला तार वाद्य
definition: a violin, the small stringed instrument held under the chin and played with a bow, the everyday word rather than Violine (die Geige, plural Geigen)
example: Meine Schwester übt jeden Tag auf der Geige. — My sister practises on the violin every day.

hindi: ज़बरदस्त — बहुत बढ़िया, बोलचाल में
definition: awesome or brilliant in youth and everyday colloquial speech, originally meaning lustful, so avoid it in formal settings
example: Das Konzert war einfach geil! — The concert was simply awesome!

hindi: कंजूसी — पैसा या चीज़ें देने से कतराने की प्रवृत्ति
definition: the stinginess and meanness of a person who hates to spend money or share anything (der Geiz, no plural)
example: Sein Geiz ist in der ganzen Familie bekannt. — His stinginess is known throughout the whole family.

hindi: कंजूस — पैसा खर्च करने से कतराने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a miser or stingy person who hates spending money, a colloquial insult for someone unwilling to share (der Geizhals, plural Geizhälse)
example: Der alte Geizhals gibt nie ein Trinkgeld. — The old miser never gives a tip.

hindi: कंजूस — पैसा खर्च करने या बाँटने से कतराने वाला
definition: stingy and mean, hating to spend money or share anything with other people (regular adjective)
example: Er ist zu geizig, um ein Trinkgeld zu geben. — He is too stingy to give a tip.

hindi: ऊबा हुआ — नीरसता से उकताया
definition: bored, showing dull weary lack of interest in whatever is going on around one
example: Die Schüler sahen gelangweilt aus dem Fenster. — The pupils looked out of the window, bored.

hindi: शांतचित्त — दबाव में भी बिना घबराए स्थिर
definition: calm and composed, relaxed and unruffled even under pressure or provocation (regular adjective)
example: Er bleibt auch im Stau ganz gelassen. — He stays completely calm even in a traffic jam.

hindi: शांतचित्तता — दबाव में भी बिना घबराए स्थिर रहना
definition: the calm composure and serenity of someone who stays relaxed and unruffled under pressure (die Gelassenheit, no plural)
example: Die Gelassenheit meines Vaters beruhigt die ganze Familie. — My father's composure calms the whole family.

hindi: पीला — सूरज, नींबू और सरसों के फूल का रंग
definition: yellow, the bright colour of lemons, sunflowers and the middle light of a traffic signal
example: Die Bananen sind noch nicht gelb. — The bananas are not yet yellow.

hindi: पीला थैला — प्लास्टिक और धातु की पैकिंग इकट्ठा करने का थैला
definition: the yellow bag, the German collection sack for plastic, metal and composite packaging that is recycled (der Gelbe Sack, plural Gelbe Säcke)
example: Der Gelbe Sack wird alle zwei Wochen abgeholt. — The yellow bag is collected every two weeks.

hindi: पैसा — लेन-देन का मुद्रा साधन
definition: money, the coins, notes and bank balances used to purchase goods and services, plural used mainly in official finance contexts (das Geld, plural Gelder)
example: Ich habe kein Geld dabei. — I don't have any money with me.

hindi: स्वचालित नक़दी यंत्र — बैंक खाते से नक़द निकालने का यंत्र
definition: a cash machine or ATM, the bank terminal where money is withdrawn with a card outside opening hours (der Geldautomat, plural Geldautomaten)
example: Gibt es hier einen Geldautomaten? — Is there a cash machine here?

hindi: बटुआ — पैसे रखने की छोटी थैली
definition: a wallet or purse, the small folding pouch for cash, coins and cards, the usual word in southern Germany (der Geldbeutel, plural Geldbeutel)
example: Mein Geldbeutel ist leer. — My wallet is empty.

hindi: अर्थदंड — अदालत द्वारा सुनाई गई पैसे की सज़ा
definition: a monetary fine imposed by a court as punishment for a criminal offence instead of prison (die Geldstrafe, plural Geldstrafen)
example: Er kam mit einer Geldstrafe davon. — He got away with a fine.

hindi: अवसर — कोई काम करने का सही मौक़ा
definition: an opportunity or occasion, a favourable moment that makes it possible to do something a person wanted to do (die Gelegenheit, plural Gelegenheiten)
example: Bei der nächsten Gelegenheit rufe ich dich an. — At the next opportunity I will call you.

hindi: कभी-कभार — मौक़ा मिलने पर, यदा-कदा
definition: occasionally, now and then, from time to time whenever a suitable occasion happens to arise, somewhat formal
example: Wir sehen uns nur gelegentlich. — We only see each other occasionally.

hindi: जोड़ — वह जगह जहाँ दो हड्डियाँ मिलकर मुड़ती हैं
definition: a joint, the place where two bones meet and allow the body part to bend and turn (das Gelenk, plural Gelenke)
example: Das Gelenk ist geschwollen und lässt sich kaum bewegen. — The joint is swollen and can hardly move.

hindi: सफल होना — कोई काम अच्छी तरह बन जाना
definition: to succeed or turn out well, said of a plan, a dish or an attempt rather than a person (irregular: gelang, ist gelungen, + Dativ)
example: Der Kuchen ist mir heute wirklich gelungen. — The cake really turned out well for me today.

hindi: है ना? — दक्षिणी जर्मन बोलचाल में पुष्टि माँगने वाला शब्द
definition: a southern German and Austrian tag added to a statement to seek the listener's agreement, like isn't it
example: Schönes Wetter heute, gell? — Nice weather today, isn't it?

hindi: मान्य होना — किसी नियम या टिकट का लागू होना
definition: to be valid or apply, said of rules, tickets and prices that are currently in force (irregular: gilt, galt, hat gegolten; für + Akkusativ)
example: Das Ticket gilt für den ganzen Tag. — The ticket is valid for the whole day.

hindi: नीच — जानबूझकर दूसरों को दुख देने वाला, ओछा
definition: mean and nasty, deliberately unkind or cruel to other people, the word children use for an unfair playmate
example: Das war gemein von dir! — That was mean of you!

hindi: नगरपालिका — स्थानीय शासन की सबसे छोटी इकाई, गाँव या कस्बा
definition: a municipality, the smallest local unit of government, the community of a town or village (die Gemeinde, plural Gemeinden)
example: Unsere Gemeinde baut einen neuen Spielplatz. — Our municipality is building a new playground.

hindi: आराम से — बिना जल्दी, इत्मीनान भरी धीमी चाल
definition: leisurely and unhurried, moving slowly and comfortably without any pressure of time, said of walks and pace
example: Wir gingen gemächlich durch den Park. — We strolled leisurely through the park.

hindi: चित्र — रंगों से कैनवास या दीवार पर बनाई गई कलाकृति
definition: a painting, a picture made with paint on canvas, wood or a wall, the kind hung in a museum or gallery (das Gemälde, plural Gemälde)
example: Das Gemälde hängt im großen Saal des Museums. — The painting hangs in the museum's large hall.

hindi: के मुताबिक़ — किसी नियम या समझौते के अनुरूप
definition: in accordance with a rule, regulation, contract or instruction, formal and legal register (preposition, + Dativ, before or after the noun)
example: Gemäß dem Vertrag zahlen wir monatlich. — In accordance with the contract we pay monthly.

hindi: सब्ज़ी — खाने में पकाई जाने वाली पौधों की जड़ें, पत्तियाँ और फलियाँ
definition: vegetables as a collective category, the edible roots, leaves and pods like carrots, cabbage and beans that are cooked or eaten raw (das Gemüse, plural Gemüse)
example: Das Gemüse kommt direkt aus unserem Garten. — The vegetables come straight from our garden.

hindi: आरामदेह — घर जैसा गरम, सुकून भरा
definition: cosy, snug and comfortable in a warm homelike way, used of rooms, evenings and cafés where people feel relaxed and unhurried
example: Die Wohnung ist klein, aber sehr gemütlich. — The flat is small but very cosy.

hindi: सुकून भरा अपनापन — गर्मजोशी और इत्मीनान का माहौल
definition: unhurried warmth of a place and company where nobody is anxious and nothing needs finishing
example: Low lamps, a slow conversation, and complete Gemütlichkeit until midnight.

hindi: सटीक — बिल्कुल ठीक, बिना गलती के
definition: exact, precise or accurate, without error, also used as an adverb meaning exactly and as an agreeing reply
example: Die Waage zeigt das genaue Gewicht an. — The scales show the exact weight.

hindi: मंज़ूरी देना — किसी आवेदन को आधिकारिक रूप से स्वीकार करना
definition: to approve or authorise something officially, when an authority grants what an application requested (regular, inseparable: hat genehmigt)
example: Die Stadt hat unseren Bauantrag genehmigt. — The city approved our building application.

hindi: स्वीकृति — किसी काम के लिए दफ़्तर की आधिकारिक मंज़ूरी
definition: an official approval or permit granted by an authority allowing you to do something, such as build, park or hold an event (die Genehmigung, plural Genehmigungen)
example: Für den Umbau brauchen wir eine Genehmigung der Stadt. — For the renovation we need a permit from the city.

hindi: पीढ़ी — लगभग एक ही समय जन्मे लोगों का समूह
definition: the generation, all the people born around the same time, or one level of a family line (die Generation, plural Generationen)
example: Drei Generationen wohnen unter einem Dach. — Three generations live under one roof.

hindi: चिढ़ा हुआ — उकताहट भरी झुंझलाहट (बोलचाल)
definition: irritated or fed up, colloquial for being worn down by something tiresome or annoying
example: Ich bin total genervt von dem Lärm. — I am totally fed up with the noise.

hindi: प्रतिभाशाली — बेहद चतुर, कमाल का; बोलचाल में ज़बरदस्त
definition: brilliant, ingenious, inspired; praise for a clever idea or, colloquially, anything really great
example: Die Idee mit dem Fahrrad ist genial. — The idea with the bicycle is brilliant.

hindi: आनंद लेना — किसी चीज़ का रस लेकर मज़ा उठाना
definition: to enjoy or savour something with real pleasure and attention, from a good meal to a sunny afternoon (irregular: genießt, genoss, hat genossen; + Akkusativ)
example: Wir genießen die Sonne auf dem Balkon. — We are enjoying the sun on the balcony.

hindi: काफ़ी — ज़रूरत भर की मात्रा में
definition: enough, describing a quantity or degree that is sufficient for a purpose, placed after an adjective and before or after a noun
example: Haben wir genug Brot für alle? — Do we have enough bread for everyone?

hindi: आनंद — किसी चीज़ का स्वाद लेकर मज़ा उठाना
definition: enjoyment or pleasure taken in food, drink or an experience, savoured consciously (der Genuss, plural Genüsse)
example: Ein Stück Kuchen ist ein kleiner Genuss. — A slice of cake is a small pleasure.

hindi: पर्याप्त — जितना चाहिए उतना
definition: enough or sufficient in amount to meet a need, describing adequate time, money, space and supplies
example: Haben wir genügend Stühle? — Do we have enough chairs?

hindi: सामान — यात्रा में साथ ले जाए जाने वाले थैले और संदूक
definition: luggage or baggage, the suitcases and bags that a traveller carries along on a journey (das Gepäck, no plural)
example: Mein Gepäck ist am Flughafen verloren gegangen. — My luggage got lost at the airport.

hindi: सीधा — बिना मोड़ या झुकाव का, या अभी-अभी
definition: straight, without bends or curves, upright and level, also used as an adverb meaning right now or just this moment
example: Die Straße ist lang und gerade. — The road is long and straight.

hindi: सीधे — बिना मुड़े उसी दिशा में आगे
definition: straight ahead, continuing in the same direction without turning, the essential word when giving street directions (adverb)
example: Gehen Sie immer geradeaus bis zur Kirche. — Keep going straight ahead until the church.

hindi: न्यायपूर्ण — सबके साथ समान और उचित व्यवहार करने वाला
definition: just or fair, treating everyone equally and giving each person what they rightly deserve
example: Die Strafe war gerecht. — The punishment was just.

hindi: न्याय — जो उचित है उसके अनुसार निष्पक्ष व्यवहार
definition: justice, fairness in the treatment of people according to what is right and lawful (die Gerechtigkeit, no plural)
example: Die Gerechtigkeit hat am Ende doch gesiegt. — Justice won in the end after all.

hindi: चिड़चिड़ा — ज़रा-सी बात पर भड़कने को तैयार
definition: irritable and edgy, quick to snap because nerves are already frayed
example: Er reagierte gereizt auf die Frage. — He reacted irritably to the question.

hindi: व्यंजन — भोजन में परोसा जाने वाला एक पका हुआ खाना
definition: a dish, one prepared item of food served as part of a meal in a restaurant or at home (das Gericht, plural Gerichte)
example: Dieses Gericht ist die Spezialität des Hauses. — This dish is the speciality of the house.

hindi: अल्प — मात्रा, मूल्य या महत्व में थोड़ा
definition: small or slight in amount, degree or importance, a slightly formal word used for quantities, costs and chances rather than objects
example: Die Kosten sind gering. — The costs are small.

hindi: ख़ुशी से — मन से, चाव से; जो काम करना अच्छा लगे
definition: gladly, with pleasure; placed after a verb to show that someone likes doing that activity or willingly agrees to something
example: Ich trinke gern Kaffee am Morgen. — I like drinking coffee in the morning.

hindi: ख़ुशी से किया — धन्यवाद का सहज जवाब
definition: the friendly reply to thanks, saying the favour was done gladly and needs no gratitude
example: Gern geschehen, das war doch keine Mühe. — You are welcome, it was no trouble.

hindi: अच्छा लगना — किसी व्यक्ति को पसंद करना और उसकी संगत चाहना
definition: to like someone, to enjoy their company and feel affection without the weight of romantic love (separable: hat gern, hat gerngehabt)
example: Ich habe meine Kollegen wirklich gern. — I really like my colleagues.

hindi: गंध, महक — नाक से महसूस होने वाली बू
definition: a smell or odour of any kind, pleasant or not, and also the sense of smell itself (der Geruch, plural Gerüche)
example: Der Geruch von Kaffee weckt mich morgens. — The smell of coffee wakes me in the morning.

hindi: घ्राण शक्ति — नाक से सूँघने की क्षमता
definition: the sense of smell, the ability of the nose to perceive odours, scents and aromas around oneself (der Geruchssinn, no plural)
example: Bei einer Erkältung leidet der Geruchssinn. — The sense of smell suffers during a cold.

hindi: उपकरण — कोई भी यंत्र या मशीन, ख़ासकर बिजली से चलने वाला
definition: a device or appliance, any electronic or mechanical piece of equipment such as a phone, computer, printer or kitchen machine (das Gerät, plural Geräte)
example: Bitte schalten Sie das Gerät jetzt aus. — Please switch off the device now.

hindi: विशाल — काफ़ी जगह और खुलेपन वाला
definition: spacious and roomy, having plenty of space inside so that a home or vehicle feels open and large
example: Die neue Wohnung ist hell und geräumig. — The new apartment is bright and spacious.

hindi: आवाज़, आहट — कोई भी सुनाई देने वाली ध्वनि
definition: a noise or sound of any kind that the ears perceive, often one whose source is unclear (das Geräusch, plural Geräusche)
example: Was war das für ein seltsames Geräusch? — What was that strange noise?

hindi: अफ़वाह — बिना पक्की जानकारी के फैली हुई बात
definition: a rumour, the unconfirmed story about someone that spreads by word of mouth or through the media (das Gerücht, plural Gerüchte)
example: Das Gerücht über die Trennung stimmt nicht. — The rumour about the separation is not true.

hindi: पाड़ — इमारत के चारों ओर खड़ा अस्थायी ढाँचा जिस पर मज़दूर खड़े होते हैं
definition: scaffolding, the temporary framework of poles and planks that workers stand on around a building (das Gerüst, plural Gerüste)
example: Das Gerüst steht seit einer Woche am Haus. — The scaffolding has stood at the house for a week.

hindi: कुल — सब मिलाकर, समूचा
definition: total or entire including every part, used before nouns for whole amounts, complete works and entire regions
example: Die gesamte Familie kam zum Fest. — The entire family came to the party.

hindi: समग्र स्कूल — सभी धाराओं के छात्रों को एक ही छत के नीचे पढ़ाने वाला स्कूल
definition: a comprehensive secondary school that keeps pupils of all ability levels together under one roof instead of splitting them into separate school types (die Gesamtschule, plural Gesamtschulen)
example: In unserer Stadt gibt es eine neue Gesamtschule. — There is a new comprehensive school in our town.

hindi: घटना — कोई घटना घटित होना
definition: to happen or occur, said of events that take place, somewhat more formal than passieren (irregular: geschieht, geschah, ist geschehen)
example: Was ist hier geschehen? — What has happened here?

hindi: उपहार — त्योहार या जन्मदिन पर दी जाने वाली भेंट
definition: a present, a gift wrapped and given at Christmas, a birthday or another celebration (das Geschenk, plural Geschenke)
example: Das Geschenk liegt schon unter dem Baum. — The present is already lying under the tree.

hindi: कहानी — सुनाई या लिखी गई घटनाओं की कथा; इतिहास भी
definition: a story or tale told or written about connected events, and also the word for history as a subject (die Geschichte, plural Geschichten)
example: Oma erzählt uns jeden Abend eine Geschichte. — Grandma tells us a story every evening.

hindi: इतिहास-संबंधी — इतिहास के क्रम या दृष्टि से जुड़ा
definition: historical, relating to history and its development over time, seen from a historian's angle
example: Das Buch erklärt die geschichtlichen Hintergründe der Teilung. — The book explains the historical background of the division.

hindi: तलाक़शुदा — जिसका विवाह क़ानूनन टूट चुका है
definition: divorced, describing a person whose marriage has been legally ended by a court and who is free to marry again
example: Meine Eltern sind geschieden. — My parents are divorced.

hindi: बर्तन — खाने-पीने में काम आने वाली प्लेटें, कटोरियाँ और प्याले
definition: crockery or dishes, the plates, bowls, cups and serving pieces used for eating and drinking at home (das Geschirr, no plural)
example: Das schmutzige Geschirr steht noch in der Spüle. — The dirty dishes are still in the sink.

hindi: बर्तन धोने की मशीन — प्लेट और बर्तन अपने आप धोने वाली मशीन
definition: a dishwasher, the kitchen machine that washes plates, glasses and cutlery automatically after a meal (der Geschirrspüler, plural Geschirrspüler)
example: Räumst du bitte den Geschirrspüler aus? — Will you please empty the dishwasher?

hindi: बर्तन पोंछने का कपड़ा — धुले बर्तन सुखाने का सूती तौलिया
definition: a tea towel, the cotton cloth used in the kitchen to dry washed dishes, glasses and cutlery (das Geschirrtuch, plural Geschirrtücher)
example: Das Geschirrtuch hängt am Haken neben dem Herd. — The tea towel hangs on the hook next to the stove.

hindi: बंद — ताला या दरवाज़ा लगा हुआ
definition: closed or shut, not open for business or entry, locked up, also meaning united or unanimous as a group
example: Sonntags ist der Laden geschlossen. — The shop is closed on Sundays.

hindi: स्वाद, रुचि — ज़ुबान का अनुभव या पसंद
definition: the taste or flavour of food, and also a person's taste in clothes, music or style (der Geschmack, plural Geschmäcke, colloquially Geschmäcker)
example: Der Geschmack der Erdbeeren ist herrlich. — The taste of the strawberries is glorious.

hindi: गति सीमा — सड़क पर अधिकतम अनुमत रफ़्तार
definition: a speed limit, the maximum speed that vehicles are legally allowed on a stretch of road (die Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung, plural Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzungen)
example: Hier gilt eine Geschwindigkeitsbegrenzung von fünfzig. — A speed limit of fifty applies here.

hindi: भाई-बहन — एक ही माता-पिता की सारी संतानें
definition: the siblings, brothers and sisters of the same parents spoken of together as a group (die Geschwister, plural only)
example: Meine Geschwister wohnen alle in der Nähe. — My siblings all live nearby.

hindi: दुकान — जहाँ सामान बेचा जाता है, व्यापार भी
definition: a shop or store where goods are sold to customers, also a business deal or transaction in commercial talk (das Geschäft, plural Geschäfte)
example: Das Geschäft öffnet um neun Uhr. — The shop opens at nine o'clock.

hindi: प्रबंध निदेशक — कंपनी चलाने वाला सबसे ऊपर का अधिकारी
definition: the managing director or chief executive who runs a company day to day and legally represents it (der Geschäftsführer, plural Geschäftsführer)
example: Der Geschäftsführer eröffnet die Sitzung. — The managing director opens the meeting.

hindi: मिलनसार — लोगों की संगत और महफ़िल पसंद करने वाला
definition: sociable and convivial, enjoying company and gatherings, happiest among other people
example: Meine Tante ist ein geselliger Mensch. — My aunt is a sociable person.

hindi: समाज — साथ रहने वाले लोगों का समुदाय; कंपनी भी
definition: society, the community of people living together under shared rules, and also a company or club (die Gesellschaft, plural Gesellschaften)
example: Unsere Gesellschaft wird immer älter. — Our society is getting older and older.

hindi: सामूहिक खेल — कई लोगों का मेज़ पर खेला जाने वाला खेल
definition: a parlour game, a board or card game played together by a group of friends or family (das Gesellschaftsspiel, plural Gesellschaftsspiele)
example: Zum Geburtstag gab es ein Gesellschaftsspiel. — There was a parlour game for the birthday.

hindi: क़ानून — संसद द्वारा पारित नियम जिसका पालन सबको करना होता है
definition: a statute passed by parliament, a legal rule that everyone in the country must obey (das Gesetz, plural Gesetze)
example: Das neue Gesetz gilt ab Januar. — The new law applies from January.

hindi: चेहरा — सिर का अगला हिस्सा जिसमें आँखें, नाक और मुँह होते हैं
definition: the face, the front part of the head with the eyes, nose, mouth and cheeks (das Gesicht, plural Gesichter)
example: Ihr Gesicht wurde rot vor Freude. — Her face turned red with joy.

hindi: दृष्टिकोण — किसी विषय को देखने का एक पहलू
definition: a point of view or aspect, one angle from which a question can be considered and weighed (der Gesichtspunkt, plural Gesichtspunkte)
example: Unter diesem Gesichtspunkt sieht die Sache anders aus. — From this point of view the matter looks different.

hindi: उत्सुक — बेसब्री से इंतज़ार में
definition: eager and curious in suspense, waiting excitedly and impatiently to learn what will happen or how something ends (gespannt auf + Akkusativ)
example: Ich bin gespannt auf deine Antwort. — I am eager to hear your answer.

hindi: समग्राकृति — अंगों में न मिलने वाला संपूर्ण रूप
definition: an organized whole whose character cannot be recovered by examining its separated parts one by one
example: The melody is a Gestalt; play the notes in isolation and it disappears.

hindi: रूप देना, डिज़ाइन करना — किसी चीज़ को सोच-समझकर आकार देना
definition: to design, shape or arrange something creatively, such as a poster, a garden, an evening or one's own life (regular: hat gestaltet)
example: Wir gestalten den Garten ganz neu. — We are redesigning the garden completely.

hindi: बदबू, दुर्गंध — बुरी लगने वाली गंध
definition: a stench or foul stink, an unpleasant smell strong enough to disgust (der Gestank, no plural)
example: Der Gestank aus dem Keller ist furchtbar. — The stench from the cellar is terrible.

hindi: क़बूल करना — अपना अपराध या ग़लती मान लेना
definition: to confess or admit a crime, guilt or an uncomfortable truth, usually after denying or hiding it first (gestand, hat gestanden)
example: Der Täter hat den Einbruch gestanden. — The perpetrator confessed to the burglary.

hindi: कल (बीता हुआ) — आज से पहले वाला दिन
definition: yesterday, on the calendar day that came immediately before today, used for recent past events
