example: Gestern hat es den ganzen Tag geregnet. — Yesterday it rained the whole day.

hindi: धारीदार — समानांतर धारियों वाला
definition: striped, having a pattern of parallel lines of different colours on the fabric
example: Ich nehme das gestreifte Hemd. — I will take the striped shirt.

hindi: तनाव में — काम या दबाव से परेशान
definition: stressed and under pressure, overloaded by work or deadlines and unable to relax
example: Vor der Abgabe war sie sehr gestresst. — Before the deadline she was very stressed.

hindi: अर्ज़ी — प्राधिकरण को दी गई औपचारिक लिखित प्रार्थना
definition: a formal written request or petition addressed to an authority, formal register and common in Switzerland (das Gesuch, plural Gesuche)
example: Sie hat ein Gesuch um Fristverlängerung eingereicht. — She submitted a request for an extension of the deadline.

hindi: स्वस्थ — निरोग, तंदुरुस्त
definition: healthy or well, free from illness and in good bodily condition; also wholesome, said of food (gesünder, am gesündesten)
example: Obst ist gesund. — Fruit is healthy.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य — शरीर और मन का स्वस्थ होना; छींक पर कहा जाने वाला शब्द
definition: health, the state of being well in body and mind; also the word said to someone who has just sneezed (die Gesundheit, no plural)
example: Die Gesundheit ist wichtiger als Geld. — Health is more important than money.

hindi: अनाज — गेहूँ, राई, जौ जैसे दाने
definition: cereal grain, the collective word for wheat, rye, barley and oats grown as crops and milled into flour (das Getreide, plural Getreide)
example: Das Getreide wird im August geerntet. — The grain is harvested in August.

hindi: अलग-अलग — मेज़ पर हर मेहमान का अपना-अपना हिसाब चुकाना
definition: separately, used when each guest at the table pays only for their own food and drink instead of one shared bill
example: Wir zahlen getrennt, jeder für sich. — We pay separately, each for themselves.

hindi: अलग-अलग भुगतान — हर कोई अपना बिल ख़ुद देता है
definition: to pay separately at a restaurant, each guest settling their own share with the waiter, the normal way friends split a bill in Germany
example: Wir zahlen heute getrennt, bitte. — We are paying separately today, please.

hindi: पेय — पानी, रस, कॉफ़ी जैसा पीने योग्य कोई भी तरल
definition: a drink or beverage, any liquid such as water, juice, coffee or beer that you order to drink (das Getränk, plural Getränke)
example: Möchten Sie schon ein Getränk bestellen? — Would you like to order a drink already?

hindi: पेय-सूची — रेस्तराँ में मिलने वाले पेयों और उनके दामों की अलग सूची
definition: the drinks menu, the separate list of beverages and their prices in a restaurant or café (die Getränkekarte, plural Getränkekarten)
example: Die Getränkekarte liegt schon auf dem Tisch. — The drinks menu is already on the table.

hindi: प्रचंड — विशाल और ज़ोरदार, प्रभावशाली ढंग से बड़ा
definition: enormous or immense in size, force or extent, suggesting something powerful and impressive that overwhelms the viewer
example: Der Berg ist gewaltig. — The mountain is immense.

hindi: मज़दूर संघ — वेतन और काम की शर्तों की रक्षा करने वाला श्रमिक संगठन
definition: a trade union, an organisation of workers that defends their wages and working conditions (die Gewerkschaft, plural Gewerkschaften)
example: Die Gewerkschaft fordert mehr Lohn. — The trade union is demanding higher wages.

hindi: वज़न — किसी चीज़ का भार
definition: weight, how heavy a person, parcel or object is when measured on a scale, also used figuratively for importance (das Gewicht, plural Gewichte)
example: Das Gewicht des Pakets beträgt drei Kilo. — The weight of the parcel is three kilos.

hindi: मुनाफ़ा — ख़र्च निकालने के बाद बची कमाई; इनाम या जीत
definition: the profit that remains from business revenue after all costs have been paid, also a prize or winnings in a game or lottery (der Gewinn, plural Gewinne)
example: Die Firma macht dieses Jahr endlich einen Gewinn. — The company is finally making a profit this year.

hindi: जीतना — मुक़ाबले या खेल में विजयी होना
definition: to win, to come first or defeat the opponent in a match, competition, game or election (gewinnt, hat gewonnen)
example: Wir haben drei zu null gewonnen. — We won three nil.

hindi: अंतरात्मा — सही-गलत बताने वाली भीतरी आवाज़
definition: the conscience, the inner sense that tells a person whether their actions are morally right or wrong (das Gewissen, plural Gewissen)
example: Ich habe ein schlechtes Gewissen. — I have a guilty conscience.

hindi: कर्तव्यनिष्ठ — हर काम ईमानदारी और पूरी सावधानी से करने वाला
definition: conscientious and scrupulous, doing work carefully and thoroughly because one feels responsible for getting it right
example: Sie prüft jede Rechnung gewissenhaft. — She checks every invoice conscientiously.

hindi: एक तरह से — बात को कुछ हद तक सच मानने वाला शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning in a way or to some extent that qualifies a statement as true only from a certain angle
example: Das war gewissermaßen ein Neuanfang. — That was, in a sense, a fresh start.

hindi: आँधी-तूफ़ान — बिजली और गरज के साथ बारिश
definition: a thunderstorm, a storm with lightning flashes, rolling thunder and usually heavy rain (das Gewitter, plural Gewitter)
example: Heute Abend zieht ein Gewitter auf. — A thunderstorm is brewing this evening.

hindi: आदत — बिना सोचे बार-बार किया जाने वाला काम
definition: a habit, something a person does regularly and almost automatically without thinking about it (die Gewohnheit, plural Gewohnheiten)
example: Das Rauchen war eine schlechte Gewohnheit. — Smoking was a bad habit.

hindi: शीशाघर — नाज़ुक पौधों के लिए काँच का गर्म घर
definition: a greenhouse, the glass building where tender plants are grown in warmth and shelter (das Gewächshaus, plural Gewächshäuser)
example: Im Gewächshaus reifen die Tomaten früher. — In the greenhouse the tomatoes ripen earlier.

hindi: मसाला — खाने में स्वाद और ख़ुशबू के लिए डाला जाने वाला सूखा पदार्थ
definition: a spice or seasoning, the dried plant substance added in small amounts to give food flavour and aroma (das Gewürz, plural Gewürze)
example: Dieses Gewürz macht das Curry scharf. — This spice makes the curry hot.

hindi: पानी देना — पौधों को सींचना या तरल उँडेलना
definition: to water plants or to pour a liquid, especially giving garden flowers their daily drink (irregular: gießt, hat gegossen)
example: Kannst du im Urlaub meine Blumen gießen? — Can you water my flowers during the holiday?

hindi: झारी — पौधों को पानी देने का टोंटीदार बर्तन
definition: a watering can, the container with a long spout used to water garden plants by hand (die Gießkanne, plural Gießkannen)
example: Die Gießkanne steht neben dem Beet. — The watering can stands beside the bed.

hindi: ज़हर — शरीर को हानि पहुँचाने वाला विषैला पदार्थ, उपहार नहीं
definition: poison, a toxic substance that harms or kills living things, a notorious false friend because it never means a present (das Gift, plural Gifte)
example: Das Gift der Schlange wirkt sehr schnell. — The snake's poison works very quickly.

hindi: ज़हरीला — जो शरीर या प्रकृति को नुक़सान पहुँचाए
definition: poisonous or toxic, describing a substance that harms living things when eaten, breathed or touched
example: Diese Chemikalie ist giftig für Fische. — This chemical is toxic for fish.

hindi: दैत्याकार — अकल्पनीय रूप से विशाल
definition: gigantic or colossal in size, larger than one can easily imagine, often used with a tone of amazement
example: Das Stadion ist gigantisch. — The stadium is gigantic.

hindi: चोटी — पहाड़ का सबसे ऊँचा सिरा
definition: a summit or peak, the highest point of a mountain that climbers aim to reach (der Gipfel, plural Gipfel)
example: Nach vier Stunden erreichen wir den Gipfel. — After four hours we reach the summit.

hindi: अर्धचंद्र पेस्ट्री — मक्खन से बनी परतदार नाश्ते की मिठाई
definition: a croissant, the crescent-shaped flaky breakfast pastry, the Swiss diminutive word where Germany says Croissant or Hörnchen (das Gipfeli, plural Gipfeli)
example: Das Gipfeli ist noch warm vom Ofen. — The croissant is still warm from the oven.

hindi: चालू खाता — वेतन, रोज़मर्रा भुगतान और बिल कटौती वाला बैंक खाता
definition: a current account, the everyday bank account used for salary, payments and direct debits (das Girokonto, plural Girokonten)
example: Mein Gehalt kommt jeden Monat auf mein Girokonto. — My salary goes into my current account every month.

hindi: तार वाद्य — उँगलियों से छेड़ा जाने वाला छह तारों का बाजा
definition: a guitar, the stringed instrument with a long neck that is plucked or strummed with the fingers or a pick (die Gitarre, plural Gitarren)
example: Am Lagerfeuer holt er die Gitarre heraus. — By the campfire he brings out the guitar.

hindi: आइसक्रीम — जमी हुई मीठी मलाईदार मिठाई, स्विस शब्द
definition: ice cream, the frozen sweet dairy dessert sold by the scoop in summer, the Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Eis (die Glace, plural Glacen)
example: Die Kinder wollen nach dem Schwimmen eine Glace. — The children want an ice cream after swimming.

hindi: काँच का गिलास — पारदर्शी पात्र जिसमें पानी या रस पीते हैं; काँच
definition: a glass, the transparent drinking vessel for water, juice or wine, and also the material itself (das Glas, plural Gläser)
example: Bitte ein Glas Wasser. — A glass of water, please.

hindi: चिकना, फिसलन भरा — बिना खुरदुरेपन का समतल तल
definition: smooth or slippery, having an even surface with no roughness or bumps, describing polished wood, ice, skin or straight hair
example: Vorsicht, die Straße ist glatt! — Careful, the road is slippery!

hindi: फिसलन भरी बर्फ़ — सड़क पर जमी चिकनी बर्फ़
definition: black ice, a thin slippery layer of ice on roads and pavements that causes falls and accidents (das Glatteis, no plural)
example: Das Glatteis macht die Straßen heute gefährlich. — The black ice makes the roads dangerous today.

hindi: आस्था — ईश्वर या धर्म पर भरोसा, विश्वास
definition: faith or belief, trust in a religion, in a higher power or firmly in something without proof (der Glaube, no plural)
example: Ihr Glaube gibt ihr Kraft in schweren Zeiten. — Her faith gives her strength in hard times.

hindi: विश्वास करना — किसी बात या ईश्वर को सच मानना
definition: to believe, to hold something to be true or to have religious faith in a higher power (an + Akkusativ for believing in, + Dativ for believing a person; regular)
example: Ich glaube an Gott. — I believe in God.

hindi: किसी में विश्वास रखना — किसी बात के होने या किसी की क़ाबिलियत पर आस्था
definition: to believe in something or somebody, having faith that they exist or will succeed (an + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Die Trainerin glaubt fest an ihre Mannschaft. — The coach firmly believes in her team.

hindi: अभी-अभी — कुछ ही क्षणों में; बराबर या समान भी
definition: in a moment, right away, very soon, and as an adjective meaning equal or the same
example: Ich bin gleich fertig. — I will be ready in a moment.

hindi: समानता — समान अधिकार और दर्जा होने की स्थिति
definition: equality, the condition in which all people have the same rights and status before the state (die Gleichheit, no plural)
example: Die Gleichheit vor dem Gesetz gilt für alle. — Equality before the law applies to everyone.

hindi: समीकरण — बराबरी के चिह्न से जुड़ा गणितीय कथन
definition: an equation, a mathematical statement that two expressions have the same value, usually containing an unknown quantity to be found (die Gleichung, plural Gleichungen)
example: Wir müssen die Gleichung nach x auflösen. — We have to solve the equation for x.

hindi: रेल की पटरी — स्टेशन पर वह क्रमांक वाली पटरी जहाँ गाड़ी रुकती है
definition: a railway track at a station, the numbered line where a train stops and passengers board (das Gleis, plural Gleise)
example: Der Zug nach Berlin steht schon auf dem Gleis. — The train to Berlin is already standing on the track.

hindi: सरकना — बिना रुकावट हल्के से आगे बढ़ना
definition: to glide smoothly and silently along, through water or air or over a surface (irregular: glitt, ist geglitten)
example: Das Boot gleitet ruhig über den See. — The boat glides calmly across the lake.

hindi: लचीला समय — काम शुरू और ख़त्म करने का समय खुद चुनने की सुविधा
definition: flexitime, a working arrangement where employees choose their own start and finish times within limits (die Gleitzeit, no plural)
example: Dank Gleitzeit komme ich erst um zehn. — Thanks to flexitime I only arrive at ten.

hindi: हिमनद — पहाड़ पर धीरे खिसकती बर्फ़ की नदी
definition: a glacier, a huge slow-moving mass of ice creeping down a mountain valley (der Gletscher, plural Gletscher)
example: Der Gletscher schmilzt jedes Jahr weiter. — The glacier melts further every year.

hindi: घंटियों का वाद्य — धातु की पट्टियों या घंटियों पर हथौड़ी से बजाया जाने वाला वाद्य
definition: a percussion instrument of tuned metal bars or bells struck with small hammers, also the chiming bells of a tower clock (das Glockenspiel, plural Glockenspiele)
example: Um zwölf Uhr spielt das Glockenspiel am Rathaus. — At noon the carillon on the town hall plays.

hindi: बुद्धू बक्सा — बोलचाल में दूरदर्शन का यंत्र
definition: the telly or goggle-box, a colloquial and mildly disparaging word for a television set that people stare at for hours (die Glotze, plural Glotzen)
example: Er sitzt den ganzen Abend vor der Glotze. — He sits in front of the telly all evening.

hindi: टुकुर-टुकुर देखना — बेवकूफ़ की तरह घूरना
definition: to gawk or gape stupidly at something, a colloquial and slightly rude word for staring, also for watching television (regular)
example: Glotz nicht so, das ist unhöflich! — Stop gawking, that is rude!

hindi: चमकदार — रोशनी लौटाने वाला चमकीला तल, या शानदार
definition: shiny or glossy, having a bright surface that reflects light, describing polished metal, wet stones and silk, also meaning brilliant
example: Sie hat glänzende schwarze Haare. — She has shiny black hair.

hindi: आस्थावान — धर्म में विश्वास रखने वाला
definition: believing, devout, having religious faith and practising a religion sincerely in daily life
example: Meine Großmutter ist sehr gläubig. — My grandmother is very devout.

hindi: सुख या सौभाग्य — गहरी तृप्ति की अवस्था, साथ ही अच्छी किस्मत
definition: happiness or good fortune, the deep contented state of being well and also plain luck that favours someone (das Glück, no plural)
example: Das Glück war an diesem Abend auf unserer Seite. — Luck was on our side that evening.

hindi: ख़ुश — गहरी प्रसन्नता और संतोष से भरा
definition: happy, feeling deep joy and contentment, also lucky or fortunate in how something turned out
example: Sie ist mit ihrem neuen Job sehr glücklich. — She is very happy with her new job.

hindi: सौभाग्यवश — किस्मत अच्छी थी कि
definition: fortunately, luckily; a slightly more formal adverb expressing relief that circumstances turned out well in the end
example: Glücklicherweise war der Arzt noch da. — Fortunately the doctor was still there.

hindi: भाग्यशाली व्यक्ति — जिसे बार-बार अच्छी किस्मत मिलती हो
definition: a lucky person to whom good fortune keeps happening, literally a lucky mushroom (der Glückspilz, plural Glückspilze)
example: Du bist ein echter Glückspilz, schon wieder im Lotto gewonnen! — You are a real lucky devil, you won the lottery again!

hindi: बधाई — शुभकामना का संदेश
definition: a congratulation, the good wishes offered to someone on a birthday, wedding or achievement (der Glückwunsch, plural Glückwünsche)
example: Herzlichen Glückwunsch zur bestandenen Prüfung! — Congratulations on passing the exam!

hindi: बिजली का लट्टू — लैंप में लगने वाला रोशनी देने वाला काँच का गोला
definition: a light bulb, the glass bulb screwed into a lamp or ceiling fitting to give electric light (die Glühbirne, plural Glühbirnen)
example: Die Glühbirne im Flur muss gewechselt werden. — The light bulb in the hallway needs changing.

hindi: मसालेदार गर्म शराब — दालचीनी-लौंग के साथ गर्म की हुई लाल वाइन
definition: mulled wine, heated red wine sweetened and spiced with cinnamon and cloves, the classic warming drink at every Christmas market (der Glühwein, plural Glühweine)
example: Ein heißer Glühwein wärmt die kalten Hände. — A hot mulled wine warms cold hands.

hindi: कृपा — बिना हक़ के मिलने वाली दया या माफ़ी
definition: grace or mercy, undeserved kindness and pardon granted by God or by someone in power over another (die Gnade, plural Gnaden)
example: Die Gnade des Königs rettete den Gefangenen. — The king's mercy saved the prisoner.

hindi: सोना — पीली चमकदार कीमती धातु, गहनों की
definition: gold, the precious shiny yellow metal used for jewellery, coins and the first prize medal (das Gold, no plural)
example: Der Ring ist aus reinem Gold. — The ring is made of pure gold.

hindi: इंटरनेट पर खोजना — सर्च इंजन से ढूँढना
definition: to search for information on the internet using a search engine, the everyday verb written in lowercase (regular: hat gegoogelt)
example: Ich google schnell die Öffnungszeiten. — I will quickly google the opening hours.

hindi: ईश्वर — सृष्टि का रचयिता, परमात्मा
definition: the supreme divine being worshipped as God in monotheistic religions, or one deity among many gods (der Gott, plural Götter)
example: Sie dankte Gott für die Hilfe. — She thanked God for the help.

hindi: भगवान का शुक्र है — राहत जताने का वाक्य
definition: thank God, the everyday exclamation of relief when something feared did not happen or something turned out well
example: Gott sei Dank ist nichts passiert! — Thank God nothing happened!

hindi: पूजा-सभा — गिरजाघर में सामूहिक प्रार्थना का आयोजन
definition: a church service, the public gathering for worship with hymns, readings, prayer and sermon, usually on Sunday (der Gottesdienst, plural Gottesdienste)
example: Der Gottesdienst beginnt um zehn Uhr. — The church service begins at ten o'clock.

hindi: क़ब्र — ज़मीन में वह जगह जहाँ मृतक दफ़न है
definition: a grave, the place in the ground where a dead person lies buried (das Grab, plural Gräber)
example: Auf dem Grab liegen frische Blumen. — There are fresh flowers on the grave.

hindi: समाधि-पत्थर — क़ब्र पर लगा नाम और तारीख़ वाला पत्थर
definition: a gravestone or headstone bearing the name and dates of the person buried beneath (der Grabstein, plural Grabsteine)
example: Auf dem Grabstein steht nur ihr Name. — Only her name is on the gravestone.

hindi: डिग्री — तापमान नापने की इकाई
definition: a degree, the unit for measuring temperature on a thermometer, unchanged in the plural after numbers (der Grad, plural Grad)
example: Heute zeigt das Thermometer nur einen Grad über null. — Today the thermometer shows only one degree above zero.

hindi: ग्राम — भार की छोटी इकाई
definition: a gram, the small unit of weight used in recipes and at the delicatessen counter for cheese, meat and spices (das Gramm, plural Gramm)
example: Ein Gramm Salz mehr macht keinen Unterschied. — One gram more of salt makes no difference.

hindi: खीज भरा मूड — बिना खास वजह की चिड़चिड़ाहट, ऑस्ट्रियाई शब्द
definition: a sour grumpy mood of irritation and bad temper, the Austrian and Bavarian word for the sulky state its owner rarely explains (der Grant, no plural)
example: Lass ihn, er hat heute einen Grant. — Leave him, he is in a foul mood today.

hindi: चिड़चिड़ा — खीजा हुआ और बुरे मूड में
definition: grumpy, irritable and in a bad temper, the Austrian and Bavarian adjective for someone showing their sour mood
example: Ohne Kaffee bin ich in der Früh grantig. — Without coffee I am grumpy in the morning.

hindi: घास — ज़मीन ढकने वाली हरी पतली पत्तियाँ
definition: grass, the common green plant with narrow blades that covers lawns, meadows and pastures (das Gras, plural Gräser)
example: Das Gras ist noch nass vom Regen. — The grass is still damp from the rain.

hindi: बधाई देना — जन्मदिन या सफलता पर शुभकामना कहना
definition: to congratulate someone, to offer good wishes on a birthday, a wedding, an exam passed or another success (regular, + Dativ; zu + Dativ)
example: Ich gratuliere dir zum Geburtstag. — I congratulate you on your birthday.

hindi: किसी बात पर बधाई देना — जन्मदिन या सफलता पर शुभकामना कहना
definition: to congratulate somebody on a birthday, success, wedding or other happy event (+ Dativ, zu + Dativ, regular)
example: Ich gratuliere dir herzlich zum Geburtstag! — I congratulate you warmly on your birthday!

hindi: स्लेटी — राख और बादलों का रंग, काले और सफ़ेद के बीच
definition: grey, the neutral colour between black and white, the colour of ash, rain clouds and older hair
example: Der Himmel ist grau und es regnet. — The sky is grey and it is raining.

hindi: रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाला — बेहद डरावना या बुरा
definition: horrific, gruesome, dreadful; disapproval of something that causes horror or is of appalling quality
example: Der Film war grauenhaft, wir sind früher gegangen. — The film was dreadful, we left early.

hindi: पकड़ना — हाथ बढ़ाकर किसी चीज़ को थाम लेना
definition: to grab or reach for something with the hand, closing the fingers around it, often quickly (griff, hat gegriffen, nach + Dativ)
example: Sie griff nach ihrer Tasche und lief los. — She grabbed her bag and ran off.

hindi: चटख, चौंधियाने वाला — आँखों को चुभने वाला तेज़ रंग या रोशनी
definition: glaring or garish, a light or colour so harsh and bright that it hurts the eyes, also of a shrill sound
example: Das grelle Licht blendet mich. — The glaring light dazzles me.

hindi: सीमा — दो देशों या इलाक़ों को अलग करने वाली रेखा
definition: a border or boundary, the line separating two countries or regions, also a limit in general (die Grenze, plural Grenzen)
example: An der Grenze mussten wir die Pässe zeigen. — At the border we had to show our passports.

hindi: सीमा-स्थिति — मृत्यु या अपराधबोध जैसा निर्णायक क्षण
definition: a limit experience such as death, guilt or suffering that strips away routine and forces real choice
example: Illness turned an ordinary Tuesday into a Grenzsituation he could not delegate.

hindi: सीमा चौकी — सीमा पार करने का निर्धारित स्थान
definition: a border crossing, the official checkpoint on a road or railway where travellers pass from one country into another (der Grenzübergang, plural Grenzübergänge)
example: Am Grenzübergang gab es keine Kontrolle. — There was no inspection at the border crossing.

hindi: मूठ — किसी औज़ार, दरवाज़े या थैले का पकड़ने के लिए बना हिस्सा
definition: the handle of a tool, door, drawer or bag, the part shaped for the hand to grasp and hold (der Griff, plural Griffe)
example: Der Griff der Pfanne ist heiß. — The handle of the pan is hot.

hindi: आँच पर सेंकना — खुली आग या जाली पर मांस, सब्ज़ी भूनना
definition: to grill or barbecue, cooking meat, sausages or vegetables over an open flame or grate, often outdoors (regular: grillt, hat gegrillt)
example: Im Sommer grillen wir oft im Garten. — In summer we often barbecue in the garden.

hindi: अंगीठी पर सेंकना — बाहर कोयले की आग पर मांस या सब्ज़ी भूनना, स्विस शब्द
definition: to grill or barbecue food over an open flame or charcoal outdoors, the Swiss form of the verb where Germany says grillen (regular: grilliert, hat grilliert)
example: Am Wochenende grillieren wir am See. — At the weekend we are barbecuing by the lake.

hindi: मौसमी तेज़ बुख़ार — बदन दर्द और थकान वाली फैलने वाली बीमारी
definition: influenza or the flu, the sharper contagious illness with fever, aching limbs and exhaustion, worse than a simple cold (die Grippe, plural Grippen)
example: Die Grippe hat mich eine Woche ins Bett gezwungen. — The flu forced me into bed for a week.

hindi: मोटा-दरदरा — बारीक नहीं, स्थूल
definition: coarse or rough in texture with large particles, also approximate for estimates and rude for manners
example: Ich brauche grobes Salz. — I need coarse salt.

hindi: बड़ा — आकार, ऊँचाई या मात्रा में सामान्य से अधिक
definition: large or tall in size, height or extent, the everyday basic word for anything bigger than normal, also used for a grown-up person
example: Das Haus ist sehr groß. — The house is very large.

hindi: शानदार — बहुत बढ़िया, भव्य, प्रभावशाली
definition: magnificent, splendid, wonderful; a strong word of admiration for something impressive or brilliantly done
example: Sie hat eine großartige Rede gehalten. — She gave a magnificent speech.

hindi: आँखें फाड़कर देखना — हैरानी से अचरज भरी नज़र से देखना
definition: to open the eyes wide in astonishment, staring in surprise at something unexpected (hat große Augen gemacht)
example: Die Kinder machten große Augen, als der Zauberer kam. — The children stared wide-eyed when the magician came.

hindi: दादा-दादी या नाना-नानी — माता-पिता के माता-पिता
definition: the grandparents, the mother and father of one's own parents spoken of together as one pair, always plural (die Großeltern, plural only)
example: Wir besuchen die Großeltern jeden Sonntag. — We visit the grandparents every Sunday.

hindi: दादी या नानी — माता या पिता की माँ
definition: the grandmother, the mother of one's own mother or father, the formal word beside the everyday Oma (die Großmutter, plural Großmütter)
example: Meine Großmutter backt den besten Apfelkuchen. — My grandmother bakes the best apple cake.

hindi: महानगर — लाख से ऊपर आबादी वाला बड़ा शहर
definition: a large city, formally one with over a hundred thousand inhabitants, with busy traffic and anonymous crowds (die Großstadt, plural Großstädte)
example: Das Leben in der Großstadt ist laut und schnell. — Life in the big city is loud and fast.

hindi: दादा या नाना — माता या पिता के पिता
definition: the grandfather, the father of one's own mother or father, the formal word beside the everyday Opa (der Großvater, plural Großväter)
example: Mein Großvater erzählt gern von früher. — My grandfather likes to tell stories about the old days.

hindi: उदार — खुले दिल से देने वाला; या विशाल
definition: generous and open-handed, giving freely of money or time, also spacious when said of rooms (regular adjective)
example: Mein Onkel ist sehr großzügig mit Geschenken. — My uncle is very generous with presents.

hindi: कारण — किसी बात के होने या करने की वजह
definition: a reason or cause, the explanation why something happens or why someone does something, also the bottom or ground of something (der Grund, plural Gründe)
example: Aus welchem Grund bist du gegangen? — For what reason did you leave?

hindi: मूल क़ानून — जर्मनी का संविधान जो नागरिकों के मौलिक अधिकार तय करता है
definition: a basic fundamental statute, and above all the written German constitution that guarantees citizens their fundamental rights (das Grundgesetz, plural Grundgesetze)
example: Das Grundgesetz schützt die Würde jedes Menschen. — The Basic Law protects the dignity of every person.

hindi: आधार — जिस पर कोई बात या काम टिका हो
definition: a basis or foundation, the underlying facts or principles on which an argument, decision or theory rests (die Grundlage, plural Grundlagen)
example: Auf welcher Grundlage hast du entschieden? — On what basis did you decide?

hindi: प्राथमिक विद्यालय — छह से दस साल के बच्चों की पहली चार कक्षाओं का स्कूल
definition: primary school, the first four school years of compulsory education for children aged six to ten before secondary school (die Grundschule, plural Grundschulen)
example: Meine Tochter geht in die Grundschule. — My daughter attends primary school.

hindi: मूलतः या सिद्धांततः — बुनियादी तौर पर, आम नियम के रूप में
definition: fundamental or in principle, concerning the basic rule that holds generally even if exceptions exist
example: Grundsätzlich bin ich einverstanden, aber die Details fehlen. — In principle I agree, but the details are missing.

hindi: अभिवादन — नमस्ते या पत्र के अंत का शुभकामना-शब्द
definition: a greeting exchanged on meeting, or the regards sent at the close of a letter or message (der Gruß, plural Grüße)
example: Ein herzlicher Gruß an die ganze Familie! — Warm greetings to the whole family!

hindi: नाप/माप — कपड़े या जूते का आकार
definition: the size of clothes or shoes, the measurement number that tells whether a garment will fit (die Größe, plural Größen)
example: Haben Sie diese Jacke in der Größe M? — Do you have this jacket in size M?

hindi: अधिकांशतः — ज़्यादातर हिस्से में, मोटे तौर पर
definition: for the most part or mostly, true for the majority of cases or the largest share of something
example: Die Arbeit ist größtenteils erledigt. — The work is mostly done.

hindi: उधेड़बुन करना — किसी चिंता पर बार-बार सोचते रहना
definition: to brood or mull over something, to keep turning a worry or problem around in the mind (regular: grübelt, hat gegrübelt; über + Akkusativ)
example: Sie grübelt die ganze Nacht über den Fehler. — She broods all night over the mistake.

hindi: स्विस नमस्कार — स्विट्ज़रलैंड का दिन का अभिवादन
definition: the Swiss German daytime greeting spoken to strangers and acquaintances, the local equivalent of Guten Tag
example: Grüezi, haben Sie einen Moment? — Hello, do you have a moment?

hindi: हरा — घास और पत्तों का रंग
definition: green, the colour of fresh grass and leaves, also describing unripe fruit or an inexperienced person
example: Die Ampel ist grün, wir können gehen. — The traffic light is green, we can go.

hindi: पूर्णता से काम करना — जड़ तक जाकर, अधूरा कुछ नहीं
definition: thoroughness pursued as a virtue: the job done completely, checked twice, and never merely adequate
example: His Gründlichkeit turned a two-hour repair into a weekend, and the machine has not failed since.

hindi: नमस्कार — दक्षिण जर्मनी और ऑस्ट्रिया का दिन का पारंपरिक अभिवादन
definition: the traditional daytime greeting of Bavaria and Austria, used instead of Guten Tag in shops and streets there
example: Grüß Gott, was darf es sein? — Hello, what would you like?

hindi: अभिवादन करना — नमस्ते कहना या सलाम भेजना
definition: to greet someone politely when you meet, or to send them your regards through another person or in writing (regular: grüßt, hat gegrüßt; + Akkusativ)
example: Grüß deine Eltern von mir! — Say hello to your parents from me!

hindi: ज़रा देखो — किसी चीज़ की ओर ध्यान दिलाना
definition: look, take a look; a colloquial way to draw attention to something, especially in northern and central Germany
example: Guck mal, da drüben ist ein Reh! — Look, there is a deer over there!

hindi: ताकना, देखना — बोलचाल में नज़र डालना
definition: to look or peek at something with the eyes, the colloquial northern German everyday word for schauen (regular)
example: Wir gucken heute Abend einen Film. — We are watching a film this evening.

hindi: बिस्कुट — छोटी मीठी कुकी, ख़ासकर क्रिसमस पर पकाई जाने वाली, स्विस शब्द
definition: a small sweet biscuit or cookie, especially the home-baked kind made before Christmas, the Swiss word where Germany says Keks or Plätzchen (das Guetzli, plural Guetzli)
example: Die Guetzli für Weihnachten sind schon gebacken. — The Christmas biscuits are already baked.

hindi: रबड़ — खिंचने वाला लचीला पदार्थ, टायरों और रबड़ के लिए
definition: rubber, the stretchy elastic material used for tyres, boots and erasers, also the everyday word for an elastic band (der or das Gummi, plural Gummis)
example: Die Stiefel sind aus Gummi und halten dicht. — The boots are made of rubber and keep the water out.

hindi: भालू-आकार की गोंद-मिठाई — चबाने वाली छोटी फल-स्वाद की मिठाई
definition: a gummy bear, the small chewy fruit-flavoured sweet shaped like a bear that is the most German of all candies (das Gummibärchen, plural Gummibärchen)
example: Eine Tüte Gummibärchen ist schnell leer. — A bag of gummy bears is quickly empty.

hindi: रबर का दस्ताना — सफ़ाई में हाथ बचाने वाला दस्ताना
definition: a rubber glove, the waterproof glove worn to protect the hands while washing dishes or scrubbing with cleaning chemicals (der Gummihandschuh, plural Gummihandschuhe)
example: Zum Putzen ziehe ich immer Gummihandschuhe an. — I always put on rubber gloves for cleaning.

hindi: खीरा — लंबी हरी पानीदार सब्ज़ी, सलाद में या सिरके में डालकर
definition: a cucumber, the long green watery vegetable sliced into salads, or pickled as a gherkin (die Gurke, plural Gurken)
example: Ich schneide eine Gurke für den Salat. — I slice a cucumber for the salad.

hindi: अच्छा — बढ़िया, उत्तम
definition: good in quality, fine, well made or pleasant, the most basic word of approval for food, work, weather and people
example: Das Essen war richtig gut. — The food was really good.

hindi: जल्दी ठीक हो जाओ — बीमार को कही जाने वाली शुभकामना
definition: get well soon, the standard friendly wish for quick recovery said or written to someone sick, unwell or injured
example: Gute Besserung, und ruh dich aus! — Get well soon, and rest!

hindi: सफ़र शुभ हो — गाड़ी से निकलते किसी को दी जाने वाली शुभकामना
definition: the everyday farewell wishing someone a safe and pleasant drive or journey as they leave (fixed phrase)
example: Gute Fahrt und meldet euch, wenn ihr ankommt! — Safe travels, and let us know when you arrive!

hindi: शुभ रात्रि — सोने से पहले की विदा
definition: the farewell spoken at bedtime or when leaving someone late at night, wishing them a peaceful sleep
example: Gute Nacht, schlaf gut! — Good night, sleep well!

hindi: शुभ यात्रा — सफ़र पर निकलते किसी को दी जाने वाली शुभकामना
definition: have a good trip, the standard friendly wish spoken to someone who is setting off on a journey
example: Gute Reise und meldet euch, wenn ihr angekommen seid! — Have a good trip and get in touch when you have arrived!

hindi: शुभ संध्या — शाम के समय का अभिवादन
definition: the polite greeting spoken in the evening hours, from about six o'clock until people part for the night
example: Guten Abend, schön, dass Sie gekommen sind. — Good evening, lovely that you came.

hindi: भोजन का आनंद लें — खाना शुरू करने से पहले कही जाने वाली शुभकामना
definition: enjoy your meal, the polite wish spoken to others before everyone starts eating together
example: Guten Appetit, lasst es euch schmecken! — Enjoy your meal, hope you like it!

hindi: सुप्रभात — सुबह के समय किया जाने वाला अभिवादन
definition: the standard greeting spoken in the morning hours until roughly ten o'clock, polite and used with everyone
example: Guten Morgen, haben Sie gut geschlafen? — Good morning, did you sleep well?

hindi: नया साल शुभ हो — साल के अंत में कही जाने वाली शुभकामना
definition: the everyday wish for a good start into the new year, said in the last days of December before New Year's Eve
example: Guten Rutsch ins neue Jahr! — Have a good start into the new year!

hindi: नमस्कार — दिन के समय का औपचारिक अभिवादन
definition: the neutral formal greeting for the daytime hours, spoken to strangers, shopkeepers and officials alike
example: Guten Tag, ich habe einen Termin um zehn. — Good day, I have an appointment at ten.

hindi: सोने से पहले की कहानी — बच्चे को रात में सुनाई जाने वाली कहानी
definition: a bedtime story read or told to a child at night to settle them down before sleep (die Gutenachtgeschichte, plural Gutenachtgeschichten)
example: Papa liest jeden Abend eine Gutenachtgeschichte vor. — Dad reads a bedtime story every evening.

hindi: जमा शेष — खाते या कार्ड पर उपलब्ध बचा हुआ पैसा
definition: a credit balance, the money available in an account, on a card or in a prepaid phone plan (das Guthaben, plural Guthaben)
example: Mein Guthaben auf der Handykarte ist fast aufgebraucht. — The credit on my phone card is almost used up.

hindi: भला-मानस — नरम दिल, सहज और दूसरों को माफ़ कर देने वाला
definition: good-natured and kind-hearted, easygoing and patient, sometimes easily taken advantage of (regular adjective)
example: Unser Hund ist so gutmütig, dass Kinder auf ihm reiten dürfen. — Our dog is so good-natured that children may ride on him.

hindi: उच्च माध्यमिक अकादमिक स्कूल — विश्वविद्यालय-प्रवेश की अंतिम परीक्षा तक ले जाने वाली कठिन पढ़ाई
definition: the academic secondary school, the most demanding of the German school types, which leads to the Abitur and university entrance (das Gymnasium, plural Gymnasien)
example: Nach der Grundschule wechselte er aufs Gymnasium. — After primary school he moved to the Gymnasium.

hindi: रोंगटे खड़े होना — ठंड या रोमांच से त्वचा पर उभरे दाने
definition: goosebumps, the tiny raised bumps on the skin caused by cold, fear or intense emotion, literally goose skin (die Gänsehaut, no plural)
example: Bei diesem Lied bekomme ich immer Gänsehaut. — This song always gives me goosebumps.

hindi: माली — बाग़ और पौधों की देखभाल करने वाला
definition: a gardener, a person who tends gardens, grows plants and cares for lawns for a living or for pleasure (der Gärtner, plural Gärtner)
example: Der Gärtner pflanzt neue Rosen vor dem Rathaus. — The gardener plants new roses in front of the town hall.

hindi: बागवानी करना — शौक से पौधे उगाना और बाग़ सँवारना
definition: to garden, to grow plants and tend a garden or allotment as a relaxing hobby (regular: hat gegärtnert)
example: Meine Mutter gärtnert am liebsten am frühen Morgen. — My mother likes gardening best in the early morning.

hindi: अतिथि कक्ष — मेहमानों के ठहरने का कमरा
definition: the guest room, the spare bedroom of a home where visitors stay overnight (das Gästezimmer, plural Gästezimmer)
example: Du kannst im Gästezimmer schlafen. — You can sleep in the guest room.

hindi: सहर्ष चाहना — किसी की खुशी या लाभ को बिना ईर्ष्या स्वीकारना
definition: to be glad someone has something good and not begrudge it, or to allow oneself a treat, the opposite of envy (regular, jemandem etwas gönnen + Dativ)
example: Ich gönne dir den Urlaub von Herzen. — I am truly happy for you to have the holiday.

hindi: बच्चा — उत्तर और बर्लिन में छोटे, शरारती बच्चे के लिए बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: a northern and Berlin colloquial word for a small child, often a cheeky or naughty one, said with mild amusement or annoyance (das Gör, plural Gören)
example: Die Gören toben den ganzen Tag im Hof. — The kids romp around the yard all day.

hindi: वैध — क़ानूनी रूप से मान्य और अभी चालू
definition: valid, legally in force and still usable, said of a passport, ticket, permit or contract that has not expired
example: Ist Ihr Reisepass noch gültig? — Is your passport still valid?

hindi: किफ़ायती — अच्छे दाम पर, अनुकूल
definition: inexpensive and good value without sounding shoddy, also favourable for a moment or opportunity (günstig, günstiger, am günstigsten)
example: Dieser Supermarkt ist günstiger als der andere. — This supermarket is cheaper than the other one.

hindi: पेटी — कमर पर पतलून कसने की पट्टी
definition: a belt, the strip of leather or fabric fastened around the waist to hold up trousers (der Gürtel, plural Gürtel)
example: Der Gürtel ist mir zu lang. — The belt is too long for me.

hindi: बाल — सिर और शरीर पर उगने वाले पतले रेशे
definition: a single hair, or collectively the hair growing on the head and body of a person (das Haar, plural Haare)
example: Ihr Haar ist lang und dunkel. — Her hair is long and dark.

hindi: तेज़-तर्रार होना — झगड़ालू और मुँहफट स्वभाव का होना
definition: to be sharp-tongued and combative, said mostly of a woman who fiercely stands her ground (colloquial; hat Haare auf den Zähnen)
example: Die neue Chefin hat Haare auf den Zähnen. — The new boss is a tough customer.

hindi: नमस्कार / अलविदा — बवेरिया और ऑस्ट्रिया में शिष्ट, थोड़ा पुराना अभिवादन या विदाई
definition: a courteous, slightly old-fashioned greeting or farewell of Bavaria and Austria, literally meaning the speaker has the honour
example: Habe die Ehre, Frau Huber, schönen Tag noch! — Good day, Mrs Huber, enjoy the rest of your day!

hindi: पास होना — किसी चीज़ का स्वामी होना
definition: to have or possess something, and also the auxiliary verb that forms the perfect tense of most verbs (irregular: hat, hatte, hat gehabt)
example: Wir haben zwei Kinder und einen Hund. — We have two children and a dog.

hindi: बारीक काटना — चाकू से छोटे-छोटे टुकड़े करना
definition: to chop food finely into small pieces with quick knife strokes, as onions, herbs or nuts (regular: hackt, hat gehackt)
example: Hack die Petersilie ganz fein. — Chop the parsley very finely.

hindi: कीमा — बारीक कटा या पिसा हुआ माँस
definition: minced meat, the ground beef or pork sold at the butcher for meatballs, bolognese and stuffed peppers (das Hackfleisch, no plural)
example: Das Hackfleisch brate ich mit Zwiebeln an. — I brown the minced meat with onions.

hindi: बंदरगाह — जहाज़ों के ठहरने की सुरक्षित जगह
definition: a harbour or port, a sheltered place on the coast where ships dock and unload cargo (der Hafen, plural Häfen)
example: Im Hafen liegen viele Fischerboote. — Many fishing boats lie in the harbour.

hindi: जई — दलिया और नाश्ते के गुच्छों का अनाज
definition: oats, the cereal grain rolled into flakes for porridge and muesli, a breakfast staple in German households (der Hafer, no plural)
example: Der Hafer ist gut fürs Herz. — Oats are good for the heart.

hindi: जई के गुच्छे — नाश्ते में दूध के साथ खाए जाने वाले चपटे दाने
definition: rolled oats, the flattened oat flakes eaten with milk or yoghurt for breakfast and stirred into muesli, an everyday plural-only word (die Haferflocken, plural only)
example: Die Haferflocken sind fast alle. — The rolled oats are almost gone.

hindi: क़ैद — हिरासत या जेल में बंद रहना
definition: custody or imprisonment, the state of being held in detention by the police or serving a prison sentence (die Haft, no plural)
example: Die Haft dauerte zwei Jahre. — The imprisonment lasted two years.

hindi: दायित्व बीमा — दूसरों को अनजाने में पहुँचाए नुकसान को ढँकने वाला बीमा
definition: liability insurance, the cover that pays for damage you accidentally cause to other people or their property (die Haftpflichtversicherung, plural Haftpflichtversicherungen)
example: Jeder in Deutschland sollte eine Haftpflichtversicherung haben. — Everyone in Germany should have liability insurance.

hindi: ओले — आसमान से गिरते बर्फ़ के कठोर गोले
definition: hail, hard balls of ice that fall from thunderclouds and damage cars, crops and windows (der Hagel, no plural)
example: Der Hagel hat die Autos verbeult. — The hail dented the cars.

hindi: ओले पड़ना — बर्फ़ के गोलों का बरसना
definition: to hail, used impersonally with es when hard balls of ice fall from a thundercloud (regular: es hagelt, hat gehagelt)
example: Plötzlich hat es kräftig gehagelt. — Suddenly it hailed heavily.

hindi: मुर्गा — सुबह बाँग देने वाला नर पक्षी; नल भी
definition: a rooster, the male chicken that crows at dawn, and also the word for a water tap or faucet (der Hahn, plural Hähne)
example: Der Hahn kräht jeden Morgen um fünf. — The rooster crows every morning at five.

hindi: महिलाओं के बीच अकेला पुरुष — ध्यान का केंद्र बना इकलौता मर्द
definition: the only male person in a group of women, enjoying all their attention and admiration, often said with a wink (usually: der Hahn im Korb sein)
example: Bei dem Ausflug war er der einzige Mann, der Hahn im Korb. — On the outing he was the only man, cock of the walk.

hindi: हुक या खूँटी — चीज़ें टाँगने का मुड़ा हुआ काँटा; छुपी हुई अड़चन
definition: a hook for hanging coats, towels or bags, and colloquially the hidden catch or snag in an offer that seems too good (der Haken, plural Haken)
example: Häng den Mantel an den Haken neben der Tür. — Hang the coat on the hook next to the door.

hindi: आधा — समय बताने में अगले घंटे से आधा घंटा पहले, जैसे ढाई बजे
definition: half, and in telling time the classic learner trap: halb drei means half past two, thirty minutes before three o'clock, never half past three
example: Wir treffen uns um halb sieben vor dem Kino. — We meet at half past six in front of the cinema.

hindi: आधा करना — किसी चीज़ को दो बराबर हिस्सों में बाँटना
definition: to halve, to cut something into two equal parts or reduce an amount or price to half of what it was (regular, hat halbiert)
example: Bitte halbiere den Apfel für die Kinder. — Please halve the apple for the children.

hindi: प्रायद्वीप — तीन ओर पानी से घिरा भूभाग
definition: a peninsula, a stretch of land surrounded by water on three sides and joined to the mainland on one (die Halbinsel, plural Halbinseln)
example: Die Halbinsel ist ein beliebtes Ausflugsziel. — The peninsula is a popular day-trip destination.

hindi: आधा भोजन-पैकेज — होटल में नाश्ता और रात का खाना शामिल, दोपहर का नहीं
definition: half board, a hotel rate that includes breakfast and one main meal, usually dinner, each day (die Halbpension, no plural)
example: Die Halbpension kostet zwanzig Euro extra pro Tag. — Half board costs twenty euros extra per day.

hindi: थोड़ा-बहुत — किसी हद तक, ठीक-ठाक ढंग से
definition: more or less, halfway acceptable, a colloquial qualifier for something that is passable but not great
example: Das Zimmer ist halbwegs sauber. — The room is more or less clean.

hindi: मध्यांतर — मुक़ाबले के बीच का विराम और खेल का आधा भाग
definition: half time, the break in the middle of a football match and also each of the two halves of the game (die Halbzeit, plural Halbzeiten)
example: In der Halbzeit stand es null zu null. — At half time it was nil nil.

hindi: बंद तैराकी कुंड — छत वाला भीतरी पूल
definition: an indoor swimming pool, the covered facility where people swim in every season regardless of weather (das Hallenbad, plural Hallenbäder)
example: Im Winter schwimme ich im Hallenbad. — In winter I swim in the indoor pool.

hindi: नमस्ते — किसी से मिलने पर कहा जाने वाला सहज अनौपचारिक अभिवादन
definition: the everyday informal greeting used when meeting someone or answering the telephone, suitable at any hour of the day
example: Hallo, wie war dein Tag? — Hello, how was your day?

hindi: गर्दन/गला — सिर को धड़ से जोड़ने वाला हिस्सा, गला भी
definition: the neck and throat, the part joining the head to the shoulders, also the inside passage that hurts when sore (der Hals, plural Hälse)
example: Mein Hals tut beim Schlucken weh. — My throat hurts when I swallow.

hindi: आनन-फ़ानन में — बेतहाशा जल्दबाज़ी में, बिना सोचे-समझे
definition: headlong and in a wild rush, doing something hastily without pausing to think or prepare (adverbial phrase)
example: Sie verließ Hals über Kopf die Stadt. — She left the city in a headlong rush.

hindi: शुभकामना — मंच या परीक्षा से पहले दी जाने वाली उलटी-सी दुआ, ‘ख़ूब अच्छा हो’
definition: break a neck and a leg, the traditional ironic wish of good luck before a performance or a risky undertaking (fixed exclamation)
example: Viel Erfolg bei der Prüfung, Hals- und Beinbruch! — Good luck in the exam, break a leg!

hindi: बस, यही है — किसी बात को अटल तथ्य की तरह स्वीकार कराने वाला शब्द
definition: a colloquial particle, common in southern Germany, that presents something as simply the unchangeable way things are and closes the discussion
example: Das ist halt so. — That's just the way it is.

hindi: टिकाऊ — देर तक चलने या ख़राब न होने वाला
definition: durable and long-lasting, or in the case of food able to keep without spoiling until a certain date
example: Die Milch ist bis Freitag haltbar. — The milk keeps until Friday.

hindi: पकड़े रहना — किसी चीज़ को हाथ में थामे रखना या रुकना
definition: to hold something in the hand or keep it in position, also to stop a vehicle or to keep a promise (hält, hielt, hat gehalten)
example: Kannst du kurz meine Tasche halten? — Can you hold my bag for a moment?

hindi: किसी बारे में राय रखना — किसी व्यक्ति या विचार को कैसा मानना
definition: to have an opinion about somebody or something, to think highly or poorly of them (von + Dativ, hält, hat gehalten)
example: Was hältst du von seinem Vorschlag? — What do you think of his suggestion?

hindi: पड़ाव — बस या ट्राम के रुकने की जगह जहाँ यात्री चढ़ते-उतरते हैं
definition: a stop for buses or trams, the marked place where public transport halts for passengers (die Haltestelle, plural Haltestellen)
example: Die nächste Haltestelle ist gleich um die Ecke. — The next stop is just around the corner.

hindi: हथौड़ा — कील ठोकने का भारी सिर वाला औज़ार
definition: a hammer, the tool with a heavy metal head on a handle used to drive nails into wood or walls (der Hammer, plural Hämmer)
example: Mit dem Hammer schlage ich den Nagel in die Wand. — With the hammer I drive the nail into the wall.

hindi: गालों में खाना भरने वाला छोटा पालतू चूहा — पिंजरे में रात को पहिये पर दौड़ता है
definition: a hamster, the small rodent with cheek pouches that is kept in a cage and runs in a wheel at night (der Hamster, plural Hamster)
example: Der Hamster läuft nachts im Rad. — The hamster runs in the wheel at night.

hindi: हाथ — कलाई के आगे उँगलियों वाला अंग जिससे पकड़ते हैं
definition: the hand, the part at the end of the arm with fingers and a thumb used for gripping and holding (die Hand, plural Hände)
example: Gib mir bitte die Hand. — Please give me your hand.

hindi: ठोस होना — किसी योजना या तर्क का समझदार और पक्का होना
definition: to be solid and well thought out, said of a plan or argument that makes practical sense (hat Hand und Fuß)
example: Dein Vorschlag hat Hand und Fuß. — Your proposal makes good sense.

hindi: हस्तकला — सुई-धागे से किया गया हाथ का काम
definition: needlework or handicraft, work done by hand such as knitting, sewing or embroidery (die Handarbeit, plural Handarbeiten)
example: Die Handarbeit entspannt meine Oma am Abend. — Needlework relaxes my grandma in the evening.

hindi: व्यापार — सामान की ख़रीद-बिक्री; दुकानों और व्यापारियों का पूरा क्षेत्र
definition: trade or commerce, the buying and selling of goods, also the retail sector as a whole with its shops and traders (der Handel, no plural)
example: Der Handel mit Gebrauchtwagen läuft gut. — Trade in used cars is going well.

hindi: व्यापार करना — चीज़ें ख़रीद-बेचकर धंधा करना; मोल-भाव करना
definition: to trade in goods as a business, to bargain over a price, and generally to take action (regular: handelt, hat gehandelt)
example: Auf dem Markt kann man um den Preis handeln. — At the market you can bargain over the price.

hindi: हाथ का झाड़ू — मेज़ या सूपड़ी के लिए छोटा ब्रश
definition: a small hand brush with a short handle used together with a dustpan to sweep up crumbs and small messes (der Handfeger, plural Handfeger)
example: Mit dem Handfeger kehre ich die Krümel zusammen. — With the hand brush I sweep the crumbs together.

hindi: कलाई — हाथ और बाँह को जोड़ने वाला पतला जोड़
definition: the wrist, the narrow joint connecting the hand to the forearm on which a watch is worn (das Handgelenk, plural Handgelenke)
example: Die Uhr sitzt locker am Handgelenk. — The watch sits loosely on the wrist.

hindi: हाथ का सामान — विमान में अपने पास रखा जाने वाला छोटा थैला
definition: hand luggage or carry-on baggage, the small bag a passenger keeps with them in the cabin (das Handgepäck, no plural)
example: Flüssigkeiten dürfen nicht ins Handgepäck. — Liquids are not allowed in hand luggage.

hindi: कथानक — कहानी या फ़िल्म में घटनाओं का क्रम
definition: the plot or storyline, the sequence of events that unfolds in a novel, film or play (die Handlung, plural Handlungen)
example: Die Handlung des Films war schwer zu verstehen. — The plot of the film was hard to understand.

hindi: दस्ताना — हाथ को ढकने वाला उँगलियों वाला कपड़ा
definition: a glove, the covering for the hand with separate fingers worn against cold or for protection (der Handschuh, plural Handschuhe)
example: Ich habe einen Handschuh im Bus verloren. — I lost a glove on the bus.

hindi: गाड़ी का दराज़ — यात्री सीट के सामने का छोटा बंद ख़ाना
definition: the glove compartment, the small closed storage box in the dashboard of a motorcar in front of the passenger seat (das Handschuhfach, plural Handschuhfächer)
example: Die Papiere liegen im Handschuhfach. — The documents are in the glove compartment.

hindi: हाथ का थैला — चाबी और पैसे रखने का छोटा थैला
definition: a handbag, the small bag carried by hand or over the shoulder for purse, keys and phone (die Handtasche, plural Handtaschen)
example: Mein Schlüssel liegt in der Handtasche. — My key is in the handbag.

hindi: मुट्ठी भर — जितना एक हाथ में समाए, यानी थोड़ा
definition: a handful, the small quantity that fits in one hand, used for nuts or berries and figuratively for a small number of people (die Handvoll, plural Handvoll)
example: Nur eine Handvoll Leute kam zum Treffen. — Only a handful of people came to the meeting.

hindi: दस्तकारी — हाथ के हुनर वाला पेशा या पूरा कारीगर क्षेत्र
definition: a craft or trade, skilled manual work such as baking, joinery or plumbing, also the whole sector of such trades (das Handwerk, plural Handwerke)
example: Das Handwerk hat in Deutschland eine lange Tradition. — Skilled trades have a long tradition in Germany.

hindi: कारीगर — हाथ के हुनर से काम करने वाला मिस्त्री
definition: a tradesperson or craftsman, any skilled manual worker such as a plumber, joiner or electrician (der Handwerker, plural Handwerker)
example: Heute kommt endlich der Handwerker wegen der Tür. — Today the tradesman finally comes about the door.

hindi: चलभाष — जेब में रखा जाने वाला बेतार दूरभाष
definition: a mobile phone, the everyday German word for the pocket telephone that people carry everywhere; a German coinage that sounds English but is not (das Handy, plural Handys)
example: Ich habe mein Handy zu Hause vergessen. — I left my mobile phone at home.

hindi: चलभाष संख्या — जेबी दूरभाष का नंबर जिस पर लोग बात करते हैं
definition: a mobile phone number, the telephone number people exchange so they can call or message each other on their mobiles (die Handynummer, plural Handynummern)
example: Ich schreibe dir die Handynummer auf. — I will write down the mobile number for you.

hindi: ढलान — पहाड़ी की तिरछी उतरती सतह
definition: a slope or hillside, the sloping side of a hill or mountain where vineyards or ski runs lie (der Hang, plural Hänge)
example: Am Hang wächst Wein. — Grapes grow on the hillside.

hindi: भार-दंड — कसरत में उठाया जाने वाला भारी दंड
definition: a dumbbell or barbell, the weighted bar lifted in strength training to build muscle (die Hantel, plural Hanteln)
example: Er hebt jeden Tag schwere Hanteln. — He lifts heavy dumbbells every day.

hindi: ख़ुश, प्रसन्न — बोलचाल में
definition: happy, pleased or content in casual speech, the borrowed English adjective that young speakers use instead of glücklich
example: Ich bin total happy mit dem Ergebnis. — I am totally happy with the result.

hindi: पंजा — पत्ते बटोरने और मिट्टी समतल करने का दाँतेदार औज़ार
definition: a rake, the garden tool with a row of teeth used to gather leaves and smooth soil; southern German says Rechen (die Harke, plural Harken)
example: Mit der Harke sammle ich das Laub zusammen. — With the rake I gather up the leaves.

hindi: हानिरहित — जिससे कोई नुक़सान न हो
definition: harmless and innocuous, unable to cause injury or trouble, used of animals, jokes, illnesses and people
example: Keine Angst, der Hund ist harmlos. — Don't worry, the dog is harmless.

hindi: कठोर, सख़्त — दबाने पर न झुके, या कठिन और कड़ा
definition: hard, firm and solid so that it does not bend or dent under pressure, also describing tough work or a harsh judgement
example: Das Brot ist schon ganz hart. — The bread is already completely hard.

hindi: दृढ़ और अड़ियल — हार न मानकर डटे रहने वाला
definition: persistent and tenacious, stubbornly refusing to give up, also said of a stubborn cough or persistent problem
example: Der Journalist stellte hartnäckig weitere Fragen. — The journalist persistently asked more questions.

hindi: जंगली ख़रगोश — खेतों में तेज़ दौड़ने वाला लंबे कानों का जानवर
definition: a hare, the wild long-eared animal with strong hind legs that races across fields (der Hase, plural Hasen)
example: Ein Hase lief über die Wiese. — A hare ran across the meadow.

hindi: नफ़रत करना — किसी से गहरी घृणा रखना
definition: to hate, to feel intense dislike or hostility toward a person, thing or activity (regular: hat gehasst; + Akkusativ)
example: Ich hasse es, früh aufzustehen. — I hate getting up early.

hindi: हड़बड़ी वाला — इतनी जल्दी में कि सावधानी छूट जाए
definition: hasty and rushed, done so quickly that it seems nervous or careless, faster than the situation deserves
example: Er hat hastig gefrühstückt und ist gegangen. — He ate breakfast hastily and left.

hindi: अति महीन — साँस जितना पतला
definition: wafer-thin or paper-thin, extremely thin like a breath, used for slices, layers and very narrow margins
example: Die Mehrheit war hauchdünn. — The majority was wafer-thin.

hindi: ढेर — एक जगह जमा चीज़ों का अंबार
definition: a heap or pile of things thrown together, and colloquially a large quantity or number of anything (der Haufen, plural Haufen)
example: Auf dem Schreibtisch liegt ein Haufen Papier. — There is a pile of paper on the desk.

hindi: मुख्य रेल अड्डा — शहर का सबसे बड़ा केंद्रीय स्थानक
definition: the main railway station of a city, the largest central station where long-distance and local trains meet (der Hauptbahnhof, plural Hauptbahnhöfe)
example: Der Hauptbahnhof liegt mitten in der Stadt. — The main station lies in the middle of the city.

hindi: मुख्य विषय — पढ़ाई का प्रमुख विषय
definition: a major subject, the main academic discipline a student concentrates on during university studies (das Hauptfach, plural Hauptfächer)
example: Mein Hauptfach ist Geschichte. — My major is history.

hindi: मुख्य व्यंजन — भोजन का सबसे बड़ा और प्रमुख खाना
definition: the main course, the central and largest dish of a meal, served after the starter (das Hauptgericht, plural Hauptgerichte)
example: Zum Hauptgericht gibt es Schnitzel mit Kartoffelsalat. — For the main course there is schnitzel with potato salad.

hindi: मुख्य भूमिका — फ़िल्म या नाटक का प्रमुख किरदार
definition: the leading role, the main character part in a film or play around which the whole story turns (die Hauptrolle, plural Hauptrollen)
example: In dem neuen Film spielt sie die Hauptrolle. — She plays the leading role in the new film.

hindi: मुख्य मौसम — साल का सबसे भीड़भाड़ और महँगा पर्यटन-काल
definition: the high season, the busiest and most expensive period of the year for tourism and travel (die Hauptsaison, plural Hauptsaisons)
example: In der Hauptsaison sind die Hotels doppelt so teuer. — In high season the hotels are twice as expensive.

hindi: बुनियादी माध्यमिक स्कूल — नौवीं कक्षा तक, आगे शिल्प-प्रशिक्षण की तैयारी
definition: the basic secondary school type ending after year nine that traditionally prepares pupils for an apprenticeship in a trade (die Hauptschule, plural Hauptschulen)
example: Die Hauptschule liegt gleich neben dem Bahnhof. — The Hauptschule is right next to the station.

hindi: राजधानी — देश या राज्य का मुख्य शहर जहाँ सरकार बैठती है
definition: a capital city, the main city of a country or state where the government and parliament have their seat (die Hauptstadt, plural Hauptstädte)
example: Die Hauptstadt liegt im Osten des Landes. — The capital city lies in the east of the country.

hindi: मुख्य सड़क — कस्बे की सबसे बड़ी और व्यस्त सड़क
definition: the main street of a town, the principal busy road where the shops stand, often literally the street name (die Hauptstraße, plural Hauptstraßen)
example: Die Bäckerei liegt an der Hauptstraße. — The bakery is on the main street.

hindi: मुख्यतः — सबसे ज़्यादा या प्रमुख रूप से
definition: mainly or chiefly, more than anything else, naming the principal part or reason among several
example: Ich lese hauptsächlich Krimis. — I mainly read crime novels.

hindi: घर का काम — सफ़ाई, खाना बनाना और कपड़े धोने जैसे रोज़ के काम
definition: housework, the everyday chores of cleaning, cooking, washing and tidying that keep a home running, also a university term paper (die Hausarbeit, plural Hausarbeiten)
example: Wir teilen uns die Hausarbeit gerecht auf. — We share the housework fairly.

hindi: पारिवारिक चिकित्सक — पहली सलाह देने वाला सामान्य चिकित्सक
definition: a family doctor or general practitioner, the first physician a person visits before being referred onward to a specialist (der Hausarzt, plural Hausärzte)
example: Mein Hausarzt kennt meine ganze Krankengeschichte. — My family doctor knows my whole medical history.

hindi: गृहकार्य — शिक्षक द्वारा घर पर करने के लिए दिया गया काम
definition: homework, a task the teacher assigns to be completed at home after school, usually spoken of in the plural (die Hausaufgabe, plural Hausaufgaben)
example: Hast du deine Hausaufgaben schon gemacht? — Have you done your homework yet?

hindi: इमारत का चौकीदार-रखवाला — सफ़ाई, चाबी और मरम्मत सँभालने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the caretaker or janitor of an apartment building who cleans, keeps keys and handles small repairs, the Austrian word where Germany says Hausmeister (der Hausbesorger, plural Hausbesorger)
example: Der Hausbesorger hat den Schlüssel für den Keller. — The caretaker has the key to the cellar.

hindi: गृहिणी — घर और परिवार की देखभाल करने वाली महिला
definition: a woman who runs the household and looks after the family rather than working outside the home, slightly dated (die Hausfrau, plural Hausfrauen)
example: Meine Großmutter war ihr ganzes Leben Hausfrau. — My grandmother was a housewife all her life.

hindi: गृहस्थी — घर और उसे चलाने के काम जैसे खाना, सफ़ाई, ख़रीदारी
definition: the household, the home together with the chores of running it such as cooking, cleaning and shopping (der Haushalt, plural Haushalte)
example: Wir teilen uns den Haushalt. — We share the housework.

hindi: चौकीदार-देखरेखकर्ता — इमारत की देखभाल और छोटी मरम्मत करने वाला
definition: the caretaker or janitor who looks after a building, fixing small faults and watching the rules (der Hausmeister, plural Hausmeister)
example: Der Hausmeister repariert morgen die Heizung. — The caretaker is repairing the heating tomorrow.

hindi: घरेलू नुस्ख़ा — घर की चीज़ों से बना इलाज
definition: a home remedy, the simple household cure such as herbal tea or a warm compress used before seeing a doctor (das Hausmittel, plural Hausmittel)
example: Honigtee ist ein bewährtes Hausmittel gegen Husten. — Honey tea is a proven home remedy for coughs.

hindi: मकान संख्या — पते में सड़क पर घर की पहचान का अंक
definition: a house number, the figure on a building that identifies it within its street for the postal address (die Hausnummer, plural Hausnummern)
example: Welche Hausnummer hat die Praxis? — What house number does the practice have?

hindi: इमारत के नियम — शांति, सफ़ाई और कूड़े के बारे में मकान के नियम
definition: the house rules of a residential building, covering quiet hours, stairwell cleaning and rubbish (die Hausordnung, plural Hausordnungen)
example: Laut Hausordnung ist ab zehn Uhr Ruhe. — According to the house rules it is quiet time from ten o'clock.

hindi: घर की चप्पल — घर के अंदर पहनी जाने वाली नरम चप्पल
definition: a slipper, the soft comfortable shoe worn only inside the house instead of street shoes (der Hausschuh, plural Hausschuhe)
example: Bitte zieh drinnen die Hausschuhe an. — Please put the slippers on indoors.

hindi: पालतू जानवर — घर में साथ रखा जाने वाला पशु
definition: a pet, a domestic animal kept in the home for company rather than for work or food (das Haustier, plural Haustiere)
example: Hast du ein Haustier? — Do you have a pet?

hindi: संपत्ति प्रबंधन — मालिकों की ओर से इमारत चलाने वाली कंपनी
definition: the property management company that runs and maintains a residential building on behalf of its owners (die Hausverwaltung, plural Hausverwaltungen)
example: Ich habe die Hausverwaltung wegen des Aufzugs angerufen. — I called the property management about the lift.

hindi: त्वचा/चमड़ी — शरीर को ढकने वाली बाहरी परत
definition: the skin, the outer covering layer of the human body that feels touch, heat and cold (die Haut, plural Häute)
example: Meine Haut ist im Winter sehr trocken. — My skin is very dry in winter.

hindi: दाई — प्रसव और उसके बाद माँ की मदद करने वाली प्रशिक्षित महिला
definition: a midwife, the trained woman who assists mothers during pregnancy, birth and the first weeks afterwards (die Hebamme, plural Hebammen)
example: Die Hebamme besucht die junge Mutter zu Hause. — The midwife visits the young mother at home.

hindi: उत्तोलक — दबाकर या खींचकर मशीन चलाने वाली छड़
definition: a lever, a rigid bar you push or pull to operate a machine, lift a weight or release a mechanism (der Hebel, plural Hebel)
example: Zieh den Hebel nach oben, um den Sitz zu verstellen. — Pull the lever upward to adjust the seat.

hindi: उठाना — किसी चीज़ को नीचे से ऊपर की ओर ले जाना
definition: to lift or raise something upward from a lower position, such as lifting a box or raising a hand (hob, hat gehoben)
example: Der Arzt sagt, ich darf nichts Schweres heben. — The doctor says I must not lift anything heavy.

hindi: बाड़ — झाड़ियों की कतार जो सीमा बनाती है
definition: a hedge, a line of closely planted shrubs forming a living fence along a garden or field boundary (die Hecke, plural Hecken)
example: Mein Nachbar schneidet jeden Sommer die Hecke. — My neighbour trims the hedge every summer.

hindi: ख़मीर — आटा फुलाने वाला जीवित उठान
definition: yeast, the living leavening agent that makes bread dough rise and ferments beer, sold fresh in small cubes in German supermarkets (die Hefe, no plural)
example: Die Hefe liegt im Kühlschrank. — The yeast is in the fridge.

hindi: अभ्यास-पुस्तिका — कॉपी जिसमें छात्र लिखते हैं
definition: an exercise book, the thin notebook in which pupils write their classwork and homework (das Heft, plural Hefte)
example: Schreibt den Satz bitte ins Heft. — Please write the sentence in your exercise book.

hindi: बंजर घास-भूमि — झाड़ियों और बैंगनी फूलों वाला खुला मैदान
definition: a heath or heathland, an open stretch of sandy land covered with low shrubs and purple heather rather than trees (die Heide, plural Heiden)
example: Im August blüht die Heide lila. — In August the heath blooms purple.

hindi: नाज़ुक — सँभालने में मुश्किल, संवेदनशील मामला
definition: delicate and touchy, a sensitive matter that is difficult to handle without causing offence or trouble
example: Das ist ein heikles Thema. — That is a delicate topic.

hindi: सही-सलामत — बिना टूटे, अक्षत
definition: intact, unbroken and undamaged, used of things that survived a fall and of people who came through unhurt
example: Die Gläser sind alle heil geblieben. — The glasses all stayed intact.

hindi: ठीक होना या करना — घाव या रोग का भरना
definition: to heal, either a wound or illness getting better on its own, or a doctor curing a patient (regular: ist geheilt when the wound heals, hat geheilt when a doctor cures)
example: Die Wunde heilt gut. — The wound is healing well.

hindi: पवित्र — ईश्वर से जुड़ा, आदरणीय, अलंघ्य
definition: holy, sacred, belonging to God or deserving religious reverence, also something regarded as untouchable and important
example: Der Sonntag ist für sie heilig. — Sunday is sacred to her.

hindi: क्रिसमस की पूर्व संध्या — चौबीस दिसंबर की शाम, जब जर्मनी में उपहार दिए जाते हैं
definition: the evening of Christmas Eve, the twenty-fourth of December when German families exchange presents and share a festive meal (der Heiligabend, plural Heiligabende)
example: An Heiligabend gibt es bei uns Kartoffelsalat mit Würstchen. — On Christmas Eve we have potato salad with sausages.

hindi: घर की ओर — अपने घर लौटते हुए
definition: home, toward one's own house, the short direction word for going back to where one lives, common in the south
example: Ich muss jetzt heim, es ist spät. — I have to go home now, it is late.

hindi: जन्मभूमि — वह जगह जहाँ कोई पला-बढ़ा और जिसे अपना मानता है
definition: the home region or native place, the town or land where someone grew up and feels emotionally rooted and safe (die Heimat, no plural)
example: Nach zehn Jahren kehrte er in seine Heimat zurück. — After ten years he returned to his home region.

hindi: घर की याद — परदेस में घर-परिवार के लिए तड़प
definition: homesickness, the aching longing for home and family while living far away (das Heimweh, no plural)
example: Das Heimweh war im ersten Semester besonders stark. — The homesickness was especially strong in the first semester.

hindi: विवाह — शादी करने की क्रिया या घटना
definition: the act or event of getting married, the marriage seen as a step taken rather than as a ceremony (die Heirat, plural Heiraten)
example: Nach der Heirat zogen sie nach Hamburg. — After the marriage they moved to Hamburg.

hindi: शादी करना — किसी से विवाह के बंधन में बँधना
definition: to marry, to become someone's husband or wife in a wedding, taking a direct object without a preposition (regular, hat geheiratet)
example: Sie heiraten nächsten Sommer in Italien. — They are getting married next summer in Italy.

hindi: शादी का प्रस्ताव — किसी से विवाह की माँग
definition: a marriage proposal, the moment one person asks another to marry them, often kneeling with a ring (der Heiratsantrag, plural Heiratsanträge)
example: Er machte ihr auf dem Turm einen Heiratsantrag. — He proposed marriage to her on the tower.

hindi: बैठी आवाज़ वाला — गला ख़राब होने से खुरदरी आवाज़
definition: hoarse, having a rough scratchy voice because the throat is sore or overused
example: Nach dem Konzert war ich völlig heiser. — After the concert I was completely hoarse.

hindi: खुला और साफ़ — धूप वाला हल्के बादलों का मौसम
definition: fair and bright, the forecast word for mostly sunny weather with only scattered light clouds; also cheerful in mood
example: Morgen wird es heiter bis wolkig. — Tomorrow it will be fair to cloudy.

hindi: तापक — दीवार पर लगा कमरा गरम करने वाला धातु का उपकरण
definition: a radiator, the metal heating unit fixed to a wall that warms a room with hot water inside (der Heizkörper, plural Heizkörper)
example: Der Heizkörper unter dem Fenster ist kalt. — The radiator under the window is cold.

hindi: तापन व्यवस्था — घर गरम रखने का तंत्र या उसका गरम उपकरण
definition: the heating system of a home, or in everyday speech the radiator itself that warms a room (die Heizung, plural Heizungen)
example: Die Heizung funktioniert nicht. — The heating is not working.

hindi: गर्म — बहुत तपता हुआ, ऊँचे तापमान का
definition: hot, having a very high temperature, burning to the touch, also used of heated debates and weather (comparative heißer)
example: Vorsicht, der Tee ist noch heiß! — Careful, the tea is still hot!

hindi: नाम होना — किसी का नाम या मतलब होना
definition: to be called or named something, and also to mean, as in what a word signifies (irregular: heißt, hieß, hat geheißen)
example: Wie heißt du? — What is your name?

hindi: मदद करना — किसी के काम या मुश्किल में सहारा देना
definition: to help or assist someone, to make a task or difficult situation easier for another person (irregular: hilft, hat geholfen, + Dativ)
example: Hilfst du mir bitte beim Tragen der Koffer? — Will you help me carry the suitcases, please?

hindi: हल्का, उजला — रोशनी से भरा या फीके रंग वाला
definition: light or bright, full of daylight or lamp light, or describing a pale shade of a colour such as light blue
example: Das Zimmer ist groß und hell. — The room is large and bright.

hindi: शिरस्त्राण — सिर की सुरक्षा के लिए पहना जाने वाला सख़्त टोप
definition: a helmet, the hard protective headgear worn by cyclists and motorbike riders to prevent injury (der Helm, plural Helme)
example: Der Helm hat ihm beim Sturz den Kopf geschützt. — The helmet protected his head in the fall.

hindi: कमीज़ — बटन और कॉलर वाला ऊपरी वस्त्र
definition: a shirt, the buttoned upper garment with collar and sleeves worn especially by men for work (das Hemd, plural Hemden)
example: Er bügelt sein Hemd für das Vorstellungsgespräch. — He is ironing his shirt for the job interview.

hindi: भुना मुर्गा — बवेरिया और ऑस्ट्रिया में सीख पर भुना पूरा चिकन
definition: the Bavarian and Austrian word for a roast chicken, the whole bird grilled on a spit and sold at every beer festival (das Hendl, plural Hendl)
example: Auf der Wiesn essen wir ein halbes Hendl. — At the festival we eat half a roast chicken.

hindi: कुंडा — प्याले, जग या टोकरी के किनारे लगा मुड़ा हुआ पकड़ने वाला हिस्सा
definition: the curved handle attached to a cup, jug, basket or pot that you hook your fingers through to hold and carry it (der Henkel, plural Henkel)
example: Der Henkel der Tasse ist abgebrochen. — The handle of the cup has broken off.

hindi: मुर्गी (मादा) — अंडे देने वाली मादा चिड़िया
definition: a hen, the female chicken that lays eggs and sits on them until the chicks hatch (die Henne, plural Hennen)
example: Die Henne hat heute zwei Eier gelegt. — The hen laid two eggs today.

hindi: इधर — वक्ता की ओर की दिशा में
definition: here, in the direction toward the speaker from a place, the small word that marks movement toward oneself
example: Komm mal her und schau dir das an. — Come here and take a look at this.

hindi: ऊपर इधर — नीचे से वक्ता की ओर चढ़ते हुए
definition: upwards and toward the speaker, coming up from below to the higher place where the speaker stands
example: Kommen Sie bitte die Treppe herauf. — Please come up the stairs.

hindi: बाहर, इधर — अंदर से वक्ता की ओर निकलते हुए
definition: outwards and toward the speaker, coming out of a space or container in the direction of the person watching
example: Sie holte den Schlüssel aus der Tasche heraus. — She took the key out of her pocket.

hindi: पता लगाना — खोजबीन करके सच जानना
definition: to find out or discover something previously unknown by asking, searching or investigating carefully (separable: findet heraus, hat herausgefunden)
example: Wir müssen herausfinden, wer das war. — We have to find out who that was.

hindi: पतझड़ — पत्ते गिरने और ठंड बढ़ने की ऋतु
definition: autumn, the season when leaves fall, harvests come in and the weather turns cooler (der Herbst, plural Herbste)
example: Im Herbst werden die Blätter bunt. — In autumn the leaves turn colourful.

hindi: चूल्हा — रसोई का वह उपकरण जिस पर बर्तन रखकर खाना पकाते हैं
definition: the stove or cooker, the kitchen appliance with heated rings or plates on which pots and pans are placed to cook (der Herd, plural Herde)
example: Der Topf steht schon auf dem Herd. — The pot is already on the stove.

hindi: झुंड — एक साथ रहने वाले पशुओं का समूह
definition: a herd or flock, a large group of animals such as cows, sheep or deer that move together (die Herde, plural Herden)
example: Eine Herde Schafe blockiert die Straße. — A flock of sheep is blocking the road.

hindi: चूल्हे की प्लेट — चूल्हे का वह गरम गोल हिस्सा जिस पर बर्तन रखते हैं
definition: a hob ring or hotplate, the single heated circle on top of a stove where one pot or pan sits (die Herdplatte, plural Herdplatten)
example: Die Herdplatte ist noch heiß, pass auf! — The hotplate is still hot, watch out!

hindi: अंदर आइए — बाहर से वक्ता की ओर भीतर आते हुए
definition: inwards and toward the speaker, coming into a room or space where the speaker already is, also the word for inviting someone in
example: Herein, die Tür ist offen! — Come in, the door is open!

hindi: मनोहर — बहुत सुंदर, आनंददायक; मौसम या दृश्य के लिए
definition: glorious, gorgeous, splendid; enthusiastic praise especially for weather, views, scenery and food
example: Heute ist herrliches Wetter zum Wandern. — Today there is glorious weather for hiking.

hindi: बनाना या निर्माण करना — कारख़ाने में सामान तैयार करना
definition: to manufacture or produce goods in a factory or workshop, also to establish a connection or contact (separable: stellt her, hat hergestellt)
example: Die Firma stellt Möbel aus Holz her. — The company manufactures furniture from wood.

hindi: निर्माता — किसी उत्पाद को बनाने वाली कंपनी
definition: a manufacturer or producer, the company that makes a product and whose name usually stands on the label (der Hersteller, plural Hersteller)
example: Der Hersteller gibt zwei Jahre Garantie. — The manufacturer gives a two-year warranty.

hindi: चारों ओर — किसी चीज़ के इर्द-गिर्द, घेरे में
definition: around, in a circle about something or moving about a place without a fixed direction
example: Um das Haus herum wächst wilder Wein. — Wild vine grows around the house.

hindi: नीचे इधर — ऊपर से वक्ता की ओर उतरते हुए
definition: downwards and toward the speaker, coming down from above to the lower place where the speaker stands
example: Der Apfel fiel vom Baum herunter. — The apple fell down from the tree.

hindi: उतारना — अंतरजाल से संचिका अपने यंत्र पर लाना
definition: to download a file, app or program from the internet onto a computer or phone; the verb downloaden is common but this is the standard form (separable: lädt herunter, hat heruntergeladen)
example: Ich lade die App jetzt herunter. — I am downloading the app now.

hindi: रेखांकित करना — किसी बात को विशेष महत्व देकर बताना
definition: to emphasise or highlight something, to single out one particular point so that it stands clearly apart from the rest (separable, irregular: hebt hervor, hat hervorgehoben)
example: Die Rednerin hob die Bedeutung der Bildung hervor. — The speaker emphasised the importance of education.

hindi: उत्तम — औरों से कहीं बेहतर, असाधारण रूप से अच्छा
definition: outstanding, superb, excellent; praise for quality that stands far above the ordinary level
example: Ihre Arbeit war hervorragend, wirklich beeindruckend. — Her work was outstanding, truly impressive.

hindi: हृदय/दिल — छाती में रक्त पंप करने वाला अंग
definition: the heart, the organ in the chest that pumps blood through the body, also the seat of feeling (das Herz, plural Herzen)
example: Mein Herz schlägt schneller, wenn ich renne. — My heart beats faster when I run.

hindi: हार्दिक — दिल से गर्मजोशी भरा और सच्चा
definition: warm and heartfelt in manner, cordial and sincere towards people, also used in greetings and thanks
example: Sie hat uns herzlich zum Essen eingeladen. — She warmly invited us to dinner.

hindi: हार्दिक स्वागत — मेहमान का स्वागत करने का वाक्य
definition: the warm phrase spoken to welcome guests, visitors or new colleagues when they arrive
example: Herzlich willkommen in unserem Team! — A warm welcome to our team!

hindi: हार्दिक बधाई — जन्मदिन या सफलता पर बधाई
definition: the warm formal congratulation offered on birthdays, weddings, passed exams and other happy occasions
example: Herzlichen Glückwunsch zur bestandenen Prüfung! — Congratulations on passing the exam!

hindi: हार्दिक संवेदना — शोक में डूबे व्यक्ति से कहा जाने वाला वाक्य
definition: the standard phrase of sympathy said or written to someone who has lost a loved person
example: Herzliches Beileid zum Verlust Ihrer Mutter. — My sincere condolences on the loss of your mother.

hindi: इस पार आते हुए — दूसरी तरफ़ से वक्ता की ओर
definition: across and toward the speaker, coming over from the other side of a street, river or room
example: Er winkte mir von der anderen Seite herüber. — He waved over to me from the other side.

hindi: हड़बड़ी में भागना — तनाव के साथ तेज़ी से इधर-उधर दौड़ना
definition: to rush or race around under stress and time pressure, hurrying frantically from one thing to the next (regular: ist gehetzt when moving)
example: Sie hetzt den ganzen Tag von Termin zu Termin. — She rushes from appointment to appointment all day.

hindi: सूखी घास — जाड़े में पशुओं का चारा
definition: hay, the grass mown and dried in summer as fodder to feed cattle and horses through the winter (das Heu, no plural)
example: Das Heu riecht nach Sommer. — The hay smells of summer.

hindi: इस साल — चालू वर्ष में, दक्षिण जर्मन और ऑस्ट्रियाई बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: this year, during the current calendar year, an everyday southern German, Austrian and Swiss adverb that the north replaces with dieses Jahr
example: Heuer bleiben wir im Sommer zu Hause. — This year we are staying home in summer.

hindi: नई शराब का देसी ठेका — अंगूर उगाने वाला अपनी ताज़ा वाइन जहाँ पिलाता है
definition: a rustic wine tavern where a winegrower serves this year's young wine with cold food, a beloved Austrian institution around Vienna (der Heurige, plural Heurigen)
example: Am Samstag gehen wir zum Heurigen nach Grinzing. — On Saturday we are going to the wine tavern in Grinzing.

hindi: आज — यह चल रहा दिन
definition: today, on this present calendar day that is happening right now, rather than yesterday or tomorrow
example: Heute habe ich keine Zeit. — Today I have no time.

hindi: आजकल — आज के ज़माने में, पहले की तुलना में
definition: nowadays, in the present era as compared with earlier times, often opening a remark about how things have changed
example: Heutzutage hat fast jeder ein Handy. — Nowadays almost everyone has a mobile phone.
