hindi: यहाँ — इसी जगह, जहाँ बोलने वाला है
definition: here, at this place where the speaker currently stands or points, the basic location word for the spot close to oneself
example: Hier ist mein Büro. — Here is my office.

hindi: यहाँ की ओर — इसी जगह पर, वक्ता के पास आते हुए
definition: to here, toward this place where the speaker stands, the direction word for coming to the speaker
example: Komm bitte sofort hierher! — Please come here right away!

hindi: इसके द्वारा — इस पत्र या कथन के ज़रिये, औपचारिक घोषणा में
definition: hereby, with this document or statement, the formal opener of official declarations and letters
example: Hiermit kündige ich meinen Vertrag zum Monatsende. — I hereby cancel my contract at the end of the month.

hindi: मदद — किसी की सहायता या बचाव; खतरे में चिल्लाकर बुलाया जाने वाला शब्द
definition: help or assistance given to someone in need, also the word people shout when they are in danger (die Hilfe, plural Hilfen)
example: Die Hilfe der Nachbarn kam nach dem Unfall sofort. — The neighbours’ help came immediately after the accident.

hindi: सहायक — मदद करने वाला, उपयोगी
definition: helpful and useful, providing real assistance or valuable support, used of advice, tips, tools and people
example: Deine Tipps waren sehr hilfreich. — Your tips were very helpful.

hindi: मददगार — दूसरों की सहायता के लिए हमेशा तैयार
definition: helpful and willing to assist, always ready to lend a hand when someone needs support
example: Die Nachbarn waren beim Umzug sehr hilfsbereit. — The neighbours were very helpful during the move.

hindi: रसभरी — लाल गुठली-रहित छोटा नरम मीठा-खट्टा फल
definition: a raspberry, the soft red berry made of tiny round segments that grows on thorny bushes and tastes sweet and sharp (die Himbeere, plural Himbeeren)
example: Die Himbeeren im Garten sind reif. — The raspberries in the garden are ripe.

hindi: स्वर्ग — ईश्वर का लोक; आकाश भी
definition: heaven, the dwelling place of God and the blessed after death, also simply the sky overhead (der Himmel, plural Himmel)
example: Der Himmel ist heute ganz blau. — The sky is completely blue today.

hindi: उधर — वक्ता से दूर की दिशा में
definition: there, in the direction away from the speaker toward a place, the small word that marks movement away
example: Wir fahren morgen hin und abends zurück. — We drive there tomorrow and back in the evening.

hindi: ऊपर की ओर — वक्ता से दूर, चढ़ते हुए
definition: upwards and away from the speaker, climbing or moving toward a higher place such as a hill or stairs
example: Wir stiegen den Berg hinauf. — We climbed up the mountain.

hindi: बाहर की ओर — वक्ता से दूर, बाहर जाते हुए
definition: outwards and away from the speaker, moving from inside toward the outside of a building or space
example: Er ging leise zur Tür hinaus. — He went quietly out through the door.

hindi: बना लेना — कोशिश करके काम ठीक कर लेना
definition: to manage or get something to work after some effort, everyday but slightly neater than hinkriegen (separable: bekommt hin, hat hinbekommen)
example: Ich habe die Reparatur ganz allein hinbekommen. — I managed the repair all by myself.

hindi: अंदर की ओर — वक्ता से दूर, भीतर जाते हुए
definition: inwards and away from the speaker, moving from outside into a building, room or container
example: Sie gingen langsam ins Haus hinein. — They went slowly into the house.

hindi: गिर पड़ना — चलते-चलते ज़मीन पर गिर जाना
definition: to fall down onto the ground while walking, running or standing, the everyday verb for taking a tumble (separable: fällt hin, ist hingefallen)
example: Das Kind ist beim Spielen hingefallen. — The child fell down while playing.

hindi: इसके विपरीत — दो बातों की तुलना में भेद दिखाने वाला शब्द
definition: on the other hand, by contrast; a formal adverb setting two things against each other
example: Der Sommer war heiß, der Winter hingegen mild. — The summer was hot, the winter by contrast mild.

hindi: कान लगाना — ध्यान से सुनने की कोशिश करना
definition: to listen closely or pay attention to a sound, often as genau hinhören when catching a detail (separable: hört hin, hat hingehört)
example: Wenn du genau hinhörst, hörst du das Meer. — If you listen closely, you can hear the sea.

hindi: लँगड़ाना — एक पैर पर ज़ोर न दे पाने से असमान चलना
definition: to limp or walk unevenly because one leg or foot is injured or weak, also said of a comparison that does not quite hold (regular: hat gehinkt)
example: Seit dem Unfall hinkt er ein wenig. — Since the accident he limps a little.

hindi: कर लेना — किसी तरह काम बना लेना (बोलचाल)
definition: to manage, pull off or get something sorted, relaxed colloquial word for succeeding (separable: kriegt hin, hat hingekriegt)
example: Das kriegen wir schon irgendwie hin. — We'll manage that somehow.

hindi: रख देना — किसी चीज़ को सामने रख देना या स्वयं लेट जाना
definition: to put or place something down at a particular spot; the reflexive sich hinlegen means to lie down and recline for a short rest (separable: legt hin, hat hingelegt)
example: Leg das Handy einfach hier hin. — Just put the phone down here.

hindi: ध्यान से देखना — किसी ओर नज़र ले जाना
definition: to look toward something or to look closely at it instead of turning away, often used as genau hinsehen (separable, irregular: sieht hin, hat hingesehen)
example: Wenn man genau hinsieht, erkennt man den Fehler. — If you look closely, you notice the mistake.

hindi: के विषय में — किसी पहलू या मामले के लिहाज़ से
definition: with regard to, concerning a particular aspect or matter being considered, formal written register (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Hinsichtlich der Kosten gibt es noch Fragen. — With regard to the costs there are still questions.

hindi: रख छोड़ना — किसी चीज़ को किसी जगह खड़ा कर देना
definition: to put or set something down in a place, standing upright, like placing a vase or a suitcase somewhere (separable: stellt hin, hat hingestellt)
example: Wo soll ich den Koffer hinstellen? — Where should I put the suitcase?

hindi: पीछे — पिछले हिस्से में, पीछे की ओर
definition: at the back or in the rear part of a room, vehicle or queue, the everyday word for the position farthest from the entrance or facing side
example: Die Toiletten sind hinten links. — The toilets are at the back on the left.

hindi: के पीछे — किसी चीज़ की पिछली ओर
definition: behind something, on the far side of it away from the viewer, both in space and in the order of things (+ Dativ for location, + Akkusativ for movement)
example: Der Parkplatz ist hinter dem Haus. — The car park is behind the house.

hindi: गाँठ बाँध लेना — कोई सबक पक्का याद रखना
definition: to make a firm mental note of a lesson and never forget it again, often said as a warning (sich etwas hinter die Ohren schreiben; hat sich geschrieben)
example: Das schreib dir mal hinter die Ohren! — You had better remember that!

hindi: पृष्ठभूमि — किसी बात के पीछे की परिस्थिति या कारण
definition: the background of an event or a person, the circumstances and history behind something that explain it, also the rear part of a picture (der Hintergrund, plural Hintergründe)
example: Die Zeitung erklärt den politischen Hintergrund der Krise. — The newspaper explains the political background of the crisis.

hindi: कपटी — पीठ पीछे चाल चलने वाला और धूर्त
definition: sneaky and underhanded, secretly scheming against people while seeming friendly to their face
example: Das war ein hinterhältiger Trick. — That was an underhanded trick.

hindi: पिछवाड़े का इलाका — तट या बड़े शहर के पीछे फैला भीतरी, कम आबाद क्षेत्र
definition: the inland region lying behind a coast, port or large city, remote from the centre and thinly settled (das Hinterland, plural Hinterländer)
example: Die Bauern aus dem Hinterland verkaufen Gemüse auf dem Markt. — Farmers from the hinterland sell vegetables at the market.

hindi: नीचे की ओर — वक्ता से दूर, उतरते हुए
definition: downwards and away from the speaker, descending or moving toward a lower place such as a valley or cellar
example: Sie liefen die Treppe hinunter. — They ran down the stairs.

hindi: उस पार जाते हुए — वक्ता से दूर, दूसरी तरफ़
definition: across and away from the speaker, moving over to the other side of a street, river or room
example: Wir gingen über die Brücke hinüber. — We walked across over the bridge.

hindi: बारहसिंगा — बड़े सींगों वाला जंगल का जानवर
definition: a stag or deer, the large forest animal whose male carries branching antlers (der Hirsch, plural Hirsche)
example: Im Herbst röhrt der Hirsch im Wald. — In autumn the stag bellows in the forest.

hindi: ऐतिहासिक — इतिहास से जुड़ा या इतिहास में महत्त्वपूर्ण
definition: historic or historical, belonging to the past or important enough to be remembered in history
example: Das war ein historischer Moment für das ganze Land. — That was a historic moment for the whole country.

hindi: गर्मी — तपाने वाला ऊँचा तापमान
definition: heat, high temperature that makes people sweat and seek shade during a summer day (die Hitze, no plural)
example: Bei dieser Hitze kann ich nicht arbeiten. — I cannot work in this heat.

hindi: गर्मी की छुट्टी — भीषण गर्मी के कारण स्कूल की जल्दी छुट्टी
definition: released from school early because the temperature is too high for lessons, used with haben or bekommen
example: Bei 32 Grad bekommen wir hitzefrei. — At 32 degrees we get sent home for the heat.

hindi: लू का दौर — कई दिनों की असामान्य भीषण गर्मी
definition: a heatwave, a stretch of several days with unusually high temperatures that strain people and crops (die Hitzewelle, plural Hitzewellen)
example: Die Hitzewelle dauert schon zwei Wochen. — The heatwave has already lasted two weeks.

hindi: शौक — फ़ुरसत में मन से किया जाने वाला काम
definition: a hobby, a leisure activity pursued regularly for pleasure rather than money (das Hobby, plural Hobbys)
example: Mein Hobby ist Fotografieren. — My hobby is photography.

hindi: ऊँचा — ज़मीन से बहुत ऊपर तक जाने वाला
definition: high or tall in height above the ground, describing buildings, mountains, prices and levels, the basic word for height
example: Der Turm ist sehr hoch. — The tower is very tall.

hindi: ऊँची इमारत — बहुत सारी मंज़िलों वाला भवन
definition: a high-rise building, a tall block with many storeys used for flats or offices in a city (das Hochhaus, plural Hochhäuser)
example: Sie wohnt im zwölften Stock eines Hochhauses. — She lives on the twelfth floor of a high-rise.

hindi: ऊपर उठाना — किसी चीज़ या बच्चे को ऊँचा उठाना
definition: to lift something or someone up high, such as raising a child into the air or hoisting a suitcase (separable: hebt hoch, hat hochgehoben)
example: Der Vater hebt das Kind hoch, damit es besser sieht. — The father lifts the child up so it can see better.

hindi: चढ़ाना — अपने यंत्र से संचिका अंतरजाल पर डालना
definition: to upload a file, photo or video from a computer or phone onto a website or cloud service; the opposite of herunterladen (separable: lädt hoch, hat hochgeladen)
example: Sie hat die Fotos in die Cloud hochgeladen. — She uploaded the photos to the cloud.

hindi: ऊँचा पठार — समुद्र तल से बहुत ऊपर स्थित प्रदेश
definition: highland or upland, an elevated region of hills and plateaus lying well above sea level (das Hochland, plural Hochländer)
example: Im Hochland ist das Klima rauer. — In the highlands the climate is harsher.

hindi: उच्च शिक्षा संस्थान — विश्वविद्यालय या उसके समकक्ष कोई भी कॉलेज
definition: a higher education institution in general, the umbrella word covering universities and colleges where students study for degrees (die Hochschule, plural Hochschulen)
example: Die Hochschule bietet viele technische Studiengänge an. — The college offers many technical degree programmes.

hindi: भरी गर्मी — गर्मी की ऋतु का सबसे तपता मध्य भाग
definition: high summer, the hottest middle stretch of the summer season when the heat peaks (der Hochsommer, plural Hochsommer)
example: Im Hochsommer ist die Stadt fast leer. — In high summer the city is almost empty.

hindi: बाढ़ — नदी का पानी किनारे लाँघ जाना
definition: flooding, the high water of a river that rises over its banks after heavy rain or melting snow (das Hochwasser, plural Hochwasser)
example: Das Hochwasser erreicht die ersten Häuser. — The floodwater reaches the first houses.

hindi: उच्च गुणवत्ता का — बढ़िया, उत्कृष्ट
definition: high-quality, premium and well made, used of materials, products and ingredients that are superior in quality
example: Die Jacke ist aus hochwertigem Stoff. — The jacket is made of high-quality fabric.

hindi: शादी — विवाह का समारोह और उत्सव
definition: the wedding, the ceremony and celebration at which two people are married before family and friends (die Hochzeit, plural Hochzeiten)
example: Die Hochzeit findet im Juni statt. — The wedding takes place in June.

hindi: मूढ़ा — बिना पीठ की छोटी बैठकी
definition: a stool, the small seat without a back or armrests, used at a counter or in a kitchen (der Hocker, plural Hocker)
example: Setz dich auf den Hocker. — Sit down on the stool.

hindi: आशा करना — किसी अच्छी बात की उम्मीद रखना
definition: to hope, to wish for something good and quietly expect that it might really happen soon (regular: hat gehofft; auf + Akkusativ)
example: Wir hoffen auf besseres Wetter am Sonntag. — We are hoping for better weather on Sunday.

hindi: किसी बात की आशा रखना — अच्छे नतीजे की उम्मीद लगाए रहना
definition: to hope for something, to wait with confident expectation that a good outcome will come (auf + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Wir hoffen auf besseres Wetter am Wochenende. — We are hoping for better weather at the weekend.

hindi: उम्मीद है कि — काश ऐसा ही हो
definition: hopefully, I hope that; an adverb expressing the speaker's wish that something desirable will actually happen
example: Hoffentlich kommt der Zug pünktlich. — Hopefully the train comes on time.

hindi: आशा — मनचाही बात के होने की उम्मीद
definition: hope, the confident trusting expectation that something wished for will actually happen in the future (die Hoffnung, plural Hoffnungen)
example: Wir haben die Hoffnung noch nicht aufgegeben. — We haven't given up hope yet.

hindi: खोखला — अंदर से खाली
definition: hollow with an empty space inside, describing tree trunks, teeth and cheeks, also empty-sounding for voices and phrases
example: Der Baum ist innen hohl. — The tree is hollow inside.

hindi: लाना — जाकर कोई चीज़ या व्यक्ति साथ ले आना
definition: to fetch, going to get something or someone and bringing them back with you (regular: holt, hat geholt)
example: Ich hole die Kinder von der Schule. — I fetch the children from school.

hindi: लकड़ी — पेड़ के तने से मिलने वाला पदार्थ, जिससे फ़र्नीचर बनता है
definition: wood, the hard material from the trunks and branches of trees, used for furniture, floors and burning in a stove (das Holz, plural Hölzer)
example: Der Tisch ist aus Holz. — The table is made of wood.

hindi: घर से काम — दफ़्तर के बजाय घर बैठकर नौकरी करना
definition: working from home, doing office work remotely from home instead of at the company premises (das Homeoffice, plural Homeoffices)
example: Freitags arbeite ich im Homeoffice. — On Fridays I work from home.

hindi: शहद — मधुमक्खियों का बनाया मीठा गाढ़ा पदार्थ
definition: honey, the sweet golden substance made by bees and spread on bread or stirred into tea, sold at every weekly market (der Honig, plural Honige)
example: Der Honig kommt vom Imker nebenan. — The honey comes from the beekeeper next door.

hindi: कान लगाना — चुपके से या सतर्क होकर सुनना
definition: to listen carefully or eavesdrop, straining the ears to catch a faint or hidden sound (regular)
example: Er horchte an der Tür, hörte aber nichts. — He listened at the door but heard nothing.

hindi: क्षितिज — जहाँ आसमान ज़मीन से मिलता दिखता है
definition: the horizon, the distant apparent line where the land or ocean seems to meet the sky (der Horizont, plural Horizonte)
example: Die Sonne verschwindet hinter dem Horizont. — The sun disappears behind the horizon.

hindi: स्कूल-बाद देखभाल केंद्र — छुट्टी के बाद बच्चों की देखरेख और गृहकार्य की जगह
definition: an after-school care centre where primary pupils are supervised, fed and helped with homework until parents finish work (der Hort, plural Horte)
example: Nach der Schule geht sie bis vier Uhr in den Hort. — After school she goes to after-school care until four.

hindi: पतलून — दोनों टाँगों को अलग-अलग ढकने वाला निचला वस्त्र
definition: trousers or pants, the garment that covers the legs separately from the waist downwards (die Hose, plural Hosen)
example: Die Hose ist mir zu lang. — The trousers are too long for me.

hindi: अंतिम देखभाल गृह — मरणासन्न रोगियों की शांति से देखभाल की जगह
definition: a hospice, a place where dying people are cared for with comfort in their final weeks (das Hospiz, plural Hospize)
example: Er verbrachte seine letzten Wochen im Hospiz. — He spent his last weeks in the hospice.

hindi: अतिथिगृह — पैसे देकर ठहरने की जगह, जहाँ कमरे और सेवाएँ मिलती हैं
definition: a hotel, a commercial building where travellers pay to sleep in furnished rooms with service (das Hotel, plural Hotels)
example: Das Hotel liegt direkt am Bahnhof. — The hotel is right by the railway station.

hindi: मुर्गी — अंडे देने वाला घरेलू पक्षी
definition: a chicken, the domestic bird kept for its eggs and meat, the general word covering hens and roosters (das Huhn, plural Hühner)
example: Das Huhn läuft frei im Hof herum. — The chicken runs free around the yard.

hindi: चैन से न बैठ पाना — बेचैनी से हिलते-डुलते रहना
definition: to be restless and unable to stay seated, fidgeting constantly with nervous energy, said especially of lively children (colloquial, literally to have bumblebees in the backside)
example: Das Kind hat Hummeln im Hintern und kann nicht ruhig sitzen. — The child has ants in its pants and cannot sit still.

hindi: हास्यबोध — मज़ाक समझने और हँसाने की क्षमता
definition: the sense of humour, the ability to notice and enjoy what is funny, make jokes and laugh at life's troubles (der Humor, no plural)
example: Mein Vater hat einen trockenen Humor. — My father has a dry sense of humour.

hindi: हास्यप्रिय — हँसी-मज़ाक को समझने और करने वाला
definition: humorous and good-humoured, having a sense of humour and taking life with a light touch
example: Der Arzt war freundlich und humorvoll. — The doctor was friendly and humorous.

hindi: लँगड़ाकर चलना — चोट के कारण कठिनाई से आगे बढ़ना
definition: to hobble or limp along painfully because of an injury, moving with difficulty (regular: ist gehumpelt when going somewhere, hat gehumpelt otherwise)
example: Sie humpelt mit dem verletzten Fuß zum Arzt. — She hobbles to the doctor with her injured foot.

hindi: कुत्ता — भौंकने वाला वफ़ादार पालतू जानवर
definition: a dog, the loyal domestic animal that barks and is walked on a leash every day (der Hund, plural Hunde)
example: Der Hund bellt laut im Garten. — The dog barks loudly in the garden.

hindi: सौ — दस दहाइयों की संख्या
definition: the cardinal number hundred, a round figure used for counting euros, people, kilometres and years in everyday conversation
example: Der Tisch kostet fast hundert Euro. — The table costs almost a hundred euros.

hindi: बहुत ख़राब मौसम — ठंडा, गीला और हवादार दिन जिसमें कोई बाहर न निकले
definition: colloquial word for really awful weather, cold, wet and windy, when nobody wants to go outside (das Hundewetter, no plural)
example: Was für ein Hundewetter heute! — What awful weather today!

hindi: भूखा — खाने की तीव्र इच्छा वाला
definition: hungry and wanting food, feeling an empty stomach and the urge to eat a meal
example: Die Kinder sind nach der Schule immer hungrig. — The children are always hungry after school.

hindi: भोंपू बजाना — गाड़ी का भोंपू बजाकर चेताना
definition: to sound the horn of a vehicle as a warning signal to others or out of impatience in traffic (regular: hat gehupt)
example: Hinter mir hupt jemand ungeduldig. — Someone behind me is honking impatiently.

hindi: फुर्ती से सरक जाना — हल्के और तेज़ कदमों से निकल जाना
definition: to scurry, dart or flit quickly and lightly past, of small animals, shadows or a quiet quick person (regular: ist gehuscht)
example: Eine Maus huscht über den Küchenboden. — A mouse scurries across the kitchen floor.

hindi: खाँसी — गले या छाती से ज़ोर से हवा निकलने की तकलीफ़
definition: a cough, the repeated forceful clearing of the throat and chest that comes with colds and infections (der Husten, no plural)
example: Der Husten hält mich nachts wach. — The cough keeps me awake at night.

hindi: टोप — किनारे वाली सख़्त टोपी
definition: a hat, the shaped head covering with a brim worn for sun, style or formal occasions (der Hut, plural Hüte)
example: Der alte Herr zieht höflich den Hut. — The old gentleman politely raises his hat.

hindi: गिरवी ऋण — घर या ज़मीन के बदले लिया गया बैंक कर्ज़
definition: a mortgage, a large bank loan secured against a house or piece of property (die Hypothek, plural Hypotheken)
example: Auf dem Haus liegt noch eine Hypothek. — There is still a mortgage on the house.

hindi: परिकल्पना — जाँच के लिए रखी गई वैज्ञानिक मान्यता
definition: a scientific hypothesis, a provisional assumption formulated so that research and experiments can test whether it holds true (die Hypothese, plural Hypothesen)
example: Die Forscher prüfen ihre Hypothese im Labor. — The researchers are testing their hypothesis in the laboratory.

hindi: मुर्गी का माँस — भूनने के लिए तैयार चिकन
definition: chicken as food, the young bird roasted whole or sold as breast and thigh, the everyday supermarket and rotisserie word (das Hähnchen, plural Hähnchen)
example: Das Hähnchen ist in einer Stunde fertig. — The chicken is ready in an hour.

hindi: क्रोशिया करना — मुड़े हुक से ऊन बुनना
definition: to crochet, to make fabric from yarn with a single hooked needle as a craft hobby (regular: hat gehäkelt)
example: Meine Tante häkelt bunte Topflappen. — My aunt crochets colourful pot holders.

hindi: आधा — दो बराबर हिस्सों में से एक
definition: a half, one of two equal parts into which something is divided, whether a cake, an amount of money or a period of time (die Hälfte, plural Hälften)
example: Die Hälfte des Kuchens ist schon weg. — Half of the cake is already gone.

hindi: हाथ मिलाना — अभिवादन में हाथ पकड़कर दबाना
definition: a handshake, the firm brief grip of hands used in Germany to greet and say goodbye, expected to be firm with eye contact (der Händedruck, plural Händedrücke)
example: Er begrüßte mich mit einem festen Händedruck. — He greeted me with a firm handshake.

hindi: व्यापारी या विक्रेता — सामान ख़रीदकर आगे बेचने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a dealer, trader or merchant who buys goods in order to sell them on, whether from a shop, a market stall or online (der Händler, plural Händler)
example: Der Händler auf dem Markt verkauft frisches Obst. — The trader at the market sells fresh fruit.

hindi: टाँगना — किसी चीज़ को कील या हुक पर लटकाना
definition: to hang something up on a hook or wall; the transitive verb is regular while the intransitive sense to be hanging is strong (hängte, hat gehängt; intransitive hing, hat gehangen)
example: Ich hänge die Jacke an den Haken. — I hang the jacket on the hook.

hindi: बार-बार — कई बार होने वाला
definition: frequently, often, occurring many times, slightly more formal than the everyday word
example: Im Herbst regnet es häufig. — In autumn it frequently rains.

hindi: अत्यधिक — सबसे ऊँचे दर्जे का, बेहद
definition: highly or extremely, an elevated intensifier for the utmost degree, common in formal writing
example: Das ist höchst interessant. — That is highly interesting.

hindi: अधिक से अधिक — इससे ज़्यादा नहीं, अधिकतम इतना
definition: at most, stating the largest number or amount that is possible or allowed, so the real figure could be lower
example: Das Zimmer kostet höchstens fünfzig Euro. — The room costs at most fifty euros.

hindi: विनम्र — आदर और सलीके से पेश आने वाला
definition: polite and courteous, showing respect and good manners towards other people (regular adjective)
example: Der Kellner war sehr höflich zu uns. — The waiter was very polite to us.

hindi: शिष्टता — दूसरों के साथ आदर और सलीके से पेश आना
definition: the politeness and courtesy shown in respectful, considerate behaviour and speech towards other people (die Höflichkeit, no plural)
example: Die Höflichkeit des Kellners hat uns sehr gefallen. — We really liked the waiter's politeness.

hindi: ऊँचाई — नीचे से ऊपर तक का नाप या स्तर
definition: height or altitude, the measured distance of something from bottom to top or above ground level, also the level of a price or amount (die Höhe, plural Höhen)
example: Der Berg hat eine Höhe von dreitausend Metern. — The mountain has a height of three thousand metres.

hindi: गुफा — चट्टान या पहाड़ में प्राकृतिक खोखली जगह
definition: a cave, a natural hollow space inside a rock or mountain large enough to enter (die Höhle, plural Höhlen)
example: In der Höhle ist es kalt und dunkel. — Inside the cave it is cold and dark.

hindi: नरक — पापियों की मृत्यु के बाद की सज़ा की जगह
definition: hell, the place of punishment after death for the wicked, also colloquially any unbearable situation (die Hölle, plural Höllen)
example: Die Prüfungswoche war die Hölle. — Exam week was hell.

hindi: ज़रा सुनो — बात शुरू करने से पहले ध्यान माँगना
definition: listen, hey; a colloquial opener that claims attention before a request, objection or piece of news
example: Hör mal, ich muss dir etwas sagen. — Listen, I have to tell you something.

hindi: सुनना — कान से आवाज़ को ग्रहण करना
definition: to hear, to perceive sounds, noises and voices with the ears, also to listen to music or someone (regular)
example: Ich höre dich schlecht, sprich bitte lauter. — I can hardly hear you, please speak louder.

hindi: श्रवण यंत्र — कान में लगाने वाला आवाज़ बढ़ाने वाला उपकरण
definition: a hearing aid, the small electronic device worn inside the ear to make sounds louder (das Hörgerät, plural Hörgeräte)
example: Ohne ihr Hörgerät versteht meine Oma fast nichts. — Without her hearing aid my grandma understands almost nothing.

hindi: व्याख्यान कक्ष — सैकड़ों छात्रों के लिए सीढ़ीदार बड़ा हॉल
definition: a lecture hall, the large tiered room at a university where hundreds of students attend a lecture (der Hörsaal, plural Hörsäle)
example: Der Hörsaal war schon zehn Minuten vor Beginn voll. — The lecture hall was already full ten minutes before the start.

hindi: कूल्हा — कमर के नीचे शरीर के दोनों ओर का चौड़ा जोड़
definition: the hip or hipbone, the wide joint area on either side of the body below the waist where the leg joins (die Hüfte, plural Hüften)
example: Meine Oma hat sich die Hüfte gebrochen. — My grandmother broke her hip.

hindi: कूल्हे का सोना — कमर और कूल्हों पर जमी अतिरिक्त चर्बी का प्यारा नाम
definition: an affectionate joking name for the extra body fat that gathers around the hips and waist, usually blamed on cake and chocolate (das Hüftgold, no plural)
example: Noch ein Stück Kuchen? Das wird Hüftgold! — Another slice of cake? That will end up on my hips!

hindi: पहाड़ी — पहाड़ से छोटी, ज़मीन की गोल ऊँचाई
definition: a hill, a rounded natural elevation of land lower and gentler than a mountain (der Hügel, plural Hügel)
example: Vom Hügel aus sieht man das ganze Dorf. — From the hill you can see the whole village.

hindi: उछलना — छोटी-छोटी कुदानें भरना
definition: to hop or bounce along with small light jumps, of children, rabbits and birds (regular: ist gehüpft)
example: Das Mädchen hüpft fröhlich über die Straße. — The girl hops cheerfully across the street.

hindi: मैं — बोलने वाला अपने लिए जो शब्द कहता है
definition: the first person singular pronoun with which the speaker refers to himself or herself, always lowercase except at the start of a sentence (Akkusativ mich, Dativ mir)
example: Ich komme aus Indien. — I come from India.

hindi: विचारों का इतिहास — धारणाओं की सदियों भर की यात्रा
definition: the study of how thoughts themselves travel, mutate and acquire authority across the centuries
example: Read enough Ideengeschichte and today's certainties start looking seasonal.

hindi: झाऊ चूहा — काँटों वाला छोटा जानवर जो ख़तरे में गेंद बन जाता है
definition: a hedgehog, the small spiny nocturnal animal that rolls into a ball when frightened (der Igel, plural Igel)
example: Der Igel rollt sich zu einer Kugel zusammen. — The hedgehog rolls itself into a ball.

hindi: तुम लोग / उसका (स्त्री का) — बहुवचन अनौपचारिक सम्बोधन और स्त्रीलिंग स्वामित्व
definition: the informal pronoun addressing several people at once, such as friends or children in a group, and also the possessive word meaning belonging to a female person or to several people (Akkusativ und Dativ euch)
example: Habt ihr schon gegessen? — Have you all eaten already?

hindi: ग़ैरक़ानूनी — क़ानून के ख़िलाफ़
definition: illegal, against the legal rules of the country, describing an action or trade that the statutes do not permit
example: Das Herunterladen des Films ist illegal. — Downloading the film is illegal.

hindi: सचित्र पत्रिका — तस्वीरों से भरी हल्की-फुल्की मैगज़ीन
definition: an illustrated magazine, the picture-heavy weekly periodical with celebrity stories, fashion and light reading (die Illustrierte, plural Illustrierten)
example: Beim Friseur lag eine alte Illustrierte auf dem Tisch. — At the hairdresser an old illustrated magazine lay on the table.

hindi: सच में — मज़ाक नहीं, गंभीरता से
definition: seriously, no kidding; used as a question of disbelief or a statement that something is not a joke
example: Im Ernst? Du hast gekündigt? — Seriously? You quit?

hindi: मूल रूप से, असल में — ऊपरी बातें हटाकर सार कहने वाला वाक्यांश
definition: a set phrase meaning basically or fundamentally that strips away details to state the essential truth
example: Im Grunde hast du recht. — Basically, you're right.

hindi: नाश्ता-ठेला — जल्दी का हल्का खाना और उसे बेचने वाली छोटी दुकान
definition: a snack bar or food stand, and the quick small meal eaten there, such as sausage with fries (der Imbiss, plural Imbisse)
example: Am Imbiss gibt es Currywurst mit Pommes. — At the snack stand there is currywurst with fries.

hindi: नामांकन — विश्वविद्यालय में औपचारिक पंजीकरण
definition: enrolment or matriculation, the formal registration of a student at a university before studies begin (die Immatrikulation, plural Immatrikulationen)
example: Die Immatrikulation ist bis Ende September möglich. — Enrolment is possible until the end of September.

hindi: हमेशा — हर बार, सदा
definition: always, at all times, every single time without any exception, the strongest frequency word
example: Sie kommt immer zu spät. — She always comes late.

hindi: नाक की सीध में — बस सीधे आगे चलते जाओ, रास्ता बताने का जवाब
definition: straight ahead following one's nose, the cheerful answer when someone asks for directions (colloquial directions phrase)
example: Zum Bahnhof? Immer der Nase nach! — To the station? Just follow your nose!

hindi: फिर भी — चलो, इतना तो है
definition: after all, at least, all the same; acknowledging a positive aspect despite an overall disappointing situation
example: Immerhin haben wir es versucht. — At least we tried.

hindi: प्रतिरक्षा तंत्र — बीमारी से लड़ने वाली शरीर की प्रणाली
definition: the immune system, the body's defence network that fights infection and disease (das Immunsystem, plural Immunsysteme)
example: Schlaf und Bewegung stärken das Immunsystem. — Sleep and exercise strengthen the immune system.

hindi: टीका लगाना — रोग से बचाव का इंजेक्शन देना
definition: to vaccinate, to give someone a protective injection against a particular disease (regular: hat geimpft; often sich impfen lassen)
example: Ich lasse mich jedes Jahr gegen Grippe impfen. — I get vaccinated against the flu every year.

hindi: टीका — रोग से बचाव के लिए लगाई जाने वाली सुई
definition: a vaccination or inoculation, the protective shot that trains the body to fight a particular disease (die Impfung, plural Impfungen)
example: Die Impfung gegen Grippe ist kostenlos. — The flu vaccination is free.

hindi: पीछे पड़ जाना — एक ही माँग बार-बार दोहराकर किसी को तंग करना
definition: to keep pestering someone with the same request, nagging persistently until they finally give in (jemandem mit etwas in den Ohren liegen; hat gelegen)
example: Die Kinder liegen mir seit Wochen mit dem Hund in den Ohren. — The kids have been nagging me about the dog for weeks.

hindi: पीठ में छुरा घोंपना — भरोसा करने वाले साथी को धोखा देना
definition: to stab someone in the back, betraying a partner or ally by attacking when they least expect it (jemandem in den Rücken fallen; ist gefallen)
example: Sein Partner ist ihm in den Rücken gefallen. — His partner stabbed him in the back.

hindi: कड़वा घूँट पीना — मजबूरी में अप्रिय काम करना
definition: to accept doing something unpleasant because there is simply no alternative, facing a disagreeable task bravely, to bite the bullet
example: Ich muss in den sauren Apfel beißen und das Wochenende arbeiten. — I have to bite the bullet and work the weekend.

hindi: करके — किस तरीके से नतीजा मिला यह बताने वाला शब्द
definition: by doing something; a conjunction that explains the means or method by which a result is achieved
example: Man lernt Deutsch, indem man jeden Tag spricht. — One learns German by speaking every day.

hindi: उद्योग — कारख़ानों में बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन का क्षेत्र
definition: industry, the sector of the economy that manufactures goods in factories on a large scale, or one branch of it (die Industrie, plural Industrien)
example: Die Industrie braucht mehr Fachkräfte. — Industry needs more skilled workers.

hindi: के परिणामस्वरूप — किसी घटना के नतीजे के कारण
definition: as a result of, in consequence of a cause or preceding event, formal written register (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Infolge des Unfalls war die Straße gesperrt. — As a result of the accident the road was closed.

hindi: इसके फलस्वरूप — घटना और उसके सीधे नतीजे को जोड़ने वाला औपचारिक शब्द
definition: as a consequence of that; a formal written adverb linking an event to its direct result
example: Der Zug fiel aus, infolgedessen kam sie zu spät. — The train was cancelled, as a consequence she arrived late.

hindi: कंप्यूटर विशेषज्ञ — सॉफ़्टवेयर और कंप्यूटर व्यवस्थाएँ बनाने वाला पेशेवर
definition: a computer scientist or software professional, someone trained in computing who develops programs and systems (der Informatiker, plural Informatiker)
example: Der Informatiker arbeitet meistens im Homeoffice. — The computer scientist mostly works from home.

hindi: अभियंता — मशीनें, पुल या तकनीकी व्यवस्थाएँ बनाने वाला पेशेवर
definition: an engineer, the technically trained professional who designs and builds machines, structures or systems (der Ingenieur, plural Ingenieure)
example: Der Ingenieur plant die neue Brücke. — The engineer is planning the new bridge.

hindi: देश के भीतर — अपना देश, विदेश के विपरीत
definition: the home country or domestic territory, the inside of one's own country as opposed to abroad, also the interior away from the coast (das Inland, no plural)
example: Die Firma verkauft nur im Inland. — The company sells only domestically.

hindi: भीतर — किसी वस्तु के अंदरूनी हिस्से में
definition: on the inside or inner surface of an object, building or container, describing the interior part rather than the outer face
example: Die Jacke ist innen weich gefüttert. — The jacket is softly lined on the inside.

hindi: शहर का भीतरी हिस्सा — दुकानों और दफ़्तरों वाला केंद्रीय इलाक़ा
definition: the inner part of a town or city where shops, offices and public buildings crowd together, the downtown area (die Innenstadt, plural Innenstädte)
example: Am Samstag fahren wir in die Innenstadt zum Einkaufen. — On Saturday we are going downtown to shop.

hindi: भीतरी आलस्य — मन का वह कमज़ोर हिस्सा जो मेहनत से बचना चाहता है
definition: the lazy inner voice that tempts a person to skip exercise, work or duty, which must be overcome by willpower (der innere Schweinehund, no plural)
example: Heute Morgen habe ich den inneren Schweinehund besiegt und bin joggen gegangen. — This morning I beat my inner lazy self and went jogging.

hindi: के भीतर — किसी सीमा या समय-अवधि के अंदर
definition: within, inside the boundary of a place or inside a stated period of time (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Bitte antworten Sie innerhalb einer Woche. — Please reply within a week.

hindi: के भीतर — किसी समय सीमा के अंदर, स्विस और ऑस्ट्रियाई दफ़्तरी शब्द
definition: within a stated period of time, a Swiss and Austrian preposition used in official notices and deadlines where Germany says innerhalb (+ Genitiv, also + Dativ)
example: Bitte antworten Sie innert zehn Tagen. — Please reply within ten days.

hindi: ध्यान खींचना — तुरंत नज़र में आ जाना, अलग दिखना
definition: to catch the eye and be immediately noticeable, something striking that stands out clearly from its surroundings (ist ins Auge gefallen)
example: Das rote Kleid fiel sofort ins Auge. — The red dress caught the eye at once.

hindi: उलटा पड़ जाना — किसी जोखिम भरी योजना का बुरी तरह बिगड़ जाना
definition: to go badly wrong and end in disaster, said of a risky plan that backfires painfully (colloquial; ist ins Auge gegangen)
example: Das kann leicht ins Auge gehen. — That can easily go badly wrong.

hindi: सोने जाना — दिन ख़त्म कर बिस्तर पर जाना
definition: to go to bed at the close of the evening, retiring to the bedroom and sleeping through the whole night (geht ins Bett, ist ins Bett gegangen)
example: Ich gehe heute früh ins Bett. — I am going to bed early today.

hindi: अनजाने में ठेस पहुँचाना — बिना सोचे बोलकर शर्मिंदगी मोल लेना
definition: to say something tactless without meaning to and embarrass oneself or offend someone (colloquial, perfect: ist getreten)
example: Mit der Frage nach ihrem Alter bin ich ins Fettnäpfchen getreten. — Asking about her age, I really put my foot in it.

hindi: मर जाना — चलती-फिरती बोली में मौत का इशारा
definition: to perish or die, a blunt and casual expression for somebody's death, often used about villains in films or soldiers in battle (colloquial, literally to bite into the grass; perfect: hat ins Gras gebissen)
example: In dem Film beißt der Bösewicht am Ende ins Gras. — In the film the villain bites the dust in the end.

hindi: विशेषकर — खासकर, ख़ास तौर से यह
definition: in particular, especially; a formal adverb that singles out the most important member of a group being mentioned
example: Kinder, insbesondere Kleinkinder, brauchen viel Schlaf. — Children, especially toddlers, need a lot of sleep.

hindi: द्वीप — चारों ओर पानी से घिरी ज़मीन
definition: an island, a piece of land completely surrounded by water in a sea, lake or river (die Insel, plural Inseln)
example: Die Insel erreicht man nur mit der Fähre. — You reach the island only by ferry.

hindi: कुल मिलाकर — सब कुछ जोड़कर
definition: altogether or in total, giving the complete sum or number when all the parts are added together
example: Insgesamt waren dreißig Personen da. — Altogether thirty people were there.

hindi: दिवालियापन — कंपनी का क़र्ज़ चुकाने में असमर्थ हो जाना
definition: insolvency or bankruptcy, the legal state of a company that can no longer pay its debts (die Insolvenz, plural Insolvenzen)
example: Die Insolvenz der Firma traf viele Mitarbeiter. — The insolvency of the company hit many employees.

hindi: नलसाज़ मिस्त्री — हीटिंग, पानी और सफ़ाई की व्यवस्था लगाने वाला कारीगर
definition: a plumber or fitter who installs heating, water and sanitary systems, the usual word in Austria (der Installateur, plural Installateure)
example: Der Installateur kommt morgen wegen der Heizung. — The fitter is coming tomorrow about the heating.

hindi: संस्थान — किसी एक विषय पर केंद्रित विश्वविद्यालय इकाई
definition: an institute, the department of a university devoted to teaching and research in one particular subject (das Institut, plural Institute)
example: Das Institut für Physik hat ein neues Labor. — The physics institute has a new laboratory.

hindi: वाद्य यंत्र — संगीत बजाने का उपकरण
definition: a musical instrument, any object such as a piano, violin or drum that is played to produce music, and also a tool or device (das Instrument, plural Instrumente)
example: Welches Instrument spielst du? — Which instrument do you play?

hindi: अक्षुण्ण — पूरी तरह सही, अटूट
definition: intact, undamaged and still fully functioning, used of machines, ecosystems and relationships that remain whole
example: Der Motor ist noch völlig intakt. — The engine is still completely intact.

hindi: दिलचस्प — ध्यान खींचने वाला, जानने योग्य
definition: interesting, engaging, worth attention; the standard neutral word of mild approval for a topic or idea
example: Das ist ein interessanter Gedanke. — That is an interesting thought.

hindi: अंतरजाल — दुनिया भर के संगणकों का जुड़ा हुआ जाल
definition: the internet, the worldwide network of connected computers that carries websites, email and online services (das Internet, no plural)
example: Das Internet ist heute sehr langsam. — The internet is very slow today.

hindi: साक्षात्कार — पत्रकार द्वारा किसी से सवाल-जवाब की बातचीत
definition: an interview, the conversation in which a journalist questions someone for publication or broadcast (das Interview, plural Interviews)
example: Die Sängerin gab der Zeitung ein langes Interview. — The singer gave the newspaper a long interview.

hindi: निवेश करना — मुनाफ़े की आशा में पैसा या समय लगाना
definition: to invest money, time or effort into a business, project or asset hoping for a future return (regular; in + Akkusativ)
example: Die Firma investiert in neue Maschinen. — The company is investing in new machines.

hindi: इस बीच — बीते समय में, अब तक
definition: in the meantime, meanwhile, by now after some time has passed since something started
example: Inzwischen ist das Essen kalt geworden. — In the meantime the food has gone cold.

hindi: कोई भी (एक) — जो भी हो, कोई एक
definition: an indefinite determiner placed before a singular noun to mean some unspecified one or any one at all, declined like ein (irgendeine, irgendeinen)
example: Gib mir irgendein Buch aus dem Regal. — Give me any book from the shelf.

hindi: कुछ भी / कुछ न कुछ — अनिश्चित चीज़
definition: an indefinite pronoun meaning some thing or other, whatever it may be, the emphatic partner of etwas (colloquially shortened to irgendwas)
example: Irgendetwas stimmt hier nicht. — Something or other is wrong here.

hindi: कोई भी (व्यक्ति) — चाहे कोई भी हो
definition: an indefinite pronoun meaning some person or other without caring who, the emphatic partner of jemand stressing that the identity does not matter
example: Irgendjemand hat meinen Regenschirm mitgenommen. — Somebody or other took my umbrella.

hindi: कभी न कभी, किसी समय — अनिश्चित वक़्त पर
definition: sometime, at some unspecified point in the future or past, when the speaker does not know or say when
example: Irgendwann möchte ich nach Japan reisen. — Sometime I would like to travel to Japan.

hindi: कोई न कोई — अनजान व्यक्ति, अनौपचारिक
definition: a colloquial indefinite pronoun meaning somebody or anybody at all, a casual spoken alternative to irgendjemand for an unknown person
example: Irgendwer muss den Müll rausbringen. — Somebody has to take out the rubbish.

hindi: किसी तरह / जैसे-तैसे — अनिश्चित ढंग से
definition: an indefinite adverb of manner meaning in some way or other, and colloquially a hedge meaning kind of or somehow when a feeling is hard to explain
example: Wir schaffen das irgendwie. — We will manage it somehow.

hindi: कहीं — किसी अनिश्चित या अज्ञात जगह पर
definition: somewhere, in some unspecified or unknown place or location, the word used when the exact spot does not matter or is not known
example: Mein Handy liegt irgendwo in der Wohnung. — My phone is somewhere in the apartment.

hindi: कहीं की ओर — किसी अनिश्चित जगह तक जाते हुए
definition: to somewhere, toward some unspecified place, the direction word for going anywhere at all
example: Lass uns am Wochenende irgendwohin fahren. — Let us drive somewhere at the weekend.

hindi: भ्रम — ग़लत समझ या ग़लत धारणा
definition: an error of judgement or mistaken belief, a wrong assumption someone holds, slightly more formal than Fehler (der Irrtum, plural Irrtümer)
example: Das war ein Irrtum, tut mir leid. — That was a mistake, I am sorry.

hindi: जैसा कि पता ही है — बात को सर्वविदित बताने वाला शब्द
definition: beyond its affirmative meaning yes, an unstressed particle that signals the listener already knows this, or with stress turns a command into a firm warning
example: Das Wetter ist ja herrlich heute. — The weather is glorious today, as you can see.

hindi: छोटा कोट — कमर तक का बाँहों वाला बाहरी वस्त्र
definition: a jacket, the short outer garment with sleeves worn over other clothes for warmth or style (die Jacke, plural Jacken)
example: Nimm eine Jacke mit, es wird kühl. — Take a jacket with you, it is getting chilly.

hindi: साल — बारह महीनों की अवधि
definition: a year, the period of twelve months that the earth needs to travel once around the sun (das Jahr, plural Jahre)
example: Das neue Jahr beginnt mit viel Schnee. — The new year begins with lots of snow.

hindi: सालगिरह — किसी घटना की हर साल आने वाली तारीख़
definition: an anniversary, the yearly return of the calendar date on which something important happened (der Jahrestag, plural Jahrestage)
example: Heute ist der zehnte Jahrestag unserer Hochzeit. — Today is the tenth anniversary of our wedding.

hindi: वर्ष-परिवर्तन — पुराने साल के खत्म होकर नए साल के शुरू होने का समय
definition: the turn of the year, the days around New Year when one year ends and the next begins (der Jahreswechsel, plural Jahreswechsel)
example: Zum Jahreswechsel fahren wir zu meinen Eltern. — At the turn of the year we drive to my parents.

hindi: ऋतु — साल का वह हिस्सा जब मौसम एक खास ढंग का रहता है
definition: a season, one of the four divisions of the year marked by its own weather and daylight (die Jahreszeit, plural Jahreszeiten)
example: Der Herbst ist die schönste Jahreszeit. — Autumn is the loveliest season.

hindi: शताब्दी — सौ सालों की अवधि
definition: a century, a period of one hundred years counted together, used for dating buildings, events and eras (das Jahrhundert, plural Jahrhunderte)
example: Die Kirche ist aus dem zwölften Jahrhundert. — The church dates from the twelfth century.

hindi: दशक — दस सालों की अवधि
definition: a decade, a period of ten years counted together, often used when talking about history or long stretches of life (das Jahrzehnt, plural Jahrzehnte)
example: Sie wohnt seit einem Jahrzehnt hier. — She has lived here for a decade.

hindi: रोना-धोना — दुखड़ा रोते हुए शिकायत करना
definition: to whine or lament about troubles, complaining repeatedly in a plaintive, self-pitying tone of voice (regular: jammert, hat gejammert; über + Akkusativ)
example: Er jammert ständig über das Wetter. — He constantly moans about the weather.

hindi: हल्का नाश्ता — दो खानों के बीच रोटी-पनीर वाला छोटा भोजन
definition: a light snack or small cold meal of bread, cheese and cold cuts eaten between main meals, the everyday Austrian word for a break with food (die Jause, plural Jausen)
example: Um vier machen wir eine kleine Jause. — At four we are having a little snack.

hindi: हल्का नाश्ता करना — दोपहर या शाम को छोटा भोजन खाना
definition: to have a light snack or small cold meal between the main meals, the Austrian verb that belongs to the noun Jause (regular: jausnet, hat gejausnet)
example: Wir jausnen auf der Hütte mit Brot und Speck. — We are snacking at the hut with bread and bacon.

hindi: मोटी नीली पतलून — मज़बूत सूती कपड़े से बनी रोज़ की पतलून
definition: jeans, the casual trousers made of sturdy blue denim cotton fabric worn almost everywhere (die Jeans, plural Jeans)
example: Die Jeans ist mir zu lang geworden. — The jeans have become too long for me.

hindi: बहरहाल, हर हाल में — बाकी अनिश्चित हो तो भी पक्की बात कहने वाला शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning in any case or anyway that states what remains certain whatever else may be unclear
example: Ich komme jedenfalls pünktlich. — In any case, I'll be on time.

hindi: हर एक / प्रत्येक — समूह का हर सदस्य अलग-अलग
definition: a singular determiner or pronoun meaning each single one of a group considered separately, declined like the definite article (jede Frau, jedes Kind)
example: Jeder Schüler bekommt ein eigenes Buch. — Every pupil gets a book of his own.

hindi: लेकिन, परंतु — औपचारिक ढंग से विरोध जोड़ने वाला शब्द
definition: a somewhat formal conjunction meaning however that introduces a contrast or objection to the previous statement
example: Er wollte kommen, jedoch hatte er keine Zeit. — He wanted to come, however he had no time.

hindi: हाँ भी ना भी — अधकचरा जवाब
definition: yes and no; a playful colloquial blended answer for a question that deserves partly agreement and partly refusal
example: Hat es geklappt? Jein. — Did it work? Yes and no.

hindi: कोई (व्यक्ति) — अज्ञात या अनिश्चित इंसान
definition: an indefinite pronoun for some unnamed or unknown person, used only in the singular and only for people (Akkusativ jemanden, Dativ jemandem)
example: Jemand hat an der Tür geklingelt. — Somebody rang the doorbell.

hindi: किसी को चिढ़ाना — बार-बार परेशान करके तंग करना
definition: to annoy someone persistently and get on their nerves, becoming increasingly irritating through repetition or behaviour (colloquial, literally to walk on someone's biscuit)
example: Diese Musik geht mir langsam auf den Keks. — This music is slowly getting on my nerves.

hindi: झूठी कहानी सुनाना — किसी को मज़ाक में बेतुकी बात पर विश्वास दिलाना
definition: to tell someone a tall story and make them believe an untrue tale, usually as a joke
example: Glaub ihm nicht, er will dir nur einen Bären aufbinden. — Do not believe him, he is just pulling your leg.

hindi: गुस्सा दिलाना — किसी को क्रोध से आगबबूला कर देना
definition: to make someone furious, driving them up the wall with irritation (colloquial, usually jemanden auf die Palme bringen)
example: Seine Unpünktlichkeit bringt mich jedes Mal auf die Palme. — His lateness drives me up the wall every time.

hindi: बुरी तरह डाँटना — किसी को कड़ी फटकार लगाना
definition: to scold someone harshly and humiliate them with a severe telling-off (colloquial)
example: Der Trainer hat ihn nach dem Spiel zur Schnecke gemacht. — The coach tore him to pieces after the match.

hindi: वह / उधर वाला — दूर वाला या पहले बताया गया
definition: a demonstrative determiner or pronoun meaning that one over there or the earlier of two mentioned, rather formal and literary in everyday speech (jene, jenes)
example: Dieses Bild gefällt mir, jenes nicht. — I like this picture, not that one.

hindi: उस पार — किसी सीमा या नदी के दूसरी तरफ़
definition: on the far side of, beyond a river, border or limit, also figuratively past a threshold (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Jenseits der Grenze spricht man Französisch. — Beyond the border people speak French.

hindi: अब, इस समय — ठीक इसी क्षण, वर्तमान में
definition: now, at this present moment, the basic everyday adverb for the current time in speech and writing
example: Jetzt habe ich endlich Zeit für dich. — Now I finally have time for you.

hindi: नौकरी — बोलचाल में कोई भी काम या कमाई का ज़रिया
definition: a job, colloquial everyday word for paid work of any kind, often temporary or casual employment (der Job, plural Jobs)
example: Sie hat einen neuen Job in Berlin gefunden. — She has found a new job in Berlin.

hindi: योडल गाना — गले और सिर की आवाज़ बदल-बदल कर पहाड़ी ढंग से गाना
definition: to sing in the Alpine style that switches rapidly between low chest voice and high head voice without words (regular)
example: Auf der Alm jodelt der Bauer jeden Morgen. — On the mountain pasture the farmer yodels every morning.

hindi: धीमी दौड़ लगाना — व्यायाम के लिए धीमी सम गति से दौड़ना
definition: to jog, to run at a slow steady pace for fitness rather than speed, usually in a park or along a street (regular, ist gejoggt)
example: Morgens jogge ich eine halbe Stunde im Park. — In the mornings I jog for half an hour in the park.

hindi: दही — जमाया हुआ खट्टा गाढ़ा दूध
definition: yoghurt, the thick tangy fermented milk eaten plain, with fruit or over muesli, sold in small pots in every supermarket (der Joghurt, plural Joghurts)
example: Ich esse jeden Morgen einen Joghurt. — I eat a yoghurt every morning.

hindi: पत्रकार — अख़बार, रेडियो या टीवी के लिए ख़बरें लिखने वाला
definition: a journalist, the person who researches and writes news reports for newspapers, radio, television or online media (der Journalist, plural Journalisten)
example: Der Journalist stellt dem Minister kritische Fragen. — The journalist asks the minister critical questions.

hindi: जयंती — किसी घटना की गोल संख्या वाली सालगिरह
definition: a jubilee or anniversary, the celebration of a round number of years since a founding or marriage (das Jubiläum, plural Jubiläen)
example: Das Jubiläum der Firma wird groß gefeiert. — The company's anniversary is celebrated in style.

hindi: जवानी — किशोरावस्था का समय, या सारे युवा लोग
definition: the youth, the years between childhood and adulthood, or young people taken together as a group (die Jugend, no plural)
example: In meiner Jugend habe ich viel Fußball gespielt. — In my youth I played a lot of football.

hindi: युवा-निवास — सस्ता साझा ठिकाना, जहाँ कई लोग एक कमरे में सोते हैं
definition: a youth hostel, cheap accommodation with shared dormitory rooms popular with young travellers and school groups (die Jugendherberge, plural Jugendherbergen)
example: Die Jugendherberge kostet nur zwanzig Euro pro Nacht. — The youth hostel costs only twenty euros per night.

hindi: किशोर — तेरह से अठारह साल का युवा व्यक्ति
definition: the teenager or adolescent, a young person between roughly thirteen and eighteen, declined like an adjective (der/die Jugendliche, plural Jugendlichen)
example: Die Jugendlichen treffen sich abends im Park. — The teenagers meet in the park in the evening.

hindi: जवान — कम उम्र का, युवा
definition: young, having lived only a short time, youthful in years, also used of fresh businesses or plants (comparative jünger)
example: Meine Schwester ist noch sehr jung. — My sister is still very young.

hindi: कुँवारेपन की विदाई — शादी से पहले दोस्तों की पार्टी
definition: a bachelor party held by friends before the wedding to say farewell to single life, often loud and travelling through the town (der Junggesellenabschied, plural Junggesellenabschiede)
example: Sein Junggesellenabschied fand in Prag statt. — His bachelor party took place in Prague.

hindi: क़ानूनविद् — क़ानून की पढ़ाई किया हुआ पेशेवर, वकील या जज
definition: a jurist or legal professional, anyone with a law degree such as a lawyer, judge or legal adviser (der Jurist, plural Juristen)
example: Der Jurist prüft den Vertrag sehr genau. — The legal professional checks the contract very carefully.

hindi: वार्षिक — हर साल होने वाला
definition: yearly, annual, happening once every year around the same date
example: Das Fest findet jährlich im Mai statt. — The festival takes place annually in May.

hindi: जनवरी — साल का पहला महीना, ऑस्ट्रिया में इसी नाम से पुकारा जाता है
definition: the month of January as Austrians call it, the first month of the calendar year where Germany would say Januar (der Jänner, plural Jänner)
example: Im Jänner fahren wir zum Skifahren nach Tirol. — In January we are going skiing in Tyrol.

hindi: निराई करना — क्यारी से खरपतवार उखाड़ना
definition: to weed, to pull unwanted wild plants out of a garden bed by hand or with a hoe (regular: jätet, hat gejätet)
example: Am Wochenende jäte ich das ganze Beet. — At the weekend I weed the whole bed.

hindi: तार — बिजली या संकेत ले जाने वाली ढकी हुई डोरी
definition: a cable or wire, the insulated cord that carries electricity or signals between devices (das Kabel, plural Kabel)
example: Das Kabel ist zu kurz für den Fernseher. — The cable is too short for the television.

hindi: कहवा — भुने बीजों से बना गरम कड़वा पेय
definition: coffee, the hot drink brewed from roasted beans that Germans drink at breakfast and again in the afternoon (der Kaffee, plural Kaffees)
example: Der Kaffee hier ist stark und heiß. — The coffee here is strong and hot.

hindi: गप्पों वाली कॉफ़ी-बैठक — मीठे के साथ बतकही
definition: an afternoon gathering over coffee and cake where the actual business being conducted is gossip
example: Her Sunday Kaffeeklatsch ran three hours and settled every rumour on the street.

hindi: सम्राट — साम्राज्य का सर्वोच्च शासक
definition: an emperor, the supreme monarch ruling an empire, who stands above kings and princes in rank (der Kaiser, plural Kaiser)
example: Der letzte deutsche Kaiser ging 1918 ins Exil. — The last German emperor went into exile in 1918.

hindi: साम्राज्य — सम्राट द्वारा शासित राज्य, ख़ासकर १८७१-१९१८ का जर्मनी
definition: an empire ruled by an emperor, and in German history above all the German Empire from 1871 to 1918 (das Kaiserreich, plural Kaiserreiche)
example: Im Kaiserreich wurde die Eisenbahn stark ausgebaut. — In the imperial era the railway was greatly expanded.

hindi: निर्मल नीला मौसम — बिलकुल साफ़, धूप-भरा दिन
definition: flawless blue-sky weather, cloudless and bright, of the kind that seems ordered for an occasion
example: The wedding party woke to perfect Kaiserwetter and cancelled the tent.

hindi: बछड़ा — गाय का छोटा बच्चा
definition: a calf, the young animal born to a cow, still drinking its mother's milk during its first months (das Kalb, plural Kälber)
example: Das Kalb trinkt Milch bei seiner Mutter. — The calf drinks milk from its mother.

hindi: पंचांग — दिन, हफ़्ते और महीने दिखाने वाली तालिका या किताब
definition: a calendar, the chart or booklet that lists the days, weeks and months of the year (der Kalender, plural Kalender)
example: Ich schreibe den Termin in den Kalender. — I write the appointment in the calendar.

hindi: ऊष्मांक — भोजन से मिलने वाली ऊर्जा की इकाई
definition: a calorie, the unit used to measure the energy that food provides to the body (die Kalorie, plural Kalorien)
example: Bei einer Diät zählt jede Kalorie. — On a diet every calorie counts.

hindi: ठंडा — कम तापमान का, सर्द
definition: cold, having a low temperature, chilly to the touch or in weather, also used of unfriendly manners (comparative kälter)
example: Draußen ist es heute sehr kalt. — It is very cold outside today.

hindi: ऐन मौके पर डर जाना — आख़िरी वक़्त पर घबराकर पीछे हट जाना
definition: to get cold feet, nervously withdrawing from a promise or commitment at the last moment (hat kalte Füße bekommen)
example: Kurz vor der Hochzeit bekam er kalte Füße. — Shortly before the wedding he got cold feet.

hindi: मूल किराया — हीटिंग और अन्य ख़र्च के बिना सिर्फ़ मकान का किराया
definition: the basic rent without heating and service charges, the figure quoted first in every flat listing (die Kaltmiete, plural Kaltmieten)
example: Die Kaltmiete liegt bei achthundert Euro. — The basic rent is eight hundred euros.

hindi: नहर — पानी का बनाया रास्ता; टीवी का प्रसारण चैनल भी
definition: a television channel or frequency, and also a canal or waterway built for boats and drainage (der Kanal, plural Kanäle)
example: Auf diesem Kanal laufen nur Nachrichten. — Only news runs on this channel.

hindi: उम्मीदवार — चुनाव लड़ने या पद के लिए आवेदन करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a candidate, a person standing for election to public office or applying formally for a position (der Kandidat, plural Kandidaten)
example: Der Kandidat spricht heute Abend auf dem Marktplatz. — The candidate speaks tonight in the market square.

hindi: ख़रगोश — लंबे कानों वाला छोटा पालतू जानवर
definition: a rabbit, the small long-eared animal with soft fur that is kept as a pet or raised on farms (das Kaninchen, plural Kaninchen)
example: Die Kinder füttern das Kaninchen mit Möhren. — The children feed the rabbit carrots.

hindi: केतली या सुराही — टोंटी वाला पात्र जिससे चाय, कॉफ़ी या दूध डालते हैं
definition: a teapot, coffee pot or pitcher with a spout, the vessel from which coffee, tea or milk is poured at the table (die Kanne, plural Kannen)
example: Die Kanne Tee steht auf dem Tisch. — The pot of tea is on the table.

hindi: किनारा, धार — मेज़ या पत्थर का सीधा तीखा छोर
definition: an edge, the sharp straight line where two surfaces of a table, a stone or a cliff meet (die Kante, plural Kanten)
example: Ich habe mich an der Kante des Tisches gestoßen. — I bumped myself on the edge of the table.

hindi: भोजनालय — दफ़्तर या कारखाने का सस्ता खाने का स्थान
definition: a canteen, the cafeteria in a company or factory where employees eat lunch cheaply (die Kantine, plural Kantinen)
example: Mittags essen wir in der Kantine. — At lunchtime we eat in the canteen.

hindi: प्रांत — स्विट्ज़रलैंड का अपने क़ानूनों वाला स्वशासित राज्य
definition: a canton, one of the self-governing member states with its own laws that together form the Swiss federation (der Kanton, plural Kantone)
example: Jeder Kanton hat eigene Schulferien. — Every canton has its own school holidays.

hindi: सरकार प्रमुख — जर्मनी और ऑस्ट्रिया की संघीय सरकार का मुखिया
definition: the chancellor, the elected head of the federal government in Germany or Austria who leads the cabinet (der Kanzler, plural Kanzler)
example: Der Kanzler hält heute eine Rede im Bundestag. — The chancellor gives a speech in the Bundestag today.

hindi: छोटा प्रार्थनाघर — छोटा गिरजाघर, अस्पताल या महल में भी
definition: a chapel, a small church or a small room for worship inside a hospital, castle or cemetery, also a music band (die Kapelle, plural Kapellen)
example: In der Kapelle brennen viele Kerzen. — Many candles are burning in the chapel.

hindi: पल्ले पड़ना — बोलचाल में किसी बात को समझ जाना
definition: to get it, a colloquial verb for finally understanding something after some effort (regular: kapiert, hat kapiert)
example: Jetzt habe ich die Regel endlich kapiert. — Now I've finally got the rule.

hindi: अध्याय — किताब का एक क्रमांकित खंड
definition: a chapter, one numbered section of a book into which the whole text is divided (das Kapitel, plural Kapitel)
example: Ich lese noch ein Kapitel, dann schlafe ich. — I will read one more chapter, then I will sleep.

hindi: टोपी-सा ढक्कन — पेन, बोतल या टूथपेस्ट के सिरे पर लगने वाला कवर
definition: a small protective covering that fits over the end of a pencil, bottle, tube or camera lens to close it, also a peaked headwear piece (die Kappe, plural Kappen)
example: Wo ist die Kappe von meinem Stift? — Where is the cap of my pen?

hindi: टूटा हुआ — ख़राब, काम न करने वाला
definition: broken or out of order, describing a machine, object or device that no longer works, also colloquially exhausted (regular adjective)
example: Die Waschmaschine ist schon wieder kaputt. — The washing machine is broken again.

hindi: ख़राब हो जाना — किसी चीज़ का टूटना या काम बंद करना
definition: to break down or stop working, the colloquial everyday verb for machines, toys, shoes and even relationships giving up (separable: geht kaputt, ist kaputtgegangen)
example: Meine Waschmaschine ist schon wieder kaputtgegangen. — My washing machine has broken down again.

hindi: कड़ी-हुक — पर्वतारोहण में रस्सी जोड़ने वाला स्प्रिंग वाला धातु का छल्ला
definition: a metal clip with a spring gate used by climbers to connect ropes and harnesses, also a short rifle (der Karabiner, plural Karabiner)
example: Prüfe den Karabiner, bevor du kletterst. — Check the carabiner before you climb.

hindi: फूलगोभी — सफ़ेद गुच्छेदार सब्ज़ी, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: cauliflower, the vegetable with a dense white head of florets, in its Austrian name where Germany says Blumenkohl (der Karfiol, plural Karfiole)
example: Der Karfiol wird heute mit Butterbröseln serviert. — The cauliflower is served with buttered breadcrumbs today.

hindi: पुण्य शुक्रवार — ईस्टर से पहले का शांत, शोकपूर्ण सार्वजनिक अवकाश
definition: the quiet public holiday of Good Friday before Easter, when shops close and dancing is banned in many regions (der Karfreitag, plural Karfreitage)
example: Am Karfreitag sind alle Geschäfte geschlossen. — On Good Friday all the shops are closed.

hindi: चौखाने वाला — चौकोर खानों के नमूने वाला
definition: checked or plaid, having a pattern of crossing lines forming squares on the fabric
example: Er trägt ein kariertes Hemd. — He is wearing a checked shirt.

hindi: वेशभूषा उत्सव — लेंट से पहले वेशभूषा, परेड और मस्ती का त्योहार, ख़ासकर राइनलैंड में
definition: carnival, the festive season of costumes, parades and street parties before Lent, celebrated most wildly along the Rhine (der Karneval, plural Karnevale)
example: Im Karneval ist die ganze Stadt verkleidet. — During carnival the whole city is in costume.

hindi: गाजर — नारंगी रंग की लंबी मीठी जड़-सब्ज़ी
definition: a carrot, the long orange root vegetable eaten raw or cooked, the word common in the south and Austria (die Karotte, plural Karotten)
example: Das Kaninchen frisst die Karotte ganz auf. — The rabbit eats up the whole carrot.

hindi: पेशेवर तरक़्क़ी — नौकरी में ऊँचे पद तक पहुँचना
definition: career or professional advancement, especially rising to higher positions over time (die Karriere, plural Karrieren)
example: Die Karriere als Ärztin war immer ihr Traum. — A career as a doctor was always her dream.

hindi: नक़्शा — भूभाग का मानचित्र; पत्ता, प्रवेश-पत्र
definition: a map or chart of a region or country used for finding the way, also a card, ticket or restaurant menu depending on context (die Karte, plural Karten)
example: Schau mal auf die Karte, wo wir gerade sind. — Have a look at the map to see where we are.

hindi: ताश का खेल — पत्तों से खेला जाने वाला खेल
definition: a card game, a game played with a pack of playing cards, or the pack itself (das Kartenspiel, plural Kartenspiele)
example: Nach dem Essen holt Opa das Kartenspiel heraus. — After the meal Grandpa gets out the card game.

hindi: आलू — जर्मन खाने की मुख्य कंद सब्ज़ी
definition: a potato, the starchy root vegetable that is the classic staple of German cooking, boiled, mashed, fried or made into dumplings (die Kartoffel, plural Kartoffeln)
example: Die Kartoffeln kochen noch zehn Minuten. — The potatoes are cooking for another ten minutes.

hindi: आलू का भरता — मसले हुए आलू का नरम व्यंजन
definition: mashed potato, the soft puree of boiled potatoes with milk and butter served as a side dish with meat and gravy (der Kartoffelbrei, no plural)
example: Der Kartoffelbrei ist schön cremig. — The mashed potato is nicely creamy.

hindi: गत्ते का बड़ा डिब्बा — सामान भरने या भेजने का मज़बूत डिब्बा
definition: a cardboard box or carton, the sturdy container used for moving house or shipping goods, also the cardboard material itself (der Karton, plural Kartons)
example: Wir packen die Bücher in einen Karton. — We pack the books into a cardboard box.

hindi: भुगतान खिड़की — दुकान में पैसे चुकाने की जगह
definition: the checkout or till where customers pay in a store, also the cash register itself and the box office at a cinema (die Kasse, plural Kassen)
example: Bitte zahlen Sie an der Kasse. — Please pay at the checkout.

hindi: रसीद — भुगतान खिड़की से मिली छपी पर्ची
definition: the printed till receipt handed over at the checkout listing every item bought and the total paid (der Kassenzettel, plural Kassenzettel)
example: Ohne Kassenzettel kann ich die Hose nicht umtauschen. — Without the receipt I can't exchange the trousers.

hindi: पैसे लेना — ग्राहक से दाम वसूलना; बोलचाल में मोटी रकम पाना
definition: to take the customer's money at a till or table, and colloquially to pocket a large sum or a penalty (regular: kassiert, hat kassiert)
example: Der Kellner kassiert gleich bei uns. — The waiter is about to take our payment.

hindi: ख़ज़ांची — भुगतान खिड़की पर पैसे लेने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a cashier, the person sitting at the checkout who scans the goods and takes the payment (der Kassierer, plural Kassierer)
example: Der Kassierer fragt nach meiner Kundenkarte. — The cashier asks for my loyalty card.

hindi: अलमारी — कपड़े या बर्तन रखने की ऊँची बंद पेटी, ऑस्ट्रियाई अर्थ
definition: a large box or crate, and in Austria and southern Germany the usual word for a wardrobe or cupboard, the tall closed furniture for clothes or dishes where the north says Schrank (der Kasten, plural Kästen)
example: Die Handtücher liegen im Kasten im Vorzimmer. — The towels are in the cupboard in the hallway.

hindi: आपदा — भारी विनाश और पीड़ा लाने वाली बड़ी विपत्ति
definition: a catastrophe or disaster, a large event such as flood or earthquake that causes widespread destruction and suffering (die Katastrophe, plural Katastrophen)
example: Das Hochwasser war eine Katastrophe für die ganze Region. — The flood was a catastrophe for the whole region.

hindi: नर बिल्ली — बिल्ला; बोलचाल में शराब के बाद का सिरदर्द
definition: a male cat, a tomcat, and colloquially also the hangover headache after drinking too much alcohol (der Kater, plural Kater)
example: Unser Kater heißt Felix. — Our tomcat is called Felix.

hindi: बिल्ली — म्याऊँ करने वाला पालतू जानवर
definition: a cat, the small furry domestic animal that purrs and hunts mice around the house (die Katze, plural Katzen)
example: Die Katze schläft auf dem Sofa. — The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

hindi: खुमारी का मलाल — रात के बाद की सुबह वाली उदासी
definition: the hollow morning-after gloom in which physical wreckage and moral regret arrive together
example: The party was triumphant; the Katzenjammer that followed was not.

hindi: बहुत थोड़ी दूरी — इतनी पास कि पल भर में पहुँच जाएँ
definition: a very short distance that takes hardly any time to cover, literally the leap of a cat (der Katzensprung, plural Katzensprünge)
example: Der Bahnhof ist nur ein Katzensprung von hier entfernt. — The station is only a stone's throw from here.

hindi: ख़रीदना — पैसे देकर कोई चीज़ लेना
definition: to buy or purchase something, to obtain goods or property by paying money for them, the basic everyday shopping verb (regular: kauft, hat gekauft)
example: Wir kaufen ein neues Sofa. — We are buying a new sofa.

hindi: बहुमंज़िला बड़ी दुकान — कपड़े, घरेलू सामान सब एक जगह
definition: a department store, a large multi-floor shop selling clothes, household goods and much else under one roof (das Kaufhaus, plural Kaufhäuser)
example: Im Kaufhaus gibt es heute Winterjacken im Angebot. — There are winter jackets on offer at the department store today.

hindi: व्यापारी — व्यापार और वाणिज्य में प्रशिक्षित कारोबारी
definition: a merchant or commercial clerk, someone trained in business and trade, also part of many official job titles (der Kaufmann, plural Kaufleute)
example: Der Kaufmann verhandelt lange über den Preis. — The merchant negotiates the price for a long time.

hindi: मुश्किल से — बहुत ही कम, लगभग नहीं
definition: hardly or scarcely, only just or almost not at all, expressing a very small degree of something
example: Ich kann dich kaum hören. — I can hardly hear you.

hindi: ज़मानत राशि — किरायेदार द्वारा मकान-मालिक के पास जमा की गई सुरक्षा रक़म
definition: a security deposit, the money a tenant leaves with the landlord against damage or unpaid rent (die Kaution, plural Kautionen)
example: Die Kaution beträgt drei Monatsmieten. — The deposit amounts to three months' rent.

hindi: बुहारना — झाड़ू से सफ़ाई करना, ख़ासकर दक्षिण जर्मनी में
definition: to sweep a floor or street with a broom, the usual word in southern Germany and Switzerland where northern speakers would say fegen (regular)
example: Im Süden kehrt man samstags die Straße. — In the south people sweep the street on Saturdays.

hindi: कूड़ा उठाने की सूपड़ी — झाड़ू से इकट्ठा कचरा उठाने वाली चपटी पत्ती
definition: a dustpan, the flat shovel-shaped tray onto which sweepings are brushed before being tipped into the rubbish (die Kehrschaufel, plural Kehrschaufeln)
example: Die Kehrschaufel hängt neben dem Handfeger. — The dustpan hangs next to the hand brush.

hindi: सफ़ाई की बारी — साझा सीढ़ी और फुटपाथ झाड़ने की साप्ताहिक बारी
definition: the rota week in which one household must sweep the shared stairwell and pavement, a Swabian institution (die Kehrwoche, plural Kehrwochen)
example: Die Kehrwoche ist diese Woche bei uns. — This week the sweeping duty is ours.

hindi: अंकुर — बीज से निकला पहला नन्हा कोंपल
definition: a sprout or germ, the first tiny shoot that pushes out of a seed when it begins to grow (der Keim, plural Keime)
example: Aus dem Samen wächst ein kleiner Keim. — A small sprout grows out of the seed.

hindi: अंकुरित होना — बीज से पहला कोंपल फूटना
definition: to sprout or germinate, to begin growing as a seed sends out its first tiny shoot (regular: keimt, ist gekeimt)
example: Die Bohnen keimen schon nach drei Tagen. — The beans sprout after just three days.

hindi: कोई नहीं / एक भी नहीं — संज्ञा का निषेध
definition: the negative determiner placed before a noun to mean not any or not a single one, the standard way of negating a noun instead of using nicht (keine Zeit, keinen Hunger)
example: Ich habe heute keine Zeit. — I have no time today.

hindi: पलक तक न झपकना — रात भर बिल्कुल न सो पाना
definition: to not sleep a wink, lying awake the whole night without closing an eye (hat kein Auge zugetan)
example: Vor der Prüfung habe ich kein Auge zugetan. — I did not sleep a wink before the exam.

term: kein Blatt vor den Mund nehmen
hindi: खरी-खरी कहना — बिना लाग-लपेट और बेझिझक बोलना
definition: to speak one's mind bluntly without softening the truth or mincing words (hat kein Blatt vor den Mund genommen)
example: Meine Oma nimmt kein Blatt vor den Mund. — My grandma does not mince her words.

hindi: कोई समस्या नहीं — सहज आश्वासन
definition: the relaxed reply to a request or apology, assuring the other person that nothing is difficult
example: Kein Problem, ich bringe es morgen mit. — No problem, I will bring it tomorrow.

hindi: कोई बात नहीं — बिल्कुल आसान, दिक्कत नहीं
definition: no problem at all, not an issue; a very colloquial reply agreeing readily to a request or favour
example: Ich fahre dich hin, kein Thema. — I will drive you there, no problem.

hindi: पता नहीं — कोई जानकारी नहीं होना
definition: no idea, no clue; the most common colloquial way to say you do not know something at all
example: Wo ist Max? Keine Ahnung. — Where is Max? No idea.

hindi: कोई कारण नहीं — धन्यवाद का जवाब
definition: the polite answer to thanks or an apology, saying there is no reason for either
example: Keine Ursache, das mache ich gern. — Don't mention it, I am happy to.

hindi: उँगली तक न हिलाना — ज़रा भी मदद या मेहनत न करना
definition: to not lift a finger, refusing to make even the smallest effort to help (hat keinen Finger gerührt)
example: Er hat beim Umzug keinen Finger gerührt. — He did not lift a finger during the move.

hindi: किसी भी हालत में नहीं — हरगिज़ नहीं
definition: under no circumstances, on no account; a firm negation forbidding something or ruling it out entirely
example: Du darfst das keinesfalls vergessen. — You must on no account forget that.

hindi: कतई नहीं — किसी भी तरह नहीं
definition: by no means, not at all, certainly not; a formal emphatic negation that rejects a suggestion or assumption completely
example: Das ist keineswegs sicher. — That is by no means certain.

hindi: मीठी कुरकुरी टिकिया — चाय के साथ खाई जाने वाली छोटी सेंकी हुई मिठाई
definition: a biscuit or cookie, the small flat crisp baked sweet eaten with tea or coffee (der Keks, plural Kekse)
example: Möchtest du einen Keks zum Kaffee? — Would you like a biscuit with your coffee?

hindi: तहख़ाना — ज़मीन के नीचे का भंडार कक्ष
definition: the cellar or basement, the storage level of a house below the ground floor (der Keller, plural Keller)
example: Die Fahrräder stehen im Keller. — The bicycles are in the cellar.

hindi: बैरा — रेस्तराँ में खाना-पीना परोसने वाला आदमी
definition: a waiter, the man who takes orders and serves food and drink at restaurant tables (der Kellner, plural Kellner)
example: Der Kellner bringt uns die Speisekarte. — The waiter brings us the menu.

hindi: परोसने वाली — रेस्तराँ में खाना-पीना परोसने वाली महिला
definition: a waitress, the woman who takes orders and serves food and drink at restaurant tables (die Kellnerin, plural Kellnerinnen)
example: Die Kellnerin fragt, ob wir noch etwas trinken möchten. — The waitress asks whether we would like anything else to drink.

hindi: पहचानना, परिचित होना — किसी व्यक्ति या जगह से जान-पहचान होना
definition: to know or be acquainted with a person, place or thing through experience rather than fact (irregular: kennt, kannte, hat gekannt)
example: Ich kenne den Mann aus der Nachbarschaft. — I know the man from the neighbourhood.

hindi: परिचय पाना — किसी से पहली बार मिलना और जानना
definition: to get to know someone, to meet a person for the first time and become acquainted (separable: lernt kennen, hat kennengelernt)
example: Wir haben uns auf einer Party kennengelernt. — We met at a party.

hindi: जानकारी — किसी विषय की सीखी हुई समझ
definition: knowledge or familiarity with a subject, usually in the plural for skills learned in a language or field (die Kenntnis, plural Kenntnisse)
example: Ich habe von dem Vertrag keine Kenntnis. — I have no knowledge of the contract.

hindi: गुप्त शब्द — खाता खोलने वाला कूटशब्द, औपचारिक और सरकारी प्रयोग
definition: a password, the secret word or string that unlocks an account or computer; the formal native synonym of Passwort seen on official forms and software (das Kennwort, plural Kennwörter)
example: Bitte geben Sie das Kennwort ein. — Please enter the password.

hindi: पंजीकरण पट्टिका — गाड़ी की पहचान वाली संख्या-पट्टी
definition: a registration number plate, the official identification plate fixed to a vehicle, also any distinguishing mark (das Kennzeichen, plural Kennzeichen)
example: Die Polizei notierte das Kennzeichen des Wagens. — The police noted the number plate of the car.

hindi: बंदा — आदमी, लड़का, बोलचाल में अक्सर स्नेह से
definition: a fellow or chap, a male person described colloquially, often with warmth or mild criticism attached (der Kerl, plural Kerle)
example: Er ist ein netter Kerl. — He is a nice fellow.

hindi: बीज या गुठली — फल के भीतर का कठोर हिस्सा; किसी बात का सार
definition: the seed, pip or stone found inside a fruit, and figuratively the central core of any matter (der Kern, plural Kerne)
example: Der Kern der Kirsche ist sehr hart. — The stone of the cherry is very hard.

hindi: मोमबत्ती — मोम की बत्ती, आगमन काल में हर घर में जलती है
definition: a candle, the wax light burned on the Advent wreath and the Christmas tree during the dark winter festive season (die Kerze, plural Kerzen)
example: Bitte zünde die Kerze auf dem Tisch an. — Please light the candle on the table.

hindi: हार — गले में पहनी जाने वाली माला या ज़ंजीर
definition: a necklace, the chain or string of beads worn around the neck as jewellery (die Kette, plural Ketten)
example: Die Kette war ein Geschenk meiner Mutter. — The necklace was a gift from my mother.

hindi: बजरी — छोटे-छोटे पत्थर जो रास्तों और कंक्रीट में बिछते हैं
definition: gravel, the small loose stones used in concrete and spread on paths and driveways (der Kies, plural Kiese)
example: Der Kies knirscht unter den Reifen. — The gravel crunches under the tyres.

hindi: किलो — वज़न की इकाई, एक हज़ार ग्राम
definition: a kilo or kilogram, the everyday unit of weight equal to one thousand grams, used for buying fruit, meat and body weight (das Kilo, plural Kilo)
example: Ich hätte gern zwei Kilo Kartoffeln. — I would like two kilos of potatoes.

hindi: किलोग्राम — भार की इकाई, हज़ार ग्राम
definition: a kilogram, the standard unit of weight equal to one thousand grams, used for groceries, luggage and body weight and shortened to Kilo in speech (das Kilogramm, plural Kilogramm)
example: Ein Kilogramm Äpfel kostet zwei Euro. — A kilogram of apples costs two euros.

hindi: किलोमीटर — हज़ार मीटर की दूरी
definition: a kilometre, one thousand metres, the unit of distance used for journeys, road signs, running and speed limits (der Kilometer, plural Kilometer)
example: Bis zum Bahnhof ist es nur ein Kilometer. — It is only one kilometre to the station.

hindi: बच्चा — छोटी उम्र का लड़का या लड़की, किसी की संतान
