definition: the child, a young person who has not yet grown into an adult, or anyone's own son or daughter at any later stage (das Kind, plural Kinder)
example: Das Kind spielt im Garten mit dem Hund. — The child plays in the garden with the dog.

hindi: बाल-चिकित्सक — शिशुओं और बच्चों का इलाज करने वाला डॉक्टर
definition: a paediatrician, the doctor specialising in babies and children whom parents visit for check-ups and vaccinations (der Kinderarzt, plural Kinderärzte)
example: Morgen haben wir einen Termin beim Kinderarzt. — Tomorrow we have an appointment with the paediatrician.

hindi: बालवाड़ी — तीन से छह साल के बच्चों की स्कूल से पहले की जगह
definition: a preschool nursery for children aged roughly three to six, where they play and learn together before formal schooling begins (der Kindergarten, plural Kindergärten)
example: Der Kindergarten macht um sieben Uhr auf. — The nursery opens at seven o'clock.

hindi: बाल भत्ता — हर बच्चे के लिए माँ-बाप को मिलने वाला मासिक सरकारी भुगतान
definition: child benefit, the monthly payment the German state gives parents for every child until at least age eighteen (das Kindergeld, no plural)
example: Das Kindergeld kommt jeden Monat aufs Konto. — The child benefit arrives in the account every month.

hindi: बच्चों-सा आसान — इतना सरल कि बच्चा भी कर ले
definition: extremely easy, so simple that even a child could manage it, the strongest everyday word for effortless
example: Die Bedienung ist kinderleicht. — The operation is child's play.

hindi: बाल कार-सीट — गाड़ी में बच्चे की सुरक्षा के लिए बाँधी जाने वाली अनिवार्य सीट
definition: a child car seat, the safety seat strapped into a vehicle that is legally required for children under twelve (der Kindersitz, plural Kindersitze)
example: Ohne einen Kindersitz darf das Kind nicht mitfahren. — Without a child seat the child may not ride along.

hindi: बच्चागाड़ी — शिशु को लिटाकर या बैठाकर ठेलने की पहियों वाली गाड़ी
definition: a pram or stroller, the wheeled carriage in which a baby is pushed along lying down or sitting (der Kinderwagen, plural Kinderwagen)
example: Der Kinderwagen passt kaum in den Aufzug. — The pram barely fits in the lift.

hindi: बच्चों का कमरा — जहाँ बच्चे सोते और खेलते हैं
definition: the children's room, the bedroom and playroom of a home where the children sleep and play (das Kinderzimmer, plural Kinderzimmer)
example: Im Kinderzimmer liegt Spielzeug auf dem Boden. — In the children's room there are toys on the floor.

hindi: बचपन — जीवन का बच्चा होने का समय
definition: the childhood, the early period of life spent as a child before growing up (die Kindheit, plural Kindheiten, rarely used)
example: Ich hatte eine glückliche Kindheit auf dem Land. — I had a happy childhood in the countryside.

hindi: बचकाना — बड़े होकर भी छोटे बच्चे जैसा अपरिपक्व व्यवहार करना
definition: childish in the disapproving sense, an adult behaving immaturely or sulking like a small child
example: Hör auf, so kindisch zu sein, und entschuldige dich. — Stop being so childish and apologise.

hindi: बालसुलभ — बच्चे जैसी मासूमियत, जिज्ञासा या रूप वाला, सकारात्मक अर्थ में
definition: childlike in the neutral or positive sense, having the innocence, curiosity or appearance of a child
example: Mit kindlicher Neugier untersucht sie jeden Käfer. — With childlike curiosity she examines every beetle.

hindi: ठोड़ी — मुँह के नीचे चेहरे का निचला उभरा हिस्सा
definition: the chin, the lowest part of the face below the mouth where the jaw sticks out (das Kinn, plural Kinne)
example: Er stützte das Kinn auf die Hand. — He rested his chin on his hand.

hindi: सिनेमाघर — जहाँ बड़े पर्दे पर फ़िल्म दिखाई जाती है
definition: a cinema, the building where films are shown on a large screen, and cinema as an art form (das Kino, plural Kinos)
example: Gehen wir heute Abend ins Kino? — Shall we go to the cinema this evening?

hindi: सिगरेट — बोलचाल में सिगरेट या उसका ठूँठ
definition: a cigarette or cigarette butt in colloquial speech, also a rubbish tip in another sense (die Kippe, plural Kippen)
example: Hast du mal eine Kippe für mich? — Have you got a cigarette for me?

hindi: तिरछा करना या उलटना — किसी चीज़ को झुकाना ताकि वह गिरे या बहे
definition: to tilt or tip something over so it leans, pours or falls, such as a window opened at an angle or a glass knocked over (regular)
example: Kipp das Fenster ein bisschen, es ist stickig. — Tilt the window open a little, it is stuffy.

hindi: गिरजाघर — ईसाई उपासना का भवन; धार्मिक संस्था
definition: a church, the building where Christians gather for worship, also the religious institution itself (die Kirche, plural Kirchen)
example: Die Kirche steht mitten im Dorf. — The church stands in the middle of the village.

hindi: चेरी — गुठली वाला छोटा गोल गहरा लाल मीठा फल
definition: a cherry, the small round dark red fruit with a hard stone inside that hangs from trees in early summer (die Kirsche, plural Kirschen)
example: Die Kirschen sind dieses Jahr besonders süß. — The cherries are especially sweet this year.

hindi: तकिया — सिर के नीचे रखने वाला नरम गद्दा
definition: a pillow or cushion, the soft stuffed cloth bag placed under the head in bed or on a sofa (das Kissen, plural Kissen)
example: Ich brauche ein zweites Kissen. — I need a second pillow.

hindi: पेटी — लकड़ी या प्लास्टिक का मज़बूत खुला या बंद बक्सा
definition: a crate or chest, a sturdy wooden or plastic box for storing or transporting bottles, fruit or tools (die Kiste, plural Kisten)
example: Die Kiste Äpfel steht im Keller. — The crate of apples is in the cellar.

hindi: शिशु-देखभाल केंद्र — स्कूल से पहले के बच्चों की दिनभर देखभाल की जगह
definition: a daycare centre for children before school age, the everyday short form of Kindertagesstätte used all over Germany (die Kita, plural Kitas)
example: Ich bringe meine Tochter jeden Morgen in die Kita. — I take my daughter to daycare every morning.

hindi: भड़कीली सस्ती कला — दिखावटी और उथली सजावट
definition: art of cheap sentiment, pleasing enough to sell everywhere yet too gaudy for anyone to admit owning
example: Her flat was a shrine to Kitsch: velvet stags, singing clocks, a lamp shaped like a swan.

hindi: मुक़दमा — अदालत में दायर की गई शिकायत
definition: a lawsuit or legal complaint filed with a court, also a complaint or lament in ordinary speech (die Klage, plural Klagen)
example: Die Firma hat eine Klage eingereicht. — The company has filed a lawsuit.

hindi: बन जाना — काम ठीक से हो जाना, सफल होना (बोलचाल)
definition: to work out, go smoothly or succeed as hoped, very common colloquial word for plans and arrangements (regular: klappt, hat geklappt)
example: Hat gestern alles gut geklappt? — Did everything go well yesterday?

hindi: ज़ाहिर है, बिल्कुल — सहज हाँ कहने का बोलचाल शब्द
definition: colloquially meaning sure or of course, a quick agreeing answer showing the request is obviously fine
example: Klar, ich helfe dir. — Sure, I'll help you.

hindi: कक्षा — एक ही स्कूल-वर्ष में साथ पढ़ने वाले छात्रों का समूह
definition: a class, the fixed group of pupils who are taught together throughout one school year (die Klasse, plural Klassen)
example: Unsere Klasse fährt im Mai nach Berlin. — Our class is going to Berlin in May.

hindi: लिखित कक्षा-परीक्षा — पाठ के दौरान निगरानी में लिखी जाने वाली अंकों वाली परीक्षा
definition: a written class test, the longer graded examination written under supervision during a lesson that counts heavily towards the report grade (die Klassenarbeit, plural Klassenarbeiten)
example: Morgen schreiben wir eine Klassenarbeit in Deutsch. — Tomorrow we are writing a class test in German.

hindi: कक्षा-अध्यापक — एक कक्षा की देखरेख और अभिभावकों से संपर्क रखने वाला शिक्षक
definition: the form teacher responsible for one particular class, who handles its administration and stays in contact with parents (der Klassenlehrer, plural Klassenlehrer)
example: Der Klassenlehrer ruft die Eltern an. — The form teacher calls the parents.

hindi: कक्षा-कक्ष — वह कमरा जहाँ छात्रों की पढ़ाई होती है
definition: the classroom, the room in a school where a class gathers for its lessons with the teacher (das Klassenzimmer, plural Klassenzimmer)
example: Das Klassenzimmer ist im zweiten Stock. — The classroom is on the second floor.

hindi: गपशप — दूसरों की निजी बातों की चटपटी चर्चा
definition: gossip, the idle chatter about other people's private lives that fills tabloids and celebrity magazines (der Klatsch, no plural)
example: Die Zeitschrift ist voller Klatsch über Stars. — The magazine is full of gossip about stars.

hindi: ताली बजाना — हथेलियों को टकराकर प्रशंसा जताना
definition: to clap or applaud, to strike the palms together to show approval of a performance, and colloquially to gossip (regular: klatscht, hat geklatscht)
example: Alle klatschen, als die Sängerin die Bühne verlässt. — Everyone claps as the singer leaves the stage.

hindi: चुराना — बोलचाल में किसी की चीज़ मार लेना
definition: to steal or pinch something, the casual colloquial word for taking what belongs to another person (regular, colloquial)
example: Wer hat meinen Stift geklaut? — Who pinched my pen?

hindi: लिखित परीक्षा — ऊँची कक्षाओं और विश्वविद्यालय में निगरानी में लिखी जाने वाली परीक्षा
definition: a written examination taken under supervision in the upper school years or at university, graded and counting towards the final result (die Klausur, plural Klausuren)
example: Die Klausur dauert drei Stunden. — The written exam lasts three hours.

hindi: कुंजी वाद्य — काली-सफ़ेद कुंजियों वाला बड़ा बाजा
definition: a piano, the large keyboard instrument with black and white keys that is played by striking them with the fingers (das Klavier, plural Klaviere)
example: Im Wohnzimmer steht ein altes Klavier. — There is an old piano in the living room.

hindi: चिपकू पट्टी — डिब्बे बंद करने और चीज़ें जोड़ने की चिपचिपी फीती
definition: adhesive tape, the sticky strip on a roll used for sealing boxes, fixing and marking things (das Klebeband, plural Klebebänder)
example: Das Klebeband klebt nicht mehr. — The tape does not stick any more.

hindi: गोंद — काग़ज़, लकड़ी या प्लास्टिक चिपकाने वाला चिपचिपा पदार्थ
definition: glue or adhesive, the sticky substance that bonds paper, wood or plastic surfaces together (der Kleber, plural Kleber)
example: Der Kleber muss eine Stunde trocknen. — The glue has to dry for an hour.

hindi: पोशाक — महिलाओं का ऊपर से नीचे तक एक ही टुकड़े का वस्त्र
definition: a dress, the single garment combining top and skirt that women wear for daily life or parties (das Kleid, plural Kleider)
example: Das rote Kleid steht dir sehr gut. — The red dress suits you very well.

hindi: कपड़ों की अलमारी — कपड़े टाँगने-रखने की बड़ी अलमारी
definition: a wardrobe, the tall cupboard in a bedroom where clothes are hung and folded (der Kleiderschrank, plural Kleiderschränke)
example: Der Kleiderschrank ist schon voll. — The wardrobe is already full.

hindi: कपड़े — शरीर पर पहने जाने वाले सारे वस्त्र
definition: the clothes and garments that people wear on their body, the general word for everything in the wardrobe (die Kleidung, no plural)
example: Ich lege die Kleidung ordentlich in den Schrank. — I put the clothes neatly in the wardrobe.

hindi: छोटा — आकार या मात्रा में सामान्य से कम
definition: small or little in size, height or amount, the everyday basic word for anything smaller than normal, also used for young children
example: Das Zimmer ist klein, aber gemütlich. — The room is small but cosy.

hindi: चिल्लर — छोटे सिक्के, खुले पैसे
definition: small change, the loose coins of low value kept in a pocket or purse for small purchases and vending machines (das Kleingeld, no plural)
example: Das Kleingeld sammle ich in einem Glas. — I collect the small change in a jar.

hindi: छोटा बच्चा — एक से तीन साल तक का बच्चा
definition: the toddler, a small child between roughly one and three years old who is learning to walk and talk (das Kleinkind, plural Kleinkinder)
example: Das Kleinkind läuft schon ohne Hilfe. — The toddler already walks without help.

hindi: छोटा-मोटा सामान — मामूली चीज़ें या तुच्छ काम
definition: small stuff, the odds and ends, trivial objects or minor unimportant tasks that clutter a drawer or a working day, colloquial (der Kleinkram, no plural)
example: In der Schublade liegt nur Kleinkram: Stifte, Büroklammern, Münzen. — The drawer holds only odds and ends: pens, paper clips, coins.

hindi: छोटा शहर — शांत माहौल वाला कम आबादी का नगर
definition: a small town, a quiet settlement with fewer inhabitants than a city where people often know each other (die Kleinstadt, plural Kleinstädte)
example: Sie ist in einer Kleinstadt aufgewachsen. — She grew up in a small town.

hindi: नलसाज़ — पानी के पाइप और नल लगाने-सुधारने वाला कारीगर
definition: a plumber, the tradesperson who installs and repairs water pipes, taps and sanitary fittings (der Klempner, plural Klempner)
example: Der Klempner repariert den tropfenden Wasserhahn. — The plumber is fixing the dripping tap.

hindi: चढ़ने का ढाँचा — बच्चों के चढ़ने-कूदने के लिए सीढ़ियों और डंडों की संरचना
definition: a climbing frame, the wooden or metal structure of bars and ladders that children clamber over on playgrounds (das Klettergerüst, plural Klettergerüste)
example: Mein Sohn hängt schon wieder kopfüber am Klettergerüst. — My son is hanging upside down on the climbing frame again.

hindi: चढ़ना — हाथ-पैर से चट्टान या पेड़ पर ऊपर जाना
definition: to climb or scramble, to move upward using hands and feet on rocks, trees or a wall (regular, ist geklettert)
example: Die Kinder klettern auf den Felsen. — The children climb onto the rock.

hindi: जलवायु — किसी इलाके का बरसों का औसत मौसम
definition: the climate, the typical long-term weather pattern of a region rather than the conditions of one single day (das Klima, plural Klimas or Klimate)
example: Das Klima in Spanien ist warm und trocken. — The climate in Spain is warm and dry.

hindi: जलवायु संरक्षण — धरती के गरम होने को रोकने के उपाय
definition: climate protection, the political and personal measures taken to slow global warming and its damage (der Klimaschutz, no plural)
example: Die Stadt investiert viel Geld in den Klimaschutz. — The city invests a lot of money in climate protection.

hindi: जलवायु परिवर्तन — धरती के मौसम में लंबे समय का बदलाव
definition: climate change, the long-term shift in global weather patterns and rising temperatures caused largely by human activity (der Klimawandel, no plural)
example: Der Klimawandel verändert unsere Sommer. — Climate change is changing our summers.

hindi: घंटी — दरवाज़े की बजाने वाली घंटी
definition: a doorbell, the button beside a front door that rings inside so visitors announce themselves (die Klingel, plural Klingeln)
example: Die Klingel ist kaputt, bitte klopfen. — The doorbell is broken, please knock.

hindi: सुनाई पड़ना, लगना — किसी ध्वनि का ऐसा प्रभाव देना
definition: to sound a certain way to the ear, used for how a voice, music or an idea comes across (irregular: klingt, hat geklungen)
example: Deine Idee klingt wirklich gut. — Your idea sounds really good.

hindi: दरवाज़े का दस्ता — नीचे दबाकर दरवाज़ा खोलने वाली मूठ
definition: the lever-shaped door handle that you press downward to open a door, the standard handle on German doors (die Klinke, plural Klinken)
example: Drück die Klinke nach unten, dann geht die Tür auf. — Press the handle down, then the door opens.

hindi: कगार — समुद्र के ऊपर खड़ी ऊँची चट्टान
definition: a cliff, a steep high rock face rising sharply above the sea or shore (die Klippe, plural Klippen)
example: Von der Klippe sieht man weit aufs Meer. — From the cliff you can see far out to sea.

hindi: शौचालय — पाख़ाने का आम बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: the toilet or loo, the colloquial everyday word for the fixture and the small room it stands in (das Klo, plural Klos)
example: Ich muss mal aufs Klo. — I need to go to the loo.

hindi: खटखटाना — दरवाज़ा या मेज़ थपथपाना, तालियों की जगह भी
definition: to knock on a door or tap on a table, which German students do with their knuckles instead of clapping to applaud a lecture (regular: hat geklopft)
example: Am Ende der Vorlesung klopfen alle auf den Tisch. — At the end of the lecture everyone knocks on the table.

hindi: मठ — भिक्षुओं या भिक्षुणियों के रहने और प्रार्थना की जगह
definition: a monastery or convent, the building where monks or nuns live together, work and pray under religious vows (das Kloster, plural Klöster)
example: Das alte Kloster liegt auf einem Hügel. — The old monastery lies on a hill.

hindi: गोल पकौड़ी — मध्य और उत्तरी जर्मनी में आलू की उबली गोल टिक्की
definition: the central and northern German word for a boiled round dumpling of potato or bread, the same dish that the south calls Knödel (der Kloß, plural Klöße)
example: Meine Mutter macht die besten Klöße zu Weihnachten. — My mother makes the best dumplings at Christmas.

hindi: बुद्धिमान — समझदार, तेज़ दिमाग और सूझबूझ वाला
definition: clever and intelligent, showing good judgement and understanding things quickly (comparative klüger)
example: Das war eine kluge Entscheidung. — That was a clever decision.

hindi: समझदारी — बुद्धिमानी और सूझबूझ से काम लेना
definition: the cleverness and practical wisdom of a person who understands quickly and chooses sensibly (die Klugheit, no plural)
example: Ihre Klugheit hat den Streit schnell beendet. — Her cleverness ended the argument quickly.

hindi: गपशप करना — उत्तरी जर्मनी में आराम से, बिना जल्दी बतियाना
definition: to chat in a relaxed, unhurried northern German way, talking about small everyday things over coffee or tea with a neighbour (regular)
example: Wir haben den ganzen Nachmittag geklönt. — We chatted the whole afternoon.

hindi: कुरकुरा — काटने पर चटकने वाला ताज़ा; बोलचाल में गठीला भी
definition: crisp or crunchy, snapping cleanly when bitten like a fresh apple or carrot, colloquially also firm and attractive (regular comparison: knackiger, am knackigsten)
example: Der Salat ist frisch und knackig. — The salad is fresh and crisp.

hindi: कम या तंग — बस थोड़ा-सा, मुश्किल से पर्याप्त
definition: scarce or barely enough in amount, describing tight money, short time and narrow wins, also just under before a number
example: Das Geld ist knapp diesen Monat. — Money is tight this month.

hindi: जेल — बोलचाल में क़ैदख़ाना
definition: prison or jail in casual colloquial speech, the building where convicted criminals serve their sentence (der Knast, plural Knäste)
example: Sein Bruder sitzt im Knast. — His brother is in jail.

hindi: मुठिया — दरवाज़े, दराज़ या छड़ी पर लगी गोल पकड़
definition: a round knob on a door, drawer or walking stick that you grip and turn or pull with the whole hand (der Knauf, plural Knäufe)
example: Der Knauf an der Schublade ist locker. — The knob on the drawer is loose.

hindi: कंजूस-मक्खीचूस — छोटी-छोटी रकम पर भी हाथ खींचने वाला
definition: tight-fisted and penny-pinching, colloquially stingy about small amounts of money, a milder cousin of geizig
example: Sei nicht so knauserig mit dem Trinkgeld. — Don't be so tight with the tip.

hindi: मधुशाला — मोहल्ले का सादा शराबघर जहाँ लोग शाम को बीयर पीते हैं
definition: a pub or tavern, the simple neighbourhood bar where people drink beer and talk in the evening (die Kneipe, plural Kneipen)
example: Nach der Arbeit gehen wir noch in die Kneipe. — After work we still go to the pub.

hindi: पैसा — बोलचाल में माल, नक़दी
definition: money or cash in casual colloquial speech, literally modelling clay, used jokingly about how much someone earns or owns (die Knete, no plural)
example: Für das Auto fehlt mir die Knete. — I lack the money for the car.

hindi: घुटना — टाँग के बीच का जोड़ जहाँ टाँग मुड़ती है
definition: the knee, the joint in the middle of the leg where the lower leg bends against the thigh (das Knie, plural Knie)
example: Beim Fußball hat er sich das Knie verletzt. — He injured his knee playing football.

hindi: पेचीदा — सूझ-बूझ माँगने वाला, टेढ़ा सवाल
definition: tricky and fiddly, difficult in a way that needs careful thought or dexterity, said of puzzles and questions
example: Die letzte Frage war ziemlich knifflig. — The last question was rather tricky.

hindi: नन्हा — छोटा बच्चा, बोलचाल में प्यार से
definition: a little kid or small child spoken about affectionately and colloquially, especially a young boy (der Knirps, plural Knirpse)
example: Der kleine Knirps läuft schon allein. — The little kid already walks on his own.

hindi: लहसुन — तेज़ गंध वाली सफ़ेद कलियों की गाँठ, मसाले की तरह
definition: garlic, the strong-smelling white bulb made of small cloves that is crushed or chopped to flavour cooking (der Knoblauch, no plural)
example: Der Knoblauch riecht sehr stark. — The garlic smells very strong.

hindi: हड्डी — शरीर के ढाँचे का कठोर सफ़ेद हिस्सा
definition: a bone, one of the hard white pieces that form the skeleton and support the body (der Knochen, plural Knochen)
example: Der Knochen ist zum Glück nicht gebrochen. — Luckily the bone is not broken.

hindi: घुंडी — कपड़ा बंद करने की छोटी गोल चीज़
definition: a button, the small round disc sewn on clothes that fastens through a hole (der Knopf, plural Knöpfe)
example: Am Hemd fehlt ein Knopf. — A button is missing from the shirt.

hindi: कली — फूल या पत्ती का बंद रूप जो खिलने वाला है
definition: a bud, the small tightly closed swelling on a plant that will open into a leaf or blossom, an unopened flower (die Knospe, plural Knospen)
example: Die Knospe öffnet sich bei warmem Wetter. — The bud opens in warm weather.

hindi: टख़ना — पैर और टाँग के बीच का उभरा जोड़
definition: the ankle, the joint with the bony bump where the foot connects to the lower leg (der Knöchel, plural Knöchel)
example: Ich bin umgeknickt und der Knöchel ist geschwollen. — I twisted my foot and the ankle is swollen.

hindi: उबला गोल पकौड़ा — आलू या डबलरोटी के आटे का, भुने माँस के साथ
definition: a dumpling, the round boiled ball of potato or bread dough served beside roast meat and gravy in Bavaria and Austria (der Knödel, plural Knödel)
example: Der Schweinebraten kommt mit zwei Knödeln. — The roast pork comes with two dumplings.

hindi: चालान — पार्किंग जुर्माने की पर्ची, बोलचाल का हल्का शब्द
definition: a parking ticket, the playful colloquial word for the small fine notice tucked under the wiper (das Knöllchen, plural Knöllchen)
example: Ein Knöllchen kostet hier zwanzig Euro. — A parking ticket costs twenty euros here.

hindi: गठबंधन — मिलकर सरकार बनाने वाले दो या अधिक दलों का मेल
definition: a coalition, an alliance of two or more political parties that forms a government together (die Koalition, plural Koalitionen)
example: Die Koalition hat sich auf einen gemeinsamen Plan geeinigt. — The coalition has agreed on a joint plan.

hindi: रसोइया — रेस्तराँ या घर में खाना पकाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a cook or chef, the person who prepares meals in a restaurant kitchen or at home (der Koch, plural Köche)
example: Der Koch kommt aus Italien und macht tolle Pasta. — The cook comes from Italy and makes great pasta.

hindi: पकाना या उबालना — आग पर खाना तैयार करना, या पानी खौलना
definition: to cook a meal in the kitchen, and also to boil, as water bubbling on the stove or pasta in a saucepan (regular: kocht, hat gekocht)
example: Heute koche ich Nudeln mit Tomatensoße. — Today I am cooking pasta with tomato sauce.

hindi: पकाने का बर्तन — ढक्कन वाला गहरा पात्र जिसमें खाना उबालते हैं
definition: a cooking pot, the deep lidded saucepan used to boil or simmer soup, vegetables or pasta (der Kochtopf, plural Kochtöpfe)
example: Nimm den großen Kochtopf für die Suppe. — Take the large cooking pot for the soup.

hindi: संदूक — यात्रा में कपड़े रखने का हत्थे वाला कठोर बक्सा
definition: a suitcase, the rigid travel case with a handle in which clothes are packed for a trip (der Koffer, plural Koffer)
example: Der Koffer ist zu schwer für das Handgepäck. — The suitcase is too heavy for hand luggage.

hindi: सामान-खाना — गाड़ी के पीछे सामान रखने की जगह
definition: the boot or trunk of a car, the luggage space at the rear for bags and shopping (der Kofferraum, plural Kofferräume)
example: Die Koffer passen alle in den Kofferraum. — The suitcases all fit in the boot.

hindi: पत्तागोभी — गोल बड़े पत्तों वाली सब्ज़ी, जर्मन सर्दियों का पारंपरिक भोजन
definition: cabbage, the round leafy vegetable with tightly packed green or white leaves, the traditional winter vegetable of German cooking (der Kohl, no plural)
example: Der Kohl braucht lange, bis er weich ist. — The cabbage takes a long time to get soft.

hindi: ज़ोरों की भूख — बोलचाल में तेज़ भूख
definition: ravenous hunger, the colloquial expression for being extremely hungry, usually in the phrase Kohldampf haben (der Kohldampf, no plural)
example: Der Kohldampf treibt uns mittags in die Kantine. — Hunger drives us to the canteen at noon.

hindi: कोयला — ज़मीन से निकला काला जलने वाला ईंधन
definition: coal, the black fossil fuel dug from the ground and burned for heat and electricity, also colloquial for money (die Kohle, plural Kohlen)
example: Die Kohle liegt im Keller neben dem Ofen. — The coal lies in the cellar next to the stove.

hindi: दहन-गैस — ईंधन जलने पर निकलने वाली गैस जो धरती को गरम करती है
definition: carbon dioxide, the gas released when fuel burns, and the main driver of global warming (das Kohlendioxid, no plural)
example: Das Kohlendioxid aus den Autos heizt die Erde auf. — The carbon dioxide from cars heats up the earth.

hindi: बकवास — मज़ाकिया अंदाज़ में कही गई फ़ालतू, बेतुकी बातें
definition: a jokey colloquial word for nonsense, silly fuss or foolish talk, mostly heard in the Rhineland and the west (der Kokolores, no plural)
example: Was erzählst du da für einen Kokolores? — What kind of nonsense are you telling there?

hindi: सहकर्मी — साथ काम करने वाला पुरुष
definition: a male colleague, a person who works with you in the same office, company or profession (der Kollege, plural Kollegen)
example: Mein Kollege ist heute krank. — My colleague is ill today.

hindi: सहकर्मी महिला — साथ काम करने वाली स्त्री
definition: a female colleague, a woman who works with you in the same office, company or profession (die Kollegin, plural Kolleginnen)
example: Eine Kollegin hat mir bei dem Bericht geholfen. — A colleague helped me with the report.

hindi: स्तंभ — एक ही लेखक का नियमित छपने वाला राय-लेख
definition: a column, the regular opinion piece by the same writer appearing in a fixed place in a newspaper or magazine (die Kolumne, plural Kolumnen)
example: Ihre Kolumne erscheint jeden Samstag in der Zeitung. — Her column appears every Saturday in the newspaper.

hindi: अजीब या हास्यास्पद — विचित्र, या हँसी लाने वाला
definition: funny in either sense, odd and peculiar or amusing and comical; very common in everyday speech
example: Komisch, ich war sicher, dass ich abgeschlossen hatte. — Funny, I was sure I had locked up.

hindi: आना — बोलने वाले की ओर पहुँचना
definition: to come or arrive at a place, moving toward the speaker or the point being talked about (irregular: kommt, kam, ist gekommen)
example: Kommst du heute Abend zu uns? — Are you coming to our place tonight?

hindi: टिप्पणी — किसी खबर पर लेखक की राय या समीक्षा
definition: a commentary or opinion piece giving the writer's personal view on the news, or any remark left under a post (der Kommentar, plural Kommentare)
example: Sein Kommentar zur Politik war ziemlich scharf. — His commentary on politics was fairly sharp.

hindi: सहपाठी — विश्वविद्यालय में साथ पढ़ने वाला दूसरा छात्र
definition: a fellow university student, someone studying alongside you in the same programme or institution (der Kommilitone, plural Kommilitonen)
example: Ein Kommilitone hat mir seine Notizen geliehen. — A fellow student lent me his notes.

hindi: जाँच अधिकारी — अपराध की तफ़्तीश करने वाला पुलिस इंस्पेक्टर
definition: a police detective inspector who leads criminal investigations, the familiar figure of every German television crime series (der Kommissar, plural Kommissare)
example: Der Kommissar befragte alle Nachbarn. — The inspector questioned all the neighbours.

hindi: दराज़दार अलमारी — नीची, कई दराज़ों वाली
definition: a chest of drawers, the low wide piece of furniture with several drawers for storing clothes (die Kommode, plural Kommoden)
example: Die Socken liegen in der Kommode. — The socks are in the chest of drawers.

hindi: सघन — छोटी जगह में ठोस और भरा हुआ
definition: compact and solidly built taking little space, describing small cars, tightly built devices and dense summaries
example: Das Auto ist kompakt und sparsam. — The car is compact and economical.

hindi: जटिल — कई परस्पर जुड़े पहलुओं वाला
definition: complex, consisting of many interconnected parts or aspects that make it hard to grasp, more formal than kompliziert
example: Das Thema ist sehr komplex. — The topic is very complex.

hindi: जटिल — कई उलझे हिस्सों वाला, समझने में मुश्किल
definition: complicated, made of many tangled parts and therefore hard to understand or handle, said of rules, machines and people
example: Die Regeln sind ziemlich kompliziert. — The rules are rather complicated.

hindi: संगीत रचना — नई धुन या संगीत कृति बनाना
definition: to compose music, to create and write down a new piece of music for instruments, singers or a film (regular: komponiert, hat komponiert)
example: Sie komponiert Musik für kleine Filme. — She composes music for short films.

hindi: संगीत रचयिता — धुनें और संगीत रचने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a composer, a person who writes music for orchestras, singers, films or other performers (der Komponist, plural Komponisten)
example: Der Komponist schrieb dieses Stück für seine Tochter. — The composer wrote this piece for his daughter.

hindi: खाद का ढेर — सड़े छिलकों और पत्तों से बनी खाद
definition: compost, the dark crumbly material made from rotted kitchen scraps and garden waste (der Kompost, plural Komposte)
example: Die Kartoffelschalen kommen auf den Kompost. — The potato peels go on the compost.

hindi: पका हुआ मीठा फल — चीनी में उबाले हुए फल का हल्का मीठा व्यंजन
definition: stewed fruit, the simple dessert of fruit cooked soft in sugar syrup and served cold or warm with pudding (das Kompott, plural Kompotte)
example: Das Kompott aus Äpfeln ist noch warm. — The stewed apple is still warm.

hindi: समझौता — दोनों पक्षों के थोड़ा-थोड़ा झुकने से बना हल
definition: a compromise, an agreement in which both sides give up part of what they wanted (der Kompromiss, plural Kompromisse)
example: Wir haben einen guten Kompromiss gefunden. — We found a good compromise.

hindi: हास्य नाटक — हँसाने वाली फ़िल्म या नाटक
definition: a comedy, a funny play or film meant to make the audience laugh and ending happily (die Komödie, plural Komödien)
example: Die Komödie war so lustig, dass alle Tränen lachten. — The comedy was so funny that everyone laughed until they cried.

hindi: दमखम — शारीरिक सहनशक्ति और फ़िटनेस
definition: physical fitness or stamina, the general condition of the body that lets an athlete keep going without tiring (die Kondition, no plural in this sense)
example: Meine Kondition ist nach dem Urlaub schlecht. — My fitness is poor after the holiday.

hindi: सम्मेलन — बड़ी औपचारिक बैठक या कई लोगों की चर्चा
definition: a conference, a larger formal meeting or discussion of many participants, also the word for a group phone or video call (die Konferenz, plural Konferenzen)
example: Die Konferenz findet nächste Woche online statt. — The conference takes place online next week.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्वी — बाज़ार में होड़ करने वाली दूसरी कंपनी या व्यक्ति
definition: a competitor or rival company or person fighting for the same customers, contract or position in a market (der Konkurrent, plural Konkurrenten)
example: Unser größter Konkurrent sitzt in München. — Our biggest competitor is based in Munich.

hindi: प्रतिद्वंद्विता — बाज़ार की होड़, या होड़ करने वाली दूसरी कंपनियाँ मिलाकर
definition: the rivalry between businesses competing for the same customers, or collectively the rival companies themselves in a market (die Konkurrenz, no plural)
example: Die Konkurrenz verkauft das gleiche Produkt billiger. — The competition sells the same product cheaper.

hindi: दृढ़ — अपने नियमों पर लगातार टिके रहने वाला
definition: consistent, firm and unwavering in applying principles or rules, never consequent or resulting
example: Die Lehrerin ist streng, aber konsequent. — The teacher is strict but consistent.

hindi: खाता — बैंक में पैसे रखने का खाता
definition: a bank account where money is kept, paid into and withdrawn from, also an online user account (das Konto, plural Konten)
example: Das Gehalt kommt am Monatsende auf mein Konto. — The salary arrives in my account at month's end.

hindi: खाता विवरण — खाते के सभी लेन-देन की सूची
definition: a bank statement, the printed list of all payments into and out of a bank account (der Kontoauszug, plural Kontoauszüge)
example: Auf dem Kontoauszug fehlt eine Buchung. — One transaction is missing from the bank statement.

hindi: खाते की शेष राशि — इस समय खाते में मौजूद रकम
definition: the account balance, the amount of money currently sitting in a bank account (der Kontostand, plural Kontostände)
example: Mein Kontostand ist am Monatsende immer niedrig. — My account balance is always low at the end of the month.

hindi: जाँचना — टिकट या दस्तावेज़ की जाँच करना, नियंत्रण से अधिक
definition: to check or inspect tickets, papers or work for correctness, more often than to control or steer (regular)
example: Der Schaffner kontrolliert die Fahrkarten. — The conductor checks the tickets.

hindi: बड़ा औद्योगिक समूह — कई कंपनियों को मिलाकर बना विशाल निगम
definition: a large corporate group formed from several companies under one controlling parent, a big multinational business (der Konzern, plural Konzerne)
example: Der Konzern verkauft Autos in über hundert Ländern. — The corporation sells cars in over a hundred countries.

hindi: संगीत समारोह — दर्शकों के सामने संगीत का लाइव प्रदर्शन
definition: a concert, the live musical performance by a band, singer or orchestra in front of an audience (das Konzert, plural Konzerte)
example: Das Konzert war schon nach zwei Stunden ausverkauft. — The concert was sold out after just two hours.

hindi: सिर — शरीर का सबसे ऊपरी भाग जिसमें दिमाग़ और चेहरा होता है
definition: the head, the upper part of the human body that holds the brain, face and hair (der Kopf, plural Köpfe)
example: Mir tut der Kopf weh. — My head hurts.

hindi: हिम्मत रखो — उदास मत हो, हार मत मानो
definition: chin up, the everyday encouragement to someone downcast to keep their courage and not give up (exclamation)
example: Kopf hoch, morgen sieht alles besser aus! — Chin up, everything will look better tomorrow!

hindi: कान का ध्वनि यंत्र — कानों पर लगाकर अकेले सुनने का उपकरण
definition: headphones or earphones, the small speakers worn on or in the ears to listen to music or calls privately (der Kopfhörer, plural Kopfhörer)
example: Der neue Kopfhörer ist sehr bequem. — The new headphones are very comfortable.

hindi: दिमाग़ी सिनेमा — कल्पना में चलती अनचाही फ़िल्म
definition: the vivid private film imagination screens for you, replaying scenes you would rather not watch
example: Waiting for the biopsy results, her Kopfkino ran all night.

hindi: सिरदर्द — सिर में होने वाली पीड़ा
definition: a headache, the aching pain inside the head, almost always spoken of in the plural (der Kopfschmerz, plural Kopfschmerzen)
example: Die Kopfschmerzen sind seit dem Morgen da. — The headache has been there since the morning.

hindi: प्रतिलिपि — किसी दस्तावेज़ की नक़ल या छायाप्रति
definition: a copy or photocopy of a document, which offices often require alongside the original when you apply for something (die Kopie, plural Kopien)
example: Legen Sie bitte eine Kopie Ihres Ausweises bei. — Please enclose a copy of your identity card.

hindi: नक़ल बनाना — फ़ाइल या लेख की हूबहू प्रति बनाना
definition: to copy a file, text or picture so that an identical duplicate exists elsewhere, on a computer or with a photocopier (regular)
example: Kopiere den Text und füge ihn hier ein. — Copy the text and paste it here.

hindi: क़ुरआन — इस्लाम का पवित्र ग्रंथ
definition: the Quran, the holy scripture of Islam believed by Muslims to be the revealed word of God (der Koran, plural Korane)
example: Er liest jeden Morgen im Koran. — He reads the Quran every morning.

hindi: टोकरी — बेंत या तार की बुनी हुई खुली टोकरी
definition: a basket, the woven container of wicker or wire for carrying shopping, bread, laundry or fruit (der Korb, plural Körbe)
example: Der Korb ist voll mit frischem Brot. — The basket is full of fresh bread.

hindi: डाट — शराब की बोतल का मुँह बंद करने वाला हल्का ठेपा
definition: the cork stopper pushed into the neck of a wine bottle, pulled out with a corkscrew before pouring (der Korken, plural Korken)
example: Der Korken ist beim Öffnen zerbrochen. — The cork broke while opening.

hindi: खुराक — किसी को दिया जाने वाला नियमित भोजन
definition: the food someone regularly eats, especially in the sense of a diet or fare prescribed or provided (die Kost, no plural)
example: Die Kost im Krankenhaus ist leicht. — The food in the hospital is light.

hindi: दाम होना — किसी चीज़ की कीमत इतनी होना
definition: to cost, to have a certain price that the buyer must pay, also to taste a small sample of food (regular: kostet, hat gekostet)
example: Was kostet das Brot? — How much does the bread cost?

hindi: मुफ़्त — बिना किसी शुल्क के
definition: free of charge, costing nothing at all, used of admission, downloads, samples and services
example: Der Eintritt ist heute kostenlos. — Admission is free today.

hindi: वेशभूषा — कार्निवल पर पहनी जाने वाली पोशाक
definition: a costume, the fancy dress outfit people wear to carnival parties and parades (das Kostüm, plural Kostüme)
example: Hast du schon ein Kostüm für Karneval? — Do you already have a costume for carnival?

hindi: घुटनों के बल चलना — बच्चे या कीड़े का रेंगना
definition: to crawl along on hands and knees like a baby, or to scuttle about like an insect (regular: ist gekrabbelt)
example: Das Baby krabbelt durch das ganze Wohnzimmer. — The baby crawls through the whole living room.

hindi: शोर — तेज़ आवाज़; झगड़ा, तकरार
definition: loud noise or racket, and colloquially a row or quarrel between people who are shouting at each other (der Krach, plural Kräche)
example: Der Krach von der Baustelle weckt mich jeden Morgen. — The racket from the building site wakes me every morning.

hindi: ऊर्जा भरना — आराम से नई शक्ति बटोरना
definition: to recharge one's batteries, to gather fresh energy and strength through rest, nature or holiday (tankt Kraft, hat Kraft getankt)
example: Am Meer kann ich richtig Kraft tanken. — By the sea I can really recharge.

hindi: बिजलीघर — जहाँ बड़े पैमाने पर बिजली बनाई जाती है
definition: a power station, the large plant where electricity is generated from coal, gas, nuclear fuel or water (das Kraftwerk, plural Kraftwerke)
example: Das alte Kraftwerk wird nächstes Jahr abgeschaltet. — The old power station will be shut down next year.

hindi: गरेबान — कमीज़ या कोट का गले वाला हिस्सा
definition: a collar, the folded band of fabric around the neck of a shirt, coat or jacket (der Kragen, plural Kragen)
example: Der Kragen ist schmutzig. — The collar is dirty.

hindi: सामान — बेकार, बिखरा हुआ छोटा-मोटा माल
definition: stuff or junk, miscellaneous small things or matters of little value, colloquial and mildly dismissive (der Kram, no plural)
example: Räum deinen Kram vom Tisch! — Clear your stuff off the table!

hindi: भारोत्तोलक यंत्र — भारी बोझ उठाने वाली लंबी भुजा की ऊँची मशीन
definition: a crane, the tall machine with a long arm that lifts heavy loads on building sites (der Kran, plural Kräne)
example: Der Kran hebt die schweren Träger nach oben. — The crane lifts the heavy girders up.

hindi: बीमार — अस्वस्थ, रोग से ग्रस्त
definition: sick or unwell, suffering from an illness and unable to work or function normally (kränker, am kränksten)
example: Ich bin krank und kann nicht kommen. — I am sick and cannot come.

hindi: अस्पताल — गंभीर रोगियों के भर्ती होकर इलाज की जगह
definition: a hospital, the large institution where seriously ill or injured people are admitted and treated (das Krankenhaus, plural Krankenhäuser)
example: Sie liegt seit Montag im Krankenhaus. — She has been in hospital since Monday.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य बीमा संस्था — इलाज का ख़र्च उठाने वाली संस्था
definition: a health insurance fund, the statutory or private insurer that pays the costs of medical treatment in Germany (die Krankenkasse, plural Krankenkassen)
example: Die Krankenkasse übernimmt die Kosten. — The health insurance covers the costs.

hindi: परिचारक — अस्पताल में मरीज़ों की देखभाल करने वाला प्रशिक्षित पुरुष
definition: a male nurse, the trained person who cares for sick patients in a hospital or care home (der Krankenpfleger, plural Krankenpfleger)
example: Der Krankenpfleger misst jeden Morgen meinen Blutdruck. — The nurse measures my blood pressure every morning.

hindi: परिचारिका — अस्पताल में मरीज़ों की देखभाल करने वाली महिला
definition: a female nurse, the trained woman who cares for sick patients in a hospital, the traditional everyday word (die Krankenschwester, plural Krankenschwestern)
example: Die Krankenschwester gibt dem Patienten seine Tabletten. — The nurse gives the patient his tablets.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य बीमा — इलाज का ख़र्च उठाने वाला अनिवार्य बीमा
definition: health insurance, the compulsory cover in Germany that pays for medical treatment and hospital stays (die Krankenversicherung, plural Krankenversicherungen)
example: Die Krankenversicherung übernimmt die Kosten der Operation. — The health insurance covers the cost of the operation.

hindi: रोगी-वाहन — बीमार या घायल को अस्पताल ले जाने वाली गाड़ी
definition: an ambulance, the emergency vehicle that carries sick or injured people quickly to hospital (der Krankenwagen, plural Krankenwagen)
example: Der Krankenwagen kam nach fünf Minuten. — The ambulance came after five minutes.

hindi: बीमारी — शरीर या मन की कोई भी रुग्ण अवस्था
definition: an illness or disease, any condition that makes a person unwell in body or mind (die Krankheit, plural Krankheiten)
example: Die Krankheit dauerte drei Wochen. — The illness lasted three weeks.

hindi: बीमारी की सूचना — काम पर बीमार होने की ख़बर देना
definition: a notification of sickness, the message an employee sends to the employer to report being unwell and absent (die Krankmeldung, plural Krankmeldungen)
example: Bitte schicken Sie die Krankmeldung bis neun Uhr. — Please send the sick notification by nine.

hindi: बीमार घोषित करना — डॉक्टर द्वारा काम से छुट्टी का प्रमाणपत्र लिखना
definition: to certify someone as unfit for work, a doctor writing a sick note that excuses them from their job (separable: schreibt krank, hat krankgeschrieben)
example: Der Arzt hat mich für eine Woche krankgeschrieben. — The doctor signed me off sick for a week.

hindi: बीमारी की छुट्टी का प्रमाणपत्र — डॉक्टर की लिखी काम से छुट्टी की पर्ची
definition: a sick note, the doctor's written certificate that excuses an employee from work while unwell (die Krankschreibung, plural Krankschreibungen)
example: Die Krankschreibung gilt bis Freitag. — The sick note is valid until Friday.

hindi: जैम भरा तला पकवान — कार्निवल पर खाई जाने वाली तली मीठी गोल पेस्ट्री
definition: a jam-filled doughnut fried in fat and dusted with sugar, eaten especially at carnival and New Year, the southern German and Austrian word (der Krapfen, plural Krapfen)
example: Zum Fasching gibt es Krapfen mit Marmelade. — At carnival there are doughnuts with jam.

hindi: ग़ज़ब, बहुत ज़्यादा — युवाओं की हैरानी
definition: extreme, blatant, glaring; in youth slang a reaction of amazement meaning intense, unbelievable
example: Krass, das hätte ich nie gedacht. — Wow, I never would have thought that.

hindi: खरोंच — सतह पर रगड़ से पड़ा हल्का निशान
definition: a scratch, a shallow mark scraped into a surface such as a car door, a screen, a table or the skin (der Kratzer, plural Kratzer)
example: Das Handy hat einen Kratzer auf dem Display. — The phone has a scratch on the screen.

hindi: गले की पट्टी — कमीज़ के गले पर बाँधी जाने वाली लंबी पट्टी
definition: a necktie, the long narrow strip of cloth knotted at the collar of a formal shirt (die Krawatte, plural Krawatten)
example: Muss ich zur Feier eine Krawatte tragen? — Do I have to wear a tie to the celebration?

hindi: हाथ-पैर से चढ़ाई करना — दक्षिणी बोली में मुश्किल पहाड़ी चढ़ाई
definition: to scramble or clamber up steep rocky ground using hands and feet, a colloquial Southern German and Austrian word for climbing (regular: ist gekraxelt)
example: Die Kinder kraxeln über die Felsen am See. — The children scramble over the rocks by the lake.

hindi: ऋण या क़र्ज़ — बैंक से उधार ली गई रकम जो ब्याज सहित लौटानी हो
definition: a loan or credit, money borrowed from a bank that must be repaid with interest over an agreed period (der Kredit, plural Kredite)
example: Wir nehmen einen Kredit für das Haus auf. — We are taking out a loan for the house.

hindi: उधारी भुगतान पत्रक — बाद में चुकाने की शर्त पर ख़रीदारी वाला बैंक का पत्रक
definition: a credit card, the plastic card used to pay for goods and settle the amount with the bank later (die Kreditkarte, plural Kreditkarten)
example: Kleine Läden nehmen oft keine Kreditkarte. — Small shops often don't accept credit cards.

hindi: चॉक — श्यामपट पर लिखने की सफ़ेद छड़ी
definition: chalk, the white or coloured stick used for writing on a classroom blackboard (die Kreide, plural Kreiden)
example: Die Kreide ist schon wieder alle. — We have run out of chalk again.

hindi: वृत्त, घेरा — पूरी तरह गोल रेखा या लोगों का समूह
definition: a circle, a perfectly round closed shape, also a ring of people sitting together or a group of friends (der Kreis, plural Kreise)
example: Die Kinder sitzen im Kreis auf dem Boden. — The children sit in a circle on the floor.

hindi: रक्त-संचार — शरीर में खून का चक्र
definition: the circulation of blood through the body; colloquially one's general circulatory condition (der Kreislauf, plural Kreisläufe)
example: Bei Hitze macht mein Kreislauf Probleme. — In the heat my circulation gives me trouble.

hindi: गोल चक्कर — जहाँ गाड़ियाँ एक घेरे में घूमकर मुड़ती हैं
definition: a roundabout, a circular junction where traffic flows around a central island instead of crossing (der Kreisverkehr, plural Kreisverkehre)
example: Im Kreisverkehr nehmen Sie die zweite Ausfahrt. — At the roundabout take the second exit.

hindi: कबाड़ — बेकार, फ़ालतू सामान
definition: junk or clutter, worthless old stuff that gets in the way and should be thrown out, colloquial (der Krempel, no plural)
example: Im Keller liegt der ganze alte Krempel. — All the old junk is lying in the cellar.

hindi: सलीब — ईसाई धर्म का चिह्न; पीठ का निचला हिस्सा भी
definition: a cross, the symbol of Christianity made of two crossing beams, also the lower back of the body (das Kreuz, plural Kreuze)
example: Über der Tür hängt ein kleines Kreuz. — A small cross hangs above the door.

hindi: समुद्री सैर — बड़े जहाज़ पर रहते हुए कई बंदरगाहों की छुट्टियाँ
definition: a cruise, a holiday spent living aboard a large ship that calls at several ports (die Kreuzfahrt, plural Kreuzfahrten)
example: Meine Eltern machen eine Kreuzfahrt durch das Mittelmeer. — My parents are going on a cruise through the Mediterranean.

hindi: चौराहा — जहाँ दो या ज़्यादा सड़कें एक-दूसरे को काटें
definition: a crossroads or intersection, the point where two or more streets cross each other, usually with traffic lights (die Kreuzung, plural Kreuzungen)
example: An der nächsten Kreuzung musst du links abbiegen. — At the next intersection you have to turn left.

hindi: वर्ग पहेली — खानों में शब्द भरने की पहेली
definition: a crossword puzzle, a grid of squares filled with words from numbered clues (das Kreuzworträtsel, plural Kreuzworträtsel)
example: Sonntags löst er gern das Kreuzworträtsel. — On Sundays he likes solving the crossword.

hindi: रेंगना — पेट या हाथ-घुटनों के बल धीरे चलना
definition: to crawl or creep along the ground on hands and knees or on the belly, also to move very slowly (irregular: kroch, ist gekrochen)
example: Die Schnecke kriecht langsam über das Blatt. — The snail crawls slowly across the leaf.

hindi: युद्ध — देशों या गुटों के बीच सशस्त्र लड़ाई
definition: war or warfare, an armed conflict fought between countries or large groups over a long period (der Krieg, plural Kriege)
example: Der Krieg endete im Mai 1945. — The war ended in May 1945.

hindi: मिल जाना — बोलचाल में कोई चीज़ पाना
definition: to get or receive something, the colloquial spoken equivalent of bekommen used all over daily German (regular: kriegt, kriegte, hat gekriegt)
example: Kriegst du das Fenster auf? — Can you get the window open?

hindi: जासूसी कहानी — अपराध और उसकी जाँच पर आधारित किताब या फ़िल्म
definition: a crime story or detective novel, colloquial short form used for both books and films about solving a murder or crime (der Krimi, plural Krimis)
example: Sonntags schauen wir immer einen Krimi im Fernsehen. — On Sundays we always watch a crime show on television.

hindi: जन्म-झाँकी — ईसा के जन्म की छोटी मूर्तियों वाला दृश्य
definition: the nativity scene, a model stable with small figures of the holy family, shepherds and animals displayed at Christmas (die Krippe, plural Krippen)
example: Unter dem Baum steht eine kleine Krippe aus Holz. — A small wooden nativity scene stands under the tree.

hindi: कसौटी — जिसके आधार पर जाँच या चुनाव किया जाए
definition: a criterion, a standard or distinguishing rule by which something is judged, selected or classified (das Kriterium, plural Kriterien)
example: Der Preis ist für mich das wichtigste Kriterium. — For me the price is the most important criterion.

hindi: आलोचना — किसी कृति या व्यवहार का मूल्यांकन या निंदा
definition: criticism or a critical review of a book, film or performance, and also disapproving comment on someone's behaviour (die Kritik, plural Kritiken)
example: Der Film bekam gute Kritiken, aber wenig Zuschauer. — The film got good reviews but few viewers.

hindi: घड़ियाली आँसू — झूठा दिखावटी दुख
definition: insincere tears or a pretended show of grief meant only to impress others (die Krokodilsträne, plural Krokodilstränen)
example: Die Krokodilstränen des Politikers überzeugten niemanden. — The politician's crocodile tears convinced nobody.

hindi: सुराही या घड़ा — हत्थे वाला बड़ा पात्र जिसमें पानी या बीयर रखते हैं
definition: a jug or pitcher, the large handled vessel for holding and pouring water, juice or beer (der Krug, plural Krüge)
example: Bring bitte einen Krug Wasser. — Please bring a jug of water.

hindi: टेढ़ा, मुड़ा हुआ — सीधा नहीं, झुका या घुमावदार
definition: crooked or bent, curved away from a straight line, describing a bent nail, a hunched back or a winding path
example: Der alte Baum ist ganz krumm gewachsen. — The old tree has grown completely crooked.

hindi: पपड़ी — रोटी की बाहरी सिंकी सख़्त परत
definition: the crust, the hard browned outer layer of a loaf of bread or a roast that many people like best (die Kruste, plural Krusten)
example: Die Kruste vom Brot ist schön knusprig. — The crust of the bread is nicely crispy.

hindi: हट्टा-कट्टा — बलिष्ठ, दमदार
definition: sturdy and robust, physically powerful and muscular, also used of strong flavours, hearty meals and vivid colours
example: Der Bauer hat kräftige Hände. — The farmer has strong hands.

hindi: मीठा पकवान — आटे, चीनी और अंडे से ओवन में सेंका गया
definition: a cake, the baked sweet made from flour, sugar, butter and eggs that is eaten with coffee in the afternoon (der Kuchen, plural Kuchen)
example: Am Sonntag backe ich einen Kuchen. — On Sunday I bake a cake.

hindi: गोला, गेंद — हर ओर से गोल ठोस आकार, या बंदूक की गोली
definition: a sphere or ball, a solid shape that is round in every direction, also a scoop of ice cream or a bullet (die Kugel, plural Kugeln)
example: Ich möchte zwei Kugeln Eis, bitte. — I would like two scoops of ice cream, please.

hindi: गाय — दूध देने वाला बड़ा खेत का जानवर
definition: a cow, the large farm animal that gives milk and grazes on the meadow (die Kuh, plural Kühe)
example: Die Kuh steht auf der Weide. — The cow is standing in the pasture.

hindi: मंच सज्जा — नाटक में पीछे लगी पेंट की हुई दृश्यावली
definition: a piece of stage scenery, the painted backdrop or set that shows where a play or film scene takes place (die Kulisse, plural Kulissen)
example: Die Kulisse zeigt eine alte Straße in Berlin. — The scenery shows an old street in Berlin.

hindi: लुढ़कते जाना — छोटी गोल चीज़ या आँसू का लुढ़कना
definition: to roll or tumble along, of small round things like marbles, coins or tears, a colloquial and slightly playful verb (regular: ist gekullert)
example: Die Münze kullert unter das Sofa. — The coin rolls under the sofa.

hindi: सांस्कृतिक विरासत — पूर्वजों से मिली इमारतें, कला और परंपराएँ
definition: cultural heritage, the buildings, artworks and traditions inherited from the past and worth protecting (das Kulturerbe, no plural)
example: Der Dom gehört zum Kulturerbe der Stadt. — The cathedral is part of the cultural heritage of the city.

hindi: ग़म — लंबे समय तक मन को कुरेदने वाली चिंता या दुःख
definition: sorrow or worry, the gnawing personal trouble that weighs on someone for a long while (der Kummer, no plural)
example: Der Kummer um seine kranke Mutter raubt ihm den Schlaf. — The worry about his sick mother robs him of sleep.

hindi: ग़म का मोटापा — दुख में खा-खाकर चढ़ा हुआ वज़न
definition: the quiet weight gained from eating your way through heartbreak, grief, or a long bad season
example: Three months after the divorce he blamed the tight jeans on Kummerspeck.

hindi: यार — बोलचाल में साथी या दोस्त
definition: a mate or buddy, a casual friend, colloquial and mostly used between men when talking about friends from school, sport or work (der Kumpel, plural Kumpel)
example: Ich treffe heute Abend einen Kumpel. — I am meeting a mate this evening.

hindi: ग्राहक — सामान या सेवा खरीदने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a customer or client, the person who buys goods or services from a shop or company (der Kunde, plural Kunden)
example: Der Kunde wartet an der Kasse. — The customer is waiting at the till.

hindi: कला — चित्रकला, संगीत, नृत्य जैसी सृजनात्मक विद्या
definition: art and artistry, the creative activity of making paintings, music, sculpture or theatre, and the artworks produced by it (die Kunst, plural Künste)
example: Sie interessiert sich sehr für die moderne Kunst. — She is very interested in modern art.

hindi: कृत्रिम पदार्थ — तेल से बना बनावटी पदार्थ, बोतलों और पैकिंग के लिए
definition: plastic, the artificial synthetic material made from oil that is moulded into bottles, packaging and countless everyday objects (der Kunststoff, plural Kunststoffe)
example: Die Flasche ist aus Kunststoff, nicht aus Glas. — The bottle is made of plastic, not glass.

hindi: कलाकृति — कलाकार की बनाई कोई भी रचना
definition: a work of art, any painting, sculpture, building or other object created by an artist and admired for its beauty (das Kunstwerk, plural Kunstwerke)
example: Dieses Kunstwerk ist über dreihundert Jahre alt. — This work of art is more than three hundred years old.

hindi: स्वास्थ्य-उपचार — किसी स्थान पर रहकर लंबा आरोग्य उपचार
definition: a health cure, a stay of several weeks at a spa or clinic for treatment and recovery, often paid by insurance (die Kur, plural Kuren)
example: Meine Mutter fährt drei Wochen zur Kur. — My mother is going to a health spa for three weeks.

hindi: कौतुकपूर्ण — अजीब पर मनोरंजक, अनोखा
definition: curious, quaint, oddly amusing; describes something strange that entertains rather than disturbs
example: Im Museum gibt es viele kuriose Erfindungen. — In the museum there are many curious inventions.

hindi: आरोग्य-स्थल — इलाज और विश्राम के लिए प्रसिद्ध जगह
definition: a spa town or health resort where people stay for treatment, rest and clean air (der Kurort, plural Kurorte)
example: Der Kurort liegt ruhig im Wald. — The spa town lies quietly in the forest.

hindi: छोटा — लंबाई या अवधि में कम
definition: short in length or duration, describing hair, distances, texts and brief periods of time, the opposite of long
example: Der Weg zum Bahnhof ist kurz. — The way to the station is short.

hindi: कम-काम व्यवस्था — मंदी में नौकरी बचाने को घटे हुए घंटे
definition: shortened hours agreed with state support, so a downturn costs workers time rather than their jobs
example: The plant went on Kurzarbeit for six months and kept every worker on the books.

hindi: दुलारना — बच्चे या साथी को गर्माहट और प्यार से चिपटाकर लेटना
definition: to cuddle or snuggle, holding a child or partner closely for warmth and affection, often under a blanket (regular: hat gekuschelt; mit + Dativ)
example: Abends kuschelt sie gern mit ihrer Mama auf dem Sofa. — In the evening she likes cuddling with her mum on the sofa.

hindi: गुदगुदा खिलौना — बच्चों का सोते समय गले लगाने वाला नरम जानवर
definition: a cuddly toy, the soft plush stuffed animal that children hug in bed and carry everywhere, literally a snuggling animal (das Kuscheltier, plural Kuscheltiere)
example: Ohne sein Kuscheltier kann der Junge nicht einschlafen. — Without his cuddly toy the boy cannot fall asleep.

hindi: चुंबन — होंठों से प्यार जताना
definition: a kiss, the touch of the lips given to a partner or loved one as a sign of affection (der Kuss, plural Küsse)
example: Er gab ihr einen Kuss zum Abschied. — He gave her a kiss goodbye.

hindi: भृंग — कड़े चमकीले पंखों वाला रेंगने वाला कीट
definition: a beetle, the insect with a hard shiny shell over its wings that crawls through gardens and forests (der Käfer, plural Käfer)
example: Ein kleiner Käfer krabbelt über das Blatt. — A small beetle crawls across the leaf.

hindi: ठंड — कँपा देने वाला नीचा तापमान
definition: cold, low temperature that makes people shiver and wrap up in coats and scarves (die Kälte, no plural)
example: Die Kälte kriecht durch die Fenster. — The cold creeps through the windows.

hindi: शीत लहर — कई दिनों की कड़ाके की ठंड
definition: a cold snap, a stretch of days with unusually freezing temperatures that grips a whole region (die Kältewelle, plural Kältewellen)
example: Die Kältewelle bringt minus fünfzehn Grad. — The cold snap brings minus fifteen degrees.

hindi: लड़ना — संघर्ष करना, किसी चीज़ के लिए जूझना
definition: to fight, struggle or battle for something, physically or through effort and competition (regular: kämpft, hat gekämpft; um/für + Akkusativ)
example: Wir kämpfen um jeden einzelnen Kunden. — We fight for every single customer.

hindi: किसी मक़सद के लिए लड़ना — किसी अधिकार या लक्ष्य के लिए संघर्ष करना
definition: to fight or struggle hard for a goal, right or cause that you want to achieve or defend (für + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Die Arbeiter kämpfen für höhere Löhne. — The workers are fighting for higher wages.

hindi: छोटी केतली — कहवाघर में दो प्याले कहवा या चाय वाला छोटा बर्तन
definition: a small pot of coffee or tea holding about two cups, the classic German café serving size (das Kännchen, plural Kännchen)
example: Wir nehmen ein Kännchen Kaffee für zwei Personen. — We will take a small pot of coffee for two people.

hindi: पनीर — दूध जमाकर बना ठोस खाद्य, पनीर
definition: cheese, the solid food made from curdled milk and eaten sliced on bread, grated over pasta or served on a platter (der Käse, plural Käse)
example: Der Käse schmeckt sehr kräftig. — The cheese tastes very strong.

hindi: धीमी आँच पर पकाना — हल्की उबाल पर देर तक रखना
definition: to simmer, cooking a liquid or stew gently over low heat just below the boiling point (regular: köchelt, hat geköchelt)
example: Die Soße köchelt zwanzig Minuten auf dem Herd. — The sauce simmers on the stove for twenty minutes.

hindi: राजा — किसी राज्य का वंशानुगत शासक
definition: a king, the hereditary male ruler of a kingdom, also the chess piece and a playing card (der König, plural Könige)
example: Der König ließ das Schloss im Wald bauen. — The king had the castle built in the forest.

hindi: सकना — किसी काम की क्षमता या अनुमति होना
definition: to be able to do something, having the skill, capacity or permission needed, the modal verb of ability (irregular: kann, konnte, hat gekonnt)
example: Ich kann gut schwimmen. — I can swim well.

hindi: अति स्वादिष्ट — लज़ीज़; बहुत मज़ेदार भी
definition: delicious, exquisite, delectable; refined praise for food, also used for something delightfully amusing
example: Das Dessert war einfach köstlich. — The dessert was simply delicious.

hindi: रसोई — खाना पकाने का कमरा
definition: the kitchen, the room of a home where meals are cooked and food is stored (die Küche, plural Küchen)
example: Die Küche ist klein, aber hell. — The kitchen is small but bright.

hindi: ठंडक भरा — हल्का ठंडा, ताज़गी वाला
definition: cool, slightly cold and refreshing, also used of chilled drinks, evening breezes and a reserved or distant manner
example: Abends wird es am Meer kühl. — In the evening it gets cool by the sea.

hindi: प्रशीतक — खाना ठंडा और ताज़ा रखने वाली बिजली की अलमारी
definition: the refrigerator, the cold kitchen cabinet that keeps food and drinks fresh for several days (der Kühlschrank, plural Kühlschränke)
example: Die Milch steht im Kühlschrank. — The milk is in the fridge.

hindi: चूज़ा — मुर्गी का पीला छोटा बच्चा
definition: a chick, the fluffy yellow baby bird of a chicken or other poultry just after hatching (das Küken, plural Küken)
example: Das Küken piepst unter der Wärmelampe. — The chick peeps under the heat lamp.

hindi: नौकरी छोड़ना या निकालना — अनुबंध समाप्त करने की सूचना देना
definition: to resign from a job or to dismiss someone, giving formal notice that a contract will end (regular; dismissing a person takes + Dativ)
example: Sie hat zum Monatsende gekündigt. — She resigned effective the end of the month.

hindi: नौकरी समाप्ति की सूचना — इस्तीफ़ा या निकाले जाने का पत्र
definition: a notice of termination, the letter by which an employee resigns or an employer dismisses someone (die Kündigung, plural Kündigungen)
example: Er hat gestern seine Kündigung eingereicht. — He handed in his resignation yesterday.

hindi: नोटिस अवधि — नोटिस देने और घर छोड़ने के बीच का अनिवार्य समय
definition: the notice period, the legally required time between giving notice and actually leaving (die Kündigungsfrist, plural Kündigungsfristen)
example: Die Kündigungsfrist beträgt drei Monate. — The notice period is three months.

hindi: भविष्य में, आगे से — आने वाले समय में
definition: in future, from now on, during the time that is still to come, slightly formal and common in rules and announcements
example: Künftig fährt der Bus jede halbe Stunde. — In future the bus will run every half hour.

hindi: कलाकार — चित्र, संगीत या मूर्ति रचने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an artist, a person who creates paintings, sculptures, music or other works of art as a profession or calling (der Künstler, plural Künstler)
example: Der Künstler erklärt den Besuchern sein neues Werk. — The artist explains his new work to the visitors.

hindi: कृत्रिम — बनावटी, नक़ली
definition: artificial, synthetic or man-made rather than natural, used of flavours, light, flowers and forced smiles
example: Die Blumen sind künstlich. — The flowers are artificial.

hindi: कद्दू — बड़ी नारंगी गोल सब्ज़ी, पतझड़ में सूप के लिए
definition: a pumpkin or squash, the large round orange autumn vegetable with thick skin that is made into soup or carved for lanterns (der Kürbis, plural Kürbisse)
example: Der Kürbis ist zu schwer für das Kind. — The pumpkin is too heavy for the child.

hindi: छोटा करना, कटौती करना — लंबाई या बजट घटाना
definition: to shorten a text, garment or speech, or to cut a budget, wage or funding to a smaller amount (regular: hat gekürzt)
example: Der Artikel wurde um die Hälfte gekürzt. — The article was cut by half.

hindi: हाल ही में — थोड़े समय पहले, कुछ ही दिन पूर्व
definition: recently, a short time ago in the recent past, slightly more formal than neulich and common in writing
example: Kürzlich wurde die Brücke erneuert. — The bridge was recently renewed.

hindi: चूमना — होंठों से चुंबन देना
definition: to kiss someone, touching them with the lips to express love or affection (regular: hat geküsst, + Akkusativ)
example: Sie küssten sich unter dem Regenschirm. — They kissed each other under the umbrella.

hindi: तटरेखा — जहाँ ज़मीन समुद्र से मिलती है
definition: a coast or coastline, the stretch of land bordering the ocean along a country or region (die Küste, plural Küsten)
example: Die Küste ist hier felsig und wild. — The coast here is rocky and wild.

hindi: बकबक करना — बिना मतलब लंबी बातें करना
definition: to babble or talk endlessly and pointlessly, colloquial and slightly dismissive about someone chatting too much (regular)
example: Hör auf zu labern und komm zum Punkt! — Stop babbling and get to the point!

hindi: प्रयोगशाला — वैज्ञानिक प्रयोग और जाँच करने का कमरा
definition: a laboratory, a room or building equipped with instruments for scientific experiments, medical tests and research (das Labor, plural Labore)
example: Im Labor darf man nicht essen. — You are not allowed to eat in the laboratory.

hindi: हँसना — मज़ेदार बात पर खिलखिलाना
definition: to laugh, to make the happy sound of amusement at a joke or a funny situation (regular: hat gelacht; über + Akkusativ)
example: Wir haben den ganzen Abend gelacht. — We laughed the whole evening.

hindi: किसी बात पर हँसना — किसी मज़ाक़ या व्यक्ति को हँसी का विषय बनाना
definition: to laugh at or about somebody or something, finding a joke or situation funny (über + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Alle lachten über seinen Witz. — Everyone laughed at his joke.

hindi: आवेशक — बिजली से फ़ोन या संगणक की बैटरी भरने वाला उपकरण
definition: a charger, the small power adapter that plugs into a socket to recharge the battery of a phone, laptop or camera (das Ladegerät, plural Ladegeräte)
example: Hast du ein Ladegerät für mein Handy? — Do you have a charger for my phone?

hindi: आवेशन तार — आवेशक को फ़ोन से जोड़ने वाला तार
definition: a charging cable, the cord that connects a phone, tablet or laptop to its charger or to a computer so the battery can fill up (das Ladekabel, plural Ladekabel)
example: Das Ladekabel ist schon wieder kaputt. — The charging cable is broken again.

hindi: दुकान — छोटी, आम बोलचाल की दुकान
definition: a shop or small store where goods are sold, the everyday colloquial word for the place around the corner (der Laden, plural Läden)
example: Der Laden an der Ecke verkauft frisches Brot. — The shop on the corner sells fresh bread.

hindi: दुकान बंद होने का समय — क़ानूनी बंदी का वक़्त
definition: closing time for shops, the hour set by law after which stores may no longer sell to customers (der Ladenschluss, plural Ladenschlüsse)
example: Kurz vor Ladenschluss wird das Brot billiger. — Shortly before closing time the bread gets cheaper.

hindi: स्थिति — किसी जगह की अवस्थिति; हालात
definition: the location or position of a place in relation to its surroundings, also the general situation or state of affairs (die Lage, plural Lagen)
example: Die Wohnung hat eine ruhige Lage am Park. — The apartment has a quiet location by the park.

hindi: भंडार या शिविर — सामान रखने का गोदाम, या तंबुओं वाला अस्थायी ठिकाना
definition: a storehouse or warehouse where goods are kept, also a camp of tents, the word behind lager beer stored cool for months (das Lager, plural Lager)
example: Die Ware liegt noch im Lager hinter dem Geschäft. — The goods are still in the warehouse behind the shop.

hindi: पूरी रोटी — साबुत गोल या लम्बी डबलरोटी की एक इकाई
definition: a whole loaf, the entire round or oblong baked bread before it is sliced, also used for a wheel of cheese (der Laib, plural Laibe)
example: Wir brauchen einen ganzen Laib Brot. — We need a whole loaf of bread.

hindi: मेमना — भेड़ का बच्चा
definition: a lamb, a young sheep in its first year, also the tender meat of a young sheep (das Lamm, plural Lämmer)
example: Das Lamm bleibt immer bei seiner Mutter. — The lamb always stays with its mother.

hindi: बत्ती — रोशनी देने वाला उपकरण
definition: a lamp, the electric light fitting that stands on a table or hangs from the ceiling of a room (die Lampe, plural Lampen)
example: Mach bitte die Lampe an. — Please switch on the lamp.

hindi: उतरना — विमान का ज़मीन पर आना
definition: to land, to touch down or bring an aircraft down onto the runway at the end of a flight (regular, perfect with sein: ist gelandet)
example: Die Maschine ist sicher gelandet. — The plane has landed safely.

hindi: राष्ट्रीय या राज्य सीमा — देश या संघीय राज्य की बाहरी रेखा
definition: a national or state border, the outer boundary line of a country or of a federal state (die Landesgrenze, plural Landesgrenzen)
example: Der Fluss bildet hier die Landesgrenze. — The river forms the state border here.

hindi: राज्य की राजधानी — किसी संघीय राज्य का मुख्य शहर
definition: a state capital, the main city of a federal state where the state parliament and state government are seated (die Landeshauptstadt, plural Landeshauptstädte)
example: Die Landeshauptstadt ist mit dem Zug schnell erreichbar. — The state capital is quick to reach by train.

hindi: नक़्शा — देश या इलाक़े का कागज़ पर बना मानचित्र
definition: a map, a printed or drawn representation of a country or region showing towns, roads, rivers and borders (die Landkarte, plural Landkarten)
example: Auf der Landkarte ist das Dorf kaum zu finden. — The village is hard to find on the map.

hindi: ज़िला — कई गाँवों और छोटे शहरों को मिलाकर बना प्रशासनिक इलाक़ा
definition: a rural district, the administrative area grouping several towns and villages under one district office and council (der Landkreis, plural Landkreise)
example: Der Landkreis baut eine neue Schule. — The district is building a new school.

hindi: परिदृश्य — किसी इलाक़े का प्राकृतिक दृश्य
definition: a landscape, the visible scenery of a region with its hills, fields, water and woods (die Landschaft, plural Landschaften)
example: Die Landschaft hier ist wunderschön. — The landscape here is beautiful.

hindi: देहाती सड़क — गाँवों और कस्बों को जोड़ने वाली सड़क
definition: a country road connecting villages and towns outside the motorway network, usually with one lane each way (die Landstraße, plural Landstraßen)
example: Die Landstraße ist kurvig, aber schön. — The country road is winding but beautiful.

hindi: राज्य विधानसभा — किसी एक जर्मन संघीय राज्य की चुनी हुई संसद
definition: the elected parliament of a single German federal state which makes the laws for that region (der Landtag, plural Landtage)
example: Der Landtag in München hat über Schulen debattiert. — The state parliament in Munich debated schools.

hindi: अवतरण — विमान का ज़मीन पर उतरना
definition: a landing, the moment an aircraft touches down onto the runway at the end of its flight (die Landung, plural Landungen)
example: Die Landung war ziemlich holprig. — The landing was quite bumpy.

hindi: कृषक — खेती का कारोबार चलाने वाला, औपचारिक शब्द
definition: a farmer, someone who runs an agricultural business growing crops or raising livestock, the formal and official term (der Landwirt, plural Landwirte)
example: Der Landwirt hat einen neuen Traktor gekauft. — The farmer has bought a new tractor.

hindi: कृषि — खेती और पशुपालन का पूरा व्यवसाय
definition: agriculture or farming, the whole business of growing crops and raising livestock on the land (die Landwirtschaft, no plural)
example: Die Landwirtschaft ist in dieser Region sehr wichtig. — Agriculture is very important in this region.

hindi: लंबा — एक सिरे से दूसरे तक अधिक दूरी वाला
definition: long in length or duration, describing roads, hair, tables and stretches of time, the basic word for length
example: Der Fluss ist sehr lang. — The river is very long.

hindi: ऊब — कुछ रोचक न होने की नीरस बेचैनी
definition: boredom, the dull restless feeling of having nothing interesting to do or watch (die Langeweile, no plural)
example: Gegen die Langeweile half nur ein gutes Buch. — Only a good book helped against the boredom.

hindi: धीमा — कम गति से चलने वाला
definition: slow, moving or happening at low speed, taking a long time, also meaning gradually or careful
example: Bitte sprechen Sie langsam und deutlich. — Please speak slowly and clearly.

hindi: देर तक सोने वाला — सुबह लंबी नींद लेने का आदी व्यक्ति
definition: a person who habitually sleeps late into the morning and enjoys staying long in bed, the opposite of an early riser (der Langschläfer, plural Langschläfer)
example: Am Wochenende bin ich ein echter Langschläfer. — On the weekend I really sleep in.

hindi: उबाऊ — जिसमें कोई रुचि या रोमांच न हो
definition: boring or dull, lacking interest or excitement so that time drags
example: Der Film war furchtbar langweilig. — The film was terribly boring.

hindi: लंबा-खिंचने वाला — बहुत समय लेने वाला और थकाऊ
definition: lengthy and protracted, taking a long time to complete and often tedious, said of processes and illnesses
example: Die Heilung nach der Operation war langwierig. — The recovery after the operation was lengthy.

hindi: पोंछने का कपड़ा — सफ़ाई में काम आने वाला चीथड़ा
definition: a rag or cleaning cloth, the piece of cloth used to wipe tables, floors and surfaces during cleaning (der Lappen, plural Lappen)
example: Nimm einen feuchten Lappen für den Tisch. — Take a damp cloth for the table.

hindi: सुवाह्य संगणक — गोद में रखकर चलाया जाने वाला हल्का मोड़दार संगणक
definition: a laptop, the portable folding computer with a built-in screen and keyboard that people carry to work, university and cafés (der Laptop, plural Laptops)
example: Ich nehme den Laptop mit ins Café. — I am taking the laptop to the café.

hindi: करने देना — किसी को करने देना या करवाना
definition: to let or allow someone to do something, to leave something behind, or to have a task done by another person (irregular: lässt, ließ, hat gelassen)
example: Lass mich bitte in Ruhe. — Please leave me alone.

hindi: स्वचालित कटौती — आपकी अनुमति से लेनदार द्वारा खाते से रकम खींचना
definition: a direct debit, a payment the recipient pulls from your account with your written permission (die Lastschrift, plural Lastschriften)
example: Die Lastschrift für die Miete kommt am Monatsersten. — The direct debit for the rent comes on the first of the month.

hindi: मालवाहक गाड़ी — भारी सामान ढोने वाला बड़ा मोटर वाहन
definition: a large heavy motor vehicle built to carry freight and goods on roads, a truck or lorry (der Lastwagen, plural Lastwagen)
example: Ein Lastwagen blockiert die ganze Straße. — A truck is blocking the whole street.

hindi: लालटेन — कागज़ की रोशनी वाली लालटेन, बच्चे नवंबर में लेकर चलते हैं
definition: a lantern, the paper lamp on a stick that children carry singing through the streets on Saint Martin's Day (die Laterne, plural Laternen)
example: Meine Laterne habe ich selbst gebastelt. — I made my lantern myself.

hindi: पतझड़ के पत्ते — पेड़ों की झड़ी हुई पत्तियाँ
definition: foliage, the leaves of trees taken together, especially the fallen coloured leaves of autumn (das Laub, no plural)
example: Im Oktober liegt das bunte Laub überall. — In October the colourful foliage lies everywhere.

hindi: गंदना — लंबी सफ़ेद-हरी डंठल वाली हल्की प्याज़-जाति की सब्ज़ी
definition: a leek, the long white and green stalk vegetable of the onion family with a mild flavour used in soups (der Lauch, no plural)
example: Der Lauch kommt zuerst in den Topf. — The leek goes into the pot first.

hindi: दौड़ — दौड़ने की क्रिया या दौड़ प्रतियोगिता, किसी चीज़ का क्रम
definition: a run or running race, the activity of running, also the course of a river or of events (der Lauf, plural Läufe)
example: Der Lauf durch den Park war anstrengend. — The run through the park was exhausting.

hindi: दौड़ना — पैरों से तेज़ चलना या दौड़ लगाना
definition: to run, and in everyday German also to walk on foot, the basic verb for moving quickly on your legs and for running as a sport (läuft, ist gelaufen)
example: Er läuft jeden Tag zehn Kilometer. — He runs ten kilometres every day.

hindi: बिना पैडल की साइकिल — छोटे बच्चों के पैरों से धकेलकर संतुलन सीखने की गाड़ी
definition: a balance bike without pedals on which small children push themselves along and learn to balance before cycling (das Laufrad, plural Laufräder)
example: Mit dem Laufrad ist sie schneller als ich zu Fuß. — On her balance bike she is faster than me on foot.

hindi: मिज़ाज — किसी क्षण का बदलता हुआ मनोभाव, अच्छा या बुरा
definition: a passing mood or temper that changes easily, either cheerful or grumpy, at a given moment (die Laune, plural Launen)
example: Die Laune des Chefs ist heute schlecht. — The boss's mood is bad today.

hindi: चंचल-मिज़ाज — जिसका मिज़ाज बार-बार और बिना कारण बदलता रहे
definition: moody and temperamental, having a mood that changes quickly, unpredictably and without any obvious reason (regular adjective)
example: Das Wetter im April ist launisch wie ein Teenager. — The weather in April is as moody as a teenager.

hindi: कान लगाकर सुनना — चुपचाप ध्यान से सुनना
definition: to listen quietly and intently to something pleasant or secret, whether music or a conversation through a door (regular, + Dativ)
example: Die Kinder lauschten gespannt der Geschichte. — The children listened intently to the story.

hindi: ऊँचा, ज़ोर का — जिसकी आवाज़ तेज़ हो
definition: loud, producing much sound or noise, the opposite of quiet, also used as an adverb for speaking aloud
example: Die Musik ist viel zu laut. — The music is much too loud.

hindi: ध्वनि विस्तारक — आवाज़ को ज़ोर से बजाने वाला यंत्र
definition: a loudspeaker, the device that plays sound or music out loud from a phone, computer or stereo system (der Lautsprecher, plural Lautsprecher)
example: Der Lautsprecher am Laptop ist viel zu leise. — The speaker on the laptop is far too quiet.

hindi: आवाज़ का स्तर — ध्वनि कितनी तेज़ या धीमी है
definition: the volume or loudness of sound, how loud the television, radio or music is playing (die Lautstärke, plural Lautstärken)
example: Dreh bitte die Lautstärke etwas leiser. — Please turn the volume down a little.

hindi: जीवन-खंड का साथी — हमेशा नहीं, बस जीवन के एक दौर का प्रेम-साथी
definition: a romantic partner for one stage of life rather than forever, a dryly ironic word for a companion one does not expect to keep (der Lebensabschnittsgefährte, plural Lebensabschnittsgefährten)
example: Sie stellte ihn ironisch als ihren Lebensabschnittsgefährten vor. — She ironically introduced him as her partner for this phase of life.

hindi: जीवन प्रत्याशा — औसतन कितने साल जीने की उम्मीद
definition: life expectancy, the average number of years a person can expect to live (die Lebenserwartung, no plural)
example: Die Lebenserwartung in Deutschland steigt weiter. — Life expectancy in Germany keeps rising.

hindi: जीवनसाथी — बिना विवाह के साथ रहने वाला साथी
definition: a life partner, the person someone lives with in a lasting relationship without being married (der Lebensgefährte, plural Lebensgefährten)
example: Ihr Lebensgefährte arbeitet als Arzt. — Her partner works as a doctor.

hindi: जीवनसंगिनी — बिना विवाह साथ रहने वाली महिला साथी
definition: a long-term female life companion in a committed unmarried relationship, the formal word for a partner one lives with (die Lebensgefährtin, plural Lebensgefährtinnen)
example: Er stellte seine Lebensgefährtin den Eltern vor. — He introduced his life partner to his parents.

hindi: जीवनवृत्त — शिक्षा और अनुभव का लिखित ब्योरा
definition: a curriculum vitae or résumé, the document listing someone's education and work experience (der Lebenslauf, plural Lebensläufe)
example: Bitte schicken Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf. — Please send us your résumé.

hindi: खाद्य-सामग्री — दुकान से खरीदी जाने वाली खाने की चीज़ें
definition: foodstuffs, the groceries and edible products that people buy in shops to cook and consume (das Lebensmittel, plural Lebensmittel)
example: Die Lebensmittel vom Markt sind frisch. — The groceries from the market are fresh.

hindi: जीवन-शैली — खाने, सोने, काम करने और जीने का ढंग
