definition: the characteristic manner in which a person lives, including eating, sleeping, working and leisure habits (der Lebensstil, plural Lebensstile)
example: Ein gesunder Lebensstil beginnt beim Frühstück. — A healthy lifestyle begins with breakfast.

hindi: जिगर/यकृत — पेट के दाईं ओर ख़ून साफ़ करने वाला बड़ा अंग
definition: the liver, the large organ on the right side of the belly that cleans the blood and processes food (die Leber, plural Lebern)
example: Zu viel Alkohol belastet die Leber. — Too much alcohol strains the liver.

hindi: कलेजी का भरवाँ गोश्त — रोटी पर लगाने वाला कलेजी का नरम लेप
definition: liver sausage, the soft spreadable sausage made with pork liver and eaten on bread, a staple of the German cold supper (die Leberwurst, plural Leberwürste)
example: Die Leberwurst kommt aufs Brot. — The liver sausage goes on the bread.

hindi: मसालेदार शहद-केक — क्रिसमस की पारंपरिक नरम मिठाई
definition: gingerbread, the soft spiced honey cake or cookie with nuts and glaze that belongs to German Christmas markets (der Lebkuchen, plural Lebkuchen)
example: Der Lebkuchen schmeckt nach Honig und Zimt. — The gingerbread tastes of honey and cinnamon.

hindi: स्वादिष्ट — जिसका स्वाद अच्छा लगे, ज़ायक़ेदार
definition: tasty or delicious, the everyday adjective for food and drink that tastes good, heard constantly at the table
example: Das Essen war wirklich lecker, danke! — The food was really tasty, thank you!

hindi: चमड़ा — जानवर की खाल से बनी मज़बूत सामग्री
definition: leather, the strong durable material made from animal hide used for shoes, belts and jackets (das Leder, no plural)
example: Das Leder ist weich und riecht gut. — The leather is soft and smells good.

hindi: चमड़े की पैंट — बवेरिया की पारंपरिक घुटनों तक की चमड़े की पोशाक
definition: knee-length trousers of leather worn as traditional Bavarian dress by men at festivals and in the mountains (die Lederhose, plural Lederhosen)
example: Mein Onkel trägt zur Blasmusik seine alte Lederhose. — My uncle wears his old lederhosen to the brass band.

hindi: अविवाहित — जिसकी शादी न हुई हो, कुँवारा
definition: single, unmarried, never having been wedded, the official word on forms for marital status
example: Bist du ledig oder verheiratet? — Are you single or married?

hindi: मात्र — केवल इतना ही (औपचारिक)
definition: only, merely, solely; a formal restrictive adverb used in written or official German
example: Es fehlt lediglich Ihre Unterschrift. — Only your signature is missing.

hindi: खाली — जिसमें कुछ न हो
definition: empty with nothing inside, describing glasses, rooms, streets and batteries, the opposite of full
example: Die Flasche ist leer. — The bottle is empty.

hindi: खाली करना — बर्तन या डिब्बे की सारी चीज़ें निकाल देना
definition: to empty a container, rubbish bin or glass completely by removing everything inside it, leaving nothing behind (regular: hat geleert)
example: Der Briefkasten wird täglich um zehn geleert. — The postbox is emptied daily at ten.

hindi: ख़ाली बोतलें-क्रेट — लौटाने के लिए जमा किया गया सामान
definition: empties, the collective word for empty deposit bottles, cans and crates taken back to the supermarket (das Leergut, no plural)
example: Bring bitte das Leergut mit zum Supermarkt. — Please bring the empties along to the supermarket.

hindi: लिटाकर रखना — किसी चीज़ को आड़ी अवस्था में रखना
definition: to lay or place something down in a horizontal position, such as putting a book flat on a table (regular: hat gelegt, place with Akkusativ)
example: Ich lege die Zeitung auf den Tisch. — I am putting the newspaper on the table.

hindi: पाठ्यपुस्तक — किसी विषय को सिखाने वाली किताब
definition: a textbook, the printed book written to teach one subject systematically to pupils or university students (das Lehrbuch, plural Lehrbücher)
example: Das Lehrbuch kostet fast fünfzig Euro. — The textbook costs almost fifty euros.

hindi: शिक्षक — स्कूल में बच्चों को पढ़ाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a teacher, the person whose profession is instructing pupils at a school in one or more subjects (der Lehrer, plural Lehrer)
example: Unser Lehrer erklärt alles sehr geduldig. — Our teacher explains everything very patiently.

hindi: शिक्षिका — स्कूल में पढ़ाने वाली महिला
definition: a female teacher, a woman whose profession is instructing pupils at a school (die Lehrerin, plural Lehrerinnen)
example: Die neue Lehrerin kommt aus Hamburg. — The new teacher comes from Hamburg.

hindi: शागिर्द — उस्ताद के पास हुनर सीखने वाला नौजवान
definition: an apprentice, a young person learning a trade under a master craftsman, the traditional word (der Lehrling, plural Lehrlinge)
example: Der Lehrling lernt beim Bäcker das Handwerk. — The apprentice is learning the trade at the baker's.

hindi: लाश, शव — मरे हुए व्यक्ति का शरीर
definition: a corpse, the dead body of a person, a direct word used in news and police reports (die Leiche, plural Leichen)
example: Die Polizei fand die Leiche am Flussufer. — The police found the body on the riverbank.

hindi: हल्का — कम वज़न का; आसान
definition: light in weight, easy to lift or carry, also meaning easy, simple or slight, used of bags, tasks and mild illnesses
example: Die Tasche ist leicht, ich trage sie. — The bag is light, I'll carry it.

hindi: लापरवाह — बिना परिणाम सोचे जोखिम उठाने वाला
definition: reckless and careless, taking foolish risks without thinking about the consequences or possible danger (regular adjective)
example: Es war leichtsinnig, ohne Helm zu fahren. — It was reckless to ride without a helmet.

hindi: पीड़ा सहना — दर्द, बीमारी या दुख झेलना
definition: to suffer pain, illness or grief, to endure hardship, and in gut leiden können to be able to stand someone (irregular: leidet, litt, hat gelitten, leiden an or unter + Dativ)
example: Sie leidet seit Jahren unter Kopfschmerzen. — She has suffered from headaches for years.

hindi: किसी बात से पीड़ित होना — किसी स्थिति के कारण दुख या तकलीफ़ झेलना
definition: to suffer from or be badly affected by a difficult situation, stress, noise or illness over time (unter + Dativ, leidet, hat gelitten)
example: Viele Menschen leiden unter dem Lärm der Stadt. — Many people suffer from the noise of the city.

hindi: दुर्भाग्य से — अफ़सोस के साथ, खेद है कि
definition: unfortunately, regrettably; the everyday adverb that softens unwelcome news or a polite refusal with an expression of regret
example: Leider habe ich morgen keine Zeit. — Unfortunately I have no time tomorrow.

hindi: उधार देना या लेना — कुछ समय के लिए पैसा या चीज़ देना-लेना
definition: to lend something to someone, or with sich, to borrow it for a limited time (irregular: leiht, hat geliehen; + Dativ der Person)
example: Kannst du mir bis Freitag fünfzig Euro leihen? — Can you lend me fifty euros until Friday?

hindi: चित्रपट — जिस कपड़े पर चित्र बनता है, या सिनेमा का पर्दा
definition: a canvas, the stretched cloth a painter works on, and also the large screen on which films are shown in a cinema (die Leinwand, plural Leinwände)
example: Die Leinwand ist noch ganz weiß und leer. — The canvas is still completely white and empty.

hindi: धीमा, मंद — जिसकी आवाज़ हल्की हो
definition: quiet or soft in sound, making little noise, used for voices, music and footsteps
example: Sprich bitte leise, das Baby schläft. — Please speak quietly, the baby is sleeping.

hindi: कर दिखाना — काम या उपलब्धि पूरी करना, प्रदर्शन करना
definition: to achieve, perform or accomplish a piece of work or service; reflexive 'sich leisten' means to afford (regular: leistet, hat geleistet)
example: Das Team hat wirklich gute Arbeit geleistet. — The team did really good work.

hindi: उपलब्धि — किया गया काम, प्रदर्शन या क्षमता
definition: performance, achievement or accomplishment, the measurable result of work or ability, also output (die Leistung, plural Leistungen)
example: Das war eine tolle Leistung von dir! — That was a great achievement of yours!

hindi: सीढ़ी — ऊँचाई तक पहुँचने के लिए डंडों वाला उपकरण
definition: a ladder, the portable frame of rungs that is climbed to reach high shelves, ceilings or roofs (die Leiter, plural Leitern)
example: Ich brauche die Leiter für die Deckenlampe. — I need the ladder for the ceiling light.

hindi: मूल स्वरलहरी — बार-बार लौटने वाला संगीत-सूत्र
definition: a recurring musical phrase tied to one character or idea, returning whenever the story summons it
example: Four descending notes serve as the villain's Leitmotiv throughout the opera.

hindi: नल का पानी — बोतल का नहीं, सीधे नल से आने वाला साधारण पानी
definition: tap water, the ordinary water from the faucet, which German restaurants rarely serve unless you ask for it (das Leitungswasser, no plural)
example: Das Leitungswasser in Deutschland kann man trinken. — You can drink the tap water in Germany.

hindi: ज़बरदस्त — बहुत बढ़िया, विएना की बोलचाल की तारीफ़
definition: great, excellent or terrific, the strongly colloquial Viennese word of praise for anything enjoyable, from a party to a film
example: Das Konzert gestern war echt leiwand. — The concert yesterday was really great.

hindi: चालन चक्र — गाड़ी की दिशा मोड़ने वाला पहिया
definition: a steering wheel, the round control the driver turns to change the direction of the vehicle (das Lenkrad, plural Lenkräder)
example: Er hielt das Lenkrad fest mit beiden Händen. — He held the steering wheel firmly with both hands.

hindi: सीखना — पढ़कर या अभ्यास से ज्ञान पाना
definition: to learn or to study, to acquire knowledge or a skill through practice and instruction (regular)
example: Ich lerne heute für die Prüfung. — I am studying for the exam today.

hindi: पढ़ना — लिखे हुए शब्दों को आँखों से समझना
definition: to read written or printed words, whether a book, a letter, a newspaper or a screen (irregular: liest, hat gelesen)
example: Mein Sohn liest jeden Abend vor dem Schlafen. — My son reads every evening before sleeping.

hindi: पाठक — अख़बार, पत्रिका या किताब पढ़ने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a reader, the person who reads a newspaper, magazine or book, often addressed by the publication (der Leser, plural Leser)
example: Ein Leser hat einen Brief an die Zeitung geschrieben. — A reader wrote a letter to the newspaper.

hindi: पढ़ाकू चुहिया — हमेशा किताबों में डूबा रहने वाला पाठक
definition: an avid enthusiastic reader who devours books constantly and always has a novel nearby, a bookworm, literally a reading rat, affectionate (die Leseratte, plural Leseratten)
example: Meine Tochter ist eine Leseratte und liest jeden Abend. — My daughter is a bookworm and reads every evening.

hindi: पाठ-गोष्ठी — लेखक द्वारा श्रोताओं के सामने अपनी रचना का वाचन
definition: a public reading, an event where an author reads aloud from their book to an audience and answers questions (die Lesung, plural Lesungen)
example: Die Lesung findet am Freitag in der Buchhandlung statt. — The reading takes place on Friday in the bookshop.

hindi: अंत में, आख़िरकार — लंबी प्रक्रिया के अंतिम नतीजे का शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning in the end or eventually, stressing the final outcome after a long process
example: Letztendlich haben wir uns geeinigt. — In the end we reached an agreement.

hindi: अंततः, आख़िर में — सब सोचकर निकाला गया निष्कर्ष
definition: an adverb meaning ultimately or in the final analysis, stating what matters when everything is weighed
example: Letztlich zählt nur das Ergebnis. — Ultimately only the result counts.

hindi: इनकार करना — किसी आरोप या तथ्य को झूठ बताना
definition: to deny an accusation or a proven fact stubbornly, insisting that something never happened or was never done (regular: leugnet, hat geleugnet)
example: Er leugnet, das Auto gefahren zu haben. — He denies having driven the car.

hindi: लोग — बोलचाल में कई व्यक्ति
definition: people, several persons spoken of together in everyday conversation, a noun used only in the plural (die Leute, no singular)
example: Die Leute hier sind sehr freundlich. — The people here are very friendly.

hindi: बत्ती की कुंजी — रोशनी जलाने-बुझाने का बटन
definition: a light switch, the small wall fitting pressed or flipped to turn the lights of a room on and off (der Lichtschalter, plural Lichtschalter)
example: Der Lichtschalter ist neben der Tür. — The light switch is next to the door.

hindi: वन-प्रांगण — जंगल के बीच खुली, धूप वाली जगह
definition: an open clearing in woodland where the canopy breaks and daylight reaches all the way to the forest floor
example: The deer were standing in the Lichtung when the path finally opened out.

hindi: प्रेम — गहरा स्नेह और लगाव
definition: love, the deep affection and attachment felt for a partner, family member or anything cherished (die Liebe, plural rare: Lieben)
example: Ihre Liebe wurde mit den Jahren stärker. — Their love grew stronger with the years.

hindi: स्नेह सहित — दोस्तों को संदेश का समापन
definition: the warm closing of a message or postcard to friends and family, often shortened to two letters
example: Liebe Grüße aus dem Urlaub, deine Mia. — Warm greetings from holiday, yours Mia.

hindi: प्यार करना — किसी से गहरा स्नेह और लगाव रखना
definition: to love someone deeply, or to be very fond of an activity or thing, the strongest everyday word for affection (regular)
example: Sie liebt ihren Mann seit zwanzig Jahren. — She has loved her husband for twenty years.

hindi: सौम्य और स्नेही — इतना विनम्र और दयालु कि सबको भा जाए
definition: amiable and gracious, kind and pleasant in a slightly formal way that makes people warm to the person
example: Der alte Herr war ausgesprochen liebenswürdig. — The old gentleman was exceptionally amiable.

hindi: बेहतर होगा कि — दो में से जिसे ज़्यादा पसंद करें
definition: rather, preferably; the comparative form of gern used to state that someone would prefer one activity or option over another
example: Ich bleibe heute lieber zu Hause. — I'd rather stay at home today.

hindi: प्रेम-संबंध — दो लोगों के बीच का प्रेम का रिश्ता
definition: a romantic relationship between two people who love each other, the word making the love explicit rather than mere friendship (die Liebesbeziehung, plural Liebesbeziehungen)
example: Aus der Freundschaft wurde eine Liebesbeziehung. — The friendship turned into a romantic relationship.

hindi: प्रेम-पीड़ा — टूटे या एकतरफ़ा प्यार का दुख
definition: lovesickness or heartache, the sadness after a breakup or from unrequited love (der Liebeskummer, no plural)
example: Der Liebeskummer hielt bei ihr wochenlang an. — Her heartache lasted for weeks.

hindi: प्यारा मानना — किसी से स्नेह रखना, ख़ासकर बच्चों या परिवार से
definition: to be fond of someone with warm affection, gentler and more family-like than lieben, often said to children (separable: hat lieb, hat liebgehabt)
example: Die Oma hat ihre Enkel sehr lieb. — Grandma is very fond of her grandchildren.

hindi: गीत — धुन के साथ गाए जाने वाले बोल
definition: a song, a short piece of music with words that is meant to be sung (das Lied, plural Lieder)
example: Dieses Lied kennt in Deutschland jedes Kind. — Every child in Germany knows this song.

hindi: आपूर्तिकर्ता — किसी कंपनी को कच्चा माल या सामान देने वाली कंपनी
definition: a supplier, the company or trader that provides another business with the goods, parts or raw materials it needs (der Lieferant, plural Lieferanten)
example: Unser Lieferant hat die Preise erhöht. — Our supplier has raised the prices.

hindi: पहुँचाना या आपूर्ति करना — मँगाया गया सामान ग्राहक तक भेजना
definition: to deliver or supply ordered goods to a customer, also to provide results, evidence or an excuse (regular)
example: Wir liefern innerhalb von drei Werktagen. — We deliver within three working days.

hindi: आपूर्ति या डिलीवरी — मँगाया गया सामान ग्राहक तक पहुँचाना
definition: a delivery, the act of bringing ordered goods to the customer or the consignment of goods that arrives (die Lieferung, plural Lieferungen)
example: Die Lieferung kommt morgen zwischen neun und zwölf. — The delivery arrives tomorrow between nine and twelve.

hindi: लेटा होना — सपाट या क्षैतिज अवस्था में होना
definition: to lie flat or be positioned horizontally somewhere, also of places to be located in a region (irregular: liegt, lag, hat gelegen)
example: Das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch. — The book is lying on the table.

hindi: प्रतियोगी वर्ग — सत्र भर आपस में खेलने वाले दलों का श्रेणीबद्ध वर्ग
definition: a league, the division of teams that play each other over a season and are ranked in a table (die Liga, plural Ligen)
example: Der Verein spielt in der zweiten Liga. — The club plays in the second league.

hindi: पसंद का निशान लगाना — सोशल मीडिया पर सराहना
definition: to mark a post or photo on social media with a like button to show approval, a recent borrowed English verb (regular: hat gelikt)
example: Hast du mein Foto gelikt? — Did you like my photo?

hindi: बैंगनी — नीले और लाल के मेल का रंग
definition: purple or violet, the colour mixed from blue and red, seen in lavender and lilac flowers, the adjective never changes its ending
example: Sie hat sich die Haare lila gefärbt. — She dyed her hair purple.

hindi: शिकंजी — मीठा, बुलबुलों वाला ठंडा पेय
definition: lemonade or any sweet fizzy soft drink, often shortened to Limo in casual speech (die Limonade, plural Limonaden)
example: Eine kalte Limonade wäre jetzt genau richtig. — A cold lemonade would be just right now.

hindi: पैमाना — सीधी रेखा खींचने और नापने की पट्टी
definition: a ruler, the flat straight-edged strip marked in centimetres used for drawing lines and measuring (das Lineal, plural Lineale)
example: Zeichne die Linie mit dem Lineal. — Draw the line with the ruler.

hindi: रेखा — खींची गई लकीर, या बस-ट्रेन का तय मार्ग
definition: a line, a long thin mark drawn on paper or a surface, also a bus, tram or train route (die Linie, plural Linien)
example: Die Linie 5 fährt zum Bahnhof. — Line 5 goes to the station.

hindi: कड़ी — दबाने पर दूसरे पन्ने तक पहुँचाने वाला जुड़ाव
definition: a link, the clickable text or address on a website or in a message that opens another page or file (der Link, plural Links)
example: Klick einfach auf den Link in der E-Mail. — Just click on the link in the email.

hindi: बाएँ — बाईं ओर या बाईं दिशा में
definition: on the left side or toward the left direction, the everyday word used when giving directions or describing where something stands
example: Die Apotheke ist gleich links neben der Bank. — The pharmacy is right on the left next to the bank.

hindi: होंठ — मुँह के किनारे की दो नरम कोमल पट्टियों में से एक
definition: the lip, one of the two soft fleshy edges that form the opening of the mouth, together called the lips (die Lippe, plural Lippen)
example: Meine Lippe ist vom kalten Wind aufgesprungen. — My lip has chapped from the cold wind.

hindi: लीटर — तरल पदार्थ की माप की इकाई
definition: a litre, the standard unit of volume for liquids such as milk, water, petrol and beer bought in bottles or at the pump (der Liter, plural Liter)
example: Wir brauchen noch einen Liter Milch. — We still need a litre of milk.

hindi: सराहना करना — अच्छे काम पर बच्चे या किसी की तारीफ़ करना
definition: to praise someone, telling a child or colleague that they have done something well and deserve recognition (regular: hat gelobt)
example: Die Lehrerin lobt ihn für die schöne Zeichnung. — The teacher praises him for the beautiful drawing.

hindi: छेद — किसी चीज़ में बना खाली गड्ढा या सुराख़
definition: a hole, an opening or hollow space through or into a surface, in a sock, a wall, the ground or a belt (das Loch, plural Löcher)
example: Ich habe ein Loch in der Socke. — I have a hole in my sock.

hindi: ढीला — कसा नहीं; बेफ़िक्र
definition: loose, slack or not tightly fixed, used of screws, teeth and soil, also colloquially meaning relaxed and easygoing
example: Die Schraube ist locker. — The screw is loose.

hindi: तर्कशास्त्र — सही सोचने और निष्कर्ष निकालने का विज्ञान
definition: logic, the science of valid reasoning and correct conclusions, and also the sensible inner consistency of an argument or plan (die Logik, no plural)
example: Ich verstehe die Logik hinter dieser Regel nicht. — I do not understand the logic behind this rule.

hindi: तर्कसंगत — सोच-समझ से मेल खाता, स्वाभाविक
definition: logical or reasonable, following correctly from the facts or premises, and colloquially used to mean obviously or of course
example: Das ist die einzige logische Erklärung. — That is the only logical explanation.

hindi: मज़दूरी — घंटे या काम के हिसाब से मिलने वाला भुगतान
definition: wages, the payment a worker receives for labour, typically hourly or weekly rather than a monthly salary (der Lohn, plural Löhne)
example: Der Lohn wird jede Woche ausgezahlt. — The wages are paid out every week.

hindi: खाने-पीने की जगह — किसी भी रेस्तराँ या शराबघर के लिए आम शब्द
definition: a restaurant, bar or pub, the general everyday word for any place where you sit down to eat or drink (das Lokal, plural Lokale)
example: Kennst du ein gutes Lokal in der Nähe? — Do you know a good restaurant nearby?

hindi: रवाना होना — गाड़ी लेकर यात्रा शुरू करना
definition: to set off or drive away, to start a journey in a vehicle and leave the starting point (separable: fährt los, ist losgefahren)
example: Wir fahren früh los, um den Stau zu vermeiden. — We set off early to avoid the traffic jam.

hindi: चल पड़ना — पैदल कहीं के लिए निकलना; शुरू होना भी
definition: to set off on foot, leaving a place to start walking somewhere; colloquially also to begin (separable: geht los, ist losgegangen)
example: Wir gehen um acht Uhr los. — We set off at eight o'clock.

hindi: छोड़ देना — पकड़ ढीली करके किसी चीज़ को जाने देना
definition: to let go of something or someone you were holding, and figuratively to release a worry or the past (separable: lässt los, hat losgelassen)
example: Lass das Seil jetzt langsam los. — Let go of the rope slowly now.

hindi: आर्द्रता — हवा में मौजूद नमी की मात्रा
definition: humidity, the amount of water vapour held in the air, which makes heat feel sticky (die Luftfeuchtigkeit, no plural)
example: Die Luftfeuchtigkeit liegt heute bei achtzig Prozent. — The humidity is at eighty percent today.

hindi: हवाई किला — हवा में बना, नींव से ख़ाली मंसूबा
definition: an elaborate plan resting entirely on wishing, with nothing underneath it bearing any weight
example: The whole business plan was a Luftschloss with a beautiful logo.

hindi: वायु प्रदूषण — धुएँ और गैसों से हवा का ज़हरीला होना
definition: air pollution, the harmful smoke, dust and gases from traffic and industry that dirty the atmosphere people breathe (die Luftverschmutzung, no plural)
example: In der Großstadt ist die Luftverschmutzung besonders hoch. — In the big city the air pollution is especially high.

hindi: फेफड़ा — छाती के अंदर साँस लेने का अंग
definition: the lung, one of the two breathing organs inside the chest that take air into the body (die Lunge, plural Lungen)
example: Rauchen schadet der Lunge. — Smoking harms the lungs.

hindi: इच्छा — कुछ करने का मन या चाह, वासना नहीं
definition: a desire or inclination to do something, the everyday feeling of being in the mood, far milder than the English word (die Lust, plural Lüste)
example: Die Lust auf Urlaub wird jeden Tag größer. — The desire for a holiday grows every day.

hindi: मज़ेदार — हँसाने वाला और खुशमिज़ाज
definition: funny and amusing, making people laugh, also cheerful and merry in mood, the everyday word for a fun person
example: Mein Bruder ist immer lustig auf Partys. — My brother is always fun at parties.

hindi: अनमना — किसी काम में मन न लगना
definition: listless and unmotivated, doing something half-heartedly without any desire, appetite or enthusiasm
example: Er stocherte lustlos im Essen herum. — He poked listlessly at his food.

hindi: काव्य — कविताओं की विधा, पद्य साहित्य
definition: poetry as a literary genre, the whole body of poems and verse writing as opposed to prose or drama (die Lyrik, no plural)
example: Moderne Lyrik ist nicht immer leicht zu verstehen. — Modern poetry is not always easy to understand.

hindi: हास्यास्पद — उपहास योग्य, बेतुका
definition: ridiculous, laughable, absurd; disapproval of something so silly or small that it deserves mockery
example: Der Preis für das kleine Zimmer ist lächerlich. — The price for the tiny room is ridiculous.

hindi: ग्रामीण — गाँव और खेतों से जुड़ा, शहर से दूर
definition: rural, relating to the countryside with villages, farms and open fields rather than to the city (ländlich, comparative ländlicher)
example: Sie bevorzugt das ländliche Leben. — She prefers rural life.

hindi: लंबाई — किसी चीज़ की एक सिरे से दूसरे सिरे तक की नाप
definition: length, the measurement of something from one end to the other, or the duration of a film, journey or speech (die Länge, plural Längen)
example: Die Länge des Tisches ist zwei Meter. — The length of the table is two metres.

hindi: कब का, बहुत पहले ही — काफ़ी समय से हो चुका
definition: long ago, long since, already a good while ago, stressing that something happened well before now
example: Das Problem ist längst gelöst. — The problem was solved long ago.

hindi: शोर — पड़ोस या सड़क से आने वाली तेज़ अवांछित आवाज़
definition: noise, loud unwanted sound from neighbours, traffic or building work (der Lärm, no plural)
example: Der Lärm von oben hält uns nachts wach. — The noise from upstairs keeps us awake at night.

hindi: अनौपचारिक — बिना औपचारिकता, आराम से और सहज
definition: casual and relaxed, said of clothes or manner that are informal and effortlessly cool
example: Er trägt gern lässige Kleidung. — He likes wearing casual clothes.

hindi: निंदा करना — किसी की पीठ पीछे बुराई करना
definition: to make spiteful or mocking remarks about someone behind their back, gossiping unkindly about their faults (regular: lästert, hat gelästert; über + Akkusativ; colloquial)
example: Sie lästern über die neue Kollegin. — They are making snide remarks about the new colleague.

hindi: कष्टकारी — बोझिल, परेशान करने वाला
definition: bothersome, tiresome, troublesome; describes a chore, insect or person that keeps being a nuisance
example: Die Mücken sind im Sommer sehr lästig. — The mosquitoes are very bothersome in summer.

hindi: लार-पट्टी — खाने के समय शिशु की ठोड़ी के नीचे बाँधा जाने वाला छोटा कपड़ा
definition: a bib, the small cloth tied under a baby's chin to catch dribble and spilled food during feeding (das Lätzchen, plural Lätzchen)
example: Bind ihm das Lätzchen um, der Brei spritzt überall hin. — Put his bib on, the puree is splashing everywhere.

hindi: चम्मच — छोटे कटोरे जैसा औज़ार जिससे सूप या दही खाते हैं
definition: a spoon, the eating tool with a small bowl on a handle used for soup, dessert or stirring (der Löffel, plural Löffel)
example: Für die Suppe brauchst du einen Löffel. — You need a spoon for the soup.

hindi: मिटाना — फ़ाइल, संदेश या डेटा को हटाना
definition: to delete a file, message, photo or account so that it disappears from the device; also to extinguish a fire or quench a thirst (regular)
example: Ich habe die alte E-Mail gelöscht. — I deleted the old email.

hindi: हल — किसी सवाल या समस्या का उत्तर
definition: a solution, the answer that solves a mathematical problem, puzzle or practical difficulty, also a liquid mixture in chemistry (die Lösung, plural Lösungen)
example: Die Lösung der Aufgabe steht hinten im Buch. — The solution to the exercise is at the back of the book.

hindi: खाली जगह भरने वाला — असली विकल्प न मिलने पर अस्थायी रूप से रखा गया व्यक्ति या चीज़
definition: a stopgap or substitute, a person or thing used temporarily to fill a gap because nothing better is available, literally someone who atones for a hole (der Lückenbüßer, plural Lückenbüßer)
example: Ich will nicht nur der Lückenbüßer sein, wenn dein Freund absagt. — I do not want to be just the stopgap when your friend cancels.

hindi: हवा लगाना — खिड़की खोलकर कमरे में ताज़ी हवा आने देना
definition: to air or ventilate a room by opening the windows so fresh outside breeze replaces stale indoor atmosphere, a daily household habit in Germany (regular)
example: Ich lüfte morgens immer zehn Minuten. — I always air the room for ten minutes in the morning.

hindi: झूठ बोलना — जानबूझकर असत्य कहना
definition: to lie, to deliberately state something untrue or false in order to deceive another person (lügt, hat gelogen)
example: Er hat mich angeschaut und gelogen. — He looked at me and lied.

hindi: अपना ख़याल रखना — दोस्ताना विदा
definition: the warm informal farewell among friends, wishing the other person well until the next meeting
example: Mach's gut und komm gesund zurück! — Take care and come back safe!

hindi: करने योग्य — जो व्यावहारिक रूप से किया जा सके
definition: feasible or doable, something that can realistically be accomplished with the available time and means
example: Der Plan ist machbar, aber knapp. — The plan is doable, but tight.

hindi: बनाना — कुछ करना या तैयार करना
definition: to make, produce or do something, the everyday workhorse verb for almost any activity or task (regular: macht, machte, hat gemacht)
example: Meine Mutter macht heute Kuchen. — My mother is making cake today.

hindi: सत्ता — लोगों और घटनाओं को नियंत्रित करने की शक्ति
definition: power, the ability to control people or events, especially political authority over a state (die Macht, plural Mächte)
example: Nach der Wahl wechselt die Macht im Land. — After the election, power in the country changes hands.

hindi: कोई बात नहीं — गलती पर दिलासा
definition: the reassuring reply to an apology, telling the other person the mistake does not matter
example: Macht nichts, das Glas war sowieso alt. — Never mind, the glass was old anyway.

hindi: पत्रिका — छपी मैगज़ीन या टीवी-रेडियो का जानकारी वाला कार्यक्रम
definition: a magazine, either the printed periodical publication or a television or radio programme mixing reports and features (das Magazin, plural Magazine)
example: Das Magazin erscheint einmal im Monat. — The magazine comes out once a month.

hindi: आमाशय/पेट — शरीर के अंदर वह थैली जहाँ खाना पचता है
definition: the stomach, the internal organ shaped like a bag where swallowed food is digested (der Magen, plural Mägen)
example: Mein Magen knurrt vor Hunger. — My stomach is growling with hunger.

hindi: दुबला — बहुत पतला या चर्बी रहित
definition: lean or skinny with little flesh, also low in fat for food, and figuratively meagre for results and harvests
example: Die Ernte war mager. — The harvest was meagre.

hindi: भोजन — खाने की एक बैठक; दोपहर के खाने पर अभिवादन भी
definition: a meal, any sitting for eating, and also the greeting coworkers exchange around lunchtime (die Mahlzeit, plural Mahlzeiten)
example: Das Frühstück ist die wichtigste Mahlzeit des Tages. — Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.

hindi: चेतावनी-स्मारक — अतीत की भूल दोहराने से रोकने वाला स्मारक
definition: a memorial built as a warning, a monument that reminds people of past suffering so it is never repeated (das Mahnmal, plural Mahnmale)
example: Das Mahnmal erinnert an die Opfer des Krieges. — The memorial reminds us of the victims of the war.

hindi: तक़ाज़ा पत्र — बकाया बिल चुकाने की लिखित चेतावनी
definition: a payment reminder, the formal letter warning that an unpaid bill is overdue (die Mahnung, plural Mahnungen)
example: Gestern kam schon die zweite Mahnung. — The second payment reminder arrived yesterday.

hindi: मई-स्तंभ — पहली मई को गाँव के चौक में खड़ा किया जाने वाला सजा हुआ ऊँचा खंभा
definition: a maypole, the tall decorated tree trunk raised in the village square on the first of May with music and beer (der Maibaum, plural Maibäume)
example: Das ganze Dorf stellt den Maibaum auf. — The whole village raises the maypole.

hindi: मक्का — भुट्टे वाली लंबी फ़सल
definition: maize or corn, the tall crop with yellow kernels on a cob, grown for food and animal feed (der Mais, no plural)
example: Der Mais steht schon zwei Meter hoch. — The maize already stands two metres high.

hindi: दलाल — मकान दिलाने वाला और कमीशन लेने वाला एजेंट
definition: an estate agent or broker who arranges flats and houses and charges a commission (der Makler, plural Makler)
example: Der Makler verlangt zwei Monatsmieten Provision. — The estate agent charges two months' rent as commission.

hindi: ज़रा — अनुरोध को हल्का और दोस्ताना बनाने वाला शब्द
definition: a softening particle dropped into requests and suggestions to make them sound casual, quick and friendly rather than demanding
example: Kannst du mir mal helfen? — Can you give me a hand for a moment?

hindi: देखते हैं — फ़ैसला बाद में, अभी टालना
definition: let us see, we will see; a noncommittal phrase that postpones a decision or promise until later
example: Kommst du morgen? Mal sehen. — Are you coming tomorrow? We will see.

hindi: चित्र बनाना — रंगों से तस्वीर रचना
definition: to paint, to make pictures with colours and a brush as an art or leisure activity (regular: hat gemalt)
example: Am Sonntag male ich gern mit Aquarellfarben. — On Sunday I like painting with watercolours.

hindi: रंगसाज़ — दीवारें रंगने वाला कारीगर या चित्र बनाने वाला चित्रकार
definition: a painter, either the tradesperson who paints walls and houses or the artist who paints pictures (der Maler, plural Maler)
example: Der Maler streicht das Wohnzimmer weiß. — The painter is painting the living room white.

hindi: खटना — बोलचाल में कड़ी मज़दूरी करना
definition: to graft or work hard at heavy labour, colloquial word from the Ruhr region and Yiddish roots (regular, hat malocht)
example: Mein Vater hat vierzig Jahre malocht. — My father grafted for forty years.

hindi: चबा-चबाकर खाना — मज़े से मुँह भरकर भोजन करना
definition: to munch or chomp, eating with obvious pleasure and a full mouth, colloquial and affectionate (regular)
example: Er mampft zufrieden sein Butterbrot. — He munches his sandwich contentedly.

hindi: कोई / लोग — सामान्य, अनिश्चित कर्ता
definition: the impersonal pronoun for people in general, the way English says one or you when describing what is usually done or allowed (Akkusativ einen, Dativ einem)
example: Hier darf man nicht rauchen. — One is not allowed to smoke here.

hindi: कुछ (लोग या चीज़ें) — सबमें से कुछ, सब नहीं
definition: an indefinite determiner or pronoun meaning some but not all of a group, often hinting at a contrast with the rest (manche, manches, plural manche)
example: Manche Leute mögen keinen Kaffee. — Some people do not like coffee.

hindi: कभी-कभी — कुछ मौक़ों पर
definition: sometimes, occasionally, on some occasions but certainly not always, the neutral middle frequency word
example: Manchmal koche ich indisch. — Sometimes I cook Indian food.

hindi: की कमी के कारण — किसी चीज़ के न होने की वजह से
definition: for lack of, because something needed is missing or insufficient, formal written register (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Mangels Beweisen wurde er freigesprochen. — For lack of evidence he was acquitted.

hindi: दल — खेल में एक ही पक्ष से खेलने वाले खिलाड़ियों का समूह
definition: a team, the group of players who compete together on the same side in a sport or match (die Mannschaft, plural Mannschaften)
example: Unsere Mannschaft hat das Spiel gewonnen. — Our team won the match.

hindi: लबादा — घुटनों तक का लंबा गरम बाहरी वस्त्र
definition: a coat, the long heavy outer garment reaching the knees that keeps out cold and rain (der Mantel, plural Mäntel)
example: Im Winter trage ich einen dicken Mantel. — In winter I wear a thick coat.

hindi: ख़ुबानी — नारंगी मीठा गुठलीदार फल, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: an apricot, the soft orange stone fruit famous from the Wachau valley, in its Austrian name where Germany says Aprikose (die Marille, plural Marillen)
example: Die Marille kommt frisch aus der Wachau. — The apricot comes fresh from the Wachau.

hindi: छाप या ब्रांड — किसी उत्पाद का पहचान-चिह्न या नाम; डाक-टिकट
definition: a brand or trademark under which products are sold and recognised, also a stamp or token (die Marke, plural Marken)
example: Diese Marke ist für gute Qualität bekannt. — This brand is known for good quality.

hindi: बाज़ार — खुली जगह जहाँ दुकानदार सामान बेचते हैं; व्यापार का क्षेत्र
definition: a market, the open square where traders sell from stalls, or the economic marketplace in which goods are bought and sold (der Markt, plural Märkte)
example: Samstags gehen wir auf den Markt. — On Saturdays we go to the market.

hindi: बाज़ार चौक — शहर के बीच का खुला चौक जहाँ हाट लगे
definition: the market square, the central open place of a town where the weekly market and public events are held (der Marktplatz, plural Marktplätze)
example: Das Rathaus steht direkt am Marktplatz. — The town hall stands right on the market square.

hindi: मुरब्बा — फल और चीनी से बना रोटी पर लगाने वाला जैम
definition: jam, the sweet spread of fruit boiled with sugar that goes on breakfast rolls, the everyday word for any jam not just marmalade (die Marmelade, plural Marmeladen)
example: Die Marmelade hat meine Oma gekocht. — My grandma made the jam.

hindi: कदमताल करना — सैनिकों की तरह दृढ़ कदमों से चलना
definition: to march with firm regular steps like soldiers, or colloquially to walk purposefully and quickly (regular: ist marschiert)
example: Die Gruppe marschiert früh am Morgen los. — The group marches off early in the morning.

hindi: संत मार्टिन दिवस — ग्यारह नवंबर, बच्चों की लालटेन यात्रा का दिन
definition: the feast of Saint Martin on the eleventh of November, when children walk through the streets with paper lanterns and sing (der Martinstag, plural Martinstage)
example: Am Martinstag ziehen die Kinder mit Laternen durch die Straßen. — On Saint Martin's Day the children walk through the streets with lanterns.

hindi: बादाम की मीठी लोई — पिसे बादाम और चीनी की नरम मिठाई जिससे आकृतियाँ बनती हैं
definition: a sweet paste of ground almonds and sugar shaped into fruits and figures, a Christmas and Easter confection (das Marzipan, no plural)
example: Das Marzipan schmeckt süß nach Mandeln. — The marzipan tastes sweetly of almonds.

hindi: यंत्र — काम करने के लिए बना चलने वाला यांत्रिक उपकरण
definition: a machine, a mechanical device with moving parts that does work, from a washing machine to an engine or an aircraft (die Maschine, plural Maschinen)
example: Die Maschine läuft Tag und Nacht. — The machine runs day and night.

hindi: मालिश — मांसपेशियों को दबाकर आराम देना
definition: a massage, the pressing and kneading of muscles by hand to relieve pain and tension (die Massage, plural Massagen)
example: Eine Massage lockert die verspannten Schultern. — A massage loosens the tense shoulders.

hindi: ठोस और भारी — पूरी तरह ठोस पदार्थ का बना, विशाल
definition: solid and massive throughout, made of heavy material without hollow parts, also used for severe problems and heavy criticism
example: Der Tisch ist aus massivem Holz. — The table is made of solid wood.

hindi: स्नातकोत्तर — स्नातक के बाद की दूसरी डिग्री
definition: a master's degree, the second university qualification that follows a bachelor's and usually takes two years (der Master, plural Master)
example: Nach dem Bachelor will er einen Master machen. — After the bachelor's he wants to do a master's.

hindi: सामग्री, पदार्थ — जिससे कोई चीज़ बनी हो, या काम के लिए ज़रूरी चीज़ें
definition: a material, the substance that an object is made from, also the supplies and documents needed for a task or lesson (das Material, plural Materialien)
example: Aus welchem Material ist die Tasche? — What material is the bag made of?

hindi: गणित — संख्याओं, आकृतियों और गणना का स्कूली विषय
definition: mathematics, the school subject dealing with numbers, shapes and calculation, shortened colloquially to Mathe (die Mathematik, no plural)
example: Mathematik ist ihr Lieblingsfach. — Mathematics is her favourite subject.

hindi: गद्दा — पलंग पर बिछा मोटा नरम आधार
definition: a mattress, the thick soft padded layer on a bed that a person lies on (die Matratze, plural Matratzen)
example: Die Matratze ist zu weich. — The mattress is too soft.

hindi: स्कूल की अंतिम परीक्षा — विश्वविद्यालय में दाख़िले की योग्यता देने वाली परीक्षा
definition: the school-leaving examination that qualifies a student for university, the Austrian and Swiss name where Germany says Abitur (die Matura, plural Maturen)
example: Meine Schwester macht heuer die Matura. — My sister is taking her school-leaving exam this year.

hindi: दीवार — पत्थर या ईंट की खड़ी बाहरी दीवार; बर्लिन की दीवार
definition: a wall built of stone or brick outdoors, and in German memory above all the Berlin Wall that divided the city (die Mauer, plural Mauern)
example: Die Mauer stand fast dreißig Jahre lang. — The Wall stood for almost thirty years.

hindi: दीवार का गिरना — १९८९ में बर्लिन की दीवार खुलने की घटना
definition: the fall of the Berlin Wall in November 1989, the moment the border between East and West opened (der Mauerfall, no plural)
example: Der Mauerfall veränderte das Leben vieler Familien. — The fall of the Wall changed the lives of many families.

hindi: चिनाई करना — ईंटें गारे में जमाकर दीवार खड़ी करना
definition: to build a wall or structure by laying bricks or stones in layers of mortar, as a bricklayer does (regular: mauert, hat gemauert)
example: Der Maurer mauert die Gartenmauer. — The bricklayer builds the garden wall.

hindi: छछूंदर — ज़मीन के नीचे सुरंग खोदने वाला जानवर
definition: a mole, the small dark underground animal that digs tunnels and leaves little hills on the lawn (der Maulwurf, plural Maulwürfe)
example: Der Maulwurf hat den Rasen aufgewühlt. — The mole has churned up the lawn.

hindi: राजमिस्त्री — ईंट और गारे से दीवार चिनने वाला कारीगर
definition: a bricklayer or mason, the building worker who lays bricks and stones with mortar to raise walls (der Maurer, plural Maurer)
example: Die Maurer bauen die Wand in zwei Tagen. — The bricklayers will build the wall in two days.

hindi: चूहा — छोटा भूरा-धूसर जानवर; कंप्यूटर चलाने की हाथ वाली युक्ति भी
definition: a mouse, the tiny grey rodent that hides in walls, and also the computer pointing device (die Maus, plural Mäuse)
example: Eine Maus huscht durch die Küche. — A mouse scurries through the kitchen.

hindi: नाप — लंबाई, मात्रा या सीमा का मानक माप
definition: a measure or measurement, the standard unit or dimension used to describe size or quantity, also the sensible limit or degree of something (das Maß, plural Maße)
example: Die Maße des Schranks passen genau. — The dimensions of the cupboard fit exactly.

hindi: नापने का फ़ीता — लंबाई मापने वाला लचीला फ़ीता
definition: a tape measure, the flexible marked strip that rolls out to measure lengths of walls, furniture and fabric (das Maßband, plural Maßbänder)
example: Hast du ein Maßband für das Regal? — Do you have a tape measure for the shelf?

hindi: मानदंड — तुलना या माप का पैमाना
definition: a standard or yardstick against which quality is measured, also the scale of a cartographic chart or model (der Maßstab, plural Maßstäbe)
example: Sie legt an sich selbst einen hohen Maßstab an. — She applies a high standard to herself.

hindi: मिस्त्री — मशीनों, इंजनों और गाड़ियों की मरम्मत करने वाला
definition: a mechanic, the skilled worker who repairs and maintains machines, engines and vehicles (der Mechaniker, plural Mechaniker)
example: Der Mechaniker wechselt die Bremsen an meinem Auto. — The mechanic is changing the brakes on my car.

hindi: किचकिच करना — छोटी-छोटी बातों पर शिकायत करते रहना
definition: to grumble or moan constantly about small things, a colloquial word that also means to bleat like a goat (regular: meckert, hat gemeckert; über + Akkusativ)
example: Hör auf zu meckern, das Essen ist gut! — Stop grumbling, the food is good!

hindi: पदक — खेल में जीत पर मिलने वाला धातु का पदक
definition: a medal, the metal disc in gold, silver or bronze awarded to the best athletes in a competition (die Medaille, plural Medaillen)
example: Sie gewann die silberne Medaille im Schwimmen. — She won the silver medal in swimming.

hindi: दवा — बीमारी ठीक करने वाला औषधीय पदार्थ
definition: a medicine or medication, any drug taken to treat, relieve or prevent an illness, whether prescribed or bought over the counter (das Medikament, plural Medikamente)
example: Nehmen Sie das Medikament dreimal täglich. — Take the medicine three times daily.

hindi: माध्यम — खबर पहुँचाने का साधन; बहुवचन में समूचा मीडिया
definition: a medium of communication such as television, radio or the internet, and in the plural the media as a whole (das Medium, plural Medien)
example: Das Internet ist heute das wichtigste Medium für Nachrichten. — The internet is today the most important medium for news.

hindi: समुद्र — खारे पानी की विशाल जलराशि
definition: the ocean or sea, the vast expanse of salt water that covers most of the planet (das Meer, plural Meere)
example: Wir fahren im Urlaub ans Meer. — We travel to the seaside on holiday.

hindi: छोटा गोल-मटोल पालतू कृंतक — पिंजरे में पाला जाने वाला बच्चों का प्रिय जानवर
definition: a guinea pig, the small plump rodent kept in a cage as a popular pet for children (das Meerschweinchen, plural Meerschweinchen)
example: Das Meerschweinchen quiekt, wenn es Hunger hat. — The guinea pig squeaks when it is hungry.

hindi: बैठक — काम पर तय समय की आपसी चर्चा
definition: a business meeting or scheduled work discussion, the borrowed English word that office German prefers to Besprechung (das Meeting, plural Meetings)
example: Das Meeting beginnt um zehn Uhr. — The meeting begins at ten o'clock.

hindi: बहुत ज़्यादा, ज़बरदस्त — बोलचाल का तीव्रक
definition: huge, terrific or extremely good, a colloquial intensifier placed before adjectives or nouns to make them bigger and better
example: Die Party war mega. — The party was awesome.

hindi: आटा — पिसे अनाज का चूर्ण जिससे रोटी, केक बनते हैं
definition: flour, the fine powder ground from wheat or other grain that is the basis of bread, cakes and pasta (das Mehl, no plural)
example: Das Mehl steht oben im Schrank. — The flour is up in the cupboard.

hindi: कई — दो से अधिक, पर बहुत नहीं
definition: several, describing an unspecified number of people or things that is more than two but not very many
example: Ich habe mehrere Bücher über Kunst. — I have several books about art.

hindi: बहु-परिवार भवन — कई परिवारों के अलग फ़्लैट वाली इमारत
definition: an apartment building housing several families in separate flats, the usual German urban dwelling (das Mehrfamilienhaus, plural Mehrfamilienhäuser)
example: Wir wohnen in einem Mehrfamilienhaus mit sechs Parteien. — We live in an apartment building with six households.

hindi: बहुमत — किसी समूह का आधे से अधिक हिस्सा
definition: the majority, the larger part or greater number of a group of people, especially in votes and elections (die Mehrheit, plural Mehrheiten)
example: Die Mehrheit stimmte für den Vorschlag. — The majority voted for the proposal.

hindi: बार-बार उपयोग होने वाली बोतल — जो धोकर फिर भरी जाती है
definition: a reusable bottle, a glass or thick plastic bottle that is washed and refilled many times before recycling (die Mehrwegflasche, plural Mehrwegflaschen)
example: Die Mehrwegflasche wird gewaschen und neu gefüllt. — The reusable bottle is washed and refilled.

hindi: मूल्य वर्धित कर — दाम में जुड़ा सरकारी कर
definition: value added tax, the government sales levy included in every shop price and shown separately on receipts and invoices (die Mehrwertsteuer, plural Mehrwertsteuern)
example: Die Mehrwertsteuer steht unten auf der Rechnung. — The VAT is shown at the bottom of the invoice.

hindi: मेरा — बोलने वाले का स्वामित्व
definition: the possessive determiner meaning belonging to the speaker, placed before a noun and taking endings like the indefinite article (meine Mutter, meinen Bruder, meinem Vater)
example: Mein Bruder wohnt noch bei unseren Eltern. — My brother still lives with our parents.

hindi: हे भगवान — हैरानी या झुंझलाहट
definition: my goodness, good grief; a mild exclamation of surprise, exasperation or disbelief
example: Meine Güte, ist das kalt heute! — My goodness, it is cold today!

hindi: राय रखना, मतलब होना — अपनी सोच व्यक्त करना
definition: to be of the opinion that something is so, and also to mean or intend a particular thing when speaking (regular: meint, hat gemeint)
example: Was meinst du zu diesem Vorschlag? — What do you think of this suggestion?

hindi: मेरी राय में — अपना मत बताने की शुरुआत
definition: the standard spoken phrase for introducing a personal opinion, meaning in my view or as I see it
example: Meiner Meinung nach ist das zu teuer. — In my opinion that is too expensive.

hindi: राय — किसी विषय पर व्यक्तिगत विचार या धारणा
definition: an opinion, a personal view or belief about a question that others may share or dispute (die Meinung, plural Meinungen)
example: Meiner Meinung nach ist das Gesetz zu streng. — In my opinion the law is too strict.

hindi: ज़्यादातर — अधिकतर मौक़ों पर
definition: mostly, usually, on most occasions though not every single time, describing a habit
example: Meistens fahre ich mit dem Rad. — Mostly I ride my bike.

hindi: उस्ताद — मास्टर परीक्षा पास कारीगर जो शागिर्द सिखा सकता है
definition: a master craftsman, a tradesperson who has passed the master examination and may train apprentices and run a business (der Meister, plural Meister)
example: Der Meister prüft die Arbeit des Lehrlings. — The master checks the apprentice's work.

hindi: साधना — किसी कठिन स्थिति या कौशल पर महारत पाना
definition: to master or handle a difficult situation, task or skill with competence and confidence (regular: meistert, hat gemeistert)
example: Er hat die Situation souverän gemeistert. — He handled the situation with real confidence.

hindi: सर्वश्रेष्ठता-प्रतियोगिता — खेल में सबसे अच्छा दल या खिलाड़ी तय करने वाला मुक़ाबला
definition: a championship, the top competition or season title that decides the best team or athlete in a sport (die Meisterschaft, plural Meisterschaften)
example: Der Verein gewann die Meisterschaft zum dritten Mal. — The club won the championship for the third time.

hindi: श्रेष्ठ कृति — किसी कलाकार की सबसे उत्कृष्ट रचना
definition: a masterpiece, the finest work of art, piece of music or book that an artist or writer has ever created (das Meisterwerk, plural Meisterwerke)
example: Das Meisterwerk zieht jedes Jahr Millionen Besucher an. — The masterpiece attracts millions of visitors every year.

hindi: छेनी — हथौड़े से ठोककर पत्थर या लकड़ी काटने का नुकीला औज़ार
definition: a chisel, the sharp-edged steel tool struck with a hammer to cut, shape or split stone, wood or metal (der Meißel, plural Meißel)
example: Mit Hammer und Meißel öffnet er die Wand. — With hammer and chisel he opens the wall.

hindi: दूध वाली कॉफ़ी — विएना के कैफ़े की झागदार दूध-कॉफ़ी
definition: a Viennese coffee made of espresso and hot milk topped with milk foam, the classic order in an Austrian coffee house (die Melange, plural Melangen)
example: Eine Melange und ein Glas Wasser, bitte. — A melange coffee and a glass of water, please.

hindi: बैंगन — बैंगनी चमकदार सब्ज़ी, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: an aubergine or eggplant, the glossy purple vegetable, in its Austrian name where Germany says Aubergine (die Melanzani, plural Melanzani)
example: Die Melanzani wird in Scheiben gegrillt. — The aubergine is grilled in slices.

hindi: निवास प्रमाण-पत्र — पंजीकृत पते की सरकारी पुष्टि
definition: the registration certificate that confirms your registered home address, issued by the citizens' office and needed for banks and visas (die Meldebescheinigung, plural Meldebescheinigungen)
example: Die Bank verlangt eine Meldebescheinigung für das Konto. — The bank requires a registration certificate for the account.

hindi: सूचना देना — खबर बताना या किसी बात की रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराना
definition: to report or announce a piece of news, or to notify an authority about something; reflexive sich melden means to get in touch (regular: hat gemeldet)
example: Das Radio meldet einen Stau auf der Autobahn. — The radio is reporting a traffic jam on the motorway.

hindi: खबर की सूचना — किसी घटना की छोटी आधिकारिक रिपोर्ट
definition: a short news report or official announcement of an event, the brief item that reaches the newsroom first (die Meldung, plural Meldungen)
example: Die Meldung über das Erdbeben kam gerade herein. — The report about the earthquake just came in.

hindi: धुन — गीत की सुरीली स्वर-रेखा
definition: a melody or tune, the sequence of musical notes that forms the recognisable line of a song or piece (die Melodie, plural Melodien)
example: Die Melodie geht mir seit Tagen nicht aus dem Kopf. — The tune has been stuck in my head for days.

hindi: तरबूज़ या खरबूज़ — बड़ा गोल पानीदार गर्मियों का फल
definition: a melon, the large round fruit with a thick rind and sweet watery flesh eaten cold in summer, including watermelon (die Melone, plural Melonen)
example: Die Melone ist kalt und schön süß. — The melon is cold and nicely sweet.

hindi: मात्रा — किसी चीज़ की कुल परिमाण या भीड़
definition: a quantity or amount of something, and colloquially a large number or a crowd of people gathered together (die Menge, plural Mengen)
example: Auf dem Fest war eine Menge Leute. — There were a lot of people at the festival.

hindi: विश्वविद्यालय भोजनालय — छात्रों के लिए सस्ता खाना देने वाली कैंटीन
definition: a university canteen, the subsidised cafeteria where students eat a cheap lunch meal on campus (die Mensa, plural Mensen)
example: In der Mensa gibt es heute Nudeln mit Tomatensoße. — In the canteen there is pasta with tomato sauce today.

hindi: इंसान — मनुष्य, कोई भी व्यक्ति
definition: a human being, a person in general regardless of sex or age, and also a common exclamation of surprise or annoyance (der Mensch, plural Menschen)
example: Auf dem Platz waren viele Menschen. — There were many people in the square.

hindi: महसूस करना, भाँपना — किसी बदलाव या बात को ताड़ लेना
definition: to notice or sense something, to become aware of a change or a feeling; reflexive 'sich merken' means to memorise something (regular: merkt, hat gemerkt)
example: Ich merke, dass du nervös bist. — I can tell that you are nervous.

hindi: लक्षण — किसी चीज़ को पहचानने वाली विशेषता
definition: a characteristic or distinguishing feature, a trait by which something can be recognised and classified (das Merkmal, plural Merkmale)
example: Ein wichtiges Merkmal dieser Sprache ist die Wortstellung. — An important feature of this language is the word order.

hindi: अजीब — विचित्र, असामान्य, चौंकाने वाला
definition: strange, odd, peculiar; describes something unusual that makes you pause and wonder
example: Er hat sich gestern merkwürdig verhalten. — He behaved strangely yesterday.

hindi: कैथोलिक पूजा-सभा — गिरजाघर की मुख्य विधि; व्यापार मेला भी
definition: a mass, the central Catholic worship service with communion, also a large trade fair or exhibition (die Messe, plural Messen)
example: Wir gehen sonntags zur Messe. — We go to mass on Sundays.

hindi: नापना — लंबाई, तापमान आदि का माप लेना
definition: to measure, to find the length, temperature, weight or size of something using a ruler, thermometer or other instrument (misst, hat gemessen)
example: Der Arzt misst meinen Blutdruck. — The doctor measures my blood pressure.

hindi: चाकू — धारदार औज़ार जिससे काटते हैं
definition: a knife, the sharp bladed tool used to cut bread, meat or vegetables at the table or in the kitchen (das Messer, plural Messer)
example: Das Messer ist sehr scharf. — The knife is very sharp.

hindi: माप — किसी मात्रा को नापने की क्रिया और उसका नतीजा
definition: a measurement, the act of measuring a quantity such as temperature, length or pressure and the numerical value that results (die Messung, plural Messungen)
example: Die Messung zeigt eine Temperatur von zwanzig Grad. — The measurement shows a temperature of twenty degrees.

hindi: धातु — लोहा, ताँबा, सोना जैसा कठोर चमकीला पदार्थ
definition: metal, the hard shiny material such as iron, copper or gold that conducts heat and is worked into tools and machines (das Metall, plural Metalle)
example: Der Griff ist aus Metall und wird heiß. — The handle is made of metal and gets hot.

hindi: मीटर — लंबाई की मानक इकाई
definition: a metre, the standard unit of length used for measuring rooms, fabric, distances and the height of people and buildings (der Meter, plural Meter)
example: Das Bett ist einen Meter breit. — The bed is one metre wide.

hindi: विधि — काम करने का सुनियोजित तरीका
definition: a method, a planned and systematic procedure for doing research, teaching or solving a problem (die Methode, plural Methoden)
example: Welche Methode benutzt du beim Vokabellernen? — Which method do you use for learning vocabulary?

hindi: कसाई — माँस काटने और बेचने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a butcher, the person who cuts, cures and sells meat and makes sausage, colloquially also the butcher's shop itself (der Metzger, plural Metzger)
example: Beim Metzger kaufe ich frisches Hackfleisch. — At the butcher I buy fresh minced meat.

hindi: कसाई की दुकान — माँस और भरवाँ गोश्त बेचने की दुकान
definition: a butcher's shop, the store selling fresh meat, sausage and cold cuts across a counter, the southern and western German word (die Metzgerei, plural Metzgereien)
example: Die Metzgerei hat samstags nur bis mittags geöffnet. — The butcher's shop is open only until noon on Saturdays.

hindi: मरियल — हास्यास्पद रूप से छोटा और कमज़ोर
definition: puny or measly in size or amount, colloquial and disapproving, describing something pitifully small and unimpressive
example: Die Portion war ziemlich mickrig. — The portion was pretty measly.

hindi: घटिया — बुरा, खराब; बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: lousy, rotten, poor; a colloquial word of disapproval for weather, mood, quality or behaviour
example: Mir geht es heute ziemlich mies. — I feel pretty lousy today.

hindi: खड़ूस बुड़बुड़िया — हमेशा शिकायत करने वाला उदास और चिड़चिड़ा व्यक्ति
definition: a grumpy sour person who constantly complains and spoils the cheerful mood with gloom, a killjoy and grouch, colloquial (der Miesepeter, plural Miesepeter)
example: Was für ein Miesepeter, nichts gefällt ihm heute! — What a grouch, nothing pleases him today!

hindi: किराया — मकान या फ़्लैट में रहने के बदले हर महीने दी जाने वाली रक़म
definition: the rent, the monthly payment a tenant makes to occupy a flat or house (die Miete, plural Mieten)
example: Die Miete ist am Ersten des Monats fällig. — The rent is due on the first of the month.

hindi: किराये पर लेना — किराया देकर मकान या चीज़ इस्तेमाल करना
definition: to rent something from an owner, paying regularly to use a flat, house, vehicle or object (regular: hat gemietet)
example: Wir mieten eine kleine Wohnung in der Stadt. — We are renting a small flat in the city.

hindi: किरायेदार — किराया देकर घर में रहने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a tenant, the person who pays rent to live in a flat or house owned by someone else (der Mieter, plural Mieter)
example: Die Mieter beschweren sich über die Heizung. — The tenants are complaining about the heating.

hindi: किराया बढ़ोतरी — मकान-मालिक द्वारा किराया बढ़ाने की माँग
definition: a rent increase, the landlord's demand that the tenant pay more from a given date (die Mieterhöhung, plural Mieterhöhungen)
example: Die Mieterhöhung kam ohne Vorwarnung. — The rent increase came without warning.

hindi: किराया कटौती — मकान में गंभीर ख़राबी पर किराया घटाने का हक़
definition: a rent reduction the tenant may claim when the flat has serious defects such as mould or broken heating (die Mietminderung, plural Mietminderungen)
example: Wegen des Schimmels verlangen wir eine Mietminderung. — Because of the mould we are demanding a rent reduction.

hindi: बकाया किराया — किरायेदार पर चढ़ा न चुकाया गया किराया
definition: rent arrears, the unpaid rent that a tenant still owes to the landlord (die Mietschulden, plural only)
example: Die Mietschulden sind inzwischen sehr hoch. — The rent arrears are now very high.

hindi: किराया सूचकांक — इलाके के औसत किराये की सरकारी तालिका
definition: the local rent index, the official table of typical rents used to judge whether a rent is fair (der Mietspiegel, plural Mietspiegel)
example: Laut Mietspiegel ist unsere Miete zu hoch. — According to the rent index our rent is too high.

hindi: किरायानामा — मकान-मालिक और किरायेदार के बीच लिखित समझौता
definition: a tenancy agreement, the written contract between landlord and tenant that fixes rent and rules (der Mietvertrag, plural Mietverträge)
example: Lies den Mietvertrag genau, bevor du unterschreibst. — Read the tenancy agreement carefully before you sign.

hindi: किराये का फ़्लैट — मालिक के बजाय किरायेदार का रहने वाला फ़्लैट
definition: a rented flat, an apartment occupied and paid for monthly by a tenant rather than by its owner (die Mietwohnung, plural Mietwohnungen)
example: Die meisten Berliner leben in einer Mietwohnung. — Most Berliners live in a rented flat.

hindi: झटपट गरम करने की मशीन — खाना कुछ ही पलों में गरम करने वाला बिजली का डिब्बा
definition: the microwave, the small electric appliance that reheats or cooks food very quickly with radiation (die Mikrowelle, plural Mikrowellen)
example: Wärm die Suppe kurz in der Mikrowelle auf. — Warm the soup briefly in the microwave.

hindi: दूध — गाय का सफ़ेद पोषक पेय
definition: milk, the white liquid from cows drunk fresh, poured over cereal and turned into butter, cheese and yoghurt (die Milch, no plural)
example: Die Milch ist leider sauer. — The milk has gone sour, unfortunately.

hindi: दूध वाला कहवा — बहुत सारे गरम दूध के साथ बना कहवा
definition: coffee with a large share of hot milk, the milky bowl-sized coffee ordered in German cafés (der Milchkaffee, plural Milchkaffees)
example: Ein großer Milchkaffee zum Mitnehmen, bitte. — A large milky coffee to take away, please.

hindi: भोला-भाला हिसाब — जो कारक भूल जाए, ऐसा गलत अनुमान
definition: a naive calculation that ignores important factors and therefore reaches a false result (die Milchmädchenrechnung, plural Milchmädchenrechnungen)
example: Ohne die Steuern ist dein Plan eine Milchmädchenrechnung. — Without the taxes your plan is wishful arithmetic.

hindi: सुहावना — न ज़्यादा गरम न ज़्यादा ठंडा
definition: mild, describing pleasantly gentle weather that is neither uncomfortably cold nor hot, especially a winter without frost
example: Der Winter war dieses Jahr sehr mild. — The winter was very mild this year.

hindi: अरब — एक के बाद नौ शून्य वाली संख्या
definition: a billion, one thousand million, the number that English speakers mistranslate as Billion (die Milliarde, plural Milliarden)
example: Die Stadt hat eine Milliarde Euro investiert. — The city has invested a billion euros.

hindi: दस लाख — हज़ार हज़ार की बड़ी संख्या
definition: a million, the large round number of one thousand thousands, used for counting money, people and populations of cities (die Million, plural Millionen)
example: Die Stadt hat fast eine Million Einwohner. — The city has almost a million inhabitants.

hindi: अल्पसंख्यक — किसी समूह का आधे से छोटा हिस्सा
definition: the minority, the smaller part or lesser number of a group of people, also a small ethnic or linguistic community (die Minderheit, plural Minderheiten)
example: Nur eine Minderheit war dagegen. — Only a minority was against it.

hindi: कम से कम — इससे कम नहीं, न्यूनतम इतना
definition: at least, stating the smallest number or amount that is possible or acceptable, so the real figure could be higher
example: Du solltest mindestens acht Stunden schlafen. — You should sleep at least eight hours.

hindi: न्यूनतम टिकाऊपन तिथि — पैकेट पर छपी सर्वोत्तम-उपयोग तारीख
definition: the best-before date printed on food packaging, the date until which the maker guarantees full quality (das Mindesthaltbarkeitsdatum, plural Mindesthaltbarkeitsdaten)
example: Das Mindesthaltbarkeitsdatum ist schon abgelaufen. — The best-before date has already passed.

hindi: न्यूनतम मज़दूरी — क़ानूनन घंटे की सबसे कम अनुमत मज़दूरी
definition: the minimum wage, the lowest hourly payment that employers are legally allowed to give their workers (der Mindestlohn, plural Mindestlöhne)
example: Der Mindestlohn wurde zum Jahresanfang erhöht. — The minimum wage was raised at the start of the year.

hindi: खनिज पानी — झरने से निकला बोतलबंद पानी, सादा या गैस वाला
definition: mineral water, bottled water from a spring, sold still or sparkling and ordered at almost every table (das Mineralwasser, plural Mineralwässer)
example: Ein Mineralwasser ohne Kohlensäure, bitte. — A mineral water without carbonation, please.

hindi: मंत्री — सरकार का सदस्य जो एक विभाग सँभालता है
definition: a minister, a senior member of the government responsible for one department such as finance or health (der Minister, plural Minister)
example: Der Minister hat seinen Rücktritt angekündigt. — The minister has announced his resignation.

hindi: मंत्रालय — किसी मंत्री के अधीन सरकारी विभाग
definition: a ministry, the government department headed by a minister that handles one area of policy (das Ministerium, plural Ministerien)
example: Das Ministerium hat die neuen Zahlen veröffentlicht. — The ministry has published the new figures.

hindi: मिनट — साठ सेकंड की अवधि
definition: a minute, the period of sixty seconds that makes up one sixtieth of an hour, used for timing short waits and journeys (die Minute, plural Minuten)
example: Der Zug kommt in einer Minute. — The train comes in one minute.

hindi: मिलाना — अलग-अलग चीज़ों को एक साथ मिश्रित करना
definition: to mix or blend two or more ingredients together so that they combine into a single mixture (regular: mischt, hat gemischt)
example: Misch das Gemüse mit dem Reis. — Mix the vegetables with the rice.

hindi: बेहद खराब — दयनीय, निकृष्ट गुणवत्ता का
definition: miserable, wretched, dreadfully poor in quality; disapproval of a performance, mood or condition
example: Die Straßen sind in miserablem Zustand. — The roads are in a miserable state.

hindi: असफलता — नाकामी, कोशिश का बुरा नतीजा
definition: failure, flop or setback, the disappointing outcome of an attempt, project or product (der Misserfolg, plural Misserfolge)
example: Der neue Film war ein totaler Misserfolg. — The new film was a total flop.

hindi: अविश्वास करना — किसी पर शक करना और भरोसा न रखना
definition: to distrust or be suspicious of someone or something, to doubt their honesty, motives or reliability and stay wary of them (regular, misstrauen + Dativ)
example: Sie misstraut jedem Verkäufer am Telefon. — She distrusts every salesperson on the phone.

hindi: गलतफ़हमी — किसी बात को गलत समझ लेना
definition: a misunderstanding, when people take each other's words in the wrong sense and confusion follows (das Missverständnis, plural Missverständnisse)
example: Das war nur ein Missverständnis. — That was just a misunderstanding.

hindi: गोबर; धत् — खीझ में निकलने वाला हल्का शब्द
definition: manure, dung; shouted alone it is a mild everyday curse expressing annoyance, roughly damn or drat (der Mist, no plural)
example: So ein Mist, ich habe den Schlüssel vergessen! — Damn, I forgot the key!

hindi: के साथ — किसी की संगत में या किसी साधन से
definition: with, accompanied by a person or thing, or using a stated tool, vehicle or means (preposition, + Dativ)
example: Ich fahre mit dem Bus zur Arbeit. — I travel to work by bus.

term: mit dem Kopf durch die Wand
hindi: ज़िद पर अड़ना — हर रुकावट के बावजूद अपनी ही बात मनवाने पर तुला रहना
definition: to try to force one's way through a wall with the head, stubbornly pushing a plan against every obstacle (mit dem Kopf durch die Wand wollen)
example: Er will immer mit dem Kopf durch die Wand. — He always tries to force things through by sheer stubbornness.

hindi: सादर — औपचारिक चिट्ठी के अंत की विदा-पंक्ति
definition: the standard formal closing of a German letter or email, literally with friendly greetings, written just before your name
example: Der Brief endet mit „Mit freundlichen Grüßen“. — The letter ends with kind regards.

hindi: सहयोग से काम करना — किसी परियोजना या समूह में साथ काम करना
definition: to work together with others on a project, in a company or as an active class participant (separable: arbeitet mit, hat mitgearbeitet; an + Dativ)
example: Sie arbeitet seit Januar an dem Projekt mit. — She has been working on the project since January.

hindi: कर्मचारी — किसी संस्था में काम करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an employee or staff member, a person who works for a company, often used by the company itself for its workers (der Mitarbeiter, plural Mitarbeiter)
example: Die Firma hat zweihundert Mitarbeiter. — The company has two hundred employees.

hindi: भनक पाना — आसपास हो रही बात को सुनकर या देखकर जान लेना
definition: to notice or catch what is happening around you, to become aware of something by overhearing or observing (separable: bekommt mit, hat mitbekommen)
example: Hast du den Streit gestern mitbekommen? — Did you catch the argument yesterday?

hindi: सहवासी — साझे फ़्लैट में साथ रहने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a flatmate or housemate, the person who shares a rented apartment with you without being family (der Mitbewohner, plural Mitbewohner)
example: Mein Mitbewohner kocht heute für alle. — My flatmate is cooking for everyone today.

hindi: साथ लाना — आते समय कोई चीज़ अपने साथ लेकर आना
definition: to bring something along with you when coming somewhere, such as a bottle of wine to a dinner party (separable: bringt mit, hat mitgebracht)
example: Soll ich etwas zum Essen mitbringen? — Shall I bring something to eat?

hindi: छोटी सौग़ात — यात्रा से लौटकर किसी को देने के लिए लाई गई छोटी भेंट
definition: a small gift brought back from a trip for someone at home, an informal word for a souvenir present (das Mitbringsel, plural Mitbringsel)
example: Ich habe dir ein kleines Mitbringsel aus Paris mitgebracht. — I brought you a little present from Paris.

hindi: साथ सवार होना — किसी की गाड़ी या सवारी में साथ यात्रा करना
definition: to ride along as a passenger in someone else's vehicle or travel together on a journey (separable: fährt mit, ist mitgefahren)
example: Darf ich morgen bei dir mitfahren? — May I ride along with you tomorrow?

hindi: साझा सवारी — किसी की गाड़ी में साथ जाने का मौका
definition: a ride share or lift, the chance to travel in someone else's vehicle for a shared cost (die Mitfahrgelegenheit, plural Mitfahrgelegenheiten)
example: Ich suche eine Mitfahrgelegenheit nach Berlin. — I am looking for a ride share to Berlin.

hindi: सहानुभूति रखना — दूसरे के दुख को अपना मानकर महसूस करना
definition: to sympathise or empathise with someone, to share their sorrow, grief or pain with warm compassion and understanding (separable: fühlt mit, hat mitgefühlt + Dativ)
example: Ich fühle mit dir in dieser schweren Zeit. — I feel for you in this difficult time.

hindi: सहानुभूति — दूसरे के दुःख में शामिल होने वाली संवेदना
definition: sympathy or empathy, the warm capacity to share another person's feelings, especially in their sorrow (das Mitgefühl, no plural)
example: Das Mitgefühl der Kollegen hat mir sehr geholfen. — My colleagues' sympathy helped me a lot.

hindi: साथ जाना — किसी के संग किसी जगह पैदल चलना
definition: to walk or go along together with someone to a place they are heading (separable: geht mit, ist mitgegangen)
example: Meine Schwester geht zum Arzt mit. — My sister is going along to the doctor.

hindi: सदस्य — किसी क्लब या संस्था से जुड़ा व्यक्ति
definition: a member, a person who belongs to a club, association, party or other group, usually paying a yearly membership subscription fee (das Mitglied, plural Mitglieder)
example: Er ist seit Jahren Mitglied im Sportverein. — He has been a member of the sports club for years.

hindi: हाथ बँटाना — किसी काम में दूसरों के साथ मदद करना
definition: to lend a hand and help along with others in a shared task or household chore (separable: hilft mit, hat mitgeholfen; bei + Dativ)
example: Beim Umzug haben alle Freunde mitgeholfen. — All the friends helped out with the move.

hindi: साथ आना — किसी के साथ चलना या उसकी बात समझते रहना
definition: to come along with someone to a place, or colloquially to keep pace with what is being explained (separable: kommt mit, ist mitgekommen)
example: Kommst du heute Abend ins Kino mit? — Are you coming along to the cinema tonight?

hindi: दया — दुखी व्यक्ति के लिए करुणा का भाव
definition: pity or compassion, the sorrowful tender sympathy someone feels toward another person who is suffering (das Mitleid, no plural)
example: Das Mitleid der Nachbarn half ihr wenig. — The neighbours' pity helped her little.

hindi: भाग लेना — किसी गतिविधि या खेल में शामिल होना
definition: to join in and take part in an activity, game or event together with others (separable: macht mit, hat mitgemacht; bei + Dativ)
example: Alle Kinder machen beim Spiel mit. — All the children are joining in the game.

hindi: साथ ले जाना — जाते समय कोई चीज़ या व्यक्ति अपने साथ लेना
definition: to take something or someone along with you when leaving, for instance food to go or a friend in the car (separable: nimmt mit, hat mitgenommen)
example: Nimmst du einen Regenschirm mit? — Are you taking an umbrella with you?

hindi: बातचीत में राय देना — किसी विषय पर बोलने और फ़ैसले में हिस्सा लेने की हैसियत रखना
definition: to join in a conversation with an informed opinion, or to have a legitimate say in a decision (separable: redet mit, hat mitgeredet; bei + Dativ)
example: Bei diesem Thema kann ich leider nicht mitreden. — Unfortunately I cannot join in on this topic.

hindi: सहपाठी — उसी कक्षा या स्कूल में साथ पढ़ने वाला छात्र
definition: a classmate or fellow pupil, someone who attends the same class or school as you (der Mitschüler, plural Mitschüler)
example: Meine Mitschüler helfen mir bei den Hausaufgaben. — My classmates help me with homework.

hindi: साथ खेलना — खेल, टीम या नाटक में शामिल होकर भाग लेना
definition: to play along with others in a game, team or performance, or to have a role in a situation (separable: spielt mit, hat mitgespielt)
example: Darf ich bei euch mitspielen? — May I play along with you?

hindi: सह-खिलाड़ी — साथ में खेलने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a fellow player, another person taking part in the same game or team (der Mitspieler, plural Mitspieler)
example: Wir brauchen noch einen Mitspieler. — We still need one more player.

hindi: दोपहर — दिन का मध्य, खाने और छोटे विश्राम का समय
definition: midday or noon, the middle of the day around twelve o'clock when people pause for their lunch break (der Mittag, plural Mittage)
example: Wir treffen uns am Mittag in der Kantine. — We meet at midday in the canteen.

hindi: दोपहर का भोजन — दिन के बीच में खाया जाने वाला, अक्सर गरम खाना
definition: lunch, the midday meal eaten around noon, often the warm cooked meal of the day in German-speaking homes (das Mittagessen, plural Mittagessen)
example: Das Mittagessen steht schon auf dem Tisch. — Lunch is already on the table.

hindi: दोपहर को — रोज़ दोपहर के समय
definition: at midday, around noon as a regular habit, the lowercase adverb formed from the noun
example: Mittags essen wir in der Kantine. — At midday we eat in the canteen.

hindi: दोपहर की शांति — दोपहर में शोर न करने का नियम
definition: the traditional midday quiet period, roughly one to three in the afternoon, when noisy work and loud music are avoided in many buildings and villages (die Mittagsruhe, no plural)
example: Während der Mittagsruhe darf niemand bohren. — Nobody may drill during the midday quiet period.

hindi: बीच — किसी जगह या समय का केंद्रीय बिंदु
definition: the middle or centre point of a space, object or period of time, the location equally distant from all edges (die Mitte, no plural)
example: Der Tisch steht in der Mitte des Zimmers. — The table stands in the middle of the room.

hindi: सूचित करना — किसी को कोई बात औपचारिक रूप से बताना
definition: to inform someone of something or communicate a piece of news or information, often in formal written notices (separable: teilt mit, hat mitgeteilt; jemandem etwas mitteilen)
example: Bitte teilen Sie uns Ihre neue Adresse mit. — Please inform us of your new address.

hindi: सूचना — किसी बात की औपचारिक जानकारी या घोषणा
definition: a notification or announcement, the formal message by which an office or person informs others about something (die Mitteilung, plural Mitteilungen)
example: Die Mitteilung über die neuen Öffnungszeiten hängt am Eingang. — The notice about the new opening hours hangs at the entrance.

hindi: मध्ययुग — प्राचीन और आधुनिक काल के बीच का यूरोपीय इतिहास
definition: the Middle Ages, the period of European history between antiquity and the modern era, roughly 500 to 1500 (das Mittelalter, no plural)
example: Die Burg wurde im Mittelalter gebaut. — The castle was built in the Middle Ages.

hindi: मझोला — न बड़ा न छोटा, बीच का आकार
definition: medium-sized or of middling size, neither large nor small, describing towns, companies, dogs and people
example: Sie wohnen in einer mittelgroßen Stadt. — They live in a medium-sized town.

hindi: औसत दर्जे का — न अच्छा न बुरा, साधारण
definition: mediocre, middling, neither good nor bad; mildly disapproving of quality that is merely average
example: Das Essen im Restaurant war nur mittelmäßig. — The food in the restaurant was only mediocre.

hindi: के ज़रिए — किसी साधन या उपकरण की मदद से
definition: by means of, using a stated tool, method or device to achieve something, formal technical register (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Die Tür öffnet sich mittels einer Karte. — The door opens by means of a card.

hindi: मध्यम आकार के उद्योग — जर्मन अर्थव्यवस्था की रीढ़ मानी जाने वाली छोटी-मझोली कंपनियाँ
definition: the sector of small and medium-sized family-owned businesses regarded as the backbone of the German economy, also the middle class of society (der Mittelstand, no plural)
example: Der Mittelstand schafft die meisten Arbeitsplätze in Deutschland. — Small and medium businesses create most jobs in Germany.

hindi: माध्य — गणित में कई मानों का औसत मध्य मान
definition: the mean or average value in mathematics and statistics, the middle figure obtained by adding several amounts together and dividing by their number (der Mittelwert, plural Mittelwerte)
example: Der Mittelwert der Messungen beträgt zwölf Grad. — The mean of the measurements is twelve degrees.

hindi: बीचोंबीच — किसी चीज़ या भीड़ के ठीक बीच में
definition: right in the middle of something, in the thick of a crowd, event or place, colloquial and lively
example: Beim Konzert standen wir mittendrin. — At the concert we stood right in the middle.

hindi: आधी रात — रात के बारह बजे, दिन बदलने का क्षण
definition: midnight, twelve o'clock at night when one calendar day passes into the next (die Mitternacht, plural Mitternächte)
example: Bis zur Mitternacht bleiben nur noch zehn Minuten. — Only ten minutes remain until midnight.

hindi: अब तक — इतने समय में, इस बीच
definition: by now, meanwhile, after all the time that has passed since something began
example: Mittlerweile spricht sie fließend Deutsch. — By now she speaks fluent German.

hindi: भाव-सूचक अव्यय — वक्ता का रुख जताने वाला व्याकरणिक शब्द
definition: the grammatical term for an unstressed particle such as doch or mal that conveys the speaker's attitude rather than information (die Modalpartikel, plural Modalpartikeln)
example: Die Modalpartikel ist für Lernende schwierig. — The modal particle is difficult for learners.

hindi: पहनावे का चलन — किसी समय में पसंद किया जाने वाला पहनावा
definition: fashion, the current style of clothes and dress that people consider attractive and modern this season (die Mode, plural Moden)
example: Die Mode ändert sich jedes Jahr. — Fashion changes every year.

hindi: प्रस्तुतकर्ता — टीवी या रेडियो कार्यक्रम का एंकर
definition: a presenter or host, the person who leads a television or radio programme and introduces guests (der Moderator, plural Moderatoren)
example: Der Moderator begrüßte die Gäste im Studio. — The presenter welcomed the guests in the studio.

hindi: आधुनिक — नए ज़माने का, चलन में
definition: modern, contemporary and up to date, used of buildings, technology, fashion and attitudes that belong to the present era
example: Die Wohnung ist hell und modern eingerichtet. — The flat is bright and furnished in a modern style.

hindi: आधुनिक बनाना — पुरानी चीज़ को नए ज़माने के मुताबिक बनाना
