definition: to modernise or bring something up to current standards, such as a building, a factory, a school system or software (regular: hat modernisiert)
example: Die Bahn modernisiert die alten Bahnhöfe. — The railway is modernising the old stations.

hindi: चलन के अनुसार — आजकल के पहनावे के मुताबिक़
definition: fashionable, following the current trend in clothes and looking modern and up to date
example: Sie kleidet sich immer sehr modisch. — She always dresses very fashionably.

hindi: उत्तरी नमस्ते — उत्तर जर्मनी का हर समय चलने वाला अभिवादन
definition: the northern German greeting used at any hour of the day, short and friendly, common in Hamburg and along the coast
example: Moin, schon lange wach? — Hi, been awake long?

hindi: दुग्धशाला — दूध से मक्खन-पनीर बनाने का कारखाना
definition: a dairy, the plant or business where milk is collected and processed into butter, cheese and yoghurt for sale (die Molkerei, plural Molkereien)
example: Die Milch kommt aus der Molkerei im Dorf. — The milk comes from the dairy in the village.

hindi: पल — बहुत छोटी अवधि, थोड़ी देर
definition: a moment, a very short stretch of time, often used to ask someone to wait briefly (der Moment, plural Momente)
example: Hast du einen Moment Zeit für mich? — Do you have a moment for me?

hindi: फ़िलहाल, इस समय — वर्तमान दौर में, अभी के लिए
definition: at the moment, currently, for the present period which may change later, common in everyday conversation
example: Momentan habe ich sehr viel Arbeit. — At the moment I have a great deal of work.

hindi: महीना — साल के बारह हिस्सों में से एक
definition: a month, one of the twelve named divisions of the calendar year, each lasting about thirty days (der Monat, plural Monate)
example: Der Vertrag läuft noch einen Monat. — The contract runs for one more month.

hindi: मासिक — हर महीने होने वाला
definition: monthly, happening or being paid once every month, usually on the same date
example: Die Miete wird monatlich bezahlt. — The rent is paid monthly.

hindi: मासिक पास — पूरे महीने असीमित सफ़र का टिकट
definition: a monthly travel pass, the ticket that allows unlimited public transport journeys for one month (die Monatskarte, plural Monatskarten)
example: Mit der Monatskarte fahre ich jeden Tag zur Arbeit. — With the monthly pass I travel to work every day.

hindi: दर्शक पटल — मेज़ वाले संगणक से जुड़ा अलग परदा
definition: a monitor, the separate display screen connected to a desktop computer, the word used mostly for external screens rather than phones (der Monitor, plural Monitore)
example: Ich brauche einen größeren Monitor fürs Büro. — I need a bigger monitor for the office.

hindi: सोमवार — सप्ताह का पहला कार्यदिवस
definition: Monday, the first day of the working week that follows the weekend, when offices and schools open again (der Montag, plural Montage)
example: Am Montag beginnt die Schule wieder. — On Monday school starts again.

hindi: जोड़ना — पुर्ज़े मिलाकर चीज़ खड़ी करना या लगाना
definition: to assemble or mount something, fitting the parts together or fixing it in place (regular: montiert, hat montiert)
example: Der Monteur montiert die neue Küche. — The fitter installs the new kitchen.

hindi: दलदली भूमि — गीली, नरम पीट वाली ज़मीन
definition: a moor or bog, a wet spongy area of peaty ground where the soil never fully dries (das Moor, plural Moore)
example: Im Moor darf man den Weg nicht verlassen. — In the bog you must not leave the path.

hindi: नैतिकता — सही और गलत आचरण के नियम
definition: morality or morals, the shared rules about right and wrong conduct, also the lesson of a story (die Moral, no plural)
example: Die Moral der Geschichte ist einfach. — The moral of the story is simple.

hindi: हत्या — जानबूझकर किसी की जान लेना
definition: murder, the deliberate killing of a person, the most serious crime in the criminal code (der Mord, plural Morde)
example: Der Mord schockierte die ganze Stadt. — The murder shocked the whole town.

hindi: सुबह — दिन का आरंभिक समय, जागने से दोपहर तक
definition: the morning, the early part of the day from waking until around noon (der Morgen, plural Morgen)
example: Der Morgen war kalt und neblig. — The morning was cold and foggy.

hindi: भोर — सूरज उगने से ठीक पहले की पहली धुँधली रोशनी
definition: dawn, the first grey half-light of morning just before the sunrise and full daylight (das Morgengrauen, no plural)
example: Wir brachen im Morgengrauen auf. — We set off at dawn.

hindi: सुबह का खड़ूस — जागने के बाद चिड़चिड़ा और चुप रहने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person who is grumpy silent and unapproachable in the early morning after waking and needs time and coffee before becoming friendly (der Morgenmuffel, plural Morgenmuffel)
example: Sprich ihn vor dem Kaffee nicht an, er ist ein Morgenmuffel. — Do not talk to him before coffee, he is grumpy in the mornings.

hindi: सुबह के समय — हर सुबह या आम तौर पर सुबह
definition: in the mornings, as a regular habit during the early part of the day before noon, typically before work or school
example: Morgens trinke ich immer Kaffee. — In the mornings I always drink coffee.

hindi: मस्जिद — मुसलमानों की नमाज़ का भवन
definition: a mosque, the building where Muslims gather to pray, often with a dome and a minaret tower (die Moschee, plural Moscheen)
example: Freitags gehen viele Männer in die Moschee. — On Fridays many men go to the mosque.

hindi: चालन यंत्र — गाड़ी को चलाने वाली मशीन
definition: an engine or motor, the machine that burns fuel or uses electricity to move a vehicle (der Motor, plural Motoren)
example: Der Motor springt bei Kälte schlecht an. — The engine starts badly in the cold.

hindi: दुपहिया वाहन — इंजन से चलने वाली दोपहिया सवारी
definition: a two-wheeled motor vehicle with an engine that the rider straddles and steers with handlebars, a motorbike (das Motorrad, plural Motorräder)
example: Im Sommer fährt er gern mit dem Motorrad. — In summer he likes riding his motorbike.

hindi: बड़बड़ाना — चिड़चिड़ाकर शिकायत करना
definition: to grouch or gripe in a sulky irritated way, colloquial for complaining loudly about something (regular)
example: Die Fahrgäste motzen über die Verspätung. — The passengers gripe about the delay.

hindi: मुँह — चेहरे का वह छिद्र जिससे खाते और बोलते हैं
definition: the mouth, the opening in the lower face with lips, teeth and tongue used for eating and speaking (der Mund, plural Münder)
example: Mach den Mund auf und sag etwas. — Open your mouth and say something.

hindi: बुदबुदाना — धीमी, अस्पष्ट आवाज़ में कुछ कहना
definition: to mutter or murmur words quietly and indistinctly under your breath, often talking to yourself rather than to others (regular: murmelt, hat gemurmelt)
example: Er murmelte eine Entschuldigung und ging. — He muttered an apology and left.

hindi: संग्रहालय — कला, इतिहास या विज्ञान की वस्तुओं का घर
definition: a museum, a building where objects of artistic, historical or scientific interest are collected, kept and shown to visitors (das Museum, plural Museen)
example: Das Museum ist montags geschlossen. — The museum is closed on Mondays.

hindi: संगीत — सुरों और तालों से रचा गया ध्वनि रूप
definition: music, sounds arranged in melody and rhythm that people sing, play on instruments and listen to for pleasure (die Musik, no plural)
example: Beim Kochen höre ich immer die Musik im Radio. — While cooking I always listen to the music on the radio.

hindi: संगीत बजाना — शौक से वाद्य बजाना या गाना
definition: to make music, to play instruments or sing together with others for pleasure (regular: hat musiziert)
example: Die Familie musiziert am Sonntag zusammen. — The family makes music together on Sunday.

hindi: मांसपेशी — शरीर का वह ऊतक जो सिकुड़कर हिलने की ताक़त देता है
definition: a muscle, the fleshy tissue in the body that tightens to move limbs and give strength (der Muskel, plural Muskeln)
example: Nach dem Training tut jeder Muskel weh. — After training every muscle hurts.

hindi: मांसपेशियों का दर्द — कड़ी कसरत के अगले दिन का दर्द
definition: sore muscles, the aching stiffness felt a day or two after unusually hard exercise, literally a muscle hangover (der Muskelkater, plural Muskelkater)
example: Nach dem ersten Training hatte ich Muskelkater. — After the first training session I had sore muscles.

hindi: नमूना, बनावट — कपड़े या दीवार पर दोहराई गई आकृतियाँ, या नक़ल के लिए नमूना
definition: a pattern, a design of shapes or colours repeated across cloth, wallpaper or tiles, also a sample or model to copy (das Muster, plural Muster)
example: Der Teppich hat ein schönes Muster. — The carpet has a beautiful pattern.

hindi: साहस — डर के बावजूद कठिन या खतरनाक काम करने की हिम्मत
definition: the courage and bravery to face danger, pain or risk despite fear and do what is needed (der Mut, no plural)
example: Ihm fehlte der Mut, dem Chef zu widersprechen. — He lacked the courage to contradict the boss.

hindi: साहसी — डर के बावजूद हिम्मत से आगे बढ़ने वाला
definition: brave and courageous, willing to face danger, risk or opposition despite fear (regular adjective)
example: Es war mutig von dir, die Wahrheit zu sagen. — It was brave of you to tell the truth.

hindi: माँ — बच्चे को जन्म देने वाली या पालने वाली स्त्री
definition: the mother, the female parent who bears or raises a child within the family (die Mutter, plural Mütter)
example: Die Mutter liest ihrer Tochter eine Geschichte vor. — The mother reads her daughter a story.

hindi: नितांत अकेला — दूर-दूर तक कोई नहीं
definition: alone to a desolate degree, without another living human soul anywhere within reach or hearing
example: The station closed at ten and left her mutterseelenallein on the platform.

hindi: मातृ दिवस — मई का दूसरा रविवार, माँ को फूल देने का दिन
definition: the second Sunday in May, Mother's Day, when children give their mothers flowers and cards (der Muttertag, plural Muttertage)
example: Zum Muttertag schenke ich ihr Blumen. — For Mother's Day I give her flowers.

hindi: भारी-भरकम — विशाल और शक्तिशाली
definition: mighty or massive in size and power, describing something huge and imposing like an ancient tree or a fortress wall
example: Eine mächtige Eiche steht im Garten. — A mighty oak stands in the garden.

hindi: लड़की — बोलचाल में युवती, छोरी
definition: a girl or young woman in friendly colloquial southern and everyday speech, warmer and more casual than the standard word (das Mädel, plural Mädel or Mädels)
example: Die Mädels treffen sich heute Abend im Café. — The girls are meeting at the café tonight.

hindi: घास काटना — मशीन या हँसिये से घास छाँटना
definition: to mow, to trim grass, a lawn or a meadow short with a garden mower or a scythe (regular: mäht, hat gemäht)
example: Ich muss heute noch den Rasen mähen. — I still have to mow the lawn today.

hindi: परीकथा — जादू और चमत्कार वाली बच्चों की लोककथा
definition: a fairy tale, a traditional magical folk story with witches, princes and talking animals told to children (das Märchen, plural Märchen)
example: Das Märchen vom Rotkäppchen kennt jedes Kind. — Every child knows the fairy tale of Little Red Riding Hood.

hindi: साधारण — न कम न ज़्यादा; बस ठीक-ठाक
definition: moderate or middling, neither much nor little, and colloquially meaning mediocre or not very good
example: Das Wetter war nur mäßig. — The weather was only so-so.

hindi: साज़-सामान की एक चीज़ — मेज़, कुर्सी जैसी घरेलू वस्तु
definition: a piece of furniture, one single item such as a table, chair or cupboard that furnishes a room (das Möbelstück, plural Möbelstücke)
example: Das Regal ist mein liebstes Möbelstück. — The shelf is my favourite piece of furniture.

hindi: सुसज्जित — पहले से बिस्तर और फ़र्नीचर लगा हुआ कमरा
definition: furnished, describing a rented room or flat that already contains beds, tables and cupboards
example: Ich suche ein möbliertes Zimmer für drei Monate. — I am looking for a furnished room for three months.

hindi: पसंद करना — किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ को अच्छा लगना
definition: to like a person or thing, feeling fondness or pleasure toward it, the modal verb of liking whose polite subjunctive möchte means would like (irregular: mag, mochte, hat gemocht)
example: Ich mag keinen Kaffee am Abend. — I do not like coffee in the evening.

hindi: संभवतः — मुमकिन है कि
definition: possibly, perhaps; a formal adverb expressing that something may well be the case without being certain
example: Das Treffen findet möglicherweise später statt. — The meeting may possibly take place later.

hindi: संभावना — कोई बात हो सकने या करने का अवसर
definition: a possibility or option, something that can happen or be done, or an available opportunity to do it (die Möglichkeit, plural Möglichkeiten)
example: Es gibt die Möglichkeit, online zu bezahlen. — There is the possibility of paying online.

hindi: गाजर — नारंगी लंबी जड़-सब्ज़ी, उत्तरी जर्मनी का शब्द
definition: a carrot, the long orange root vegetable, the usual word in northern and central Germany where Karotte sounds southern (die Möhre, plural Möhren)
example: Die Möhre ist frisch und knackig. — The carrot is fresh and crunchy.

hindi: भिक्षु — मठ में रहने वाला संन्यासी पुरुष
definition: a monk, a man who has taken religious vows and lives in a monastery devoted to prayer and simple work (der Mönch, plural Mönche)
example: Die Mönche stehen sehr früh auf. — The monks get up very early.

hindi: गारा — सीमेंट और रेत का लेप जो ईंटों को जोड़ता है
definition: mortar, the paste of cement, sand and water that holds bricks and stones together (der Mörtel, plural Mörtel)
example: Der Maurer rührt den Mörtel im Eimer an. — The bricklayer mixes the mortar in the bucket.

hindi: समुद्री चिड़िया — तट पर चीख़ने वाला सफ़ेद पक्षी जो बंदरगाहों पर मंडराता है
definition: a seagull, the loud white coastal bird that circles over harbours and snatches food from tourists (die Möwe, plural Möwen)
example: Die Möwe hat mir das Brötchen geklaut. — The seagull stole my bread roll.

hindi: मच्छर — रात में काटने वाला छोटा भिनभिनाता कीट
definition: a mosquito or midge, the tiny whining insect that bites at night and leaves itchy spots (die Mücke, plural Mücken)
example: Eine Mücke hat mich heute Nacht gestochen. — A mosquito bit me last night.

hindi: थका हुआ — नींद या आराम की ज़रूरत महसूस होना
definition: tired and drowsy after work or a long day, needing sleep or rest very soon
example: Ich bin heute sehr müde. — I am very tired today.

hindi: थकान — नींद या आराम की ज़रूरत का भाव
definition: tiredness, the feeling of needing sleep or rest after effort or a long day (die Müdigkeit, no plural)
example: Gegen Mittag kam die Müdigkeit. — Around midday the tiredness set in.

hindi: मेहनत — किसी काम में लगाया गया श्रम और कष्ट
definition: effort, trouble or pains taken to achieve something, often with the idea of strain (die Mühe, plural Mühen)
example: Das Ergebnis war die Mühe wert. — The result was worth the effort.

hindi: अनायास — बिना किसी मेहनत या कोशिश के
definition: effortless, achieved easily without any strain or hard work, said of elegant skill or a comfortable win
example: Sie hat das Rennen mühelos gewonnen. — She won the race effortlessly.

hindi: श्रमसाध्य — कष्ट और धीमी मेहनत से होने वाला
definition: laborious, arduous or painstaking, achieved only slowly and with much trouble
example: Das ist eine mühsame und langweilige Arbeit. — That is laborious and boring work.

hindi: कचरा — घर का फेंकने लायक बेकार सामान
definition: rubbish or garbage, the household waste that is thrown away and collected in bins and bags (der Müll, no plural)
example: Der Müll wird jeden Dienstag abgeholt. — The rubbish is collected every Tuesday.

hindi: कचरा बाहर ले जाना — घर का कूड़ा बाहर के बड़े कूड़ेदान में डालना
definition: to take the rubbish out, the everyday chore of carrying the full bin bag from the kitchen to the outdoor bin (bringt raus, hat rausgebracht)
example: Kannst du heute den Müll rausbringen? — Can you take the rubbish out today?

hindi: कचरा उठाने की सेवा — कूड़ा ले जाने वाली गाड़ी और कर्मचारी
definition: the refuse collection, the municipal service and truck that empties the bins and carts the rubbish away (die Müllabfuhr, plural Müllabfuhren)
example: Die Müllabfuhr kommt jeden Freitag um sechs. — The refuse collection comes every Friday at six.

hindi: कूड़ेदान — रसोई या कमरे में कचरा डालने की बाल्टी
definition: a rubbish bin, the small indoor container in a kitchen or room into which household waste is dropped (der Mülleimer, plural Mülleimer)
example: Der Mülleimer in der Küche ist schon wieder voll. — The rubbish bin in the kitchen is full again.

hindi: बड़ा कूड़ादान — घर के बाहर रखा पहियों वाला बड़ा कचरा डिब्बा
definition: a wheelie bin, the large outdoor waste container on wheels that the refuse lorry empties on collection day (die Mülltonne, plural Mülltonnen)
example: Die gelbe Mülltonne ist für Verpackungen. — The yellow bin is for packaging.

hindi: कचरे का वर्गीकरण — काग़ज़, प्लास्टिक और जैविक कचरा अलग करना
definition: the sorting of household waste into separate bins for paper, packaging, organic matter and general rubbish, a strict habit in Germany (die Mülltrennung, no plural)
example: Die Mülltrennung ist in Deutschland sehr wichtig. — Sorting waste is very important in Germany.

hindi: सिक्का — धातु का पैसा
definition: a coin, a piece of metal money such as a one-euro or fifty-cent piece (die Münze, plural Münzen)
example: Für den Automaten brauche ich eine Münze. — I need a coin for the machine.

hindi: जई-मेवे का नाश्ता — जई, मेवे और सूखे फल का दूध के साथ खाया जाने वाला मिश्रण
definition: muesli, the breakfast mixture of oat flakes, nuts and dried fruit eaten with milk or yoghurt, a Swiss invention now universal in Germany (das Müsli, plural Müslis)
example: Das Müsli esse ich mit Joghurt. — I eat the muesli with yoghurt.

hindi: ज़रूरी होना — मजबूरी या आवश्यकता से कुछ करना पड़ना
definition: to have to do something because necessity or compulsion leaves no choice, the modal verb of strong obligation (irregular: muss, musste, hat gemusst)
example: Ich muss morgen früh aufstehen. — I have to get up early tomorrow.

hindi: टोपी — सिर को गरम रखने वाली नरम ऊनी टोपी
definition: a cap or beanie, the soft close-fitting head covering, often knitted, worn to keep warm in cold weather (die Mütze, plural Mützen)
example: Die Mütze hält meine Ohren warm. — The cap keeps my ears warm.

hindi: अरे, तो — बात शुरू करने या पूछने का छोटा शब्द
definition: an interjection that opens a question, greets someone casually, or prods the listener to answer
example: Na, wie war dein Tag? — So, how was your day?

hindi: तो फिर — बात समेटकर आगे बढ़ना
definition: well then, in that case; a phrase that accepts a situation and moves on, often before a farewell
example: Na dann, bis morgen! — Well then, see you tomorrow!

hindi: ख़ैर, ठीक ही है — आधे-अधूरे मन से मानने वाला वाक्यांश
definition: an interjection expressing lukewarm acceptance or mild doubt, roughly oh well or sort of
example: Na ja, es geht so. — Oh well, it's alright I suppose.

hindi: हाँ बेशक — बिना झिझक की हामी
definition: of course, sure thing; a warm colloquial agreement meaning naturally, without any doubt at all
example: Hilfst du mir? Na klar! — Will you help me? Of course!

hindi: के बाद — समय में बाद में, या किसी जगह की ओर
definition: after in time, or towards a city, country or direction, or according to some source or opinion (preposition, + Dativ)
example: Nach der Arbeit gehe ich einkaufen. — After work I am going shopping.

hindi: हाँ-में-हाँ मिलाना — खुश करने के लिए वही कहना जो सामने वाला सुनना चाहे
definition: to tell someone only what they want to hear, flattering them instead of being honest (jemandem nach dem Mund reden; hat geredet)
example: Er redet dem Chef ständig nach dem Mund. — He constantly tells the boss what he wants to hear.

hindi: घर की ओर — अपने घर लौटना या घर की तरफ़ जाना
definition: homeward, going towards one's own home; contrast zu Hause, which means being at home (adverbial phrase used with verbs of motion)
example: Ich gehe jetzt nach Hause. — I am going home now.

hindi: पड़ोसी — बगल के घर या फ़्लैट में रहने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a neighbour, the person who lives next door or in the flat beside yours (der Nachbar, plural Nachbarn)
example: Unser Nachbar gießt die Blumen, wenn wir weg sind. — Our neighbour waters the flowers when we are away.

hindi: पड़ोसी देश — साझा सीमा वाला देश
definition: a neighbouring country, a state that shares a common border with one's own country (das Nachbarland, plural Nachbarländer)
example: Wir fahren oft ins Nachbarland zum Einkaufen. — We often drive to the neighbouring country to shop.

hindi: पड़ोस — आस-पास के घर और उनमें रहने वाले लोग
definition: the neighbourhood, the streets around your home together with the neighbours who live there, including the local shops and friendly community (die Nachbarschaft, plural Nachbarschaften)
example: In unserer Nachbarschaft kennt jeder jeden. — In our neighbourhood everyone knows everyone.

hindi: पड़ोसी सहयोग — मोहल्ले की बिन-माँगी आपसी मदद
definition: neighbourly help offered as routine, from watering plants to clearing snow off the shared path
example: The snow was gone by Nachbarschaftshilfe long before the council trucks arrived.

hindi: के बाद — मुख्य घटना से पहले हुई बात बताने वाला शब्द
definition: after; a conjunction introducing an event that happened before the main action, usually with the perfect or pluperfect tense
example: Nachdem wir gegessen hatten, gingen wir spazieren. — After we had eaten, we went for a walk.

hindi: विचार करना — किसी बात पर गहराई से सोचना
definition: to think something over carefully, to reflect, ponder or consider before reaching a decision (separable: denkt nach, hat nachgedacht; über + Akkusativ)
example: Ich muss über das Angebot noch nachdenken. — I still have to think the offer over.

hindi: किसी बात पर सोच-विचार करना — किसी विषय पर गहराई से मनन करना
definition: to think carefully or reflect deeply about a question, problem or decision (separable: denkt nach, hat nachgedacht, über + Akkusativ)
example: Ich muss über dein Angebot noch nachdenken. — I still have to think about your offer.

hindi: विचारमग्न — गहरी सोच में डूबा हुआ
definition: thoughtful or pensive, absorbed in reflection and quiet after hearing something (nachdenklich, nachdenklicher, am nachdenklichsten)
example: Nach dem Gespräch war sie sehr nachdenklich. — After the conversation she was very pensive.

hindi: माँग — बाज़ार में किसी सामान को ख़रीदने की इच्छा; पूछताछ
definition: the demand for goods or services in a market, how much customers want to buy, also a follow-up enquiry (die Nachfrage, no plural)
example: Die Nachfrage nach Elektroautos wächst schnell. — Demand for electric cars is growing fast.

hindi: दोबारा पूछना — पुष्टि या स्पष्टता के लिए फिर से सवाल करना
definition: to ask again or enquire further with someone in order to check, confirm or clarify a detail you are unsure about (separable: fragt nach, hat nachgefragt; bei + Dativ)
example: Ich frage lieber noch einmal beim Arzt nach. — I would rather check again with the doctor.

hindi: झुक जाना — दबाव या ज़िद के आगे अपनी बात छोड़ देना
definition: to give in or yield to pressure, demands or persuasion after resisting for a while (separable: gibt nach, hat nachgegeben)
example: Am Ende hat der Vater doch nachgegeben. — In the end the father gave in after all.

hindi: पीछे चलना — किसी के पीछे जाना या किसी मामले की छानबीन करना
definition: to follow behind someone, to pursue and investigate a matter or hobby, or of a clock to run slow (separable: geht nach, ist nachgegangen; + Dativ)
example: Die Polizei geht jedem Hinweis nach. — The police follow up every lead.

hindi: टिकाऊ — जो आगे की पीढ़ियों के संसाधन न खाए
definition: sustainable, describing something done in a lasting way that does not exhaust resources for future generations
example: Wir versuchen, nachhaltig einzukaufen. — We try to shop sustainably.

hindi: टिकाऊपन — संसाधनों का ऐसा उपयोग जो भविष्य को न छीने
definition: sustainability, the principle of meeting present needs without using up the resources future generations will need (die Nachhaltigkeit, no plural)
example: Die Nachhaltigkeit ist der Firma sehr wichtig. — Sustainability is very important to the company.

hindi: बाद में — थोड़ी देर बाद, आज ही
definition: afterwards, later on, a short time after now or after something else has finished
example: Nachher gehen wir noch einkaufen. — Afterwards we are going shopping.

hindi: ट्यूशन — कमज़ोर विषय में स्कूल के बाहर निजी अतिरिक्त पढ़ाई
definition: private tutoring or extra coaching outside school for a pupil who is struggling with a subject (die Nachhilfe, no plural)
example: Die Nachhilfe in Mathe hilft ihr sehr. — The maths tutoring helps her a lot.

hindi: छूटा काम पूरा करना — जो पहले नहीं हो सका, उसे बाद में पूरा करना
definition: to catch up on something missed earlier, to make up for a lesson, exam or sleep later (separable: holt nach, hat nachgeholt)
example: Ich muss die verpasste Prüfung nächste Woche nachholen. — I have to make up the missed exam next week.

hindi: वंशज — बाद की पीढ़ी का व्यक्ति, संतान की संतान
definition: the descendant, a person of a later generation who comes down from a particular ancestor (der Nachkomme, plural Nachkommen)
example: Die Nachkommen des Bauern leben noch im Dorf. — The farmer's descendants still live in the village.

hindi: युद्धोत्तर काल — युद्ध के ठीक बाद के कठिन वर्ष
definition: the postwar period, the hard years right after a war when a country rebuilds and recovers (die Nachkriegszeit, plural Nachkriegszeiten)
example: In der Nachkriegszeit gab es wenig zu essen. — In the postwar period there was little to eat.

hindi: मृतक की संपत्ति — मरने के बाद छोड़ी गई कुल चीज़ें और काग़ज़
definition: the estate, all the property, papers and belongings a dead person leaves behind (der Nachlass, plural Nachlässe)
example: Der Nachlass des Malers ging an das Museum. — The painter's estate went to the museum.

hindi: कम होना — दर्द, बारिश या ताक़त का धीरे-धीरे घटना
definition: to decrease or subside gradually, said of pain, rain, strength, performance or interest (separable: lässt nach, hat nachgelassen)
example: Der Regen hat endlich nachgelassen. — The rain has finally eased off.

hindi: पीछे भागना — किसी के पीछे दौड़ना या उसके पीछे पड़े रहना
definition: to run after someone or something, or figuratively to chase a person or goal persistently without success (separable: läuft nach, ist nachgelaufen; + Dativ)
example: Der Hund läuft dem Ball immer nach. — The dog always runs after the ball.

hindi: लापरवाह — काम में ढिलाई और बेपरवाही बरतने वाला
definition: careless and negligent, not taking proper care over work or duties and leaving things sloppy or undone
example: Er arbeitet in letzter Zeit sehr nachlässig. — He has been working very carelessly lately.

hindi: नकल करना — किसी की हरकत या काम को वैसा ही दोहराना
definition: to imitate or copy what someone else does, to reproduce an action or a product (separable: macht nach, hat nachgemacht)
example: Die Kinder machen alles nach, was die Eltern tun. — The children copy everything the parents do.

hindi: अगला किरायेदार — मौजूदा किरायेदार के जाने के बाद फ़्लैट लेने वाला
definition: the next tenant, the person who takes over a flat when the current tenant leaves (der Nachmieter, plural Nachmieter)
example: Wir suchen dringend einen Nachmieter für unsere Wohnung. — We are urgently looking for a successor tenant for our flat.

hindi: अपराह्न — दोपहर के बाद शाम तक का समय
definition: the afternoon, the part of the day between midday and the evening, often a time for coffee and cake (der Nachmittag, plural Nachmittage)
example: Am Nachmittag trinken wir Kaffee. — In the afternoon we drink coffee.

hindi: पुनः सत्यापन करना — किसी दावे या हिसाब की सच्चाई दोबारा जाँचना
definition: to verify or check something again carefully to make sure it is correct and accurate (separable: prüft nach, hat nachgeprüft)
example: Bitte prüfen Sie die Rechnung noch einmal nach. — Please verify the invoice once more.

hindi: बाद में जमा करना — छूटा दस्तावेज़ बाद में देना
definition: to submit a missing document later, after the main application has already been handed in (separable: reicht nach, hat nachgereicht)
example: Ich reiche das Zeugnis nächste Woche nach. — I will hand in the certificate next week.

hindi: संदेश — किसी को भेजी गई ख़बर या मैसेज
definition: a message, a text or chat message sent to someone, and in the plural the news broadcast on television or radio (die Nachricht, plural Nachrichten)
example: Ich schicke dir eine Nachricht, wenn ich da bin. — I will send you a message when I am there.

hindi: देखकर जाँचना — कोई चीज़ या स्थिति ठीक है या नहीं, यह देखने जाना
definition: to look and check whether something is in order or to find something, common in southern and colloquial usage (separable: schaut nach, hat nachgeschaut)
example: Ich schaue kurz nach, ob die Post da ist. — I will quickly check whether the mail is here.

hindi: शब्द खोजना — शब्दकोश या संदर्भ-पुस्तक में कोई शब्द या तथ्य ढूँढ़ना
definition: to look something up in a dictionary or reference book to find a word or fact (separable: schlägt nach, hat nachgeschlagen)
example: Ich schlage das Wort im Wörterbuch nach. — I look the word up in the dictionary.

hindi: जाँच कर देखना — कुछ ठीक है या नहीं, यह देखने के लिए जाकर जाँचना
definition: to check by looking, to walk over and verify whether something is in order or where an object has been placed (separable: sieht nach, hat nachgesehen)
example: Sieh bitte nach, ob die Tür abgeschlossen ist. — Please check whether the door is locked.

hindi: मिठाई — भोजन के अंत में परोसा जाने वाला मीठा व्यंजन
definition: dessert, the sweet final dish of a meal, a slightly more formal word for the same sweet course (die Nachspeise, plural Nachspeisen)
example: Die Nachspeise war noch besser als das Hauptgericht. — The dessert was even better than the main course.

hindi: रात — सूरज डूबने से उगने तक का अँधेरा समय
definition: the night, the dark hours between sunset and sunrise when most people sleep (die Nacht, plural Nächte)
example: Die Nacht war lang und still. — The night was long and quiet.

hindi: हानि, नुक़सान — जो बात किसी को कमज़ोर स्थिति में डाले
definition: a disadvantage or drawback, an unfavourable feature that makes something worse or puts someone at a loss (der Nachteil, plural Nachteile)
example: Der einzige Nachteil ist der hohe Preis. — The only disadvantage is the high price.

hindi: रात का खाना — शाम का मुख्य भोजन, स्विस शब्द
definition: the evening meal or supper, the main hot meal of the evening, the Swiss word where Germany says Abendessen (das Nachtessen, plural Nachtessen)
example: Kommst du heute zum Nachtessen zu uns? — Are you coming to our place for dinner tonight?

hindi: मीठा — भोजन के अंत में परोसा जाने वाला मीठा व्यंजन
definition: dessert, the sweet course served after the main meal such as pudding, fruit or ice cream (der Nachtisch, plural Nachtische)
example: Was gibt es heute zum Nachtisch? — What is there for dessert today?

hindi: रात के समय — रात में, आम तौर पर या बार-बार
definition: at night, during the dark hours between sunset and sunrise as a regular or repeated pattern
example: Nachts ist die Straße ganz ruhig. — At night the street is completely quiet.

hindi: पलंग के पास की मेज़ — सिरहाने की छोटी मेज़
definition: a bedside table, the small table beside a bed for a lamp, book or glass of water (der Nachttisch, plural Nachttische)
example: Mein Handy liegt auf dem Nachttisch. — My phone is on the bedside table.

hindi: समझ पाना, तर्क पकड़ना — दूसरे के सोचने के ढंग को अपनाकर समझना
definition: to follow and understand someone's reasoning or feelings by retracing them in one's own mind (separable: vollzieht nach, hat nachvollzogen)
example: Ich kann deine Entscheidung gut nachvollziehen. — I can well understand your decision.

hindi: प्रमाण — किसी बात को साबित करने वाला दस्तावेज़ी सबूत
definition: documentary proof or evidence that shows a fact is true, such as proof of income, insurance or address, often demanded by an office (der Nachweis, plural Nachweise)
example: Für das Visum brauche ich einen Nachweis über mein Einkommen. — For the visa I need proof of my income.

hindi: गुद्दी — गर्दन का पिछला हिस्सा, सिर के नीचे
definition: the nape, the back of the neck below the head where stiffness and tension gather (der Nacken, plural Nacken)
example: Der Nacken ist vom langen Sitzen ganz steif. — The back of the neck is stiff from long sitting.

hindi: बिना खोल का घोंघा — बगीचे की पत्तियाँ खाने वाला चिपचिपा जीव
definition: a slug, the soft slimy garden creature that resembles a snail but has no shell and eats lettuce leaves at night, literally a naked snail (die Nacktschnecke, plural Nacktschnecken)
example: Nach dem Regen kriechen Nacktschnecken über den Salat. — After the rain slugs crawl over the lettuce.

hindi: कील — लकड़ी या दीवार में ठोकी जाने वाली नुकीली धातु की छड़
definition: a nail, the thin pointed metal pin hammered into wood or walls to fix or hang things, also a fingernail (der Nagel, plural Nägel)
example: Der Nagel für das Bild ist zu kurz. — The nail for the picture is too short.

hindi: पास — थोड़े फ़ासले पर, नज़दीक
definition: near or close by, describing a place that is only a short distance away and quickly reached on foot, the opposite of far
example: Der Supermarkt ist ganz nah. — The supermarket is very close.

hindi: लगभग — करीब-करीब, बहुत थोड़ा कम
definition: almost or virtually, very close to the full amount or state, a slightly formal alternative to fast
example: Der Saal war nahezu leer. — The hall was almost empty.

hindi: भोजन — जीने के लिए खाया जाने वाला पदार्थ
definition: food in general, the nourishment that people and animals take in to stay alive and grow (die Nahrung, no plural)
example: Die Nahrung liefert dem Körper Energie. — Food gives the body energy.

hindi: स्थानीय यातायात — शहर और आसपास की सड़क-रेल, यात्री-वाहन और स्थानीय रेल
definition: local public transport, the buses, trams and regional trains that serve a city and its surroundings (der Nahverkehr, no plural)
example: Das Ticket gilt für den gesamten Nahverkehr. — The ticket is valid for all local transport.

hindi: अरे यह क्या — अचानक हैरानी जताने वाला शब्द
definition: an interjection of mild surprise at something unexpected, roughly hello, what's this
example: Nanu, wo ist mein Schlüssel? — Hey, where's my key?

hindi: चटोरेपन से मीठा खाना — थोड़ा-थोड़ा करके चुपके से मिठाई खाना
definition: to nibble sweets, to snack on small sugary treats between meals, often secretly and with a guilty pleasure (regular: hat genascht)
example: Die Kinder naschen heimlich von der Schokolade. — The children secretly nibble the chocolate.

hindi: नाक — चेहरे के बीच का अंग जिससे सूँघते और साँस लेते हैं
definition: the nose, the organ in the middle of the face used for breathing and smelling odours (die Nase, plural Nasen)
example: Meine Nase läuft schon seit Tagen. — My nose has been running for days.

hindi: गीला — पानी या बारिश से भीगा
definition: wet and damp, describing something soaked with water or weather with a great deal of rain
example: Nach dem Regen war die Bank noch nass. — After the rain the bench was still wet.

hindi: रूमाल — नाक पोंछने का कपड़ा या कागज़, स्विस शब्द
definition: a handkerchief or paper tissue for blowing the nose, the Swiss word where Germany says Taschentuch (das Nastuch, plural Nastücher)
example: Hast du ein Nastuch für mich? — Do you have a tissue for me?

hindi: प्रकृति — इंसान के बनाए बिना का प्राकृतिक संसार
definition: nature, the natural world of plants, animals, land and water untouched by human building (die Natur, no plural)
example: Am Wochenende sind wir gern in der Natur. — At the weekend we like to be out in nature.

hindi: प्रकृति संरक्षण — जंगल, जीव-जंतु और परिदृश्य की रक्षा
definition: nature conservation, protecting landscapes, forests, animals and plants from being destroyed by human activity (der Naturschutz, no plural)
example: Der Naturschutz ist in diesem Gebiet sehr streng. — Nature conservation is very strict in this area.

hindi: बेशक — ज़ाहिर है, स्वाभाविक रूप से
definition: of course, naturally; confirming something as obvious or granting permission readily and warmly
example: Natürlich kannst du mitkommen. — Of course you can come along.

hindi: है ना — उत्तरी जर्मनी में हामी माँगना
definition: right?, isn't it?; a northern colloquial tag particle at sentence end, also a casual short form of nein
example: Das war lustig, ne? — That was funny, right?

hindi: कोहरा — ज़मीन के पास छाई धुंध
definition: fog or thick mist, a dense cloud of tiny water droplets close to the ground that hides the view (der Nebel, plural Nebel)
example: Im Nebel fahren wir langsamer. — In fog we drive more slowly.

hindi: कुहरे का सागर — ऊपर से दिखती घाटी भरती धुंध
definition: an unbroken layer of low fog seen from above, filling a valley so it resembles a white ocean
example: From the summit hut they looked down on a Nebelmeer with only two peaks breaking through.

hindi: के बग़ल में — ठीक पास में, साथ लगा हुआ
definition: next to or beside something, directly alongside it without space between, also besides in the sense of in addition (+ Dativ for location, + Akkusativ for movement)
example: Der Schlüssel liegt neben der Lampe. — The key is lying next to the lamp.

hindi: बग़ल में — ठीक साथ वाले घर या कमरे में
definition: next door or in the immediately adjacent house, room or shop, the cosy everyday word for something right beside where you are
example: Meine Eltern wohnen gleich nebenan. — My parents live right next door.

hindi: गौण विषय — मुख्य विषय के साथ पढ़ा जाने वाला दूसरा विषय
definition: a minor subject, the secondary academic discipline a student studies alongside the main one (das Nebenfach, plural Nebenfächer)
example: Mein Nebenfach ist Spanisch. — My minor subject is Spanish.

hindi: अतिरिक्त ख़र्च — किराये के ऊपर हीटिंग, पानी और सफ़ाई का खर्च
definition: the additional charges for heating, water, rubbish and building upkeep paid on top of the basic rent (die Nebenkosten, plural only)
example: Die Nebenkosten sind in der Miete nicht enthalten. — The service charges are not included in the rent.

hindi: गौण सड़क — मुख्य सड़क से लगी शांत छोटी सड़क
definition: a side street, a quieter minor road branching off from a main street through a residential area (die Nebenstraße, plural Nebenstraßen)
example: In der Nebenstraße findet man leichter einen Parkplatz. — In the side street it is easier to find parking.

hindi: दुष्प्रभाव — दवा का अनचाहा असर
definition: a side effect, the unwanted secondary reaction a medicine causes alongside its intended benefit (die Nebenwirkung, plural Nebenwirkungen)
example: Müdigkeit ist eine häufige Nebenwirkung. — Tiredness is a common side effect.

hindi: कोहरे वाला — जब धुंध छाई हो
definition: foggy, describing weather with thick mist hanging low over the ground and hiding the view
example: Der Morgen war kalt und neblig. — The morning was cold and foggy.

hindi: भतीजा या भांजा — भाई या बहन का बेटा
definition: the nephew, the son of one's brother or sister, or of a sibling-in-law, seen from the uncle or aunt (der Neffe, plural Neffen)
example: Mein Neffe lernt gerade Fahrrad fahren. — My nephew is just learning to ride a bicycle.

hindi: लेना — किसी चीज़ को हाथ में या अपने पास ले लेना
definition: to take something into one's hand or possession, the basic verb for taking, choosing or using something (nimmt, nahm, hat genommen)
example: Nimm dir ein Stück Kuchen! — Take a piece of cake!

hindi: ईर्ष्या — दूसरे की चीज़ या सुख पाने की कड़वी चाह
definition: envy, the bitter resentful wish to have what another person owns or enjoys (der Neid, no plural)
example: Der Neid der Kollegen war deutlich zu spüren. — The colleagues' envy was clearly noticeable.

hindi: ईर्ष्यालु — दूसरे की चीज़ देखकर जलने वाला
definition: envious, resentfully wishing to have what another person owns, enjoys or has achieved
example: Er ist neidisch auf den Erfolg seines Bruders. — He is envious of his brother's success.

hindi: नाम रखना — किसी को किसी नाम से पुकारना या उसका ज़िक्र करना
definition: to call or name a person or thing, giving it a label or mentioning it by name (irregular: nennt, nannte, hat genannt)
example: Alle nennen ihn einfach Max. — Everyone simply calls him Max.

hindi: नस/तंत्रिका — शरीर में संवेदना और संकेत ले जाने वाला रेशा
definition: a nerve, one of the fibres carrying signals of feeling and pain between the brain and the body (der Nerv, plural Nerven)
example: Der eingeklemmte Nerv verursacht die Schmerzen. — The pinched nerve is causing the pain.

hindi: खिजाना — किसी को परेशान करके चिढ़ाना
definition: to get on someone's nerves, to annoy or irritate them persistently, colloquial and very common (regular)
example: Die laute Musik nervt mich total. — The loud music is really getting on my nerves.

hindi: नसों की आरी — लगातार परेशान करके दिमाग खाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: an irritating person who annoys everyone constantly with talking, nagging or whining, literally a saw on the nerves, colloquial (die Nervensäge, plural Nervensägen)
example: Der kleine Bruder ist heute eine echte Nervensäge. — The little brother is a real pain today.

hindi: खिजाने वाला — चिढ़ पैदा करने वाला; बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: annoying, irritating, getting on the nerves; the colloquial word for people or things that grate
example: Die Werbung vor dem Video ist echt nervig. — The advert before the video is really annoying.

hindi: घबराया हुआ — बेचैन और तनाव में
definition: nervous and jittery, anxious, tense or restless before something important, stressful or frightening happens (regular adjective)
example: Vor der Prüfung war ich total nervös. — Before the exam I was totally nervous.

hindi: अच्छा-भला — दूसरों के प्रति सहज, दयालु और सुखद
definition: nice, pleasant and kind, the mildest everyday word of praise for a person who treats others well
example: Deine neuen Nachbarn sind wirklich nett. — Your new neighbours are really nice.

hindi: जाल — गोल के पीछे या मैदान के बीच का जाल
definition: a net, the mesh stretched across a court in tennis or volleyball or hung behind the goal in football (das Netz, plural Netze)
example: Der Ball landete im Netz. — The ball landed in the net.

hindi: नया — हाल ही में बना या आया
definition: brand-new, recently made, bought or begun, the basic word for anything fresh, unfamiliar or newly arrived
example: Ich habe ein neues Fahrrad gekauft. — I bought a new bicycle.

hindi: नई इमारत — हाल में बना आधुनिक मकान
definition: a new building, a recently constructed house or flat with modern insulation and higher rents (der Neubau, plural Neubauten)
example: Im Neubau sind die Nebenkosten niedriger. — In the new building the service charges are lower.

hindi: जिज्ञासा — नई बातें जानने और समझने की तीव्र इच्छा
definition: the eager desire to know, learn or find out about things and people, sometimes prying (die Neugier, no plural)
example: Am Ende war die Neugier stärker, und sie öffnete den Brief. — In the end curiosity won, and she opened the letter.

hindi: जिज्ञासु — हर बात जानने को उत्सुक
definition: curious and inquisitive, eager to know or find out about things and people (auf + Akkusativ)
example: Ich bin neugierig auf deine neue Wohnung. — I am curious about your new flat.

hindi: नववर्ष — पहली जनवरी, नए साल का पहला दिन
definition: new Year's Day, the first day of January when the new calendar year begins (das Neujahr, no plural)
example: An Neujahr schlafen alle lange. — On New Year's Day everyone sleeps late.

hindi: हाल ही में — कुछ ही दिन पहले
definition: recently or the other day, a short while ago at an unspecified point in the past
example: Ich habe neulich deinen Bruder getroffen. — I met your brother the other day.

hindi: नौ — गिनती की नौवीं संख्या
definition: the cardinal number nine, the last single digit used in counting things, people and clock hours in everyday speech
example: Der Laden öffnet erst um neun. — The shop only opens at nine.

hindi: समझदार होना — काफ़ी चतुर और होशियार, कोई बेवकूफ़ नहीं
definition: to be nobody's fool, quick-witted and quite capable of looking after oneself, said with approval (ist nicht auf den Kopf gefallen)
example: Der Junge ist nicht auf den Kopf gefallen. — That boy is nobody's fool.

hindi: ज़रा भी नहीं — बिल्कुल नहीं, रत्ती भर भी नहीं
definition: not in the least, absolutely nothing, an emphatic denial showing complete lack of interest or understanding (colloquial, literally not the bean)
example: Das interessiert mich nicht die Bohne. — That does not interest me one little bit.

hindi: क्या यह सच नहीं? — विनम्र ढंग से सहमति माँगने वाला वाक्यांश
definition: a slightly formal tag phrase meaning isn't that so, inviting the listener to confirm what was said
example: Sie kennen ihn doch, nicht wahr? — You know him, don't you?

hindi: भतीजी या भांजी — भाई या बहन की बेटी
definition: the niece, the daughter of one's brother or sister, or of a sibling-in-law, seen from the uncle or aunt (die Nichte, plural Nichten)
example: Meine Nichte feiert morgen ihren Geburtstag. — My niece celebrates her birthday tomorrow.

hindi: कुछ नहीं — किसी भी चीज़ का अभाव
definition: an indefinite pronoun meaning not anything at all, the negative partner of etwas, never changing its form and often followed by a capitalised adjective (nichts Neues)
example: Es gibt heute nichts Neues. — There is nothing new today.

hindi: धन्यवाद की ज़रूरत नहीं — आभार का विनम्र जवाब
definition: the modest reply to thanks, insisting that the small favour deserves no gratitude at all
example: Nichts zu danken, ich musste sowieso hierher. — Don't mention it, I had to come anyway.

hindi: निकल — चाँदी जैसी चमक वाली कठोर धातु जो सिक्कों और मिश्रधातुओं में लगती है
definition: a hard silvery metal used in coins and stainless steel alloys, named by German miners after a mischievous goblin (das Nickel, no plural)
example: Das Nickel im Schmuck kann Allergien auslösen. — The nickel in jewellery can trigger allergies.

hindi: सिर हिलाना — सहमति या अभिवादन में सिर झुकाना
definition: to nod, bowing the head downward once or twice to signal agreement, understanding or a silent greeting (regular: hat genickt)
example: Er nickt kurz und geht weiter. — He nods briefly and walks on.

hindi: कभी नहीं — किसी भी समय नहीं
definition: never, at no time, not on any occasion whatsoever, the absolute negative frequency word
example: Ich war noch nie in Japan. — I have never been to Japan.

hindi: हतोत्साहित — मन टूटा हुआ, उत्साह ख़त्म
definition: dejected and downhearted, discouraged and gloomy after a setback or defeat, with spirits sunk very low
example: Nach der Niederlage waren die Spieler niedergeschlagen. — After the defeat the players were dejected.

hindi: हार — मुक़ाबले में मिली पराजय
definition: a defeat or loss, the result of being beaten by the opponent in a match or contest (die Niederlage, plural Niederlagen)
example: Nach der Niederlage war die Stimmung schlecht. — After the defeat the mood was bad.

hindi: नीचा — ऊँचाई या स्तर में कम
definition: low or low-lying, not high and lying close to the ground, describing ceilings, walls, prices and temperatures, the opposite of high
example: Die Decke ist ziemlich niedrig. — The ceiling is rather low.

hindi: कभी भी नहीं — किसी हाल में नहीं, ज़ोर देकर
definition: never ever, at no time whatsoever, a stronger and more emphatic equivalent of nie
example: Das werde ich niemals vergessen. — I will never ever forget that.

hindi: कोई नहीं — एक भी इंसान नहीं
definition: an indefinite pronoun meaning not a single person, the negative partner of jemand and used only for people (Akkusativ niemanden, Dativ niemandem)
example: Niemand hat mir davon erzählt. — Nobody told me about it.

hindi: गुर्दा — पीठ के निचले हिस्से में ख़ून छानने वाला अंग
definition: the kidney, one of the pair of organs in the lower back that filter waste from the blood into urine (die Niere, plural Nieren)
example: Die linke Niere arbeitet nicht mehr richtig. — The left kidney no longer works properly.

hindi: फुहार पड़ना — महीन बूँदों की हल्की बारिश होना
definition: to drizzle, used impersonally with es when very fine light rain falls steadily (regular: es nieselt, hat genieselt)
example: Es nieselt schon den ganzen Tag. — It has been drizzling all day.

hindi: फुहार — बहुत महीन बूँदों वाली हल्की बारिश
definition: drizzle, a very light rain of tiny drops that falls steadily and quietly for hours (der Nieselregen, no plural)
example: Der Nieselregen hört heute gar nicht auf. — The drizzle simply does not stop today.

hindi: छींकना — नाक से अचानक झटके से हवा निकलना
definition: to sneeze, to expel air suddenly through the nose because of dust, pollen or a cold (regular: hat geniest)
example: Sie niest ständig wegen der Pollen. — She keeps sneezing because of the pollen.

hindi: संत निकोलस — छह दिसंबर को बच्चों के जूतों में मिठाई रखने वाले संत
definition: the figure of Saint Nicholas, the bishop who leaves sweets and nuts in children's boots on the sixth of December; colloquially also that day itself (der Nikolaus, plural Nikoläuse)
example: Der Nikolaus hat Schokolade in meinen Stiefel gesteckt. — Saint Nicholas put chocolate in my boot.

hindi: दरियाई घोड़ा — अफ़्रीका की नदियों में रहने वाला भारी जानवर
definition: a hippopotamus, the huge heavy African animal that spends the day in rivers and lakes, literally a horse of the Nile (das Nilpferd, plural Nilpferde)
example: Im Zoo haben wir ein Nilpferd beim Baden gesehen. — At the zoo we saw a hippo bathing.

hindi: कहीं नहीं — किसी भी जगह पर नहीं
definition: nowhere, in no place or location at all, the word for something that cannot be found at any spot however hard one searches
example: Ich finde meinen Schlüssel nirgends. — I cannot find my key anywhere.

hindi: कहीं भी नहीं — किसी भी स्थान पर नहीं
definition: nowhere, at no place whatsoever, a slightly fuller everyday form of the negative place word
example: Nirgendwo schmeckt der Kaffee so gut wie hier. — Nowhere does the coffee taste as good as here.

hindi: अभी भी — अब तक जारी; और भी
definition: still, yet, continuing until now, and also meaning more or another one when ordering or counting
example: Wohnst du noch in München? — Do you still live in Munich?

hindi: भिक्षुणी — मठ में रहने वाली संन्यासिनी स्त्री
definition: a nun, a woman who has taken religious vows and lives in a convent devoted to prayer and service (die Nonne, plural Nonnen)
example: Die Nonne arbeitet im Krankenhaus. — The nun works in the hospital.

hindi: उत्तर — दिक्सूचक की उत्तरी दिशा
definition: the north, the compass direction toward the upper edge of a printed map, also the northern region of a country (der Norden, no plural)
example: Hamburg liegt im Norden von Deutschland. — Hamburg lies in the north of Germany.

hindi: आपातकालीन चिकित्सक — रोगीवाहन के साथ मौके पर पहुँचने वाला डॉक्टर
definition: an emergency doctor who travels with the ambulance service to treat seriously injured or sick people on the spot (der Notarzt, plural Notärzte)
example: Der Notarzt kam zehn Minuten nach dem Unfall. — The emergency doctor arrived ten minutes after the accident.

hindi: आपातकालीन विभाग — अस्पताल का तुरंत इलाज वाला हिस्सा
definition: the emergency department or casualty ward, the part of a hospital that takes urgent cases without an appointment (die Notaufnahme, plural Notaufnahmen)
example: Wir fuhren sofort in die Notaufnahme. — We drove straight to the emergency department.

hindi: आपातकालीन निकास — आग या खतरे में इमारत से बाहर निकलने का दरवाज़ा
definition: an emergency exit, the marked door through which people leave a building quickly during fire or other danger (der Notausgang, plural Notausgänge)
example: Der Notausgang befindet sich links neben der Bühne. — The emergency exit is on the left next to the stage.

hindi: आपातकालीन रोक — रेलगाड़ी में खतरे के समय खींचा जाने वाला हत्था
definition: the emergency brake handle in a train or bus that passengers pull to stop the vehicle in an emergency (die Notbremse, plural Notbremsen)
example: Jemand zog im Zug die Notbremse. — Someone pulled the emergency brake on the train.

hindi: अंक या ग्रेड — स्कूल के काम पर एक (सर्वोत्तम) से छह (सबसे खराब) तक की श्रेणी
definition: a mark or grade awarded for schoolwork, on the German scale from one (very good) down to six (insufficient) (die Note, plural Noten)
example: Ich habe in Mathe eine gute Note bekommen. — I got a good grade in maths.

hindi: आपातकाल — अचानक आई गंभीर स्थिति जिसमें तुरंत मदद चाहिए
definition: an emergency, a sudden serious situation that needs immediate action or medical help right away (der Notfall, plural Notfälle)
example: Im Notfall rufen Sie bitte sofort die 112 an. — In an emergency, please call 112 immediately.

hindi: संकट की स्थिति — ऐसी मुश्किल हालत जिसमें इंसान को बाहरी मदद चाहिए
definition: a predicament or emergency situation of serious distress in which a person urgently needs outside help (die Notlage, plural Notlagen)
example: Die Familie war nach dem Brand in einer echten Notlage. — After the fire the family was in a real predicament.

hindi: आपात पुकार — पुलिस, दमकल या एम्बुलेंस को किया गया फ़ोन
definition: an emergency call to the police, fire brigade or ambulance, also the emergency number itself (der Notruf, plural Notrufe)
example: Der Notruf ging um Mitternacht ein. — The emergency call came in at midnight.

hindi: आपातकालीन संख्या — पुलिस, दमकल या रोगीवाहन बुलाने का छोटा फ़ोन अंक
definition: an emergency telephone number, the short number people dial to reach police, ambulance or fire brigade quickly (die Notrufnummer, plural Notrufnummern)
example: Die Notrufnummer 112 gilt in ganz Europa. — The emergency number 112 works throughout Europe.

hindi: सेवई — आटे की पकाई जाने वाली पट्टी, पास्ता का हर रूप
definition: a noodle, one strip or shape of wheat pasta, used almost always in the plural Nudeln as the everyday German word for any pasta dish (die Nudel, plural Nudeln)
example: Die Nudeln kochen schon. — The pasta is already boiling.

hindi: बेलन — आटा बेलने का लकड़ी का गोल डंडा
definition: a rolling pin, the wooden cylinder used to roll dough flat for pastry, pizza or biscuits (das Nudelholz, plural Nudelhölzer)
example: Roll den Teig mit dem Nudelholz aus. — Roll out the dough with the rolling pin.

hindi: शून्य — गिनती में कुछ भी नहीं की संख्या
definition: the cardinal number zero, used in counting, telephone numbers, temperatures and sports scores where German speakers say the digit aloud
example: Wir haben null zu zwei verloren. — We lost zero to two.

hindi: क्रमांक — पहचान के लिए दी गई क्रम संख्या
definition: a number that labels or identifies something, such as a telephone number, house number, ticket number or shoe size (die Nummer, plural Nummern)
example: Wie ist die Nummer vom Taxi? — What is the number of the taxi company?

hindi: संख्या पट्टिका — गाड़ी की पंजीकरण संख्या वाली पट्टी, बोलचाल
definition: a number plate, the identification plate with letters and digits fixed to a vehicle, the everyday word (das Nummernschild, plural Nummernschilder)
example: Das Nummernschild war völlig verdreckt. — The number plate was completely dirty.

hindi: अब, तो — इस समय, बात आगे बढ़ाते हुए
definition: now, at this present moment, slightly more formal than jetzt and often marking a next step in speech
example: Nun sind wir alle da. — Now we are all here.

hindi: केवल — सिर्फ़, बस इतना ही
definition: only, just, merely; restricting a statement to a single thing, a small amount or a limited degree
example: Ich habe nur fünf Euro dabei. — I only have five euros with me.

hindi: अस्पष्ट बोलना — शब्द निगलते हुए धीमे-धीमे बोलना
definition: to mumble, speaking unclearly with slurred and swallowed words that other people find difficult to understand (regular: nuschelt, hat genuschelt; colloquial)
example: Sprich lauter, du nuschelst schon wieder! — Speak up, you are mumbling again!

hindi: अखरोट-बादाम आदि मेवा — कठोर छिलके में बंद खाने योग्य गिरी
definition: a nut, one of the hard-shelled nuts or seeds with an edible kernel inside such as a hazelnut, walnut or almond (die Nuss, plural Nüsse)
example: Das Eichhörnchen versteckt die Nuss im Boden. — The squirrel hides the nut in the ground.

hindi: अखरोट तोड़ने वाला — लकड़ी के सैनिक की आकृति जो जबड़े से मेवा तोड़ता है
definition: a nutcracker, especially the painted wooden soldier figure from the Ore Mountains that cracks nuts in its jaw and decorates Christmas rooms (der Nussknacker, plural Nussknacker)
example: Der Nussknacker steht jedes Jahr auf dem Fensterbrett. — The nutcracker stands on the windowsill every year.

hindi: उपयोगिता — किसी चीज़ से मिलने वाला असली फ़ायदा
definition: use or benefit, the practical value and gain that something brings to a person or purpose (der Nutzen, no plural)
example: Welchen Nutzen hat diese neue App? — What benefit does this new app have?

hindi: बेकार — किसी काम का नहीं, व्यर्थ
definition: useless and pointless, serving no purpose or bringing no benefit, used of broken tools, wasted effort and futile attempts
example: Ohne Akku ist das Gerät nutzlos. — Without a battery the device is useless.

hindi: उपयोगी पशु — दूध, अंडे या मांस के लिए पाला गया जानवर
definition: a farm animal kept for milk, eggs, meat or work, a livestock creature rather than a pet (das Nutztier, plural Nutztiere)
example: Die Kuh ist ein typisches Nutztier. — The cow is a typical farm animal.

hindi: परोपकार — पड़ोसी और हर मनुष्य से प्रेम
definition: charity or love of one's neighbour, the Christian ideal of caring for every fellow human being (die Nächstenliebe, no plural)
example: Die Nächstenliebe ist ein christliches Ideal. — Love of one's neighbour is a Christian ideal.

hindi: ठोस काम करना — बातों की जगह पक्का निर्णय लेकर पूरा करना
definition: to stop discussing and do something properly and decisively, getting the thing done for real (colloquial)
example: Genug geplant, jetzt machen wir Nägel mit Köpfen. — Enough planning, now let us get down to business.

hindi: निकटता — पास होने की स्थिति, आस-पास का इलाक़ा
definition: nearness or the immediate vicinity around a place, used in the everyday phrase in der Nähe to say something is close by (die Nähe, no plural)
example: Gibt es eine Bank in der Nähe? — Is there a bank nearby?

hindi: सिलना — सुई-धागे से कपड़ा जोड़ना
definition: to sew fabric together with needle and thread, to make or mend a garment (regular)
example: Meine Mutter näht mir ein Kleid. — My mother is sewing me a dress.

hindi: क्योंकि दरअसल — वजह या स्पष्टीकरण जोड़ने वाला शब्द
definition: an adverb that adds the reason or explanation for what was just said, or specifies exactly which one is meant
example: Ich bleibe zu Hause, ich bin nämlich krank. — I'm staying home, because I'm ill.

hindi: ना — हल्के-फुल्के अंदाज़ में मना
definition: nope; a casual colloquial refusal, relaxed and slightly offhand, used among friends instead of a formal nein
example: Willst du noch was essen? Nö. — Do you want to eat something else? Nope.

hindi: होश में — बिना नशे के, खाली पेट भी
definition: sober and not under alcohol, also on an empty stomach or matter-of-fact in manner
example: Der Fahrer war zum Glück nüchtern. — Luckily the driver was sober.

hindi: उपयोगी — काम आने वाला, लाभदायक
definition: useful and helpful, serving a purpose or bringing a practical benefit, used of tools, advice and information
example: Diese App ist sehr nützlich. — This app is very useful.

hindi: कि क्या — हाँ-या-ना वाले अप्रत्यक्ष सवाल का शब्द
definition: whether, if; the conjunction introducing an indirect yes-or-no question inside a longer sentence, verb at the end
example: Weißt du, ob der Laden heute offen ist? — Do you know whether the shop is open today?

hindi: ऊपर — ऊँचाई पर, ऊपरी मंज़िल या ऊपरी हिस्से में
definition: up above or at the top, on a higher floor or upper part of something, the plain word for where something sits when it is not below
example: Das Schlafzimmer ist oben unter dem Dach. — The bedroom is upstairs under the roof.

hindi: सतह — किसी चीज़ का ऊपरी बाहरी तल
definition: the surface of an object or liquid, the outer layer you can see and touch, smooth or rough (die Oberfläche, plural Oberflächen)
example: Die Oberfläche des Tisches ist ganz glatt. — The surface of the table is completely smooth.

hindi: के ऊपर — किसी चीज़ से ऊँचे स्थान पर
definition: above, situated higher than a given point or level on a slope, wall or scale (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Das Dorf liegt oberhalb des Sees. — The village lies above the lake.

hindi: मलाई — दूध की ऊपरी गाढ़ी परत, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: cream, the rich fatty layer skimmed from milk and used in cooking and coffee, in its Austrian name where Germany says Sahne (das Obers, no plural)
example: Das Obers kommt extra zum Kaffee. — The cream comes separately with the coffee.

hindi: जाँघ — कूल्हे और घुटने के बीच टाँग का मोटा हिस्सा
definition: the thigh, the thick muscular upper section of the leg running between the hip joint and the knee (der Oberschenkel, plural Oberschenkel)
example: Der Oberschenkel brennt nach dem Radfahren. — The thigh burns after cycling.

hindi: यद्यपि — हालाँकि का थोड़ा औपचारिक रूप
definition: although, even though; a somewhat more formal or written synonym of obwohl introducing a concession
example: Obgleich es kalt war, gingen wir schwimmen. — Although it was cold, we went swimming.

hindi: फल — पेड़-पौधों से मिलने वाले मीठे खाने योग्य फल, सामूहिक शब्द
definition: fruit as a collective category, all the sweet edible fruits like apples, pears and berries taken together as food (das Obst, no plural)
example: Das Obst vom Markt ist heute sehr frisch. — The fruit from the market is very fresh today.

hindi: फलदार पेड़ — सेब, नाशपाती जैसे फल देने वाला पेड़
definition: a fruit tree, an apple, pear, cherry or plum tree grown for the fruit it bears (der Obstbaum, plural Obstbäume)
example: Im Garten steht ein alter Obstbaum. — An old fruit tree stands in the garden.

hindi: हालाँकि — विरोध या रियायत जताने वाला रोज़मर्रा का शब्द
definition: although, even though; the everyday conjunction that introduces a contrast or concession, verb at the end of the clause
example: Obwohl er müde war, arbeitete er weiter. — Although he was tired, he kept working.

hindi: है ना? — वाक्य के अंत में पुष्टि माँगने वाला शब्द
definition: besides its usual meaning or, a question tag placed at the end of a statement to ask the listener for agreement, like right or isn't that true
example: Du kommst morgen, oder? — You're coming tomorrow, right?

hindi: भट्ठी या अँगीठी — सेंकने या कमरा गरम करने का बंद उपकरण
definition: an oven or stove, any enclosed heated appliance used for baking food or for warming a room (der Ofen, plural Öfen)
example: Die Pizza kommt jetzt in den Ofen. — The pizza goes into the oven now.

hindi: खुला — बंद न किया हुआ, या साफ़-दिल
definition: open, not closed or locked, also meaning frank and honest in manner, or still undecided and unpaid
example: Das Fenster ist noch offen. — The window is still open.

hindi: स्पष्टतः — साफ़ दिखता है कि
definition: evidently, obviously, apparently; stating something that seems clearly to be the case from the evidence
example: Er hat den Termin offenbar vergessen. — He has evidently forgotten the appointment.

hindi: स्पष्ट — जो साफ़ दिखाई दे, ज़ाहिर
definition: obvious or evident, so clearly visible that nobody needs to prove it, also used adverbially meaning apparently
example: Er hat offensichtlich keine Ahnung davon. — He obviously has no idea about it.

hindi: अंतरजाल से कटा — बिना जाल संपर्क के
definition: not connected to the internet, or done without a network connection, for example reading a downloaded article on a train (also used as an adjective)
example: Im Zug bin ich meistens offline. — On the train I am mostly offline.

hindi: अक्सर — बहुत बार
definition: often, frequently, many times, the everyday word for something that happens a lot
example: Wir gehen oft ins Café. — We often go to the café.

hindi: अरे बाप रे — चिंता या अफ़सोस की आवाज़
definition: oh dear, oh no; a soft interjection of dismay or sympathy when something has gone wrong
example: Oh je, das sieht nicht gut aus. — Oh dear, that does not look good.

hindi: के बिना — किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति की अनुपस्थिति में
definition: without, lacking or not accompanied by a person, thing or quality that would normally be present (preposition, + Akkusativ; also ohne zu with infinitive)
example: Ich trinke den Kaffee ohne Zucker. — I drink the coffee without sugar.

hindi: वैसे भी — यूँ ही, बिना उसके भी
definition: anyway, in any case, as it is; a slightly more formal synonym of sowieso saying that something holds regardless
example: Das Geschäft ist ohnehin geschlossen. — The shop is closed anyway.

hindi: कान — सिर के दोनों ओर का अंग जिससे सुनते हैं
definition: the ear, the organ of hearing on either side of the head, including the outer earlobe, that picks up sounds (das Ohr, plural Ohren)
example: Das rechte Ohr ist seit dem Flug verstopft. — The right ear has been blocked since the flight.

hindi: दिमाग़ में चिपका गाना — बार-बार अपने आप बजने वाली धुन
definition: a catchy scrap of music that lodges itself in memory and replays on repeat against your wishes
example: That advert jingle became an Ohrwurm she could not shake for days.

hindi: ठीक है, चलेगा — स्वीकृति या संतोषजनक
definition: fine, acceptable or agreed, the universal borrowed word for consenting to something or rating it as satisfactory
example: Das Hotel war okay, aber nicht besonders schön. — The hotel was okay, but not especially nice.

hindi: दादी या नानी — नानी-दादी के लिए प्यार भरा घरेलू शब्द
definition: the grandma, the warm everyday family word for a grandmother, used by children and adults alike (die Oma, plural Omas)
example: Die Oma strickt einen Pullover für den Enkel. — Grandma is knitting a sweater for her grandson.

hindi: चाचा, मामा, मौसा या फूफा — माता-पिता का भाई या मौसी-बुआ का पति
definition: the uncle, the brother of one's mother or father, or the husband of an aunt, covering every Hindi uncle word (der Onkel, plural Onkel)
example: Mein Onkel wohnt in Österreich. — My uncle lives in Austria.

hindi: अंतरजाल से जुड़ा — या अंतरजाल के ज़रिए किया गया
definition: connected to the internet, or done through the internet rather than in person, as with shopping, banking or meetings (also used as an adjective)
example: Ich kaufe meine Bücher meistens online. — I mostly buy my books online.

hindi: दादा या नाना — नाना-दादा के लिए प्यार भरा घरेलू शब्द
definition: the grandpa, the warm everyday family word for a grandfather, used by children and adults alike (der Opa, plural Opas)
example: Der Opa sitzt mit der Zeitung auf dem Balkon. — Grandpa sits on the balcony with the newspaper.

hindi: संगीत नाटक — पूरी तरह गाकर मंचित नाटक, या उसका भवन
definition: an opera, a dramatic stage work in which the story is sung with orchestra, and also the opera house itself (die Oper, plural Opern)
example: Wir gehen am Samstag in die Oper. — We are going to the opera on Saturday.

hindi: पीड़ित — जिस पर अपराध या हादसा बीता हो
definition: a victim, the person harmed by a crime, an accident or a disaster, also a sacrifice (das Opfer, plural Opfer)
example: Das Opfer liegt noch im Krankenhaus. — The victim is still in hospital.

hindi: विपक्ष — संसद में सरकार से बाहर रहकर उसकी आलोचना करने वाले दल
definition: the opposition, the parties in parliament that stay outside the government and criticise its policies openly (die Opposition, plural Oppositionen)
example: Die Opposition kritisiert den neuen Haushalt scharf. — The opposition sharply criticises the new budget.

hindi: संतरा — नारंगी रंग का रसीला खट्टा-मीठा गोल फल
definition: an orange, the round citrus fruit with thick orange peel and juicy segments inside, in northern Germany also called Apfelsine (die Orange, plural Orangen)
example: Ich presse eine Orange für den Saft aus. — I squeeze an orange for the juice.

hindi: वाद्यवृंद — कई वादकों का बड़ा संगीत समूह
definition: an orchestra, a large group of musicians playing strings, wind and percussion instruments together under a conductor (das Orchester, plural Orchester)
example: Das Orchester stimmt vor dem Konzert die Instrumente. — The orchestra tunes its instruments before the concert.

hindi: सुव्यवस्थित — सलीके से रखा हुआ, साफ़-सुथरा
definition: tidy, neat and well ordered, describing a room or person that keeps everything properly in place, also colloquially meaning considerable or proper (regular adjective)
example: Ihre Küche ist immer ordentlich und sauber. — Her kitchen is always tidy and clean.

hindi: अशिष्ट — भद्दा और निम्न रुचि का, साधारण नहीं
definition: vulgar, crude or common in a coarse way, describing rude language or tasteless style, never ordinary
example: Solche Witze finde ich ordinär. — I find such jokes vulgar.

hindi: संचिका-खाना — संचिकाएँ एक जगह रखने का खाना, या काग़ज़ों की छल्लेदार नत्थी
definition: a folder, the container in which computer files are grouped and stored, and also the physical ring binder used for paper documents (der Ordner, plural Ordner)
example: Der Ordner enthält alle Fotos vom Urlaub. — The folder contains all the photos from the holiday.

hindi: व्यवस्था — हर चीज़ अपनी सही जगह पर, एक नैतिक आदर्श
definition: the settled, correct arrangement of things, treated less as simple tidiness than as a moral condition
example: His desk was a monument to Ordnung, every cable coiled the same way.

hindi: आयोजन करना — व्यवस्थित ढंग से इंतज़ाम करना
definition: to organise, arrange or set up an event, party, process or one's own daily work systematically (regular: organisiert, hat organisiert)
example: Wer organisiert dieses Jahr die Weihnachtsfeier? — Who is organising the Christmas party this year?

hindi: प्रचंड चक्रवात — सबसे तेज़ दर्जे का तूफ़ान
definition: a hurricane-force storm, the strongest category of wind that uproots trees and tears off roofs (der Orkan, plural Orkane)
example: Der Orkan hat ganze Wälder umgelegt. — The hurricane flattened whole forests.

hindi: स्थान या क़स्बा — कोई जगह या छोटी बस्ती
definition: a place or locality, either a specific spot where something happens or a small town or village where people live (der Ort, plural Orte)
example: Der Ort liegt direkt am Fluss. — The village lies right on the river.

hindi: बस्ती या क़स्बा — सड़क किनारे बोर्ड से चिह्नित छोटी आबादी
definition: a small locality or settlement, the slightly formal word for any village or small town seen as a marked built-up place, common on road signs (die Ortschaft, plural Ortschaften)
example: In der Ortschaft gilt Tempo fünfzig. — In the built-up area the speed limit is fifty.

hindi: पूर्व-स्मृति-मोह — पूर्वी जर्मनी के जीवन की मीठी याद
definition: a fond, slightly ironic nostalgia for everyday life and products of the former East Germany (die Ostalgie, no plural)
example: Die Ostalgie ist bei älteren Leuten im Osten verbreitet. — Nostalgia for East German life is common among older people in the east.

hindi: पूर्व — दिक्सूचक की पूर्वी दिशा, जहाँ सूरज उगता है
definition: the east, the compass direction where the sun rises, also the eastern region of a country (der Osten, no plural)
example: Die Sonne geht im Osten auf. — The sun rises in the east.

hindi: ईस्टर अंडा — रंगा हुआ या चॉकलेट का अंडा जो छिपाया और ढूँढा जाता है
definition: an Easter egg, a hard-boiled chicken egg dyed in bright colours or a chocolate egg hidden and searched for on Easter Sunday (das Osterei, plural Ostereier)
example: Ich habe ein rotes Osterei gefunden. — I have found a red Easter egg.

hindi: ईस्टर खरगोश — बच्चों के लिए बगीचे में अंडे छिपाने वाला काल्पनिक खरगोश
definition: the Easter bunny, the imaginary rabbit that hides painted and chocolate eggs in the garden for children to find (der Osterhase, plural Osterhasen)
example: Der Osterhase hat die Eier im Garten versteckt. — The Easter bunny has hidden the eggs in the garden.

hindi: ईस्टर — वसंत का ईसाई त्योहार, अंडे और खरगोश की परंपरा
definition: Easter, the spring festival celebrated with painted eggs and a long holiday weekend (das Ostern, plural Ostern, usually used without an article)
example: An Ostern suchen die Kinder Eier im Garten. — At Easter the children hunt for eggs in the garden.

hindi: अंडाकार — अंडे जैसा लंबा गोल आकार
definition: oval, shaped like an egg, a stretched circle that is longer than it is wide, describing faces, mirrors and tables
example: Sie hat ein ovales Gesicht. — She has an oval face.

hindi: महासागर — महाद्वीपों के बीच फैला विशाल समुद्र
definition: an ocean, one of the immense bodies of salt water lying between the continents (der Ozean, plural Ozeane)
example: Der Ozean trennt Europa und Amerika. — The ocean separates Europe and America.

hindi: जोड़ा — साथ रहने वाले दो लोग
definition: a couple, two people who are together in a relationship, and also a pair of matching things, such as shoes or socks (das Paar, plural Paare)
example: Das Paar tanzte den ganzen Abend. — The couple danced all evening.

hindi: सामान बाँधना — यात्रा के लिए सूटकेस में चीज़ें भरना
definition: to pack, to fold clothes and gather belongings into a suitcase or travel bag before a journey (regular)
example: Ich packe heute Abend den Koffer für morgen. — I am packing the suitcase for tomorrow this evening.

hindi: डिब्बा — किसी चीज़ का बंद पुलिंदा या पुड़िया
definition: a pack or packet, the sealed box or bundle in which goods such as biscuits or tablets are sold (die Packung, plural Packungen)
example: Eine Packung Nudeln, bitte. — One packet of pasta, please.

hindi: पार्सल — डाक से भेजा जाने वाला बड़ा बँधा हुआ डिब्बा
definition: a parcel or package, a larger wrapped box sent through the post or delivered by a courier service (das Paket, plural Pakete)
example: Das Paket ist gestern beim Nachbarn abgegeben worden. — The parcel was left with the neighbour yesterday.

hindi: पतला मीठा पैनकेक — जैम या पनीर भरकर लपेटा जाता है
definition: a thin rolled pancake filled with apricot jam or sweet quark, a classic Austrian dessert related to the French crêpe (die Palatschinke, plural Palatschinken)
example: Die Palatschinke ist mit Marillenmarmelade gefüllt. — The pancake is filled with apricot jam.

hindi: घबराहट — अचानक हावी होने वाला डर जिससे सूझ-बूझ खो जाए
definition: panic, the sudden overwhelming fear that makes people lose their heads and act blindly (die Panik, plural Paniken)
example: Als das Licht ausging, brach eine Panik aus. — When the light went out, a panic broke out.

hindi: गाड़ी का ख़राब होना — रास्ते में वाहन का अचानक बंद पड़ जाना
definition: a breakdown, a sudden technical failure such as a flat tyre or dead engine that stops a vehicle on the road (die Panne, plural Pannen)
example: Wir hatten eine Panne mitten auf der Landstraße. — We had a breakdown in the middle of the country road.

hindi: चप्पल का हीरो — बाहर बहादुर पर घर में पत्नी के आगे दबा रहने वाला पति
definition: a henpecked husband who is meek and submissive to his wife at home, literally a hero in slippers, colloquial and mocking (der Pantoffelheld, plural Pantoffelhelden)
example: Er traut sich nichts ohne seine Frau, ein echter Pantoffelheld. — He dares nothing without his wife, a real henpecked husband.

hindi: बख़्तरबंद युद्ध-वाहन — कवच और तोप वाली सैनिक गाड़ी; कछुए का कवच भी
definition: an armoured military vehicle with tracks and a cannon, also the protective shell of a tortoise or beetle (der Panzer, plural Panzer)
example: Die Schildkröte zieht den Kopf in ihren Panzer. — The tortoise pulls its head into its shell.

hindi: काग़ज़ — लिखने-छापने की पतली चादर
definition: paper, the thin flat material made from wood pulp that you write, print and wrap things in, plural also meaning documents (das Papier, plural Papiere)
example: Hast du ein Blatt Papier für mich? — Do you have a sheet of paper for me?

hindi: कागज़ी जंग — फ़ाइलों और फ़ॉर्मों की न खत्म होने वाली लड़ाई
definition: a grinding campaign of forms, stamps and correspondence waged against you by an administration
example: Registering the car turned into a three-month Papierkrieg.

hindi: शिमला मिर्च — लाल, पीली या हरी मोटी मीठी मिर्च; लाल मसाला भी
definition: a bell pepper, the hollow sweet red, yellow or green pepper eaten raw or stuffed, and also the red powdered spice (die Paprika, plural Paprikas)
example: Die rote Paprika ist süßer als die grüne. — The red pepper is sweeter than the green one.

hindi: टमाटर — लाल रसीली सब्ज़ी, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: a tomato, the juicy red vegetable, in its everyday Austrian name where Germany says Tomate (der Paradeiser, plural Paradeiser)
example: Der Paradeiser aus dem Garten schmeckt süßer als der gekaufte. — The garden tomato tastes sweeter than the bought one.

hindi: गाड़ी खड़ी करना — वाहन को किसी जगह रोककर छोड़ना
definition: to park a vehicle, to leave a car standing in a marked space while the driver is away (regular: hat geparkt)
example: Ich parke immer hinter dem Haus. — I always park behind the house.

hindi: बहुमंज़िला वाहन-स्थल — कई तलों वाली गाड़ियाँ खड़ी करने की इमारत
definition: a multi-storey car park, a building with several floors designed solely for parking vehicles (das Parkhaus, plural Parkhäuser)
example: Das Parkhaus am Bahnhof ist rund um die Uhr offen. — The car park at the station is open around the clock.

hindi: गाड़ी खड़ी करना — वाहन को निर्धारित जगह पर रोकना, स्विस शब्द
definition: to park a vehicle in a space or by the road, the Swiss form of the verb where Germany says parken (regular: parkiert, hat parkiert)
example: Hier darf man nur eine Stunde parkieren. — You may only park here for one hour.

hindi: गाड़ी खड़ी करने की जगह — वाहन रखने का चिह्नित स्थान
definition: a parking space or car park, a marked place or open area where vehicles may be left standing (der Parkplatz, plural Parkplätze)
example: Ich habe endlich einen Parkplatz gefunden. — I finally found a parking space.

hindi: संसद — चुने हुए प्रतिनिधियों की सभा जो क़ानून बनाती है
definition: the parliament, the assembly of elected representatives who debate public questions and pass the laws of a country (das Parlament, plural Parlamente)
example: Das Parlament tagt in dieser Woche jeden Tag. — The parliament is in session every day this week.

hindi: राजनीतिक दल — चुनाव के ज़रिए सत्ता चाहने वाला संगठित समूह
definition: a political party, an organised group of people with shared goals that seeks power through elections (die Partei, plural Parteien)
example: Welche Partei hast du gewählt? — Which party did you vote for?

hindi: साथी — जीवन साथी या व्यापार साझेदार
definition: a partner, the person you share your life and household with, or someone you work together with in business (der Partner, plural Partner)
example: Mein Partner und ich suchen eine Wohnung. — My partner and I are looking for a flat.

hindi: साथिन — जीवन या प्रेम की महिला साथी
definition: a female romantic partner in a relationship, also a woman who is a business or dance partner (die Partnerin, plural Partnerinnen)
example: Seine Partnerin arbeitet als Ärztin in Berlin. — His partner works as a doctor in Berlin.

hindi: साझेदारी — बराबरी पर टिका प्रेम या जीवन-संबंध
definition: a committed romantic relationship between two partners built on equal footing, often used for unmarried couples living together (die Partnerschaft, plural Partnerschaften)
example: Eine gute Partnerschaft braucht Vertrauen und Geduld. — A good partnership needs trust and patience.

hindi: जश्न, दावत — दोस्तों का मौज-मस्ती वाला जमावड़ा
definition: a party, a festive gathering with music, drinks and friends, the borrowed English word used for private celebrations (die Party, plural Partys)
example: Kommst du am Samstag zu meiner Party? — Are you coming to my party on Saturday?

hindi: यात्री — विमान या जहाज़ में सफ़र करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a passenger travelling on a plane, ship or train, the person carried who is not part of the crew (der Passagier, plural Passagiere)
example: Der Passagier wartet auf sein Gepäck. — The passenger is waiting for his luggage.

hindi: ठीक आना — कपड़े का नाप में सही बैठना
definition: to fit properly, said of clothes and shoes that are the right size for the wearer (regular, + Dativ)
example: Die Schuhe passen mir perfekt. — The shoes fit me perfectly.
