hindi: घटित होना — कोई घटना हो जाना
definition: to happen or occur, said of events and accidents that take place, the everyday spoken word (regular but with sein: passiert, ist passiert)
example: Was ist gestern passiert? — What happened yesterday?

hindi: चलेगा, ठीक है — छोटी बात को जाने देना
definition: it is fine, never mind; a relaxed colloquial phrase saying something is acceptable or not worth fussing over
example: Du hast dich verspätet? Passt schon. — You were late? It is fine.

hindi: कूटशब्द — खाते में घुसने के लिए गुप्त शब्द
definition: a password, the secret string of letters and numbers typed to unlock an account, phone or computer (das Passwort, plural Passwörter)
example: Ich habe das Passwort schon wieder vergessen. — I have forgotten the password yet again.

hindi: प्रोटेस्टेंट पादरी — उत्तर जर्मनी में गिरजाघर का प्रमुख
definition: a pastor, a Protestant clergyman leading a congregation, the usual word in northern Germany for the local church minister (der Pastor, plural Pastoren)
example: Unser Pastor spricht sehr verständlich. — Our pastor speaks very clearly.

hindi: मरीज़ — इलाज कराने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a patient, the sick person receiving examination, care or treatment from a doctor, nurse or hospital (der Patient, plural Patienten)
example: Der Patient wartet schon eine Stunde. — The patient has already been waiting an hour.

hindi: भद्दी चूक — लापरवाही से हुई मूर्खतापूर्ण गलती
definition: a careless blunder or silly mistake made through inattention, which chess players in English apply to a weak amateur (der Patzer, plural Patzer)
example: Dem Torwart passierte ein peinlicher Patzer. — The goalkeeper made an embarrassing blunder.

hindi: रटना — परीक्षा से पहले ज़ोर-शोर से पढ़ना
definition: to cram or swot, to study hard and mechanically before an examination, colloquial (regular)
example: Vor dem Abitur haben wir wochenlang gepaukt. — Before the Abitur we crammed for weeks.

hindi: एकमुश्त यात्रा — उड़ान, ठहराव और भोजन एक ही दाम में बँधी यात्रा
definition: a package holiday where flight, accommodation and often meals are booked together at one fixed price (die Pauschalreise, plural Pauschalreisen)
example: Eine Pauschalreise ist oft billiger als alles einzeln zu buchen. — A package holiday is often cheaper than booking everything separately.

hindi: अवकाश — पाठों के बीच का छोटा विराम जब छात्र बाहर जाते हैं
definition: a break between lessons when pupils leave the classroom to eat, play or chat in the schoolyard (die Pause, plural Pausen)
example: In der Pause spielen die Kinder auf dem Hof. — During the break the children play in the yard.

hindi: अंतराल का नाश्ता — स्कूल की छुट्टी में खाने के लिए साथ लिया गया सैंडविच
definition: a packed snack sandwich that a child takes to school to eat during the morning break (das Pausenbrot, plural Pausenbrote)
example: Mama packt mir jeden Tag ein Pausenbrot ein. — Mum packs me a break-time sandwich every day.

hindi: अभागा व्यक्ति — जिसके साथ बार-बार बुरा हो
definition: a person who keeps having bad luck, an unlucky soul to whom mishaps constantly happen (der Pechvogel, plural Pechvögel)
example: Er ist ein echter Pechvogel: schon wieder ein platter Reifen. — He is a real unlucky fellow: another flat tyre already.

hindi: शर्मनाक — लज्जाजनक, झेंप दिलाने वाला
definition: embarrassing, awkward, mortifying; describes a situation that makes someone feel ashamed or uncomfortable
example: Es war mir peinlich, seinen Namen vergessen zu haben. — I was embarrassed to have forgotten his name.

hindi: आना-जाना — रोज़ घर और दूसरे शहर के काम के बीच सफ़र करना
definition: to commute, travelling regularly between home and a workplace in another town (regular: pendelt, ist gependelt)
example: Sie pendelt jeden Tag eine Stunde zur Arbeit. — She commutes an hour to work every day.

hindi: सोना — बोलचाल में नींद लेना
definition: to sleep or kip, the relaxed colloquial word for sleeping, also to nod off when one should be paying attention (regular)
example: Ich habe bis mittags gepennt. — I slept until noon.

hindi: छोटा होटल — परिवार द्वारा चलाया गया सादा ठिकाना, प्रायः नाश्ते सहित
definition: a small family-run guesthouse offering simple rooms, usually with breakfast, cheaper than a full hotel (die Pension, plural Pensionen)
example: Wir haben in einer kleinen Pension im Dorf übernachtet. — We stayed overnight in a small guesthouse in the village.

hindi: उत्तम — बिल्कुल सही, त्रुटिहीन
definition: perfect, flawless and exactly right, used of plans, timing and results, also as an enthusiastic reply meaning great
example: Das Timing war perfekt. — The timing was perfect.

hindi: भैंस के आगे बीन बजाना — बेकद्र लोगों को अच्छी चीज़ देना
definition: to offer something valuable to people who cannot appreciate it, casting pearls before swine
example: Diesen Wein für die Gäste öffnen? Das wäre Perlen vor die Säue werfen. — Open this wine for those guests? That would be pearls before swine.

hindi: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म — स्टेशन पर ट्रेन में चढ़ने की ऊँची जगह, स्विस शब्द
definition: a railway platform where passengers wait and board the train, the Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Bahnsteig (der Perron, plural Perrons)
example: Der Zug fährt heute vom Perron drei ab. — The train leaves from platform three today.

hindi: व्यक्ति — एक अकेला इंसान, गिनती में
definition: a person, a single individual human being, especially when counting or naming someone officially (die Person, plural Personen)
example: Ein Tisch für vier Personen, bitte. — A table for four people, please.

hindi: कार्मिक विभाग — भर्ती, अनुबंध और कर्मचारियों के मामले देखने वाला विभाग
definition: the human resources department, the section of a company that handles hiring, contracts and staff matters (die Personalabteilung, plural Personalabteilungen)
example: Die Personalabteilung meldet sich nächste Woche bei Ihnen. — Human resources will contact you next week.

hindi: व्यक्तित्व — किसी व्यक्ति की समग्र पहचान और स्वभाव; या कोई नामी व्यक्ति
definition: the whole personality of a person, the distinctive way they think and behave, also a notable public figure (die Persönlichkeit, plural Persönlichkeiten)
example: Sie hat eine warme, offene Persönlichkeit. — She has a warm, open personality.

hindi: पगडंडी — जंगल या पहाड़ में पैदल चलने की संकरी राह
definition: a path or trail, a narrow track through woods or hills worn by people walking (der Pfad, plural Pfade)
example: Der Pfad führt steil zum Gipfel hinauf. — The trail leads steeply up to the summit.

hindi: जमानत राशि — बोतल या गिलास लौटाने पर वापस मिलने वाली छोटी रक़म
definition: a deposit, the small refundable sum paid on bottles, cans and glasses that you get back when returning them (das Pfand, plural Pfänder)
example: Das Pfand bekommst du im Supermarkt zurück. — You get the deposit back at the supermarket.

hindi: जमानत वाली बोतल — लौटाने पर पैसे वापस मिलते हैं
definition: a returnable bottle carrying a deposit that the customer gets back at the reverse vending machine (die Pfandflasche, plural Pfandflaschen)
example: Die Pfandflaschen stehen neben der Tür. — The deposit bottles are by the door.

hindi: तवा या कड़ाही — चौड़ा उथला पात्र जिसमें तलते-भूनते हैं
definition: a frying pan or skillet, the wide shallow cooking vessel used to fry eggs, meat or vegetables (die Pfanne, plural Pfannen)
example: In der Pfanne brutzeln zwei Spiegeleier. — Two fried eggs are sizzling in the pan.

hindi: पलटा — चपटा औज़ार जिससे तवे पर खाना पलटते हैं
definition: a spatula or turner, the flat kitchen tool used to flip pancakes, eggs or meat in the frying pan (der Pfannenwender, plural Pfannenwender)
example: Dreh den Pfannkuchen mit dem Pfannenwender um. — Flip the pancake with the spatula.

hindi: पैनकेक — तवे पर सिकी पतली मीठी रोटी; बर्लिन में जैम भरा डोनट
definition: a thin flat pancake fried in a pan and rolled with jam or sugar, though in Berlin the same word means a jam-filled doughnut (der Pfannkuchen, plural Pfannkuchen)
example: Der Pfannkuchen mit Apfelmus schmeckt den Kindern. — The children love the pancake with apple sauce.

hindi: पादरी — किसी स्थानीय गिरजाघर का प्रमुख पुरोहित
definition: a pastor or parish priest, the clergyman who leads a local church congregation, holds services and cares for its members (der Pfarrer, plural Pfarrer)
example: Der Pfarrer besucht die Kranken im Dorf. — The pastor visits the sick in the village.

hindi: घोड़ा — सवारी और गाड़ी खींचने वाला बड़ा जानवर
definition: a horse, the large strong animal that people ride and that once pulled carts on every farm (das Pferd, plural Pferde)
example: Sie reitet jeden Samstag auf ihrem Pferd. — She rides her horse every Saturday.

hindi: आत्मा-अवतरण पर्व — ईस्टर के पचास दिन बाद का लंबा सप्ताहांत
definition: the long holiday weekend of Whitsun or Pentecost seven weeks after Easter, when many families travel or camp (das Pfingsten, plural Pfingsten)
example: An Pfingsten fahren wir zum Campen. — At Whitsun we go camping.

hindi: आड़ू — रोएँदार छिलके वाला रसीला गुठलीदार गर्मियों का फल
definition: a peach, the round summer fruit with fuzzy soft skin, juicy yellow flesh and a large stone (der Pfirsich, plural Pfirsiche)
example: Der Pfirsich ist so saftig, dass er tropft. — The peach is so juicy that it drips.

hindi: पौधा — ज़मीन में उगने वाला कोई भी वनस्पति जीव
definition: a plant, any living thing that grows in soil with roots, stems and leaves, from a weed to a tree (die Pflanze, plural Pflanzen)
example: Diese Pflanze braucht viel Sonne. — This plant needs a lot of sunshine.

hindi: रोपना — पौधा या पेड़ मिट्टी में लगाना
definition: to plant, to put a young plant, bulb or tree into the soil so that it grows there (regular: pflanzt, hat gepflanzt)
example: Wir pflanzen heute einen Apfelbaum im Garten. — Today we plant an apple tree in the garden.

hindi: चिपकाने वाली छोटी पट्टी — छोटे घाव पर लगाई जाने वाली चिपचिपी पट्टी
definition: a plaster or adhesive bandage, the small sticky strip put over a minor wound or scratch; also paving on a street (das Pflaster, plural Pflaster)
example: Hast du ein Pflaster für meinen Finger? — Do you have a plaster for my finger?

hindi: आलूबुखारा — नीले-बैंगनी छिलके वाला गुठलीदार मीठा फल
definition: a plum, the oval purple or blue fruit with soft sweet flesh around a single stone, often baked on cakes (die Pflaume, plural Pflaumen)
example: Die Pflaume ist innen gelb und süß. — The plum is yellow and sweet inside.

hindi: देखभाल — बीमार या बुज़ुर्ग की सेवा और तीमारदारी
definition: the daily care and nursing given to someone elderly, sick or unable to look after themselves (die Pflege, no plural)
example: Die Pflege ihrer Mutter kostet viel Zeit. — Caring for her mother takes a lot of time.

hindi: देखभाल गृह — बीमार या बहुत बूढ़े लोगों की नर्सिंग सुविधा
definition: a nursing home where elderly or sick people who need constant care are looked after (das Pflegeheim, plural Pflegeheime)
example: Das Pflegeheim liegt direkt neben dem Krankenhaus. — The nursing home is right next to the hospital.

hindi: देखभाल कर्मी — बुज़ुर्गों या बीमारों की सेवा करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: a professional carer or nurse who looks after elderly or sick people in a home (die Pflegekraft, plural Pflegekräfte)
example: Die Pflegekraft kommt jeden Morgen um acht. — The carer comes every morning at eight.

hindi: देखभाल करना — बीमार या बुज़ुर्ग की सेवा करना
definition: to look after and nurse a sick or elderly person, also to maintain something carefully (regular)
example: Sie pflegt ihren kranken Vater zu Hause. — She cares for her sick father at home.

hindi: कर्तव्य — क़ानून या नैतिकता से निभाना ज़रूरी दायित्व
definition: a duty or obligation that a person must fulfil because the legal system or morality demands it (die Pflicht, plural Pflichten)
example: Es ist deine Pflicht, den Vertrag zu lesen. — It is your duty to read the contract.

hindi: कर्तव्यपरायण — अपने दायित्व को गंभीरता से निभाने वाला
definition: dutiful and responsible, aware of one's obligations and conscientious about fulfilling them properly
example: Der Beamte war stets pflichtbewusst. — The civil servant was always dutiful.

hindi: तोड़ना — पेड़ या पौधे से फल या फूल हाथ से तोड़ लेना
definition: to pick or pluck, to take fruit, berries or flowers from the tree or plant by hand (regular: hat gepflückt)
example: Wir pflücken Äpfel im Garten der Nachbarn. — We pick apples in the neighbours' garden.

hindi: हल चलाना — बोने से पहले खेत जोतना
definition: to plough, to turn over the soil of a field with a plough before sowing seed (regular: pflügt, hat gepflügt)
example: Früher hat man mit Pferden gepflügt. — In the past people ploughed with horses.

hindi: आधा किलो — बाज़ार में चलने वाली भार की इकाई
definition: a pound, the traditional unit of weight equal to half a kilogram still used at markets and butchers for produce and meat (das Pfund, plural Pfund)
example: Ein Pfund Hackfleisch, bitte. — A pound of minced meat, please.

hindi: विमान चालक — हवाई जहाज़ उड़ाने वाला
definition: a pilot, the trained person who flies and steers an aircraft from the cockpit (der Pilot, plural Piloten)
example: Der Pilot begrüßt die Passagiere an Bord. — The pilot welcomes the passengers on board.

hindi: कुकुरमुत्ता, खुंभी — जंगल में उगने वाला छतरी जैसा खाद्य कवक
definition: a mushroom, the umbrella-shaped fungus that grows in forests and fields, some kinds gathered and cooked as food (der Pilz, plural Pilze)
example: Der Pilz wächst unter dem Baum. — The mushroom grows under the tree.

hindi: कूची — रंग लगाने के लिए बालों वाली छोटी झाड़ू
definition: a paintbrush, the tool with bristles on a handle that a painter uses to apply paint to a surface (der Pinsel, plural Pinsel)
example: Bitte wasch den Pinsel nach dem Malen aus. — Please wash the brush out after painting.

hindi: योजना — आगे क्या और कैसे करना है उसका ख़ाका
definition: a plan, the worked-out scheme of what to do and how to do it, also a map or drawing of a building or town (der Plan, plural Pläne)
example: Hast du schon einen Plan für das Wochenende? — Do you already have a plan for the weekend?

hindi: योजना बनाना — पहले से सोचकर तय करना
definition: to plan, arrange or design something carefully in advance before actually doing it (regular: plant, hat geplant)
example: Wir planen für nächstes Jahr ein neues Projekt. — We are planning a new project for next year.

hindi: बकबक करने वाला मुँह — बिना सोचे लगातार बोलने वाला बातूनी व्यक्ति
definition: a chatterbox who talks constantly and thoughtlessly and often blurts out secrets, literally a babbling mouth, colloquial and teasing (das Plappermaul, plural Plappermäuler)
example: Erzähl es nicht dem Plappermaul, sonst weiß es morgen jeder. — Do not tell the blabbermouth, or everyone will know tomorrow.

hindi: बड़बड़ करना — बिना सोचे लगातार बोलते रहना
definition: to babble or prattle on without pause or much thought, used of small children and chatterboxes (regular: plappert, hat geplappert; colloquial)
example: Die Kleine plappert den ganzen Tag. — The little one babbles all day long.

hindi: पन्नी का पदार्थ — बोलचाल में कृत्रिम पदार्थ, थैलियों और कचरे के संदर्भ में
definition: plastic, the everyday colloquial word for synthetic material, especially when talking about bags, waste and pollution (das Plastik, no plural)
example: Wir wollen weniger Plastik verwenden. — We want to use less plastic.

hindi: पन्नी — दुकान से मिलने वाली पतली कृत्रिम थैली
definition: a plastic bag, the thin carrier bag from a shop that many stores now charge for or no longer offer (die Plastiktüte, plural Plastiktüten)
example: Ich brauche keine Plastiktüte, danke. — I do not need a plastic bag, thanks.

hindi: चौक — शहर में खुला सार्वजनिक मैदान; जगह
definition: a public square or open space in a town where streets meet and people gather, also room or space in general (der Platz, plural Plätze)
example: Auf dem Platz vor der Kirche ist heute Markt. — There is a market today in the square in front of the church.

hindi: मूसलाधार बौछार — अचानक टूट पड़ने वाली भारी बारिश
definition: a sudden heavy downpour of rain that bursts out of the sky and drenches everything within minutes (der Platzregen, plural Platzregen)
example: Der Platzregen kam ohne jede Warnung. — The downpour came without any warning.

hindi: गपशप करना — हल्की-फुल्की आरामदेह बातें करना
definition: to chat pleasantly and casually about light everyday matters without any serious purpose (regular: plaudert, hat geplaudert; mit + Dativ)
example: Die Nachbarn plaudern gern am Gartenzaun. — The neighbours like to chat at the garden fence.

hindi: कंगाल या दिवालिया — बोलचाल में पैसे बिल्कुल ख़त्म हो जाना
definition: broke or bankrupt, the colloquial word for having no money left or for a business that has failed financially (colloquial, used after sein: pleite sein)
example: Nach dem Urlaub bin ich total pleite. — After the holiday I am completely broke.

hindi: चतुर — उत्तरी जर्मनी में समझदार, होशियार और तेज़ दिमाग वाला
definition: clever, bright and quick-witted in the northern German and Low German sense, said approvingly of a smart child or a sharp idea
example: Das Mädchen ist ganz schön plietsch. — The girl is really quite clever.

hindi: कबाड़ — बेकार, पुराना सामान
definition: junk or worthless rubbish, old useless belongings piled up without purpose, colloquial and dismissive (der Plunder, no plural)
example: Wirf den ganzen Plunder endlich weg! — Finally throw all that junk away!

hindi: छोटे घर के बिस्कुट — खासकर क्रिसमस पर बनाए जाने वाले
definition: a small home-baked biscuit or cookie, especially the decorated ones families bake together in the weeks before Christmas (das Plätzchen, plural Plätzchen)
example: Die Plätzchen duften nach Zimt und Butter. — The biscuits smell of cinnamon and butter.

hindi: अचानक — बिना चेतावनी, एकाएक होने वाला
definition: sudden and unexpected, happening quickly and without any warning, both an adjective and an adverb
example: Plötzlich fing es an zu regnen. — Suddenly it started to rain.

hindi: विजय-कप — विजेता को मिलने वाला कप और कप प्रतियोगिता
definition: a trophy or cup, the prize given to the winner of a competition, and also the knockout competition itself (der Pokal, plural Pokale)
example: Der Kapitän hob den Pokal in die Höhe. — The captain lifted the cup into the air.

hindi: राजनीति — शासन करने की गतिविधि और राज्य की नीतियाँ
definition: politics, the activity of governing a country, and also the policy or strategy that a government pursues (die Politik, no plural)
example: Die Politik interessiert mich nicht besonders. — Politics does not interest me much.

hindi: राजनेता — पेशेवर रूप से राजनीति में सक्रिय व्यक्ति
definition: a politician, a person who is professionally active in politics and holds or seeks office (der Politiker, plural Politiker)
example: Der Politiker besucht heute unsere Schule. — The politician visits our school today.

hindi: राजनीतिक — राजनीति, सरकार या सार्वजनिक मामलों से जुड़ा
definition: political, relating to politics, government, parties or public affairs of a state
example: Das ist eine politische Entscheidung, keine rechtliche. — That is a political decision, not a legal one.

hindi: आरक्षी बल — क़ानून लागू करने और व्यवस्था बनाए रखने वाला राज्य बल
definition: the police, the state force that keeps public order and enforces the legal system (die Polizei, no plural)
example: Die Polizei hat die Straße gesperrt. — The police have closed the street.

hindi: पुलिसकर्मी — क़ानून-व्यवस्था बनाए रखने वाला सिपाही
definition: a police officer, the uniformed official who keeps public order, enforces laws, directs traffic and investigates crimes (der Polizist, plural Polizisten)
example: Der Polizist regelt den Verkehr an der Kreuzung. — The police officer directs traffic at the crossing.

hindi: शादी-पूर्व उत्सव — बर्तन तोड़कर सौभाग्य लाने की रात
definition: a traditional party on the evening before a wedding where guests smash crockery for good luck and the couple sweeps up together (der Polterabend, plural Polterabende)
example: Beim Polterabend zerbrachen die Gäste viele Teller. — At the pre-wedding party the guests smashed many plates.

hindi: उत्पाती प्रेत — शोर और तोड़फोड़ करने वाली आत्मा
definition: a noisy household spirit blamed for slamming doors, thrown crockery, and furniture that moves itself
example: The family insisted a Poltergeist emptied the cupboards; the plumber blamed the pipes.

hindi: तले आलू के लच्छे — तेल में तले आलू के लम्बे टुकड़े
definition: french fries, the deep-fried potato sticks sold at every snack stand with mayonnaise or ketchup, the colloquial short form of Pommes frites (die Pommes, plural only)
example: Die Pommes sind heute zu salzig. — The fries are too salty today.

hindi: बटुआ — सिक्के और काग़ज़ी पैसे रखने की थैली
definition: a purse or wallet for coins, notes and cards, a French loanword widely used in northern and western Germany (das Portemonnaie, plural Portemonnaies)
example: Ich habe mein Portemonnaie im Auto vergessen. — I left my purse in the car.

hindi: हिस्सा — एक व्यक्ति को परोसी जाने वाली खाने की मात्रा
definition: a portion or serving, the amount of food given to one person on a plate, often larger in German restaurants than expected (die Portion, plural Portionen)
example: Die Portion ist riesig, das schaffe ich nicht allein. — The portion is huge, I cannot manage it alone.

hindi: व्यक्तिचित्र — किसी व्यक्ति के चेहरे का चित्र या फ़ोटो
definition: a portrait, a painting, drawing or photograph that shows the face and often the shoulders of a particular person (das Porträt, plural Porträts)
example: Das Porträt zeigt die Königin als junge Frau. — The portrait shows the queen as a young woman.

hindi: डाक — चिट्ठी-पार्सल की सेवा, या आई हुई डाक
definition: the postal service and the post office, also the mail itself, all the letters and parcels that arrive at your door (die Post, no plural)
example: Ist heute schon Post gekommen? — Has any mail come today yet?

hindi: डाकिया — डाक और पार्सल बाँटने वाला, रोज़मर्रा का शब्द
definition: a postman or mail carrier who delivers letters and parcels to homes, the common everyday word (der Postbote, plural Postboten)
example: Der Postbote hat ein Paket für dich abgegeben. — The postman dropped off a parcel for you.

hindi: साझा करना — सोशल मीडिया पर तस्वीर या संदेश डालना
definition: to publish a message, photo or video on social media or an online forum, the borrowed English verb for sharing (regular: hat gepostet)
example: Sie postet jeden Tag Fotos vom Essen. — She posts photos of food every day.

hindi: डाक-कूट — पते में शहर या इलाक़े का अंक-संकेत
definition: the postal code, the five-digit number written before the town name in a German address that identifies the delivery area (die Postleitzahl, plural Postleitzahlen)
example: Welche Postleitzahl hat Ihre neue Wohnung? — What postcode does your new flat have?

hindi: मुर्ग़ी का मांस — पकाने के लिए मुर्ग़ा, स्विस शब्द
definition: a chicken for cooking or its meat on the menu, the Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Hähnchen (das Poulet, plural Poulets)
example: Das Poulet ist im Ofen und bald fertig. — The chicken is in the oven and almost ready.

hindi: प्रशिक्षण — पढ़ाई के दौरान कंपनी में काम का अनुभव
definition: an internship, the period of practical work experience in a company that students complete during their studies (das Praktikum, plural Praktika)
example: Im Sommer mache ich ein Praktikum bei einer Bank. — In summer I am doing an internship at a bank.

hindi: व्यावहारिक — सुविधाजनक, काम का
definition: practical, handy and convenient to use, used of bags, gadgets and solutions, also an adverb meaning virtually or almost
example: Die Tasche ist praktisch und hat viele Fächer. — The bag is practical and has many pockets.

hindi: भरवाँ कोको-मिठाई — भीतर मलाई या मेवे वाली छोटी कीमती मिठाई
definition: a filled chocolate or truffle, the small luxurious chocolate with a soft nut or cream centre sold in gift boxes (die Praline, plural Pralinen)
example: Die Praline ist mit Nougat gefüllt. — The chocolate is filled with nougat.

hindi: चिकित्सक का निजी दवाख़ाना — अस्पताल से बाहर रोगी देखने की जगह
definition: a doctor's surgery or medical practice, the private office where a physician sees patients outside a hospital (die Praxis, plural Praxen)
example: Die Praxis ist am Mittwochnachmittag geschlossen. — The practice is closed on Wednesday afternoon.

hindi: उपदेश देना — धर्म-सभा में शिक्षा देना; बार-बार समझाना
definition: to preach, to give a sermon in a religious service, or colloquially to urge something on someone insistently and repeatedly (regular)
example: Der Pfarrer predigt über die Nächstenliebe. — The pastor preaches about charity.

hindi: धर्मोपदेश — पुरोहित का सभा में दिया भाषण
definition: a sermon, the religious speech given by a pastor or priest during a church service, also a colloquial scolding lecture (die Predigt, plural Predigten)
example: Die Predigt war heute ziemlich lang. — The sermon was rather long today.

hindi: दाम — किसी चीज़ की कीमत; पुरस्कार भी
definition: the price of something, the amount of money asked for goods or a service, also a prize in a competition (der Preis, plural Preise)
example: Der Preis für Butter ist wieder gestiegen. — The price of butter has gone up again.

hindi: वाजिब दाम का — कीमत के हिसाब से अच्छा
definition: good value for money, reasonably priced for the quality offered, the polite word a shop uses instead of cheap (preiswert, preiswerter)
example: Das Restaurant ist gut und preiswert. — The restaurant is good and reasonably priced.

hindi: प्रथम प्रदर्शन — किसी फ़िल्म या नाटक का पहला सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन
definition: a premiere, the first public performance or screening of a play, opera or film, often a festive event (die Premiere, plural Premieren)
example: Zur Premiere kamen viele bekannte Gäste. — Many well-known guests came to the premiere.

hindi: पत्रकार जगत — अख़बार और पत्रकार मिलकर; दबाने की मशीन भी
definition: the press, the newspapers and journalists taken together as a group, and also a machine that presses things (die Presse, plural Pressen for the machine)
example: Die Presse wartete vor dem Gericht. — The press was waiting outside the court.

hindi: पत्रकार सम्मेलन — पत्रकारों को बुलाकर दी जाने वाली सूचना
definition: a press conference, the meeting at which an organisation or politician answers questions from journalists (die Pressekonferenz, plural Pressekonferenzen)
example: Der Trainer gab nach dem Spiel eine Pressekonferenz. — The coach gave a press conference after the match.

hindi: पुरोहित — धार्मिक विधियाँ कराने वाला दीक्षित व्यक्ति
definition: a priest, an ordained person who performs religious rites and sacraments, especially in the Catholic church or other religions (der Priester, plural Priester)
example: Der Priester segnete das Brautpaar. — The priest blessed the bridal couple.

hindi: बढ़िया — बहुत अच्छा, उम्दा; थोड़ा पुराना बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: great, first-rate, splendid; a slightly old-fashioned but still common colloquial word of approval that never inflects
example: Prima, dann treffen wir uns um sieben. — Great, then we meet at seven.

hindi: चुटकी — दो उँगलियों से उठाई नमक या मसाले की मात्रा
definition: a pinch, the small amount of salt, pepper or spice held between two fingers when cooking (die Prise, plural Prisen)
example: Noch eine Prise Salz in die Suppe. — One more pinch of salt in the soup.

hindi: प्रति — हर एक इकाई, व्यक्ति या समय के हिसाब से
definition: per, for each unit, person or period of time when stating a rate or price (preposition, + Akkusativ, usually without article)
example: Das Zimmer kostet fünfzig Euro pro Nacht. — The room costs fifty euros per night.

hindi: पूर्वाभ्यास — मंचन से पहले की तैयारी, या नमूना
definition: a rehearsal for a concert, play or choir performance, and also a sample or test of something (die Probe, plural Proben)
example: Die letzte Probe vor der Premiere ist morgen. — The final rehearsal before the premiere is tomorrow.

hindi: पूर्वाभ्यास करना — मंचन से पहले मिलकर अभ्यास करना
definition: to rehearse, to practise a play, concert or piece of music together before performing it in public (regular: probt, hat geprobt)
example: Das Ensemble probt heute die zweite Szene. — The ensemble is rehearsing the second scene today.

hindi: परीक्षण काल — नई नौकरी के शुरुआती परखने के महीने
definition: a probation period, the first months of a new job during which either side can end the contract easily (die Probezeit, plural Probezeiten)
example: Die Probezeit dauert sechs Monate. — The probation period lasts six months.

hindi: चखना, आज़माना — स्वाद देखने या परखने के लिए थोड़ा लेना
definition: to try or sample food and drink to taste it, also to attempt something to see whether it works (regular)
example: Probier mal den Kuchen, er ist selbst gebacken. — Try the cake, it is home-made.

hindi: समस्या — जिसका हल निकालना ज़रूरी हो ऐसी मुश्किल
definition: a problem, a difficulty or troublesome matter that needs to be dealt with or solved (das Problem, plural Probleme)
example: Kein Problem, das machen wir morgen. — No problem, we will do that tomorrow.

hindi: बिना किसी समस्या के — बिना अड़चन, सहज रूप से
definition: without any problems, going smoothly and easily with no trouble or obstacles along the way
example: Die Reise verlief problemlos. — The journey went without any problems.

hindi: उत्पाद — बनाकर बेचा जाने वाला सामान
definition: a product, an article that is manufactured and offered for sale to customers, also the result of a process or of multiplication (das Produkt, plural Produkte)
example: Das neue Produkt kommt im Herbst auf den Markt. — The new product comes onto the market in autumn.

hindi: उत्पादन — सामान बनाने की प्रक्रिया या बनाए गए सामान की मात्रा
definition: production, the manufacturing process that turns materials into finished goods, or the total quantity a plant produces (die Produktion, plural Produktionen)
example: Die Produktion läuft rund um die Uhr. — Production runs around the clock.

hindi: उत्पादन करना — बड़ी मात्रा में माल या फ़िल्म बनाना
definition: to produce goods, films, music or food in quantity, the international word used in industry and media (regular: hat produziert)
example: Das Werk produziert täglich tausend Autos. — The plant produces a thousand cars a day.

hindi: आचार्य — विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ाने और शोध करने वाला वरिष्ठ शिक्षक
definition: a professor, the senior academic teacher who lectures and leads research at a university (der Professor, plural Professoren)
example: Der Professor beantwortet nach der Vorlesung gern Fragen. — The professor happily answers questions after the lecture.

hindi: कार्यक्रम — संगणक पर चलने वाला तंत्रांश, या टीवी और आयोजनों की सूची
definition: a program, a piece of software that runs on a computer, and also a television channel schedule or the plan of events at a festival (das Programm, plural Programme)
example: Das Programm startet nicht mehr. — The program no longer starts.

hindi: परियोजना — तय लक्ष्य वाला बड़ा योजनाबद्ध काम
definition: a project, a planned piece of work with a defined goal that a team carries out over time (das Projekt, plural Projekte)
example: Das Projekt läuft bis Ende des Jahres. — The project runs until the end of the year.

hindi: शोध-उपाधि — शोध-प्रबंध के बाद मिलने वाली डॉक्टर की उपाधि
definition: the process of earning a doctorate, the doctoral studies and thesis that give someone the title of doctor (die Promotion, plural Promotionen)
example: Nach der Promotion arbeitet sie als Forscherin. — After her doctorate she works as a researcher.

hindi: डॉक्टरेट करना — शोध-प्रबंध लिखकर डॉक्टर की उपाधि पाना
definition: to earn a doctorate, to write a doctoral thesis and obtain the title of doctor (regular, hat promoviert)
example: Er promoviert in Chemie an der Universität Bonn. — He is doing his doctorate in chemistry at the University of Bonn.

hindi: विवरणिका — सामान या सेवा की जानकारी देने वाला पर्चा
definition: a brochure or leaflet advertising products, holidays or services, never a prospect or outlook (der Prospekt, plural Prospekte)
example: Im Prospekt stehen alle Preise. — All the prices are in the brochure.

hindi: जाम की शुभकामना — गिलास टकराते हुए पीने से पहले कहा जाने वाला शब्द
definition: cheers, the toast people call out while raising and clinking glasses before drinking beer or wine together
example: Prost, auf einen schönen Abend! — Cheers, to a lovely evening!

hindi: विरोध — आपत्ति या असहमति की सार्वजनिक अभिव्यक्ति
definition: a protest, a public expression of objection or disagreement with a decision, policy or plan (der Protest, plural Proteste)
example: Der Protest gegen die Fabrik wächst weiter. — The protest against the factory keeps growing.

hindi: कार्यवृत्त — बैठक में कही और तय हुई बातों का लिखित रिकॉर्ड
definition: the minutes of a meeting, the written record of what was discussed and decided, also an official log or procedure (das Protokoll, plural Protokolle)
example: Wer schreibt heute das Protokoll der Sitzung? — Who is writing the minutes of the session today?

hindi: प्रतिशत — सौ में से हिस्सा
definition: a percent, one part in a hundred, used for discounts, interest rates, statistics and the alcohol content of drinks (das Prozent, plural Prozente)
example: Die Bank zahlt nur ein Prozent Zinsen. — The bank pays only one percent interest.

hindi: मुक़दमे की सुनवाई — अदालत में चलने वाली कार्यवाही
definition: a trial or court case that runs through hearings to a verdict, also any process in general (der Prozess, plural Prozesse)
example: Der Prozess beginnt am Montag. — The trial begins on Monday.

hindi: परखना — किसी चीज़ की सही होने की जाँच करना
definition: to check or test whether something is correct, works properly or meets a standard, also to examine a student (regular: hat geprüft)
example: Bitte prüfen Sie die Zahlen noch einmal. — Please check the numbers once more.

hindi: परीक्षा — ज्ञान की औपचारिक जाँच जिसमें पास या फेल होते हैं
definition: an examination, a formal test of knowledge or ability that a candidate either passes or fails (die Prüfung, plural Prüfungen)
example: Er hat die Prüfung beim ersten Versuch bestanden. — He passed the exam on the first attempt.

hindi: जनता या श्रोतागण — कार्यक्रम देखने-सुनने वाले सब लोग
definition: the audience or public, all the people watching or listening to a performance, broadcast or publication (das Publikum, no plural)
example: Das Publikum klatschte laut nach dem Konzert. — The audience clapped loudly after the concert.

hindi: दूध की गाढ़ी मिठाई — स्टार्च से जमाई ठंडी खीर जैसी मीठी चीज़
definition: a pudding, the thick cold milk dessert set with starch in vanilla or chocolate flavour, a classic children's dessert (der Pudding, plural Puddings)
example: Der Pudding muss im Kühlschrank fest werden. — The pudding has to set in the fridge.

hindi: घुँघराले बालों वाला कुत्ता — घने छल्लेदार बालों वाली पालतू कुत्ते की नस्ल
definition: a breed of dog with dense curly hair that is often clipped into shapes, known as poodle in English (der Pudel, plural Pudel)
example: Ihr weißer Pudel wird jede Woche frisiert. — Her white poodle is groomed every week.

hindi: बुना ऊनी पहनावा — सिर से पहना जाने वाला गरम ऊपरी वस्त्र
definition: a sweater or jumper, the warm knitted garment pulled over the head to cover the upper body (der Pullover, plural Pullover)
example: Zieh einen Pullover an, es ist kalt. — Put on a sweater, it is cold.

hindi: काली राई डबलरोटी — बहुत देर तक भाप में पकी, हल्की मीठी, पतली परतों में कटी
definition: a very dark sweetish Westphalian rye bread steamed for many hours until almost black, sold in thin dense slices (der Pumpernickel, plural Pumpernickel)
example: Der Pumpernickel schmeckt gut mit Frischkäse. — The pumpernickel tastes good with cream cheese.

hindi: बिंदु — ज्यामिति की सबसे छोटी स्थिति, या वाक्य के अंत का चिह्न
definition: a point or dot, the smallest position in geometry, the full stop ending a sentence, a score in a game, or an item on an agenda (der Punkt, plural Punkte)
example: Unsere Mannschaft hat drei Punkte gewonnen. — Our team won three points.

hindi: गुड़िया — बच्चे या इंसान की आकृति का खिलौना जिसे बच्चे सजाते-खिलाते हैं
definition: a doll, the toy figure of a baby or person that children dress, cuddle and play families with (die Puppe, plural Puppen)
example: Meine Tochter zieht der Puppe ein neues Kleid an. — My daughter is putting a new dress on the doll.

hindi: तख़्तापलट — सेना या गुट द्वारा सरकार को अचानक बलपूर्वक हटाना
definition: a sudden violent attempt by soldiers or a small group to overthrow a government and seize power (der Putsch, plural Putsche)
example: Der Putsch der Generäle scheiterte nach zwei Tagen. — The generals' coup failed after two days.

hindi: साफ़ करना — घर, फ़र्श या खिड़की की गंदगी हटाकर चमकाना
definition: to clean a room, floor, window or other surface by scrubbing and wiping away dirt, the everyday household word for housework cleaning (regular)
example: Am Samstag putze ich die ganze Wohnung. — On Saturday I clean the whole flat.

hindi: सफ़ाई का घोल — सतह साफ़ करने वाला रसायन
definition: a cleaning product, the liquid, spray or powder used to clean bathrooms, kitchens and floors (das Putzmittel, plural Putzmittel)
example: Das Putzmittel steht unter dem Waschbecken. — The cleaning product is under the sink.

hindi: टुकड़ों की पहेली — कटे टुकड़े जोड़कर चित्र बनाने का खेल
definition: a jigsaw puzzle, a picture cut into many pieces that must be fitted back together (das Puzzle, plural Puzzles)
example: Das Puzzle hat tausend Teile. — The jigsaw puzzle has a thousand pieces.

hindi: छोटा पार्सल — डाक से भेजा जाने वाला छोटा हल्का बंडल
definition: a small parcel or package sent cheaply through the post, lighter than a full parcel and usually without tracking (das Päckchen, plural Päckchen)
example: Meine Oma schickt mir jeden Monat ein Päckchen. — My grandma sends me a small parcel every month.

hindi: समय पर — ठीक तय समय पर, न आगे न पीछे
definition: punctual or on time, arriving or departing exactly at the scheduled moment without delay (adjective, also used as adverb)
example: Der Zug war heute ausnahmsweise pünktlich. — For once the train was on time today.

hindi: समयनिष्ठा — तय समय पर पहुँचने की आदत और गुण
definition: the habit and virtue of being exactly on time for appointments, work and trains, valued in German culture as a mark of reliability (die Pünktlichkeit, no plural)
example: Die Pünktlichkeit ist ihm sehr wichtig. — Punctuality is very important to him.

hindi: वर्ग — चार बराबर भुजाओं वाली चौकोर आकृति
definition: a square, a flat shape with four equal sides and four right-angled corners, also used in measuring area (das Quadrat, plural Quadrate)
example: Zeichne bitte ein Quadrat auf das Papier. — Please draw a square on the paper.

hindi: वर्गाकार — चार बराबर भुजाओं वाला चौकोर
definition: square, having four equal sides and four right-angled corners, describing a plate, a room or a photograph
example: Das Bild hat ein quadratisches Format. — The picture has a square format.

hindi: वर्ग मीटर — फ़्लैट का क्षेत्रफल नापने की इकाई
definition: a square metre, the unit in which flat sizes and rent per area are quoted (der Quadratmeter, plural Quadratmeter)
example: Der Quadratmeter kostet hier fünfzehn Euro Miete. — The square metre costs fifteen euros in rent here.

hindi: ताज़ा नरम खट्टा पनीर — दही जैसा, फल या हरी पत्तियों के साथ खाया जाता है
definition: quark, the fresh soft slightly sour white cheese eaten with fruit or herbs and baked into cheesecake, a German fridge essential (der Quark, no plural)
example: Der Quark schmeckt mit Beeren besonders gut. — The quark tastes especially good with berries.

hindi: तिमाही — साल की तीन-तीन महीनों की चार अवधियों में से एक
definition: a quarter, one of the four three-month periods into which a business year is divided (das Quartal, plural Quartale)
example: Die Zahlen für das erste Quartal sind gut. — The figures for the first quarter are good.

hindi: स्फटिक — पारदर्शी या दूधिया कठोर खनिज जो घड़ियों में भी लगता है
definition: a hard glassy mineral found in rocks and sand, used in watches for its steady vibration, spelled quartz in English (der Quarz, plural Quarze)
example: Die Uhr läuft mit einem kleinen Quarz sehr genau. — The watch keeps very accurate time with a small quartz crystal.

hindi: लगभग, मानो — बात के करीब-करीब सही होने का शब्द
definition: a colloquial adverb meaning virtually or as good as, presenting something as approximately but not exactly the case
example: Wir sind quasi fertig. — We're practically finished.

hindi: बकबक करना — लगातार बेमतलब बोलते रहना
definition: to jabber or chatter nonstop, talking quickly and at length in a way that tires the listener, colloquial (regular)
example: Meine Tante quasselt immer ohne Pause. — My aunt always jabbers without a pause.

hindi: बकबक की डोरी — बिना रुके बोलने वाला बातूनी व्यक्ति
definition: a chatterbox who talks constantly without pause, especially on the telephone, literally a babbling cord, colloquial and affectionate (die Quasselstrippe, plural Quasselstrippen)
example: Meine Tante ist eine Quasselstrippe, sie telefoniert stundenlang. — My aunt is a chatterbox, she phones for hours.

hindi: बकवास — बेतुकी, फ़ालतू बात
definition: nonsense or rubbish, silly talk or foolish ideas that deserve no serious attention, very common colloquial word (der Quatsch, no plural)
example: Das ist doch der größte Quatsch! — That is the biggest nonsense!

hindi: बकबक करना — बेतकल्लुफ़ी से इधर-उधर की बातें करना
definition: to chat or natter casually, a colloquial verb for informal talking that can also mean talking nonsense (regular: quatscht, hat gequatscht; colloquial)
example: Wir haben den ganzen Abend nur gequatscht. — We just chatted the whole evening.

hindi: स्रोत — ज़मीन से पानी निकलने की जगह
definition: a spring or source, the place where water rises naturally from the ground and a stream begins (die Quelle, plural Quellen)
example: Aus der Quelle kommt eiskaltes Wasser. — Ice-cold water comes from the spring.

hindi: मिनमिनाना — थके बच्चे का रोते स्वर में लगातार शिकायत करना
definition: to whine or whinge, a tired child's persistent complaining and nagging in a tearful voice (regular: hat gequengelt)
example: Das müde Kind quengelt die ganze Rückfahrt. — The tired child whines the whole journey home.

hindi: पेशा बदलने वाला — बिना पारंपरिक प्रशिक्षण दूसरे क्षेत्र से आया व्यक्ति
definition: a career changer, someone who enters a profession from an unrelated field without the usual training (der Quereinsteiger, plural Quereinsteiger)
example: Der neue Lehrer ist ein Quereinsteiger aus der Industrie. — The new teacher is a career changer from industry.

hindi: रसीद — भुगतान का लिखित प्रमाण
definition: a receipt, the written proof that a payment has been made, needed for refunds, expenses and warranties (die Quittung, plural Quittungen)
example: Kann ich bitte eine Quittung bekommen? — Could I have a receipt, please?

hindi: छूट — दाम में कटौती
definition: a discount, a reduction taken off the normal price of goods for a customer or a sale (der Rabatt, plural Rabatte)
example: Den Rabatt bekommen nur Studenten. — Only students get the discount.

hindi: कौआ — काला बड़ा चतुर पक्षी
definition: a raven, the large glossy black bird known for its intelligence and harsh croaking call (der Rabe, plural Raben)
example: Ein Rabe sitzt auf dem Zaun und krächzt. — A raven sits on the fence and croaks.

hindi: कौवा माँ — बच्चों की उपेक्षा करने वाली माँ के लिए कठोर ताना
definition: a harsh reproach for a mother judged to neglect her children, for example by working long hours, literally a raven mother, now often criticised as unfair (die Rabenmutter, plural Rabenmütter)
example: Weil sie Vollzeit arbeitet, nennen manche sie eine Rabenmutter. — Because she works full time, some call her a bad mother.

hindi: साइकिल चलाना — पैडल मारकर दोपहिये पर सवारी करना
definition: to cycle or ride a bicycle, to travel or exercise on a bike, written as two words in standard spelling (fährt Rad, ist Rad gefahren)
example: Am Wochenende fahren wir gern Rad. — At the weekend we like to go cycling.

hindi: रबड़ — पेंसिल की लिखावट मिटाने वाला टुकड़ा
definition: an eraser, the small rubber block used to remove pencil marks from paper (der Radiergummi, plural Radiergummis)
example: Kannst du mir deinen Radiergummi leihen? — Can you lend me your eraser?

hindi: आकाशवाणी यंत्र — ध्वनि प्रसारण का माध्यम और उसे सुनने का सेट
definition: the radio, both the sound broadcasting medium and the receiver device that plays music and news (das Radio, plural Radios)
example: Das Radio in der Küche läuft den ganzen Tag. — The radio in the kitchen plays all day long.

hindi: साइकिल पथ — सिर्फ़ साइकिलों के लिए बना अलग रास्ता
definition: a cycle path, a lane or track marked out solely for bicycles beside a road or through a park (der Radweg, plural Radwege)
example: Der Radweg führt am Fluss entlang. — The cycle path runs along the river.

hindi: समझना — बोलचाल में बात पकड़ना
definition: to grasp or comprehend something, casual colloquial synonym for understanding, often negated when someone is slow (regular)
example: Ich raffe diese Regel einfach nicht. — I just do not grasp this rule.

hindi: मलाई — दक्षिण जर्मनी और स्विट्ज़रलैंड में दूध की गाढ़ी वसायुक्त मलाई
definition: the southern German and Swiss word for cream, the thick fatty part of milk used in sauces and desserts, where the north says Sahne (der Rahm, no plural)
example: Der Rahm macht die Suppe schön cremig. — The cream makes the soup nice and creamy.

hindi: चौखट — तस्वीर के चारों ओर लगा किनारा
definition: a frame, the wooden or metal border fitted around a picture, mirror or window to hold and display it (der Rahmen, plural Rahmen)
example: Der goldene Rahmen passt gut zu dem alten Gemälde. — The golden frame suits the old painting well.

hindi: किनारा — किसी चीज़ की बाहरी सीमा या हाशिया
definition: an edge, rim or margin, the outer boundary of a surface, town or object where it ends (der Rand, plural Ränder)
example: Wir wohnen am Rand der Stadt. — We live on the edge of the city.

hindi: फुर्तीला — बिना देर किए झटपट होने वाला
definition: quick or swift, happening fast and without delay, a slightly more formal word than schnell
example: Wir brauchen eine rasche Antwort. — We need a quick answer.

hindi: घास का मैदान — घर के आगे-पीछे की छोटी कटी घास
definition: a lawn, the area of short mown grass in front of or behind a house (der Rasen, plural Rasen)
example: Bitte nicht den Rasen betreten! — Please keep off the lawn!

hindi: घास काटने की मशीन — लॉन की घास बराबर काटने का यंत्र
definition: a lawnmower, the machine pushed across a lawn to cut the grass short and even (der Rasenmäher, plural Rasenmäher)
example: Der Rasenmäher ist am Sonntag verboten. — The lawnmower is forbidden on Sunday.

hindi: विश्राम स्थल — राजमार्ग किनारे खाने-पीने और रुकने की जगह
definition: a motorway service area with restaurant, toilets and fuel where drivers rest on long journeys (die Raststätte, plural Raststätten)
example: An der nächsten Raststätte machen wir eine Pause. — We will take a break at the next service area.

hindi: सलाह — किसी समस्या पर दिया गया परामर्श, चूहा नहीं
definition: advice or counsel given to help someone decide, also a council or advisory body, never a rodent (der Rat, plural Ratschläge for advice, Räte for councils)
example: Kannst du mir einen Rat geben? — Can you give me some advice?

hindi: किस्त — बड़े कर्ज़ या ख़रीद की नियमित आंशिक अदायगी
definition: an instalment, one regular partial payment toward a larger debt or purchase (die Rate, plural Raten)
example: Die letzte Rate für den Fernseher ist im Mai fällig. — The last instalment for the television is due in May.

hindi: अंदाज़ा लगाना, सलाह देना — बिना जाने उत्तर बताना
definition: to guess an answer without knowing it for certain, and also to advise someone what they should do (irregular: rät, riet, hat geraten; + Dativ for advising)
example: Rate mal, wer heute angerufen hat! — Guess who called today!

hindi: नगर भवन — शहर की सरकार और महापौर का दफ़्तर
definition: the town hall or city hall, the building housing the local government, the mayor and the civic offices (das Rathaus, plural Rathäuser)
example: Den neuen Ausweis bekommst du im Rathaus. — You get the new identity card at the town hall.

hindi: किंकर्तव्यविमूढ़ — क्या करें, सूझ न पड़े
definition: helpless and completely at a loss, puzzled and not knowing what to do next or which solution might work
example: Wir standen ratlos vor der kaputten Tür. — We stood helplessly in front of the broken door.

hindi: गपशप करना — बवेरिया और ऑस्ट्रिया में देर तक बतियाना
definition: to chat or gossip at length in the Bavarian and Austrian colloquial way, exchanging news and small talk with friends and neighbours (regular)
example: Die Nachbarinnen ratschen jeden Morgen am Zaun. — The neighbours chat at the fence every morning.

hindi: सलाह — किसी को दी गई एक निश्चित सुझाव भरी बात
definition: a single piece of advice or a suggestion offered to help someone with a decision or problem (der Ratschlag, plural Ratschläge)
example: Der Ratschlag hat mir sehr geholfen. — The piece of advice helped me a lot.

hindi: बड़ा चूहा — नालियों और तहख़ानों में रहने वाला जानवर
definition: a rat, the larger long-tailed rodent found in cellars and sewers, sometimes kept as a clever pet (die Ratte, plural Ratten)
example: Im Keller haben wir eine Ratte gesehen. — We saw a rat in the cellar.

hindi: गहरी नींद सोना — बोलचाल में सो जाना
definition: to sleep soundly or crash out, colloquial for sleeping deeply, often after exhaustion (regular)
example: Nach der Wanderung haben alle sofort geratzt. — After the hike everyone crashed out immediately.

hindi: खुरदुरा — छूने में असमतल, चिकना नहीं
definition: rough, having an uneven bumpy surface that is not smooth to touch, describing bark, sandpaper, chapped hands or a hoarse voice
example: Meine Hände sind vom Wind ganz rau. — My hands are completely rough from the wind.

hindi: डकैती — धमकी या ज़ोर-ज़बरदस्ती से लूटना
definition: robbery, the crime of stealing from someone using force or threats of violence (der Raub, no plural)
example: Der Raub geschah am helllichten Tag. — The robbery happened in broad daylight.

hindi: धुआँ — जलती चीज़ से उठने वाला काला या भूरा गैसीय बादल
definition: smoke, the cloud of grey or black gas and particles that rises from something burning and can suffocate people (der Rauch, no plural)
example: Der Rauch drang dicht aus dem Keller. — The smoke was pouring thickly out of the cellar.

hindi: धुआँ संसूचक — छत पर लगा उपकरण जो धुआँ पाकर तेज़ आवाज़ करता है
definition: a smoke detector, the small ceiling device that sounds a loud alarm when it senses smoke from a fire (der Rauchmelder, plural Rauchmelder)
example: In jedem Schlafzimmer muss ein Rauchmelder hängen. — There must be a smoke detector in every bedroom.

hindi: ऊपर — बोलचाल में ऊपर जाने या चढ़ाने का शब्द
definition: up or upwards in colloquial spoken German, the short everyday form used for climbing or lifting something higher
example: Geh schon mal rauf, ich komme gleich. — Go on up, I will come right away.

hindi: बारह पवित्र रातें — क्रिसमस से एपिफ़नी तक की, प्रेत-वास मानी जाने वाली रातें
definition: one of the twelve nights between Christmas and Epiphany, held in folklore to be haunted by spirits
example: On the first Rauhnacht the farmer walked his stables with incense, as his grandfather had.

hindi: कक्ष / जगह — कमरा या खाली स्थान
definition: a room or space, a somewhat more formal word for any enclosed area inside a building, also empty space in general (der Raum, plural Räume)
example: Dieser Raum wird als Büro genutzt. — This room is used as an office.

hindi: बुदबुदाकर शिकायत करना — हर बात पर बड़बड़ाना, विएना का शब्द
definition: to grumble, whine and complain in a moaning tone about small things, a favourite Viennese verb for everyday grouching (regular: raunzt, hat geraunzt)
example: Er raunzt den ganzen Tag über das Wetter. — He grumbles all day about the weather.

hindi: बाहर — बोलचाल में बाहर जाने या निकालने का शब्द
definition: out or outside in colloquial spoken German, the short everyday form used for leaving or taking something out
example: Ich muss kurz raus an die frische Luft. — I need to go out for some fresh air.

hindi: बाहर ले जाना — कूड़ा या कोई चीज़ घर से बाहर रखना
definition: to take out the rubbish or carry something outside the house, a colloquial everyday verb (separable, colloquial: bringt raus, hat rausgebracht)
example: Bringst du bitte den Müll raus? — Will you please take out the rubbish?

hindi: किसी बात पर प्रतिक्रिया देना — जो हुआ उसके जवाब में कुछ करना या कहना
definition: to react or respond to something that has happened, showing a reaction in words or action (auf + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Er hat sehr ruhig auf die Kritik reagiert. — He reacted very calmly to the criticism.

hindi: साकार करना — योजना को अमल में लाना; समझ जाना भी
definition: to carry out or bring a plan into reality, and only more recently to become aware of something (regular)
example: Wir haben das Projekt endlich realisiert. — We have finally carried out the project.

hindi: यथार्थ-राजनीति — सिद्धांत नहीं, शक्ति और परिस्थिति से चलती नीति
definition: politics conducted from power and circumstance rather than from principle, ideology or moral preference
example: The treaty was pure Realpolitik, signed by two governments that despised each other.

hindi: मध्यम माध्यमिक स्कूल — दसवीं कक्षा तक की पढ़ाई, आगे व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण की राह
definition: the intermediate secondary school type that ends after year ten with a certificate opening the way to vocational training or further schooling (die Realschule, plural Realschulen)
example: Sie hat die Realschule mit guten Noten abgeschlossen. — She finished the Realschule with good grades.

hindi: हिसाब लगाना — जोड़-घटाव आदि गणना करना
definition: to calculate or do arithmetic, working out sums with numbers, also to reckon or expect something with mit + Dativ (regular, hat gerechnet)
example: Die Schüler rechnen heute mit Brüchen. — The pupils are calculating with fractions today.

hindi: किसी बात की उम्मीद रखना — किसी संभावना को पहले से मानकर चलना
definition: to expect or count on something happening, taking the possibility into account and planning for it in advance (mit + Dativ, regular)
example: Wir rechnen mit etwa fünfzig Gästen. — We are expecting about fifty guests.

hindi: संगणक — गणना, लेखन और दफ़्तर के काम की बिजली से चलने वाली मशीन
definition: a computer, the electronic machine people use for work, writing and calculation; the everyday native German word beside the borrowed Computer (der Rechner, plural Rechner)
example: Der Rechner im Büro ist heute sehr langsam. — The computer in the office is very slow today.

hindi: हिसाब — खाने या ख़रीदारी के बाद चुकाने की रक़म का पर्चा
definition: the bill or invoice, the written total you must pay after a meal or purchase (die Rechnung, plural Rechnungen)
example: Die Rechnung, bitte! — The bill, please!

hindi: अधिकार — क़ानूनी हक़; क़ानून की पूरी व्यवस्था भी
definition: the legal system of a country as a whole, and also a right that a person holds and may claim (das Recht, plural Rechte)
example: Jeder Mensch hat das Recht auf Bildung. — Every person has the right to education.

hindi: सही होना — किसी की बात या राय का सच निकलना
definition: to be right or correct about something, the phrase people use when they concede a point in conversation (hat recht, hat recht gehabt)
example: Du hattest recht, der Zug war voll. — You were right, the train was full.

hindi: आयताकार — चार समकोण और दो लंबी, दो छोटी भुजाओं वाला
definition: rectangular, having four right-angled corners with two longer and two shorter sides, like most tables and screens
example: Der Garten ist lang und rechteckig. — The garden is long and rectangular.

hindi: दाएँ — दाईं ओर या दाईं दिशा में
definition: on the right side or toward the right direction, the everyday word used when giving directions or describing where something stands
example: Biegen Sie an der Ampel rechts ab. — Turn right at the traffic light.

hindi: अधिवक्ता — अदालत में मुक़दमा लड़ने वाला पंजीकृत वकील
definition: a lawyer or attorney admitted to represent clients in court and advise them on legal matters, the full formal title (der Rechtsanwalt, plural Rechtsanwälte)
example: Der Rechtsanwalt vertritt sie vor Gericht. — The attorney represents her in court.

hindi: समय रहते — देर होने से पहले, सही वक़्त पर
definition: in good time, early enough before a deadline or event so that nothing is missed
example: Wir sind rechtzeitig am Bahnhof angekommen. — We arrived at the station in good time.

hindi: पुनर्चक्रित करना — पुरानी चीज़ों को फिर से काम में लाना
definition: to recycle, to process used material so that it can be turned into something new instead of thrown away (regular: hat recycelt)
example: Wir recyceln fast unser ganzes Plastik. — We recycle almost all of our plastic.

hindi: पुनर्चक्रण — पुराने सामान से नया कच्चा माल बनाना
definition: recycling, the process of turning used material such as paper, glass or plastic into new products (das Recycling, no plural)
example: Das Recycling spart Rohstoffe und Energie. — Recycling saves raw materials and energy.

hindi: संपादक — अख़बार या पत्रिका में लेख सँवारने और चुनने वाला
definition: an editor, the staff journalist who selects, edits and prepares articles for a newspaper, magazine or broadcaster (der Redakteur, plural Redakteure)
example: Der Redakteur hat meinen Text stark gekürzt. — The editor shortened my text a lot.

hindi: संपादकीय विभाग — अख़बार या चैनल का संपादक-दल और उसका दफ़्तर
definition: the editorial office or editorial staff, the team of editors and journalists who produce a newspaper or programme (die Redaktion, plural Redaktionen)
example: Die Redaktion arbeitet bis spät in die Nacht. — The editorial staff works until late at night.

hindi: बातें करना — किसी से बातचीत करना या भाषण देना
definition: to talk or speak with someone, slightly more casual than sprechen and often describing talking at length or giving a speech (regular: redet, hat geredet; mit + Dativ, über + Akkusativ)
example: Wir müssen dringend miteinander reden. — We urgently need to talk to each other.

hindi: घटाना — दाम या मात्रा कम करना
definition: to reduce or lower something such as a price, quantity or costs, the verb behind sale labels reading reduziert (regular: reduziert, hat reduziert)
example: Der Laden reduziert alle Schuhe um dreißig Prozent. — The shop reduces all shoes by thirty percent.

hindi: मौखिक प्रस्तुति — किसी विषय पर कक्षा के सामने दिया जाने वाला व्याख्यान
definition: an oral presentation or short talk that a pupil prepares and delivers to the class on an assigned topic (das Referat, plural Referate)
example: Ich halte morgen ein Referat über Vulkane. — Tomorrow I am giving a presentation on volcanoes.

hindi: ताक़ — किताबें या सामान रखने की खुली तख़्तेदार अलमारी
definition: a shelf unit or bookcase, the open piece of furniture with flat boards for holding books and objects (das Regal, plural Regale)
example: Die Bücher stehen im Regal. — The books are on the shelf.

hindi: नियम — जो करना या न करना तय किया गया हो
definition: a rule, an established principle that says what must or must not be done, as in in der Regel meaning as a rule (die Regel, plural Regeln)
example: In der Regel arbeite ich bis fünf. — As a rule I work until five.

hindi: नियमित — तय अंतराल पर बार-बार
definition: regularly, at fixed even intervals, following a steady repeating pattern
example: Ich gehe regelmäßig schwimmen. — I go swimming regularly.

hindi: बारिश — बादलों से गिरता पानी
definition: rain, the water that falls from clouds in drops and soaks streets, gardens and people (der Regen, plural Regen)
example: Der Regen hört einfach nicht auf. — The rain simply will not stop.

hindi: इंद्रधनुष — बारिश के बाद आसमान में रंगों का चाप
definition: a rainbow, the coloured arc that appears in the sky when sunshine breaks through after rain (der Regenbogen, plural Regenbogen)
example: Nach dem Schauer stand ein Regenbogen am Himmel. — After the shower a rainbow stood in the sky.

hindi: बारिश की बौछार — अचानक आकर जल्दी थम जाने वाली बारिश
definition: a rain shower, a brief sudden fall of rain that ends quickly and leaves the streets damp (der Regenschauer, plural Regenschauer)
example: Ein kurzer Regenschauer hat uns überrascht. — A short rain shower surprised us.

hindi: छाता — बारिश से बचाने वाला छतरी जैसा साधन
definition: an umbrella, the folding canopy on a handle that people hold above their heads to stay dry in the rain (der Regenschirm, plural Regenschirme)
example: Nimm den Regenschirm mit, es soll heute regnen. — Take the umbrella, it is supposed to rain today.

hindi: वर्षावन — भूमध्य रेखा के पास का घना, नम जंगल
definition: a rainforest, the dense wet tropical forest whose clearing threatens the climate and countless species (der Regenwald, plural Regenwälder)
example: Der Regenwald wird jedes Jahr kleiner. — The rainforest gets smaller every year.

hindi: शासन करना — सरकार के रूप में देश या क्षेत्र चलाना
definition: to govern, to rule a country or region as its government and direct its public affairs (regular, hat regiert)
example: Die Partei regiert seit zehn Jahren das Land. — The party has governed the country for ten years.

hindi: सरकार — देश चलाने वाले मंत्रियों और नेताओं का समूह
definition: the government, the group of ministers and leaders who run the country and decide its policy (die Regierung, plural Regierungen)
example: Die Regierung hat ein neues Gesetz vorgeschlagen. — The government has proposed a new law.

hindi: क्षेत्र या प्रदेश — साझा भूगोल या संस्कृति वाला बड़ा इलाक़ा
definition: a region, a large area of land distinguished by shared geography, culture or economy rather than by strict borders (die Region, plural Regionen)
example: Die Region ist für ihren Wein bekannt. — The region is known for its wine.

hindi: निर्देशक — फ़िल्म या नाटक को दिशा देने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a director, the person who guides the actors and shapes the whole production of a film or play (der Regisseur, plural Regisseure)
example: Der Regisseur drehte den Film in Berlin. — The director shot the film in Berlin.

hindi: बारिश होना — बादलों से पानी बरसना
definition: to rain, used impersonally with es when water falls from the clouds onto the ground (regular: es regnet, hat geregnet)
example: Es regnet seit dem frühen Morgen. — It has been raining since early morning.

hindi: छोटा हिरण — यूरोप के जंगलों का शर्मीला नाज़ुक जानवर
definition: a roe deer, the small shy forest animal with a reddish coat that darts across roads at dusk (das Reh, plural Rehe)
example: Ein Reh stand plötzlich auf der Straße. — A deer suddenly stood on the road.

hindi: पुनर्वास — बीमारी या चोट के बाद फिर से सक्षम बनाने का उपचार
definition: rehabilitation, the medical programme that restores strength and ability after illness, surgery or injury; short for Rehabilitation (die Reha, plural Rehas)
example: Nach der Operation kommt er in die Reha. — After the operation he goes into rehab.

hindi: कद्दूकस करना — पनीर या गाजर को झाँझरी पर घिसना
definition: to grate cheese, carrots or apples by rubbing them against a grater into fine shreds (irregular: reibt, hat gerieben)
example: Reib den Käse über die Pasta. — Grate the cheese over the pasta.

hindi: अमीर — बहुत धन-संपत्ति वाला
definition: rich and wealthy, having much money or property, also meaning abundant
example: Der Unternehmer ist sehr reich. — The businessman is very rich.

hindi: थमाना — पास बैठे व्यक्ति को कोई चीज़ बढ़ाकर देना
definition: to pass or hand something across to someone within reach, often at the table; also means to be enough or sufficient (regular, + Dativ for the receiver)
example: Reichst du mir bitte das Brot? — Would you pass me the bread, please?

hindi: भरपूर — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा, प्रचुर
definition: ample or plentiful in amount, more than enough, describing generous portions, plenty of time and abundant supplies
example: Es gab reichlich Essen. — There was plenty of food.

hindi: पका हुआ — फल का खाने के लिए तैयार होना; परिपक्व भी
definition: ripe, describing fruit that has finished growing and is ready to eat, also mature when said of people (regular comparison: reifer, am reifsten)
example: Die Bananen sind noch nicht reif genug. — The bananas are not ripe enough yet.

hindi: पकना — फल का धीरे-धीरे तैयार और मीठा होना
definition: to ripen, to become mature and ready to eat as a fruit slowly does in the sun, also used for plans or people maturing (ist gereift)
example: Die Tomaten reifen im August in der Sonne. — The tomatoes ripen in the sun in August.

hindi: शुद्ध — बिना मिलावट, निर्मल, स्वच्छ
definition: pure, clean and unmixed, used of clean water, pure wool, clear skin and figuratively of a clean conscience or pure truth
example: Der Pullover ist aus reiner Wolle. — The sweater is made of pure wool.

hindi: स्वच्छ करना — किसी चीज़ को धोकर या पोंछकर गंदगी से मुक्त करना
definition: to clean or purify something thoroughly by removing dirt and stains, a slightly more formal word than putzen used for clothes, carpets and machines (regular)
example: Der Teppich muss professionell gereinigt werden. — The carpet has to be professionally cleaned.

hindi: चावल — पानी में पकाया जाने वाला सफ़ेद अनाज
definition: rice, the white or brown cereal grain boiled as a side dish, the usual alternative to potatoes and noodles on a German plate (der Reis, no plural)
example: Der Reis ist in zwanzig Minuten fertig. — The rice is ready in twenty minutes.

hindi: यात्रा — एक जगह से दूर किसी दूसरी जगह तक का सफ़र
definition: a journey or trip, the whole travel from home to another place and back again (die Reise, plural Reisen)
example: Die Reise nach Italien dauert zwölf Stunden mit dem Zug. — The journey to Italy takes twelve hours by train.

hindi: यात्रा-एजेंसी — दुकान जहाँ उड़ान, होटल और छुट्टियाँ बुक की जाती हैं
definition: a travel agency, the shop where an agent books flights, hotels and package holidays for customers (das Reisebüro, plural Reisebüros)
example: Im Reisebüro haben wir eine Reise nach Kreta gebucht. — At the travel agency we booked a trip to Crete.

hindi: यात्रा-पुस्तिका — किसी जगह के बारे में जानकारी देने वाली किताब, या पर्यटकों का मार्गदर्शक
definition: a guidebook describing a place for travellers, also the person who guides tourists around (der Reiseführer, plural Reiseführer)
example: Im Reiseführer steht ein gutes Restaurant am Hafen. — The guidebook lists a good restaurant at the harbour.

hindi: यात्रा करना — एक जगह से दूसरी जगह सफ़र पर जाना
definition: to travel, to make a journey from one place to another, especially for holiday or business (ist gereist)
example: Sie reist gern allein durch Europa. — She likes travelling alone through Europe.

hindi: पारपत्र — विदेश यात्रा के लिए सरकार द्वारा जारी पहचान-पुस्तिका
definition: a passport, the official identity booklet issued by a government that allows travel across borders (der Reisepass, plural Reisepässe)
example: Vergiss deinen Reisepass nicht, wir fliegen morgen! — Don't forget your passport, we fly tomorrow!

hindi: यात्रा बीमा — सफ़र में बीमारी, रद्दीकरण या खोए सामान से बचाव की बीमा-योजना
definition: travel insurance, a policy that covers illness, cancellation or lost luggage while on a trip (die Reiseversicherung, plural Reiseversicherungen)
example: Die Reiseversicherung hat die Arztkosten bezahlt. — The travel insurance paid the doctor's bills.

hindi: सरकने वाला बंधन — दो कतार दाँतों को खींचकर जोड़ने वाली पट्टी
definition: a zip or zipper, the fastener with two rows of teeth pulled together by a sliding tab (der Reißverschluss, plural Reißverschlüsse)
example: Der Reißverschluss an meiner Jacke klemmt. — The zip on my jacket is stuck.

hindi: प्रचार — सामान बेचने का चटपटा विज्ञापन, कुछ पुराना शब्द
definition: advertising or publicity for products, a somewhat old-fashioned everyday word for commercial promotion and its posters (die Reklame, plural Reklamen)
example: Die Reklame an der Hauswand ist riesig. — The advertisement on the house wall is huge.

hindi: कीर्तिमान — अब तक का सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रदर्शन
definition: a record, the best performance ever achieved in a sport, such as the fastest time or the highest jump (der Rekord, plural Rekorde)
example: Der Läufer stellte einen neuen Rekord auf. — The runner set a new record.

hindi: अपेक्षाकृत — दूसरों की तुलना में, कुछ हद तक
definition: relatively or comparatively, to a moderate degree when measured against others, a mild qualifier
example: Die Wohnung ist relativ günstig. — The flat is relatively cheap.

hindi: धर्म — ईश्वर और आस्था की व्यवस्थित परंपरा
definition: a religion, an organised system of belief in a higher power with its teachings, rituals and community, also the school subject (die Religion, plural Religionen)
example: Die Religion spielt in ihrem Leben eine große Rolle. — Religion plays a big role in her life.

hindi: धार्मिक — धर्म से जुड़ा या धर्म को मानने वाला
definition: religious, relating to religion or describing a person who practises and values religious belief seriously
example: Er ist nicht besonders religiös. — He is not particularly religious.

hindi: प्रेम-मुलाक़ात — प्रेमियों की तय मिलन-भेंट
definition: a romantic date, a planned meeting between two people who are courting, slightly old-fashioned and playful (das Rendezvous, plural Rendezvous)
example: Sie hat heute Abend ein Rendezvous im Café. — She has a date at the café tonight.

hindi: तेज़ दौड़ना — पूरी रफ़्तार से भागना
definition: to race or run fast, to move at full speed, faster and more urgent than laufen (rennt, ist gerannt)
example: Die Kinder rannten zum Bus. — The children ran to the bus.

hindi: मरम्मत-रंगाई करना — दीवारें रंगकर और सुधारकर घर ठीक करना
definition: to renovate or redecorate a flat, painting walls and repairing surfaces before moving in or out (regular: hat renoviert)
example: Vor dem Auszug müssen wir die Wohnung renovieren. — We have to redecorate the flat before moving out.

hindi: पेंशन — सेवानिवृत्ति के बाद मिलने वाली मासिक राशि
definition: the pension, the monthly money paid to someone after retirement, and retirement itself in the phrase in Rente gehen (die Rente, plural Renten)
example: Mein Vater geht nächstes Jahr in Rente. — My father is retiring next year.

hindi: पेंशनभोगी — काम से सेवानिवृत्त होकर पेंशन पाने वाला
definition: the pensioner or retiree, a person who has stopped working and lives on a state pension (der Rentner, plural Rentner)
example: Die Rentner treffen sich mittwochs zum Kartenspielen. — The pensioners meet on Wednesdays to play cards.

hindi: मरम्मत करना — टूटी चीज़ को फिर से ठीक करना
definition: to repair or mend something broken so that it works again, from a leaking tap to a wobbly chair (regular)
example: Mein Vater repariert den tropfenden Wasserhahn selbst. — My father repairs the dripping tap himself.

hindi: आँखों देखा हाल — घटनास्थल से लिखी या फ़िल्माई गई विस्तृत खबर
definition: an on-the-spot news feature, the longer report written or filmed from the scene by a journalist who was there (die Reportage, plural Reportagen)
example: Die Reportage aus dem Flüchtlingslager hat mich berührt. — The feature report from the refugee camp moved me.

hindi: संवाददाता — घटनास्थल से खबर भेजने वाला पत्रकार
definition: a reporter, the journalist sent to the scene of an event to gather facts and report back (der Reporter, plural Reporter)
example: Der Reporter berichtet live vom Unfallort. — The reporter is reporting live from the accident site.

hindi: आरक्षित करना — मेज़ या कमरा पहले से अपने लिए रखवाना
definition: to reserve or book a table, room or seat in advance so that it is kept free for you (regular: hat reserviert)
example: Ich habe einen Tisch für vier Personen reserviert. — I have reserved a table for four people.

hindi: आरक्षण — किसी समय के लिए अपने नाम पर रखी गई मेज़ या कमरा
definition: a reservation or booking, the table or room held in your name for a certain time (die Reservierung, plural Reservierungen)
example: Guten Abend, wir haben eine Reservierung für acht Uhr. — Good evening, we have a reservation for eight o'clock.

hindi: सम्मान — किसी के प्रति आदर की भावना
definition: respect or esteem shown toward a person, their age, position or achievement, expressed through polite forms and attentive behaviour (der Respekt, no plural)
example: Der Respekt vor älteren Menschen ist ihr wichtig. — Respect for older people matters to her.

hindi: बचा हुआ — जो हिस्सा शेष रह गया
definition: the rest or remainder, what is left over of an amount, a meal or a period of time after part has been used (der Rest, plural Reste)
example: Den Rest essen wir morgen. — We will eat the rest tomorrow.

hindi: बचा हुआ कचरा — जो कचरा न कागज़ है, न काँच, न जैविक
definition: residual waste, the leftover household rubbish that cannot be recycled and goes in the grey or black bin (der Restmüll, no plural)
example: Windeln gehören in den Restmüll. — Nappies belong in the residual waste.

hindi: बचाना — किसी को खतरे या मौत से निकालना
definition: to rescue or save someone or something from danger, death or destruction, bringing a person or animal safely away from harm (regular: rettet, hat gerettet)
example: Die Feuerwehr rettete zwei Kinder aus dem Haus. — The fire brigade rescued two children from the house.

hindi: बचाव — खतरे से किसी को सुरक्षित निकालना; ऑस्ट्रिया में एम्बुलेंस सेवा
definition: a rescue, the action of saving someone from danger or death, and in Austria the everyday word for the ambulance service (die Rettung, plural Rettungen)
example: Die Rettung kam für den Verletzten gerade noch rechtzeitig. — The rescue came just in time for the injured man.

hindi: आपात चिकित्सा सेवा — घायलों तक रोगीवाहन और चिकित्साकर्मी भेजने वाली संस्था
definition: the emergency medical service that sends ambulances and paramedics to treat and transport injured or sick people (der Rettungsdienst, plural Rettungsdienste)
example: Der Rettungsdienst brachte die Frau ins Krankenhaus. — The emergency medical service took the woman to hospital.

hindi: रोगीवाहन — मरीज़ों को अस्पताल ले जाने वाली चिकित्सा उपकरणों से लैस गाड़ी
definition: an ambulance, the emergency vehicle fitted with medical equipment that carries injured or sick people to hospital (der Rettungswagen, plural Rettungswagen)
example: Der Rettungswagen fuhr mit Blaulicht durch die Stadt. — The ambulance drove through the city with its blue light on.

hindi: पछतावा — किए गए गलत काम पर गहरा दुख
definition: remorse or repentance, deep regret and sorrow for a wrong deed that one has committed (die Reue, no plural)
example: Er zeigte keine Reue vor Gericht. — He showed no remorse in court.

hindi: क्रांति — शासन या समाज में अचानक बड़ा उलटफेर
definition: a revolution, a sudden and fundamental overthrow of a government or social order by the people (die Revolution, plural Revolutionen)
example: Die friedliche Revolution von 1989 begann in Leipzig. — The peaceful revolution of 1989 began in Leipzig.

hindi: समीक्षा — किताब या फ़िल्म का छपा हुआ मूल्यांकन
definition: a review, a published critical evaluation of a book, film, play or album written by a critic or reader (die Rezension, plural Rezensionen)
example: Die Rezension in der Zeitung war sehr positiv. — The review in the newspaper was very positive.

hindi: नुस्ख़ा — डॉक्टर की लिखी दवा की पर्ची
definition: a prescription, the written note from a doctor that lets the pharmacy hand over medicine; also a cooking recipe (das Rezept, plural Rezepte)
example: Ohne Rezept bekommen Sie diese Tabletten nicht. — Without a prescription you will not get these tablets.

hindi: स्वागत-पटल — होटल का काउंटर जहाँ मेहमान आते-जाते समय पंजीकरण कराते हैं
definition: the reception desk of a hotel where guests check in, collect their keys and ask for help (die Rezeption, plural Rezeptionen)
example: Bitte geben Sie den Schlüssel an der Rezeption ab. — Please hand the key in at reception.

hindi: ताल — संगीत की नियमित धड़कन
definition: rhythm, the regular pattern of beats and stresses in music, dance or speech (der Rhythmus, plural Rhythmen)
example: Die Kinder klatschen im Rhythmus der Musik. — The children clap along to the rhythm of the music.

hindi: न्यायाधीश — अदालत में फ़ैसला सुनाने वाला अधिकारी
definition: a judge, the official who presides over a court and decides cases and sentences (der Richter, plural Richter)
example: Der Richter verkündet morgen das Urteil. — The judge announces the verdict tomorrow.

hindi: सही — बिना गलती के, उचित
definition: correct and right, without mistakes or errors, also meaning proper, genuine or real, and colloquially really or truly
example: Deine Antwort ist richtig. — Your answer is correct.

hindi: दिशा — वह ओर जिधर कोई चीज़ जाती या मुड़ती है
definition: a direction, the line or course along which someone moves or something points, the word on every road sign and travel announcement (die Richtung, plural Richtungen)
example: Der Zug fährt in die falsche Richtung. — The train is going in the wrong direction.

hindi: सूँघना — नाक से गंध महसूस करना; गंध देना
definition: to smell, to perceive an odour through the nose, or to give off a scent oneself (riecht, hat gerochen; nach + Dativ)
example: Hier riecht es nach frischem Brot. — It smells of fresh bread here.

hindi: पट्टी — चॉकलेट या मूसली की लंबी पट्टी, या दरवाज़े की सिटकनी
definition: a bar of chocolate or muesli, the long narrow snack shape, also the bolt that locks a door (der Riegel, plural Riegel)
example: Ich esse schnell einen Riegel Schokolade. — I quickly eat a bar of chocolate.

hindi: विशाल — बहुत ही बड़ा, दैत्य जैसा
definition: huge or enormous in size, much larger than normal, from the word for giant, very common in everyday speech
example: Der Hund ist riesig! — The dog is huge!

hindi: गोमांस — गाय-बैल का माँस
definition: beef, the meat of cattle used for roasts, goulash and the classic Sunday pot roast in German kitchens (das Rindfleisch, no plural)
example: Das Rindfleisch ist sehr zart. — The beef is very tender.

hindi: अंगूठी — उँगली में पहना जाने वाला गोल गहना
definition: a ring, the small circular band of metal worn on a finger as jewellery or sign of marriage (der Ring, plural Ringe)
example: Der Ring passt genau an ihren Finger. — The ring fits her finger exactly.

hindi: पसली — छाती के चारों ओर धनुषाकार हड्डी
definition: a rib, one of the curved bones of the ribcage around the chest that protect the heart and lungs (die Rippe, plural Rippen)
example: Beim Sturz hat er sich eine Rippe gebrochen. — He broke a rib in the fall.

hindi: जोखिम — नुकसान या खतरे की संभावना जो कोई जानबूझकर उठाता है
definition: a risk, the chance that something harmful or unwanted might happen, often one that someone knowingly takes (das Risiko, plural Risiken)
example: Ohne Helm geht man ein hohes Risiko ein. — Without a helmet you run a high risk.

hindi: जोखिम भरा — जिसमें हानि की संभावना हो
definition: risky or hazardous, involving a real chance of loss or failure, used of plans, investments and daring manoeuvres
example: Das Überholen hier ist ziemlich riskant. — Overtaking here is quite risky.

hindi: दरार या चीरा — फटने या टूटने से बनी पतली लकीर
definition: a crack, tear or split in a surface or fabric, a thin line where something has begun to break apart (der Riss, plural Risse)
example: In der Wand ist ein langer Riss. — There is a long crack in the wall.

hindi: यंत्रमानव — इंसान जैसे काम अपने आप करने वाली मशीन
definition: a robot, a programmable machine that carries out tasks automatically, in a factory or as a household helper (der Roboter, plural Roboter)
example: Der Roboter putzt jeden Tag die Wohnung. — The robot cleans the flat every day.

hindi: मज़बूत — टिकाऊ, सहनशील
definition: robust, sturdy and hard-wearing, able to withstand rough treatment, used of tools, phones, plants and healthy people
example: Das Handy ist robust und wasserdicht. — The phone is robust and waterproof.

hindi: घाघरा — कमर से नीचे लटकने वाला बिना बँटा वस्त्र
definition: a skirt, the garment hanging from the waist that covers the legs without dividing them (der Rock, plural Röcke)
example: Sie trägt heute einen kurzen Rock. — She is wearing a short skirt today.
