hindi: राई — गहरी रोटी बनाने वाला ठंडे मौसम का अनाज
definition: rye, the hardy cereal grain of northern climates whose dark flour gives German bread its characteristic colour and sourness (der Roggen, no plural)
example: Der Roggen wächst auch auf schlechten Böden. — The rye grows even on poor soils.

hindi: राई की रोटी — राई के आटे से बनी खट्टी-सी डबलरोटी
definition: rye bread, the slightly sour dense loaf baked with rye flour rather than wheat, common throughout German bakeries (das Roggenbrot, plural Roggenbrote)
example: Das Roggenbrot bleibt lange frisch. — The rye bread stays fresh for a long time.

hindi: नली — पानी या गैस ले जाने वाली खोखली नाली
definition: a pipe or tube, the hollow channel that carries water, gas or cables through a building (das Rohr, plural Rohre)
example: Das Rohr unter der Spüle ist undicht. — The pipe under the sink is leaking.

hindi: भूमिका — नाटक में निभाया जाने वाला पात्र, या गोल लपेटा
definition: a role or part played by an actor in a play or film, and also a roll of paper or a wheel (die Rolle, plural Rollen)
example: Sie spielt die Rolle der Mutter in dem Stück. — She plays the part of the mother in the play.

hindi: लुढ़कना — गोल चीज़ का घूमते हुए आगे बढ़ना
definition: to roll along by turning over and over, of a ball, wheel or vehicle, also to roll something up (regular: ist gerollt when moving, hat gerollt with an object)
example: Der Ball rollt langsam auf die Straße. — The ball rolls slowly onto the street.

hindi: झिलमिली — खिड़की के बाहर ऊपर-नीचे लुढ़कने वाला पट्टीदार आवरण
definition: a roller shutter, the slatted screen outside a window that rolls down to darken and secure a room (der Rollladen, plural Rollläden)
example: Abends lassen wir die Rollläden herunter. — In the evening we lower the roller shutters.

hindi: पहिया-कुर्सी — पहियों वाली कुर्सी जिस पर चलने में असमर्थ व्यक्ति बैठता है
definition: a wheelchair, a chair with wheels for people who cannot walk on their own (der Rollstuhl, plural Rollstühle)
example: Seit dem Unfall sitzt er im Rollstuhl. — Since the accident he has been in a wheelchair.

hindi: उपन्यास — लंबी काल्पनिक गद्य कहानी
definition: a novel, a long fictional prose story told across many chapters with invented characters and events (der Roman, plural Romane)
example: Der Roman spielt in Berlin nach dem Krieg. — The novel is set in Berlin after the war.

hindi: गुलाबी — हल्का लाल रंग, गुलाब की पंखुड़ियों जैसा
definition: pink, a pale light shade of red, the colour of rose petals and many baby clothes, the adjective never changes its ending
example: Das Baby trägt eine rosa Mütze. — The baby is wearing a pink hat.

hindi: गुलाब — काँटेदार डंठल वाला सुगंधित फूल
definition: a rose, the fragrant garden flower with thorny stems, widely given as a symbol of love (die Rose, plural Rosen)
example: Die rote Rose duftet herrlich. — The red rose smells wonderful.

hindi: गुलाब सोमवार — कार्निवल का चरम दिन, बड़ी परेड का दिन
definition: the Monday before Ash Wednesday, the climax of carnival with huge parades and floats through the streets (der Rosenmontag, plural Rosenmontage)
example: Am Rosenmontag haben viele Büros geschlossen. — On carnival Monday many offices are closed.

hindi: लाल — खून और पके टमाटर का रंग
definition: red or scarlet, the colour of blood, ripe tomatoes and strawberries, also the colour of warning signs and traffic stop lights
example: Das Auto ist rot. — The car is red.

hindi: दिनचर्या — रोज़ एक ही ढंग से किए जाने वाले काम
definition: a routine, the fixed sequence of everyday tasks done the same way each time, or the practised skill that comes from long repetition (die Routine, plural Routinen)
example: Nach dem Umzug fehlt mir meine Routine. — After the move I miss my routine.

hindi: पीठ का थैला — कंधों पर टाँगकर पीठ पर ले जाने वाला बैग
definition: a backpack or rucksack, a bag carried on the back with straps over both shoulders (der Rucksack, plural Rucksäcke)
example: Für die Wanderung packe ich Wasser in den Rucksack. — For the hike I pack water into the backpack.

hindi: पुकारना — किसी को ज़ोर से आवाज़ देना या बुलाना
definition: to call out loudly with your voice or call someone over to you, also to summon help, a doctor or a taxi (irregular: ruft, hat gerufen)
example: Mama ruft uns zum Essen. — Mum is calling us to dinner.

hindi: शांति — शोर, हलचल और चिंता का अभाव
definition: quiet, calm and stillness, the absence of noise, hurry, worry or disturbance around someone (die Ruhe, no plural)
example: Die Ruhe im Wald tut mir gut. — The quiet of the forest does me good.

hindi: सेवानिवृत्ति — काम छोड़कर आराम का जीवन
definition: the retirement, the stage of life after leaving working life for good, slightly more formal than Rente (der Ruhestand, no plural)
example: Seit dem Ruhestand reist er viel. — Since retirement he travels a lot.

hindi: शांति भंग — शोर से पड़ोसियों को परेशान करना
definition: a disturbance of the peace, noise loud enough during quiet hours that neighbours may complain or call the police (die Ruhestörung, plural Ruhestörungen)
example: Die Ruhestörung dauerte bis drei Uhr nachts. — The noise disturbance lasted until three in the morning.

hindi: शांति-काल — रात और दोपहर का समय जब शोर वर्जित है
definition: the quiet hours, the legally protected periods at night and midday when noise must be kept down (die Ruhezeit, plural Ruhezeiten)
example: Während der Ruhezeit darf man nicht bohren. — You may not drill during quiet hours.

hindi: शांत — बिना शोर या हलचल, स्थिर मन
definition: calm and quiet, peaceful without noise or agitation, also steady in temperament
example: Bleib ruhig, alles wird gut. — Stay calm, everything will be fine.

hindi: खंडहर — टूटी-फूटी पुरानी इमारत के अवशेष
definition: a ruin, the crumbling remains of an old building or castle destroyed by time, war or long neglect (die Ruine, plural Ruinen)
example: Die Ruine der alten Kirche steht mitten im Park. — The ruin of the old church stands in the middle of the park.

hindi: गोल — गेंद या पहिये जैसा, बिना कोने का
definition: round, shaped like a circle or a ball with no corners or edges, also meaning roughly when placed before a number
example: Wir sitzen an einem runden Tisch. — We are sitting at a round table.

hindi: प्रसारण सेवा — रेडियो-टीवी की सार्वजनिक प्रसारण व्यवस्था
definition: broadcasting, the radio and television service as an institution, a formal word used for public broadcasters (der Rundfunk, no plural)
example: Der öffentliche Rundfunk wird durch Gebühren finanziert. — Public broadcasting is financed by licence fees.

hindi: चक्कर-यात्रा — कई शहरों या जगहों को छूती हुई गोल-घुमाव वाली यात्रा
definition: a round trip or touring holiday that visits several places in turn before returning home (die Rundreise, plural Rundreisen)
example: Die Rundreise durch Schottland dauert zehn Tage. — The tour through Scotland lasts ten days.

hindi: नीचे — बोलचाल में नीचे जाने या उतारने का शब्द
definition: down or downwards in colloquial spoken German, the short everyday form used for descending or lowering something
example: Komm bitte runter, das Essen ist fertig. — Please come down, dinner is ready.

hindi: फिसलपट्टी — चिकनी ढलान जिस पर बच्चे ऊपर से फिसलकर नीचे आते हैं
definition: a slide, the smooth sloping playground chute that children climb up and glide down on their bottoms (die Rutsche, plural Rutschen)
example: Die kleine Rutsche ist für Kinder unter drei Jahren. — The small slide is for children under three.

hindi: फिसलना — चिकनी सतह पर सरकना, या फिसलपट्टी पर खेलना
definition: to slide or slip along a smooth surface, also to move along a bench to make room (regular: ist gerutscht)
example: Die Kinder rutschen im Winter den Hang hinunter. — In winter the children slide down the slope.

hindi: पहेली — सुलझाने के लिए दी गई गुत्थी
definition: a riddle or puzzle, a question or problem posed to be solved for amusement, also a mystery (das Rätsel, plural Rätsel)
example: Das Rätsel in der Zeitung war heute schwer. — The puzzle in the newspaper was hard today.

hindi: बेदख़ली — किरायेदार को ज़बरन मकान से निकालना
definition: an eviction or clearing-out, the enforced removal of a tenant from a flat by court order (die Räumung, plural Räumungen)
example: Das Gericht hat die Räumung der Wohnung angeordnet. — The court ordered the eviction from the flat.

hindi: कसे आलू की कुरकुरी टिकिया — मक्खन में सेंकी गई स्विस राष्ट्रीय डिश
definition: a flat golden cake of grated potatoes fried crisp in butter, the Swiss national dish served with sausage or fried eggs (die Rösti, plural Rösti)
example: Die Rösti wird mit Spiegelei serviert. — The potato rösti is served with a fried egg.

hindi: उस पार — बोलचाल में दूसरी तरफ़ जाने का शब्द
definition: over or across in colloquial spoken German, the short everyday form for crossing to the other side
example: Komm doch kurz rüber auf einen Kaffee. — Come over for a quick coffee.

hindi: पीठ — गर्दन से कमर तक शरीर का पिछला भाग
definition: the back, the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders down to the waist (der Rücken, plural Rücken)
example: Mein Rücken schmerzt nach dem Umzug. — My back aches after the move.

hindi: प्रतिक्रिया — किसी संदेश या काम पर वापस दी गई राय या उत्तर
definition: feedback or a reply, the response someone sends back after receiving a message, proposal or piece of work (die Rückmeldung, plural Rückmeldungen)
example: Ich warte noch auf eine Rückmeldung vom Kunden. — I am still waiting for feedback from the customer.

hindi: जवाबी फ़ोन — छूटी हुई बात के जवाब में किया गया टेलीफ़ोन
definition: a return phone call made in response to a missed call or a request to ring back (der Rückruf, plural Rückrufe)
example: Ich warte noch auf einen Rückruf vom Arzt. — I am still waiting for a return call from the doctor.

hindi: लिहाज़ — दूसरों की ज़रूरतों का ध्यान रखना
definition: consideration or regard for other people, the care taken not to disturb or harm neighbours, passengers and strangers (die Rücksicht, plural Rücksichten)
example: Die Rücksicht auf die Nachbarn ist hier wichtig. — Consideration for the neighbours is important here.

hindi: बेलिहाज़ — दूसरों की परवाह किए बिना अपना करने वाला
definition: inconsiderate and ruthless, acting without any regard for the feelings, safety or needs of other people
example: Er fährt rücksichtslos und viel zu schnell. — He drives recklessly and far too fast.

hindi: लिहाज़ रखने वाला — दूसरों की भावनाओं और सुविधा का ध्यान रखने वाला
definition: considerate and thoughtful, careful to respect the feelings and needs of other people around you
example: Er ist ein rücksichtsvoller Fahrer. — He is a considerate driver.

hindi: परामर्श — फ़ैसले से पहले किसी से थोड़ी बातचीत करना
definition: a brief consultation with someone before deciding, the short talk you hold with a colleague or superior to check back (die Rücksprache, plural Rücksprachen)
example: Nach einer kurzen Rücksprache mit dem Chef melde ich mich wieder. — After a short consultation with the boss I will get back to you.

hindi: पीछे की ओर — उलटी दिशा में, पीठ की तरफ़
definition: backwards, moving in the reverse direction with one's back leading, the word for reversing a car or stepping back
example: Er fährt rückwärts aus der Garage. — He reverses out of the garage.

hindi: गाजर — नारंगी जड़ वाली सब्ज़ी, स्विस शब्द
definition: a carrot, the crunchy orange root vegetable, the everyday Swiss word where Germany says Karotte or Möhre, famous through the Aargau carrot cake (das Rüebli, plural Rüebli)
example: Das Rüebli wird fein gerieben in den Kuchen gemischt. — The carrot is finely grated into the cake.

hindi: अंडे की भुर्जी — फेंटकर तले नरम अंडे
definition: scrambled eggs, the beaten eggs stirred in a hot pan until softly set, a breakfast and quick supper favourite (das Rührei, plural Rühreier)
example: Zum Frühstück mache ich uns Rührei. — For breakfast I am making us scrambled eggs.

hindi: हिलाना — चम्मच से घुमाकर मिलाना
definition: to stir a liquid or mixture with a spoon in circles so that it blends and does not stick (regular: rührt, hat gerührt)
example: Rühr die Soße langsam mit dem Löffel. — Stir the sauce slowly with the spoon.

hindi: उपनगरीय रेल — शहर और आसपास के इलाकों को जोड़ने वाली तेज़ स्थानीय गाड़ी
definition: a suburban rapid transit train that links a city centre with its surrounding towns and districts (die S-Bahn, plural S-Bahnen)
example: Die S-Bahn zum Flughafen fährt von Gleis zwei. — The suburban train to the airport leaves from track two.

hindi: प्रकरण अधिकारी — दफ़्तर में आपकी फ़ाइल सँभालने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: the clerk or case officer at an office or company who handles a particular file, application or customer account (der Sachbearbeiter, plural Sachbearbeiter)
example: Mein Sachbearbeiter ist diese Woche leider im Urlaub. — Unfortunately my case officer is on holiday this week.

hindi: ज्ञानवर्धक पुस्तक — किसी विषय पर तथ्य समझाने वाली गैर-काल्पनिक किताब
definition: a non-fiction book that explains a factual subject such as science, history or health for general readers (das Sachbuch, plural Sachbücher)
example: Er liest lieber ein Sachbuch als einen Roman. — He prefers reading a non-fiction book to a novel.

hindi: वस्तुनिष्ठ — भावना के बिना, तथ्यों पर आधारित
definition: objective or matter-of-fact, sticking to the facts of the matter without emotion or personal attack
example: Bleiben wir bitte sachlich. — Let us please stay objective.

hindi: बोरा — आटा, आलू या कोयला भरने का बड़ा मोटा थैला
definition: a sack, the large coarse bag of cloth or plastic for potatoes, flour, coal or rubbish (der Sack, plural Säcke)
example: Der Sack Kartoffeln wiegt zehn Kilo. — The sack of potatoes weighs ten kilos.

hindi: छोटी थैली — दुकान से मिलने वाला प्लास्टिक या कागज़ का बैग
definition: a small bag or sack, especially the plastic or paper carrier bag handed over at a shop, in its Austrian diminutive form where Germany says Tüte (das Sackerl, plural Sackerln)
example: Brauchen Sie ein Sackerl für das Obst? — Do you need a bag for the fruit?

hindi: बंद गली — जिसका आगे कोई रास्ता न निकले; गतिरोध
definition: a dead-end street with no way through, also figuratively a situation or plan that leads nowhere (die Sackgasse, plural Sackgassen)
example: Wir sind in eine Sackgasse gefahren und mussten wenden. — We drove into a dead end and had to turn around.

hindi: जेब का चाकू — मोड़कर जेब में रखने वाला बहुउपयोगी चाकू, स्विस शब्द
definition: a folding pocket knife, often with several blades and tools, the Swiss word where Germany says Taschenmesser (das Sackmesser, plural Sackmesser)
example: Mit dem Sackmesser schneide ich den Apfel. — I am cutting the apple with my pocket knife.

hindi: रस — सेब या संतरे जैसे फलों से निचोड़ा हुआ पेय
definition: juice, the liquid pressed from fruit such as apples or oranges, drunk cold as a soft drink (der Saft, plural Säfte)
example: Der Saft ist frisch gepresst. — The juice is freshly squeezed.

hindi: रसीला — जिसमें बहुत रस भरा हो; बोलचाल में बहुत महंगा भी
definition: juicy, full of liquid like a ripe peach or a good steak, and colloquially steep when said of a price or fine (regular comparison: saftiger, am saftigsten)
example: Die Birnen sind schön saftig. — The pears are nice and juicy.

hindi: ज़रा बताओ — सवाल शुरू करने का जुमला
definition: tell me, say; a casual opener before a question, sometimes with a note of surprise or reproach
example: Sag mal, hast du meine Nachricht gelesen? — Tell me, did you read my message?

hindi: कहना — मुँह से कोई बात बोलकर बताना
definition: to say or state something aloud, the most basic everyday verb for putting words into speech (regular: sagt, hat gesagt)
example: Was hast du gerade gesagt? — What did you just say?

hindi: मलाई — दूध की गाढ़ी चिकनी ऊपरी परत, क्रीम
definition: cream, the rich fatty part of milk used in sauces and whipped for cake and coffee, whipped cream being Schlagsahne (die Sahne, no plural)
example: Die Sahne muss steif geschlagen werden. — The cream has to be whipped stiff.

hindi: सोने पर सुहागा — पहले से अच्छी चीज़ पर आखिरी सुंदर चीज़
definition: the finishing touch that makes something good even better, literally the little cap of cream (das Sahnehäubchen, plural Sahnehäubchen)
example: Der Sonnenuntergang war das Sahnehäubchen auf einem perfekten Tag. — The sunset was the cherry on top of a perfect day.

hindi: सूखा भरवाँ गोश्त — सख़्त, मसालेदार, पतली फाँकों में कटा
definition: salami, the hard dry cured sausage cut into thin slices for bread, pizza and snack platters, among the most bought cold cuts (die Salami, plural Salamis)
example: Die Salami ist ziemlich scharf. — The salami is quite spicy.

hindi: सलाद — कच्ची सब्ज़ियों का ठंडा व्यंजन; हरी पत्तेदार सब्ज़ी भी
definition: salad, a cold dish of raw or cooked vegetables in dressing, and also the leafy green lettuce it is made from (der Salat, plural Salate)
example: Zum Abendessen gibt es nur einen Salat. — For dinner there is only a salad.

hindi: मरहम — त्वचा पर लगाने वाली चिकनी दवा
definition: an ointment or cream, the greasy medicinal paste that is spread on the skin to heal wounds and rashes (die Salbe, plural Salben)
example: Die Salbe zweimal am Tag dünn auftragen. — Apply the ointment thinly twice a day.

hindi: नमक — खाने का स्वाद बढ़ाने वाला सफ़ेद खनिज
definition: salt, the white crystalline mineral sprinkled on food to season it and bring out the flavour (das Salz, plural Salze)
example: Das Salz steht neben dem Pfeffer. — The salt is next to the pepper.

hindi: नमक डालना — खाने में नमक मिलाना
definition: to salt food, adding salt to soup, water or a dish to season it properly (irregular perfect: salzt, hat gesalzen)
example: Salz das Nudelwasser gut. — Salt the pasta water well.

hindi: नमकीन — जिसमें नमक का स्वाद हो
definition: salty in taste, containing much salt, used for food, sea water and tears
example: Die Chips sind ziemlich salzig. — The crisps are quite salty.

hindi: बीज — जिससे बोने पर नया पौधा उगता है
definition: a seed, the small grain from which a new plant grows when it is sown in soil (der Samen, plural Samen)
example: Im März säe ich die Samen im Garten aus. — In March I sow the seeds in the garden.

hindi: संग्रह करना — शौक से चीज़ें इकट्ठा करना
definition: to collect, to gather and keep objects of one kind as a hobby, or to gather things together (regular: hat gesammelt)
example: Mein Bruder sammelt alte Münzen. — My brother collects old coins.

hindi: संग्रह — शौक से इकट्ठी की गई चीज़ों का समूह
definition: a collection, a set of objects gathered and kept together by a private collector or a museum (die Sammlung, plural Sammlungen)
example: Seine Sammlung umfasst über tausend Briefmarken. — His collection includes more than a thousand stamps.

hindi: शनिवार — सप्ताहांत का पहला दिन
definition: Saturday, the first day of the weekend when shops are open but most offices close (der Samstag, plural Samstage)
example: Am Samstag kaufe ich auf dem Markt ein. — On Saturday I shop at the market.

hindi: समेत — किसी के साथ-साथ, सब मिलाकर
definition: together with, including everything or everyone that belongs with the main thing mentioned (preposition, + Dativ)
example: Das Haus wurde samt Garten verkauft. — The house was sold together with the garden.

hindi: रेत — बहुत महीन पत्थर के कण
definition: sand, the loose grains of finely crushed rock found on beaches and in deserts (der Sand, plural Sande)
example: Der Sand am Strand ist heiß. — The sand on the beach is hot.

hindi: खुली चप्पल — पट्टियों वाला गर्मी का खुला जूता
definition: a sandal, the open summer shoe with straps that leaves the foot mostly uncovered (die Sandale, plural Sandalen)
example: Die Sandale hat einen kaputten Riemen. — The sandal has a broken strap.

hindi: बालू का खेल-कुंड — बच्चों के खोदने-बनाने के लिए बालू भरा घेरा
definition: a sandpit or sandbox, the wooden frame filled with sand where small children dig and build on playgrounds (der Sandkasten, plural Sandkästen)
example: Die Kinder bauen im Sandkasten eine große Burg. — The children are building a large castle in the sandpit.

hindi: बचपन का दोस्त — रेत के घरौंदे बनाने के दिनों से जुड़ा मित्र
definition: a childhood friend known since the earliest playground years, literally a friend from the sandbox, warm and nostalgic (der Sandkastenfreund, plural Sandkastenfreunde)
example: Max ist mein Sandkastenfreund, wir kennen uns seit dreißig Jahren. — Max is my childhood friend, we have known each other thirty years.

hindi: आपात चिकित्साकर्मी — रोगीवाहन में प्राथमिक उपचार देने वाला प्रशिक्षित कर्मी
definition: a paramedic or medical orderly, the trained ambulance worker who gives first aid and transports patients (der Sanitäter, plural Sanitäter)
example: Die Sanitäter versorgten den Verletzten am Straßenrand. — The paramedics treated the injured man at the roadside.

hindi: ताबूत — मृत शरीर रखने का लकड़ी का बक्सा
definition: a coffin, the long wooden box in which a dead body is placed for burial (der Sarg, plural Särge)
example: Sechs Männer trugen den Sarg zum Grab. — Six men carried the coffin to the grave.

hindi: अघाया हुआ — पेट भरा, और खाने की इच्छा नहीं
definition: full after eating enough food, no longer hungry and wanting nothing more
example: Danke, ich bin satt. — Thank you, I am full.

hindi: स्वच्छ — गंदगी और धब्बों से मुक्त
definition: clean, free of dirt, dust and stains, describing a freshly washed or wiped surface, garment or room (regular adjective)
example: Endlich ist das Badezimmer wieder sauber. — Finally the bathroom is clean again.

hindi: साफ़ कर देना — किसी गंदी चीज़ को बोलचाल में साफ़ करना
definition: to clean something up, the relaxed colloquial everyday phrase for making a dirty room, table or child clean again (macht sauber, hat sauber gemacht)
example: Kannst du bitte den Tisch sauber machen? — Can you please clean the table?

hindi: नाराज़ — किसी से खफ़ा (बोलचाल; मूल अर्थ खट्टा)
definition: annoyed or cross, the colloquial everyday word for being angry with someone, literally sour
example: Meine Schwester ist sauer auf mich. — My sister is cross with me.

hindi: खट्टा भुना मांस — सिरके में कई दिन मैरिनेट करके धीमी आँच पर पका गोमांस
definition: a pot roast of beef marinated for days in vinegar and spices before slow braising, a classic Sunday meat dish (der Sauerbraten, plural Sauerbraten)
example: Der Sauerbraten von Oma schmeckt sonntags am besten. — Grandma's sauerbraten tastes best on Sundays.

hindi: खमीर उठाई खट्टी गोभी — बारीक कटी पत्तागोभी को नमक में खमीराकर बनाया खट्टा साग
definition: finely shredded white cabbage fermented in salt until sour, served warm beside sausage and pork (das Sauerkraut, no plural)
example: Das Sauerkraut passt gut zu den Würstchen. — The sauerkraut goes well with the sausages.

hindi: खट्टा ख़मीर — प्राकृतिक उठान वाला खमीरा आटा
definition: sourdough, the naturally fermented starter dough that gives traditional German rye bread its tang and long shelf life (der Sauerteig, plural Sauerteige)
example: Der Sauerteig muss über Nacht ruhen. — The sourdough has to rest overnight.

hindi: शराब पीना — बोलचाल में जमकर दारू पीना
definition: to booze or drink alcohol heavily, colloquial and blunt, also the neutral word for animals drinking (säuft, hat gesoffen)
example: Am Wochenende haben sie zu viel gesoffen. — At the weekend they drank far too much.

hindi: वैक्यूम करना — मशीन से फ़र्श या कालीन की धूल खींचना
definition: to vacuum the floor or carpet with a vacuum cleaner, the short everyday form of staubsaugen (in this sense regular: saugt, hat gesaugt)
example: Ich sauge einmal in der Woche. — I vacuum once a week.

hindi: भाप-स्नान कक्ष — पसीना बहाने वाला गर्म लकड़ी का कमरा
definition: a sauna, a heated wooden room where people sweat to relax and cleanse the body (die Sauna, plural Saunen)
example: Nach dem Schwimmen gehen wir in die Sauna. — After swimming we go to the sauna.

hindi: सनसनाते हुए दौड़ना — बहुत तेज़ रफ़्तार से निकल जाना
definition: to whizz or zoom along at great speed, often with a rushing sound; colloquially to dash somewhere (regular: ist gesaust)
example: Der Radfahrer saust den Berg hinunter. — The cyclist zooms down the hill.

hindi: शतरंज — चौंसठ खानों पर खेला जाने वाला बुद्धि का खेल
definition: chess, the strategy board game for two players with sixteen pieces each (das Schach, no plural)
example: Im Schach ist die Dame die stärkste Figur. — In chess the queen is the strongest piece.

hindi: गत्ते की डिबिया — जूते, माचिस या मिठाई रखने का छोटा डिब्बा
definition: a small box of cardboard or thin material, the kind that holds matches, shoes, chocolates or cigarettes (die Schachtel, plural Schachteln)
example: Die Schuhe sind noch in der Schachtel. — The shoes are still in the box.

hindi: अफ़सोस — खेद की बात, दुख की बात
definition: a pity, a shame, regrettable; used predicatively to express mild disappointment about something
example: Schade, dass du nicht mitkommen kannst. — A pity that you cannot come along.

hindi: नुक़सान — किसी चीज़ को पहुँची क्षति या हानि
definition: damage or harm done to property or a person, the loss that an insurance or a court may compensate (der Schaden, plural Schäden)
example: Der Schaden am Auto beträgt tausend Euro. — The damage to the car comes to a thousand euros.

hindi: परपीड़ा-सुख — दूसरे के दुर्भाग्य पर छिपी खुशी
definition: the quiet and faintly shameful enjoyment a person feels when misfortune lands on somebody else
example: There was open Schadenfreude in the office when the loudest forecast collapsed.

hindi: हानिकारक पदार्थ — पर्यावरण या शरीर को नुक़सान पहुँचाने वाला रसायन
definition: a pollutant, a harmful substance or chemical that damages the environment, plants or human health (der Schadstoff, plural Schadstoffe)
example: Das Wasser enthält keine Schadstoffe mehr. — The water no longer contains any pollutants.

hindi: भेड़ — ऊन देने वाला खेत का जानवर
definition: a sheep, the woolly farm animal kept in flocks for its wool, milk and meat (das Schaf, plural Schafe)
example: Das Schaf grast auf dem Hügel. — The sheep is grazing on the hill.

hindi: रचना, सृजन करना — कोई नई चीज़ अस्तित्व में लाना
definition: to create or bring something new into existence, such as jobs, artworks or space; in the everyday sense of managing or accomplishing something it is regular (irregular: schuf, hat geschaffen; regular when managing: hat geschafft)
example: Die Firma hat hundert neue Arbeitsplätze geschaffen. — The company has created a hundred new jobs.

hindi: यात्रा-पत्र जाँचक — रेल में किराया-पर्चियाँ जाँचने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: a train conductor, the railway employee who checks tickets and helps passengers on board (der Schaffner, plural Schaffner)
example: Der Schaffner kontrolliert gerade die Fahrkarten. — The conductor is checking the tickets right now.

hindi: मफ़लर/शॉल — गले में लपेटा जाने वाला लंबा कपड़ा
definition: a scarf, the long strip of fabric or knitted wool wrapped around the neck for warmth (der Schal, plural Schals)
example: Sie wickelt sich den Schal um den Hals. — She wraps the scarf around her neck.

hindi: छिलका या छोटा कटोरा — फल का बाहरी आवरण, या उथला पात्र
definition: a peel or skin of fruit and vegetables, and also a small shallow bowl for fruit or nuts (die Schale, plural Schalen)
example: Die Schale der Orange ist sehr dick. — The peel of the orange is very thick.

hindi: सेवा खिड़की — स्टेशन या बैंक की खिड़की जहाँ सेवा मिलती है; बिजली का बटन भी
definition: a counter or service window at a station, bank or airport where tickets and help are given; also an electric switch (der Schalter, plural Schalter)
example: Am Schalter gibt es Fahrkarten und Auskunft. — At the counter there are tickets and information.

hindi: अधिवर्ष — हर चौथा साल जिसमें फ़रवरी में एक दिन अधिक होता है
definition: a leap year, the year every four years in which February gains an extra twenty-ninth day (das Schaltjahr, plural Schaltjahre)
example: Dieses Jahr ist ein Schaltjahr. — This year is a leap year.

hindi: लज्जा — ग़लती या भेद खुलने पर होने वाली शर्मिंदगी
definition: shame, the painful embarrassed feeling of having done something wrong or been exposed (die Scham, no plural)
example: Die Scham ließ ihn ganz rot werden. — The shame made him go completely red.

hindi: तीखा, तेज़ — मिर्च जैसा या पैना
definition: spicy and hot in taste like chilli, also sharp for a knife or a clearly focused image
example: Das Curry ist mir zu scharf. — The curry is too spicy for me.

hindi: ख़ज़ाना, जानू — प्रेमी को पुकारने का प्यारा संबोधन
definition: a treasure, and the most common German pet name for a partner or child, like darling or sweetheart (der Schatz, plural Schätze)
example: Mein Schatz, hast du die Schlüssel gesehen? — Darling, have you seen the keys?

hindi: देखना, निहारना — जान-बूझकर नज़र डालना
definition: to look or gaze deliberately at something with the eyes, common in southern Germany and Austria alongside sehen (regular)
example: Schau mal, da drüben ist ein Regenbogen! — Look, there is a rainbow over there!

hindi: बौछार — थोड़ी देर की तेज़ बारिश
definition: a shower, a short burst of rain that starts suddenly and passes quickly within minutes (der Schauer, plural Schauer)
example: Am Nachmittag gibt es einen kurzen Schauer. — In the afternoon there is a short shower.

hindi: झूला — रस्सियों पर टँगी सीट जिस पर बच्चे आगे-पीछे झूलते हैं
definition: a swing, the hanging seat on ropes or chains that children push back and forth on playgrounds (die Schaukel, plural Schaukeln)
example: Kannst du mich auf der Schaukel anschubsen? — Can you give me a push on the swing?

hindi: अभिनेता — फ़िल्म या नाटक में भूमिका निभाने वाला
definition: an actor, the person who plays a role in a film, television series or theatre play (der Schauspieler, plural Schauspieler)
example: Der Schauspieler bekam einen Preis für seine Rolle. — The actor received a prize for his role.

hindi: फाँक — रोटी, पनीर या भरवाँ गोश्त का कटा पतला टुकड़ा
definition: a slice, the thin flat piece cut from bread, cheese or sausage, also the word for a pane of glass (die Scheibe, plural Scheiben)
example: Die Scheibe Brot ist sehr dünn. — The slice of bread is very thin.

hindi: तलाक़ — विवाह का क़ानूनी अंत
definition: the divorce, the legal ending of a marriage by a court so that both spouses are free (die Scheidung, plural Scheidungen)
example: Nach der Scheidung zog sie nach München. — After the divorce she moved to Munich.

hindi: काग़ज़ी मुद्रा — काग़ज़ का पैसा; प्रमाणपत्र भी
definition: a banknote, paper money such as a ten-euro note, also a certificate or slip of paper proving something (der Schein, plural Scheine)
example: Können Sie einen Fünfzig-Euro-Schein wechseln? — Can you change a fifty-euro note?

hindi: लगना — प्रतीत होना; सूरज का चमकना
definition: to seem or appear a certain way, giving an impression, and also of the sun or a lamp to shine brightly (irregular: scheint, schien, hat geschienen)
example: Heute scheint die Sonne den ganzen Tag. — Today the sun is shining all day.

hindi: अग्र-दीप — गाड़ी के आगे की तेज़ रोशनी
definition: a headlight, the bright lamp at the front of a vehicle that lights the road at night (der Scheinwerfer, plural Scheinwerfer)
example: Ein Scheinwerfer ist kaputt, du musst ihn wechseln. — One headlight is broken, you have to replace it.

hindi: असफल होना — कोशिश के बावजूद काम बिगड़ जाना, नाकाम होना
definition: to fail, collapse or fall through despite the attempt, said of plans, projects and people (an + Dativ; ist gescheitert)
example: Der Plan ist am fehlenden Geld gescheitert. — The plan failed for lack of money.

hindi: उपहार देना — किसी को तोहफ़े के रूप में कुछ देना
definition: to give something as a present, to hand over a gift to someone at Christmas or a birthday (regular, + Dativ)
example: Ich schenke meiner Mutter ein Buch. — I am giving my mother a book as a present.

hindi: खलिहान — घास, अनाज और मशीनें रखने का बड़ा भवन
definition: a barn, the large farm building where hay, straw, grain and machines are stored (die Scheune, plural Scheunen)
example: In der Scheune lagert das Heu für den Winter. — The hay for winter is stored in the barn.

hindi: घिनौना — बहुत बदसूरत या बुरा, अरुचिकर
definition: hideous, ghastly, awful; disapproval of something ugly, disgusting or thoroughly unpleasant
example: Die Tapete im Flur ist scheußlich. — The wallpaper in the hallway is hideous.

hindi: पारी — कारखाने या अस्पताल में काम का तय समय-खंड
definition: a shift, one fixed working period in a factory, hospital or other place that operates around the clock (die Schicht, plural Schichten)
example: Meine Schicht beginnt heute um sechs Uhr. — My shift starts at six o'clock today.

hindi: पाली का काम — सुबह, शाम या रात की बदलती पालियों में काम
definition: shift work, a schedule in which employees work in rotating early, late or night shifts (die Schichtarbeit, no plural)
example: Die Schichtarbeit im Krankenhaus ist anstrengend. — The shift work in the hospital is exhausting.

hindi: सजीला — देखने में सुरुचिपूर्ण और आकर्षक
definition: chic or smart, said of clothes and people that look stylish, elegant and well dressed
example: Du siehst heute richtig schick aus. — You look really smart today.

hindi: भेजना — किसी को संदेश, चीज़ या व्यक्ति रवाना करना
definition: to send something or someone to a place or person, the everyday spoken word for mailing a message, parcel or email (regular)
example: Schick mir bitte das Foto per Handy. — Please send me the photo by phone.

hindi: धकेलना — किसी चीज़ को आगे की ओर ठेलना
definition: to push or shove something along a surface away from yourself, like a trolley or a heavy wardrobe (schob, hat geschoben)
example: Er schiebt den Einkaufswagen zur Kasse. — He pushes the shopping trolley to the checkout.

hindi: निर्णायक — खेल में नियम लागू करने वाला अधिकारी
definition: a referee or umpire, the official who enforces the rules during a match and decides fouls and goals (der Schiedsrichter, plural Schiedsrichter)
example: Der Schiedsrichter zeigte die gelbe Karte. — The referee showed the yellow card.

hindi: तिरछा, झुका — सीधा या समतल न होकर एक ओर ढला
definition: crooked, slanting or lopsided, leaning to one side instead of being straight or level, like a tilted picture frame
example: Das Bild hängt schief an der Wand. — The picture hangs crooked on the wall.

hindi: चित्रण करना — किसी घटना का सजीव विवरण देना
definition: to depict or recount events vividly and in detail, especially personal experiences (regular: schildert, hat geschildert)
example: Sie schilderte den Unfall sehr genau. — She described the accident very precisely.

hindi: कछुआ — कठोर खोल वाला धीमा जीव
definition: a tortoise or turtle, the slow reptile that carries a hard protective shell on its back, literally a shield toad (die Schildkröte, plural Schildkröten)
example: Die Schildkröte im Garten ist über vierzig Jahre alt. — The tortoise in the garden is over forty years old.

hindi: फफूँद — नम दीवारों पर उगने वाली काली-सलेटी परत
definition: mould, the black or grey fungus that grows on damp walls and causes tenant disputes (der Schimmel, no plural)
example: Der Schimmel wächst an der Decke im Badezimmer. — The mould is growing on the bathroom ceiling.

hindi: डाँटना — गुस्से में ज़ोर से बुरा-भला कहना
definition: to scold or rant angrily at someone, grumbling loudly and harshly about their behaviour or about a situation (regular: schimpft, hat geschimpft; mit + Dativ, über + Akkusativ)
example: Die Mutter schimpfte mit den Kindern. — The mother scolded the children.

hindi: सूअर की जाँघ का माँस — नमक या धुएँ से सुखाया, पतली फाँकों में
definition: ham, the cured or smoked pork from a pig's hind leg, served in thin slices on bread or wrapped around asparagus (der Schinken, plural Schinken)
example: Der Schinken ist sehr salzig. — The ham is very salty.

hindi: कसाई — उत्तरी जर्मनी में मांस बेचने वाला दुकानदार
definition: the northern German word for a butcher who slaughters animals and sells meat, heard around Hamburg and Bremen where the south says Metzger (der Schlachter, plural Schlachter)
example: Beim Schlachter gibt es heute frische Bratwurst. — There is fresh bratwurst at the butcher today.

hindi: नींद — रात के विश्राम की अवस्था जिसमें शरीर ताज़ा होता है
definition: sleep, the nightly state of rest in which the body and mind recover their strength (der Schlaf, no plural)
example: Der Schlaf ist wichtig für die Gesundheit. — Sleep is important for your health.

hindi: सोने का पहनावा — रात को सोने के लिए पहना जाने वाला ढीला कपड़ा
definition: pyjamas, the loose comfortable two-piece garment that people wear in bed at night (der Schlafanzug, plural Schlafanzüge)
example: Der Schlafanzug liegt unter dem Kissen. — The pyjamas are under the pillow.

hindi: सोना — रात में आँखें मूँदकर विश्राम करना
definition: to sleep, resting with eyes closed and the mind unconscious through the night (irregular: schläft, hat geschlafen)
example: Hast du gut geschlafen? — Did you sleep well?

hindi: लोरी — शिशु को सुलाने के लिए धीमे स्वर में गाया जाने वाला गीत
definition: a lullaby, the soft gentle song sung to a baby or small child to lull them to sleep (das Schlaflied, plural Schlaflieder)
example: Sie singt dem Baby leise ein Schlaflied. — She softly sings the baby a lullaby.

hindi: नींद की टोपी — देर तक सोने वाला या सुस्त और धीमा व्यक्ति
definition: a sleepy sluggish person who oversleeps in the morning or reacts slowly and dozily, literally a nightcap, affectionate colloquial teasing (die Schlafmütze, plural Schlafmützen)
example: Aufstehen, Schlafmütze, der Bus kommt in zehn Minuten! — Get up, sleepyhead, the bus comes in ten minutes!

hindi: शयनकक्ष — सोने का कमरा जहाँ पलंग रहता है
definition: the bedroom, the room of a home where people sleep and keep their bed and clothes (das Schlafzimmer, plural Schlafzimmer)
example: Das Schlafzimmer liegt im ersten Stock. — The bedroom is on the first floor.

hindi: मारना — किसी पर प्रहार करना; खेल में हराना
definition: to hit or strike someone or something forcefully, and also to beat an opponent in a game (irregular: schlägt, schlug, hat geschlagen)
example: Die Uhr schlägt zwölf. — The clock is striking twelve.

hindi: फेंटी हुई मलाई — केक और कॉफ़ी पर सजाने की झागदार क्रीम
definition: whipped cream, the fluffy sweetened cream heaped onto cakes and coffee, in its Austrian name where Germany says Schlagsahne (das Schlagobers, no plural)
example: Das Schlagobers auf der Torte ist ganz frisch. — The whipped cream on the cake is really fresh.

hindi: सुर्ख़ी — अख़बार के पहले पन्ने की बड़ी मोटी हेडलाइन
definition: a headline, the large bold line across the front page that announces the biggest story of the day (die Schlagzeile, plural Schlagzeilen)
example: Die Schlagzeile war heute wieder riesig. — The headline was huge again today.

hindi: ताल वाद्य समूह — बैंड में एक व्यक्ति के बजाए ढोल और झाँझ
definition: a drum kit, the set of drums and cymbals played by one person in a rock, jazz or pop band (das Schlagzeug, plural Schlagzeuge)
example: Mein Bruder sitzt in der Band am Schlagzeug. — My brother sits at the drums in the band.

hindi: फूहड़ — गंदे, बेतरतीब और लापरवाह ढंग से काम करने वाला
definition: sloppy and slovenly, untidy and careless in work or appearance, a colloquial and rather harsh judgement
example: Die Hausaufgaben waren schlampig gemacht. — The homework was done sloppily.

hindi: कतार — पंक्ति में खड़े लोग; साँप भी
definition: a queue or line of people waiting at a checkout or counter, the same word that also means snake (die Schlange, plural Schlangen)
example: An der Kasse ist eine lange Schlange. — There's a long queue at the checkout.

hindi: क़तार में लगना — बारी के लिए लाइन में खड़े रहना
definition: to stand in line and wait one's turn at a counter, ticket office or bakery, an unwritten rule of fairness in public places
example: Vor der Bäckerei stehen die Leute Schlange. — People are queuing in front of the bakery.

hindi: छरहरा — पतला और सुडौल
definition: slim or slender in build, thin in an attractive healthy way, used of people, figures and elegant shapes
example: Sie ist groß und schlank. — She is tall and slim.

hindi: ढीला-ढाला — कमज़ोर और सुस्त महसूस करना
definition: limp and listless, feeling weak, sluggish and without energy, often just before an illness starts
example: Ich fühle mich heute irgendwie schlapp. — I feel somehow listless today.

hindi: चतुर — चालाकी और होशियारी से काम निकालने वाला
definition: clever and cunning, smart in a shrewd or sly way, often said admiringly of a quick-witted person or animal
example: Der Fuchs ist ein schlaues Tier. — The fox is a cunning animal.

hindi: बुरा — ख़राब, घटिया
definition: poor in quality, inferior or unpleasant, the basic negative word for weather, food, grades and moods
example: Das Wetter ist heute schlecht. — The weather is bad today.

hindi: दबे पाँव चलना — चुपचाप बिना आहट के चलना
definition: to creep or sneak along quietly and slowly so that nobody notices you, also to crawl along at low speed (irregular: schlich, ist geschlichen)
example: Sie schleicht leise aus dem Zimmer. — She sneaks quietly out of the room.

hindi: घिसना — रेगमाल से सतह चिकनी करना
definition: to sand or grind a rough surface smooth with sandpaper or a grinding machine, or to sharpen a blade (irregular: schleift, hat geschliffen)
example: Er schleift das Holz vor dem Lackieren. — He sands the wood before varnishing.

hindi: टहलते हुए घूमना — बिना जल्दी के धीरे-धीरे चलना
definition: to stroll or saunter along slowly and without any hurry, walking in a relaxed unhurried manner (regular: ist geschlendert)
example: Wir schlendern durch die Altstadt und schauen in die Läden. — We stroll through the old town and look into the shops.

hindi: घसीटना — भारी बोझ मुश्किल से ढोकर ले जाना
definition: to drag or lug something heavy with great effort, often used with a tone of complaint (regular: hat geschleppt)
example: Wir mussten die Kisten in den fünften Stock schleppen. — We had to lug the boxes up to the fifth floor.

hindi: बंद करना — दरवाज़ा, खिड़की या दुकान बंद करना
definition: to close or shut a door, window, lid or shop, and to conclude a contract or friendship (schloss, hat geschlossen)
example: Das Geschäft schließt um acht Uhr. — The shop closes at eight.

hindi: अंततः, आख़िरकार — लम्बे क्रम के अंत में
definition: finally, eventually, at the end of a long sequence of events, also meaning after all when giving a reason
example: Schließlich haben wir den Weg gefunden. — Finally we found the way.

hindi: बुरा — गंभीर, हानिकारक, चिंताजनक
definition: serious, grave, harmfully bad; describes trouble, injury or news that is worrying or harmful
example: Ist es schlimm, wenn ich später komme? — Is it bad if I come later?

hindi: बर्फ़-जूता — बर्फ़ पर फिसलने का धार वाला जूता
definition: an ice skate, the boot with a metal blade for gliding on ice, used in the phrase Schlittschuh laufen for skating (der Schlittschuh, plural Schlittschuhe)
example: Der linke Schlittschuh drückt am Knöchel. — The left skate pinches at the ankle.

hindi: महल — राजाओं का शानदार निवास; ताला
definition: a palace or stately castle once home to princes and now often a museum, also a lock on a door (das Schloss, plural Schlösser)
example: Wir besichtigen morgen das Schloss. — We are visiting the palace tomorrow.

hindi: खड्ड — चट्टानों के बीच गहरी संकरी दरार
definition: a gorge or ravine, a deep narrow valley with steep rocky walls cut by a river (die Schlucht, plural Schluchten)
example: Durch die Schlucht führt ein schmaler Weg. — A narrow path leads through the gorge.

hindi: घूँट — एक बार में निगला गया तरल
definition: a sip, gulp or mouthful of drink, the small amount of water, coffee or other liquid swallowed at one time (der Schluck, plural Schlucke)
example: Trink einen Schluck Wasser. — Drink a sip of water.

hindi: रिश्ता तोड़ना — प्रेम-संबंध ख़त्म कर देना, बोलचाल
definition: to break up with someone and end the relationship, the colloquial everyday expression among young couples (macht Schluss, hat Schluss gemacht, mit + Dativ)
example: Sie hat per Nachricht mit ihm Schluss gemacht. — She broke up with him by text message.

hindi: निष्कर्ष — तर्क या तथ्यों से निकाला गया अंतिम नतीजा
definition: a conclusion or inference, the judgement logically drawn from facts and arguments at the end of reasoning (die Schlussfolgerung, plural Schlussfolgerungen)
example: Welche Schlussfolgerung ziehst du aus den Daten? — What conclusion do you draw from the data?

hindi: उनींदा — नींद से बोझिल आँखें, सोने को मन
definition: sleepy and drowsy, with heavy eyelids and a strong wish to fall asleep
example: Der warme Tee macht mich schläfrig. — The warm tea makes me sleepy.

hindi: बल्ला — गेंद मारने का हत्थेदार उपकरण
definition: a racket or bat, the handled implement used to strike the ball in tennis, badminton or table tennis (der Schläger, plural Schläger)
example: Mein Schläger braucht neue Saiten. — My racket needs new strings.

hindi: चाबी — ताला खोलने वाली धातु की चीज़
definition: a door key, the small metal piece that opens a lock, handed over at the start of a tenancy (der Schlüssel, plural Schlüssel)
example: Ich habe meinen Schlüssel in der Wohnung vergessen. — I left my key in the flat.

hindi: चाबियों का गुच्छा — छल्ले में बँधी कई चाबियाँ
definition: a bunch of keys held together on one ring, the jangling collection carried in a pocket or handbag (der Schlüsselbund, plural Schlüsselbunde)
example: Wo ist mein Schlüsselbund? Ich habe ihn schon wieder verlegt. — Where is my bunch of keys? I have misplaced it again.

hindi: चाबी सौंपना — किराये के शुरू या अंत में चाबी देने की मुलाक़ात
definition: the key handover, the meeting where landlord and tenant exchange keys and check the flat's condition (die Schlüsselübergabe, plural Schlüsselübergaben)
example: Die Schlüsselübergabe findet am Freitag statt. — The key handover takes place on Friday.

hindi: ज़ायकेदार — अच्छे स्वाद वाला, रुचिकर
definition: tasty, savoury, palatable; a slightly formal word for food that tastes pleasant
example: Die Suppe war einfach, aber sehr schmackhaft. — The soup was simple but very tasty.

hindi: सँकरा, तंग — किनारे से किनारे तक कम चौड़ाई वाला
definition: narrow or slim, measuring only a small distance from one side to the other, describing a narrow path, door or face
example: Die Gasse ist zu schmal für das Auto. — The alley is too narrow for the car.

hindi: खट्टी मलाई — गाढ़ी खट्टी क्रीम, सूप और केक में
definition: sour cream of a thick rich kind, stirred into soups, spread on onion tart and spooned over baked potatoes (der Schmand, no plural)
example: Der Schmand kommt zum Schluss in die Suppe. — The sour cream goes into the soup at the end.

hindi: स्वादिष्ट व्यंजन — बवेरिया और ऑस्ट्रिया में ख़ास लज़ीज़ चीज़ या मज़ेदार ख़ासियत
definition: the Bavarian and Austrian word for a tasty delicacy or special treat, and by extension any delightful little highlight (das Schmankerl, plural Schmankerln)
example: Der Wirt bringt uns ein Schmankerl aus der Küche. — The landlord brings us a delicacy from the kitchen.

hindi: बकवास — बवेरिया में फ़ालतू बात या बेतुकी चीज़
definition: the Bavarian and Austrian word for nonsense, rubbish or silly talk that deserves no attention, also a shredded pancake dish (der Schmarrn, plural Schmarrn)
example: Red keinen Schmarrn, das stimmt doch nicht! — Do not talk nonsense, that is simply not true!

hindi: स्वाद लेना/स्वाद होना — जीभ से स्वाद महसूस करना
definition: to taste, to perceive flavour with the tongue, or of food to have a certain flavour (regular; nach + Dativ)
example: Die Suppe schmeckt heute besonders gut. — The soup tastes especially good today.

hindi: दर्द — शरीर में चोट या रोग से होने वाली पीड़ा
definition: pain, the physical hurt felt in the body from injury or illness, mostly used in the plural (der Schmerz, plural Schmerzen)
example: Der Schmerz im Rücken wird schlimmer. — The pain in my back is getting worse.

hindi: तितली — रंगीन पंखों वाला उड़ने वाला कीट
definition: a butterfly, the insect with large colourful wings that flutters between flowers in summer (der Schmetterling, plural Schmetterlinge)
example: Ein bunter Schmetterling sitzt auf der Blume. — A colourful butterfly sits on the flower.

hindi: प्रेम की गुदगुदी होना — नए प्यार में पेट में हलचल-सी लगना
definition: to feel the fluttering excitement of being newly in love, the nervous thrill in the stomach
example: Seit dem ersten Date hat sie Schmetterlinge im Bauch. — Since the first date she has had butterflies in her stomach.

hindi: गहने/आभूषण — सजने के लिए पहने जाने वाली कीमती चीज़ें
definition: jewellery, the rings, necklaces and other ornaments people wear on the body for decoration (der Schmuck, no plural)
example: Der Schmuck liegt in einer kleinen Kiste. — The jewellery lies in a small box.

hindi: गंदा-गीला मौसम — ठंडा, धूसर, फुहार वाला उदास दिन
definition: colloquial word for grey, damp, drizzly and miserable weather that makes everything outside look dirty (das Schmuddelwetter, no plural)
example: Bei diesem Schmuddelwetter bleibe ich zu Hause. — In this miserable weather I stay at home.

hindi: गंदा — मैल, धूल या दाग से भरा
definition: dirty, covered with dirt, dust or stains and needing to be cleaned, the standard neutral word (regular adjective)
example: Deine Schuhe sind total schmutzig. — Your shoes are totally dirty.

hindi: विएना की चुटीली बात — मज़ाक़, चाल और मीठी बातों का मिला-जुला अंदाज़
definition: the wry teasing charm and quick joking talk that Viennese people are known for, also a trick or tall story told with a straight face (der Schmäh, plural Schmähs)
example: Der Kellner hat den typischen Wiener Schmäh. — The waiter has that typical Viennese wit.

hindi: सजाना — पेड़ या घर को गहनों, बत्तियों से सुंदर बनाना
definition: to decorate, to make the tree, the house or a room festive with lights, baubles and ornaments (regular)
example: Wir schmücken den Baum am Nachmittag. — We decorate the tree in the afternoon.

hindi: बतियाना — उत्तरी जर्मनी में हल्की-फुल्की गपशप करना
definition: to chat or talk in the casual northern German and Low German way, exchanging small talk and gossip around Hamburg and the coast (regular)
example: Lass uns bei einem Kaffee ein bisschen schnacken. — Let us have a little chat over a coffee.

hindi: समझ लेना — बोलचाल में बात पल्ले पड़ना
definition: to catch on or finally understand something, colloquial, literally to buckle or fasten a strap (regular)
example: Endlich hat er den Witz geschnallt. — He finally caught on to the joke.

hindi: कड़ी शराब — छोटे गिलास में पी जाने वाली तेज़ पारदर्शी मदिरा
definition: schnapps, a strong clear spirit drunk in small glasses, often after a heavy meal as a digestive (der Schnaps, plural Schnäpse)
example: Nach dem Essen gibt es einen Schnaps aufs Haus. — After the meal there is a schnapps on the house.

hindi: नशे की सूझ — रात को शानदार, सुबह बेवक़ूफ़ी लगने वाला विचार
definition: a scheme that sounded magnificent late at night over drinks and looks embarrassing by breakfast
example: Driving to the coast at two in the morning was a Schnapsidee.

hindi: एक-से अंकों की संख्या — १११ या २२२ जैसी दोहराए अंकों वाली मज़ेदार संख्या
definition: a playful number made of the same repeated digit, such as 111 or 222, that people notice on clocks, odometers and birthdays with delight (die Schnapszahl, plural Schnapszahlen)
example: Mein Kilometerzähler zeigt eine Schnapszahl: 77777! — My odometer shows a number of all-matching digits: 77777!

hindi: दाढ़ी-मूँछ वाला कुत्ता — थूथन पर लंबे बालों वाली सख़्त बालों की कुत्ते की नस्ल
definition: a breed of dog with a wiry coat and a bearded muzzle, named after the German word for snout (der Schnauzer, plural Schnauzer)
example: Der Schnauzer bewacht den Hof des Bauern. — The schnauzer guards the farmer's yard.

hindi: घोंघा — धीरे रेंगने वाला चिपचिपा जीव
definition: a snail or slug, the slow slimy creature with or without a shell that eats lettuce in the garden (die Schnecke, plural Schnecken)
example: Die Schnecke frisst den ganzen Salat. — The snail is eating all the lettuce.

hindi: बर्फ़ — आसमान से गिरते सफ़ेद हिम कण
definition: snow, the soft white frozen flakes that fall from winter clouds and cover the ground (der Schnee, no plural)
example: Der Schnee liegt zwanzig Zentimeter hoch. — The snow lies twenty centimetres deep.

hindi: फेंटनी — तारों का औज़ार जिससे अंडे या क्रीम फेंटते हैं
definition: a whisk, the looped wire kitchen tool used to beat eggs, cream or batter until light (der Schneebesen, plural Schneebesen)
example: Schlag die Sahne mit dem Schneebesen. — Whip the cream with the whisk.

hindi: हिमपात — बर्फ़ का गिरना
definition: snowfall, a period during which snow falls from the sky and settles on the ground (der Schneefall, plural Schneefälle)
example: Der starke Schneefall hat die Straßen blockiert. — The heavy snowfall has blocked the roads.

hindi: बर्फ़ का फाहा — गिरता हुआ बर्फ़ का एक छोटा कण
definition: a snowflake, a single soft crystal of snow that drifts down from the sky in winter (die Schneeflocke, plural Schneeflocken)
example: Die ersten Schneeflocken tanzen vor dem Fenster. — The first snowflakes dance outside the window.

hindi: बर्फ़ का बगूला — घुमड़ती हुई हिम-बौछार
definition: a brief, swirling flurry of snow driven about by gusts rather than falling steadily to the ground
example: A sudden Schneegestöber swallowed the road markings for a quarter of an hour.

hindi: बर्फ़ीला तूफ़ान — तेज़ हवा के साथ भारी हिमपात
definition: a blizzard, a storm of heavy snow driven by strong wind that makes roads and paths impassable (der Schneesturm, plural Schneestürme)
example: Im Schneesturm sah man keine zehn Meter weit. — In the blizzard you could not see ten metres.

hindi: काटने का तख़्ता — सब्ज़ी या रोटी काटने की लकड़ी की पट्टी
definition: a chopping board, the flat wooden or plastic board on which bread, meat and vegetables are cut (das Schneidebrett, plural Schneidebretter)
example: Leg die Zwiebel auf das Schneidebrett. — Put the onion on the chopping board.

hindi: काटना — चाकू से टुकड़े करना
definition: to cut or slice bread, meat or vegetables with a knife into pieces of the wanted size (irregular: schneidet, hat geschnitten)
example: Ich schneide das Brot in dünne Scheiben. — I am cutting the bread into thin slices.

hindi: बर्फ़ गिरना — आसमान से हिम कण बरसना
definition: to snow, used impersonally with es when white flakes fall from winter clouds (regular: es schneit, hat geschneit)
example: Es schneit seit heute Morgen. — It has been snowing since this morning.

hindi: तेज़ — कम समय में ज़्यादा दूरी, फुर्तीला
definition: fast or quick, moving or happening at high speed, rapid, finished within a short time
example: Der Zug fährt sehr schnell. — The train travels very fast.

hindi: पतला तला मांस-टुकड़ा — रोटी के चूरे में लपेटकर तला गया मांस का पतला पार्चा
definition: a thin slice of veal or pork coated in breadcrumbs and fried in fat, the best known meat dish of the region (das Schnitzel, plural Schnitzel)
example: Ich nehme das Schnitzel mit Pommes, bitte. — I will have the schnitzel with fries, please.

hindi: चुसनी — शिशु को शांत रखने के लिए मुँह में दिया जाने वाला रबर का निपल
definition: a dummy or pacifier, the rubber teat a baby sucks on for comfort when it is tired or fussy (der Schnuller, plural Schnuller)
example: Ohne den Schnuller schläft sie einfach nicht ein. — Without the dummy she simply will not fall asleep.

hindi: नज़ला — बहती या बंद नाक वाला हल्का ज़ुकाम
definition: a head cold or runny nose, the blocked sniffling nose that comes with a mild infection (der Schnupfen, plural Schnupfen)
example: Der Schnupfen geht seit einer Woche nicht weg. — The runny nose has not gone away for a week.

hindi: सूँघ-सूँघ कर देखना — नाक से हल्के-हल्के गंध लेना
definition: to sniff at something curiously with short breaths, also figuratively to try out a job or hobby briefly (regular, an + Dativ)
example: Der Hund schnupperte neugierig an meiner Tasche. — The dog sniffed curiously at my bag.

hindi: डोरी या रस्सी — बाँधने के लिए पतली मज़बूत डोर
definition: a string or cord, a thin strong line for tying parcels, hanging things or connecting a device, also a power cable (die Schnur, plural Schnüre)
example: Bind das Paket mit einer Schnur zu. — Tie the parcel up with a string.

hindi: सस्ता सौदा — बहुत कम दाम में मिली अच्छी चीज़
definition: a bargain, something bought surprisingly cheaply that feels like a small lucky catch (das Schnäppchen, plural Schnäppchen)
example: Die Jacke war ein echtes Schnäppchen. — The jacket was a real bargain.

hindi: जूते का फ़ीता — जूता बाँधने की डोरी
definition: a shoelace, the thin cord threaded through a shoe and tied to hold it firmly on the foot (der Schnürsenkel, plural Schnürsenkel)
example: Dein Schnürsenkel ist offen. — Your shoelace is undone.

hindi: चॉकलेट — कोको से बनी मीठी टिकिया, स्विस बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: chocolate, the sweet made from cocoa that Switzerland is famous for, in the affectionate colloquial Swiss form where Germany says Schokolade (die Schoggi, plural Schoggis)
example: Bring mir aus Zürich eine gute Schoggi mit. — Bring me some good chocolate from Zurich.

hindi: कोको की मिठाई — कोको और चीनी से बनी भूरी मीठी चीज़, टिकिया या पेय
definition: chocolate, the brown sweet food made from cocoa and sugar eaten as a bar or drunk hot with milk (die Schokolade, plural Schokoladen)
example: Die Schokolade schmilzt in der Sonne. — The chocolate melts in the sun.

hindi: पहले ही — अपेक्षा से जल्दी हो चुका; बात नरम करने वाला शब्द भी
definition: already, sooner or earlier than expected, and also a softening particle that makes commands and questions sound friendlier
example: Bist du schon fertig? — Are you already finished?

hindi: ठीक है, जाने दो — बात को शांत करना
definition: it is alright, forget it; a soothing or slightly impatient phrase ending an apology or an argument
example: Schon gut, ich mache das selbst. — It is alright, I will do it myself.

hindi: मिश्रित पेय — रस या शराब में सोडा-पानी मिलाकर बना हल्का ताज़ा पेय
definition: a refreshing drink mixing fruit juice or wine with sparkling water, the classic German café thirst quencher (die Schorle, plural Schorlen)
example: Im Sommer trinke ich am liebsten eine kalte Schorle. — In summer I most like to drink a cold spritzer.

hindi: चिमनी साफ़ करने वाला — धुआँकश साफ़ और जाँचने वाला, भाग्यशाली माना जाता है
definition: a chimney sweep, the tradesperson who cleans and inspects chimneys and heating flues, traditionally thought to bring luck (der Schornsteinfeger, plural Schornsteinfeger)
example: Der Schornsteinfeger kommt einmal im Jahr vorbei. — The chimney sweep comes by once a year.

hindi: अलमारी — सामान रखने का दरवाज़ेदार लंबा बक्सा
definition: a cupboard or wardrobe, the tall piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing clothes or dishes (der Schrank, plural Schränke)
example: Die Teller stehen im Schrank. — The plates are in the cupboard.

hindi: पेच — चूड़ीदार धातु की कील जो घुमाकर लगाई जाती है
definition: a screw, the threaded metal fastener that is turned with a screwdriver to hold parts together (die Schraube, plural Schrauben)
example: Eine Schraube am Stuhl ist locker. — One screw on the chair is loose.

hindi: पेच कसना — पेच घुमाकर चीज़ जोड़ना
definition: to fasten or turn something with screws, fixing a part tightly into place or loosening it again (regular: schraubt, hat geschraubt)
example: Sie schraubt das Regal an die Wand. — She screws the shelf to the wall.

hindi: पाना — नट और बोल्ट कसने-खोलने का औज़ार
definition: a spanner or wrench, the hand tool for gripping and turning nuts and bolts (der Schraubenschlüssel, plural Schraubenschlüssel)
example: Zieh die Mutter mit dem Schraubenschlüssel fest. — Tighten the nut with the spanner.

hindi: पेचकस — पेच कसने या खोलने का हाथ का औज़ार
definition: a screwdriver, the hand tool with a shaped tip used to turn screws in or out (der Schraubenzieher, plural Schraubenzieher)
example: Gib mir bitte den kleinen Schraubenzieher. — Please hand me the small screwdriver.

hindi: किराये की बग़ीची — शहर के बाहर कुटिया वाला छोटा किराये का बाग़
definition: an allotment garden, a small rented plot with a hut in a fenced colony outside town (der Schrebergarten, plural Schrebergärten)
example: Mein Opa verbringt jedes Wochenende im Schrebergarten. — My grandpa spends every weekend at the allotment garden.

hindi: भयानक — बहुत बुरा, डरावना; बोलचाल में बहुत ज़्यादा
definition: terrible, dreadful, horrible; strong disapproval of something very unpleasant, also an intensifier meaning extremely
example: Das Wetter war die ganze Woche schrecklich. — The weather was terrible all week.

hindi: लिखना — शब्दों को काग़ज़ या स्क्रीन पर उतारना
definition: to write words, letters, messages or whole books by hand or on a keyboard (irregular: schreibt, hat geschrieben)
example: Sie schreibt gerade ihren zweiten Roman. — She is currently writing her second novel.

hindi: लिखने की मेज़ — पढ़ाई और दफ़्तर के काम की मेज़
definition: a desk, the table with drawers at which a person writes, studies or works at a computer (der Schreibtisch, plural Schreibtische)
example: Mein Schreibtisch ist voller Papiere. — My desk is full of papers.

hindi: चिल्लाना — बहुत तेज़ आवाज़ में बोलना या चीखना
definition: to shout, scream or yell loudly with your voice out of anger, fear, pain or excitement (irregular: schreit, hat geschrien)
example: Das Baby schreit die ganze Nacht. — The baby screams all night.

hindi: बढ़ई — लकड़ी से फ़र्नीचर और दरवाज़े बनाने वाला कारीगर
definition: a joiner or carpenter who builds furniture, doors and fittings from wood, the southern and western German word (der Schreiner, plural Schreiner)
example: Der Schreiner baut uns einen neuen Schrank. — The joiner is building us a new cupboard.

hindi: गरिमा से चलना — धीमे, लंबे और शानदार कदम रखना
definition: to stride or pace along with slow dignified steps, a formal or literary word for solemn walking (irregular: schritt, ist geschritten)
example: Das Brautpaar schreitet langsam durch die Kirche. — The bridal couple strides slowly through the church.

hindi: लेखक — पेशे से उपन्यास या साहित्य लिखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a writer or novelist by profession, a person who creates literary works such as novels and stories (der Schriftsteller, plural Schriftsteller)
example: Der Schriftsteller liest heute Abend aus seinem neuen Buch. — The writer is reading from his new book this evening.

hindi: पाव — बर्लिन की चीरा-लगी छोटी डबलरोटी
definition: a bread roll, the small crusty individual bread with a split top, the Berlin word for what others call Brötchen (die Schrippe, plural Schrippen)
example: Ich nehme eine Schrippe mit Butter. — I will take a bread roll with butter.

hindi: कदम — चलते समय एक पैर आगे रखने की क्रिया
definition: a step or pace, the single movement of placing one foot ahead of the other while walking, also a stage in a process (der Schritt, plural Schritte)
example: Der erste Schritt ist oft der schwerste. — The first step is often the hardest.

hindi: सिकुड़ना — आकार या संख्या में छोटा होते जाना
definition: to shrink or become smaller in size or number, used for clothes in the wash, populations, budgets and profits (regular: ist geschrumpft)
example: Der Pullover ist beim Waschen geschrumpft. — The sweater shrank in the wash.

hindi: ठेला — एक पहिये वाली हाथ से धकेली जाने वाली गाड़ी
definition: a wheelbarrow, the one-wheeled cart pushed by hand to move soil, leaves and stones around a garden (die Schubkarre, plural Schubkarren)
example: Er schiebt die volle Schubkarre zum Kompost. — He pushes the full wheelbarrow to the compost.

hindi: दराज़ — मेज़ या अलमारी का खींचने वाला खाना
definition: a drawer, the sliding box inside a desk, table or cupboard that is pulled out to store things (die Schublade, plural Schubladen)
example: Das Besteck ist in der obersten Schublade. — The cutlery is in the top drawer.

hindi: खटना — कड़ी और थका देने वाली मेहनत करना (बोलचाल)
definition: to slave away, toil or work extremely hard physically, colloquial and slightly complaining (regular: schuftet, hat geschuftet)
example: Wir haben den ganzen Tag auf der Baustelle geschuftet. — We slaved away all day on the building site.

hindi: जूता — पैर को ढकने वाला मज़बूत तलवे वाला पहनावा
definition: a shoe, the sturdy outer covering for the foot with a firm sole for walking outside (der Schuh, plural Schuhe)
example: Die neuen Schuhe drücken noch ein bisschen. — The new shoes still pinch a little.

hindi: पाठ्यपुस्तक — किसी विषय की स्कूल में पढ़ाई जाने वाली किताब
definition: a school textbook, the printed book from which a subject is taught and studied over the school year (das Schulbuch, plural Schulbücher)
example: Schlagt das Schulbuch auf Seite zwanzig auf. — Open the textbook at page twenty.

hindi: दोष — ग़लती या अपराध की ज़िम्मेदारी
definition: guilt or blame, the responsibility for a crime or wrong that someone carries, in the plural also debts owed (die Schuld, plural Schulden)
example: Die Schuld liegt allein bei ihm. — The blame lies with him alone.

hindi: कर्ज़ — किसी को लौटाने योग्य बकाया रकम
definition: debts, the money someone owes to a bank or another person and must repay (die Schulden, plural only)
example: Die Schulden bei der Bank sind sehr hoch. — The debts with the bank are very high.

hindi: दोषी — जिसने अपराध या ग़लती की हो
definition: guilty, responsible for a crime or wrong, the word a court uses when it convicts a defendant
example: Der Angeklagte ist in allen Punkten schuldig. — The defendant is guilty on all counts.

hindi: स्कूल — बच्चों को पढ़ाने वाली संस्था और उसकी इमारत
definition: a school, the institution and building where children receive their formal education from teachers (die Schule, plural Schulen)
example: Die Schule beginnt um acht Uhr. — School starts at eight o'clock.

hindi: स्कूल का मैदान — अवकाश में छात्रों के खेलने का खुला आँगन
definition: the schoolyard or playground, the open area beside the school building where pupils spend their breaks (der Schulhof, plural Schulhöfe)
example: Auf dem Schulhof spielen die Kinder Fußball. — The children play football in the schoolyard.

hindi: स्कूल-वर्ष — गर्मी की छुट्टियों के बाद शुरू होकर अगली गर्मियों तक चलने वाला शिक्षा-सत्र
definition: the school year, the period of teaching running from late summer to the following summer holidays (das Schuljahr, plural Schuljahre)
example: Das neue Schuljahr beginnt im September. — The new school year begins in September.

hindi: प्रधानाध्यापक — पूरे स्कूल का प्रमुख और प्रबंधक
definition: the head teacher or principal who runs a school and is responsible for its staff and pupils (der Schulleiter, plural Schulleiter)
example: Der Schulleiter begrüßt die neuen Schüler. — The head teacher welcomes the new pupils.

hindi: स्कूल बस्ता — प्राथमिक बच्चों का सख़्त, चौकोर पीठ पर लटकाने वाला थैला
definition: a rigid, box-shaped school satchel worn on the back by primary-school children to carry books and pencil case (der Schulranzen, plural Schulranzen)
example: Der Schulranzen ist viel zu schwer. — The school satchel is far too heavy.

hindi: कंधा — गर्दन के दोनों ओर वह जोड़ जहाँ बाँह शरीर से जुड़ती है
definition: the shoulder, the joint on either side of the body where the upper arm joins the trunk (die Schulter, plural Schultern)
example: Er klopfte mir freundlich auf die Schulter. — He patted me on the shoulder in a friendly way.

hindi: स्कूल-शंकु — पहले स्कूली दिन बच्चे को मिलने वाला मिठाइयों से भरा बड़ा सजा शंकु
definition: the large decorated cardboard cone filled with sweets and small gifts that a child receives on the first day of school (die Schultüte, plural Schultüten)
example: Die Schultüte war größer als das Kind. — The school cone was bigger than the child.

hindi: प्रशिक्षण सत्र — कर्मचारियों को कोई ख़ास कौशल या तरीक़ा सिखाने की कक्षा
definition: a training session or course that teaches employees a specific skill or procedure (die Schulung, plural Schulungen)
example: Morgen gibt es eine Schulung für die neue Software. — Tomorrow there is a training session for the new software.

hindi: स्कूल का रास्ता — घर से स्कूल तक का रोज़ का सफ़र
definition: the way to school, the daily route a child walks or rides between home and the school building (der Schulweg, plural Schulwege)
example: Der Schulweg dauert zehn Minuten zu Fuß. — The walk to school takes ten minutes.

hindi: बेईमानी करना — खेल में चुपके से नियम तोड़ना
definition: to cheat in a small way, to bend the rules secretly in a game, colloquial and mild (regular: hat geschummelt)
example: Beim Kartenspiel schummelt Opa immer ein bisschen. — Grandpa always cheats a little at cards.

hindi: बचाव — खतरे या नुकसान से रक्षा
definition: protection or shelter, something that keeps a person or thing safe from harm, weather or attack (der Schutz, no plural)
example: Unter der Brücke fanden wir den nötigen Schutz vor dem Hagel. — Under the bridge we found the shelter we needed from the hail.

hindi: कमज़ोर — ताक़त या असर में कम
definition: weak, feeble or lacking strength, used of tired bodies, faint signals, poor performances and diluted drinks
example: Das Signal hier ist sehr schwach. — The signal here is very weak.

hindi: साला, जीजा या देवर — पति-पत्नी का भाई या बहन का पति
definition: the brother-in-law, the brother of one's spouse or the husband of one's sister, related through marriage (der Schwager, plural Schwäger)
example: Mein Schwager repariert gerade unser Auto. — My brother-in-law is repairing our car right now.

hindi: पानी सोखने वाली गद्दी — बर्तन और सतह रगड़कर साफ़ करने का नरम टुकड़ा
definition: a sponge, the soft absorbent block used with soap and water to scrub dishes, sinks and surfaces (der Schwamm, plural Schwämme)
example: Der Schwamm riecht schon, wirf ihn weg. — The sponge already smells, throw it away.

hindi: जाने दो — पुरानी बात भूलकर माफ़ कर देना
definition: let us forget about it and wipe the slate clean, an invitation to forgive and move on (colloquial, literally sponge over it)
example: Du hast dich entschuldigt, also Schwamm drüber. — You apologised, so let us forget the whole thing.

hindi: राजहंस — लंबी गर्दन वाला सुंदर सफ़ेद पानी का पक्षी
definition: a swan, the graceful large white water bird with a long curved neck seen on lakes and rivers (der Schwan, plural Schwäne)
example: Ein Schwan schwimmt auf dem See. — A swan is swimming on the lake.

hindi: गर्भवती — जिसके पेट में बच्चा पल रहा हो
definition: pregnant, carrying an unborn child, expecting a baby, often with von + Dativ for the father
example: Meine Schwester ist im vierten Monat schwanger. — My sister is four months pregnant.

hindi: गर्भावस्था — गर्भ में बच्चा पलने का समय
definition: the pregnancy, the roughly nine months during which a woman carries an unborn child (die Schwangerschaft, plural Schwangerschaften)
example: Während der Schwangerschaft trank sie keinen Kaffee. — During the pregnancy she drank no coffee.

hindi: डगमगाना — इधर-उधर झूलना या लड़खड़ाना
definition: to sway, rock or wobble unsteadily from side to side, also to waver between choices (regular: hat geschwankt in place, ist geschwankt when moving)
example: Der Betrunkene schwankt über die Straße. — The drunk man sways across the street.

hindi: पूँछ — जानवर के शरीर के पिछले हिस्से का लंबा भाग
definition: the tail of an animal, the long part at the back end that a dog wags and a cat swishes (der Schwanz, plural Schwänze)
example: Der Hund wedelt mit dem Schwanz. — The dog is wagging its tail.

hindi: काला — रात और कोयले का रंग
definition: black, the darkest colour with no light, the colour of coal, night and formal mourning clothes
example: Sie trägt ein schwarzes Kleid. — She is wearing a black dress.

hindi: काली रोटी — राई के आटे की गहरी घनी डबलरोटी
definition: dark rye bread, the heavy dark brown loaf made largely from rye flour, the traditional everyday bread of northern Germany (das Schwarzbrot, plural Schwarzbrote)
example: Zum Käse passt das Schwarzbrot am besten. — The dark rye bread goes best with the cheese.

hindi: बिना टिकट यात्री — बिना किराया दिए सफ़र करने वाला
definition: a fare dodger, someone who rides a train, bus or tram without paying for a ticket (der Schwarzfahrer, plural Schwarzfahrer)
example: Der Schwarzfahrer musste sechzig Euro Strafe zahlen. — The fare dodger had to pay a sixty euro fine.

hindi: गप लड़ाना — बेकार की बातें करते रहना, जैसे कक्षा में
definition: to chatter or gossip idly, often used of pupils talking during lessons instead of listening (regular: schwatzt, hat geschwatzt; colloquial)
example: Die Kinder schwatzen ständig im Unterricht. — The children chatter constantly in class.

hindi: हवा में तैरना — बिना सहारे के हवा या पानी में लटके रहना
definition: to float or hover in the air or water without touching the ground, also to be in a state of suspense (regular: hat geschwebt in place, ist geschwebt when moving)
example: Ein Ballon schwebt langsam über die Stadt. — A balloon floats slowly over the city.

hindi: चुप रहना — कुछ न बोलना, मौन रहना
definition: to be silent or say nothing, either deliberately keeping quiet or having nothing to say (irregular: schweigt, hat geschwiegen)
example: Er schwieg die ganze Fahrt über. — He stayed silent the whole journey.

hindi: सूअर — खेत का मोटा गुलाबी जानवर; भाग्य का प्रतीक भी
definition: a pig, the plump farm animal raised for pork, and in German folklore a symbol of good luck (das Schwein, plural Schweine)
example: Das Schwein wälzt sich im Schlamm. — The pig is rolling in the mud.

hindi: क़िस्मत अच्छी होना — बाल-बाल बच जाना
definition: to be lucky or have a narrow escape, colloquial idiom for good fortune that one did not deserve, literally to have a pig
example: Wir haben Schwein gehabt, der Zug wartete noch. — We were lucky, the train was still waiting.

hindi: सूअर का माँस — जर्मनी में सबसे आम गोश्त
definition: pork, the meat of pigs, by far the most eaten meat in Germany and the base of most sausages and schnitzel (das Schweinefleisch, no plural)
example: Das Schweinefleisch kommt vom Bauernhof. — The pork comes from the farm.

hindi: भारी — वज़नदार; कठिन
definition: heavy in weight, hard to lift or carry, also meaning difficult, serious or severe, used of luggage, tasks and illnesses
example: Der Koffer ist viel zu schwer. — The suitcase is much too heavy.

hindi: बहन — एक ही माता-पिता की स्त्री सहोदर
definition: the sister, a female sibling who shares the same parents within the family (die Schwester, plural Schwestern)
example: Meine Schwester wohnt noch bei unseren Eltern. — My sister still lives with our parents.

hindi: सास — पति या पत्नी की माँ
definition: the mother-in-law, the mother of one's husband or wife, a stock figure of family jokes (die Schwiegermutter, plural Schwiegermütter)
example: Meine Schwiegermutter kommt am Wochenende zu Besuch. — My mother-in-law is visiting at the weekend.

hindi: दामाद — बेटी का पति
definition: the son-in-law, the husband of one's daughter who thereby becomes part of the wider family through marriage (der Schwiegersohn, plural Schwiegersöhne)
example: Der Schwiegersohn grillt für die ganze Familie. — The son-in-law is grilling for the whole family.

hindi: बहू — बेटे की पत्नी
definition: the daughter-in-law, the wife of one's son who thereby becomes part of the wider family through marriage (die Schwiegertochter, plural Schwiegertöchter)
example: Ihre Schwiegertochter arbeitet als Ärztin. — Her daughter-in-law works as a doctor.

hindi: ससुर — पति या पत्नी के पिता
definition: the father-in-law, the father of one's husband or wife, joined to the family through marriage (der Schwiegervater, plural Schwiegerväter)
example: Mein Schwiegervater hilft uns beim Umzug. — My father-in-law is helping us with the move.

hindi: कठिन — जिसे करना या समझना आसान न हो
definition: difficult or hard, demanding effort or skill to accomplish or understand, the everyday opposite of easy
example: Die Prüfung war wirklich schwierig. — The exam was really difficult.

hindi: कठिनाई — किसी काम में आने वाली बाधा या मुश्किल
definition: a difficulty, the quality of being hard to do, or a particular obstacle or trouble a person runs into (die Schwierigkeit, plural Schwierigkeiten)
example: Die größte Schwierigkeit ist die Grammatik. — The biggest difficulty is the grammar.

hindi: तैराकी का कुंड — तैरने के लिए बना सार्वजनिक पूल
definition: a swimming pool, the public facility with basins where people swim for exercise or leisure (das Schwimmbad, plural Schwimmbäder)
example: Wir gehen am Samstag ins Schwimmbad. — We are going to the swimming pool on Saturday.

hindi: तैरना — पानी में हाथ-पैर चलाकर आगे बढ़ना
definition: to swim, to move through water using arms and legs, for sport, exercise or pleasure (schwimmt, ist geschwommen)
example: Sie schwimmt jeden Morgen tausend Meter. — She swims a thousand metres every morning.

hindi: चक्कर — सिर घूमने का एहसास
definition: dizziness or vertigo, the spinning unsteady feeling in the head; also a swindle or fraud (der Schwindel, no plural)
example: Der Schwindel kam beim Aufstehen ganz plötzlich. — The dizziness came quite suddenly when standing up.

hindi: जिसे चक्कर आ रहा हो — सिर घूमने का एहसास
definition: dizzy or giddy, feeling that the whole room spins and one might lose balance and fall (used with Dativ: mir ist schwindelig)
example: Mir ist schwindelig, ich muss mich setzen. — I feel dizzy, I have to sit down.

hindi: झूठ-मूठ कहना — छोटा-मोटा झूठ बोलना
definition: to fib or tell small harmless lies, a milder and more playful word than lügen (regular: schwindelt, hat geschwindelt; colloquial)
example: Er hat beim Alter ein bisschen geschwindelt. — He fibbed a little about his age.

hindi: पसीना आना — गर्मी या मेहनत से त्वचा से पसीना निकलना
definition: to sweat, to give off moisture through the skin because of heat, exercise or nervousness (regular)
example: Bei dieser Hitze schwitze ich schon beim Sitzen. — In this heat I sweat even while sitting.

hindi: साली, भाभी या ननद — पति-पत्नी की बहन या भाई की पत्नी
definition: the sister-in-law, the sister of one's spouse or the wife of one's brother, related through marriage (die Schwägerin, plural Schwägerinnen)
example: Meine Schwägerin erwartet ihr zweites Kind. — My sister-in-law is expecting her second child.

hindi: स्कूल से भागना — बिना अनुमति पाठ या स्कूल छोड़ना
definition: to skip school or play truant, to stay away from lessons without permission, colloquial (regular)
example: Sie hat gestern die Schule geschwänzt. — She skipped school yesterday.

hindi: दीवाना होना — किसी की तारीफ़ में उत्साह से बोलते रहना
definition: to rave enthusiastically about someone or something, to be infatuated and gush with glowing praise, often about a person, place or holiday (regular, schwärmen für + Akkusativ or von + Dativ)
example: Sie schwärmt seit Wochen von ihrem Urlaub. — She has been raving about her holiday for weeks.

hindi: गपशप करना — स्वाबिया में बातें करना, बकबक करना
definition: to chat or talk casually in the Swabian and southwestern colloquial way, sometimes idly or too much, the everyday verb for talking (regular)
example: Die Schüler schwätzen im Unterricht zu viel. — The pupils chatter too much in class.

hindi: उमस भरा — गरम और चिपचिपी नमी वाला
definition: humid and sultry, describing hot sticky heavy air that makes breathing uncomfortable before a thunderstorm
example: Heute ist es unangenehm schwül. — Today it is unpleasantly humid.

hindi: उमस — गरम चिपचिपी हवा का भारीपन
definition: sultriness, the oppressive sticky heat of humid air that often builds before a thunderstorm (die Schwüle, no plural)
example: Die Schwüle hält bis zum Gewitter an. — The sultriness lasts until the thunderstorm.

hindi: अपना हित सुरक्षित करना — समय रहते अपना फायदा पक्का कर लेना
definition: to secure one's own profit or safety before trouble arrives, usually with a hint of selfishness (full form: seine Schäfchen ins Trockene bringen)
example: Vor der Krise hat er seine Schäfchen ins Trockene gebracht. — Before the crisis he made sure his own interests were safe.

hindi: छीलना — फल या सब्ज़ी का छिलका उतारना
definition: to peel the skin from fruit, potatoes or vegetables with a knife or peeler before cooking (regular: schält, hat geschält)
example: Ich schäle die Kartoffeln für das Abendessen. — I am peeling the potatoes for dinner.

hindi: अंदाज़ा लगाना — बिना नापे मोटे तौर पर मान बताना
