definition: a souvenir, a small object bought on a trip to remember the place later (das Souvenir, plural Souvenirs)
example: Als Souvenir habe ich eine kleine Kuckucksuhr gekauft. — As a souvenir I bought a small cuckoo clock.

hindi: जहाँ तक — बात को अपनी जानकारी तक सीमित करना
definition: as far as, to the extent that; a conjunction limiting a statement to what the speaker knows or remembers, often in soweit ich weiß
example: Soweit ich weiß, ist er im Urlaub. — As far as I know, he is on holiday.

hindi: तथा — सूची में चीज़ें जोड़ने वाला औपचारिक शब्द
definition: as well as, and also; a formal conjunction joining items in a list, common in written German and official notices
example: Wir brauchen Brot, Butter sowie Käse. — We need bread, butter as well as cheese.

hindi: वैसे भी — यूँ भी, हर हाल में
definition: anyway, in any case; a colloquial adverb saying that something holds regardless of other circumstances
example: Ich wollte sowieso gehen. — I wanted to go anyway.

hindi: दोनों — दो चीज़ों को समान रूप से शामिल करने वाली जोड़ी
definition: both; the first half of sowohl ... als auch, which includes two things equally
example: Sie spricht sowohl Deutsch als auch Englisch. — She speaks both German and English.

hindi: यूँ कहें तो — तुलना या लाक्षणिक बात को नरम करने वाला शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning so to speak that flags a comparison or figurative expression as approximate rather than literal
example: Er ist sozusagen mein zweiter Vater. — He is my second father, so to speak.

hindi: रोमांचक — उत्सुकता से बाँधे रखने वाला
definition: exciting or gripping, holding the attention with suspense and interest so that nobody wants to stop
example: Das Brettspiel war bis zum Schluss spannend. — The board game was exciting right to the end.

hindi: बचाना — पैसे जमा करना, कम ख़र्च करना
definition: to save money by putting it aside or by spending less than usual on something (regular: spart, hat gespart, auf + Akkusativ)
example: Wir sparen auf ein neues Auto. — We are saving up for a new car.

hindi: शतावरी — वसंत में खाई जाने वाली सफ़ेद या हरी लंबी डंठल वाली सब्ज़ी
definition: asparagus, the long white or green spring vegetable shoot that Germans celebrate every year from April to June (der Spargel, plural Spargel)
example: Der Spargel ist dieses Jahr sehr teuer. — The asparagus is very expensive this year.

hindi: सार्वजनिक बचत बैंक — हर जर्मन कस्बे में मिलने वाला स्थानीय सरकारी बैंक
definition: a savings bank, the public regional bank found in nearly every German town and village (die Sparkasse, plural Sparkassen)
example: Meine Eltern haben ihr Konto bei der Sparkasse. — My parents have their account at the savings bank.

hindi: बचत खाता — ब्याज कमाने के लिए पैसा अलग रखने वाला बैंक खाता
definition: a savings account, the bank account where money sits untouched to earn interest over time (das Sparkonto, plural Sparkonten)
example: Auf dem Sparkonto liegen zweitausend Euro. — There are two thousand euros in the savings account.

hindi: मितव्ययी — सोच-समझकर बचत करने वाला
definition: thrifty and economical, careful and sensible about spending money or using resources, a praised virtue rather than a fault
example: Meine Großmutter war immer sehr sparsam. — My grandmother was always very thrifty.

hindi: फावड़ा — मिट्टी खोदने का चपटा लंबे हत्थे वाला औज़ार
definition: a spade, the flat-bladed digging tool with a long handle used to turn garden soil (der Spaten, plural Spaten)
example: Mit dem Spaten grabe ich ein tiefes Loch. — With the spade I dig a deep hole.

hindi: गौरैया — छोटी भूरी चहचहाती चिड़िया
definition: a sparrow, the small brown chirping bird found in every garden and city street (der Spatz, plural Spatzen)
example: Ein Spatz pickt Krümel vom Tisch. — A sparrow pecks crumbs off the table.

hindi: टहलने जाना — बिना जल्दी के आराम से चलना
definition: to go for a walk, to stroll slowly outdoors for pleasure rather than to reach somewhere (irregular: geht spazieren, ist spazieren gegangen)
example: Wir gehen jeden Abend im Park spazieren. — We go for a walk in the park every evening.

hindi: टहलना — आराम से की गई छोटी पैदल सैर
definition: a walk or stroll, a short leisurely walk taken for fresh air and pleasure (der Spaziergang, plural Spaziergänge)
example: Nach dem Essen machen wir einen Spaziergang. — After the meal we go for a walk.

hindi: मज़े की ब्रेक — दूसरों का आनंद और उत्साह बिगाड़ने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a killjoy who spoils the fun and dampens the cheerful mood of a group, literally a brake on enjoyment, colloquial and teasing (die Spaßbremse, plural Spaßbremsen)
example: Sei keine Spaßbremse und tanz mit uns! — Do not be a killjoy and dance with us!

hindi: चर्बीदार सूअर माँस — धुँआ लगी सूअर की पेटी का माँस
definition: bacon, the fatty smoked or cured pork belly cut into cubes for frying or thin slices, a base for many hearty dishes (der Speck, no plural)
example: Der Speck wird knusprig gebraten. — The bacon is fried until crispy.

hindi: सहेजना — फ़ाइल या डेटा को कंप्यूटर में सुरक्षित रखना
definition: to save a file or data on a computer or phone so that it is kept and not lost when the program closes (regular)
example: Hast du das Dokument schon gespeichert? — Have you saved the document yet?

hindi: व्यंजन-सूची — रेस्तराँ में मिलने वाले खानों और उनके दामों की सूची
definition: the menu, the printed list of dishes and prices that a restaurant offers its guests (die Speisekarte, plural Speisekarten)
example: Könnten wir bitte die Speisekarte haben? — Could we please have the menu?

hindi: भोजन डिब्बा — रेल में खाना परोसने वाला डिब्बा
definition: a dining car, the railway carriage where passengers can sit and buy a meal, drink or coffee (der Speisewagen, plural Speisewagen)
example: Im Speisewagen gibt es Kaffee und Kuchen. — In the dining car there is coffee and cake.

hindi: दान देना — भलाई के काम के लिए धन या सामान देना
definition: to donate money, clothes, blood or other goods to a charity or good cause without wanting anything back (regular: hat gespendet)
example: Viele Leute spenden nach der Flut Kleidung. — Many people are donating clothes after the flood.

hindi: खिलाना-पिलाना — दोस्तों के लिए खाने-पीने का बिल अपनी ओर से भरना
definition: to treat someone to a drink or meal by generously paying for it, a colloquial cousin of spenden (regular)
example: Heute spendiere ich euch eine Runde Bier. — Today I am treating you all to a round of beer.

hindi: बड़ा कचरा — पुराना फ़र्नीचर जैसा भारी सामान जो अलग से उठाया जाता है
definition: bulky waste, large discarded items such as furniture or mattresses that the council collects separately (der Sperrmüll, no plural)
example: Das alte Sofa steht zum Sperrmüll auf der Straße. — The old sofa is out on the street for bulky waste collection.

hindi: बंदी का समय — वह घंटा जिसके बाद शराबख़ाने बंद होने चाहिए
definition: the legal closing hour after which pubs, bars and restaurants must stop serving and shut their doors for the night (die Sperrstunde, plural Sperrstunden)
example: Die Sperrstunde beginnt hier um ein Uhr. — Closing time here begins at one o'clock.

hindi: नक़ल की पर्ची — परीक्षा में छिपाकर देखने के लिए लिखी छोटी चिट
definition: a crib sheet or cheat note, a tiny slip of paper with answers that a pupil hides to consult during a test (der Spickzettel, plural Spickzettel)
example: Der Lehrer fand den Spickzettel unter dem Tisch. — The teacher found the crib sheet under the desk.

hindi: आईना — जिसमें अपना चेहरा दिखता है
definition: a mirror, the polished glass surface on a wall in which a person sees their own reflection (der Spiegel, plural Spiegel)
example: Im Bad hängt ein großer Spiegel. — There is a large mirror hanging in the bathroom.

hindi: आधा तला अंडा — जर्दी साबुत रखकर तला अंडा
definition: a fried egg, the egg cooked in a pan with the yolk left whole and shining like a mirror, often laid on top of a dish (das Spiegelei, plural Spiegeleier)
example: Auf dem Schnitzel liegt ein Spiegelei. — There is a fried egg on top of the schnitzel.

hindi: खेल — दो पक्षों का मुक़ाबला या मनोरंजन के लिए खेला जाने वाला खेल
definition: a game or match, the single contest between teams or players, and also any game played for fun (das Spiel, plural Spiele)
example: Das Spiel endete zwei zu eins. — The match ended two to one.

hindi: खेल की शाम — दोस्तों के साथ मेज़ पर खेल खेलने की संध्या
definition: a games evening, a gathering where friends spend the evening playing board or card games (der Spielabend, plural Spielabende)
example: Kommst du am Samstag zum Spielabend? — Are you coming to the games evening on Saturday?

hindi: खेलना — मनोरंजन के लिए खेल या वाद्य बजाना
definition: to play, to take part in a game or sport or to play a musical instrument (regular: hat gespielt)
example: Wir spielen jeden Freitag Karten. — We play cards every Friday.

hindi: खिलाड़ी — खेल में भाग लेने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a player, the person who takes part in a game or sport, as a member of a team or on their own (der Spieler, plural Spieler)
example: Ein Spieler wurde verletzt vom Platz getragen. — One player was carried off the pitch injured.

hindi: गोटी — खेल के बोर्ड पर चलाया जाने वाला मोहरा
definition: a playing piece, the token or figure a player moves around the board in a game (die Spielfigur, plural Spielfiguren)
example: Meine Spielfigur ist die grüne. — My playing piece is the green one.

hindi: खेल का मैदान — झूले-फिसलपट्टी वाला बच्चों के खेलने का सार्वजनिक स्थान
definition: a playground, the public outdoor area with swings, slides and sandpits where children play under their parents' eyes (der Spielplatz, plural Spielplätze)
example: Am Nachmittag gehen wir auf den Spielplatz. — In the afternoon we go to the playground.

hindi: खेल का नियम — खेल कैसे खेला जाए, इसकी शर्त
definition: a rule of a game, one of the agreed instructions that state how a game must be played (die Spielregel, plural Spielregeln)
example: Lies bitte zuerst die Spielregeln vor. — Please read out the rules of the game first.

hindi: खिलौना — बच्चों के खेलने की चीज़
definition: a toy or toys, objects made for children to play with, from dolls to building blocks (das Spielzeug, plural Spielzeuge)
example: Das Spielzeug liegt überall im Kinderzimmer. — The toys are lying all over the nursery.

hindi: संकीर्ण दक़ियानूस — नियम-क़ायदों में सिमटा साधारण आदमी
definition: a narrow conventional soul who prizes tidy hedges and correct paperwork above anything unfamiliar
example: He called his neighbour a Spießer for reporting the barbecue to the building manager.

hindi: पालक — गहरे हरे पत्तों वाली सब्ज़ी, लोहे से भरपूर मानी जाती है
definition: spinach, the dark green leafy vegetable cooked down into a soft mass and famous for its iron (der Spinat, no plural)
example: Der Spinat ist schnell gekocht. — The spinach is cooked quickly.

hindi: मकड़ी — आठ टाँगों वाला जाला बुनने वाला जीव
definition: a spider, the eight-legged creature that spins webs in corners and catches insects (die Spinne, plural Spinnen)
example: In der Ecke hängt eine große Spinne. — A big spider is hanging in the corner.

hindi: पागल होना — बोलचाल में बेतुकी बात करना
definition: to be crazy or talk nonsense, colloquial for someone acting unreasonably, literally to spin thread (spinnt, hat gesponnen)
example: Du spinnst doch, das geht nicht! — You are crazy, that will not work!

hindi: अस्पताल — बीमारों के इलाज की बड़ी इमारत, ऑस्ट्रियाई और स्विस शब्द
definition: a hospital, the building where the sick and injured receive medical treatment, the usual Austrian and Swiss word where Germany says Krankenhaus (das Spital, plural Spitäler)
example: Er liegt seit Montag im Spital. — He has been in hospital since Monday.

hindi: नुकीला — सुई या पेंसिल की तरह तीखी नोक वाला
definition: pointed or sharp, ending in a fine point like a needle, a pencil or a mountain peak, also of a cutting remark
example: Der Bleistift ist sehr spitz. — The pencil is very sharp.

hindi: लाजवाब — सबसे बढ़िया, चोटी का; बोलचाल की तारीफ़
definition: top-notch, superb, excellent; a colloquial indeclinable word of praise meaning something is the very best
example: Das Essen hier ist einfach spitze. — The food here is simply superb.

hindi: खेल — शारीरिक व्यायाम और प्रतियोगी खेल
definition: sport or physical exercise, any athletic activity done for fitness, competition or fun, also the school subject (der Sport, no plural)
example: Treibst du regelmäßig Sport? — Do you do sport regularly?

hindi: खेल हॉल — भीतरी खेलों के लिए बड़ा भवन
definition: a sports hall, the large indoor building where handball, basketball, volleyball and other games are played (die Sporthalle, plural Sporthallen)
example: Die neue Sporthalle hat tausend Sitzplätze. — The new sports hall has a thousand seats.

hindi: खेल-प्रेमी — फ़ुर्तीला, कसरती और खेल से जुड़ा
definition: sporty or athletic, describing a fit and active person, or something connected with sport such as clothing or a car (also fair in the sense of good sportsmanship)
example: Meine Schwester ist sehr sportlich. — My sister is very sporty.

hindi: खेल का मैदान — बाहर खेलने का मैदान
definition: a sports ground or playing field, the outdoor area with pitch and track where a club or school plays and trains (der Sportplatz, plural Sportplätze)
example: Die Kinder treffen sich auf dem Sportplatz. — The children meet on the sports ground.

hindi: भाषा की सहज पकड़ — नियम जाने बिना सही-ग़लत का एहसास
definition: an internalised feeling for what sounds right in a language, running deeper than any rule taught
example: No grammar book gave her that Sprachgefühl; eight years in Vienna did.

hindi: बोलना — आवाज़ से शब्द कहना या किसी भाषा में बात करना
definition: to speak or talk, whether saying words aloud, holding a conversation, or knowing a language (irregular: spricht, hat gesprochen; mit + Dativ, über + Akkusativ)
example: Sie spricht drei Sprachen fließend. — She speaks three languages fluently.

hindi: किसी विषय पर बात करना — किसी मुद्दे के बारे में बोलना या चर्चा करना
definition: to speak or talk about a topic, person or problem, discussing it together with somebody else (über + Akkusativ, spricht, hat gesprochen)
example: Wir sprechen morgen über das neue Projekt. — We will talk about the new project tomorrow.

hindi: परामर्श समय — डॉक्टर के रोगी देखने के तय घंटे
definition: consultation hours or surgery hours, the fixed times when a doctor receives patients for advice and examination (die Sprechstunde, plural Sprechstunden)
example: Die Sprechstunde beginnt um acht Uhr. — Consultation hours begin at eight o'clock.

hindi: कूदना — ज़मीन से उछलकर हवा में जाना
definition: to jump or leap upward from the ground into the air, over an obstacle or down into water (irregular: sprang, ist gesprungen)
example: Die Kinder springen ins kalte Wasser. — The children jump into the cold water.

hindi: तेज़ दौड़ लगाना — थोड़ी दूरी पूरी ताक़त से भागना
definition: to sprint, running at full speed over a short distance in sport or to catch something (regular: ist gesprintet)
example: Er sprintet die letzten hundert Meter zum Ziel. — He sprints the last hundred metres to the finish.

hindi: सुई — सुई से शरीर में दवा डालना या वह उपकरण
definition: an injection or the syringe used to give it, the shot that puts medicine or a vaccine under the skin (die Spritze, plural Spritzen)
example: Die Spritze tat kaum weh. — The injection hardly hurt.

hindi: बुलबुलेदार पानी — गैस मिला हुआ खनिज पानी
definition: sparkling mineral water with carbon dioxide bubbles, the fizzy water Germans usually drink with meals (der Sprudel, plural Sprudel)
example: Der Sprudel ist schön kalt. — The sparkling water is nicely cold.

hindi: छलाँग — ज़मीन से उछलकर हवा में जाने की क्रिया
definition: a jump or leap into the air or over something, also a crack in glass or a sudden advance (der Sprung, plural Sprünge)
example: Mit einem großen Sprung landet er im Wasser. — With a big jump he lands in the water.

hindi: सुराग़ — अपराध का निशान या पदचिह्न
definition: a trace, track or clue left behind that investigators follow, also a lane on a road (die Spur, plural Spuren)
example: Die Polizei hat eine heiße Spur. — The police have a hot lead.

hindi: देर से — तय समय के बाद, या दिन का आख़िरी हिस्सा
definition: late, after the expected or usual time, also referring to the evening hours
example: Es ist schon spät, ich gehe schlafen. — It is already late, I am going to bed.

hindi: बाद में — अभी के कुछ समय के बाद
definition: later, at a time after the present moment or after another event has happened
example: Wir sprechen später darüber. — We will talk about it later.

hindi: उतरती गर्मी — गर्मी की ऋतु का अंतिम, हल्का गर्म हिस्सा
definition: late summer, the final mild weeks of the summer season just before autumn arrives (der Spätsommer, plural Spätsommer)
example: Der Spätsommer war dieses Jahr besonders schön. — Late summer was especially lovely this year.

hindi: अंडे-आटे के छोटे नरम नूडल — स्वाबिया का घरेलू व्यंजन, ग्रेवी या पनीर के साथ
definition: spaetzle, the soft irregular egg noodles scraped from dough into boiling water, the pride of Swabian home cooking served with gravy or cheese (die Spätzle, plural only)
example: Die Spätzle macht meine Mutter selbst. — My mother makes the spaetzle herself.

hindi: बर्तन धोने का हौज़ — रसोई का वह हौज़ जिसमें नल के नीचे बर्तन धोए जाते हैं
definition: the kitchen sink, the basin with a tap where dishes are washed and water is drawn (die Spüle, plural Spülen)
example: Das schmutzige Geschirr steht in der Spüle. — The dirty dishes are in the sink.

hindi: खँगालना — बर्तन धोना या पानी से कुल्ला करना
definition: to rinse or wash dishes with water, also to flush a toilet or rinse the mouth, the standard word for washing up in much of Germany (regular)
example: Ich spüle schnell die Gläser vom Frühstück. — I will quickly wash the glasses from breakfast.

hindi: बर्तन धोने की मशीन — गंदे बर्तन अपने आप धोने वाला यंत्र
definition: the dishwasher, the kitchen machine that washes dirty plates, glasses and cutlery automatically (die Spülmaschine, plural Spülmaschinen)
example: Stell die Teller bitte in die Spülmaschine. — Please put the plates in the dishwasher.

hindi: बर्तन धोने का साबुन — चिकनाई काटने वाला तरल
definition: washing-up liquid, the dish soap squirted into the sink to cut grease when washing plates and pans (das Spülmittel, plural Spülmittel)
example: Ein Tropfen Spülmittel reicht für das ganze Geschirr. — One drop of washing-up liquid is enough for all the dishes.

hindi: महसूस करना — शरीर में किसी संवेदना को अनुभव करना
definition: to feel or sense something physically in the body, such as pain, warmth or a light touch (regular)
example: Ich spüre einen leichten Schmerz im Rücken. — I feel a slight pain in my back.

hindi: राज्य — सरकार, क़ानून, ज़मीन और नागरिकों वाली राजनीतिक इकाई
definition: a state, a country seen as a political unit with its own government, legal system, territory and citizens (der Staat, plural Staaten)
example: Der Staat zahlt das Kindergeld jeden Monat. — The state pays the child benefit every month.

hindi: सरकारी वकील — अपराध में राज्य की ओर से आरोप लगाने वाला अभियोजक
definition: a public prosecutor, the lawyer who brings criminal charges on behalf of the state and argues them in court (der Staatsanwalt, plural Staatsanwälte)
example: Der Staatsanwalt fordert drei Jahre Haft. — The prosecutor is demanding three years in prison.

hindi: नागरिकता — किसी राज्य का क़ानूनी सदस्य होने की स्थिति
definition: citizenship, the legal status of belonging to a state with full rights and obligations (die Staatsbürgerschaft, plural Staatsbürgerschaften)
example: Sie hat letztes Jahr die deutsche Staatsbürgerschaft bekommen. — She received German citizenship last year.

hindi: स्थिर — मज़बूत, डगमगाने वाला नहीं
definition: stable, sturdy and unlikely to wobble or collapse, used of furniture, structures, prices and a patient's condition
example: Der Tisch ist stabil und trägt viel Gewicht. — The table is sturdy and bears a lot of weight.

hindi: साही — तीखे काँटों से ढका हुआ जानवर
definition: a porcupine, the animal covered in long sharp quills that it raises when threatened, literally a spiky pig (das Stachelschwein, plural Stachelschweine)
example: Das Stachelschwein stellte seine Stacheln auf. — The porcupine raised its quills.

hindi: क्रीड़ांगन — दर्शक दीर्घाओं वाला बड़ा खेल मैदान
definition: a stadium, the large sports arena with stands for thousands of spectators, used for football and athletics (das Stadion, plural Stadien)
example: Das Stadion war bis auf den letzten Platz voll. — The stadium was full to the last seat.

hindi: शहर — बड़ी बस्ती जहाँ बहुत लोग रहते और काम करते हैं
definition: a town or city, a large settlement with streets, shops and many inhabitants, also its local administration (die Stadt, plural Städte)
example: Die Stadt baut einen neuen Spielplatz. — The city is building a new playground.

hindi: शहर का बीचोबीच — नगर का केंद्रीय, व्यस्त हिस्सा
definition: the middle of a town, the central inner part where shops and public life gather, a common word on buses and signs (die Stadtmitte, plural Stadtmitten)
example: Dieser Bus fährt bis zur Stadtmitte. — This bus goes as far as the town centre.

hindi: शहर का नक़्शा — सड़कों और जगहों का चित्रित मानचित्र
definition: a city map or street plan showing the streets, squares and landmarks of a town, the sheet a visitor unfolds to find the way (der Stadtplan, plural Stadtpläne)
example: Auf dem Stadtplan ist der Dom rot markiert. — The cathedral is marked in red on the city map.

hindi: शहर का किनारा — नगर की बाहरी सीमा का इलाक़ा
definition: the edge or outskirts of a town, the outer fringe where the city thins into countryside (der Stadtrand, plural Stadtränder)
example: Am Stadtrand sind die Mieten günstiger. — On the outskirts the rents are cheaper.

hindi: शहर का हिस्सा — नगर का एक नामी इलाक़ा या मोहल्ला
definition: a district or part of a city, a named quarter with its own character and neighbourhood life (der Stadtteil, plural Stadtteile)
example: In welchem Stadtteil wohnst du? — Which part of town do you live in?

hindi: नगर केंद्र — शहर का सबसे व्यस्त मध्य भाग
definition: the central district of a city, the busiest inner part where shops and offices gather, the town centre (das Stadtzentrum, plural Stadtzentren)
example: Das Hotel liegt direkt im Stadtzentrum. — The hotel is right in the city centre.

hindi: इस्पात — लोहे से बनी और भी मज़बूत धातु, पुलों और चाकुओं के लिए
definition: steel, the very strong metal made from iron and carbon, used for bridges, cars, knives and building frames (der Stahl, plural Stähle)
example: Die Brücke ist aus Stahl gebaut. — The bridge is built of steel.

hindi: बाड़ा — जानवरों के रहने का भवन, अस्तबल
definition: a stable or barn, the building where farm animals such as horses, cows or pigs are kept (der Stall, plural Ställe)
example: Die Pferde stehen nachts im Stall. — The horses stand in the stable at night.

hindi: तना — पेड़ का मोटा मुख्य खंभा
definition: a trunk, the thick main stem of a tree from which the branches grow (der Stamm, plural Stämme)
example: Der Stamm der Eiche ist sehr dick. — The trunk of the oak is very thick.

hindi: वंश-वृक्ष — पीढ़ियों की सूची पेड़ की तरह बनी
definition: the family tree, a chart showing ancestors and descendants across the generations of a family (der Stammbaum, plural Stammbäume)
example: Mein Opa hat unseren Stammbaum bis 1800 erforscht. — My grandpa researched our family tree back to 1800.

hindi: नियमित ग्राहक — एक ही कैफ़े या रेस्तराँ में बार-बार आने वाला जाना-पहचाना मेहमान
definition: a regular customer, someone who returns to the same café, restaurant or tavern so often that the staff know them (der Stammgast, plural Stammgäste)
example: Der Stammgast bekommt immer seinen Lieblingstisch. — The regular always gets his favourite table.

hindi: पक्का अड्डा — पब की वह मेज़ जहाँ नियमित लोग रोज़ जुटते हैं
definition: the reserved pub table where the same regulars gather each week to settle politics over their beer
example: Every Thursday he vanishes to the Stammtisch and returns with the village's opinions.

hindi: विवाह-पंजीकरण कार्यालय — जन्म, विवाह और मृत्यु दर्ज करने वाला दफ़्तर
definition: the registry office where births, marriages and deaths are officially recorded and where civil weddings take place (das Standesamt, plural Standesämter)
example: Wir heiraten im Juni auf dem Standesamt. — We are getting married at the registry office in June.

hindi: ठिकाना — किसी व्यक्ति, दुकान या कंपनी की सटीक जगह
definition: the exact location or site where a person, shop or company is situated, the word a phone map uses for your current position (der Standort, plural Standorte)
example: Die Firma hat einen neuen Standort in Leipzig. — The company has a new site in Leipzig.

hindi: मत — किसी विषय पर अपनी स्थिति या रुख़
definition: a standpoint or position, the firm point of view someone holds and defends in a discussion (der Standpunkt, plural Standpunkte)
example: Ich verstehe deinen Standpunkt, aber ich teile ihn nicht. — I understand your position, but I do not share it.

hindi: भारी कदमों से चलना — बर्फ़ या कीचड़ में धम-धम कर चलना
definition: to trudge or tramp along with heavy laboured steps, typically through snow, mud or deep sand (regular: ist gestapft)
example: Wir stapfen durch den tiefen Schnee zum Haus. — We trudge through the deep snow to the house.

hindi: मज़बूत — ताक़तवर, शक्तिशाली
definition: strong, powerful and forceful, used of muscles, coffee, storms and arguments, also colloquially meaning great or impressive
example: Der Kaffee ist mir zu stark. — The coffee is too strong for me.

hindi: घूरना — बिना पलक झपकाए टकटकी लगाना
definition: to stare fixedly at something with unmoving eyes, whether from shock, boredom or fascination (regular, auf + Akkusativ)
example: Er starrte stundenlang auf den Bildschirm. — He stared at the screen for hours.

hindi: उड़ान भरना — विमान का ज़मीन से हवा में उठना, या कुछ शुरू करना
definition: to take off, of an aircraft leaving the runway, or to start a journey, engine or machine (regular; ist gestartet for taking off)
example: Das Flugzeug startet in einer halben Stunde. — The plane takes off in half an hour.

hindi: आँकड़े — संख्याओं का संग्रह और उनका विश्लेषण
definition: statistics, the collection and analysis of numerical data about a population or activity, also a single such set of figures (die Statistik, plural Statistiken)
example: Die Statistik zeigt einen klaren Anstieg der Preise. — The statistics show a clear rise in prices.

hindi: के बजाय — किसी चीज़ की जगह दूसरी चीज़
definition: instead of, in place of something else that was expected, planned or possible (preposition, + Genitiv, colloquially + Dativ)
example: Statt Kaffee trinke ich heute Tee. — Instead of coffee I am drinking tea today.

hindi: इसके बजाय — अपेक्षित चीज़ की जगह कुछ और करना
definition: instead of that; an adverb saying one thing was done in place of another that was expected
example: Er kam nicht, stattdessen schickte er eine Nachricht. — He did not come, instead he sent a message.

hindi: जाम — गाड़ियों की लंबी रुकी हुई क़तार
definition: a traffic jam, a long line of vehicles standing still or crawling because the road is blocked (der Stau, plural Staus)
example: Wir standen zwei Stunden im Stau. — We were stuck in a traffic jam for two hours.

hindi: धूल — फ़र्नीचर और फ़र्श पर जमने वाले सूक्ष्म कण
definition: dust, the fine dry powder of tiny particles that settles on furniture, shelves and floors inside a house (der Staub, no plural)
example: Auf dem Regal liegt eine dicke Schicht Staub. — There is a thick layer of dust on the shelf.

hindi: मशीन से धूल चूसना — बिजली के यंत्र से कालीन और फ़र्श की धूल साफ़ करना
definition: to vacuum a carpet or floor with a vacuum cleaner, the everyday chore verb formed from Staub and saugen (regular: hat gestaubsaugt)
example: Ich muss noch das Wohnzimmer staubsaugen. — I still have to vacuum the living room.

hindi: धूल चूसने की मशीन — हवा खींचकर कालीन और फ़र्श की धूल साफ़ करने वाला बिजली का यंत्र
definition: a vacuum cleaner, the electric household machine that sucks dust and dirt from carpets and floors (der Staubsauger, plural Staubsauger)
example: Der Staubsauger ist viel zu laut für die Nachbarn. — The vacuum cleaner is far too loud for the neighbours.

hindi: धूल पोंछने का कपड़ा — फ़र्नीचर से धूल हटाने वाला मुलायम कपड़ा
definition: a dusting cloth, the soft rag or microfibre cloth used to wipe dust from furniture and surfaces (das Staubtuch, plural Staubtücher)
example: Das Staubtuch liegt in der Schublade unter der Spüle. — The dusting cloth is in the drawer under the sink.

hindi: चकित होना — किसी बात पर विस्मय से भर जाना
definition: to be amazed or astonished, to marvel with open eyes at something impressive, huge or unexpected (regular: staunt, hat gestaunt; über + Akkusativ)
example: Die Kinder staunen über den großen Elefanten. — The children marvel at the huge elephant.

hindi: बिजली का खाँचा — दीवार में बिजली की पिन लगाने की जगह
definition: an electrical socket or outlet, the fitting in a wall into which a plug is pushed to draw power (die Steckdose, plural Steckdosen)
example: Gibt es hier eine Steckdose? — Is there a power socket here?

hindi: खोंसना — किसी चीज़ को किसी जगह में घुसाकर रखना
definition: to stick, insert or tuck something into a narrow space, like putting a key in a lock or hands in pockets (regular: hat gesteckt, place with Akkusativ)
example: Er steckt den Schlüssel ins Schloss. — He puts the key into the lock.

hindi: बिजली की पिन — तार के सिरे पर लगा हिस्सा जो दीवार की बिजली-डिब्बी में जाता है
definition: a plug, the fitting at the end of a cable that connects an electrical device to a wall socket (der Stecker, plural Stecker)
example: Zieh bitte den Stecker aus der Dose. — Please pull the plug out of the socket.

hindi: खड़ा होना — पैरों पर सीधा टिके रहना
definition: to stand upright on your feet, or of an object to be placed vertically somewhere (irregular: steht, stand, hat gestanden)
example: Das Auto steht vor dem Haus. — The car is standing in front of the house.

hindi: रुक जाना — चलते-चलते ठहर जाना
definition: to stop walking and stand still, also of a clock or engine that stops running (irregular: blieb stehen, ist stehen geblieben)
example: Bleib bitte kurz stehen, ich muss mir die Schuhe binden. — Please stop for a moment, I have to tie my shoes.

hindi: चुराना — किसी की चीज़ बिना पूछे ले लेना
definition: to steal, to take something that belongs to another person without permission and keep it (stiehlt, hat gestohlen)
example: Jemand hat mein Fahrrad gestohlen. — Someone has stolen my bicycle.

hindi: चढ़ना या उतरना — सीढ़ी, पहाड़ या गाड़ी में कदम रखते हुए ऊपर-नीचे जाना
definition: to climb, ascend or step upward, also to get into or out of a vehicle; of prices, to rise (irregular: stieg, ist gestiegen)
example: Wir steigen langsam auf den Hügel. — We slowly climb up the hill.

hindi: खड़ा, ढालू — बहुत तेज़ी से ऊपर या नीचे जाने वाला
definition: steep, rising or falling at a sharp angle, said of slopes, paths and stairs that are hard to climb
example: Der Weg zum Gipfel ist sehr steil. — The path to the summit is very steep.

hindi: पत्थर — धरती से निकला कठोर ठोस पदार्थ, या उसका टुकड़ा
definition: stone or rock, the hard natural material of mountains and walls, also one single piece of it that you can hold or throw (der Stein, plural Steine)
example: Die Mauer ist aus Stein. — The wall is made of stone.

hindi: पद — किसी कंपनी में खाली या भरी हुई नौकरी की जगह
definition: a job position or post at a company, the vacancy that someone applies for or currently holds (die Stelle, plural Stellen)
example: Die Firma hat eine neue Stelle ausgeschrieben. — The company has advertised a new position.

hindi: खड़ा करके रखना — किसी चीज़ को सीधी अवस्था में रखना
definition: to put or place something upright in a standing position, such as a bottle on a shelf; also to ask a question (regular: hat gestellt, place with Akkusativ)
example: Stell die Flasche bitte in den Kühlschrank. — Please put the bottle in the fridge.

hindi: नौकरी का विज्ञापन — खाली पद और उसकी शर्तों की प्रकाशित सूचना
definition: a job advertisement, the notice published online or in newspapers announcing an open position, its tasks and the requirements for applicants (die Stellenanzeige, plural Stellenanzeigen)
example: Ich habe die Stellenanzeige in der Zeitung gesehen. — I saw the job advertisement in the newspaper.

hindi: अभिमत — किसी मुद्दे पर औपचारिक लिखित राय या पक्ष
definition: a formal statement of position, the written opinion or response an organisation or person gives on a question or complaint (die Stellungnahme, plural Stellungnahmen)
example: Die Abteilung bittet um eine kurze Stellungnahme. — The department requests a brief statement.

hindi: मुहर — दस्तावेज़ पर लगाई जाने वाली दफ़्तरी छाप
definition: a rubber stamp or the official mark it leaves on a document, showing a date, an office or approval (der Stempel, plural Stempel)
example: Ohne Stempel akzeptiert das Amt das Formular nicht. — Without a stamp the office does not accept the form.

hindi: मरना — जीवन का अंत होना
definition: to die, to stop living, reaching the final moment of a person's or animal's life through illness, accident or ageing (stirbt, ist gestorben, an + Dativ for the cause)
example: Mein Großvater ist letztes Jahr gestorben. — My grandfather died last year.

hindi: किसी बीमारी से मरना — किसी रोग या चोट के कारण मृत्यु होना
definition: to perish from an illness, injury, disease or other cause, dying because of it and losing your life (an + Dativ, stirbt, ist gestorben)
example: Sein Großvater starb an einem Herzinfarkt. — His grandfather died of a heart attack.

hindi: सदैव, हमेशा — हर समय, औपचारिक स्वर में
definition: always, at all times, constantly, a more formal or elevated equivalent of immer common in writing
example: Er war stets freundlich zu uns. — He was always friendly to us.

hindi: कर — नागरिकों और कंपनियों द्वारा राज्य को दिया जाने वाला धन
definition: a tax, the compulsory levy that citizens and companies must pay to the state on income and goods to fund public services (die Steuer, plural Steuern)
example: Die Steuer auf Benzin wird wieder erhöht. — The tax on petrol is being raised again.

hindi: कर सलाहकार — कर विवरण भरने और कर की सलाह देने वाला
definition: a tax adviser, the licensed professional who prepares tax returns and advises clients on taxes (der Steuerberater, plural Steuerberater)
example: Mein Steuerberater macht jedes Jahr meine Steuererklärung. — My tax adviser does my tax return every year.

hindi: आयकर विवरणी — कर कार्यालय को दी जाने वाली सालाना आय की घोषणा
definition: a tax return, the yearly written declaration of income and expenses submitted to the tax office (die Steuererklärung, plural Steuererklärungen)
example: Ich muss meine Steuererklärung bis Juli abgeben. — I have to submit my tax return by July.

hindi: ऊँचा जूता — टखने या घुटने तक पहुँचने वाला जूता
definition: a boot, the tall shoe reaching the ankle or knee that protects against rain, snow and mud (der Stiefel, plural Stiefel)
example: Der linke Stiefel ist undicht. — The left boot is leaking.

hindi: सौतेली माँ — पिता की दूसरी पत्नी
definition: the stepmother, the wife of one's father who is not one's own mother, famous from fairy tales (die Stiefmutter, plural Stiefmütter)
example: Ihre Stiefmutter ist sehr nett zu ihr. — Her stepmother is very kind to her.

hindi: सौतेला पिता — माँ का दूसरा पति
definition: the stepfather, the husband of one's mother who is not one's own biological father but helps raise the children (der Stiefvater, plural Stiefväter)
example: Sein Stiefvater bringt ihn jeden Morgen zur Schule. — His stepfather takes him to school every morning.

hindi: सीढ़ी — ऑस्ट्रिया और दक्षिण में इमारत के अंदर की सीढ़ियाँ
definition: the Austrian and southern word for a staircase, the flight of steps inside a building that the rest of Germany calls Treppe (die Stiege, plural Stiegen)
example: Die Stiege zum Keller ist ziemlich steil. — The staircase to the cellar is rather steep.

hindi: साँड़ — गाय का नर, बैल
definition: a bull, the male of cattle, a large powerful animal with horns kept for breeding (der Stier, plural Stiere)
example: Der Stier ist gefährlich, bleib am Zaun. — The bull is dangerous, stay by the fence.

hindi: शांत, चुप — जहाँ कोई आवाज़ या हलचल न हो
definition: silent and calm, without noise or movement, also used for still mineral water without bubbles
example: Im Wald war es ganz still. — In the forest it was completely silent.

hindi: मत — चुनाव में डाला गया वोट; आवाज़ भी
definition: a vote cast in an election or ballot, also the voice with which a person speaks or sings (die Stimme, plural Stimmen)
example: Jede Stimme zählt bei dieser Wahl. — Every vote counts in this election.

hindi: सही होना — किसी बात का तथ्यों से मेल खाना
definition: to be right, to be correct; said of a statement, figure or bill that matches the facts, and "stimmt!" alone is an everyday spoken agreement (regular)
example: Stimmt, morgen ist ja Feiertag. — Right, tomorrow is a holiday after all.

hindi: बाक़ी रख लो — हिसाब से ज़्यादा देकर बैरे से कहा जाने वाला वाक्य
definition: keep the change, the phrase said to a waiter or driver when handing over more money than the bill total
example: Zwanzig Euro, stimmt so. — Twenty euros, keep the change.

hindi: माहौल — व्यक्ति या जगह का भावनात्मक वातावरण और मूड
definition: the emotional mood or atmosphere of a person, a group or a place at a particular time (die Stimmung, plural Stimmungen)
example: Auf der Party war die Stimmung großartig. — The mood at the party was great.

hindi: बदबू देना — दुर्गंध फैलाना
definition: to stink or give off a foul unpleasant smell, also colloquially for something being suspicious (irregular: stinkt, hat gestunken, nach + Dativ)
example: Der Müll stinkt schon seit Tagen. — The rubbish has been stinking for days.

hindi: बदबूदार धारीदार जानवर — खतरे में बदबूदार द्रव छोड़ने वाला काला-सफ़ेद जीव
definition: a skunk, the black and white striped animal that sprays a terrible smelling liquid when threatened, literally a stinking animal (das Stinktier, plural Stinktiere)
example: Ein Stinktier lief nachts über die Straße. — A skunk ran across the road at night.

hindi: छात्रवृत्ति — पढ़ाई के लिए मिलने वाली आर्थिक सहायता
definition: a scholarship, the financial grant or regular payment given to a gifted or needy student to support their studies (das Stipendium, plural Stipendien)
example: Sie hat ein Stipendium für ein Jahr in Berlin bekommen. — She received a scholarship for a year in Berlin.

hindi: माथा — भौंहों और बालों के बीच चेहरे का ऊपरी हिस्सा
definition: the forehead, the flat upper part of the face between the eyebrows and the hairline (die Stirn, plural Stirnen)
example: Er wischte sich den Schweiß von der Stirn. — He wiped the sweat from his forehead.

hindi: मंज़िल — इमारत का एक तल
definition: a floor or storey, one level of a building counted from the ground floor upwards (das Stockwerk, plural Stockwerke)
example: Das Büro liegt im dritten Stockwerk. — The office is on the third floor.

hindi: कपड़ा/वस्त्र-सामग्री — जिससे कपड़े सिले जाते हैं
definition: fabric or cloth, the woven material from which clothes and curtains are made (der Stoff, plural Stoffe)
example: Der Stoff fühlt sich weich an. — The fabric feels soft.

hindi: बड़े दिन की मेवा-रोटी — सूखे मेवे और मार्ज़िपान वाली भारी मीठी रोटी
definition: a heavy sweet Christmas bread loaf filled with raisins, candied fruit and often marzipan, dusted thickly with sugar (der Stollen, plural Stollen)
example: Der Stollen aus Dresden ist berühmt. — The Christmas loaf from Dresden is famous.

hindi: ठोकर खाना — पैर अटकने से लड़खड़ा जाना
definition: to stumble or trip over an obstacle and almost fall, catching your foot on something (regular: ist gestolpert; über + Akkusativ)
example: Ich bin über die Stufe gestolpert. — I tripped over the step.

hindi: गर्व — अपनी उपलब्धि पर संतोष; या घमंड
definition: the pride felt in your own achievements, family or worth, which can also turn into haughty arrogance towards others (der Stolz, no plural)
example: Der Stolz in ihren Augen war nicht zu übersehen. — The pride in her eyes was impossible to miss.

hindi: सारस — छत पर घोंसला बनाने वाला लंबी टाँगों का पक्षी
definition: a stork, the tall white bird with long legs that nests on rooftops and, in folklore, brings babies (der Storch, plural Störche)
example: Auf dem Kirchturm nistet ein Storch. — A stork nests on the church tower.

hindi: हकलाना — बोलते समय शब्दों में अटकना
definition: to stutter or stammer, repeating sounds and getting stuck on words while speaking (regular: stottert, hat gestottert)
example: Vor Aufregung fing er an zu stottern. — He started stuttering from excitement.

hindi: दंडनीय — जिस पर क़ानूनन सज़ा हो सकती हो
definition: punishable under criminal statute, describing an action that counts as a criminal offence and brings a penalty
example: Beleidigung ist in Deutschland strafbar. — Insult is a punishable offence in Germany.

hindi: सज़ा — अपराध या ग़लती के बदले मिलने वाला दंड
definition: a punishment or penalty imposed for a crime or offence, whether prison, a fine or something smaller (die Strafe, plural Strafen)
example: Die Strafe fiel milder aus als erwartet. — The punishment turned out milder than expected.

hindi: दंडनीय अपराध — जिस पर क़ानूनन सज़ा हो
definition: a criminal offence, any act that the criminal law punishes, the neutral legal term for a crime (die Straftat, plural Straftaten)
example: Fahren ohne Führerschein ist eine Straftat. — Driving without a licence is a criminal offence.

hindi: चालान — यातायात नियम तोड़ने पर मिलने वाली जुर्माने की पर्ची
definition: a parking or traffic ticket, the written fine notice left on a vehicle or sent to the driver (der Strafzettel, plural Strafzettel)
example: Ich habe schon wieder einen Strafzettel bekommen. — I got another parking ticket.

hindi: समुद्र-तट — समुद्र किनारे की रेतीली ज़मीन, जहाँ लोग धूप सेंकते हैं
definition: a beach, the sandy or pebbly shore beside the sea where people swim and sunbathe (der Strand, plural Strände)
example: Wir liegen den ganzen Tag am Strand. — We lie on the beach the whole day.

hindi: झाड़ — कई तनों वाला छोटा झाड़ीदार पौधा
definition: a shrub, a woody plant smaller than a tree with several stems branching from the base, often planted in gardens (der Strauch, plural Sträucher)
example: Im Frühling blüht der Strauch weiß. — In spring the shrub blooms white.

hindi: गुलदस्ता — तोड़े हुए फूलों का बँधा गुच्छा
definition: a bouquet, a bunch of cut flowers arranged and tied together as a present or decoration (der Strauß, plural Sträuße)
example: Zum Geburtstag bekam sie einen großen Strauß Tulpen. — For her birthday she received a large bouquet of tulips.

hindi: सड़क — गाड़ियों और लोगों के चलने का पक्का रास्ता
definition: a street or road, the paved route through a town that vehicles drive along and houses stand beside (die Straße, plural Straßen)
example: Die Straße ist wegen einer Baustelle gesperrt. — The street is closed because of roadworks.

hindi: सड़क-रेल — सड़क पर बिछी पटरी पर चलने वाली बिजली की गाड़ी
definition: a tram, the electric rail vehicle that runs on tracks laid in city streets (die Straßenbahn, plural Straßenbahnen)
example: Die Straßenbahn fährt alle zehn Minuten. — The tram runs every ten minutes.

hindi: सड़क की बत्ती — रात में सड़क रोशन करने वाला खंभा
definition: a street lamp, a tall post with a light that illuminates the road and pavement at night (die Straßenlaterne, plural Straßenlaternen)
example: Unter der Straßenlaterne wartete ein Mann. — A man was waiting under the street lamp.

hindi: सीधे देखना-सुनना — इंटरनेट से फ़िल्म या गाना चलाना
definition: to watch or listen to music, films and series directly over the internet, or to broadcast live online (regular: hat gestreamt)
example: Wir streamen heute Abend eine Serie. — We are streaming a series tonight.

hindi: नंबरों का दीवाना — शिक्षक की वाहवाही के लिए खटने वाला
definition: an anxious overachiever who works for the teacher's approval rather than for the subject itself
example: Nobody sat with the class Streber, and he finished top of the year anyway.

hindi: उद्यमी — आगे बढ़ने की लगन से मेहनत करने वाला
definition: ambitious and industrious, eagerly working hard in order to get ahead in school or career
example: Der strebsame Lehrling wurde schnell befördert. — The ambitious apprentice was promoted quickly.

hindi: मार्ग — दो जगहों के बीच की रेल लाइन या दूरी
definition: a route or stretch of track, the line and distance a train or bus travels between two places (die Strecke, plural Strecken)
example: Die Strecke nach Basel ist wegen Bauarbeiten gesperrt. — The line to Basel is closed due to construction work.

hindi: रंगना — ब्रश से दीवार या दरवाज़े पर रंग चढ़ाना
definition: to paint a wall, fence or door with a brush or roller, covering the surface with colour; also to cross out (irregular: streicht, hat gestrichen)
example: Wir streichen das Zimmer am Wochenende. — We are painting the room at the weekend.

hindi: गश्त — पुलिस का इलाक़े में चक्कर लगाना
definition: a police patrol, officers or a patrol car moving through an area to keep watch and maintain order (die Streife, plural Streifen)
example: Nachts fährt hier regelmäßig eine Streife. — A patrol drives through here regularly at night.

hindi: हड़ताल — माँगें मनवाने के लिए मज़दूरों का काम रोकना
definition: a strike, an organised stoppage of work by employees to press their demands on employers (der Streik, plural Streiks)
example: Wegen des Streiks fahren heute keine Züge. — Because of the strike no trains are running today.

hindi: झगड़ा — तेज़ बहस या लड़ाई
definition: a quarrel or argument, a heated dispute between partners, friends or neighbours with raised voices (der Streit, plural rare: Streite)
example: Nach dem Streit sprachen sie zwei Tage nicht. — After the argument they did not speak for two days.

hindi: झगड़ना — गुस्से में बहस या विवाद करना
definition: to argue or quarrel with someone, having a heated disagreement in words (irregular: streitet, hat gestritten, sich streiten mit + Dativ)
example: Die Nachbarn streiten sich ständig. — The neighbours are constantly quarrelling.

hindi: कड़ा या सख़्त — नियमों में ढील न देने वाला
definition: strict or severe, demanding obedience and allowing no exceptions to the rules, often said of teachers
example: Unser Mathelehrer ist ziemlich streng. — Our maths teacher is quite strict.

hindi: तनाव — काम या दबाव से होने वाली मानसिक थकान
definition: stress, strain or pressure from too much work or worry, very common everyday word (der Stress, no plural)
example: Der Stress im Büro macht mich müde. — The stress at the office makes me tired.

hindi: तनावभरा, थकाऊ — दबाव और भागदौड़ वाला
definition: stressful, hectic or full of pressure, the colloquial adjective for days, jobs and periods that exhaust you
example: Die Woche vor der Prüfung war sehr stressig. — The week before the exam was very stressful.

hindi: चूरेदार परत — मक्खन, चीनी और आटे का चूरा जो केक के ऊपर सेंका जाता है
definition: a crumbly topping of butter, sugar and flour baked over cakes and fruit tarts, borrowed into English baking (der Streusel, plural Streusel)
example: Die Streusel auf dem Pflaumenkuchen sind knusprig. — The streusel on the plum cake is crunchy.

hindi: बुनना — सलाइयों से ऊन का कपड़ा बनाना
definition: to knit, to make fabric or garments from yarn with two needles as a craft (regular: hat gestrickt)
example: Sie strickt einen Schal für den Winter. — She is knitting a scarf for winter.

hindi: बुनी हुई जैकेट — सामने से खुलने वाला ऊनी कार्डिगन
definition: a cardigan, the knitted woollen jacket that opens down the front with buttons or a zip (die Strickjacke, plural Strickjacken)
example: Oma sitzt in ihrer grauen Strickjacke am Fenster. — Grandma sits by the window in her grey cardigan.

hindi: पुआल — अनाज कटने के बाद बचे सूखे पीले डंठल
definition: straw, the dry yellow stalks left after grain is threshed, used as bedding for animals (das Stroh, no plural)
example: Die Kinder spielen auf dem Stroh in der Scheune. — The children play on the straw in the barn.

hindi: बिजली, महानदी — बिजली की धारा, या बहुत बड़ी चौड़ी नदी
definition: electric current or power supply, the electricity flowing from the mains; also a broad mighty river flowing into the ocean (der Strom, plural Ströme)
example: Nach dem Sturm ist der Strom ausgefallen. — After the storm the power went out.

hindi: बिजली गुल — कुछ समय के लिए बिजली का चले जाना
definition: a power cut, a sudden interruption of the electricity supply that leaves homes and streets dark (der Stromausfall, plural Stromausfälle)
example: Beim Stromausfall saßen wir zwei Stunden im Dunkeln. — During the power cut we sat in the dark for two hours.

hindi: बिजली की खपत — जितनी बिजली इस्तेमाल होती है
definition: electricity consumption, the amount of power a household, device or country uses over a period (der Stromverbrauch, no plural)
example: Unser Stromverbrauch ist im Winter viel höher. — Our electricity consumption is much higher in winter.

hindi: लच्छेदार भरवाँ मिठाई — बहुत पतले आटे में सेब या पनीर भरकर लपेटी सिकी मिठाई
definition: a baked pastry of paper-thin dough rolled around a sweet filling such as apple or curd, an Austrian favourite (der Strudel, plural Strudel)
example: Der Apfelstrudel schmeckt warm mit Vanillesoße am besten. — The apple strudel tastes best warm with vanilla sauce.

hindi: मोज़ा-पतलून — कमर से पैर तक ढकने वाला पतला बुना वस्त्र
definition: tights or pantyhose, the thin close-fitting garment covering feet, legs and hips in one piece (die Strumpfhose, plural Strumpfhosen)
example: Meine Strumpfhose hat ein Loch. — My tights have a hole.

hindi: छात्र — विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ने वाला पुरुष विद्यार्थी
definition: a male university student, someone enrolled at a higher education institution and studying for a degree (der Student, plural Studenten)
example: Der Student sitzt jeden Tag in der Bibliothek. — The student sits in the library every day.

hindi: छात्रा — विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ने वाली महिला विद्यार्थी
definition: a female university student, a woman enrolled at a higher education institution and studying for a degree (die Studentin, plural Studentinnen)
example: Die Studentin schreibt gerade ihre Masterarbeit. — The student is writing her master's thesis right now.

hindi: अध्ययन — किसी प्रश्न पर किया गया वैज्ञानिक शोध और उसकी रिपोर्ट
definition: a scientific study, a piece of organised research that investigates one question and publishes its findings (die Studie, plural Studien)
example: Eine neue Studie zeigt, dass Schlaf wichtig ist. — A new study shows that sleep is important.

hindi: अध्ययन कार्यक्रम — डिग्री की ओर ले जाने वाला निश्चित पाठ्यक्रम
definition: a degree programme, the structured course of university studies that leads to one particular academic qualification (der Studiengang, plural Studiengänge)
example: Der Studiengang Informatik ist sehr beliebt. — The computer science degree programme is very popular.

hindi: शिक्षण शुल्क — विश्वविद्यालय में पढ़ने के लिए दी जाने वाली फ़ीस
definition: a tuition fee or charge, the money a student pays to a university for the right to study there each semester (die Studiengebühr, plural Studiengebühren)
example: Die Studiengebühr beträgt hier nur wenige hundert Euro. — The tuition fee here is only a few hundred euros.

hindi: पढ़ना — विश्वविद्यालय में किसी विषय का अध्ययन करना
definition: to study at a university, to pursue an academic subject for a degree at a higher education institution (regular, hat studiert)
example: Ich studiere Medizin in Hamburg. — I am studying medicine in Hamburg.

hindi: पढ़ाई — विश्वविद्यालय में डिग्री के लिए की जाने वाली अध्ययन अवधि
definition: a course of university studies, the whole period a student spends studying for a degree at a higher institution (das Studium, plural Studien)
example: Nach dem Studium möchte sie im Ausland arbeiten. — After her studies she wants to work abroad.

hindi: कुर्सी — एक व्यक्ति की पीठ वाली बैठने की चीज़
definition: a chair, the single seat with a back and usually four legs that people sit on at a table (der Stuhl, plural Stühle)
example: Bitte nimm dir einen Stuhl. — Please take a chair.

hindi: ब्रेड की स्लाइस — बर्लिन और उत्तर में मक्खन या पनीर लगी रोटी की फाँक
definition: the Berlin and northern German word for a slice of bread spread with butter and topped with cheese or sausage, a simple sandwich (die Stulle, plural Stullen)
example: Ich packe dir eine Stulle für die Schule ein. — I am packing you a sandwich for school.

hindi: भोथरा — बिना धार या नोक का
definition: blunt or dull without a sharp edge or point, describing knives and pencils, also dull for colours and feelings
example: Das Messer ist stumpf. — The knife is blunt.

hindi: घंटा — साठ मिनट की अवधि, या एक पाठ का समय
definition: an hour, the period of sixty minutes, and also a single school lesson (die Stunde, plural Stunden)
example: Die Fahrt dauert eine Stunde. — The journey takes an hour.

hindi: समय-सारणी — किस घंटे कौन सा विषय पढ़ाया जाएगा, उसकी सूची
definition: the school timetable listing which subject is taught in each lesson period on every weekday (der Stundenplan, plural Stundenpläne)
example: Der neue Stundenplan hängt an der Wand. — The new timetable is hanging on the wall.

hindi: ज़िद्दी — अपनी बात पर अड़ा रहने वाला
definition: stubborn and obstinate, flatly refusing to change your mind or listen to reason and argument (regular adjective)
example: Mein Vater ist stur wie ein Esel. — My father is as stubborn as a mule.

hindi: अड़ियलपन — टस से मस न होना
definition: immovable stubbornness, the refusal to bend that is admired in a builder and cursed in a colleague
example: Only his Sturheit kept the project alive after everyone else had quietly written it off.

hindi: तूफ़ान — बहुत तेज़ हवा वाला मौसम
definition: a storm, a period of very strong wind that bends trees and rattles roofs, often with rain (der Sturm, plural Stürme)
example: Der Sturm hat das Dach beschädigt. — The storm damaged the roof.

hindi: माता-पिता के बिना घर — घर पर अकेले होने की आज़ादी
definition: having the home to oneself because parents or partners are away, free to invite friends and do as one pleases, always used with the verb haben (sturmfreie Bude haben)
example: Meine Eltern sind weg, ich habe sturmfrei! — My parents are away, I have the house to myself!

hindi: गिरावट — अचानक ज़ोर से गिर पड़ना, या सत्ता का पतन
definition: a heavy fall or tumble from a height or while moving, also the sudden overthrow of a government (der Sturz, plural Stürze)
example: Nach dem Sturz vom Fahrrad tat ihm das Knie weh. — After the fall from the bicycle his knee hurt.

hindi: शहरी — शहर से जुड़ा या नगरपालिका द्वारा चलाया गया
definition: urban, belonging to a town or its municipal government, as in a municipal library or city-run swimming pool (regular adjective)
example: Das städtische Schwimmbad ist im Sommer immer voll. — The municipal swimming pool is always full in summer.

hindi: लगातार — बिना रुके, हर समय
definition: constantly, all the time, without a break, often with a note of irritation
example: Das Telefon klingelt ständig. — The phone rings constantly.

hindi: टुकड़ा — किसी चीज़ का एक हिस्सा या एक नग
definition: a piece or single item, the unit used when counting things sold or served individually such as cake, fruit or furniture (das Stück, plural Stücke)
example: Ein Stück Kuchen, bitte. — A piece of cake, please.

hindi: हर घंटे — प्रति घंटे होने वाला
definition: hourly, happening once every hour, typical of buses, trains and news bulletins
example: Der Bus fährt stündlich in die Stadt. — The bus goes into town hourly.

hindi: तूफ़ानी — बहुत तेज़ हवा वाला
definition: stormy, describing weather with very strong gusting wind and rough conditions outdoors or at sea
example: Bei stürmischem Wetter fahren keine Fähren. — In stormy weather no ferries run.

hindi: धड़ाम से गिरना — ज़ोर से या ऊँचाई से गिर पड़ना
definition: to fall heavily or plunge from a height, often with injury; also to rush headlong somewhere (regular: ist gestürzt)
example: Die Radfahrerin ist auf der nassen Straße gestürzt. — The cyclist fell heavily on the wet road.

hindi: खोज यंत्र — अंतरजाल पर जानकारी ढूँढने वाली सेवा
definition: a search engine, the website that finds pages and information across the internet when a person types in a question or keyword (die Suchmaschine, plural Suchmaschinen)
example: Ich habe das Rezept über eine Suchmaschine gefunden. — I found the recipe through a search engine.

hindi: लत — किसी चीज़ की ऐसी आदत जो छूटे नहीं
definition: an addiction, a compulsive dependence on a substance or activity that harms health (die Sucht, plural Süchte)
example: Die Sucht nach Zucker ist weit verbreitet. — Addiction to sugar is widespread.

hindi: जोड़ — कई संख्याओं या रकमों का कुल योग
definition: a sum, the total obtained by adding numbers together, or an amount of money named as a whole (die Summe, plural Summen)
example: Die Summe steht unten auf der Rechnung. — The total is at the bottom of the bill.

hindi: दलदल — कीचड़ और पानी से भरी नरम ज़मीन
definition: a swamp or marsh, a waterlogged area of soft muddy ground where reeds grow (der Sumpf, plural Sümpfe)
example: Der Sumpf ist voller Mücken. — The swamp is full of mosquitoes.

hindi: बेहतरीन — बहुत बढ़िया, ज़बरदस्त; बोलचाल की तारीफ़
definition: super, great, excellent; an informal all-purpose word of praise used constantly in speech, never inflected before nouns
example: Das hast du super gemacht. — You did that brilliantly.

hindi: बड़ी किराना दुकान — जहाँ ग्राहक ख़ुद सामान उठाते हैं
definition: a large self-service store selling groceries and household goods where customers fill their own trolley (der Supermarkt, plural Supermärkte)
example: Ich gehe schnell zum Supermarkt, wir haben keine Milch mehr. — I'm going quickly to the supermarket, we're out of milk.

hindi: अंतरजाल पर घूमना — बिना ख़ास मक़सद एक पन्ने से दूसरे पर जाना
definition: to browse the internet, to move from website to website reading and looking around; also to ride waves on a surfboard (regular)
example: Abends surfe ich gern im Internet. — In the evenings I like to browse the internet.

hindi: भला लगने वाला — जो पहली मुलाक़ात में ही पसंद आ जाए
definition: likeable and congenial, giving a pleasant impression that makes people like the person at once, never meaning sympathetic in the English sense
example: Der neue Kollege wirkt sehr sympathisch. — The new colleague seems very likeable.

hindi: लक्षण — बीमारी का दिखने वाला संकेत
definition: a symptom, the visible sign or felt complaint that points towards a particular illness (das Symptom, plural Symptome)
example: Fieber ist ein typisches Symptom der Grippe. — Fever is a typical symptom of the flu.

hindi: संवादों की आवाज़ बदलना — फ़िल्म के मूल संवादों को दूसरी भाषा में बोलकर बदलना
definition: to dub a film, that is to replace the original spoken dialogue with voices recorded in another language, also to synchronise data (regular: hat synchronisiert)
example: In Deutschland werden fast alle Filme synchronisiert. — In Germany almost all films are dubbed.

hindi: दृश्य — फ़िल्म या नाटक का एक छोटा हिस्सा
definition: a scene, one short section of a film or play set in a single place and time, also a social milieu (die Szene, plural Szenen)
example: Die letzte Szene des Films hat mich zum Weinen gebracht. — The last scene of the film made me cry.

hindi: बोना — खेत या क्यारी में बीज डालना
definition: to sow, to scatter or plant seeds in prepared soil so that crops or flowers grow (regular: sät, hat gesät)
example: Der Bauer sät im Frühling den Weizen. — The farmer sows the wheat in spring.

hindi: आरी — दाँतेदार पत्ती से लकड़ी काटने का औज़ार
definition: a saw or handsaw, the cutting tool with a toothed steel blade used for sawing through wood, boards and branches (die Säge, plural Sägen)
example: Die Säge liegt im Keller neben dem Holz. — The saw is in the cellar next to the wood.

hindi: आरी से काटना — दाँतेदार पत्ती चलाकर लकड़ी काटना
definition: to cut wood, metal or plastic with a saw, moving the toothed blade back and forth through the material (regular: sägt, hat gesägt)
example: Er sägt das Brett in zwei Teile. — He saws the board into two pieces.

hindi: समस्त / सारे के सारे — बिना अपवाद सभी
definition: a somewhat formal determiner meaning all of them without a single exception, stronger and more emphatic than alle, common in written and official German (plural sämtliche)
example: Sämtliche Unterlagen liegen auf dem Tisch. — All the documents are lying on the table.

hindi: गायक — गाना गाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a singer, a person who sings, whether professionally on stage or as a member of a choir or band (der Sänger, plural Sänger)
example: Der Sänger bedankt sich beim Publikum. — The singer thanks the audience.

hindi: सफ़ाई करना — गंदगी या कचरा हटाकर किसी जगह को साफ़ बनाना
definition: to clean a place or object by clearing away dirt, rubbish or debris, often used for tidying a garden, shoes or a wound (regular)
example: Bitte säubere deine Schuhe vor der Tür. — Please clean your shoes in front of the door.

hindi: दुधमुँहा शिशु — एक साल से छोटा दूध पीता बच्चा, औपचारिक शब्द
definition: an infant still being nursed or bottle-fed, the formal or medical word for a baby under about one year (der Säugling, plural Säuglinge)
example: Der Kinderarzt untersucht den Säugling gründlich. — The paediatrician examines the infant thoroughly.

hindi: दक्षिण — दिक्सूचक की दक्षिणी दिशा
definition: the south, the compass direction toward the bottom of a map, also the southern region of a country (der Süden, no plural)
example: Im Süden ist das Wetter oft wärmer. — The weather is often warmer in the south.

hindi: पाप — ईश्वर की आज्ञा का उल्लंघन; बड़ी गलती
definition: a sin, a wrongdoing that breaks a divine commandment or moral rule, also jokingly a small indulgence like cake (die Sünde, plural Sünden)
example: Dieses Dessert ist eine süße Sünde. — This dessert is a sweet sin.

hindi: बलि का बकरा — दूसरों की गलती का दोष झेलने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a person unfairly blamed and punished for the mistakes or failures of other people, the scapegoat who carries everyone's guilt (der Sündenbock, plural Sündenböcke)
example: Der neue Kollege wurde schnell zum Sündenbock für alle Fehler. — The new colleague quickly became the scapegoat for every mistake.

hindi: मीठा — चीनी जैसा स्वाद; बोलचाल में प्यारा भी
definition: sweet, tasting of sugar or honey like ripe fruit and cake, and colloquially also cute or adorable (regular comparison: süßer, am süßesten)
example: Der Honig ist mir zu süß. — The honey is too sweet for me.

hindi: मिठाई — चीनी से बनी छोटी मीठी चीज़, जैसे टॉफ़ी या चॉकलेट
definition: a sweet or piece of candy, any small sugary treat like chocolate, gummy bears or bonbons, usually in the plural (die Süßigkeit, plural Süßigkeiten)
example: Die Süßigkeiten liegen im obersten Fach. — The sweets are on the top shelf.

hindi: छोटी बाँह की सूती कमीज़ — बिना कॉलर और बटन के सिर से पहनी जाने वाली
definition: a T-shirt, the collarless short-sleeved cotton shirt pulled over the head and worn casually everywhere (das T-Shirt, plural T-Shirts)
example: Im Sommer reicht ein T-Shirt. — In summer a T-shirt is enough.

hindi: तालिका — पंक्तियों और स्तंभों में सजाए आँकड़े
definition: a table or chart, data arranged in rows and columns for easy comparison, also the league standings in sport (die Tabelle, plural Tabellen)
example: Die Ergebnisse stehen in der Tabelle auf Seite zwei. — The results are in the table on page two.

hindi: पटल संगणक — उँगली से छूकर चलाया जाने वाला पतला सपाट संगणक
definition: a tablet, the flat handheld computer with a touch screen and no keyboard, used for reading, videos and browsing (das Tablet, plural Tablets)
example: Die Kinder schauen Filme auf dem Tablet. — The children watch films on the tablet.

hindi: गोली — मुँह से ली जाने वाली छोटी ठोस दवा
definition: a tablet or pill, the small solid dose of medicine that is swallowed with water (die Tablette, plural Tabletten)
example: Die Tablette hilft gegen Kopfschmerzen. — The tablet helps against headaches.

hindi: श्यामपट — कक्षा के सामने का बोर्ड जिस पर शिक्षक लिखते हैं
definition: the blackboard or whiteboard at the front of the classroom on which the teacher writes during lessons (die Tafel, plural Tafeln)
example: Der Lehrer schreibt das Datum an die Tafel. — The teacher writes the date on the board.

hindi: दिन का उदय — रात खत्म होकर सुबह की रोशनी फूटने का समय
definition: daybreak, the moment at dawn when the first morning light appears and the night ends (der Tagesanbruch, plural Tagesanbrüche)
example: Der Tagesanbruch kam kurz nach fünf Uhr. — Daybreak came shortly after five o'clock.

hindi: आज की सूची — रेस्तराँ में केवल आज बनने वाले ख़ास खानों की छोटी सूची
definition: the menu of the day, the short list of dishes a restaurant cooks only today, often cheaper at lunchtime (die Tageskarte, plural Tageskarten)
example: Auf der Tageskarte steht heute Gulasch mit Nudeln. — Today's menu has goulash with noodles.

hindi: दिन की पालक माँ — अपने घर में दिनभर छोटे बच्चों की देखभाल करने वाली महिला
definition: a childminder, a woman who looks after several small children in her own home during working hours for payment (die Tagesmutter, plural Tagesmütter)
example: Die Tagesmutter betreut drei Kinder gleichzeitig. — The childminder looks after three children at once.

hindi: कार्यसूची — बैठक में चर्चा होने वाले मुद्दों की सूची
definition: the agenda of a meeting, the ordered list of topics and items that will be discussed during the session (die Tagesordnung, plural Tagesordnungen)
example: Die Tagesordnung hat heute nur drei Punkte. — The agenda has only three items today.

hindi: दिन के समय — दिन भर, रात के विपरीत
definition: during the daytime, in the hours of daylight as opposed to at night, throughout the working day
example: Tagsüber ist niemand zu Hause. — During the day nobody is at home.

hindi: कमर — पसलियों और कूल्हे के बीच शरीर का पतला हिस्सा
definition: the waist, the narrow middle part of the body between the ribs and the hips (die Taille, plural Taillen)
example: Der Rock sitzt eng an der Taille. — The skirt fits tightly at the waist.

hindi: ताल की मात्रा — संगीत में गिनती की इकाई, या शिष्टता
definition: a bar or beat in music, the counted unit of time that keeps players together, and also tact in dealing with people (der Takt, plural Takte)
example: Der Dirigent gibt den Takt mit der Hand an. — The conductor indicates the beat with his hand.

hindi: सूझ-बूझ वाला — नाज़ुक बात को बिना ठेस पहुँचाए कहने वाला
definition: tactful and discreet, handling delicate matters with sensitivity so that nobody is embarrassed or hurt
example: Sie hat das Problem sehr taktvoll angesprochen. — She raised the problem very tactfully.

hindi: घाटी — दो पहाड़ों के बीच की नीची ज़मीन
definition: a valley, the low stretch of land lying between hills or mountains, often with a river running through (das Tal, plural Täler)
example: Im Tal liegt ein kleines Dorf. — A small village lies in the valley.

hindi: ईंधन भरवाना — गाड़ी की टंकी में पेट्रोल या डीज़ल डालना
definition: to fill a vehicle with petrol or diesel fuel at a petrol station, to refuel the empty tank (regular: hat getankt)
example: Ich tanke schnell, der Tank ist fast leer. — I will fill up quickly, the tank is almost empty.

hindi: ईंधन केंद्र — गाड़ी में ईंधन भरवाने की जगह
definition: a petrol station where drivers fill their vehicles with fuel and often buy snacks (die Tankstelle, plural Tankstellen)
example: Die nächste Tankstelle ist zehn Kilometer entfernt. — The next petrol station is ten kilometres away.

hindi: देवदार का पेड़ — क्रिसमस पर सजाया जाने वाला सदाबहार पेड़
definition: a fir tree, the evergreen conifer that serves as the decorated Christmas tree in the festive holiday season (der Tannenbaum, plural Tannenbäume)
example: Der Tannenbaum riecht nach Wald. — The fir tree smells of the forest.

hindi: चाची, मामी, मौसी या बुआ — माता-पिता की बहन या चाचा-मामा की पत्नी
definition: the aunt, the sister of one's mother or father, or the wife of an uncle, covering every Hindi aunt word (die Tante, plural Tanten)
example: Die Tante bringt immer Geschenke mit. — The aunt always brings presents.

hindi: दीवारी काग़ज़ — भीतरी दीवार पर चिपकाया जाने वाला सजावटी काग़ज़
definition: wallpaper, the decorated paper rolls glued onto the interior walls of a room to cover and brighten them (die Tapete, plural Tapeten)
example: Die alte Tapete muss runter. — The old wallpaper has to come off.

hindi: वीर — कष्ट या ख़तरा बहादुरी से सहने वाला
definition: brave and valiant, bearing pain, fear or hardship without complaint, often said of children and soldiers
example: Das Kind war beim Zahnarzt sehr tapfer. — The child was very brave at the dentist.

hindi: सामूहिक वेतन समझौता — संघ और नियोक्ताओं का पूरे क्षेत्र के लिए वेतन और शर्तों का अनुबंध
definition: a collective wage agreement, the contract between unions and employers fixing pay and conditions for a whole sector (der Tarifvertrag, plural Tarifverträge)
example: Der neue Tarifvertrag gilt für zwei Jahre. — The new collective agreement applies for two years.

hindi: जेब/थैला — कपड़े में सिली जेब या हाथ का बैग
definition: a pocket sewn into a garment, or a bag carried by hand for shopping and belongings (die Tasche, plural Taschen)
example: Er steckt die Hände in die Taschen. — He puts his hands in his pockets.

hindi: मुलायम जिल्द वाली किताब — सस्ती, छोटी किताब जो जेब या बैग में आ जाए
definition: a paperback, the small cheap softcover edition of a book that fits easily into a pocket or bag (das Taschenbuch, plural Taschenbücher)
example: Das Taschenbuch kostet nur zehn Euro. — The paperback costs only ten euros.

hindi: गणक यंत्र — जेब में रखने लायक हिसाब लगाने की मशीन
definition: a pocket calculator, the small electronic device used for doing arithmetic and other calculations at school or work (der Taschenrechner, plural Taschenrechner)
example: In der Prüfung ist der Taschenrechner erlaubt. — The calculator is allowed in the exam.

hindi: प्याला — हत्थे वाला छोटा पात्र जिसमें चाय-कॉफ़ी पीते हैं
definition: a cup or teacup, the small handled drinking vessel from which hot beverages like coffee or tea are drunk (die Tasse, plural Tassen)
example: Möchtest du eine Tasse Kaffee? — Would you like a cup of coffee?

hindi: कुंजीपटल — संगणक पर अक्षर लिखने वाला बटनों का पटल
definition: a keyboard, the panel of keys used to type letters and numbers into a computer or phone; also the keyboard of a piano (die Tastatur, plural Tastaturen)
example: Die Tastatur hat eine deutsche Belegung. — The keyboard has a German layout.

hindi: कुंजी — टाइप करने के पटल, फ़ोन या पियानो की दबाने वाली चाबी
definition: a key or button on a keyboard, remote control, telephone or piano that you press with a finger to trigger a function or note (die Taste, plural Tasten)
example: Drück die Taste zweimal, dann speichert es. — Press the key twice, then it saves.

hindi: टटोलना — हाथों से महसूस करके ढूँढना
definition: to grope or feel one's way with the hands, searching by touch in the dark or with closed eyes (regular, nach + Dativ)
example: Im Dunkeln tastete er nach dem Lichtschalter. — In the dark he felt for the light switch.

hindi: स्पर्श शक्ति — त्वचा से छूकर महसूस करने की क्षमता
definition: the sense of touch, the ability of the skin and fingers to feel texture, pressure and warmth (der Tastsinn, no plural)
example: Blinde Menschen verlassen sich stark auf den Tastsinn. — Blind people rely heavily on the sense of touch.

hindi: घटनास्थल — जहाँ अपराध हुआ हो
definition: the scene of a crime, the exact place where an offence was committed and police gather evidence (der Tatort, plural Tatorte)
example: Die Spurensicherung untersucht den Tatort. — Forensics are examining the crime scene.

hindi: वाक़ई — सचमुच, असल में
definition: actually, indeed, really; confirming that something surprising is genuinely true after all
example: Er hat tatsächlich gewonnen. — He actually won.

hindi: बहरा — सुनने की शक्ति से रहित
definition: deaf, unable to hear, also used for a limb that has gone numb and lost feeling
example: Seine Tante ist auf einem Ohr taub. — His aunt is deaf in one ear.

hindi: कबूतर — शहर के चौकों में घूमने वाला पक्षी
definition: a pigeon or dove, the grey city bird that struts around squares and stations looking for crumbs (die Taube, plural Tauben)
example: Die Taube pickt Krümel auf dem Marktplatz. — The pigeon pecks crumbs in the market square.

hindi: गोता लगाना — पानी के नीचे जाना
definition: to dive or go underwater, to swim beneath the surface, often with a mask or diving equipment (regular; ist getaucht for motion, hat getaucht otherwise)
example: Im Urlaub sind wir im Meer getaucht. — On holiday we went diving in the sea.

hindi: पिघलना — बर्फ़ का गरमी से पानी बनना
definition: to thaw, when snow and ice melt into water as the weather turns milder (regular: es taut, hat getaut; der Schnee ist getaut)
example: Der Schnee taut schon in der Sonne. — The snow is already thawing in the sun.

hindi: बपतिस्मा — जल से ईसाई बनाने की विधि
definition: a baptism or christening, the Christian ceremony with water that receives a child or adult into the church (die Taufe, plural Taufen)
example: Die Taufe findet nächsten Sonntag statt. — The baptism takes place next Sunday.

hindi: बपतिस्मा देना — जल से ईसाई धर्म में लेना; नाम देना
definition: to baptise or christen, to receive someone into the Christian church with water and give a name, also to name a ship or animal (regular)
example: Sie lassen ihre Tochter im Mai taufen. — They are having their daughter baptised in May.

hindi: लड़खड़ाना — चक्कर या कमज़ोरी से डगमगाते हुए चलना
definition: to stagger or reel unsteadily as if dizzy, weak or stunned, barely keeping balance (regular: ist getaumelt)
example: Nach dem Schlag taumelt der Boxer zurück. — After the punch the boxer staggers back.

hindi: अदला-बदली करना — बिना पैसे एक चीज़ के बदले दूसरी लेना
definition: to swap or exchange one thing for another directly between people, without money changing hands (regular: tauscht, hat getauscht)
example: Die Kinder tauschen auf dem Schulhof Sticker. — The children swap stickers in the schoolyard.

hindi: हज़ार — दस सौ की संख्या
definition: the cardinal number thousand, a large round figure used for counting money, people and years; also used loosely for very many
example: Die Stadt hat rund tausend Einwohner. — The town has around a thousand inhabitants.

hindi: भाड़े की गाड़ी — किराये पर सवारी को मनचाही जगह ले जाने वाली गाड़ी
definition: a taxi, the hired car with a driver that takes a passenger wherever they ask for a fare (das Taxi, plural Taxis)
example: Wir nehmen ein Taxi zum Bahnhof. — We are taking a taxi to the station.

hindi: दल — साथ काम करने या खेलने वाला समूह
definition: a team, the group of players or colleagues who work together toward one goal in sport or at work (das Team, plural Teams)
example: Das Team trainiert dreimal pro Woche. — The team trains three times a week.

hindi: तकनीक — मशीनों और उपकरणों का ज्ञान और उनके काम करने का ढंग
definition: technology or technique, the practical machines and methods of engineering, also the skilled way of doing something (die Technik, plural Techniken)
example: Die Technik in diesem Auto ist ganz neu. — The technology in this car is completely new.

hindi: तकनीशियन — मशीनें लगाने और ठीक करने वाला कर्मचारी
definition: a technician, a skilled worker who installs, repairs and maintains machines or technical equipment (der Techniker, plural Techniker)
example: Der Techniker kommt morgen und repariert die Heizung. — The technician is coming tomorrow to repair the heating.

hindi: तकनीकी — मशीनों, इंजीनियरिंग या तकनीक से जुड़ा
definition: technical, relating to machines, engineering or the practical details of how something works
example: Wir haben ein technisches Problem mit dem Server. — We have a technical problem with the server.

hindi: प्रौद्योगिकी — विज्ञान पर आधारित आधुनिक तकनीकी विधियाँ
definition: technology, the advanced scientific methods and machines used in industry and modern life, slightly more formal than Technik (die Technologie, plural Technologien)
example: Die neue Technologie verändert unsere Arbeit. — The new technology is changing our work.

hindi: खिलौना भालू — नरम भरा हुआ भालू-खिलौना जिसे बच्चा गले लगाकर सोता है
definition: a teddy bear, the soft stuffed toy bear that a small child hugs and takes to bed at night (der Teddybär, plural Teddybären)
example: Ohne den Teddybären geht er nirgendwohin. — He goes nowhere without the teddy bear.

hindi: चाय — पत्तियों या जड़ी-बूटियों को उबलते पानी में डालकर बना गरम पेय
definition: tea, the hot beverage made by steeping leaves or herbs in boiling water, often served in a glass or small pot (der Tee, plural Tees)
example: Der Tee ist noch zu heiß zum Trinken. — The tea is still too hot to drink.

hindi: छोटी चम्मच — चाय हिलाने या मापने की छोटी चम्मच
definition: a teaspoon, the small spoon used for stirring tea and coffee and as a measure in recipes (der Teelöffel, plural Teelöffel)
example: Der Teelöffel liegt neben der Tasse. — The teaspoon is lying next to the cup.

hindi: तालाब — झील से छोटा स्थिर जलाशय
definition: a pond, a small body of still water smaller than a lake, often in a garden or park (der Teich, plural Teiche)
example: Im Teich schwimmen viele Frösche. — Many frogs swim in the pond.

hindi: गूँथा आटा — रोटी, केक या पास्ता के लिए तैयार लोई
definition: dough or batter, the soft kneaded mixture of flour and liquid prepared before baking bread, cake or pasta (der Teig, plural Teige)
example: Der Teig muss eine Stunde gehen. — The dough has to rise for an hour.

hindi: बाँटना — भाग करना या किसी के साथ साझा करना
definition: to divide a number by another in arithmetic, or to split something into parts and share it with other people (regular; durch + Akkusativ for division, mit + Dativ for sharing)
example: Ich teile den Kuchen mit meiner Schwester. — I share the cake with my sister.

hindi: भाग लेना — बैठक या कार्यक्रम में शामिल होना
definition: to take part in or attend a meeting, training course or event as one of the registered participants (separable: nimmt teil, hat teilgenommen, an + Dativ)
example: Ich nehme morgen an der Besprechung teil. — I am taking part in the meeting tomorrow.

hindi: किसी आयोजन में भाग लेना — बैठक, कोर्स या प्रतियोगिता में शामिल होना
definition: to take part or participate actively in a meeting, course, competition or other organised event (separable: nimmt teil, hat teilgenommen, an + Dativ)
example: Sie nimmt an einem Deutschkurs teil. — She is taking part in a German course.

hindi: प्रतिभागी — बैठक, कोर्स या सम्मेलन में शामिल व्यक्ति
definition: a participant or attendee, a person who takes part in a meeting, conference, course or telephone call (der Teilnehmer, plural Teilnehmer)
example: Jeder Teilnehmer erhält das Protokoll per E-Mail. — Every participant receives the minutes by email.

hindi: विभाजन — किसी देश या चीज़ का बँटवारा
definition: division or partition, the splitting of a country or thing into separate parts, as Germany was after the war (die Teilung, plural Teilungen)
example: Die Teilung Deutschlands dauerte über vierzig Jahre. — The division of Germany lasted over forty years.

hindi: आंशिक रूप से — कुछ हिस्सों में, पूरा नहीं
definition: partly or partially, true for some parts or some of the time but not for the whole
example: Das stimmt nur teilweise. — That is only partly true.

hindi: अंशकालिक — पूरे समय से कम घंटों की नौकरी
definition: part-time work, employment with fewer weekly hours than a full position (die Teilzeit, no plural)
example: Sie arbeitet seit dem Baby in Teilzeit. — She has worked part-time since the baby.

hindi: फ़ोन पर बात करना — टेलीफ़ोन से बातचीत करना
definition: to talk on the telephone or hold a phone conversation with another person, often for some length of time (regular: telefoniert, hat telefoniert; mit + Dativ)
