example: Ich habe gerade mit meiner Mutter telefoniert. — I just spoke to my mother on the phone.

hindi: थाली — सपाट गोल पात्र जिसमें खाना परोसा जाता है
definition: a plate, the flat round dish from which a meal is eaten at the table (der Teller, plural Teller)
example: Der Teller ist noch leer. — The plate is still empty.

hindi: तापमान — गर्मी-ठंड की नापी गई मात्रा
definition: temperature, the measured degree of warmth or cold of the outside air, the water or a human body, read from a thermometer (die Temperatur, plural Temperaturen)
example: Die Temperatur steigt heute auf dreißig Grad. — The temperature rises to thirty degrees today.

hindi: गति सीमा — रफ़्तार की अधिकतम अनुमत हद, छोटा शब्द
definition: a speed limit, the maximum speed that vehicles are allowed on a road, the shorter everyday word (das Tempolimit, plural Tempolimits)
example: Auf vielen Autobahnen gibt es kein Tempolimit. — On many motorways there is no speed limit.

hindi: रैकेट-गेंद का खेल — जाल के पार गेंद को रैकेट से मारने का खेल
definition: tennis, the racket sport in which players strike a ball over a net on a marked court (das Tennis, no plural)
example: Sie spielt seit ihrer Kindheit Tennis. — She has played tennis since childhood.

hindi: क़ालीन — फ़र्श पर बिछाया मोटा कपड़ा
definition: a carpet or rug, the thick woven floor covering that makes a room warmer and softer underfoot (der Teppich, plural Teppiche)
example: Der Teppich im Wohnzimmer ist neu. — The carpet in the living room is new.

hindi: तय मुलाक़ात — डॉक्टर या दफ़्तर से पहले से तय समय
definition: an appointment, the fixed date and time booked in advance to see a doctor or handle other business (der Termin, plural Termine)
example: Ich habe um zehn Uhr einen Termin beim Arzt. — I have an appointment with the doctor at ten.

hindi: समयसीमा का दबाव — तारीख सिर पर होने का बोझ
definition: the squeezing pressure of a deadline bearing down on work that still needs proper attention
example: Under Termindruck she shipped the feature and quietly skipped the tests.

hindi: चबूतरा — घर से सटा खुला पक्का आँगन
definition: a terrace or patio, the paved outdoor area beside a house at ground level where people sit and eat (die Terrasse, plural Terrassen)
example: Im Sommer frühstücken wir auf der Terrasse. — In summer we have breakfast on the terrace.

hindi: परीक्षण — किसी चीज़ की गुणवत्ता या काम जाँचने की विधि
definition: a test or trial that checks whether something works, whether a product, a machine, a medicine or a person's knowledge (der Test, plural Tests)
example: Das neue Handy hat den Test bestanden. — The new phone passed the test.

hindi: वसीयत — मृत्यु के बाद संपत्ति बाँटने का लिखित दस्तावेज़
definition: a will, the legal document stating who receives a person's property after death (das Testament, plural Testamente)
example: Er hat sein Testament beim Notar hinterlegt. — He deposited his will with the notary.

hindi: परीक्षण करना — किसी चीज़ को आज़माकर देखना कि वह काम करती है
definition: to test a product, machine or idea by trying it out to see whether it works as intended (regular: hat getestet)
example: Wir testen die neue Software eine Woche lang. — We are testing the new software for a week.

hindi: महँगा — ज़्यादा दाम वाला
definition: expensive, costing a large amount of money, more than seems reasonable for the thing (comparative teurer)
example: Das Hotel war schön, aber sehr teuer. — The hotel was nice but very expensive.

hindi: शैतान — बुराई का प्रतीक दुष्ट आत्मा
definition: the devil, the evil spirit opposed to God in religious belief, also used in colloquial curses and exclamations (der Teufel, plural Teufel)
example: Wer zum Teufel hat das gemacht? — Who the devil did that?

hindi: रंगमंच — नाटक दिखाने की जगह; बोलचाल में नाटकबाज़ी या हंगामा
definition: a theatre, the building and art form where plays are performed on stage; colloquially also a needless fuss or drama (das Theater, plural Theater)
example: Wir haben Karten fürs Theater am Samstag. — We have tickets for the theatre on Saturday.

hindi: नाटक — मंच पर अभिनय के लिए लिखी रचना
definition: a stage play, a dramatic work written to be performed by actors in a theatre before an audience (das Theaterstück, plural Theaterstücke)
example: Das Theaterstück dauert fast drei Stunden. — The play lasts almost three hours.

hindi: ऊँची मेज़ — शराबघर या दुकान की लंबी मेज़ जिसके पीछे से पेय परोसे जाते हैं
definition: the counter of a bar, pub or shop, the long high surface behind which drinks are poured and served (die Theke, plural Theken)
example: Wir setzen uns an die Theke und bestellen Bier. — We sit down at the counter and order beer.

hindi: सिद्धांत — तथ्यों को समझाने वाली वैज्ञानिक व्याख्या
definition: a theory, a scientific explanation of facts based on reasoning, also knowledge in principle as opposed to practice (die Theorie, plural Theorien)
example: In der Theorie klingt das einfach. — In theory that sounds simple.

hindi: सिद्धांत-वाक्य — बहस के लिए रखा गया दावा
definition: a thesis or proposition, a claim put forward as the central statement of an argument that must then be defended with reasons (die These, plural Thesen)
example: Ihre These ist mutig, aber gut begründet. — Her thesis is bold, but well founded.

hindi: प्रवेश-पत्र — उड़ान, रेल या कार्यक्रम में जाने की अनुमति वाली पर्ची
definition: a ticket for travel or admission, the everyday loanword used for flights, trains and events (das Ticket, plural Tickets)
example: Das Ticket nach München war ziemlich teuer. — The ticket to Munich was quite expensive.

hindi: गहरा — सतह से बहुत नीचे तक जाने वाला
definition: deep in depth below a surface, describing water, holes, voices and feelings, also low when describing temperatures
example: Der See ist sehr tief. — The lake is very deep.

hindi: भूमिगत वाहन-स्थल — इमारत के नीचे बनी गाड़ियाँ रखने की जगह
definition: an underground car park, a parking garage built beneath a building or square below street level (die Tiefgarage, plural Tiefgaragen)
example: Mein Auto steht in der Tiefgarage. — My car is in the underground garage.

hindi: जानवर — कोई भी पशु, इंसान के अलावा जीव
definition: an animal of any kind, the general word for every living creature that is not a human being (das Tier, plural Tiere)
example: Welches Tier ist das? — Which animal is that?

hindi: पशु चिकित्सक — बीमार जानवरों का इलाज करने वाला डॉक्टर
definition: a veterinarian or animal doctor, the medical professional who examines and treats sick or injured animals and pets (der Tierarzt, plural Tierärzte)
example: Wir bringen den Hund heute zum Tierarzt. — We are taking the dog to the vet today.

hindi: टंकण करना — कुंजीपटल पर उँगलियों से अक्षर लिखना
definition: to type, to enter text by pressing keys on a keyboard or phone screen; colloquially also to guess or to tap something lightly (regular)
example: Er tippt sehr schnell mit zwei Fingern. — He types very fast with two fingers.

hindi: मेज़ — खाने-लिखने की ऊँची सपाट चौकी
definition: a table, the flat-topped piece of furniture that people eat and work at (der Tisch, plural Tische)
example: Der Tisch steht am Fenster. — The table stands by the window.

hindi: मेज़पोश — खाने की मेज़ पर बिछाया जाने वाला कपड़ा
definition: a tablecloth, the large cloth spread over the dining table before a meal is served (die Tischdecke, plural Tischdecken)
example: Die Tischdecke hat einen Fleck. — The tablecloth has a stain.

hindi: बढ़ई — लकड़ी का फ़र्नीचर बनाने वाला, उत्तर जर्मनी का शब्द
definition: a joiner or carpenter who builds furniture, doors and fittings from wood, the northern and eastern German word (der Tischler, plural Tischler)
example: Der Tischler macht uns einen schönen Tisch. — The joiner is making us a beautiful table.

hindi: शीर्षक — किताब, फ़िल्म या नाटक का नाम
definition: the title, the name given to a book, film, play or song by which people refer to it (der Titel, plural Titel)
example: Der Titel des Films klingt sehr geheimnisvoll. — The title of the film sounds very mysterious.

hindi: मुखपृष्ठ — अख़बार या पत्रिका का पहला पन्ना
definition: the front page or cover, the first page of a newspaper or magazine carrying the main story and picture (die Titelseite, plural Titelseiten)
example: Ihr Foto war auf der Titelseite der Zeitung. — Her photo was on the front page of the newspaper.

hindi: ख़ैर, अब क्या करें — बेबसी या हिचक जताने वाला शब्द
definition: an interjection of resignation or hesitation, roughly well, what can you do, spoken before accepting something unwelcome
example: Tja, dann müssen wir warten. — Well, then we'll have to wait.

hindi: सिंकी डबलरोटी — सेंकने के लिए बनी पतली नरम सफ़ेद फाँकें
definition: toast, the soft square sliced white bread sold in packets for toasting, distinct from proper bakery bread (der Toast, plural Toasts)
example: Der Toast ist leider verbrannt. — The toast is burnt, unfortunately.

hindi: उछल-कूद मचाना — बच्चों का शोर करते हुए बेतहाशा दौड़ना-कूदना
definition: to romp or rampage boisterously, children running, shouting and jumping around with wild energy indoors or outside (regular: hat getobt)
example: Die Kinder toben laut durch das ganze Haus. — The children romp noisily through the whole house.

hindi: बेटी — माता-पिता की स्त्री संतान
definition: the daughter, the female child of a mother and father, spoken of from the parents' side of the family (die Tochter, plural Töchter)
example: Ihre Tochter wird nächste Woche zehn Jahre alt. — Her daughter turns ten next week.

hindi: मृत्यु — जीवन का अंत, मौत
definition: the death, the final ending of life, the event of dying spoken of as a fact, a moment or a painful loss (der Tod, plural Tode, rarely used)
example: Nach dem Tod der Mutter blieb das Haus leer. — After the mother's death the house stayed empty.

hindi: मृत्यु की घटना — परिवार या दफ़्तर में किसी के मरने का मामला
definition: a death considered as an event, the official or family word for someone dying (der Todesfall, plural Todesfälle)
example: Wegen eines Todesfalls bleibt das Geschäft heute geschlossen. — Due to a death the shop stays closed today.

hindi: शौचालय — मल-मूत्र त्याग की सीट और कमरा
definition: the toilet, the fixture and also the small room where a person relieves themselves (die Toilette, plural Toiletten)
example: Wo ist bitte die Toilette? — Where is the toilet, please?

hindi: सहिष्णुता — दूसरों की भिन्न मान्यताओं को सहना
definition: tolerance, the willingness to accept beliefs, religions and ways of life different from one's own (die Toleranz, no plural)
example: Die Toleranz gegenüber anderen Religionen ist wichtig. — Tolerance towards other religions is important.

hindi: ज़बरदस्त — बहुत बढ़िया, शानदार; रोज़मर्रा की तारीफ़ का सबसे आम शब्द
definition: great, terrific, wonderful; the most common everyday word of enthusiastic praise for anything from a film to a plan, colloquial
example: Das Konzert gestern war echt toll! — The concert yesterday was really great!

hindi: टमाटर — लाल रसीली गोल सब्ज़ी, सलाद और चटनी में
definition: a tomato, the soft round red vegetable with juicy seedy flesh used in salads, sauces and on bread (die Tomate, plural Tomaten)
example: Die Tomaten aus dem eigenen Garten schmecken am besten. — The tomatoes from our own garden taste best.

hindi: आँखों पर पट्टी बँधी होना — सामने की साफ़ दिखती चीज़ भी न देख पाना
definition: to have tomatoes on the eyes, meaning to fail to notice something obvious right in front of oneself (colloquial; hat Tomaten auf den Augen)
example: Hast du Tomaten auf den Augen? Das Schild steht direkt hier. — Are you blind? The sign is right here.

hindi: बर्तन — गहरा पात्र जिसमें सूप या चावल पकाते हैं
definition: a pot or saucepan, the deep round cooking vessel with handles used for boiling soup, rice or pasta (der Topf, plural Töpfe)
example: Der Topf ist voll mit Nudeln. — The pot is full of pasta.

hindi: छेना जैसा ताज़ा पनीर — मीठे-नमकीन दोनों में इस्तेमाल, ऑस्ट्रियाई नाम
definition: quark, the soft fresh white curd cheese used in strudel and dumplings, in its Austrian and Bavarian name where Germany says Quark (der Topfen, no plural)
example: Der Topfen kommt in den Strudel. — The quark goes into the strudel.

hindi: लक्ष्य-द्वार — जाल वाला ढाँचा जिसमें गेंद डालकर अंक मिलता है, और वह अंक भी
definition: a goal in football or handball, both the framed target with the net and the point scored by putting the ball into it (das Tor, plural Tore)
example: Er schoss das Tor in der letzten Minute. — He scored the goal in the last minute.

hindi: नशे में लड़खड़ाना — शराब के असर से डगमगाते हुए चलना
definition: to stagger or lurch about unsteadily, typically because of being drunk (regular: ist getorkelt)
example: Er torkelt spät nachts aus der Kneipe. — He staggers out of the pub late at night.

hindi: समय बीतने का भय — मौके बंद होते जाने की घबराहट
definition: the mounting dread that life's important doors are closing while you stand there still deciding
example: Her thirty-ninth birthday brought a wave of Torschlusspanik about the house she never bought.

hindi: मलाईदार परतदार पकवान — खास मौकों पर सजाकर परोसा जाने वाला भव्य मीठा
definition: a gateau or layered cake, the richer fancier cousin of Kuchen with cream filling and decoration served on special days (die Torte, plural Torten)
example: Zum Geburtstag gab es eine große Torte. — For the birthday there was a large gateau.

hindi: गोलरक्षक — गोल की रखवाली करने वाला खिलाड़ी
definition: a goalkeeper, the player who guards the goal and stops the ball with hands or body in football or handball (der Torwart, plural Torwarte)
example: Der Torwart hielt den Elfmeter. — The goalkeeper saved the penalty.

hindi: मृत — जिसका जीवन समाप्त हो गया हो
definition: dead, no longer alive, used of people, animals and figuratively of empty places
example: Der Vogel auf dem Balkon war schon tot. — The bird on the balcony was already dead.

hindi: एकदम — पूरी तरह, बोलचाल में बहुत ज़्यादा
definition: totally or completely, a colloquial intensifier popular in casual speech, similar to völlig but less formal
example: Ich bin total müde. — I am totally tired.

hindi: पर्यटक — मौज-मस्ती या दर्शन के लिए यात्रा करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a tourist, a person travelling for pleasure who visits famous places and sights (der Tourist, plural Touristen)
example: Der Tourist fragt nach dem Weg zum Museum. — The tourist asks the way to the museum.

hindi: परंपरा — पीढ़ियों से चली आ रही रीति
definition: a tradition, a custom or practice handed down through generations and repeated at festivals (die Tradition, plural Traditionen)
example: Das Plätzchenbacken ist bei uns Tradition. — Baking cookies is a tradition in our family.

hindi: तंबाकू और अख़बार की दुकान — सिगरेट, टिकट और लॉटरी बेचने वाला छोटा खोखा
definition: a small licensed shop selling tobacco, newspapers, stamps and transport tickets, a fixture of every Austrian street (die Trafik, plural Trafiken)
example: Die Fahrkarte kaufe ich in der Trafik. — I am buying the ticket at the tobacconist.

hindi: पहनना/धारण करना — कोई कपड़ा या गहना शरीर पर रखना
definition: to wear a garment, jewellery or glasses on the body, also to carry something heavy in the hands (irregular: trägt, hat getragen)
example: Sie trägt heute eine rote Bluse. — She is wearing a red blouse today.

hindi: दुखद — शोकपूर्ण, दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण
definition: tragic, sad, deeply unfortunate; describes a loss or accident, also colloquially any minor mishap
example: Der Unfall war wirklich tragisch. — The accident was truly tragic.

hindi: त्रासदी — दुखांत नाटक; भारी दुर्भाग्य भी
definition: a tragedy, a serious play or film with a sorrowful ending, and also any terrible misfortune in real life (die Tragödie, plural Tragödien)
example: Die Schüler lesen eine Tragödie von Schiller. — The pupils are reading a tragedy by Schiller.

hindi: प्रशिक्षक — खिलाड़ियों को प्रशिक्षण देने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a coach or trainer, the person who prepares athletes or a team, plans training and directs them during matches (der Trainer, plural Trainer)
example: Der Trainer wechselte zwei Spieler aus. — The coach substituted two players.

hindi: अभ्यास करना — खेल या फ़िटनेस के लिए नियमित मेहनत करना
definition: to train or practise, to exercise regularly in order to improve strength, skill or fitness for a sport (regular, hat trainiert)
example: Ich trainiere zweimal pro Woche im Fitnessstudio. — I train twice a week at the gym.

hindi: प्रशिक्षण — खेल के लिए नियमित अभ्यास का सत्र
definition: a training session or practice, the regular exercise time when athletes work on skill and fitness (das Training, plural Trainings)
example: Das Training beginnt um sechs Uhr. — Training starts at six o'clock.

hindi: बैठक की कार्यसूची का बिंदु — सभा में चर्चा के लिए रखा गया विषय, स्विस शब्द
definition: an item on the agenda of a meeting or assembly, the Swiss word for a point to be discussed where Germany says Tagesordnungspunkt (das Traktandum, plural Traktanden)
example: Das nächste Traktandum ist das Budget. — The next agenda item is the budget.

hindi: जुताई की गाड़ी — हल और माल-गाड़ी खींचने वाला खेती का ताक़तवर वाहन
definition: a tractor, the powerful farm vehicle with large rear wheels that pulls ploughs and trailers (der Traktor, plural Traktoren)
example: Der alte Traktor springt bei Kälte nicht an. — The old tractor does not start in the cold.

hindi: शहरी पटरी गाड़ी — शहर की सड़कों पर पटरी पर चलने वाली बिजली की गाड़ी, स्विस शब्द
definition: the tram or streetcar, the electric rail vehicle running through city streets, neuter in Swiss usage where Germany says die Straßenbahn (das Tram, plural Trams)
example: Das Tram hält direkt vor dem Bahnhof. — The tram stops right in front of the station.

hindi: चुगली करना — दूसरों के बारे में चटपटी बातें फैलाना
definition: to gossip about other people, spreading juicy stories and rumours behind their backs (regular: tratscht, hat getratscht; colloquial; über + Akkusativ)
example: Im Büro wird viel über den Chef getratscht. — There is a lot of gossip about the boss in the office.

hindi: अंगूर — गुच्छे में लगने वाला छोटा गोल रसीला फल, शराब भी इसी से बनती है
definition: a grape, the small round juicy fruit that grows in tight bunches on a vine and is also pressed for wine (die Traube, plural Trauben)
example: Die Traube ist grün und ohne Kerne. — The grape is green and seedless.

hindi: शोक — मृत्यु या बड़े नुक़सान के बाद का भारी दुःख
definition: grief or mourning, the heavy sorrow felt after a death or a serious loss (die Trauer, no plural)
example: Die Trauer um den Großvater war groß. — The grief for the grandfather was great.

hindi: शोक सभा — मृतक की याद में आयोजित समारोह
definition: a memorial service, the gathering held to mourn and honour a dead person (die Trauerfeier, plural Trauerfeiern)
example: Die Trauerfeier beginnt in der kleinen Kapelle. — The memorial service begins in the small chapel.

hindi: उदासी का लड्डू — हमेशा गमगीन और बेरंग रहने वाला बुझा हुआ व्यक्ति
definition: a gloomy dull person who mopes around and spoils the cheerful mood of others, a wet blanket, literally a dumpling of mourning, colloquial (der Trauerkloß, plural Trauerklöße)
example: Lach doch mal, du Trauerkloß! — Laugh for once, you wet blanket!

hindi: शोक मनाना — किसी की मृत्यु या हानि पर गहरा दुख करना
definition: to mourn or grieve, to feel deep sorrow after a death or serious loss (regular, trauern um + Akkusativ)
example: Die Familie trauert um den Großvater. — The family is mourning the grandfather.

hindi: उदास — दुःख से भरा या दुःख देने वाला
definition: sad, feeling or showing sorrow, also describing a thing or piece of news that causes sadness
example: Warum bist du heute so traurig? — Why are you so sad today?

hindi: उदासी — मन भारी और दुखी होने का हल्का भाव
definition: sadness, the low unhappy mood of someone whose heart feels heavy, milder than grief (die Traurigkeit, no plural)
example: Eine leise Traurigkeit lag in ihrer Stimme. — There was a quiet sadness in her voice.

hindi: विवाह-संस्कार — गिरजाघर या दफ़्तर में शादी की विधि
definition: a wedding ceremony, the formal act of marrying a couple in a church or at the registry office (die Trauung, plural Trauungen)
example: Die kirchliche Trauung war sehr feierlich. — The church wedding ceremony was very solemn.

hindi: मिलना — किसी से भेंट होना; निशाने पर लगना
definition: to meet a person by plan or chance, and also to hit a target or make a decision (irregular: trifft, traf, hat getroffen)
example: Ich treffe morgen meine Freunde im Café. — I am meeting my friends at the café tomorrow.

hindi: निशाना — गोल या सटीक वार जिससे अंक मिले
definition: a hit or a scored goal, the successful strike that lands on target and earns a point in a match (der Treffer, plural Treffer)
example: Der zweite Treffer entschied das Spiel. — The second goal decided the match.

hindi: हरितगृह प्रभाव — गैसों द्वारा धरती की गरमी को रोक लेना
definition: the greenhouse effect, the trapping of heat in the atmosphere by gases such as carbon dioxide, warming the planet (der Treibhauseffekt, plural Treibhauseffekte)
example: Kohlendioxid verstärkt den Treibhauseffekt. — Carbon dioxide strengthens the greenhouse effect.

hindi: चलन, रुझान — फ़ैशन या विकास की दिशा
definition: a trend, the current fashion or general direction in which taste and development are moving, borrowed from English (der Trend, plural Trends)
example: Kurze Haare sind wieder im Trend. — Short hair is trendy again.

hindi: अलग करना — चीज़ों को अलग-अलग बाँटना, ख़ासकर कचरे को
definition: to separate, to sort things apart from each other, used constantly about dividing rubbish into categories (regular: hat getrennt)
example: Wir trennen unseren Müll sehr genau. — We separate our rubbish very carefully.

hindi: अलगाव — प्रेमियों या पति-पत्नी का बिछड़ना
definition: a separation or breakup, when a couple ends their relationship and goes their separate ways (die Trennung, plural Trennungen)
example: Die Trennung fiel beiden sehr schwer. — The separation was very hard for both.

hindi: सीढ़ी — एक मंज़िल से दूसरी तक जाने की सीढ़ियाँ
definition: a staircase, the flight of steps that leads from one floor of a building to another (die Treppe, plural Treppen)
example: Die Treppe führt in den Keller. — The staircase leads down to the cellar.

hindi: सीढ़ीघर — इमारत में सीढ़ियों वाला साझा हिस्सा
definition: the stairwell, the shared part of an apartment building that holds the staircase between the floors (das Treppenhaus, plural Treppenhäuser)
example: Im Treppenhaus ist es dunkel. — It is dark in the stairwell.

hindi: सीढ़ी की सूझ — बहस ख़त्म होने के बाद सूझा करारा जवाब
definition: the perfect retort that arrives only on the staircase, long after the argument has been lost
example: His best line was a Treppenwitz, delivered to the elevator doors.

hindi: पेय-पटल — शराबघर की वह लंबी मेज़ जहाँ खड़े होकर पीते हैं
definition: the bar counter, a northern German word for the same long surface where drinks are served (der Tresen, plural Tresen)
example: Am Tresen stehen schon die ersten Gäste. — The first guests are already standing at the bar counter.

hindi: वफ़ादार — रिश्ते या वचन में अटल निष्ठा वाला
definition: loyal and faithful, staying steadily devoted to a partner, friend, employer or promise over many years (+ Dativ)
example: Der Hund blieb seinem Herrn immer treu. — The dog always stayed loyal to his master.

hindi: निष्ठा — रिश्ते या वचन में अटल वफ़ादारी
definition: the loyalty and faithfulness that keeps someone steadily devoted to a partner, friend, employer or promise over time (die Treue, no plural)
example: Die Treue ist ihm in einer Beziehung sehr wichtig. — Faithfulness is very important to him in a relationship.

hindi: खेल-कमीज़ — खिलाड़ी की दल के रंगों वाली कमीज़
definition: a jersey or shirt, the team top in club colours with a number that players wear during a match (das Trikot, plural Trikots)
example: Er trägt das Trikot mit der Nummer zehn. — He wears the jersey with the number ten.

hindi: पीना — पानी, चाय या शराब जैसा तरल गले से उतारना
definition: to drink, to swallow a liquid such as water, coffee or beer, also to drink alcohol socially (irregular: trank, hat getrunken)
example: Wir trinken heute nur Wasser. — Today we are only drinking water.

hindi: बख़्शीश — अच्छी सेवा पर बैरे को दी जाने वाली थोड़ी अतिरिक्त रक़म
definition: a tip or gratuity, the small extra money left for a waiter or taxi driver for good service (das Trinkgeld, plural Trinkgelder)
example: Das Trinkgeld lassen wir auf dem Tisch liegen. — We leave the tip on the table.

hindi: जाम की शुभकामना — पीने से पहले बोले गए छोटे शब्द
definition: a toast, the short speech or saying spoken with a raised glass to honour a person or occasion before everyone drinks (der Trinkspruch, plural Trinksprüche)
example: Der Trauzeuge hält einen kurzen Trinkspruch. — The best man gives a short toast.

hindi: सूखा — बिना बारिश या नमी का
definition: dry and arid, describing weather or ground without rainfall or moisture, also used for a dry wine or humour
example: Es bleibt bis zum Wochenende trocken. — It stays dry until the weekend.

hindi: कपड़े सुखाने की मशीन — गर्म हवा से धुले कपड़े सुखाने वाला यंत्र
definition: a tumble dryer, the household machine that dries washed clothes with warm air instead of hanging them out (der Trockner, plural Trockner)
example: Im Winter kommt die Wäsche in den Trockner. — In winter the laundry goes in the dryer.

hindi: ढोल — चमड़े को पीटकर बजाया जाने वाला ताल वाद्य
definition: a drum, the percussion instrument with a skin stretched over a hollow frame that is struck with sticks or hands (die Trommel, plural Trommeln)
example: Die Trommel ist bei jedem Umzug zu hören. — The drum can be heard at every parade.

hindi: बूँद — बूँदों में ली जाने वाली तरल दवा
definition: a drop, and in the plural the liquid medicine measured out drop by drop for eyes, nose or mouth (der Tropfen, plural Tropfen)
example: Die Tropfen helfen gegen trockene Augen. — The drops help against dry eyes.

hindi: सांत्वना — दुःख में मिलने वाला ढाढ़स
definition: comfort or consolation, the soothing support that eases someone's sorrow or disappointment (der Trost, no plural)
example: Ihre Worte waren ein großer Trost für mich. — Her words were a great comfort to me.

hindi: फुटपाथ — सड़क के किनारे पैदल चलने की पट्टी, स्विस शब्द
definition: the pavement or sidewalk, the raised strip beside the road where pedestrians walk, the Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Bürgersteig (das Trottoir, plural Trottoirs)
example: Bitte das Velo nicht auf dem Trottoir parkieren. — Please do not park the bicycle on the pavement.

hindi: के बावजूद — किसी रुकावट या विरोध के होते हुए भी
definition: despite, notwithstanding some obstacle or contrary circumstance that might have prevented the action (preposition, + Genitiv, colloquially + Dativ)
example: Trotz des Regens gehen wir spazieren. — Despite the rain we are going for a walk.

hindi: इसके बावजूद — रुकावट के बाद भी करने वाला शब्द
definition: an everyday adverb meaning nevertheless or anyway that says something happens despite the difficulty just named
example: Ich bin müde, aber ich komme trotzdem. — I'm tired, but I'm coming anyway.

hindi: हठ की अवस्था — दो-तीन साल की उम्र में बच्चे का हर बात पर नहीं कहने का दौर
definition: the terrible twos, the defiant phase around age two or three when a toddler screams no to everything (die Trotzphase, plural Trotzphasen)
example: Unser Sohn steckt mitten in der Trotzphase. — Our son is right in the middle of the terrible twos.

hindi: पीरू — बड़ा पालतू पक्षी जिसका मांस त्योहारों पर खाया जाता है
definition: a turkey, the large farm bird with a fan-shaped tail whose meat is eaten at festive meals (der Truthahn, plural Truthähne)
example: Der Truthahn ist größer als das Huhn. — The turkey is bigger than the chicken.

hindi: सुस्त — धीमा, आलसी और बिना जोश का
definition: sluggish and inert, moving slowly and without energy, said of people, animals or a slow economy
example: Nach dem Essen fühle ich mich träge. — After the meal I feel sluggish.

hindi: आँसू — रोते समय आँख से निकलने वाली बूँद
definition: a tear, the drop of water that falls from the eye when someone cries (die Träne, plural Tränen)
example: Eine Träne lief ihm über die Wange. — A tear ran down his cheek.

hindi: किसी चीज़ का सपना देखना — किसी इच्छा की कल्पना या नींद में देखना
definition: to dream of or about something, either while sleeping or as a strong wish for the future (von + Dativ, regular)
example: Sie träumt von einem Haus am Meer. — She dreams of a house by the sea.

hindi: सांत्वना देना — दुखी को ढाढ़स बँधाना
definition: to comfort or console someone, to ease their sorrow with kind words or presence (regular: hat getröstet; + Akkusativ)
example: Sie tröstete das weinende Kind. — She comforted the crying child.

hindi: अलविदा — इतालवी से लिया हुआ हल्का-फुल्का विदाई शब्द, ख़ासकर दक्षिण में
definition: a light informal goodbye borrowed from Italian and spelled the German way, especially common in the south and among younger people
example: Tschau, wir sehen uns am Wochenende. — Ciao, see you at the weekend.

hindi: अलविदा — दोस्तों-परिचितों के बीच अनौपचारिक विदा
definition: the everyday informal goodbye used between friends, colleagues and shop staff throughout Germany
example: Tschüss, und grüß deine Mutter! — Bye, and give my regards to your mother!

hindi: नली — टूथपेस्ट या मलहम की दबाने वाली नरम नली
definition: a squeezable tube, the soft container that toothpaste, cream, mustard or glue comes in (die Tube, plural Tuben)
example: Die Tube Zahnpasta ist fast leer. — The tube of toothpaste is almost empty.

hindi: सद्गुण — नैतिक रूप से अच्छा गुण
definition: a virtue, a morally good quality of character such as honesty, patience or courage (die Tugend, plural Tugenden)
example: Geduld ist eine seltene Tugend. — Patience is a rare virtue.

hindi: करना — कोई काम या क्रिया अंजाम देना
definition: to do or perform an action in a general sense, a short everyday verb also found in fixed phrases about hurting and pretending (irregular: tut, tat, hat getan)
example: Was tust du heute Nachmittag? — What are you doing this afternoon?

hindi: सुरंग — पहाड़ या ज़मीन के नीचे से बना रास्ता
definition: a tunnel, an underground or through-mountain passage carrying a road or railway line (der Tunnel, plural Tunnel)
example: Im Tunnel bitte das Licht einschalten. — Please switch on the lights in the tunnel.

hindi: मीनार — ऊँचा और सँकरा भवन या उसका हिस्सा
definition: a tower, a tall narrow structure or part of a building such as a church steeple or television tower (der Turm, plural Türme)
example: Vom Turm hat man einen tollen Blick über die Stadt. — From the tower you have a great view over the city.

hindi: व्यायामशाला — स्कूल या क्लब का भीतरी खेल हॉल
definition: a gymnasium or sports hall, the large indoor room at a school or club where gymnastics and ball games are played (die Turnhalle, plural Turnhallen)
example: Bei Regen turnen wir in der Turnhalle. — When it rains we do gymnastics in the gym hall.

hindi: प्रतियोगिता-शृंखला — कई दलों की क्रमबद्ध प्रतियोगिता
definition: a tournament, the sporting competition in which many teams or players meet in a series of matches to find a winner (das Turnier, plural Turniere)
example: Beim Turnier spielen zwölf Mannschaften. — Twelve teams play in the tournament.

hindi: खेल का जूता — दौड़ने-खेलने वाला हल्का जूता
definition: a sneaker or trainer, the light sports shoe with a soft sole worn for exercise and everyday comfort (der Turnschuh, plural Turnschuhe)
example: Ich finde den linken Turnschuh nicht. — I cannot find the left trainer.

hindi: सहायक कक्षा — वरिष्ठ छात्र द्वारा चलाई जाने वाली छोटी अभ्यास कक्षा
definition: a tutorial class at university, the small supporting session run by an advanced student to help beginners understand a lecture (das Tutorium, plural Tutorien)
example: Das Tutorium hilft mir sehr beim Verstehen der Mathematik. — The tutorial helps me a lot with understanding the maths.

hindi: बंदा — कोई आदमी, लड़का, बोलचाल में
definition: a guy or bloke, any male person spoken about casually and colloquially, often when his name is unknown (der Typ, plural Typen)
example: Der Typ an der Kasse war sehr freundlich. — The guy at the till was very friendly.

hindi: दैनिक — हर दिन होने वाला
definition: daily, happening or done every single day without exception
example: Der Bus fährt täglich um acht Uhr. — The bus leaves daily at eight o'clock.

hindi: अपराधी — जिसने अपराध किया हो
definition: the perpetrator or culprit, the person who actually committed a crime or offence, the word police reports and news use (der Täter, plural Täter)
example: Die Polizei hat den Täter noch nicht gefasst. — The police have not caught the perpetrator yet.

hindi: कार्य / गतिविधि — नौकरी में किया जाने वाला काम का प्रकार
definition: an activity or occupation, the kind of work someone performs in their job or position (die Tätigkeit, plural Tätigkeiten)
example: Ihre Tätigkeit umfasst auch die Betreuung der Kunden. — Her work also includes looking after clients.

hindi: मोटरसाइकिल — इंजन वाली दोपहिया, स्विस बोलचाल का शब्द
definition: a motorcycle or motorbike, the engine-driven two-wheeler, the colloquial Swiss word imitating its sound where Germany says Motorrad (der Töff, plural Töffs)
example: Mit dem Töff bin ich schneller in der Stadt. — On the motorbike I get into town faster.

hindi: काबिल और मेहनती — काम में दक्ष, चुस्त और भरोसेमंद
definition: capable, efficient and hardworking, competent at getting things done properly, also used colloquially meaning thoroughly or a great deal
example: Unsere Nachbarin ist eine tüchtige Handwerkerin. — Our neighbour is a capable craftswoman.

hindi: दरवाज़ा — कमरे या घर में आने-जाने का द्वार
definition: a door, the hinged panel in a wall that opens and closes to let people enter a room or building (die Tür, plural Türen)
example: Die Tür ist abgeschlossen. — The door is locked.

hindi: थैली — कागज़ या प्लास्टिक की थैली
definition: a carrier bag of paper or plastic given at the checkout to carry goods home, also a small paper cone of sweets (die Tüte, plural Tüten)
example: Brauchen Sie eine Tüte? — Do you need a bag?

hindi: भूमिगत रेल — शहर के नीचे सुरंग में चलने वाली रेल
definition: an underground railway or metro, the urban train that runs mostly in tunnels beneath a city (die U-Bahn, plural U-Bahnen)
example: Mit der U-Bahn bin ich in zwanzig Minuten dort. — By metro I am there in twenty minutes.

hindi: किनारा — नदी या झील के साथ की ज़मीन
definition: a bank or shore, the strip of land along the edge of a river, lake or ocean (das Ufer, plural Ufer)
example: Wir sitzen am Ufer und angeln. — We sit on the bank and fish.

hindi: घड़ी — समय मापने का यंत्र; समय बताते हुए 'बजे' का अर्थ भी
definition: a clock or wristwatch, and placed after a number the word for o'clock when telling the time (die Uhr, plural Uhren)
example: Die Uhr an der Wand geht fünf Minuten vor. — The clock on the wall is five minutes fast.

hindi: घड़ी का समय — दिन में घंटे और मिनट के हिसाब से समय
definition: the time of day, the exact hour and minute shown on a clock, asked for when arranging meetings and departures (die Uhrzeit, plural Uhrzeiten)
example: Können Sie mir bitte die Uhrzeit sagen? — Could you please tell me the time?

hindi: के चारों ओर — किसी के गिर्द, या ठीक किसी समय पर
definition: around, encircling something, also at an exact clock time, or by a stated amount of change (preposition, + Akkusativ)
example: Der Zug fährt um neun Uhr ab. — The train leaves at nine o'clock.

hindi: उँगलियों पर नचाना — मीठी बातों से किसी को वश में कर लेना
definition: to wrap someone around one's little finger, charming them into doing whatever one wants (jemanden um den Finger wickeln; hat gewickelt)
example: Die Kleine wickelt ihren Opa um den Finger. — The little girl has her grandpa wrapped around her finger.

hindi: बात घुमाना — असली मुद्दे पर सीधे न आना
definition: to avoid the real issue and talk around a subject instead of addressing it directly (colloquial)
example: Hör auf, um den heißen Brei herumzureden, und sag, was los ist. — Stop beating around the bush and say what is wrong.

hindi: कोने के आस-पास — बहुत पास, बस मोड़ के उधर
definition: around the corner, just past the nearest turning and therefore very close by, the colloquial phrase for a short walk away
example: Der Friseur ist gleich um die Ecke. — The hairdresser is just around the corner.

hindi: एक बाल से — बाल-बाल, ज़रा-सी कमी से
definition: by a hair's breadth, describing something that very nearly happened or was narrowly avoided (adverbial phrase)
example: Um ein Haar hätte ich den Zug verpasst. — I very nearly missed the train.

hindi: भगवान के लिए — घबराहट या सख़्त मनाही
definition: for heaven's sake; an exclamation of alarm, urgent protest or horrified refusal
example: Um Gottes willen, fass das nicht an! — For heaven's sake, do not touch that!

hindi: गले लगाना — बाँहों में भर लेना
definition: to hug or embrace someone, wrapping the arms around them warmly in greeting or comfort (regular: hat umarmt, + Akkusativ)
example: Die Mutter umarmte ihre Tochter am Flughafen. — The mother hugged her daughter at the airport.

hindi: आलिंगन — गले लगने की क्रिया
definition: an embrace or hug, the gesture of holding someone in both arms to greet, comfort or say farewell (die Umarmung, plural Umarmungen)
example: Eine feste Umarmung tut nach einem langen Tag gut. — A firm hug feels good after a long day.

hindi: फेरबदल कर बनाना — इमारत या कमरे का ढाँचा बदलना
definition: to rebuild, convert or remodel a building or room so that it has a different layout or purpose (separable: baut um, hat umgebaut)
example: Sie bauen die Scheune zu einem Wohnhaus um. — They are converting the barn into a house.

hindi: लुढ़क जाना — खड़ी चीज़ या व्यक्ति का गिर पड़ना
definition: to fall over or topple from an upright position, of a person, a tree or a standing object (separable: fällt um, ist umgefallen)
example: Der Stuhl ist einfach umgefallen. — The chair simply fell over.

hindi: परिधि — किसी आकृति के चारों ओर की कुल लंबाई
definition: the perimeter or circumference, the total length measured around the outside edge of a shape, also the general extent or scope of something (der Umfang, plural Umfänge)
example: Der Umfang des Kreises beträgt drei Meter. — The circumference of the circle is three metres.

hindi: व्यापक — बहुत कुछ समेटे हुए, बड़ा और विस्तृत
definition: extensive or comprehensive in scope and size, describing large collections, thorough reports and lengthy documents
example: Die Bibliothek ist sehr umfangreich. — The library is very extensive.

hindi: व्यवहार शैली — लोगों से मिलने-जुलने के शिष्ट तरीक़े
definition: a manner or form of social conduct, the accepted polite way of dealing with people, nearly always used in the plural for good manners (die Umgangsform, plural Umgangsformen)
example: Seine Umgangsformen sind tadellos. — His manners are impeccable.

hindi: आस-पास — किसी जगह के इर्द-गिर्द का इलाक़ा
definition: the surroundings or surrounding area around a place, the neighbourhood and countryside within easy reach of it (die Umgebung, plural Umgebungen)
example: In der Umgebung gibt es viele schöne Wanderwege. — There are many lovely hiking trails in the surrounding area.

hindi: तुरंत — बिना देर किए, दफ़्तरी भाषा में
definition: immediately or without delay, the formal office word for promptly when asking for or promising a quick response
example: Wir werden uns umgehend um Ihr Anliegen kümmern. — We will attend to your request immediately.

hindi: इधर-उधर — बिना तय दिशा के चारों ओर
definition: about or around in various directions, wandering or looking here and there without a fixed goal
example: Die Touristen liefen neugierig in der Altstadt umher. — The tourists wandered curiously around the old town.

hindi: लौट पड़ना — रास्ते में पलटकर वापस चलना
definition: to turn around and head back the way one came, because the road is wrong or the destination has been passed (separable: kehrt um, ist umgekehrt)
example: Wir sind zu weit gefahren und kehren jetzt um. — We have driven too far and are turning back now.

hindi: कपड़े बदलने की कोठरी — दुकान में कपड़े पहनकर देखने की जगह
definition: a fitting room or changing cubicle in a shop where customers try clothes on before buying (die Umkleidekabine, plural Umkleidekabinen)
example: Die Umkleidekabine ist gerade besetzt. — The fitting room is occupied right now.

hindi: आसपास का इलाक़ा — शहर के चारों ओर फैला ग्रामीण क्षेत्र
definition: the surrounding countryside of a city, the rural area and small towns around a large urban centre that depend on it (das Umland, no plural)
example: Viele Pendler kommen aus dem Umland. — Many commuters come from the surrounding area.

hindi: स्वर-परिवर्तन बिंदु — स्वर अक्षरों के ऊपर लगे दो बिंदु जो उच्चारण बदलते हैं
definition: the two dots placed over the vowels a, o and u that change their sound, and the vowel change itself (der Umlaut, plural Umlaute)
example: Das Wort Mütter schreibt man mit einem Umlaut. — The word Mütter is written with an umlaut.

hindi: मार्ग परिवर्तन — सड़क बंद होने पर बताया गया वैकल्पिक रास्ता
definition: a diversion or detour, the alternative route signposted when a road is closed for building work (die Umleitung, plural Umleitungen)
example: Die Umleitung führt durch das ganze Dorf. — The detour leads through the whole village.

hindi: चलाना — पकते खाने को बीच-बीच में हिलाना
definition: to give something a stir, moving the contents of a pot or cup around so they mix and do not burn (separable: rührt um, hat umgerührt)
example: Rühr die Suppe ab und zu um. — Stir the soup now and then.

hindi: कारोबार या बिक्री-राशि — किसी अवधि में बेचकर कमाई गई कुल रकम
definition: the turnover or total sales revenue that a business earns from selling goods or services over a given period, before costs are deducted (der Umsatz, plural Umsätze)
example: Der Umsatz ist im letzten Jahr deutlich gestiegen. — Turnover rose noticeably last year.

hindi: चैनल बदलना — दूसरे चैनल या कार्यक्रम पर जाना
definition: to switch over or change channels on the television or radio to another programme (separable: schaltet um, hat umgeschaltet)
example: Kannst du bitte auf einen anderen Kanal umschalten? — Can you please switch to another channel?

hindi: लिफ़ाफ़ा — चिट्ठी रखने का काग़ज़ी खोल
definition: an envelope, the paper cover into which a letter is placed before it is addressed and posted (der Umschlag, plural Umschläge)
example: Schreib die Adresse deutlich auf den Umschlag. — Write the address clearly on the envelope.

hindi: पुनः प्रशिक्षण — नया पेशा अपनाने के लिए दूसरी सिखलाई
definition: retraining for a different occupation, a course that prepares someone to switch to a new profession (die Umschulung, plural Umschulungen)
example: Nach dem Unfall machte er eine Umschulung zum Bürokaufmann. — After the accident he retrained as an office clerk.

hindi: मुफ़्त या व्यर्थ — बिना दाम का, या बेकार गया
definition: either free of charge without payment, or in vain without any result; the context decides which meaning applies
example: Der Eintritt ist heute umsonst. — Admission is free today.

hindi: परिस्थिति — किसी बात के साथ जुड़ी हुई स्थिति या हालात
definition: a circumstance, one of the surrounding conditions that shape a situation, plural Umstände also meaning trouble or fuss (der Umstand, plural Umstände)
example: Ein wichtiger Umstand wurde leider übersehen. — An important circumstance was unfortunately overlooked.

hindi: गाड़ी बदलना — यात्रा के बीच एक गाड़ी से उतरकर दूसरी पकड़ना
definition: to change trains, buses or planes during a journey, leaving one vehicle to board another (separable: steigt um, ist umgestiegen)
example: In Frankfurt müssen wir umsteigen. — We have to change trains in Frankfurt.

hindi: बदलकर नया ढंग अपनाना — व्यवस्था, समय या आदत को दूसरे ढंग पर ले जाना
definition: to switch or convert a system, routine or arrangement to a different setting, such as clocks, diet or software (separable: stellt um, hat umgestellt; auf + Akkusativ)
example: Die Firma stellt auf digitale Rechnungen um. — The company is switching to digital invoices.

hindi: विवादित — जिस पर लोगों की राय बँटी हो
definition: controversial or disputed, a matter about which people hold strongly differing opinions
example: Die Entscheidung ist sehr umstritten. — The decision is highly controversial.

hindi: झंझट भरा — ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा घुमावदार और लंबा
definition: cumbersome and roundabout, done in a complicated and awkward way that takes more steps than necessary
example: Das Formular ist furchtbar umständlich. — The form is terribly cumbersome.

hindi: अदला-बदली — ख़रीदी चीज़ को लौटाकर बदलना
definition: an exchange of purchased goods for a different item or a refund, usually within a stated period and with the receipt (der Umtausch, no plural)
example: Der Umtausch ist nur mit Kassenzettel möglich. — Exchange is only possible with the receipt.

hindi: बदलना — ख़रीदी चीज़ लौटाकर दूसरी लेना
definition: to exchange a purchased item for another size or colour, or to swap currency (separable: tauscht um, hat umgetauscht)
example: Kann ich das Hemd umtauschen? — Can I exchange the shirt?

hindi: रूपांतरित करना — एक चीज़ को दूसरी चीज़ में बदल देना
definition: to convert or transform something into a different form or type, common for energy, buildings, files and money (separable: wandelt um, hat umgewandelt; in + Akkusativ)
example: Die Anlage wandelt Sonnenlicht in Strom um. — The plant converts sunlight into electricity.

hindi: चक्कर — सीधे रास्ते से लंबा घुमावदार मार्ग
definition: a detour, a longer roundabout route taken instead of the direct way, whether by choice or because the road is blocked (der Umweg, plural Umwege)
example: Wegen der Baustelle müssen wir einen Umweg machen. — Because of the roadworks we have to take a detour.

hindi: पर्यावरण — हमारे चारों ओर की प्रकृति, हवा, पानी और ज़मीन
definition: the natural environment, the surrounding world of air, water, soil and living things that human activity affects (die Umwelt, no plural)
example: Wir müssen die Umwelt für unsere Kinder schützen. — We must protect the environment for our children.

hindi: पर्यावरण-अनुकूल — जो प्रकृति को कम नुक़सान पहुँचाए
definition: environmentally friendly, describing a product or habit that causes little harm to nature and the climate
example: Der Zug ist viel umweltfreundlicher als das Flugzeug. — The train is much more environmentally friendly than the plane.

hindi: पर्यावरण संरक्षण — प्रकृति को नुक़सान से बचाने के प्रयास
definition: environmental protection, the collective effort of laws, habits and technology that keeps nature from being damaged (der Umweltschutz, no plural)
example: Der Umweltschutz ist ihr ein wichtiges Anliegen. — Environmental protection is an important concern for her.

hindi: घर बदलना — एक घर से दूसरे में जाना
definition: to move house, to leave one home and take all your belongings to a different apartment or house (separable: zieht um, ist umgezogen)
example: Wir ziehen nächsten Monat in eine größere Wohnung um. — Next month we are moving to a bigger apartment.

hindi: घर-बदली — सामान बाँधकर नए घर में ले जाने का काम
definition: a house move, the whole business of packing and transporting belongings to a new home (der Umzug, plural Umzüge)
example: Der Umzug hat den ganzen Samstag gedauert. — The move took the whole Saturday.

hindi: सामान का डिब्बा — घर बदलते समय सामान भरने का मज़बूत गत्ते का बक्सा
definition: a moving box, the sturdy cardboard carton used to pack belongings for a house move (der Umzugskarton, plural Umzugskartons)
example: Der Umzugskarton mit den Büchern ist sehr schwer. — The moving box with the books is very heavy.

hindi: अप्रिय — असुविधाजनक, कष्टदायक
definition: unpleasant, uncomfortable, awkward; describes a situation, smell or person one would rather avoid
example: Das Gespräch mit dem Chef war unangenehm. — The conversation with the boss was unpleasant.

hindi: हर हाल में — ज़रूर, बिना किसी शर्त के
definition: absolutely, without fail, at all costs; stressing that something is necessary or strongly desired
example: Du musst diesen Film unbedingt sehen. — You absolutely have to see this film.

hindi: अनुपयोगी — इस्तेमाल के लायक नहीं
definition: unusable or unfit for purpose, describing something so faulty or damaged that it cannot serve its intended function
example: Nach dem Regen war das Zelt unbrauchbar. — After the rain the tent was unusable.

hindi: और — शब्दों या वाक्यों को जोड़ने वाला मूल शब्द
definition: and; the basic coordinating conjunction that joins words, phrases or whole clauses together
example: Ich kaufe Brot und Milch. — I am buying bread and milk.

hindi: बेईमान — झूठ बोलने और धोखा देने वाला
definition: dishonest and untruthful, willing to lie, cheat or deceive people in order to gain an advantage
example: Er war unehrlich und hat das Geld behalten. — He was dishonest and kept the money.

hindi: अनंत — जिसका कोई अंत न हो
definition: infinite or endless without limit in size, number or duration, also used emphatically for very great patience or gratitude
example: Das Universum scheint unendlich groß. — The universe seems infinitely large.

hindi: बराबरी पर — खेल जिसमें कोई नहीं जीता
definition: drawn or tied, describing a match that ends with equal scores so that neither side wins (also the noun das Unentschieden)
example: Das Spiel endete unentschieden. — The match ended in a draw.

hindi: दुर्घटना — गाड़ियों की टक्कर या अचानक हुई हानि
definition: an accident, an unexpected collision or mishap on the road that causes damage or injury (der Unfall, plural Unfälle)
example: Auf der Autobahn gab es einen schweren Unfall. — There was a serious accident on the motorway.

hindi: अधीरता — प्रतीक्षा न कर पाने की बेचैनी और झुँझलाहट
definition: the restless impatience and irritation of a person who cannot bear waiting any longer for something expected (die Ungeduld, no plural)
example: Die Ungeduld der Kinder wuchs mit jeder Minute. — The children's impatience grew with every minute.

hindi: अधीर — ज़रा सी देर भी न सह पाने वाला
definition: impatient and restless, easily irritated by waiting, delays or slowness in other people
example: Die Kinder warteten ungeduldig auf den Bus. — The children waited impatiently for the bus.

hindi: लगभग — ठीक-ठीक नहीं, अंदाज़न
definition: approximately or roughly, used before a number, time or amount to signal that the figure is not exact
example: Der Weg dauert ungefähr zwanzig Minuten. — The walk takes approximately twenty minutes.

hindi: निरापद — ख़तरे से रहित, सुरक्षित
definition: not dangerous, safe and posing no threat of harm, used of substances, sports and situations that carry little risk
example: Die Schlange ist völlig ungefährlich. — The snake is completely harmless.

hindi: अपार — असाधारण रूप से विशाल या भारी
definition: monstrous or tremendous in size, amount or degree, describing something so large it seems beyond normal measure
example: Das war eine ungeheure Leistung. — That was a tremendous achievement.

hindi: अनमने ढंग से — मन न होते हुए, मजबूरी में करना
definition: reluctantly, without pleasure; used when someone does something only unwillingly or would rather avoid the activity altogether
example: Ich gehe ungern zum Zahnarzt. — I don't like going to the dentist.

hindi: अविश्वसनीय — विश्वास से परे, ज़बरदस्त
definition: unbelievable, incredible, astonishing; praise or shock at something hard to believe, also an intensifier
example: Das Konzert war unglaublich gut. — The concert was incredibly good.

hindi: हादसा — बड़ी दुर्घटना या विपत्ति जिसमें कई लोग प्रभावित हों
definition: a disaster or serious accident such as a train crash or explosion, also bad luck or misfortune in general (das Unglück, plural Unglücke)
example: Das Unglück forderte mehrere Todesopfer. — The disaster claimed several lives.

hindi: दुखी — नाख़ुश, जीवन या हालात से असंतुष्ट
definition: unhappy and miserable about how life or a situation turned out, also unlucky or unfortunate in circumstances
example: Er ist in seinem Job sehr unglücklich. — He is very unhappy in his job.

hindi: अशिष्ट — बदतमीज़ी और बिना अदब के पेश आने वाला
definition: impolite and rude, lacking basic good manners and showing little respect towards other people
example: Es ist unhöflich, andere zu unterbrechen. — It is impolite to interrupt other people.

hindi: विश्वविद्यालय — उच्च शिक्षा और शोध की सबसे बड़ी संस्था
definition: a university, the highest institution of learning where students study for academic degrees and scholars research (die Universität, plural Universitäten)
example: Meine Schwester studiert an der Universität in Heidelberg. — My sister studies at the university in Heidelberg.

hindi: खरपतवार — बग़ीचे में अनचाहा जंगली पौधा
definition: a weed, any unwanted wild plant that keeps growing among the flowers and vegetables (das Unkraut, plural Unkräuter)
example: Das Unkraut wächst schneller als der Salat. — The weeds grow faster than the lettuce.

hindi: असंभव — जो किसी भी तरह हो ही न सके
definition: impossible, unable to happen or be done under any circumstances, also colloquially meaning outrageous
example: Das ist leider unmöglich. — Unfortunately that is impossible.

hindi: अस्त-व्यस्त — बिखरा हुआ, बेतरतीब
definition: untidy, messy and disorganised, used of cluttered rooms, sloppy handwriting and careless work
example: Der Schreibtisch ist furchtbar unordentlich. — The desk is terribly messy.

hindi: अव्यवस्था — बिखरी हुई चीज़ों की गड़बड़ी
definition: a mess or disorder, the untidy state of a room where things lie scattered instead of in their proper places (die Unordnung, no plural)
example: In seinem Zimmer herrscht totale Unordnung. — His room is in total chaos.

hindi: बेचैन — मन या शरीर को चैन न मिलना
definition: restless and uneasy, unable to sit still or sleep because something worries the mind
example: Ich habe unruhig geschlafen. — I slept restlessly.

hindi: निर्दोष — जिसने कोई अपराध न किया हो
definition: innocent, not guilty of the crime someone stands accused of, also naive, harmless and inexperienced in everyday speech
example: Ich bin unschuldig, das schwöre ich. — I am innocent, I swear it.

hindi: हमारा — बोलने वालों के समूह का स्वामित्व
definition: the possessive determiner meaning belonging to the speaker together with other people, used for a shared house, team, country or family and declined before the noun (unsere Wohnung, unseren Garten)
example: Unser Haus hat einen kleinen Garten. — Our house has a small garden.

hindi: असमंजस में — आत्मविश्वास की कमी, संदेह में
definition: insecure and uncertain, lacking self-confidence in a situation, or unsure and doubtful about what is true or correct
example: Sie fühlte sich in der neuen Gruppe unsicher. — She felt insecure in the new group.

hindi: अदृश्य — जो आँखों से दिखाई न दे
definition: invisible, impossible to see with the eyes, whether hidden, too small or simply not present
example: Bakterien sind mit bloßem Auge unsichtbar. — Bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.

hindi: बकवास — तर्कहीन या निरर्थक बात
definition: nonsense or absurdity, talk or behaviour without sense or logic, slightly more neutral than the other colloquial words (der Unsinn, no plural)
example: Red keinen Unsinn, das stimmt nicht. — Do not talk nonsense, that is not true.

hindi: नीचे — निचली मंज़िल या निचले हिस्से में
definition: down below or at the bottom, on a lower floor or lower part of something, the plain word for where something sits when it is not above
example: Die Küche ist unten im Erdgeschoss. — The kitchen is downstairs on the ground floor.

hindi: के नीचे — किसी चीज़ के तले, या लोगों के बीच
definition: under, beneath something, also among a group of people or below a limit (preposition, + Dativ for location, + Akkusativ for movement)
example: Die Katze schläft unter dem Bett. — The cat is sleeping under the bed.

hindi: बात दबा देना — समस्या को छिपाकर अनदेखा करना
definition: to cover up a problem or unpleasant fact instead of dealing with it, sweeping it under the carpet
example: Der Skandal wurde jahrelang unter den Teppich gekehrt. — The scandal was swept under the carpet for years.

hindi: दिल को छू जाना — गहरे तक भावुक कर देना
definition: to get under the skin, touching someone so deeply that they feel it emotionally (ist unter die Haut gegangen)
example: Der Film ging mir richtig unter die Haut. — The film really got under my skin.

hindi: बारीकी से जाँचना — ध्यान से परखना
definition: to examine something very closely and critically, scrutinising every detail
example: Die Behörde nahm die Firma genau unter die Lupe. — The authority put the company under close scrutiny.

hindi: अकेले में — सिर्फ़ दो लोगों के बीच, गोपनीय बातचीत
definition: in private between two people only, with nobody else present to overhear the conversation (adverbial phrase)
example: Können wir das unter vier Augen besprechen? — Can we discuss this in private?

hindi: बीच में टोकना — किसी की बात या काम बीच में रोकना
definition: to interrupt someone who is speaking by cutting into their sentence, or to pause an activity, journey or connection for a while (irregular: unterbricht, hat unterbrochen; + Akkusativ)
example: Unterbrich mich bitte nicht dauernd! — Please stop interrupting me all the time!

hindi: रुकावट — किसी काम या सेवा का बीच में थम जाना, स्विस शब्द
definition: an interruption or break in a service, journey or activity, the Swiss form of the noun where Germany says Unterbrechung (der Unterbruch, plural Unterbrüche)
example: Nach einem kurzen Unterbruch fährt der Zug weiter. — After a short interruption the train continues.

hindi: इसी बीच, इस दौरान — उसी समय कहीं और
definition: meanwhile, in the meantime while something else is happening elsewhere, slightly formal or literary
example: Unterdessen wartete er draußen im Regen. — Meanwhile he waited outside in the rain.

hindi: भूमिगत मार्ग — सड़क या रेल के नीचे से पार जाने का रास्ता
definition: an underpass, a passage leading under a road or railway so pedestrians and cyclists can cross safely (die Unterführung, plural Unterführungen)
example: Nachts ist die Unterführung schlecht beleuchtet. — At night the underpass is poorly lit.

hindi: डूबना, अस्त होना — जहाज़ का डूबना या सूरज का छिपना
definition: to go under, sink or set, used for ships sinking, the sun setting and empires or companies collapsing (separable: geht unter, ist untergegangen)
example: Die Sonne geht heute um acht unter. — The sun sets at eight today.

hindi: के नीचे — किसी चीज़ से नीचे के स्थान पर
definition: below, situated lower than a given point or level on a slope, wall or scale (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Unterhalb der Brücke fließt der Bach. — Below the bridge flows the stream.

hindi: मनोरंजन या बातचीत — मन बहलाने वाला कार्यक्रम; आपसी वार्तालाप भी
definition: entertainment, the programmes and shows that amuse people, and also a conversation between people (die Unterhaltung, plural Unterhaltungen)
example: Die Sendung bietet leichte Unterhaltung am Abend. — The programme offers light entertainment in the evening.

hindi: जांघिया — पतलून के नीचे पहनी जाने वाली छोटी भीतरी पैंट
definition: underpants, the short inner garment worn beneath trousers or a skirt (die Unterhose, plural Unterhosen)
example: Die Unterhose liegt in der Schublade. — The underpants are in the drawer.

hindi: ठिकाना — यात्रा में रात बिताने की जगह, होटल या किराए का कमरा
definition: accommodation or lodging, any place where a traveller sleeps during a journey such as a hotel or rented room (die Unterkunft, plural Unterkünfte)
example: Habt ihr schon eine Unterkunft für Berlin gefunden? — Have you already found accommodation for Berlin?

hindi: दस्तावेज़ — आवेदन के साथ लगाए जाने वाले काग़ज़ात
definition: a supporting document or paper, used almost always in the plural Unterlagen for the set of documents you must submit with an application (die Unterlage, plural Unterlagen)
example: Bitte reichen Sie alle Unterlagen vollständig ein. — Please submit all documents in full.

hindi: उप-किराया — किरायेदार से किराये पर कमरा या फ़्लैट लेना
definition: subletting, renting a room or flat from someone who is themselves only a tenant (die Untermiete, plural Untermieten)
example: Er wohnt zur Untermiete bei einer älteren Dame. — He lives as a subtenant with an elderly lady.

hindi: उप-किरायेदार — किरायेदार से कमरा किराये पर लेने वाला
definition: a subtenant, someone who rents a room from an existing tenant rather than from the building owner (der Untermieter, plural Untermieter)
example: Der Untermieter zahlt die Hälfte der Miete. — The subtenant pays half the rent.

hindi: उद्यम — बड़ी कंपनी या व्यावसायिक प्रतिष्ठान
definition: an enterprise or company, a business organisation that employs people, somewhat more formal than Firma (das Unternehmen, plural Unternehmen)
example: Das Unternehmen sucht neue Mitarbeiter. — The company is looking for new employees.

hindi: उद्यमी — अपना कारोबार चलाने और जोखिम उठाने वाला
definition: an entrepreneur or business owner, someone who runs their own company and bears its risks (der Unternehmer, plural Unternehmer)
example: Der Unternehmer trägt das volle Risiko. — The entrepreneur bears the full risk.

hindi: पढ़ाई या शिक्षण — कक्षा में शिक्षक द्वारा दिए जाने वाले पाठ
definition: lessons or teaching, the activity of classroom instruction given by a teacher to pupils (der Unterricht, no plural)
example: Der Unterricht fällt heute aus. — Lessons are cancelled today.

hindi: पढ़ाना — किसी विषय की कक्षा में शिक्षा देना
definition: to teach, to give lessons in a subject to pupils or students at a school or college (inseparable: unterrichtet, hat unterrichtet)
example: Sie unterrichtet Englisch am Gymnasium. — She teaches English at the Gymnasium.

hindi: अंतर — दो चीज़ों के बीच का फ़र्क़
definition: a difference, the way in which two things or people are not alike when compared with each other (der Unterschied, plural Unterschiede)
example: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen den beiden? — What is the difference between the two?

hindi: हस्ताक्षर करना — दस्तावेज़ के नीचे अपना नाम लिखना
definition: to sign a document by writing your name at the bottom, making it valid or showing agreement (inseparable, irregular: hat unterschrieben)
example: Sie müssen hier unten noch unterschreiben. — You still need to sign here at the bottom.

hindi: हस्ताक्षर — काग़ज़ पर अपना नाम लिखकर सहमति देना
definition: a signature, your name written by hand at the bottom of a document to make it valid or show agreement (die Unterschrift, plural Unterschriften)
example: Ohne Ihre Unterschrift ist der Vertrag nicht gültig. — Without your signature the contract is not valid.

hindi: जाँच करना — रोगी के शरीर का परीक्षण करना
definition: to examine, for a doctor to inspect a patient's body carefully to find the cause of trouble (inseparable: untersucht, hat untersucht)
example: Die Ärztin untersucht zuerst den Hals. — The doctor examines the throat first.

hindi: जाँच — डॉक्टर द्वारा रोगी के शरीर का परीक्षण
definition: a medical examination or check-up, the careful inspection of the body a doctor performs to find what is wrong (die Untersuchung, plural Untersuchungen)
example: Die Untersuchung dauerte nur zehn Minuten. — The examination took only ten minutes.

hindi: उपशीर्षक — परदे के नीचे दिखने वाला संवाद का अनुवाद
definition: a subtitle, the translated or transcribed dialogue text shown at the bottom of the screen during a film (der Untertitel, plural Untertitel)
example: Wir schauen den Film auf Englisch mit deutschen Untertiteln. — We are watching the film in English with German subtitles.

hindi: रास्ते में — सफ़र पर, घर से बाहर
definition: on the way, travelling or moving about between places rather than sitting at home or in the office, also of a parcel still in transit
example: Ich bin gerade unterwegs, ruf später an. — I am on the road right now, call later.

hindi: भीतरी वस्त्र — कपड़ों के नीचे पहने जाने वाले अंदरूनी कपड़े
definition: underwear, the garments worn next to the skin underneath the outer clothes (die Unterwäsche, no plural)
example: Frische Unterwäsche liegt in der obersten Schublade. — Fresh underwear is in the top drawer.

hindi: बेवफ़ा — साथी को धोखा देने वाला
definition: unfaithful, betraying a partner by having a romantic or sexual relationship with someone else (untreu + Dativ)
example: Sie war ihm nie untreu. — She was never unfaithful to him.

hindi: बेशर्म — हद से ज़्यादा गुस्ताख़ और बेहया
definition: impertinent and shameless, outrageously rude with no sense of embarrassment, also used of outrageous prices
example: Seine Antwort war einfach unverschämt. — His answer was simply outrageous.

hindi: प्रचंड तूफ़ान — नुकसान करने वाला भयंकर मौसम
definition: severe weather, a violent storm with heavy rain, hail or wind that causes damage and triggers warnings (das Unwetter, plural Unwetter)
example: Das Unwetter hat viele Bäume umgeworfen. — The severe storm knocked over many trees.

hindi: अनगिनत — इतने अधिक कि गिने न जा सकें
definition: countless or innumerable in number, too many to count, used emphatically for stars, attempts and questions
example: Ich habe unzählige Male angerufen. — I called countless times.

hindi: अद्यतन — किसी कार्यक्रम का नया सुधरा हुआ रूप
definition: an update, the newer version of a program or operating system that is downloaded to fix problems and add features (das Update, plural Updates)
example: Das Handy installiert gerade ein Update. — The phone is installing an update right now.

hindi: विश्व-प्रथम मंचन — किसी नई रचना का सबसे पहला प्रदर्शन कहीं भी
definition: the world premiere, the very first performance anywhere of a newly written play, opera or piece of music (die Uraufführung, plural Uraufführungen)
example: Die Uraufführung der Oper fand in Wien statt. — The world premiere of the opera took place in Vienna.

hindi: प्रमाण-पत्र — जन्म, विवाह या योग्यता का आधिकारिक दस्तावेज़
definition: an official certificate or deed that legally records a fact or event, such as a birth, marriage or qualification (die Urkunde, plural Urkunden)
example: Bringen Sie bitte die Urkunde im Original mit. — Please bring the original certificate with you.

hindi: छुट्टी — काम से दूर आराम या घूमने के लिए ली गई अवकाश अवधि
definition: a holiday or vacation, the period of leave taken from work to rest or travel somewhere (der Urlaub, plural Urlaube)
example: Der Urlaub am Meer war wunderschön. — The holiday by the sea was wonderful.

hindi: अस्थि-कलश — दाह के बाद राख रखने का पात्र
definition: an urn, the closed container that holds the ashes of a cremated person after death (die Urne, plural Urnen)
example: Die Urne wurde im Familiengrab beigesetzt. — The urn was placed in the family grave.

hindi: कारण — जिससे कोई घटना घटित होती है
definition: a cause, the thing or event that brings about an effect and explains why something happened (die Ursache, plural Ursachen)
example: Die Ursache des Unfalls ist noch unklar. — The cause of the accident is still unclear.

hindi: फ़ैसला — अदालत का निर्णय या किसी की राय
definition: a court verdict or judgment that ends a trial, also a personal judgment or opinion about something (das Urteil, plural Urteile)
example: Das Urteil wird nächste Woche verkündet. — The verdict will be announced next week.

hindi: पिता — बच्चे का पुरुष अभिभावक
definition: the father, the male parent who raises and provides for a child within the family (der Vater, plural Väter)
example: Der Vater kocht heute das Abendessen. — The father is cooking dinner today.

hindi: साइकिल — पैडल से चलने वाली दोपहिया, स्विस शब्द
definition: a bicycle, the two-wheeled pedal vehicle, the everyday Swiss word taken from French where Germany says Fahrrad (das Velo, plural Velos)
example: Ich fahre jeden Tag mit dem Velo zur Arbeit. — I ride my bicycle to work every day.

hindi: तय मुलाक़ात — पहले से बँधा हुआ मिलने का वादा
definition: an arranged meeting, binding enough that cancelling it late counts as a small personal betrayal
example: We have a Verabredung at seven, and here that genuinely means seven.

hindi: तुच्छ समझना — किसी को हेय दृष्टि से देखना
definition: to despise someone or something, to look down on them with contempt and consider them unworthy of respect (regular)
example: Er verachtet Menschen, die lügen. — He despises people who lie.

hindi: पट्टी — घाव पर लपेटी जाने वाली कपड़े की पट्टी
definition: a bandage or dressing, the strip of cloth wrapped around a wound or injured limb; also an association (der Verband, plural Verbände)
example: Der Verband wird morgen gewechselt. — The bandage will be changed tomorrow.

hindi: सुधारना — किसी चीज़ को पहले से बेहतर बनाना
definition: to improve or correct something, making a text, a skill or a situation better than before (regular: hat verbessert)
example: Ich möchte mein Deutsch verbessern. — I want to improve my German.

hindi: मना करना — किसी काम पर रोक लगाना
definition: to forbid or prohibit an action officially, the opposite of allowing or permitting something (irregular: verbot, hat verboten, + Dativ)
example: Der Arzt hat ihm das Rauchen verboten. — The doctor forbade him to smoke.

hindi: जोड़ना — दो चीज़ों को आपस में मिलाना
definition: to connect two things or people together, to put a phone call through, or to bandage a wound (irregular: verband, hat verbunden, mit + Dativ)
example: Ich verbinde Sie mit Frau Müller. — I will connect you to Ms Müller.

hindi: बाध्यकारी — जो क़ानूनी रूप से पक्षों को बाँधता हो
definition: binding and obligatory, describing an agreement, booking or statement that legally commits the parties involved
example: Die Anmeldung ist verbindlich und kann nicht storniert werden. — The registration is binding and cannot be cancelled.

hindi: संपर्क मार्ग — दो जगहों के बीच गाड़ियों का जुड़ाव; फ़ोन या नेट का जुड़ाव भी
definition: a connection or link, the route by train or bus between two places, also a telephone or internet link (die Verbindung, plural Verbindungen)
example: Es gibt eine gute Verbindung nach Leipzig. — There is a good connection to Leipzig.

hindi: मनाही — किसी काम पर लगी रोक
definition: a ban or prohibition, an official rule that forbids something such as smoking or parking (das Verbot, plural Verbote)
example: Trotz des Verbots rauchte er im Zug. — Despite the ban he smoked on the train.

hindi: निषिद्ध — जिसकी मनाही हो
definition: forbidden or prohibited by statute or by a rule, the warning word printed on countless German signs and notices
example: Hier ist das Rauchen verboten. — Smoking is forbidden here.

hindi: उपभोक्ता — अपने उपयोग के लिए सामान ख़रीदने वाला आम व्यक्ति
definition: a consumer, the ordinary person who buys and uses goods and services for private needs, the word used in law and consumer protection (der Verbraucher, plural Verbraucher)
example: Der Verbraucher achtet immer mehr auf den Preis. — The consumer pays more and more attention to the price.

hindi: जुर्म — क़ानून तोड़ने वाला गंभीर अपराध
definition: a crime, a serious offence against the criminal law such as robbery or murder, also crime in general (das Verbrechen, plural Verbrechen)
example: Das Verbrechen geschah mitten in der Nacht. — The crime happened in the middle of the night.

hindi: बिताना — समय या छुट्टी गुज़ारना
definition: to spend time somewhere or with someone, passing hours, days or a holiday (irregular: verbrachte, hat verbracht)
example: Wir verbringen den Sommer am Meer. — We are spending the summer at the seaside.

hindi: शक — किसी पर अपराध का संदेह
definition: suspicion, the belief that someone may have committed a crime or done something wrong without proof yet (der Verdacht, plural Verdachte, rarely used)
example: Die Polizei hat einen Verdacht gegen ihn. — The police have a suspicion against him.

hindi: धिक्कार — गुस्से या झुंझलाहट का हल्का अपशब्द
definition: damned, damn; a mild colloquial curse expressing anger or frustration, also an intensifier meaning extremely
example: Verdammt, der Zug ist schon weg! — Damn, the train has already left!

hindi: सड़ना, बिगाड़ना — खाने का ख़राब होना या मज़ा किरकिरा करना
definition: to spoil or go bad, said of food, and to ruin something such as an evening, a mood or someone's appetite (irregular: verdirbt, ist verdorben; hat verdorben when spoiling something)
example: Die Milch ist in der Hitze verdorben. — The milk went off in the heat.

hindi: कमाना — काम के बदले पैसा पाना
definition: to earn money through work, and also to deserve something through one's conduct (regular)
example: Sie verdient mehr als ihr Chef. — She earns more than her boss.

hindi: कमाई — काम से होने वाली आमदनी
definition: earnings, the money someone makes from work, the income received as salary or wages (der Verdienst, plural Verdienste)
example: Sein Verdienst reicht für die Familie. — His earnings are enough for the family.

hindi: दुगुना करना — किसी मात्रा को दो गुना बढ़ाना
definition: to double, to make an amount, number or price twice as large as before, or to become twice as large as sich verdoppeln (regular, hat verdoppelt)
example: Die Firma hat ihren Umsatz verdoppelt. — The company has doubled its turnover.

hindi: सड़ा हुआ — खाने लायक न रहा, बिगड़ा
definition: spoiled or gone off, used of food that has become unsafe to consume, also of a ruined mood or a corrupted character
example: Die Milch ist verdorben, sie riecht komisch. — The milk has gone off, it smells strange.

hindi: रफ़ूचक्कर होना — चुपचाप गायब हो जाना
definition: to vanish or slip away quietly, colloquial for disappearing before anyone notices, literally to evaporate like scent (ist verduftet)
example: Der Dieb ist schnell verduftet. — The thief quickly vanished.

hindi: संदिग्ध — जिस पर शक हो
definition: suspicious, giving reason to suspect that someone or something is involved in a crime
example: Ein verdächtiger Mann stand vor dem Haus. — A suspicious man was standing in front of the house.

hindi: शक करना — किसी पर अपराध का संदेह जताना
definition: to suspect someone of a crime or wrongdoing, to voice that belief openly without having proof yet (regular; jemanden + Genitiv for the crime)
example: Man verdächtigte ihn des Diebstahls. — He was suspected of the theft.

hindi: आदर करना — किसी को बहुत ऊँचा मानकर श्रद्धा रखना
definition: to revere or venerate someone, to admire them with deep respect that borders on worship, formal register (regular)
example: Er verehrt seinen alten Lehrer noch heute. — He still reveres his old teacher today.

hindi: संघ — साझा शौक़ या उद्देश्य वाला पंजीकृत संगठन
definition: a club or registered association, the typical German organisation for a shared hobby, sport or cause (der Verein, plural Vereine)
example: Im Dorf gibt es einen Verein für alles. — In the village there is a club for everything.

hindi: तय करना — आपसी सहमति से समय या शर्त निश्चित करना
definition: to arrange or agree upon an appointment, price or condition together with another person (regular, + Akkusativ)
example: Wir vereinbaren einen Termin für nächste Woche. — We are arranging an appointment for next week.

hindi: विरासत में देना — मरने के बाद अपनी संपत्ति किसी को छोड़ना
definition: to leave property or money to someone in a will, to pass it on after death (inseparable, regular, + Dativ: vererbt, hat vererbt)
example: Der Großvater vererbt den Hof seinem Enkel. — The grandfather is leaving the farm to his grandson.

hindi: प्रक्रिया — काम करने की निर्धारित पद्धति या क़ानूनी कार्यवाही
definition: a procedure or process, the established sequence of steps for doing something, also legal proceedings in court (das Verfahren, plural Verfahren)
example: Das Verfahren dauert mehrere Wochen. — The procedure takes several weeks.

hindi: जर्जर होना, मियाद ख़त्म होना — इमारत का ढहना या टिकट का बेकार हो जाना
definition: to decay or fall into ruin, said of neglected buildings, and to expire or lapse, said of tickets, vouchers and deadlines (irregular: verfällt, ist verfallen)
example: Der Gutschein verfällt am Monatsende. — The voucher expires at the end of the month.

hindi: रचयिता — किसी लिखित पाठ को लिखने वाला, औपचारिक शब्द
definition: the author or writer of a specific text, a formal word used in offices and libraries for whoever composed a document (der Verfasser, plural Verfasser)
example: Der Verfasser des Briefes ist unbekannt. — The author of the letter is unknown.

hindi: संविधान — राज्य का मूल लिखित क़ानून जो अधिकार और शक्तियाँ तय करता है
definition: the constitution, the fundamental written legal document of a state that sets out rights and powers (die Verfassung, plural Verfassungen)
example: Die Verfassung schützt die Meinungsfreiheit. — The constitution protects freedom of opinion.

hindi: फ़िल्मी रूपांतरण — किताब या नाटक पर बनाई गई फ़िल्म
definition: a film adaptation, the movie version made from a novel, play or true story (die Verfilmung, plural Verfilmungen)
example: Die Verfilmung ist nicht so gut wie das Buch. — The film adaptation is not as good as the book.

hindi: पीछा करना — किसी के पीछे-पीछे जाना, या किसी लक्ष्य का अनुसरण करना
definition: to chase, pursue or follow someone closely, also to follow a plan, a goal or the news (regular: hat verfolgt; + Akkusativ)
example: Die Polizei verfolgt den Dieb durch die Stadt. — The police chase the thief through the city.

hindi: अतीत — बीता हुआ समय
definition: the past, the time that has already gone by, also the past tense in grammar (die Vergangenheit, no plural)
example: Das gehört der Vergangenheit an. — That belongs to the past.

hindi: अतीत से निपटना — देश के काले इतिहास का ईमानदार सामना
definition: the struggle to come to terms with a painful national past, especially Germany's honest reckoning with its dictatorship years (die Vergangenheitsbewältigung, no plural)
example: Die Vergangenheitsbewältigung ist in Deutschland ein wichtiges Thema. — Coming to terms with the past is an important topic in Germany.

hindi: क्षमा करना — गलती माफ़ करना; पद या मौका देना
definition: to forgive, to pardon someone for a wrong they have done, also to award or give away a position or prize (+ Dativ; vergibt, hat vergeben)
example: Sie hat ihm längst vergeben. — She forgave him long ago.

hindi: व्यर्थ — बेकार, बिना नतीजे के
definition: in vain, without success; describing an effort that brought no result despite the attempt being made
example: Ich habe vergeblich auf deinen Anruf gewartet. — I waited for your call in vain.

hindi: क्षमा — गलती का दोष माफ़ कर देना
definition: forgiveness, the act of pardoning someone for a wrong deed and letting go of blame and resentment (die Vergebung, no plural)
example: Sie hofft auf die Vergebung ihrer Schwester. — She hopes for her sister's forgiveness.

hindi: बीत जाना, मिट जाना — समय का गुज़रना या भाव का खत्म होना
definition: to pass or elapse, said of time, and to fade away, said of pain, anger, hunger and fashions (irregular: ist vergangen)
example: Die Zeit vergeht so schnell. — Time passes so quickly.

hindi: भूलना — किसी बात को याद न रख पाना
definition: to forget something, to fail to remember a fact, a duty, an appointment or a physical object (irregular: vergisst, hat vergessen)
example: Ich habe meinen Schlüssel zu Hause vergessen. — I forgot my key at home.

hindi: भुलक्कड़ — बातें जल्दी भूल जाने वाला
definition: forgetful, tending to forget names, appointments and where things were left (vergesslich, vergesslicher, am vergesslichsten)
example: Im Alter wird man oft vergesslich. — People often become forgetful in old age.

hindi: विषाक्तता — ज़हरीली चीज़ खाने या साँस लेने से हुई बीमारी
definition: poisoning, the illness caused by swallowing, breathing or touching a toxic substance (die Vergiftung, plural Vergiftungen)
example: Der Arzt vermutete eine Vergiftung durch Pilze. — The doctor suspected mushroom poisoning.

hindi: तुलना — दो चीज़ों को साथ रखकर समानता-अंतर देखना
definition: a comparison, the act of setting two things side by side to examine how they are alike and how they differ (der Vergleich, plural Vergleiche)
example: Im Vergleich zu gestern ist es heute warm. — Compared with yesterday it is warm today.

hindi: तुलना करना — दो चीज़ों की समानता-भिन्नता देखना
definition: to compare two or more things, numbers or prices in order to notice how they are similar or different (irregular: vergleicht, hat verglichen; mit + Dativ)
