example: Wir vergleichen die Preise, bevor wir kaufen. — We compare the prices before we buy.

hindi: किसी से तुलना करना — दो चीज़ों की समानता और अंतर देखना
definition: to compare one thing or person with another, carefully looking at their similarities and differences side by side (+ Akkusativ, mit + Dativ, vergleicht, hat verglichen)
example: Man kann Berlin nicht mit München vergleichen. — You cannot compare Berlin with Munich.

hindi: आनंद — किसी चीज़ से मिलने वाली खुशी
definition: pleasure or enjoyment, the cheerful delight taken in an amusing activity or entertainment (das Vergnügen, plural Vergnügen)
example: Es war mir ein Vergnügen, mit euch zu spielen. — It was a pleasure playing with you.

hindi: बड़ा करना — किसी चीज़ का आकार या दायरा बढ़ाना
definition: to enlarge or make something bigger in size, area or scale, such as a photograph, a business or a garden (regular: hat vergrößert)
example: Kannst du das Bild ein bisschen vergrößern? — Can you enlarge the picture a little?

hindi: गिरफ़्तार करना — पुलिस द्वारा हिरासत में लेना
definition: to arrest someone, to take a suspect into police custody on suspicion of a crime (regular, hat verhaftet)
example: Die Polizei hat den Verdächtigen verhaftet. — The police have arrested the suspect.

hindi: गिरफ़्तारी — किसी को हिरासत में लेना
definition: an arrest, the act of taking a suspect into police custody, often on a warrant issued by a judge (die Verhaftung, plural Verhaftungen)
example: Die Verhaftung überraschte die ganze Familie. — The arrest surprised the whole family.

hindi: मोल-भाव या बातचीत करना — समझौते के लिए शर्तों पर चर्चा करना
definition: to negotiate terms, prices or a contract with another party in order to reach an agreement (regular; über + Akkusativ or mit + Dativ)
example: Wir verhandeln noch über den Preis. — We are still negotiating the price.

hindi: सुनवाई — अदालत में मुक़दमे की कार्यवाही, या वार्ता
definition: a court hearing where a case is argued before the judge, also a negotiation between parties (die Verhandlung, plural Verhandlungen)
example: Die Verhandlung wurde auf Juni verschoben. — The hearing was postponed to June.

hindi: विवाहित — जिसकी शादी हो चुकी हो
definition: married, having a husband or wife, the state of being wedded to someone, often with mit + Dativ
example: Sie ist seit fünf Jahren verheiratet. — She has been married for five years.

hindi: संबंध — रिश्ता; बोलचाल में गुप्त प्रेम-संबंध भी
definition: a relationship or ratio between people or things, and colloquially a secret romantic affair outside a marriage (das Verhältnis, plural Verhältnisse)
example: Er hatte ein Verhältnis mit seiner Kollegin. — He had an affair with his colleague.

hindi: पूछताछ — पुलिस या अदालत द्वारा सख़्त सवाल-जवाब
definition: an interrogation, the formal and often lengthy questioning of a suspect or witness conducted by police officers or a court (das Verhör, plural Verhöre)
example: Das Verhör dauerte über vier Stunden. — The interrogation lasted over four hours.

hindi: उतरते नशे की बेहाली — ज़्यादा पीने के अगले दिन सिरदर्द और मिचली
definition: colloquial for hungover, suffering from headache, tiredness and nausea the morning after drinking too much alcohol
example: Am Sonntag war er total verkatert. — On Sunday he was totally hungover.

hindi: बेचना — पैसे लेकर चीज़ देना
definition: to sell something, to hand over goods to a buyer in exchange for money (regular: verkauft, hat verkauft)
example: Er verkauft sein altes Fahrrad für fünfzig Euro. — He is selling his old bicycle for fifty euros.

hindi: यातायात — सड़कों पर गाड़ियों और लोगों की आवाजाही
definition: traffic, the movement of vehicles and people through the streets, also transport in general (der Verkehr, no plural)
example: Morgens ist der Verkehr in der Stadt schrecklich. — In the morning the traffic in the city is terrible.

hindi: यातायात चिह्न — सड़क के नियम बताने वाला बोर्ड
definition: a traffic sign, a road sign on a post that tells drivers the rules, speed limits or directions (das Verkehrsschild, plural Verkehrsschilder)
example: Hast du das Verkehrsschild nicht gesehen? — Did you not see the road sign?

hindi: सड़क दुर्घटना — सड़क पर गाड़ियों की टक्कर या हादसा
definition: a road traffic accident, a crash between vehicles or with pedestrians on the road that causes injury or damage (der Verkehrsunfall, plural Verkehrsunfälle)
example: Bei dem Verkehrsunfall wurden zwei Personen verletzt. — Two people were injured in the road accident.

hindi: मुक़दमा करना — किसी के ख़िलाफ़ अदालत में दावा दायर करना
definition: to sue someone, to bring a civil lawsuit against a person or company in court (regular; auf + Akkusativ for the claim)
example: Er will die Firma auf Schadenersatz verklagen. — He wants to sue the company for damages.

hindi: छोटा करना — किसी चीज़ का आकार घटाना
definition: to make something smaller in size or scale, such as a photograph, a font, a team or a company (regular: hat verkleinert)
example: Bitte verkleinern Sie die Schrift ein wenig. — Please make the font a little smaller.

hindi: दुकानदार — दुकान में सामान बेचने या मदद करने वाला
definition: a shop assistant or salesman, the person in a store who serves customers and sells goods (der Verkäufer, plural Verkäufer)
example: Der Verkäufer zeigt mir drei verschiedene Jacken. — The sales assistant shows me three different jackets.

hindi: प्रकाशन गृह — किताबें छापकर बेचने वाली संस्था
definition: a publishing house, the company that prints, produces and sells books, magazines or newspapers (der Verlag, plural Verlage)
example: Der Verlag hat ihr Manuskript angenommen. — The publisher accepted her manuscript.

hindi: माँगना — दृढ़ता से किसी चीज़ की माँग करना या लालसा रखना
definition: to demand something firmly, or to crave and long for it, with the sense of a strong insistent desire (regular, verlangen nach + Dativ)
example: Der Kunde verlangt sein Geld zurück. — The customer demands his money back.

hindi: छोड़ना — कोई जगह या व्यक्ति पीछे छोड़कर जाना
definition: to leave a place or a person behind, walking out of a room or ending a relationship; reflexively to rely on someone (irregular: verlässt, hat verlassen; sich verlassen auf + Akkusativ)
example: Er hat das Haus um sieben Uhr verlassen. — He left the house at seven o'clock.

hindi: सकुचाया हुआ — असहज और झेंपा हुआ
definition: embarrassed or self-conscious, awkwardly unsure what to say or where to look in a situation
example: Er lächelte verlegen und sagte nichts. — He smiled awkwardly and said nothing.

hindi: किराए या उधार पर देना — अपनी चीज़ दूसरों को इस्तेमाल को देना; पुरस्कार देना
definition: to lend or hire out something one owns, such as cars or costumes, and formally to award a prize or title (inseparable, irregular: verleiht, hat verliehen)
example: Der Laden verleiht Fahrräder an Touristen. — The shop hires out bicycles to tourists.

hindi: चोट पहुँचाना — शरीर या भावनाओं को आहत करना
definition: to injure a person or a body part, or to hurt someone's feelings and offend them (regular: hat verletzt)
example: Sie hat sich beim Sport am Knie verletzt. — She injured her knee doing sport.

hindi: घायल — जिसे शरीर पर चोट लगी हो
definition: injured or hurt, having suffered physical damage to the body in an accident or attack
example: Der verletzte Radfahrer wurde ins Krankenhaus gebracht. — The injured cyclist was taken to hospital.

hindi: चोट — शरीर को पहुँचा नुक़सान
definition: an injury, the physical damage done to the body by an accident, fall or blow (die Verletzung, plural Verletzungen)
example: Die Verletzung am Knie heilt langsam. — The knee injury is healing slowly.

hindi: प्रेम में डूबा — किसी पर दिल आया हुआ
definition: in love and infatuated, smitten, with heart, feelings and thoughts constantly turning towards someone special (verliebt in + Akkusativ)
example: Er ist in seine Nachbarin verliebt. — He is in love with his neighbour.

hindi: हारना — खेल में पराजित होना; खो देना
definition: to lose, to be defeated in a match or game, and also to mislay an object or be unable to find it (verliert, hat verloren)
example: Leider haben wir das Finale verloren. — Unfortunately we lost the final.

hindi: सगाई हो चुकी — शादी का वादा किया हुआ
definition: engaged to be married, having formally promised marriage to someone but not yet wedded, the status between proposal and wedding (verlobt mit + Dativ)
example: Meine Schwester ist seit Ostern verlobt. — My sister has been engaged since Easter.

hindi: सगाई — शादी का वादा और उसकी घोषणा
definition: an engagement, the promise between two people to marry each other, often celebrated and announced to family (die Verlobung, plural Verlobungen)
example: Wir feiern am Samstag unsere Verlobung. — We are celebrating our engagement on Saturday.

hindi: झूठा — आदतन झूठ बोलने वाला और दोमुँहा
definition: mendacious and hypocritical, habitually lying and pretending to be better than one really is, a strong condemnation
example: Seine Entschuldigung klang verlogen. — His apology sounded dishonest and hypocritical.

hindi: घाटा या हानि — कमाई से ज़्यादा ख़र्च होना; कुछ खो देना
definition: a financial loss when costs exceed revenue, or more generally the losing of something or someone valuable (der Verlust, plural Verluste)
example: Der Betrieb machte im ersten Jahr einen hohen Verlust. — The business made a heavy loss in its first year.

hindi: खोने का डर — प्रिय के छिन जाने की सतत आशंका
definition: persistent fear of losing someone, which quietly damages the closeness it so desperately guards
example: Her Verlustangst turned every unanswered message into an emergency.

hindi: बढ़वाना — दस्तावेज़ या समय-सीमा की अवधि बढ़ाना
definition: to extend or renew the validity of a document, contract or deadline, or to make something longer (regular, inseparable: hat verlängert)
example: Ich möchte mein Visum um ein Jahr verlängern. — I would like to extend my visa by one year.

hindi: विश्वसनीय — जिस पर भरोसा किया जा सके, पक्का
definition: dependable and trustworthy, a person or source you can rely on, a close synonym of zuverlässig
example: Sie ist eine verlässliche Freundin. — She is a dependable friend.

hindi: टालना — किसी परेशानी से जान-बूझकर बचना
definition: to avoid a mistake, a conflict or an awkward situation deliberately by not letting it happen (irregular: vermied, hat vermieden)
example: Ich vermeide es, spät abends Kaffee zu trinken. — I avoid drinking coffee late in the evening.

hindi: किराये पर देना — पैसे लेकर अपना मकान या कमरा दूसरे को देना
definition: to let or rent out a flat, house or room to a tenant in return for regular money (regular: hat vermietet; an + Akkusativ)
example: Sie vermietet das Zimmer an eine Studentin. — She rents the room out to a student.

hindi: मकान मालिक — किराये पर घर देने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a landlord, the owner who rents out a flat or house to a tenant in exchange for monthly rent (der Vermieter, plural Vermieter)
example: Der Vermieter hat die Miete erhöht. — The landlord raised the rent.

hindi: याद आना — किसी की कमी खलना
definition: to miss someone or something, to feel their absence painfully with sadness or longing while they are away (regular: hat vermisst; + Akkusativ)
example: Ich vermisse meine Freunde aus der Schulzeit. — I miss my friends from school days.

hindi: अनुमान लगाना — किसी बात को संभावित मानना
definition: to suppose or presume something is the case based on likelihood rather than firm proof or evidence (regular: vermutet, hat vermutet)
example: Ich vermute, dass sie im Stau steht. — I suspect she is stuck in traffic.

hindi: अनुमानतः — लगता है कि, शायद
definition: presumably, probably; expressing a reasonable guess based on the available evidence or common sense
example: Er ist vermutlich schon zu Hause. — He is presumably already at home.

hindi: अनुमान — बिना प्रमाण के लगाया गया अंदाज़ा
definition: a supposition or assumption held without proof, an educated guess about what happened or will happen (die Vermutung, plural Vermutungen)
example: Das ist nur eine Vermutung, kein Beweis. — That is only a supposition, not proof.

hindi: विरासत — मृतक द्वारा छोड़ी गई धरोहर या संदेश
definition: a legacy, what a dead person leaves behind in values, works or a gift in a will (das Vermächtnis, plural Vermächtnisse)
example: Seine Bücher sind sein Vermächtnis an uns. — His books are his legacy to us.

hindi: संपत्ति — किसी व्यक्ति का कुल धन और परिसंपत्तियाँ
definition: wealth or fortune, the total money, property and assets that a person owns (das Vermögen, plural Vermögen)
example: Die Familie hat ein großes Vermögen geerbt. — The family inherited a large fortune.

hindi: सुन पाना — कोई आवाज़ कानों तक पहुँचना
definition: to hear or perceive a sound, a formal or literary word, also used for police questioning a witness (inseparable, irregular: vernimmt, hat vernommen)
example: Aus der Ferne vernahm man ein leises Donnern. — A faint thunder could be heard in the distance.

hindi: मिटा देना — पूरी तरह से खत्म कर देना
definition: to annihilate or wipe out something completely, stronger than destroying, used for documents, harvests, pests and hopes (regular: hat vernichtet)
example: Der Frost hat die ganze Ernte vernichtet. — The frost wiped out the entire harvest.

hindi: विवेक — भावना के बजाय सही-गलत सोचकर निर्णय लेने की समझ
definition: the reason and good sense that guide a person to sensible decisions instead of rash emotion (die Vernunft, no plural)
example: Am Ende hat die Vernunft gesiegt. — In the end reason prevailed.

hindi: समझदार — विवेक से सही निर्णय लेने वाला; या उचित
definition: sensible and reasonable, guided by sound judgement, also said of a fair price or decent option (regular adjective)
example: Sei vernünftig und zieh eine Jacke an. — Be sensible and put on a jacket.

hindi: विनियम — सरकार द्वारा जारी क़ानूनी नियम
definition: a regulation or ordinance issued by a government or public authority that carries legal binding force (die Verordnung, plural Verordnungen)
example: Die neue Verordnung gilt ab ersten Januar. — The new regulation applies from the first of January.

hindi: लपेटकर बंद करना — बेचने या भेजने के लिए सामान को आवरण में बंद करना
definition: to package or wrap goods for sale or shipping, to enclose something in protective packaging (inseparable: verpackt, hat verpackt)
example: Der Laden verpackt alles in Plastik. — The shop packages everything in plastic.

hindi: पैकिंग — किसी चीज़ को लपेटने या रखने का डिब्बा या थैला
definition: packaging, the box, wrapper, bottle or foil that a product is sold in and that becomes waste (die Verpackung, plural Verpackungen)
example: Die Verpackung ist größer als das Produkt. — The packaging is bigger than the product.

hindi: छूट जाना — देर से पहुँचकर गाड़ी या मौका खो देना
definition: to miss a train, bus, flight or opportunity by arriving too late to catch it, to fail to reach it (regular: hat verpasst)
example: Ich habe den letzten Bus verpasst. — I missed the last bus.

hindi: भुलक्कड़, बेध्यान — गड़बड़ा गया हुआ
definition: scatterbrained, confused or hopelessly disorganised in youth slang, said of someone who forgets and muddles things
example: Sorry, ich bin heute total verpeilt. — Sorry, I am totally scatterbrained today.

hindi: भेद खोलना — राज़ बता देना या किसी से गद्दारी करना
definition: to reveal a secret or give away hidden information, also to betray a person, a friend or a cause (irregular: verrät, hat verraten; jemandem etwas verraten)
example: Verrätst du mir dein Rezept? — Will you tell me your recipe?

hindi: सफ़र पर निकल जाना — कुछ दिनों के लिए घर से दूर जाना
definition: to go away on a trip, to leave home for several days of travel or holiday (ist verreist)
example: Über Weihnachten verreisen wir nach Österreich. — Over Christmas we are going away to Austria.

hindi: घटाना — मात्रा या स्तर को कम करना
definition: to reduce or lessen an amount, risk, distance or level, slightly more formal than everyday speech (regular: hat verringert)
example: Wir müssen den Energieverbrauch verringern. — We have to reduce energy consumption.

hindi: पागल — सनकी, बेतुका; बोलचाल में ज़बरदस्त भी
definition: crazy, mad, wild; describes an idea or person that is absurd, also colloquial praise for something thrilling
example: Das ist eine verrückte Idee, aber sie gefällt mir. — That is a crazy idea, but I like it.

hindi: घोलकर मिलाना — दो चीज़ों को हिलाकर एक कर देना
definition: to stir ingredients together until they blend into one smooth mixture, as eggs into flour (regular: verrührt, hat verrührt)
example: Verrühre die Eier mit dem Zucker. — Mix the eggs with the sugar.

hindi: प्रेषण या शिपिंग — सामान डाक या कूरियर से भेजना, और वह विभाग
definition: the dispatch or shipping of goods to customers by post or courier, also the department of a business that handles it (der Versand, no plural)
example: Der Versand ist ab fünfzig Euro kostenlos. — Shipping is free from fifty euros.

hindi: मुफ़्त दे देना — अपनी चीज़ें बिना दाम बाँट देना; मौका गँवाना
definition: to give something away for free rather than sell it, and figuratively to throw away a chance or points (inseparable, regular: verschenkt, hat verschenkt)
example: Wir verschenken die alten Möbel an Nachbarn. — We are giving the old furniture away to neighbours.

hindi: रवाना करना — संदेश, निमंत्रण या पार्सल भेज देना
definition: to send off or dispatch something, often to several recipients at once, such as invitations, newsletters or parcels (regular)
example: Wir haben die Einladungen per E-Mail verschickt. — We sent out the invitations by email.

hindi: स्थगित करना — बैठक या काम आगे की तारीख पर ले जाना
definition: to postpone an appointment or event to a later date, or to move an object to another position (irregular: verschob, hat verschoben)
example: Können wir das Treffen auf Montag verschieben? — Can we postpone the meeting to Monday?

hindi: देर तक सोए रह जाना — उठने का समय नींद में निकल जाना
definition: to oversleep, to sleep right through the time when you should have gotten up (inseparable: verschläft, hat verschlafen)
example: Ich habe verschlafen und den Bus verpasst. — I overslept and missed the bus.

hindi: बिगाड़ना, बदतर होना — हालत का पहले से ख़राब होना
definition: to make something worse or, reflexively, to get worse, used for health, weather, results and relations between people (regular: hat verschlechtert)
example: Sein Zustand hat sich über Nacht verschlechtert. — His condition worsened overnight.

hindi: सुधारते-सुधारते बिगाड़ना — भले इरादे से बात और खराब कर देना
definition: to make something worse precisely by trying to improve it, usually with the very best intentions
example: Every attempt to tidy the config only managed to verschlimmbessern the build.

hindi: सुधार के नाम पर बिगाड़ — ठीक करने की कोशिश में और ख़राब
definition: an improvement that leaves the thing worse than it was, combining repair and damage in one act
example: The redesigned checkout page was a textbook Verschlimmbesserung.

hindi: और बुरा करना — किसी बुरी हालत को और गंभीर बना देना
definition: to aggravate or make a bad situation worse, or reflexively for pain, damage and conflicts becoming more serious (regular: hat verschlimmert)
example: Kratzen verschlimmert den Ausschlag nur. — Scratching only makes the rash worse.

hindi: बंद करने वाला ढक्कन या क्लिप — बोतल, बैग या हार को बंद रखने की चीज़
definition: the closure, cap, clasp or fastener that keeps a bottle, bag, necklace or container securely closed until opened (der Verschluss, plural Verschlüsse)
example: Der Verschluss der Flasche lässt sich nicht öffnen. — The cap of the bottle will not open.

hindi: प्रदूषित करना — हवा, पानी या ज़मीन को गंदा करना
definition: to pollute, to make air, water or soil dirty and harmful with waste or chemicals (regular: hat verschmutzt)
example: Die Fabrik verschmutzt den Fluss mit Chemikalien. — The factory pollutes the river with chemicals.

hindi: प्रदूषण — हवा, पानी या ज़मीन का गंदा और ज़हरीला होना
definition: pollution, the dirtying of air, water or soil with harmful substances from factories, traffic and waste (die Verschmutzung, plural Verschmutzungen)
example: Die Verschmutzung des Flusses ist ein großes Problem. — The pollution of the river is a big problem.

hindi: दवा लिखना — डॉक्टर द्वारा नुस्ख़ा देना
definition: to prescribe, for a doctor to write out a medicine on a prescription slip that a patient takes to the pharmacy (inseparable: verschreibt, hat verschrieben; + Dativ for the patient)
example: Der Arzt hat mir ein Antibiotikum verschrieben. — The doctor prescribed me an antibiotic.

hindi: उड़ाना — पैसा, समय या चीज़ बेकार बरबाद करना
definition: to waste money, time or resources by spending them carelessly on nothing worthwhile (inseparable, regular: verschwendet, hat verschwendet)
example: Verschwende dein Geld nicht für solchen Unsinn. — Do not waste your money on such nonsense.

hindi: ग़ायब होना — दिखना बंद हो जाना या खो जाना
definition: to disappear or vanish from sight, used for lost keys, fading traces, people leaving quietly and species dying out (irregular: ist verschwunden)
example: Mein Schlüssel ist schon wieder verschwunden. — My key has disappeared again.

hindi: भूलवश — ग़लती से, अनजाने में
definition: by mistake, inadvertently; describing an action done unintentionally through carelessness or a simple oversight
example: Ich habe die Datei versehentlich gelöscht. — I deleted the file by mistake.

hindi: बीमा कराना — नुकसान या बीमारी के ख़तरे से सुरक्षा ख़रीदना
definition: to insure a person or possession against future loss, damage, theft or illness (regular; sich versichern gegen + Akkusativ)
example: Wir haben das neue Fahrrad gegen Diebstahl versichert. — We insured the new bicycle against theft.

hindi: बीमा पत्रक — डॉक्टर को दिखाया जाने वाला स्वास्थ्य बीमा का चिप वाला पत्रक
definition: the health insurance card, the plastic chip card every patient shows at the reception before a doctor's visit (die Versichertenkarte, plural Versichertenkarten)
example: Haben Sie Ihre Versichertenkarte dabei? — Do you have your insurance card with you?

hindi: बीमा — नुकसान, बीमारी या हानि पर भुगतान करने वाला अनुबंध
definition: insurance, a contract that pays out when damage, illness, theft or other loss occurs (die Versicherung, plural Versicherungen)
example: Die Versicherung zahlt den Schaden am Auto. — The insurance pays for the damage to the car.

hindi: वादा करना — पक्का वचन देना कि कुछ करेंगे
definition: to promise another person firmly that you will certainly do something, also as a reflexive verb to misspeak or slip up (irregular: verspricht, hat versprochen; jemandem etwas versprechen)
example: Ich verspreche dir, ich komme pünktlich. — I promise you I will come on time.

hindi: विलंब — गाड़ी या उड़ान का तय समय से देर होना
definition: a delay, the lateness of a train, flight or person against the scheduled time (die Verspätung, plural Verspätungen)
example: Wegen der Verspätung habe ich meinen Anschluss verpasst. — Because of the delay I missed my connection.

hindi: बुद्धि — सोचने, समझने और तर्क करने की मानसिक शक्ति
definition: the intellect and reasoning mind that lets a person think clearly, understand and judge sensibly (der Verstand, no plural)
example: Hast du den Verstand verloren? — Have you lost your mind?

hindi: समझना — किसी बात, भाषा या व्यक्ति का अर्थ ग्रहण करना
definition: to understand words, a language, a person or a situation, the everyday verb for comprehension (irregular: versteht, verstand, hat verstanden)
example: Ich verstehe dich leider nicht, sprich bitte langsamer. — Sorry, I don't understand you, please speak slower.

hindi: नीलाम करना — सबसे ऊँची बोली वाले को बेचना
definition: to auction something off, selling it publicly to whoever bids the highest price (inseparable, regular: versteigert, hat versteigert)
example: Das Gemälde wurde für eine Million versteigert. — The painting was auctioned off for a million.

hindi: स्वर्गवासी होना — मरने के लिए शिष्ट और औपचारिक शब्द
definition: to pass away, the formal and gentle verb for dying used in notices and polite speech (verstirbt, ist verstorben)
example: Herr Müller ist gestern friedlich verstorben. — Mr Müller passed away peacefully yesterday.

hindi: उल्लंघन — नियम या क़ानून तोड़ना
definition: a violation or breach of a rule, regulation or law, usually less serious than a crime (der Verstoß, plural Verstöße)
example: Das war ein klarer Verstoß gegen die Regeln. — That was a clear violation of the rules.

hindi: चुप हो जाना — अचानक बोलना बंद कर देना
definition: to fall silent or stop speaking suddenly, as a voice or a crowd does when something happens (regular: verstummt, ist verstummt)
example: Als der Lehrer hereinkam, verstummte die Klasse. — When the teacher came in, the class fell silent.

hindi: प्रयोग — किसी बात को परखने के लिए किया गया परीक्षण या कोशिश
definition: an experiment or scientific trial carried out to test an idea, also an ordinary attempt at doing something (der Versuch, plural Versuche)
example: Der Versuch im Labor ist gelungen. — The experiment in the laboratory succeeded.

hindi: कोशिश करना — किसी काम का प्रयास करना
definition: to try or attempt to do something, making an effort without knowing if it will succeed, also to taste food (regular: hat versucht)
example: Ich versuche, jeden Tag ein bisschen Deutsch zu lernen. — I try to learn a little German every day.

hindi: सुलह — झगड़े के बाद फिर से मेल
definition: a reconciliation, making peace after a quarrel and restoring the good relationship (die Versöhnung, plural Versöhnungen)
example: Die Versöhnung kam mit einem langen Gespräch. — The reconciliation came with a long conversation.

hindi: बाँटना — कई लोगों के बीच चीज़ें अलग-अलग करके देना
definition: to distribute or share things out among several people or places, such as handing out leaflets or dividing food (inseparable, regular: hat verteilt)
example: Die Lehrerin verteilt die Arbeitsblätter an die Klasse. — The teacher hands out the worksheets to the class.

hindi: अनुबंध — दो पक्षों के बीच लिखित समझौता
definition: a contract, a written legal agreement between two parties such as employer and employee (der Vertrag, plural Verträge)
example: Ich habe den Vertrag noch nicht unterschrieben. — I have not signed the contract yet.

hindi: भरोसा करना — किसी पर विश्वास रखना
definition: to trust someone, to rely on a person and believe firmly that they are honest, loyal and reliable (+ Dativ, hat vertraut)
example: Ich vertraue meinem Bruder völlig. — I trust my brother completely.

hindi: निष्कासन — लोगों को उनकी मातृभूमि से ज़बरन निकालना
definition: expulsion, the forced removal of people from their homeland, a painful chapter of postwar memory (die Vertreibung, plural Vertreibungen)
example: Nach der Vertreibung kam die Familie nach Bayern. — After the expulsion the family came to Bavaria.

hindi: स्थानापन्न — अनुपस्थित व्यक्ति की जगह काम करने वाला
definition: a substitute or stand-in, the person who covers someone's duties during holiday or illness, also the act of representing (die Vertretung, plural Vertretungen)
example: Während meines Urlaubs übernimmt Herr Klein die Vertretung. — During my holiday Mr Klein takes over as stand-in.

hindi: सज़ा सुनाना — अदालत द्वारा दोषी ठहराकर दंड देना, या निंदा करना
definition: to convict and sentence someone in court, also to condemn an action morally (regular; zu + Dativ for the sentence)
example: Das Gericht verurteilte ihn zu drei Jahren Haft. — The court sentenced him to three years in prison.

hindi: प्रशासन — सार्वजनिक मामलों का प्रबंध करने वाला तंत्र
definition: the administration, the bureaucracy and offices that manage public affairs for the state or a town (die Verwaltung, plural Verwaltungen)
example: Die Verwaltung arbeitet in diesem Jahr digitaler. — The administration is working more digitally this year.

hindi: कायापलट करना — किसी चीज़ को बिल्कुल दूसरी चीज़ बना देना
definition: to transform or turn something completely into something else, often dramatically as in fairy tales or renovations (regular: hat verwandelt; in + Akkusativ)
example: Der Regen verwandelte die Straße in einen Fluss. — The rain turned the street into a river.

hindi: रिश्तेदार — परिवार से खून या विवाह के नाते जुड़ा व्यक्ति
definition: the relative, a person connected to the family by blood or marriage, declined like an adjective (der/die Verwandte, plural Verwandten)
example: Zur Hochzeit kamen viele Verwandte aus dem Ausland. — Many relatives from abroad came to the wedding.

hindi: रिश्तेदारी — सारे रिश्तेदार या उनसे नाता
definition: the kinship or the whole body of relatives, family relationship taken as a group or a bond (die Verwandtschaft, plural Verwandtschaften)
example: Die ganze Verwandtschaft sitzt am Tisch. — The whole extended family is sitting at the table.

hindi: मुरझाना — फूल या पत्तियों का सूखकर झुक जाना
definition: to wilt or wither, said of flowers and leaves that droop and dry out, also figuratively of beauty fading (regular: ist verwelkt)
example: Die Rosen sind schon nach zwei Tagen verwelkt. — The roses wilted after only two days.

hindi: प्रयोग करना — किसी सामग्री या तरीके को काम में लाना
definition: to use or employ material, a word or a method, slightly more formal than benutzen and common in writing (regular: hat verwendet)
example: Für den Kuchen verwende ich nur frische Butter. — For the cake I use only fresh butter.

hindi: उलझन में — भ्रमित, समझ न पाना
definition: confused and bewildered, puzzled and unable to understand or make sense of what is happening around you
example: Nach der Erklärung war ich völlig verwirrt. — After the explanation I was completely confused.

hindi: लाड़ में बिगाड़ना — बच्चे को हर चीज़ देकर और कुछ न रोककर सिर चढ़ाना
definition: to spoil or pamper someone, especially a child, by giving them too much and denying them nothing (regular: hat verwöhnt)
example: Die Großeltern verwöhnen die Enkel mit Süßigkeiten. — The grandparents spoil the grandchildren with sweets.

hindi: माफ़ करना — किसी की गलती पर नाराज़गी छोड़ देना
definition: to forgive or excuse, to stop being angry at someone for a wrong or mistake they have made (+ Dativ; hat verziehen)
example: Verzeihen Sie die Störung! — Please excuse the interruption!

hindi: क्षमा-याचना — कुछ औपचारिक माफ़ी
definition: forgiveness or pardon, the slightly formal word spoken when apologising for a small mistake (die Verzeihung, no plural)
example: Er hoffte auf ihre Verzeihung. — He hoped for her forgiveness.

hindi: त्याग करना — किसी चीज़ को छोड़ देना
definition: to give something up or do without it, especially a pleasure such as sweets, meat or alcohol (regular; auf + Akkusativ)
example: Ich verzichte diesen Monat auf Alkohol. — I am giving up alcohol this month.

hindi: किसी चीज़ का त्याग करना — जो मिल सकता था उसे जानबूझकर छोड़ देना
definition: to give up or do without something willingly, deliberately renouncing a pleasure, right, habit or claim (auf + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Im Urlaub verzichte ich gern auf mein Handy. — On holiday I gladly do without my phone.

hindi: हताश — निराशा में टूटा, कोई रास्ता न दिखे
definition: desperate and despairing, at the end of one's rope, feeling hopeless with no solution or escape in sight
example: Sie suchte verzweifelt nach ihrem Schlüssel. — She searched desperately for her key.

hindi: निराशा — कोई रास्ता न दिखने पर हताश हो जाने की दशा
definition: despair, the hopeless desperate state of someone who sees no way out of their situation (die Verzweiflung, no plural)
example: Die Verzweiflung stand ihr ins Gesicht geschrieben. — Despair was written all over her face.

hindi: बदलना — किसी चीज़ को पहले से अलग कर देना
definition: to change or alter something noticeably, making it different from how it was before (regular: hat verändert)
example: Die Stadt hat sich in zehn Jahren sehr verändert. — The city has changed a lot in ten years.

hindi: परिवर्तन — किसी चीज़ का पहले से अलग हो जाना
definition: a change or alteration in the state of something, the noun for developments in life, work, weather and society (die Veränderung, plural Veränderungen)
example: Die Veränderung tut ihm gut. — The change is doing him good.

hindi: नाराज़ — किसी बात से खिन्न और चिढ़ा
definition: annoyed and displeased, irritated by something that went wrong, slightly formal
example: Die Kunden waren über die Verspätung verärgert. — The customers were annoyed about the delay.

hindi: प्रकाशित करना — लेख, किताब या खबर को सबके सामने लाना
definition: to publish an article, book, photo or piece of information so that the public can read it (regular: hat veröffentlicht)
example: Die Zeitung hat die Fotos gestern veröffentlicht. — The newspaper published the photos yesterday.

hindi: हल्का भोजन — स्वाबिया और बाडेन में शाम का रोटी-सॉसेज वाला ठंडा नाश्ता
definition: the Swabian and southwestern word for a cold snack meal of bread, sausage and cheese eaten in the late afternoon or evening (das Vesper, plural Vesper)
example: Zum Vesper gibt es Brot, Wurst und Käse. — For the evening snack there is bread, sausage and cheese.

hindi: मवेशी — गाय, सुअर, भेड़ जैसे पालतू पशु
definition: livestock or cattle, the farm animals such as cows, pigs and sheep kept for milk, meat and work (das Vieh, no plural)
example: Der Bauer treibt das Vieh auf die Weide. — The farmer drives the livestock to the pasture.

hindi: बहुत — बड़ी मात्रा या संख्या में
definition: much or a lot, describing a large quantity or amount of something uncountable, and with plural nouns many things or people
example: Ich habe heute viel Arbeit. — I have a lot of work today.

hindi: सफलता की कामना — मेहनत के फल की शुभकामना
definition: the wish for success spoken before a task that depends on effort rather than luck, common in business
example: Viel Erfolg bei der Präsentation! — Good luck with the presentation!

hindi: शुभकामना — भाग्य साथ दे की कामना
definition: the wish for good fortune spoken before an exam, interview or anything whose outcome depends on chance
example: Viel Glück bei der Prüfung morgen! — Good luck in the exam tomorrow!

hindi: आनंद लें — मौज-मस्ती की शुभकामना
definition: the wish for enjoyment spoken to someone leaving for a party, holiday or outing
example: Viel Spaß auf dem Konzert heute Abend! — Have fun at the concert tonight!

hindi: सिर पर ढेरों काम होना — काम से बेहद व्यस्त होना
definition: to have a great deal on one's plate, being extremely busy with many tasks at once (colloquial; hat viel um die Ohren)
example: Ich habe diese Woche viel um die Ohren. — I have a lot on my plate this week.

hindi: बहुत धन्यवाद — विनम्र आभार
definition: the polite expression of thanks used with strangers, officials and in letters, stronger than plain danke
example: Vielen Dank für Ihre schnelle Antwort. — Many thanks for your quick reply.

hindi: अग्रिम धन्यवाद — अनुरोध करते हुए पहले से आभार जताना
definition: the polite closing line thanking someone in advance for help or a reply that has been requested in the email
example: Vielen Dank im Voraus für Ihre Unterstützung. — Many thanks in advance for your support.

hindi: शायद — हो सकता है
definition: perhaps, maybe, possibly; expressing uncertainty about whether something is true or will happen
example: Vielleicht regnet es morgen. — Maybe it will rain tomorrow.

hindi: चार — गिनती की चौथी संख्या
definition: the cardinal number four, used when counting items, people, rooms or hours in everyday German speech
example: Die Wohnung hat vier Zimmer und einen Balkon. — The flat has four rooms and a balcony.

hindi: मोहल्ला — शहर का एक छोटा इलाक़ा, या चौथाई हिस्सा
definition: a quarter or neighbourhood of a city, a residential district with its own character and local shops, also the fraction one fourth (das Viertel, plural Viertel)
example: Unser Viertel hat viele kleine Cafés. — Our neighbourhood has many small cafés.

hindi: प्रवेश-अनुमति — किसी देश में प्रवेश की सरकारी इजाज़त, पारपत्र में लगी मुहर
definition: a visa, the official permission stamped into a passport that allows entry into a foreign country (das Visum, plural Visa)
example: Für Indien brauchen wir ein Visum. — For India we need a visa.

hindi: जीवनसत्त्व — शरीर के लिए ज़रूरी सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्व
definition: a vitamin, one of the essential nutrients the body needs in small amounts from food to stay healthy (das Vitamin, plural Vitamine)
example: Das Vitamin C stärkt die Abwehrkräfte. — Vitamin C strengthens the body's defences.

hindi: जान-पहचान का ज़ोर — काम निकलवाने वाला रिश्ता
definition: connections as nourishment: the useful acquaintance who opens a door no application ever could
example: He found that apartment through Vitamin B, never through the listing.

hindi: पक्षी — पंखों वाला उड़ने वाला जीव
definition: a bird, a feathered creature with wings that flies and sings, the general word for every bird (der Vogel, plural Vögel)
example: Ein Vogel singt vor dem Fenster. — A bird is singing outside the window.

hindi: शब्द — विदेशी भाषा का याद किया जाने वाला शब्द
definition: a vocabulary item, a single foreign-language word that a learner memorises, usually spoken of in the plural (die Vokabel, plural Vokabeln)
example: Ich lerne jeden Abend zwanzig Vokabeln. — I learn twenty vocabulary words every evening.

hindi: जनता — किसी राष्ट्र के लोग, पूरी आबादी
definition: the people of a nation, the whole population of a country from whom democratic political power comes (das Volk, plural Völker)
example: Das Volk wählt alle vier Jahre ein neues Parlament. — The people elect a new parliament every four years.

hindi: लोक मेला — झूलों, बीयर-तंबू और संगीत वाला बड़ा सार्वजनिक मेला
definition: a funfair or folk festival with beer tents, rides and music that a town holds every year (das Volksfest, plural Volksfeste)
example: Das Volksfest zieht jedes Jahr Tausende Besucher an. — The funfair attracts thousands of visitors every year.

hindi: जन शिक्षा केंद्र — वयस्कों के लिए सस्ते शाम के कोर्स देने वाला संस्थान
definition: an adult education centre, the public institution offering affordable evening courses in languages, crafts and hobbies (die Volkshochschule, plural Volkshochschulen)
example: Ich lerne Spanisch an der Volkshochschule. — I am learning Spanish at the adult education centre.

hindi: भरा — जिसमें और जगह न बची हो
definition: full with no room left inside, describing glasses, buses and rooms, also complete when describing hours and success
example: Der Bus ist schon voll. — The bus is already full.

hindi: पूरा करना — किसी काम को उसके अंतिम रूप तक पहुँचाना
definition: to complete or finish something so that it reaches its final and whole form, rather formal (inseparable: vollendet, hat vollendet)
example: Er hat den Roman nach drei Jahren vollendet. — He completed the novel after three years.

hindi: बालिग़ — क़ानूनन वयस्क, अठारह साल का
definition: of legal age, having reached eighteen years and therefore counted as an adult before the law
example: Mit achtzehn ist man in Deutschland volljährig. — At eighteen you are of legal age in Germany.

hindi: पूर्णतया — पूरी तरह, सम्पूर्ण रूप से
definition: completely or perfectly, to the fullest possible degree, also an adjective meaning perfect or flawless
example: Ich bin vollkommen deiner Meinung. — I completely agree with you.

hindi: साबुत अनाज की रोटी — पूरे दाने के आटे से बनी गहरी भारी डबलरोटी
definition: wholegrain bread, the dark dense loaf baked from whole cereal grains that Germans regard as proper healthy bread (das Vollkornbrot, plural Vollkornbrote)
example: Das Vollkornbrot macht lange satt. — The wholegrain bread keeps you full for a long time.

hindi: मुख़्तारनामा — किसी को अपनी ओर से काम करने का लिखित अधिकार
definition: a written power of attorney or authorisation that lets another person act, sign or collect something on your behalf (die Vollmacht, plural Vollmachten)
example: Mit dieser Vollmacht darf meine Schwester das Paket abholen. — With this authorisation my sister may collect the parcel.

hindi: पूर्ण — जिसमें कोई हिस्सा या काग़ज़ छूटा न हो
definition: complete, with nothing missing, said of an application, a set of documents or information that includes every required part
example: Der Antrag ist nur vollständig mit allen Anlagen. — The application is only complete with all attachments.

hindi: पूर्णकालिक — पूरे हफ़्ते के सभी तय घंटों की नौकरी
definition: full-time work, employment for the complete regular weekly hours of a position (die Vollzeit, no plural)
example: Er sucht eine Stelle in Vollzeit. — He is looking for a full-time position.

hindi: आयतन — किसी वस्तु या पात्र की समाई हुई जगह
definition: volume, the amount of three-dimensional space that an object or container occupies, measured in cubic units or litres (das Volumen, plural Volumina)
example: Das Volumen der Flasche ist ein Liter. — The volume of the bottle is one litre.

hindi: से — किसी जगह, व्यक्ति या समय से आया हुआ
definition: from a place, person or starting time, or belonging to someone, often replacing the genitive in speech (preposition, + Dativ)
example: Das Buch ist von meiner Schwester. — The book is from my sister.

hindi: सिर से पाँव तक — पूरी तरह, ऊपर से नीचे तक
definition: from head to foot, describing something completely or thoroughly from top to bottom (adverbial phrase)
example: Sie war von Kopf bis Fuß in Weiß gekleidet. — She was dressed in white from head to toe.

hindi: बिल्कुल नहीं — किसी दावे को झुठलाना
definition: no way, far from it; a colloquial phrase flatly denying a claim someone else has just made
example: Billig? Von wegen, das war richtig teuer. — Cheap? No way, that was really expensive.

hindi: के सामने — किसी चीज़ की अगली ओर; पहले
definition: in front of something, on the near side facing the viewer, also before in time and the word for ago (+ Dativ for location, + Akkusativ for movement)
example: Wir treffen uns vor dem Kino. — We meet in front of the cinema.

hindi: सबसे बढ़कर — सबसे पहले और सबसे ज़रूरी
definition: above all, most importantly; used to highlight the main point or the most significant item among several things
example: Vor allem musst du geduldig sein. — Above all you have to be patient.

hindi: पहले से — मुख्य बात या दस्तावेज़ से पहले, अग्रिम रूप में
definition: in advance or beforehand, used when sending information or a quick answer ahead of the full document or decision
example: Vorab schicke ich Ihnen schon die wichtigsten Zahlen. — In advance I am already sending you the most important figures.

hindi: आगे-आगे — औरों से पहले, आगे निकलकर
definition: ahead or in advance of others, moving in front of a group or being further along than the rest
example: Der Hund lief uns weit voraus. — The dog ran far ahead of us.

hindi: पूर्वकल्पना करना — किसी बात को पहले से मान लेना या अपेक्षित रखना
definition: to presuppose or take for granted, to require something as a precondition before another thing can happen (separable: setzt voraus, hat vorausgesetzt)
example: Die Stelle setzt gute Englischkenntnisse voraus. — The position requires good English skills.

hindi: पूर्वशर्त — किसी बात के लिए पहले से ज़रूरी शर्त
definition: a prerequisite or precondition, something that must already exist before another thing becomes possible (die Voraussetzung, plural Voraussetzungen)
example: Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind eine Voraussetzung für das Studium. — Good German skills are a prerequisite for the degree course.

hindi: पास से गुज़रना — किसी जगह के बगल से होकर चले जाना, या थोड़ी देर को आना
definition: to walk past a place or person, also to drop by briefly, and of time or pain to pass (separable: geht vorbei, ist vorbeigegangen; an + Dativ)
example: Ich gehe jeden Tag an der Bäckerei vorbei. — I walk past the bakery every day.

hindi: तैयारी करना — किसी काम या घटना के लिए पहले से इंतज़ाम करना
definition: to prepare something in advance, or reflexively to get ready for an exam, journey or meeting (separable: bereitet vor, hat vorbereitet; sich vorbereiten auf + Akkusativ)
example: Sie bereitet sich auf die Prüfung vor. — She is preparing for the exam.

hindi: छपा हुआ प्रपत्र — पहले से छपा सरकारी फ़ॉर्म जिसमें खाली जगह भरनी होती है
definition: a preprinted official form with fixed wording and blank spaces that the applicant completes (der Vordruck, plural Vordrucke)
example: Den Vordruck bekommen Sie am Schalter. — You get the preprinted form at the counter.

hindi: पूर्वज — पहले की पीढ़ियों का व्यक्ति जिससे वंश चला
definition: the ancestor, a forebear from an earlier generation from whom a family descends, often spoken of in the plural (der Vorfahr, plural Vorfahren)
example: Unsere Vorfahren kamen aus Polen. — Our ancestors came from Poland.

hindi: पूर्वज — जिसके वंश में कोई जन्मा हो
definition: an ancestor, a person from whom someone is descended, from grandparents back through the generations (der Vorfahre, plural Vorfahren)
example: Meine Vorfahren kamen aus Schlesien. — My ancestors came from Silesia.

hindi: पहले जाने का हक़ — चौराहे पर किस गाड़ी को पहले जाना है
definition: the right of way, the rule deciding which vehicle may proceed first at a crossing (die Vorfahrt, no plural)
example: Hier hat der Radfahrer die Vorfahrt. — The cyclist has the right of way here.

hindi: पूर्वानंद — आने वाली खुशी की प्रतीक्षा का सुख
definition: the pleasure of anticipating something good, frequently sweeter than the awaited occasion itself
example: Half the holiday is the Vorfreude of packing the night before.

hindi: आगे बढ़ना — किसी ढंग से काम करना, या घड़ी का तेज़ चलना
definition: to proceed or act in a certain manner when tackling a task, to walk ahead of others, or of a clock to run fast (separable: geht vor, ist vorgegangen)
example: Wie sollen wir bei diesem Problem vorgehen? — How should we proceed with this problem?

hindi: उच्चाधिकारी — काम पर आपसे ऊपर का व्यक्ति
definition: a superior or line manager, the person above you in the hierarchy at work, formal register (der Vorgesetzte, plural Vorgesetzten)
example: Bitte sprechen Sie zuerst mit Ihrem Vorgesetzten. — Please speak to your superior first.

hindi: परसों (बीता हुआ) — कल से एक दिन पहले
definition: the day before yesterday, two days before today, counting backwards from the present
example: Vorgestern war ich noch krank. — The day before yesterday I was still sick.

hindi: इरादा रखना — कुछ करने की योजना बनाना
definition: to plan or intend to do something, to have arrangements already made for a coming evening, weekend or holiday (separable: hat vor, hat vorgehabt)
example: Was hast du am Wochenende vor? — What are you planning for the weekend?

hindi: पर्दा — खिड़की ढकने का मोटा कपड़ा
definition: a curtain, the heavy cloth hung at a window that is drawn closed to block light and views (der Vorhang, plural Vorhänge)
example: Zieh bitte den Vorhang zu. — Please draw the curtain.

hindi: पहले — किसी बात से पूर्व, उससे पहले
definition: beforehand, before that, earlier than a certain event or action, often used when giving advance notice
example: Ruf bitte vorher an. — Please call beforehand.

hindi: अभी थोड़ी देर पहले — कुछ मिनट या घंटे पूर्व
definition: a little while ago, earlier today, just before the present moment
example: Vorhin hat jemand angerufen. — Someone called a little while ago.

hindi: घटित होना — कोई बात होना या पाई जाना; किसी को कुछ लगना
definition: to occur or happen, to exist and be found somewhere, or to seem a certain way to someone (separable: kommt vor, ist vorgekommen)
example: So ein Fehler kommt leider öfter vor. — Unfortunately such a mistake happens quite often.

hindi: प्रस्तुत करना — जाँच के लिए दस्तावेज़ दिखाना
definition: to present or produce a document for inspection when an office or official asks to see it (separable: legt vor, hat vorgelegt)
example: Sie müssen am Schalter Ihren Ausweis vorlegen. — You must present your identity card at the counter.

hindi: पढ़कर सुनाना — दूसरों के लिए ज़ोर से पढ़ना
definition: to read aloud to someone, typically a parent reading a story to a child at bedtime (separable: liest vor, hat vorgelesen; + Dativ)
example: Papa liest den Kindern ein Märchen vor. — Dad reads a fairy tale aloud to the children.

hindi: व्याख्यान — बड़े हॉल में प्रोफ़ेसर द्वारा दिया जाने वाला पाठ
definition: a university lecture, the large class where a professor speaks to many students in a lecture hall (die Vorlesung, plural Vorlesungen)
example: Die Vorlesung beginnt jeden Montag um acht Uhr. — The lecture starts every Monday at eight o'clock.

hindi: फ़िलहाल, अस्थायी रूप से — अभी के लिए, बाद में बदल सकता है
definition: for the time being, provisionally, temporarily until a final decision or change comes, also an adjective
example: Vorläufig bleibt alles beim Alten. — For the time being everything stays as it was.

hindi: करके दिखाना — किसी को कोई काम करके सिखाना, या धोखा देना
definition: to demonstrate something by doing it first, or colloquially to fool someone with a pretence (separable: macht vor, hat vorgemacht; + Dativ)
example: Der Trainer macht die Übung zuerst vor. — The coach demonstrates the exercise first.

hindi: पिछला किरायेदार — मौजूदा किरायेदार से पहले रहने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the previous tenant, the person who rented the flat before the current occupant (der Vormieter, plural Vormieter)
example: Der Vormieter hat die Küche dagelassen. — The previous tenant left the kitchen behind.

hindi: पूर्वाह्न — सुबह देर से दोपहर तक का समय
definition: the late morning, the part of the day between breakfast time and noon (der Vormittag, plural Vormittage)
example: Am Vormittag habe ich einen Termin beim Arzt. — In the late morning I have a doctor's appointment.

hindi: आगे — सामने के हिस्से में, अगली ओर
definition: at the front or in the forward part of a room, vehicle or queue, the everyday word for the position nearest the entrance or facing side
example: Ich sitze im Bus gern vorne. — I like sitting at the front of the bus.

hindi: उपनगर — बड़े शहर के किनारे बसी रिहायशी बस्ती
definition: a suburb, a residential settlement on the outskirts of a larger city where many commuters live (der Vorort, plural Vororte)
example: Wir wohnen in einem ruhigen Vorort von Berlin. — We live in a quiet suburb of Berlin.

hindi: भंडार — बाद के लिए रखा हुआ खाने या सामान का स्टॉक
definition: a stock or supply, the store of food, fuel or goods kept at home or in a shop for later use (der Vorrat, plural Vorräte)
example: Unser Vorrat an Kaffee ist fast aufgebraucht. — Our supply of coffee is almost used up.

hindi: संकल्प — नए साल पर कुछ बदलने का पक्का इरादा
definition: a resolution, the firm intention to change a habit that people make for the new year (der Vorsatz, plural Vorsätze)
example: Mein Vorsatz für das neue Jahr ist mehr Sport. — My resolution for the new year is more exercise.

hindi: प्रस्ताव — बैठक या चर्चा में रखा गया सुझाव
definition: a suggestion or proposal put forward in a discussion for others to consider and accept or reject (der Vorschlag, plural Vorschläge)
example: Ihr Vorschlag klingt sehr vernünftig. — Your proposal sounds very sensible.

hindi: सुझाव देना — कोई योजना या विचार विचार के लिए सामने रखना
definition: to suggest or propose an idea, plan, date or candidate for other people to consider and discuss (separable: schlägt vor, hat vorgeschlagen)
example: Ich schlage vor, dass wir morgen früh losfahren. — I suggest that we leave early tomorrow.

hindi: नियम — अधिकारी द्वारा तय किया गया विनियम
definition: a regulation or rule laid down by an authority that people must follow, often felt as bureaucratic (die Vorschrift, plural Vorschriften)
example: Die Vorschrift verlangt einen Helm. — The regulation requires a helmet.

hindi: सावधानी — खतरे से बचने के लिए बरती गई सतर्कता
definition: caution or care, the careful attention one takes to avoid danger, often shouted as a warning (die Vorsicht, no plural)
example: Die Vorsicht der Fahrerin verhinderte einen schweren Unfall. — The driver’s caution prevented a serious accident.

hindi: सावधान — खतरे से बचने के लिए सोच-समझकर कदम रखने वाला
definition: careful and cautious, taking care to avoid danger, mistakes or harm (regular adjective)
example: Fahr bitte vorsichtig, die Straße ist glatt. — Please drive carefully, the road is icy.

hindi: रोकथाम — बीमारी से पहले सावधानी और जाँच
definition: preventive care, the checks and precautions taken to catch or avoid illness before it develops (die Vorsorge, no plural)
example: Die Vorsorge ist besser als jede Behandlung. — Prevention is better than any treatment.

hindi: निवारक जाँच — बीमारी से पहले की नियमित स्वास्थ्य जाँच
definition: a preventive check-up, the routine health screening done while a person feels well to catch disease early (die Vorsorgeuntersuchung, plural Vorsorgeuntersuchungen)
example: Die Vorsorgeuntersuchung ist einmal im Jahr. — The preventive check-up is once a year.

hindi: पहला व्यंजन — मुख्य भोजन से पहले परोसा जाने वाला छोटा खाना
definition: a starter or appetizer, the small dish served before the main course of a meal (die Vorspeise, plural Vorspeisen)
example: Die Vorspeise war eine leichte Tomatensuppe. — The starter was a light tomato soup.

hindi: उपनगर — नगर के बाहर सटा हुआ इलाक़ा
definition: a suburb or outer town, the built-up residential district lying just outside the historic centre of a city (die Vorstadt, plural Vorstädte)
example: In der Vorstadt sind die Mieten günstiger. — In the suburbs the rents are cheaper.

hindi: परिचय कराना — किसी को दूसरों से मिलवाना या मन में कल्पना करना
definition: to introduce a person to others by name, and reflexively to imagine or picture something in your mind (separable: stellt vor, hat vorgestellt; sich etwas vorstellen)
example: Darf ich Ihnen meine Kollegin vorstellen? — May I introduce my colleague to you?

hindi: प्रदर्शन या कल्पना — नाटक-फ़िल्म का एक शो; मन में बना विचार भी
definition: a performance or showing of a play or film at a set time, and also an idea or mental picture of something (die Vorstellung, plural Vorstellungen)
example: Die Vorstellung beginnt um halb acht. — The performance begins at half past seven.

hindi: साक्षात्कार — नौकरी के लिए आमने-सामने की बातचीत
definition: a job interview, the meeting where an employer questions a candidate applying for a position (das Vorstellungsgespräch, plural Vorstellungsgespräche)
example: Morgen habe ich ein Vorstellungsgespräch. — Tomorrow I have a job interview.

hindi: पेशगी देना — बाद में लौटाने की शर्त पर पहले पैसा देना
definition: to advance money to someone who will pay it back later, covering a cost on their behalf (separable: streckt vor, hat vorgestreckt)
example: Meine Schwester hat mir das Geld vorgestreckt. — My sister advanced me the money.

hindi: लाभ, फ़ायदा — जो बात किसी को बेहतर स्थिति में रखे
definition: an advantage or benefit, a favourable feature that puts someone in a better position than others (der Vorteil, plural Vorteile)
example: Der Vorteil dieser Wohnung ist die Lage. — The advantage of this flat is the location.

hindi: व्याख्यान — किसी विषय पर श्रोताओं के सामने दिया गया भाषण
definition: a talk or lecture, the prepared speech someone gives to an audience on a particular topic (der Vortrag, plural Vorträge)
example: Der Vortrag über Klimawandel war sehr interessant. — The talk about climate change was very interesting.

hindi: दोष लगाना — किसी पर उसकी ग़लती का आरोप लगाना
definition: to reproach or accuse someone of a fault, to hold something against a person (separable: wirft vor, hat vorgeworfen; + Dativ)
example: Sie wirft ihm vor, nie zuzuhören. — She accuses him of never listening.

hindi: आगे की ओर — सामने की दिशा में बढ़ते हुए
definition: forwards, moving ahead in the direction one is facing, also figuratively making progress
example: Langsam vorwärts, die Straße ist glatt. — Slowly forwards, the road is slippery.

hindi: दिखाना — टिकट या पहचान-पत्र जाँच के लिए प्रस्तुत करना
definition: to show or present a ticket, document or identity card for inspection when asked (separable: zeigt vor, hat vorgezeigt)
example: Bitte zeigen Sie an der Kasse Ihren Ausweis vor. — Please show your identity card at the counter.

hindi: तरजीह देना — दो विकल्पों में एक को बेहतर मानकर चुनना
definition: to prefer one option over another, or to move an appointment to an earlier time (separable: zieht vor, hat vorgezogen)
example: Ich ziehe Tee dem Kaffee vor. — I prefer tea to coffee.

hindi: ज्वालामुखी — लावा और राख उगलने वाला पहाड़
definition: a volcano, a mountain with an opening through which molten lava and ash erupt (der Vulkan, plural Vulkane)
example: Der Vulkan ist seit Jahren ruhig. — The volcano has been quiet for years.

hindi: पूर्णतः — पूरी तरह, बिना किसी कमी के
definition: completely or totally, to the fullest extent with nothing left out, often before adjectives like richtig or falsch
example: Du hast völlig recht. — You are completely right.

hindi: तराज़ू — वज़न तौलने का यंत्र
definition: a scale or balance for weighing, from the bathroom scale at home to the machine in the fruit section where customers weigh loose produce (die Waage, plural Waagen)
example: Leg die Äpfel bitte auf die Waage. — Please put the apples on the scale.

hindi: जागा हुआ — नींद से बाहर, सजग
definition: awake and alert, not sleeping, with eyes open and the mind clear and attentive
example: Bist du schon wach? — Are you awake yet?

hindi: उगना — पौधे, बच्चे या शहर का बढ़ना
definition: to grow, to become larger or taller as a plant, child or town develops over time (irregular: wächst, ist gewachsen)
example: Die Tomaten wachsen dieses Jahr sehr schnell. — The tomatoes are growing very quickly this year.

hindi: विकास या वृद्धि — अर्थव्यवस्था, कंपनी या पौधे का बढ़ना
definition: growth, the increase in size of an economy, company or population, also the growing of a plant or child (das Wachstum, no plural)
example: Das Wachstum der Firma überrascht alle. — The company's growth surprises everyone.

hindi: डगमगाता — हिलता-डुलता, अस्थिर
definition: wobbly, shaky or unsteady, used of rickety chairs, loose ladders and figuratively of shaky finances or health
example: Der Stuhl ist ziemlich wackelig. — The chair is quite wobbly.

hindi: पिंडली — घुटने के नीचे टाँग के पीछे का मांसल हिस्सा
definition: the calf, the fleshy muscular back part of the lower leg below the knee (die Wade, plural Waden)
example: Nachts bekomme ich oft Krämpfe in der Wade. — At night I often get cramps in my calf.

hindi: हथियार — हमला या बचाव करने का औज़ार
definition: a weapon such as a knife or firearm used to attack or defend, strictly regulated by law (die Waffe, plural Waffen)
example: Die Waffe lag unter dem Bett. — The weapon was lying under the bed.

hindi: गाड़ी — मोटर वाहन के लिए थोड़ा औपचारिक शब्द
definition: a motor vehicle or car, the slightly more formal everyday word beside Auto, also a railway carriage (der Wagen, plural Wagen)
example: Mein Wagen ist in der Werkstatt. — My car is at the garage.

hindi: चुनाव — मतदान से प्रतिनिधि या नेता चुनने की प्रक्रिया
definition: an election in which citizens vote to choose their representatives or leaders, also a choice between options (die Wahl, plural Wahlen)
example: Die nächste Wahl findet im September statt. — The next election takes place in September.

hindi: चुनाव प्रचार — चुनाव से पहले वोट पाने की दलों की होड़
definition: the election campaign, the period before an election when parties and candidates compete for votes (der Wahlkampf, plural Wahlkämpfe)
example: Im Wahlkampf hängen überall Plakate. — During the election campaign there are posters everywhere.

hindi: मताधिकार — वोट देने का अधिकार; चुनाव क़ानून भी
definition: the right to vote in elections, and also the body of electoral rules and voting laws of a country (das Wahlrecht, no plural)
example: Das Wahlrecht gilt in Deutschland ab achtzehn Jahren. — In Germany the right to vote applies from the age of eighteen.

hindi: पागलपन; ग़ज़ब — हैरानी से भरी तारीफ़
definition: madness, insanity; shouted alone it is a colloquial reaction of amazement meaning incredible, unbelievable (der Wahnsinn, no plural)
example: Das ist ja der Wahnsinn, was für ein Tor! — That is incredible, what a goal!

hindi: दीवाना — पागल; बोलचाल में बेहद, बहुत ज़्यादा
definition: insane, mad; in everyday speech mostly an intensifier meaning incredibly or extremely
example: Ich habe mich wahnsinnig gefreut. — I was incredibly pleased.

hindi: अनुभव करना, ग्रहण करना — इंद्रियों से कुछ महसूस करना
definition: to perceive something with the senses or to become aware of it, also to attend and keep an appointment (separable: nimmt wahr, hat wahrgenommen)
example: Ich habe den Geruch gar nicht wahrgenommen. — I didn't perceive the smell at all.

hindi: संभवतः — बहुत मुमकिन है कि
definition: probably, likely; expressing that something is more likely than not to be true or to happen
example: Sie kommt wahrscheinlich etwas später. — She will probably come a little later.

hindi: संभावना — किसी घटना के घटने की गणितीय आशंका
definition: probability or likelihood, the measured chance that something will happen, expressed in mathematics as a number between zero and one (die Wahrscheinlichkeit, plural Wahrscheinlichkeiten)
example: Die Wahrscheinlichkeit für Regen liegt bei achtzig Prozent. — The probability of rain is eighty percent.

hindi: जंगल — पेड़ों से घना ढका बड़ा इलाक़ा
definition: a forest, a large area of land densely covered with trees where people walk, hike and gather mushrooms (der Wald, plural Wälder)
example: Wir gehen am Sonntag im Wald spazieren. — We go for a walk in the forest on Sunday.

hindi: वन-एकांत — जंगल में अकेले होने की अनुभूति
definition: the particular solitude of standing alone among trees, half peaceful and half faintly unsettling
example: An hour into the spruce forest the Waldeinsamkeit became almost audible.

hindi: वन-क्षय — अम्ल वर्षा से जंगलों का सूखना
definition: the widespread dieback of trees, blamed on acid rain, that alarmed Germany in the nineteen-eighties
example: Photographs of grey, needleless firs made Waldsterben a household word overnight.

hindi: दीवार — कमरे को घेरने वाली खड़ी सतह
definition: a wall, the vertical inside surface that encloses a room and on which pictures are hung (die Wand, plural Wände)
example: An der Wand hängt ein Bild. — There is a picture hanging on the wall.

hindi: बदलाव — समय के साथ समाज या हालात का धीरे-धीरे बदलना
definition: gradual change or transformation on a large scale, the slow shift in society, climate or times, somewhat formal (der Wandel, no plural)
example: Die Stadt ist im Wandel. — The city is changing.

hindi: भ्रमण-लालसा — घुमक्कड़ी की बेचैन इच्छा
definition: a restless craving to travel, less about arriving anywhere particular than about the leaving itself
example: Two weeks back at his desk and the Wanderlust returned like a fever.

hindi: पैदल घूमना — पहाड़ या जंगल में लंबी सैर पर जाना
definition: to hike, to walk long distances through countryside or mountains for pleasure (ist gewandert)
example: Am Wochenende wandern wir im Schwarzwald. — At the weekend we go hiking in the Black Forest.

hindi: पैदल यात्रा — पहाड़ या जंगल में की गई लंबी सैर
definition: a hike, a long walk through countryside or mountains done for pleasure and exercise (die Wanderung, plural Wanderungen)
example: Die Wanderung zum Gipfel dauert vier Stunden. — The hike to the summit takes four hours.

hindi: पैदल यात्रा मार्ग — चिह्नित लंबी पगडंडी
definition: a hiking trail, a marked footpath through countryside or mountains meant for long walks (der Wanderweg, plural Wanderwege)
example: Der Wanderweg ist gut ausgeschildert. — The hiking trail is well signposted.

hindi: गाल — आँख के नीचे और मुँह के बगल का चेहरे का नरम हिस्सा
definition: the cheek, the soft rounded side of the face below the eye and beside the nose and mouth (die Wange, plural Wangen)
example: Sie gab ihm einen Kuss auf die Wange. — She gave him a kiss on the cheek.

hindi: कब — समय पूछने का प्रश्न
definition: the question word asking about the time or date at which something happens, not to be confused with the conjunction wenn meaning if or whenever
example: Wann beginnt der Film? — When does the film start?

hindi: माल — बेचने का सामान
definition: goods or merchandise, the products a store keeps in stock and offers for sale (die Ware, plural Waren)
example: Die neue Ware kommt morgen früh. — The new goods arrive tomorrow morning.

hindi: गुनगुना — सुखद रूप से गर्म
definition: warm, pleasantly heated without being scorching, also used of cosy clothes, friendly hearts and mild weather (comparative wärmer)
example: Heute ist es angenehm warm draußen. — It is pleasantly warm outside today.

hindi: गर्म पानी से नहाने वाला — आरामपसंद, कमज़ोर और डरपोक व्यक्ति के लिए मज़ाकिया ताना
definition: a joking insult for a soft timid person who avoids hardship and discomfort and always chooses the comfortable option, literally someone who showers warm (der Warmduscher, plural Warmduscher)
example: Ohne Heizung zelten? Nein danke, ich bin ein Warmduscher. — Camping without heating? No thanks, I am a softie.

hindi: पूरा किराया — हीटिंग और अन्य ख़र्च मिलाकर कुल किराया
definition: the total rent including heating and service charges, what actually leaves the tenant's account each month (die Warmmiete, plural Warmmieten)
example: Die Warmmiete ist deutlich höher als die Kaltmiete. — The all-inclusive rent is much higher than the basic rent.

hindi: चेताना — किसी को आने वाले खतरे से पहले सावधान करना
definition: to warn someone, to tell a person about a danger or problem before it happens so they can avoid it (regular: warnt, hat gewarnt, vor + Dativ)
example: Die Polizei warnt vor Glatteis auf den Straßen. — The police are warning of black ice on the roads.

hindi: किसी ख़तरे से आगाह करना — पहले से सावधान करना कि नुक़सान हो सकता है
definition: to warn somebody about a danger, risk or person before harm can happen (+ Akkusativ, vor + Dativ, regular)
example: Der Wetterdienst warnt vor starkem Sturm. — The weather service is warning of a strong storm.

hindi: चेतावनी — आने वाले खतरे की पहले से दी गई सूचना
definition: a warning, a notice or message that tells people about a coming danger so they can protect themselves (die Warnung, plural Warnungen)
example: Der Wetterdienst gab eine Warnung vor Sturm heraus. — The weather service issued a storm warning.

hindi: ज़रा रुको — ध्यान खींचना या टोकना
definition: wait a minute, hang on; a casual phrase that stops someone briefly or signals a sudden thought
example: Warte mal, das stimmt doch gar nicht. — Wait a minute, that is not right at all.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा-पर्ची — दफ़्तर में बारी बताने वाली नंबर वाली पर्ची
definition: a numbered ticket drawn at an office that shows your place in the waiting queue (die Wartemarke, plural Wartemarken)
example: Ziehen Sie bitte zuerst eine Wartemarke. — Please take a queue ticket first.

hindi: किसी का इंतज़ार करना — किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ के आने तक रुके रहना
definition: to wait for somebody or something, staying where you are until the person or thing arrives (auf + Akkusativ, regular)
example: Ich warte seit einer Stunde auf den Bus. — I have been waiting for the bus for an hour.

hindi: प्रतीक्षा कक्ष — क्लिनिक में रोगियों के बारी का इंतज़ार करने का कमरा
definition: a waiting room, the space in a medical practice where patients wait until they are called (das Wartezimmer, plural Wartezimmer)
example: Bitte nehmen Sie im Wartezimmer Platz. — Please take a seat in the waiting room.

hindi: क्यों — कारण पूछने का सबसे आम प्रश्न
definition: the most common question word asking for the reason or cause of something, answered with a clause beginning weil
example: Warum bist du so spät gekommen? — Why did you arrive so late?

hindi: क्या — चीज़ या बात पूछने का प्रश्न
definition: the interrogative pronoun asking about a thing, an action or a matter rather than a person, and colloquially a short form of etwas meaning something
example: Was machst du am Wochenende? — What are you doing at the weekend?

hindi: आपको क्या तकलीफ़ है? — डॉक्टर का पहला सवाल
definition: what seems to be the trouble, the polite formal question a doctor asks a patient about their complaint at the start of a consultation (literally what is missing for you)
example: Guten Tag, was fehlt Ihnen denn? — Good day, what seems to be the trouble?

hindi: किस तरह का / कैसा — प्रकार पूछने का प्रश्न
definition: a fixed question phrase asking what kind of person or thing something is, with only the ein part declining, also used as an exclamation of surprise
example: Was für ein Auto fährst du? — What kind of car do you drive?

hindi: जो हो, छोड़ो — बेपरवाही से मान लेना
definition: whatever, who cares; a shrugging phrase accepting an unwelcome situation and moving on without complaint
example: Der Bus ist weg, was soll's. — The bus is gone, whatever.

hindi: चिलमची — हाथ-मुँह धोने का दीवार पर लगा नलवाला पात्र
definition: a washbasin or sink, the bowl fixed to a bathroom wall with a tap for washing hands and face (das Waschbecken, plural Waschbecken)
example: Das Waschbecken ist verstopft. — The washbasin is blocked.

hindi: नक़ाबपोश भालू-सा जानवर — काले मुखौटे जैसे चेहरे वाला जीव जो खाना पानी में धोता दिखता है
definition: a raccoon, the grey masked animal with a striped tail that seems to wash its food in water, literally a washing bear (der Waschbär, plural Waschbären)
example: Ein Waschbär hat nachts unsere Mülltonne geplündert. — A raccoon raided our rubbish bin at night.

hindi: धोना — पानी और साबुन से कपड़े या शरीर साफ़ करना
definition: to wash clothes, dishes, hands or hair with water and soap in order to clean them (irregular: wäscht, hat gewaschen)
example: Ich wasche die Handtücher bei sechzig Grad. — I wash the towels at sixty degrees.

hindi: कपड़े धोने की मशीन — बिजली से कपड़े धोने वाली घरेलू मशीन
definition: a washing machine, the electric household appliance that washes clothes, sheets and towels automatically (die Waschmaschine, plural Waschmaschinen)
example: Die Waschmaschine läuft schon seit einer Stunde. — The washing machine has been running for an hour already.

hindi: कपड़े धोने का साबुन — मशीन में डाला जाने वाला पाउडर या तरल
definition: laundry detergent, the powder or liquid soap added to the washing machine to clean clothes (das Waschmittel, plural Waschmittel)
example: Wir brauchen neues Waschmittel für die Buntwäsche. — We need new detergent for the coloured laundry.

hindi: झरना — ऊँचाई से गिरती पानी की धारा
definition: a waterfall, a stream of water plunging over a cliff or steep rocky drop (der Wasserfall, plural Wasserfälle)
example: Der Wasserfall ist fast fünfzig Meter hoch. — The waterfall is almost fifty metres tall.

hindi: नल — पानी खोलने-बंद करने की टोंटी
definition: a tap or faucet, the fitting on a sink or bath that is turned to let water flow (der Wasserhahn, plural Wasserhähne)
example: Der Wasserhahn tropft die ganze Nacht. — The tap drips all night.

hindi: केतली — पानी झटपट उबालने वाला बिजली का बर्तन
definition: the electric kettle, the small appliance that boils water quickly for tea, coffee or cooking (der Wasserkocher, plural Wasserkocher)
example: Der Wasserkocher ist schon fertig. — The kettle is already done.

hindi: जल ऊर्जा — बहते पानी की ताक़त से बनी बिजली
definition: hydropower, electricity produced by flowing or falling water turning turbines in a dam or river (die Wasserkraft, no plural)
example: Die Wasserkraft liefert in den Bergen viel Strom. — Hydropower supplies a lot of electricity in the mountains.

hindi: जलसतह मापी — बुलबुले से समतल जाँचने वाला औज़ार
definition: a spirit level, the tool with a bubble in liquid that shows whether a surface is perfectly horizontal (die Wasserwaage, plural Wasserwaagen)
example: Prüf mit der Wasserwaage, ob das Regal gerade hängt. — Check with the level whether the shelf hangs straight.

hindi: जालपृष्ठ — अंतरजाल पर खोलकर पढ़ा जाने वाला पन्ना
definition: a website or web page, a location on the internet that people open in a browser to read information or use a service (die Webseite, plural Webseiten)
example: Die Webseite lädt sehr langsam. — The website loads very slowly.

hindi: बाकी पैसे — भुगतान के बाद लौटाए गए पैसे
definition: the change handed back at the till when a customer pays with more money than the price (das Wechselgeld, no plural)
example: Der Kassierer gibt mir das Wechselgeld zurück. — The cashier gives me back the change.

hindi: बदलता रहने वाला — कभी धूप कभी बारिश वाला मौसम
definition: changeable, describing unsettled weather that switches between sunshine, clouds and showers within a single day
example: Im April ist das Wetter oft wechselhaft. — In April the weather is often changeable.

hindi: विनिमय दर — एक मुद्रा के बदले दूसरी मुद्रा की कीमत
definition: the exchange rate, the value of one currency expressed in another currency when money is exchanged (der Wechselkurs, plural Wechselkurse)
example: Der Wechselkurs für den Dollar ist heute günstig. — The exchange rate for the dollar is favourable today.

hindi: बदलना — पैसे को दूसरी मुद्रा या छोटे नोटों में बदलना
definition: to change money into another currency or to break a large note into smaller ones (regular)
example: Können Sie mir hundert Euro in Rupien wechseln? — Can you change a hundred euros into rupees for me?

hindi: जगाना — सोते हुए किसी को नींद से उठाना
definition: to wake someone else up, to rouse a sleeping person from their sleep (regular: weckt, hat geweckt)
example: Kannst du mich morgen um sieben wecken? — Can you wake me tomorrow at seven?

hindi: अलार्म घड़ी — सोते व्यक्ति को जगाने के लिए बजने वाली छोटी घड़ी
definition: an alarm clock, the small clock that rings to wake a sleeping person in the morning (der Wecker, plural Wecker)
example: Der Wecker klingelt um halb sieben. — The alarm clock rings at half past six.

hindi: न — दोनों विकल्पों को नकारने वाली जोड़ी का पहला शब्द
definition: neither; the first half of the pair weder ... noch that denies both of two alternatives
example: Er trinkt weder Kaffee noch Tee. — He drinks neither coffee nor tea.

hindi: न इधर का न उधर का — अस्पष्ट, बिना साफ़ पहचान वाला
definition: something that belongs to no clear category, neither one thing nor the other, indecisive or half-hearted
example: Der Vorschlag ist weder Fisch noch Fleisch, niemand versteht ihn. — The proposal is neither fish nor fowl, nobody understands it.

hindi: रास्ता — एक जगह से दूसरी जगह तक का मार्ग
definition: a way, path or route leading from one place to another, both the physical track and the journey taken along it (der Weg, plural Wege)
example: Kennen Sie den Weg zum Bahnhof? — Do you know the way to the station?

hindi: रास्ते का विवरण — कहीं पहुँचने के निर्देश
definition: directions, a spoken or written description of the route to follow to reach a place (die Wegbeschreibung, plural Wegbeschreibungen)
example: Können Sie mir eine Wegbeschreibung zum Hotel schicken? — Can you send me directions to the hotel?

hindi: नहीं आना — किसी जगह या कार्यक्रम से दूर रहना
definition: to stay away from a place or event, to remain absent or not come home (separable: bleibt weg, ist weggeblieben)
example: Warum bist du gestern vom Unterricht weggeblieben? — Why did you stay away from class yesterday?

hindi: ले जाकर छोड़ना — कोई चीज़ या व्यक्ति कहीं और पहुँचा देना
definition: to take something or someone away to another place, such as rubbish to the bin or a child to school (separable: bringt weg, hat weggebracht)
example: Ich bringe schnell den Müll weg. — I will quickly take the rubbish out.

hindi: के कारण — किसी वजह या सबब से
definition: because of, owing to the stated reason or cause of something that happens (preposition, + Genitiv, colloquially + Dativ)
example: Wegen des Staus kam sie zu spät. — Because of the traffic jam she arrived late.

hindi: गाड़ी से निकल जाना — वाहन में सवार होकर दूर चले जाना
definition: to drive away or leave a place by vehicle, often to go on a trip or holiday (separable: fährt weg, ist weggefahren)
example: Wir fahren über Ostern für eine Woche weg. — We are going away for a week over Easter.

hindi: समाप्त हो जाना — कोई शुल्क, नियम या नौकरी का हट जाना
definition: to cease to apply or be dropped, said of fees, rules, jobs or scheduled classes (separable: fällt weg, ist weggefallen)
example: Die Gebühr fällt ab nächstem Jahr weg. — The fee is dropped from next year.

hindi: चले जाना — किसी जगह से निकल जाना या बाहर घूमने जाना
definition: to leave a place and walk away, or colloquially to go out for the evening with friends (separable: geht weg, ist weggegangen)
example: Sie ist ohne ein Wort weggegangen. — She left without a word.

hindi: छोड़ देना — किसी हिस्से या चीज़ को शामिल न करना
definition: to leave something out or omit a part, ingredient, word or detail deliberately from a whole (separable: lässt weg, hat weggelassen)
example: Du kannst den letzten Satz ruhig weglassen. — You can safely leave out the last sentence.

hindi: भाग जाना — किसी जगह या व्यक्ति से दूर दौड़ जाना
definition: to run away or flee from a place, person or problem, leaving quickly on foot, running off (separable: läuft weg, ist weggelaufen)
example: Der Hund ist heute Morgen weggelaufen. — The dog ran away this morning.

hindi: छीन लेना — किसी से कोई चीज़ हटाकर या ज़बरन ले लेना
definition: to take something away from someone, often against their wishes, like removing a toy from a child (separable: nimmt weg, hat weggenommen, + Dativ)
example: Der große Bruder nimmt ihm immer das Spielzeug weg. — The big brother always takes the toy away from him.

hindi: हटाकर रखना — रास्ते से सामान उठाकर उसकी जगह रखना
definition: to clear something away out of the way, putting dishes, toys or tools back in their places (separable: räumt weg, hat weggeräumt)
example: Räum bitte das Geschirr vom Tisch weg. — Please clear the dishes off the table.

hindi: भेज देना — किसी को दूर भेजना या डाक रवाना करना
definition: to send someone away without helping them, or to dispatch a letter or parcel somewhere else (separable: schickt weg, hat weggeschickt)
example: Der Arzt hat den Patienten ohne Rezept weggeschickt. — The doctor sent the patient away without a prescription.

hindi: नज़र फेरना — किसी अप्रिय चीज़ से आँखें हटाना
definition: to look away from something unpleasant, also figuratively to ignore a wrong that one ought to notice (separable, irregular: sieht weg, hat weggesehen)
example: Bei der Spritze habe ich lieber weggesehen. — I preferred to look away during the injection.

hindi: फेंक देना — बेकार चीज़ को कचरे में डालना
definition: to throw something away into the rubbish because it is broken, spoiled or no longer needed (separable: wirft weg, hat weggeworfen)
example: Wirf die alten Zeitungen bitte weg. — Please throw the old newspapers away.

hindi: मीठी उदासी — बीती सुंदरता की कोमल टीस
definition: gentle sorrow tinted with sweetness, the mood left behind by something lovely and finished
example: She packed the last box with more Wehmut than regret.

hindi: दर्द करना — किसी अंग में पीड़ा होना
definition: to hurt or ache, said of a body part that causes pain to its owner (separable: tut weh, hat wehgetan; + Dativ)
example: Mir tut der Hals weh. — My throat hurts.

hindi: मुलायम, नरम — दबाने पर आसानी से दब जाए
definition: soft, yielding easily when pressed and pleasant to touch, describing a pillow, fresh bread, fur or a gentle voice
example: Das Kissen ist schön weich. — The pillow is nice and soft.

hindi: नरम अंडा — कमज़ोर, डरपोक और आरामपसंद व्यक्ति के लिए ताना
definition: a colloquial insult for a weak timid person without toughness who complains about small discomforts and avoids every challenge, literally a soft egg (das Weichei, plural Weicheier)
example: Sei kein Weichei, das Wasser ist gar nicht kalt! — Do not be a wimp, the water is not cold at all!

hindi: चरागाह — पशुओं के चरने की घास वाली ज़मीन
definition: a pasture, a grassy field where cattle, sheep or horses graze in the open (die Weide, plural Weiden)
example: Die Kühe stehen den ganzen Tag auf der Weide. — The cows stand in the pasture all day.

hindi: क्रिसमस — पच्चीस दिसंबर का ईसाई त्योहार और उसकी छुट्टियाँ
definition: Christmas, the festival on the twenty-fifth of December and the family holidays around it (das Weihnachten, plural Weihnachten, usually used without an article)
example: Weihnachten feiern wir bei meiner Oma. — We celebrate Christmas at my grandmother's.

hindi: क्रिसमस का पेड़ — घर में सजाया जाने वाला देवदार का पेड़
