definition: the Christmas tree, a decorated evergreen fir placed inside the house during the festive holiday season (der Weihnachtsbaum, plural Weihnachtsbäume)
example: Der Weihnachtsbaum steht schon im Wohnzimmer. — The Christmas tree is already standing in the living room.

hindi: बड़े दिन का समारोह — दफ़्तर या क्लब की सालाना उत्सव भोज
definition: a Christmas party, the festive gathering an office, club or school holds in December with food and drinks (die Weihnachtsfeier, plural Weihnachtsfeiern)
example: Die Weihnachtsfeier der Firma ist am Freitag. — The company Christmas party is on Friday.

hindi: क्रिसमस की हंस — त्योहार के भोज पर भूनी जाने वाली हंस
definition: the Christmas goose, the roasted bird served with red cabbage and dumplings at the festive holiday dinner (die Weihnachtsgans, plural Weihnachtsgänse)
example: Die Weihnachtsgans braucht vier Stunden im Ofen. — The Christmas goose needs four hours in the oven.

hindi: क्रिसमस गीत — त्योहार पर गाया जाने वाला पारंपरिक गाना
definition: a Christmas carol, a traditional festive song sung at church, around the tree or at the Christmas market (das Weihnachtslied, plural Weihnachtslieder)
example: Wir singen jedes Jahr dasselbe Weihnachtslied. — We sing the same Christmas carol every year.

hindi: उपहार लाने वाले बाबा — लाल कपड़ों वाला दाढ़ी वाला बूढ़ा जो बड़े दिन पर तोहफ़े लाता है
definition: the figure of Father Christmas, the bearded old man in a red coat who brings the presents in northern Germany (der Weihnachtsmann, plural Weihnachtsmänner)
example: Der Weihnachtsmann kommt heute Abend. — Father Christmas is coming this evening.

hindi: क्रिसमस बाज़ार — दिसंबर में शहर के चौक पर सजने वाला खुला बाज़ार
definition: the Christmas market, an open-air fair of wooden stalls in the town square selling mulled wine, sweets and handmade gifts throughout December (der Weihnachtsmarkt, plural Weihnachtsmärkte)
example: Auf dem Weihnachtsmarkt trinken wir einen Glühwein. — We drink a mulled wine at the Christmas market.

hindi: क्योंकि — कारण बताने वाला रोज़मर्रा का शब्द, क्रिया वाक्य के अंत में जाती है
definition: because, the everyday subordinating conjunction that gives the reason for something and sends the verb to the end of its clause
example: Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil es regnet. — I am staying at home because it is raining.

hindi: थोड़ी देर — कुछ समय की अनिश्चित अवधि
definition: a while, an unspecified stretch of time that is neither very short nor very long (die Weile, no plural)
example: Wir haben eine Weile gewartet. — We waited for a while.

hindi: पुरवा या टोला — गाँव से भी छोटी, कुछ घरों की बस्ती
definition: a hamlet, a tiny rural settlement of only a handful of houses and farms, smaller than a village and without its own church (der Weiler, plural Weiler)
example: Der Weiler besteht aus vier Bauernhöfen. — The hamlet consists of four farms.

hindi: अंगूरी शराब — अंगूर के रस से बनी लाल या सफ़ेद मदिरा
definition: wine, the alcoholic drink made from fermented grapes, served red, white or rosé by the glass or bottle (der Wein, plural Weine)
example: Zum Essen trinken wir einen trockenen Wein. — With the meal we drink a dry wine.

hindi: रोना — दुःख या पीड़ा में आँसू बहाना
definition: to cry or weep, to shed tears from sadness, pain or sometimes overwhelming happiness (regular: hat geweint)
example: Das Baby weint die ganze Nacht. — The baby cries all night.

hindi: ढीला — शरीर से दूर, खुला और चौड़ा
definition: loose or wide, said of clothes that hang with plenty of room, also meaning far in distance (weit, weiter, am weitesten)
example: Der Pullover ist schön weit und bequem. — The sweater is nice and loose and comfortable.

hindi: आगे — और दूर, रुके बिना आगे बढ़ते हुए
definition: further or onward, continuing ahead to a more distant point or keeping going without stopping
example: Der Bus fährt weiter bis zum Flughafen. — The bus goes on as far as the airport.

hindi: आगे की शिक्षा — नौकरी के दौरान कौशल बढ़ाने का प्रशिक्षण
definition: further training or professional development, courses taken to improve skills while already working (die Weiterbildung, plural Weiterbildungen)
example: Die Firma bezahlt die Weiterbildung. — The company pays for the further training.

hindi: आगे बढ़ते रहना — रुकने के बाद फिर चलना, या क्रम जारी रहना
definition: to continue walking or move on after a stop, also of a story or process to carry on (separable: geht weiter, ist weitergegangen)
example: Nach der Pause gehen wir weiter. — After the break we carry on walking.

hindi: अग्रेषित करना — मिला हुआ संदेश किसी और को भेज देना
definition: to forward an email, message or call to another person who should receive or handle it (separable: leitet weiter, hat weitergeleitet, an + Akkusativ)
example: Ich leite Ihre Anfrage an die zuständige Abteilung weiter. — I am forwarding your enquiry to the responsible department.

hindi: जारी रखना — रुके बिना काम आगे बढ़ाते रहना
definition: to carry on, keep going or continue with what one is doing, everyday and informal (separable: macht weiter, hat weitergemacht)
example: Macht ruhig weiter, ich komme gleich. — Carry on, I'll be right there.

hindi: फैला हुआ — बड़े क्षेत्र में विस्तृत
definition: extensive or sprawling over a large area, describing parks, estates and buildings, also distant when describing relatives
example: Das Gelände ist weitläufig. — The grounds are extensive.

hindi: गेहूँ — सफ़ेद आटे और बीयर का मुख्य अनाज
definition: wheat, the cereal grain milled into white flour for bread, rolls and pasta, also the base of Bavarian wheat beer (der Weizen, no plural)
example: Der Weizen steht hoch auf dem Feld. — The wheat stands tall in the field.

hindi: सफ़ेद — बर्फ़ और दूध का रंग
definition: white, the lightest colour with no shade, the colour of snow, milk and fresh paper
example: Die Wände sind weiß gestrichen. — The walls are painted white.

hindi: सफ़ेद डबलरोटी — मैदे से बनी हल्की नरम रोटी
definition: white bread, the light soft loaf made from refined wheat flour, seen in Germany as a treat rather than daily bread (das Weißbrot, plural Weißbrote)
example: Das Weißbrot ist schon trocken. — The white bread is already dry.

hindi: कौन-सा — कई में से चुनने का प्रश्न
definition: an interrogative determiner or pronoun asking which one out of a known set of people or things, declined like the definite article (welche, welches, welchen)
example: Welcher Bus fährt zum Bahnhof? — Which bus goes to the railway station?

hindi: मुरझाना — पानी बिना फूल या पत्ती का सूखकर झुकना
definition: to wilt or wither, to droop and dry up as a flower or leaf does when it lacks water (regular: welkt, ist gewelkt)
example: Ohne Wasser welken die Blumen schnell. — Without water the flowers wilt quickly.

hindi: लहर — पानी की सतह पर उठती-गिरती तरंग
definition: a wave, a moving ridge of water rolling across the surface of the ocean or a lake (die Welle, plural Wellen)
example: Eine große Welle rollt an den Strand. — A large wave rolls onto the beach.

hindi: पिल्ला — कुत्ते का छोटा बच्चा
definition: a puppy, a young dog only a few weeks or months old, still playful and clumsy while it learns (der Welpe, plural Welpen)
example: Der Welpe kaut an meinem Schuh. — The puppy is chewing on my shoe.

hindi: विश्वदृष्टि — जगत को समझने का समूचा वैचारिक ढाँचा
definition: the whole framework of beliefs through which a person or a culture interprets existence and history
example: Two economists shared one dataset and still disagreed, each reading it through a different Weltanschauung.

hindi: विश्वयुद्ध — कई महाद्वीपों में फैला बड़ा युद्ध
definition: a world war, a global armed conflict involving many countries across several continents (der Weltkrieg, plural Weltkriege)
example: Mein Urgroßvater kämpfte im Ersten Weltkrieg. — My great-grandfather fought in the First World War.

hindi: जगत-वेदना — दुनिया की अपूर्णता से उपजा विषाद
definition: world-weary sadness at the distance between how existence is and how it decently ought to be
example: He read the morning headlines and sank into a familiar Weltschmerz.

hindi: मोड़ — बड़ा बदलाव; १९८९-९० का पूर्वी जर्मनी का शांतिपूर्ण परिवर्तन
definition: a turning point or major change, and specifically the peaceful revolution of 1989 that ended communist rule in East Germany (die Wende, plural Wenden)
example: Nach der Wende zog die Familie nach Hamburg. — After the 1989 political turnaround, the family moved to Hamburg.

hindi: पलटना — किसी चीज़ का दूसरा पहलू ऊपर करना, गाड़ी मोड़ना
definition: to turn something over to its other side, like a pancake or a page, or to turn a vehicle around in the street (hat gewendet; sich wenden an + Akkusativ: to approach someone)
example: Wende das Fleisch nach drei Minuten. — Turn the meat over after three minutes.

hindi: थोड़ा — छोटी मात्रा या संख्या में
definition: little or few, describing a small, scant quantity or amount of something, less than one would expect or need
example: Wir haben nur wenig Zeit. — We have only little time.

hindi: कम से कम तो — चलो इतना तो हुआ
definition: at least, at any rate; consoling that even a small positive thing remains in a disappointing situation
example: Wenigstens scheint die Sonne. — At least the sun is shining.

hindi: अगर, जब — शर्त या समय बताने वाला मूल शब्द
definition: if, when, whenever; the basic conjunction for conditions and for repeated or future times, verb at the end
example: Wenn du Zeit hast, ruf mich an. — If you have time, call me.

hindi: कौन — व्यक्ति की पहचान का प्रश्न
definition: the interrogative pronoun asking about the identity of a person, changing its form by case (Akkusativ wen, Dativ wem, Genitiv wessen)
example: Wer hat heute Geburtstag? — Whose birthday is it today?

hindi: कौन जाने — अनिश्चित भविष्य पर टिप्पणी
definition: who knows; a shrugging remark that something uncertain might still happen and nobody can tell
example: Wer weiß, vielleicht klappt es doch noch. — Who knows, maybe it will still work out.

hindi: विज्ञापन-झलकी — टीवी या रेडियो पर आने वाला छोटा प्रचार
definition: a commercial, the short advertising clip broadcast on television, radio or online between programmes (der Werbespot, plural Werbespots)
example: Der Werbespot läuft vor jeder Sendung. — The commercial runs before every programme.

hindi: विज्ञापन — किसी चीज़ को बेचने के लिए प्रचार
definition: advertising or an advertisement, the paid promotion of products shown on television, printed or displayed to persuade people to purchase (die Werbung, plural Werbungen)
example: Die Werbung im Fernsehen nervt mich. — The advertising on television annoys me.

hindi: बनना — किसी अवस्था में बदल जाना; भविष्य बताने वाली सहायक क्रिया
definition: to become or turn into something, and also the auxiliary verb that builds the future tense and the passive voice (irregular: wird, wurde, ist geworden)
example: Meine Schwester wird Ärztin. — My sister is becoming a doctor.

hindi: फेंकना — हाथ से किसी चीज़ को हवा में उछालना
definition: to throw or toss something through the air with the hand, as with a ball or a stone (wirft, warf, hat geworfen)
example: Die Kinder werfen Steine ins Wasser. — The children are throwing stones into the water.

hindi: मरम्मत की दुकान — गाड़ियाँ ठीक करने का गैराज
definition: a workshop or garage where mechanics repair and service vehicles, also any craft workshop (die Werkstatt, plural Werkstätten)
example: Das Auto muss morgen in die Werkstatt. — The car has to go to the garage tomorrow.

hindi: कार्यदिवस — सोमवार से शनिवार तक का काम वाला दिन
definition: a working day, any weekday from Monday to Saturday that is not a Sunday or public holiday (der Werktag, plural Werktage)
example: Das Paket kommt am nächsten Werktag. — The parcel arrives on the next working day.

hindi: औज़ार — मरम्मत या बनाने के काम आने वाला हाथ का उपकरण
definition: a tool, any hand-held instrument such as a hammer, pliers or screwdriver used for repairs and building work (das Werkzeug, plural Werkzeuge)
example: Ohne das richtige Werkzeug geht das nicht. — Without the right tool that will not work.

hindi: औज़ारों का डिब्बा — हथौड़ा, पेचकस आदि रखने का बक्सा
definition: a toolbox, the sturdy box in which hammers, screwdrivers, pliers and screws are stored together (der Werkzeugkasten, plural Werkzeugkästen)
example: Der Werkzeugkasten steht unter der Treppe. — The toolbox is under the stairs.

hindi: मान — नापी गई संख्या या किसी चीज़ का मूल्य
definition: a value, the number that a measurement or calculation produces, also the worth, price or importance of something (der Wert, plural Werte)
example: Der Wert liegt über dem Normalbereich. — The value lies above the normal range.

hindi: मूल्य-निरपेक्षता — शोध में अपनी मान्यताएँ न घुसाने का आदर्श
definition: the ideal that scholarship should describe the world without smuggling the scholar's own values into it
example: Weber demanded Wertfreiheit in the lecture hall and passionate conviction outside it.

hindi: मूलभूत — जो सारतः महत्वपूर्ण हो, या काफ़ी अधिक
definition: essential or substantial, belonging to the core of a matter, also used before comparatives meaning considerably
example: Der neue Plan ist wesentlich besser als der alte. — The new plan is considerably better than the old one.

hindi: किस कारण / क्यों — औपचारिक कारण-प्रश्न
definition: a somewhat formal question word asking for the reason of something, also used as a relative word meaning for which reason or which is why
example: Weshalb ist der Zug ausgefallen? — For what reason was the train cancelled?

hindi: ततैया — डंक मारने वाला पीला-काला कीट
definition: a wasp, the yellow and black stinging insect that hovers around cake and drinks in late summer (die Wespe, plural Wespen)
example: Eine Wespe sitzt auf meinem Kuchen. — A wasp is sitting on my cake.

hindi: किसका — स्वामित्व पूछने का प्रश्न
definition: the genitive question word asking to whom something belongs, placed directly before the noun and slightly formal in spoken German
example: Wessen Jacke liegt hier auf dem Stuhl? — Whose jacket is lying here on the chair?

hindi: पश्चिम — दिक्सूचक की पश्चिमी दिशा, जहाँ सूरज डूबता है
definition: the west, the compass direction where the sun sets, also the western region of a country (der Westen, no plural)
example: Der Wind kommt heute aus dem Westen. — The wind is coming from the west today.

hindi: किस वजह से — कारण पूछने का शब्द
definition: a question word asking on account of what or because of which reason something happened, interchangeable with weshalb and slightly more formal than warum
example: Weswegen bist du beim Arzt gewesen? — What did you go to the doctor for?

hindi: प्रतिस्पर्धा — बाज़ार में कंपनियों की होड़; कोई प्रतियोगिता
definition: competition between companies fighting for the same customers in a market, also a contest in which people or firms compete for a prize (der Wettbewerb, plural Wettbewerbe)
example: Der Wettbewerb im Handel wird immer härter. — Competition in retail keeps getting tougher.

hindi: मौसम — किसी दिन की हवा, धूप, बारिश की हालत
definition: the weather, the state of the atmosphere on a given day with its sunshine, rain, wind and temperature (das Wetter, plural Wetter)
example: Das Wetter ist heute richtig schön. — The weather is really nice today.

hindi: मौसम समाचार — रेडियो-टीवी पर मौसम की रिपोर्ट
definition: the weather report, the short forecast broadcast after the news on radio or television (der Wetterbericht, plural Wetterberichte)
example: Nach den Nachrichten kommt der Wetterbericht. — After the news comes the weather report.

hindi: बिन गरज बिजली — क्षितिज पर दूर कौंधती चमक
definition: distant lightning that flickers along the horizon with no thunder audible from where you stand
example: We sat on the balcony watching the Wetterleuchten over the hills, waiting for rain that never came.

hindi: मौसम का पलटना — अचानक मौसम में बड़ा बदलाव
definition: a sudden change in the weather, an abrupt swing from warm sunshine to cold rain or the reverse (der Wetterumschwung, plural Wetterumschwünge)
example: Der Wetterumschwung kam über Nacht. — The change in the weather came overnight.

hindi: मौसम का पूर्वानुमान — आने वाले दिनों के मौसम की भविष्यवाणी
definition: the weather forecast, the official prediction of coming sunshine, rain or storms for the next days (die Wettervorhersage, plural Wettervorhersagen)
example: Die Wettervorhersage verspricht Regen am Wochenende. — The weather forecast promises rain at the weekend.

hindi: प्रतियोगिता — खिलाड़ियों के बीच जीत के लिए मुक़ाबला
definition: a competition or contest, the organised sporting event where athletes compete against each other for victory (der Wettkampf, plural Wettkämpfe)
example: Der Wettkampf findet am Sonntag statt. — The competition takes place on Sunday.

hindi: गुप्त उपहार खेलना — समूह में लॉटरी से एक-दूसरे को छोटे तोहफ़े देना
definition: to play secret Santa, to exchange small anonymous presents within a group after drawing names by lot (regular)
example: Im Büro wichteln wir jedes Jahr vor Weihnachten. — At the office we play secret Santa every year before Christmas.

hindi: पोतड़ा बदलना — शिशु को साफ़ करके नया पोतड़ा लगाना, शब्दार्थ लपेटना
definition: to change a baby's nappy, literally to wrap, the everyday verb for the whole routine of cleaning and rediapering an infant (regular: hat gewickelt)
example: Ich muss das Baby noch wickeln, bevor wir losfahren. — I still have to change the baby before we leave.

hindi: घिनौना — मन को घृणा से भर देने वाला
definition: repulsive, loathsome, disgusting; describes a smell, taste or behaviour that revolts someone
example: Ich finde sein Verhalten widerlich. — I find his behaviour repulsive.

hindi: विरोध जताना — किसी की बात के विपरीत बोलना
definition: to contradict someone or object to what they said, stating the opposite view or disagreeing openly (irregular: widerspricht, hat widersprochen; + Dativ)
example: Ich muss Ihnen leider widersprechen. — I unfortunately have to contradict you.

hindi: आपत्ति — सरकारी फ़ैसले के ख़िलाफ़ लिखित विरोध, या विरोधाभास
definition: a formal objection or appeal lodged in writing against an official decision within a deadline, also a logical contradiction (der Widerspruch, plural Widersprüche)
example: Gegen den Bescheid habe ich Widerspruch eingelegt. — I lodged an objection against the decision.

hindi: कैसे / कितना — ढंग, हाल या मात्रा का प्रश्न
definition: the question word asking about manner, condition or degree, used for asking how somebody is, how something works and how old or large a thing is, and also meaning as or like in comparisons
example: Wie geht es dir heute? — How are you today?

hindi: जो भी हो — बात बदलने या समेटने का जुमला
definition: anyway, however that may be; a phrase that closes a topic or waves aside details before moving on
example: Wie auch immer, wir müssen jetzt losfahren. — Anyway, we have to leave now.

hindi: क्या कहा — विनम्रता से दोहराने की विनती
definition: the polite request to repeat something not heard or understood, the courteous form of what
example: Wie bitte? Können Sie das wiederholen? — Pardon? Could you repeat that?

hindi: कैसे हो — अनौपचारिक हालचाल पूछना
definition: the informal question asking how someone is doing, the usual opener of small talk; formally 'Wie geht es Ihnen'
example: Hallo Tom, wie geht's? — Hi Tom, how are you?

hindi: कुत्ते-बिल्ली की तरह — हमेशा लड़ते-झगड़ते रहने वाले दो लोग
definition: describes two people who constantly quarrel and cannot get along, fighting like natural enemies
example: Die beiden Geschwister vertragen sich wie Hund und Katze. — The two siblings get along like cat and dog.

hindi: मैं कैसे पहुँचूँ — रास्ता पूछने का विनम्र वाक्य
definition: how do I get to, the polite question a learner asks a stranger when looking for a street, station or building (+ Dativ: Wie komme ich zum Bahnhof?)
example: Entschuldigung, wie komme ich zum Rathaus? — Excuse me, how do I get to the town hall?

hindi: कितना / कितने — मात्रा या संख्या का प्रश्न
definition: the two word question phrase asking about an amount or quantity, with wie viele before countable plural nouns and wie viel before uncountable ones
example: Wie viel kostet das Ticket? — How much does the ticket cost?

hindi: फिर से, दोबारा — एक बार और
definition: again, once more, another time after something has already happened before, extremely common in speech
example: Kannst du das bitte wieder sagen? — Can you please say that again?

hindi: पुनर्निर्माण — नष्ट हुए शहरों और देश को फिर खड़ा करना
definition: reconstruction, the rebuilding of destroyed cities, industry and public life after a war or disaster (der Wiederaufbau, no plural)
example: Der Wiederaufbau der Stadt dauerte viele Jahre. — The reconstruction of the city took many years.

hindi: दोहराना — कही गई बात फिर से कहना
definition: to repeat something that was said or done, or to revise material you have already learned for an exam (regular: wiederholt, hat wiederholt; inseparable)
example: Können Sie das bitte wiederholen? — Could you please repeat that?

hindi: पुनर्मिलन — विभाजित देश के दो भागों का फिर एक होना
definition: reunification, the joining together of two divided parts of a country, above all Germany in October 1990 (die Wiedervereinigung, plural Wiedervereinigungen)
example: Die Wiedervereinigung wird jedes Jahr am dritten Oktober gefeiert. — Reunification is celebrated every year on the third of October.

hindi: फिर से उपयोग में लाना — बेकार सामग्री को दोबारा काम का बनाना
definition: to reuse or recycle material, to make waste useful again by processing it into something new (separable: verwertet wieder, hat wiederverwertet)
example: Glas lässt sich unendlich oft wiederverwerten. — Glass can be recycled endlessly.

hindi: तौलना — तराज़ू पर वज़न जानना
definition: to weigh, to find how heavy something is on a scale, or to have a particular weight as a person or object (wiegt, hat gewogen)
example: Das Baby wiegt schon fünf Kilo. — The baby already weighs five kilos.

hindi: घास का मैदान — फूलों और घास से ढकी खुली ज़मीन
definition: a meadow, an open grassy field with wildflowers where cattle graze or people picnic (die Wiese, plural Wiesen)
example: Die Kinder spielen auf der Wiese hinter dem Haus. — The children play in the meadow behind the house.

hindi: क्यों / कैसे भला — हैरानी भरा कारण-प्रश्न
definition: a colloquial question word asking for the reason behind something, close to warum but often carrying a note of surprise or mild challenge
example: Wieso hast du mich nicht angerufen? — Why did you not call me?

hindi: जंगली प्रदेश — इंसानी बस्ती से दूर अछूता इलाक़ा
definition: wilderness, a wild untamed region far from roads and settlements where nature rules alone (die Wildnis, plural Wildnisse)
example: In der Wildnis gibt es keine Straßen. — In the wilderness there are no roads.

hindi: जंगली सूअर — जंगल का काला बालों वाला दाँतदार सूअर
definition: a wild boar, the dark bristly forest pig with tusks that roots through the ground at night (das Wildschwein, plural Wildschweine)
example: Ein Wildschwein hat den Garten umgegraben. — A wild boar has dug up the garden.

hindi: जंगली जानवर — प्रकृति में आज़ाद रहने वाला पशु
definition: a wild animal that lives freely in nature rather than in a home or on a farm (das Wildtier, plural Wildtiere)
example: Das Wildtier darf man nicht füttern. — The wild animal must not be fed.

hindi: इच्छाशक्ति — कुछ करने या पाने का दृढ़ संकल्प
definition: the will and determination to accomplish or achieve something, the firm intention standing behind a decision or effort (der Wille, no plural)
example: Wo ein Wille ist, ist auch ein Weg. — Where there is a will, there is a way.

hindi: बरौनी — आँख की पलक के किनारे उगने वाला छोटा बाल
definition: an eyelash, one of the short hairs growing along the edge of the eyelid that protect the eye (die Wimper, plural Wimpern)
example: Eine Wimper ist mir ins Auge geraten. — An eyelash has got into my eye.

hindi: हवा — बहती हुई वायु
definition: wind, moving air that blows across the land and sea and pushes clouds, leaves and sails (der Wind, plural Winde)
example: Der Wind kommt heute aus dem Westen. — The wind is coming from the west today.

hindi: पोतड़ा — शिशु की कमर पर बाँधा जाने वाला सोखने वाला कपड़ा या पैड
definition: a nappy or diaper, the absorbent pad wrapped around a baby's bottom that has to be changed several times daily (die Windel, plural Windeln)
example: Die Windel ist voll, ich wechsle sie schnell. — The nappy is full, I will change it quickly.

hindi: हवादार — जहाँ तेज़ हवा चल रही हो
definition: windy, describing a day or a place where the wind blows strongly and constantly
example: Am Strand ist es heute sehr windig. — It is very windy on the beach today.

hindi: पवन ऊर्जा — हवा की शक्ति से बनी बिजली
definition: wind power, electricity generated by the force of moving air turning large turbines (die Windkraft, no plural)
example: Die Windkraft liefert im Norden den meisten Strom. — Wind power supplies most of the electricity in the north.

hindi: पवन चक्की — बिजली बनाने वाला ऊँचा घूमता पंखा
definition: a wind turbine, the tall tower with rotating blades that produces electricity from the wind (das Windrad, plural Windräder)
example: Hinter dem Dorf stehen zehn neue Windräder. — Behind the village stand ten new wind turbines.

hindi: कोण — दो रेखाओं के मिलने से बना झुकाव, डिग्री में नापा
definition: an angle, the opening formed where two lines or surfaces meet, measured in degrees, also a quiet corner of a room or town (der Winkel, plural Winkel)
example: Ein rechter Winkel hat neunzig Grad. — A right angle has ninety degrees.

hindi: हाथ हिलाना — अभिवादन या विदा में हाथ लहराना
definition: to wave the hand as a greeting or farewell or to beckon someone, never to wink an eye (regular: hat gewinkt)
example: Das Kind winkt dem Zug hinterher. — The child waves after the train.

hindi: सर्दी की ऋतु — साल का सबसे ठंडा, बर्फ़ वाला समय
definition: winter, the coldest season of the year with short days, frost and often snow (der Winter, plural Winter)
example: Im Winter schneit es hier oft. — In winter it often snows here.

hindi: नन्हा — बहुत ही छोटा, अति सूक्ष्म
definition: tiny or minute in size, much smaller than normal, the common everyday word for something very small indeed
example: Die Wohnung ist winzig. — The flat is tiny.

hindi: हम — बोलने वाला और उसके साथी
definition: the first person plural pronoun meaning the speaker together with other people, used for families, teams, couples and whole groups (Akkusativ und Dativ uns)
example: Wir fahren am Wochenende in die Berge. — We are driving to the mountains at the weekend.

hindi: रीढ़ की हड्डी — पीठ के बीच से गुज़रती जुड़ी हड्डियों की कड़ी
definition: the spine or backbone, the column of small bones running down the middle of the back (die Wirbelsäule, plural Wirbelsäulen)
example: Die Wirbelsäule sollte beim Heben gerade bleiben. — The spine should stay straight when lifting.

hindi: सचमुच — वाक़ई, असल में
definition: really, truly, genuinely; confirming that something is actually the case or intensifying an adjective
example: Das Essen schmeckt wirklich gut. — The food really tastes good.

hindi: मधुशाला-मालिक — शराबघर या सराय चलाने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: the landlord or innkeeper, the person who runs a tavern, pub or inn and often serves guests himself (der Wirt, plural Wirte)
example: Der Wirt kennt jeden Gast beim Namen. — The landlord knows every guest by name.

hindi: अर्थव्यवस्था — देश का उत्पादन और व्यापार का पूरा तंत्र; छोटा भोजनालय
definition: the economy, the whole system of production, trade and money in a country, also a small traditional tavern or restaurant (die Wirtschaft, plural Wirtschaften)
example: Die Wirtschaft wächst in diesem Jahr langsam. — The economy is growing slowly this year.

hindi: आर्थिक चमत्कार — युद्ध के बाद की तेज़ आर्थिक प्रगति
definition: the economic miracle, the rapid postwar growth of the West German economy in the 1950s (das Wirtschaftswunder, plural Wirtschaftswunder)
example: Mein Opa erlebte das Wirtschaftswunder als junger Mann. — My grandpa lived through the economic miracle as a young man.

hindi: पारंपरिक मधुशाला — बीयर और भारी खाना मिलने वाला बवेरियाई भोजनालय
definition: a traditional tavern serving beer and hearty food, the word heard mostly in Bavaria and Austria (das Wirtshaus, plural Wirtshäuser)
example: Das alte Wirtshaus liegt direkt am Dorfplatz. — The old tavern is right on the village square.

hindi: पोंछना — गीले कपड़े या पोछे से फ़र्श या सतह साफ़ करना
definition: to wipe or mop a floor, table or other surface with a damp cloth or mop, mopping and wiping away dust and spills (regular)
example: Ich wische jeden Freitag den Küchenboden. — I mop the kitchen floor every Friday.

hindi: पोछा — फ़र्श पोंछने का लंबे डंडे वाला औज़ार
definition: a mop, the long-handled mopping tool with an absorbent head used to wash floors with water (der Wischmopp, plural Wischmopps)
example: Der Wischmopp muss nach dem Putzen trocknen. — The mop has to dry after cleaning.

hindi: जानना — किसी तथ्य या बात की जानकारी होना
definition: to know a fact or piece of information, to have certain knowledge about something learned (irregular: weiß, wusste, hat gewusst)
example: Weißt du, wann der Zug fährt? — Do you know when the train leaves?

hindi: विज्ञान — ज्ञान की व्यवस्थित खोज और अध्ययन
definition: science or scholarship, the organised pursuit of knowledge through research and academic study (die Wissenschaft, plural Wissenschaften)
example: Sie will später in der Wissenschaft arbeiten. — She wants to work in academia later.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक — विज्ञान में शोध करने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a scientist or scholar, a person who does professional research in a scientific field at a university or institute (der Wissenschaftler, plural Wissenschaftler)
example: Der Wissenschaftler erklärt seine Ergebnisse. — The scientist explains his results.

hindi: वैज्ञानिक — शोध और विज्ञान से जुड़ा
definition: scientific or academic, relating to research, evidence and the careful methods of scholarship at universities (regular adjective)
example: Die Hausarbeit muss wissenschaftlich geschrieben sein. — The term paper must be written academically.

hindi: विधवा — जिसका पति मर चुका हो
definition: the widow, a woman whose husband has died and who has not married again, often living alone afterwards (die Witwe, plural Witwen)
example: Die Witwe lebt allein in dem großen Haus. — The widow lives alone in the large house.

hindi: विधुर — जिसकी पत्नी मर चुकी हो
definition: the widower, a man whose wife has died and who has not married again, often living alone afterwards (der Witwer, plural Witwer)
example: Der Witwer besucht jede Woche das Grab seiner Frau. — The widower visits his wife's grave every week.

hindi: हाज़िरजवाब — तीखे और चतुर मज़ाक करने वाला
definition: witty and funny, quick with clever jokes and remarks that make people laugh
example: Ihre Kommentare sind immer sehr witzig. — Her comments are always very witty.

hindi: बेतार अंतरजाल — घर या होटल में बिना तार का अंतरजाल संपर्क
definition: wireless internet, the radio network that connects phones and laptops to the internet in homes, cafés and hotels; Germans say this instead of Wi-Fi (das WLAN, plural WLANs)
example: Wie lautet das Passwort für das WLAN? — What is the password for the wireless network?

hindi: कहाँ — किस जगह पर, यह पूछने का शब्द
definition: where, the basic question word asking at what place or location something is or happens
example: Wo ist der nächste Bahnhof? — Where is the nearest station?

hindi: किसी और जगह — बोलचाल में कहीं और
definition: somewhere else, at another place, the everyday spoken word for a different location than this one
example: Das Restaurant war voll, wir essen woanders. — The restaurant was full, we will eat somewhere else.

hindi: हालाँकि, जिसमें — कही बात में टिप्पणी या छोटा सुधार जोड़ना
definition: whereby, although; a conjunction adding a remark or small correction to what was just said
example: Das Essen war gut, wobei die Suppe kalt war. — The food was good, although the soup was cold.

hindi: सप्ताह — सोमवार से रविवार तक के सात दिन
definition: a week, the period of seven days running from Monday through Sunday, the usual unit for planning work and school (die Woche, plural Wochen)
example: In der nächsten Woche habe ich Urlaub. — Next week I am on holiday.

hindi: सप्ताहांत — शनिवार और रविवार, काम से छुट्टी के दिन
definition: the weekend, Saturday and Sunday, the days free from work and school at the close of the week (das Wochenende, plural Wochenenden)
example: Am Wochenende schlafen wir lange. — At the weekend we sleep late.

hindi: साप्ताहिक बाज़ार — खुले में फल-सब्ज़ी की मंडी
definition: a weekly open-air market where farmers and traders sell fresh vegetables, fruit, cheese and flowers (der Wochenmarkt, plural Wochenmärkte)
example: Auf dem Wochenmarkt ist das Gemüse frischer. — The vegetables are fresher at the weekly market.

hindi: सप्ताह का दिन — सोमवार से रविवार में से कोई एक दिन
definition: a day of the week, any one of the seven named days, or a working day as opposed to the weekend (der Wochentag, plural Wochentage)
example: Der Mittwoch ist für mich der anstrengendste Wochentag. — Wednesday is the most tiring weekday for me.

hindi: किसके लिए / किस बात के लिए — उद्देश्य या पात्र का प्रश्न
definition: a question word asking for what purpose or on behalf of what thing something is done or spent, formed from wo plus the preposition für
example: Wofür hast du das ganze Geld ausgegeben? — What did you spend all the money on?

hindi: कहाँ से — किस जगह से आया हुआ
definition: where from, asking about the origin or starting point of a movement or person, the question word for coming from somewhere
example: Woher kommst du gerade? — Where are you coming from just now?

hindi: कहाँ को — किस जगह की ओर, किधर
definition: where to, asking about the destination or direction of a movement, the question word for going somewhere
example: Wohin fährt dieser Bus? — Where does this bus go?

hindi: शायद, संभवतः — सोच-समझकर लगाया गया अनुमान जताने वाला शब्द
definition: a particle that marks a statement as a probable assumption rather than certain knowledge, roughly presumably or surely
example: Sie ist wohl schon zu Hause. — She's probably home already.

hindi: कुशलक्षेम — तन-मन के भले और सुखी होने का भाव
definition: a general feeling of physical comfort and mental contentment, the sense of being well in body and spirit (das Wohlbefinden, no plural)
example: Regelmäßiger Schlaf steigert das Wohlbefinden. — Regular sleep improves your wellbeing.

hindi: रहना — किसी जगह अपना घर होना
definition: to live or reside somewhere, to have one's home at a particular place or address (regular: hat gewohnt; in + Dativ)
example: Wir wohnen seit zwei Jahren in Hamburg. — We have lived in Hamburg for two years.

hindi: रहने का क्षेत्रफल — किराये के लिए नापी गई फ़्लैट की जगह
definition: the living area, the floor space of a flat measured in square metres for rent purposes (die Wohnfläche, plural Wohnflächen)
example: Die Wohnfläche beträgt siebzig Quadratmeter. — The living area is seventy square metres.

hindi: आवास भत्ता — कम आय वालों को किराये के लिए सरकारी सहायता
definition: housing benefit, the state subsidy paid to low-income households towards their rent (das Wohngeld, no plural)
example: Das Wohngeld hilft ihr bei der Miete. — The housing benefit helps her with the rent.

hindi: साझा फ़्लैट — कई लोगों का मिलकर किराए पर रहना
definition: a shared flat, the arrangement where several people, typically students, rent an apartment together and share kitchen and bathroom (die Wohngemeinschaft, plural Wohngemeinschaften)
example: Ich suche ein Zimmer in einer Wohngemeinschaft. — I am looking for a room in a shared flat.

hindi: छात्रावास — छात्रों के लिए सस्ते कमरों वाला आवास भवन
definition: a hall of residence, the building with small cheap rooms where students live during their studies (das Wohnheim, plural Wohnheime)
example: Im ersten Semester wohnte ich im Wohnheim. — In my first semester I lived in the hall of residence.

hindi: आवास — बड़ी इमारत के भीतर रहने के कमरों का एक हिस्सा
definition: a flat or apartment, a set of rooms for living in within a larger residential building (die Wohnung, plural Wohnungen)
example: Die Wohnung hat drei Zimmer und einen Balkon. — The flat has three rooms and a balcony.

hindi: बैठक — घर का वह कमरा जहाँ परिवार बैठता और मेहमानों से मिलता है
definition: the living room, the main room of a home where the family relaxes, watches television and receives guests (das Wohnzimmer, plural Wohnzimmer)
example: Wir sitzen abends im Wohnzimmer und lesen. — In the evening we sit in the living room and read.

hindi: भेड़िया — झुंड में शिकार करने वाला जंगली कुत्ते जैसा जानवर
definition: a wolf, the wild grey animal related to the dog that hunts in packs and howls at night (der Wolf, plural Wölfe)
example: Der Wolf heult nachts in den Bergen. — The wolf howls in the mountains at night.

hindi: बादल — आसमान में तैरता जलवाष्प का पुंज
definition: a cloud, a visible mass of water droplets floating in the sky that can bring shade or rain (die Wolke, plural Wolken)
example: Am Himmel ist keine einzige Wolke. — There is not a single cloud in the sky.

hindi: बादल फटना — बहुत भारी, अचानक मूसलाधार बारिश
definition: a cloudburst, an extremely violent downpour of rain that floods streets within a few minutes (der Wolkenbruch, plural Wolkenbrüche)
example: Nach dem Wolkenbruch stand die Straße unter Wasser. — After the cloudburst the street was under water.

hindi: गगनचुंबी इमारत — बादलों को छूती-सी बहुत ऊँची मीनार-भवन
definition: a skyscraper, an extremely tall building of very many storeys that dominates a city skyline (der Wolkenkratzer, plural Wolkenkratzer)
example: In Frankfurt stehen die höchsten Wolkenkratzer Deutschlands. — Germany's tallest skyscrapers stand in Frankfurt.

hindi: निरभ्र — बिना किसी बादल का साफ़ आसमान
definition: cloudless, describing a perfectly clear sky with full sunshine and not a single cloud
example: Ein wolkenloser Himmel begrüßte uns am Morgen. — A cloudless sky greeted us in the morning.

hindi: ऊन — भेड़ के बालों से बना गरम रेशा
definition: wool, the warm natural fibre from sheep used for sweaters, scarves and winter coats (die Wolle, no plural)
example: Die Wolle kratzt ein bisschen auf der Haut. — The wool itches a little on the skin.

hindi: चाहना — किसी चीज़ की पक्की इच्छा रखना
definition: to want or intend to do something with firm resolve, the modal verb of will and intention (irregular: will, wollte, hat gewollt)
example: Wir wollen im Sommer nach Italien fahren. — We want to travel to Italy in summer.

hindi: किससे / किस चीज़ से — साधन का प्रश्न
definition: a question word asking with what tool, means or thing something is done, formed from wo plus the preposition mit, also used as a relative word
example: Womit hast du die Wand gestrichen? — What did you paint the wall with?

hindi: शब्द-भंडार — किसी व्यक्ति या भाषा के जाने हुए शब्दों का समूह
definition: vocabulary, the whole stock of words that a person knows or a language contains, literally a treasure of words (der Wortschatz, plural Wortschätze)
example: Mit jedem Buch wächst mein deutscher Wortschatz. — With every book my German vocabulary grows.

hindi: किस बारे में — विषय पूछने का शब्द
definition: a question word asking about the topic of a talk, laugh or complaint, formed from wo plus the preposition über and also used as a relative word
example: Worüber habt ihr so lange gesprochen? — What did you talk about for so long?

hindi: किसलिए / किस मक़सद से — उद्देश्य का प्रश्न
definition: a question word asking about the purpose or goal of an action, what something is meant for, formed from wo plus the preposition zu
example: Wozu brauchst du so viele Kartons? — What do you need so many boxes for?

hindi: घाव — कटी या फटी त्वचा की जगह
definition: a wound, the open bleeding cut or torn place in the skin caused by an injury (die Wunde, plural Wunden)
example: Die Wunde muss sauber bleiben. — The wound must stay clean.

hindi: चमत्कार — प्रकृति के नियमों से परे अद्भुत घटना
definition: a miracle, an astonishing event that seems to defy natural laws and is attributed to divine power (das Wunder, plural Wunder)
example: Es ist ein Wunder, dass er überlebt hat. — It is a miracle that he survived.

hindi: अद्भुत — बहुत सुंदर या सुखद, मन को छू लेने वाला
definition: wonderful, marvellous, lovely; warm praise for something delightful, beautiful or deeply pleasing
example: Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Abend zusammen. — We had a wonderful evening together.

hindi: विलक्षण बालक — असमय प्रतिभा दिखाने वाला किशोर
definition: a young person whose talent arrives decades early, in music, chess, mathematics, or business
example: At nineteen she was the firm's Wunderkind; at thirty, simply very good at her job.

hindi: भरवाँ गोश्त — मसालेदार कीमे से भरी आँत, जर्मन खान-पान की पहचान
definition: sausage, the seasoned minced meat stuffed into a casing, whether fresh for grilling or sliced cold for bread, the great German food institution (die Wurst, plural Würste)
example: Die Wurst liegt im Kühlschrank. — The sausage is in the fridge.

hindi: जड़ — पौधे का ज़मीन के अंदर वाला हिस्सा
definition: a root, the underground part of a plant or tree that anchors it and draws water from the soil (die Wurzel, plural Wurzeln)
example: Ich bin über eine Wurzel gestolpert. — I tripped over a root.

hindi: क्रोध — उबलता हुआ तेज़ गुस्सा
definition: rage or fury, the hot violent anger that boils up inside and wants to lash out (die Wut, no plural)
example: Die Wut über den Fehler verging schnell. — The anger about the mistake passed quickly.

hindi: गुस्से का दौरा — बच्चे का चीखते-लोटते ज़िद करना; बड़े का क्रोध-विस्फोट भी
definition: a tantrum or fit of rage, a child screaming and kicking on the supermarket floor, also an adult's outburst (der Wutanfall, plural Wutanfälle)
example: An der Kasse bekam die Kleine einen Wutanfall. — At the checkout the little girl had a tantrum.

hindi: चुनना — मतदान करना या कई विकल्पों में से एक को पसंद करना
definition: to vote in an election, or to choose someone or something from among several options (regular, hat gewählt)
example: Ich habe gestern zum ersten Mal gewählt. — I voted yesterday for the first time.

hindi: मतदाता — चुनाव में वोट डालने का हक़ रखने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a voter, a person entitled to cast a ballot in an election and choose representatives (der Wähler, plural Wähler)
example: Der Wähler entscheidet am Sonntag über die neue Regierung. — The voter decides on the new government on Sunday.

hindi: जबकि, के दौरान — दो बातों का एक साथ होना
definition: while, during; a conjunction stating that two things happen at the same time (also a preposition with Genitiv)
example: Während ich koche, deckt er den Tisch. — While I cook, he sets the table.

hindi: उसी दौरान, इस बीच — जब वह हो रहा हो
definition: during that time, in the meantime while the other action is going on, marking two things happening together
example: Ich koche, und du kannst währenddessen den Tisch decken. — I will cook, and meanwhile you can set the table.

hindi: मुद्रा — किसी देश का पैसा, जैसे यूरो या रुपया
definition: a currency, the system of money used in a particular country, such as the euro or the rupee (die Währung, plural Währungen)
example: Der Euro ist die Währung in Deutschland. — The euro is the currency in Germany.

hindi: धुलाई के कपड़े — धोने या धुले हुए कपड़ों का ढेर
definition: laundry, the clothes, sheets and towels that need washing or have just been washed, also the washing process itself (die Wäsche, no plural)
example: Die Wäsche hängt noch auf dem Balkon. — The laundry is still hanging on the balcony.

hindi: कपड़े की चिमटी — रस्सी पर कपड़े पकड़कर रखने वाली छोटी क्लिप
definition: a clothes peg or clothespin, the small wooden or plastic clip that holds washed clothes onto the clothesline (die Wäscheklammer, plural Wäscheklammern)
example: Mir fehlen noch drei Wäscheklammern für die Hemden. — I am still missing three clothes pegs for the shirts.

hindi: कपड़े सुखाने की रस्सी — धुले कपड़े टाँगने की तनी हुई डोरी
definition: a clothesline, the stretched cord or wire on which washed laundry is hung outside or on a balcony to dry (die Wäscheleine, plural Wäscheleinen)
example: Die Wäscheleine ist zwischen zwei Bäumen gespannt. — The clothesline is stretched between two trees.

hindi: साप्ताहिक — हर हफ़्ते होने वाला
definition: weekly, happening or done once every week on a regular basis
example: Wir haben ein wöchentliches Treffen im Büro. — We have a weekly meeting in the office.

hindi: चाहना — किसी चीज़ की इच्छा या कामना करना
definition: to wish for something or desire that it happen, also used when wishing someone luck or a pleasant day (regular, sich etwas wünschen + Dativ)
example: Ich wünsche dir viel Glück bei der Prüfung. — I wish you good luck in the exam.

hindi: घन, पासा — छह बराबर चौकोर फलकों वाला ठोस या खेल का पासा
definition: a cube, a solid shape with six equal square faces, also the numbered dice thrown in board games (der Würfel, plural Würfel)
example: Schneide den Käse in kleine Würfel. — Cut the cheese into small cubes.

hindi: पासा फेंकना — खेल में पासा लुढ़काना
definition: to roll the dice, to throw dice in a game, also to cut food into cubes (regular: hat gewürfelt)
example: Du bist dran, würfel mal! — It is your turn, roll the dice!

hindi: छोटा भरवाँ गोश्त — गरम पानी में गरम की गई पतली धुँआ लगी भरवाँ आँत
definition: a small thin sausage, especially the smoked frankfurter type heated in hot water and served with potato salad or in a roll (das Würstchen, plural Würstchen)
example: An Heiligabend essen viele Würstchen mit Kartoffelsalat. — On Christmas Eve many people eat sausages with potato salad.

hindi: मसाला डालना — नमक, मिर्च या मसालों से स्वाद देना
definition: to season food with salt, pepper, herbs or spices so that it gains flavour (regular: würzt, hat gewürzt)
example: Würze das Gemüse mit Salz und Pfeffer. — Season the vegetables with salt and pepper.

hindi: रेगिस्तान — बहुत कम बारिश वाला सूखा रेतीला प्रदेश
definition: a desert, a dry barren region of sand or rock where almost no rain falls (die Wüste, plural Wüsten)
example: In der Wüste ist es nachts sehr kalt. — In the desert it is very cold at night.

hindi: क्रोधित — तेज़ गुस्से से भरा
definition: furious or enraged, filled with hot violent anger toward someone or something that went wrong
example: Der Kunde war wütend über die lange Wartezeit. — The customer was furious about the long wait.

hindi: संख्या — गिनती या नाप बताने वाला अंक
definition: a number, the abstract figure used in counting, arithmetic and statistics, whether written in digits or spoken aloud (die Zahl, plural Zahlen)
example: Bitte schreiben Sie die Zahl in Worten. — Please write the number in words.

hindi: चुकाना — रेस्तराँ में खाने का दाम देना
definition: to pay for something, especially to settle the bill in a restaurant, where the single word alone calls the waiter (regular: hat gezahlt)
example: Ich zahle mit Karte, bitte. — I am paying by card, please.

hindi: अनेक — बड़ी संख्या में, कई सारे
definition: numerous, describing a large number of people or things, somewhat more formal than viele and common in written German
example: Zahlreiche Besucher kamen zur Ausstellung. — Numerous visitors came to the exhibition.

hindi: भुगतान — चुकाई गई रकम या उसे चुकाने की क्रिया
definition: a payment, the act of paying money that is owed or the sum that is transferred to settle a bill (die Zahlung, plural Zahlungen)
example: Die Zahlung ist noch nicht eingegangen. — The payment has not arrived yet.

hindi: दाँत — मुँह में कठोर सफ़ेद टुकड़ा जिससे चबाते हैं
definition: a tooth, one of the hard white bony pieces in the mouth used for biting and chewing food (der Zahn, plural Zähne)
example: Der Zahn muss leider gezogen werden. — Unfortunately the tooth has to be pulled.

hindi: दंत चिकित्सक — दाँतों और मसूड़ों का इलाज करने वाला
definition: a dentist, the medical professional who examines, cleans, repairs and treats teeth and gums (der Zahnarzt, plural Zahnärzte)
example: Beim Zahnarzt habe ich immer Angst. — At the dentist I am always scared.

hindi: मसूड़े — दाँतों के आसपास का गुलाबी मांस
definition: the gums, the pink soft tissue around the teeth inside the mouth that bleeds when brushed too hard, literally tooth flesh (das Zahnfleisch, no plural)
example: Mein Zahnfleisch blutet beim Zähneputzen. — My gums bleed when I brush my teeth.

hindi: सँड़सी — तार या छोटी चीज़ें पकड़ने, मोड़ने या काटने का औज़ार
definition: pliers or tongs, the hinged gripping tool used to hold, bend or cut wire and small parts (die Zange, plural Zangen)
example: Mit der Zange ziehe ich den alten Nagel heraus. — With the pliers I pull the old nail out.

hindi: पैसा — बोलचाल में माल, रोकड़
definition: money or cash in old-fashioned colloquial slang, spoken with a wink about wealth and earnings among friends (der Zaster, no plural)
example: Der ganze Zaster ist schon wieder weg. — All the money is already gone again.

hindi: बाड़ के पीछे का दर्शक — बिना टिकट या बिना बुलावे दूर से तमाशा देखने वाला
definition: an onlooker who watches an event from outside without a ticket or invitation, an uninvited spectator, literally a guest at the fence (der Zaungast, plural Zaungäste)
example: Viele Zaungäste verfolgten das Konzert vom Hügel aus. — Many onlookers followed the concert from the hill.

hindi: पैदल पार-पथ — सड़क पर सफ़ेद धारियों से बना वह स्थान जहाँ पैदल लोग सड़क पार करें
definition: a pedestrian crossing marked with broad white stripes across the road where cars must stop for walkers (der Zebrastreifen, plural Zebrastreifen)
example: Bitte geh nur am Zebrastreifen über die Straße. — Please cross the street only at the zebra crossing.

hindi: पैर की उँगली — पैर के अगले सिरे पर पाँच छोटे अंगों में से एक
definition: a toe, one of the five small movable digits at the front end of the human foot that help with balance and walking (die Zehe, plural Zehen)
example: Ich habe mir die große Zehe gestoßen. — I stubbed my big toe.

hindi: दस — गिनती की दसवीं संख्या
definition: the cardinal number ten, the round decimal figure after nine used for counting fingers, euros, minutes and people in ordinary conversation
example: Das kostet nur zehn Euro. — That costs only ten euros.

hindi: चित्र-सजीव चलचित्र — बनाए हुए चित्रों को चलाकर बनी बच्चों की पसंदीदा फ़िल्म
definition: an animated cartoon film made from drawn or computer-generated pictures rather than live actors (der Zeichentrickfilm, plural Zeichentrickfilme)
example: Die Kinder lieben diesen alten Zeichentrickfilm. — The children love this old cartoon film.

hindi: रेखांकन करना — पेंसिल से आकृति खींचना
definition: to draw, to make pictures with lines using pencil, pen or charcoal (regular: hat gezeichnet)
example: Er zeichnet jeden Tag in seinem Skizzenbuch. — He draws every day in his sketchbook.

hindi: रेखाचित्र — पेंसिल या स्याही से बनाया चित्र
definition: a drawing, a picture made with pencil, pen, chalk or charcoal rather than with paint (die Zeichnung, plural Zeichnungen)
example: Die Zeichnung zeigt einen alten Mann am Fenster. — The drawing shows an old man at the window.

hindi: काल — किसी प्रमुख लक्षण से पहचाना जाने वाला लंबा युग
definition: an age or era of history named after its defining feature, such as the industrial or digital age (das Zeitalter, plural Zeitalter)
example: Wir leben im digitalen Zeitalter. — We live in the digital age.

hindi: समय की खिड़की — किसी काम के लिए तय सीमित अवधि
definition: a time window or time slot, the limited period during which something must happen or a delivery arrives, literally a window of time (das Zeitfenster, plural Zeitfenster)
example: Das Zeitfenster für die Lieferung ist zwischen neun und zwölf. — The delivery window is between nine and twelve.

hindi: युगधर्म — किसी काल की साझा मनोदशा और मान्यताएँ
definition: the shared mood and unexamined assumptions of a period, visible only once that period has ended
example: Nothing dates a film faster than its confidence about the Zeitgeist.

hindi: धीमी गति का दृश्य — फ़िल्म में क्रिया को धीमा करके दिखाना
definition: slow motion, the filming technique that shows movement much slower than real speed, literally a time magnifier (die Zeitlupe, plural Zeitlupen)
example: Das Tor wurde noch einmal in Zeitlupe gezeigt. — The goal was shown again in slow motion.

hindi: समय की तंगी — काम पूरा करने के लिए बहुत कम वक़्त बचने की स्थिति
definition: shortage of time when a deadline presses, used in chess for the frantic minutes when a player's clock runs low (die Zeitnot, no plural)
example: Kurz vor der Abgabe geriet sie in Zeitnot. — Shortly before the deadline she ran short of time.

hindi: समय-बिंदु — किसी घटना का ठीक वक़्त
definition: a point in time, the particular moment at which something happens or is planned to happen (der Zeitpunkt, plural Zeitpunkte)
example: Der Zeitpunkt für das Gespräch ist schlecht. — The timing for the conversation is bad.

hindi: पत्रिका — नियमित छपने वाली सचित्र या विषय-विशेष की मैगज़ीन
definition: a magazine or periodical, the glossy publication appearing weekly or monthly with articles on one field or interest (die Zeitschrift, plural Zeitschriften)
example: Sie hat eine Zeitschrift über Gartenarbeit abonniert. — She has subscribed to a magazine about gardening.

hindi: अख़बार — रोज़ या हफ़्ते में छपने वाला समाचार-पत्र
definition: a newspaper, the printed daily or weekly publication carrying news reports, articles and advertisements (die Zeitung, plural Zeitungen)
example: Mein Vater liest jeden Morgen die Zeitung. — My father reads the newspaper every morning.

hindi: समय काटने का साधन — खाली वक़्त भरने वाला हल्का शौक
definition: a pastime, a light leisure activity that pleasantly fills empty hours without serious purpose (der Zeitvertreib, plural Zeitvertreibe)
example: Kreuzworträtsel sind sein liebster Zeitvertreib. — Crossword puzzles are his favourite pastime.

hindi: समय-साक्षी — जिसने ऐतिहासिक घटना खुद देखी हो
definition: a contemporary witness, a person who lived through a historic event and can tell about it first hand (der Zeitzeuge, plural Zeitzeugen)
example: Ein Zeitzeuge erzählte den Schülern vom Mauerfall. — A contemporary witness told the pupils about the fall of the Wall.

hindi: कोठरी — जेल या थाने का छोटा बंद कमरा
definition: a cell, the small locked room where a prisoner is held in a jail or police station, also a biological cell (die Zelle, plural Zellen)
example: Er verbrachte die Nacht in einer Zelle. — He spent the night in a cell.

hindi: तंबू — कपड़े और डंडों से बना अस्थायी घर, जिसमें बाहर सोते हैं
definition: a tent, a portable shelter made of cloth stretched over poles that campers sleep under outdoors (das Zelt, plural Zelte)
example: Wir haben das Zelt neben dem Fluss aufgebaut. — We pitched the tent beside the river.

hindi: तंबू में रहना — छुट्टी में खुले में डेरा डालना
definition: to camp in a tent, to spend nights outdoors under canvas while on holiday (regular: hat gezeltet)
example: Wir zelten dieses Jahr direkt am See. — This year we are camping right by the lake.

hindi: जोड़ने वाला चूर्ण — पानी से जमने वाला धूसर चूर्ण जो रेत और बजरी को बाँधता है
definition: cement, the grey powder that hardens with water and binds concrete and mortar together (der Zement, plural Zemente)
example: Der Zement wird mit Wasser und Sand gemischt. — The cement is mixed with water and sand.

hindi: सेंटीमीटर — मीटर का सौवाँ हिस्सा
definition: a centimetre, one hundredth of a metre, the small unit of length used for body height, clothing sizes and measurements at home (der Zentimeter, plural Zentimeter)
example: Das Bild hängt einen Zentimeter zu tief. — The picture hangs one centimetre too low.

hindi: केंद्र — किसी शहर या चीज़ का मध्य बिंदु
definition: the centre or central point of a city or any other thing, also a facility such as a shopping or medical centre (das Zentrum, plural Zentren)
example: Wie komme ich am schnellsten ins Zentrum? — What is the quickest way to the centre?

hindi: टूट जाना, तोड़ देना — काँच जैसी चीज़ का टुकड़े-टुकड़े होना
definition: to break or shatter into pieces, said of glass, plates and hearts, both when something breaks and when someone breaks it (irregular: zerbricht, ist zerbrochen; hat zerbrochen when breaking something)
example: Die Vase ist in tausend Stücke zerbrochen. — The vase shattered into a thousand pieces.

hindi: नाज़ुक — आसानी से टूटने वाला
definition: fragile and breakable, easily shattered if dropped or knocked, the word printed on parcels containing glass or china
example: Vorsicht, die Vase ist sehr zerbrechlich. — Careful, the vase is very fragile.

hindi: बिखरना, टूटकर ढहना — टुकड़ों में बँट जाना
definition: to fall apart, crumble or disintegrate into pieces, used for old walls, empires, families and chemical substances (irregular: zerfällt, ist zerfallen; in + Akkusativ)
example: Die alte Mauer zerfällt langsam. — The old wall is slowly crumbling.

hindi: झटके से खींचना — बेसब्री या ज़ोर से किसी चीज़ को खींचना
definition: to tug or yank at something roughly and impatiently, pulling hard rather than gently, often at a jammed drawer or a leash (regular, an + Dativ)
example: Der Hund zerrt an der Leine. — The dog tugs at the leash.

hindi: अंतर्द्वंद्व — भीतर से दो हिस्सों में बँटे होने की दशा
definition: the torn inner condition of being pulled between loyalties or selves that refuse to reconcile
example: His Zerrissenheit between the family firm and the conservatory lasted a decade.

hindi: नष्ट करना — किसी चीज़ को पूरी तरह बरबाद करना
definition: to destroy something completely, wrecking a building, a relationship or hopes beyond repair (regular: hat zerstört)
example: Das Feuer hat das ganze Haus zerstört. — The fire destroyed the whole house.

hindi: सामान — चीज़ें, माल, बोलचाल में
definition: stuff or things in general, any unnamed collection of objects or material spoken about casually (das Zeug, no plural)
example: Wem gehört das Zeug in der Schublade? — Who does the stuff in the drawer belong to?

hindi: गवाह — जिसने घटना देखी हो और अदालत में बयान दे
definition: a witness, a person who saw what happened and gives testimony about it to the police or in court (der Zeuge, plural Zeugen)
example: Der Zeuge hat den Unfall genau gesehen. — The witness saw the accident clearly.

hindi: अंक-पत्र — हर छमाही के अंत में हर विषय के अंक दिखाने वाली रिपोर्ट
definition: a school report card handed out at the end of each half-year listing the grade achieved in every subject (das Zeugnis, plural Zeugnisse)
example: Am Freitag bekommen die Kinder das Zeugnis. — On Friday the children get their report card.

hindi: बकरी — सींगों वाला दूध देने वाला पहाड़ी जानवर
definition: a goat, the horned farm animal that gives milk, climbs rocks and eats almost anything (die Ziege, plural Ziegen)
example: Die Ziege frisst die Blätter vom Busch. — The goat is eating the leaves off the bush.

hindi: ईंट — पकी मिट्टी का चौकोर टुकड़ा जिससे दीवार और छत बनती है
definition: a brick, the baked clay block used for building walls and covering roofs (der Ziegel, plural Ziegel)
example: Der Ziegel ist aus gebranntem Ton. — The brick is made of fired clay.

hindi: खींचना — किसी चीज़ को अपनी ओर लाना या घर बदलना
definition: to pull or draw something towards yourself, such as a door or a rope; with sein it means to move house (zog, hat gezogen; ist gezogen for moving)
example: Zieh bitte an der Tür, nicht drücken! — Pull the door, do not push!

hindi: लक्ष्य — जो पाना या जहाँ पहुँचना हो, मंज़िल
definition: goal, aim or target that one works towards, also the finish line or destination of a journey (das Ziel, plural Ziele)
example: Das Ziel ist noch weit entfernt. — The goal is still a long way off.

hindi: काफ़ी — अच्छी-ख़ासी मात्रा में, पर पूरी तरह नहीं
definition: rather or fairly, to a considerable degree but not completely, the everyday softener before an adjective
example: Es ist heute ziemlich kalt. — It is rather cold today.

hindi: नाज़ुक — छोटा, हल्का और सुंदर बना
definition: dainty or petite in build, small and delicately shaped, used approvingly of people, hands and finely made objects
example: Sie hat zierliche Hände. — She has dainty hands.

hindi: अंक — शून्य से नौ तक का लिखित चिह्न
definition: a digit, one of the written figures from zero to nine that make up a number, as opposed to the number itself (die Ziffer, plural Ziffern)
example: Die letzte Ziffer der Telefonnummer fehlt. — The last digit of the phone number is missing.

hindi: कमरा — घर या होटल का एक कक्ष
definition: a room, any single enclosed space inside a house, apartment or hotel with walls and a door (das Zimmer, plural Zimmer)
example: Die Wohnung hat drei Zimmer. — The apartment has three rooms.

hindi: भवन-बढ़ई — घर की लकड़ी की बीम और छत का ढाँचा बनाने वाला
definition: a carpenter who builds the wooden frames, beams and roof structures of houses (der Zimmermann, plural Zimmerleute)
example: Der Zimmermann setzt heute den Dachstuhl auf. — The carpenter is putting up the roof frame today.

hindi: घरेलू पौधा — कमरे में गमले में सजावट के लिए रखा पौधा
definition: a houseplant, a potted plant kept indoors for decoration on windowsills and shelves (die Zimmerpflanze, plural Zimmerpflanzen)
example: Meine Zimmerpflanze braucht wenig Licht. — My houseplant needs little light.

hindi: ब्याज — उधार या जमा रकम पर बैंक द्वारा लिया या दिया गया प्रतिशत
definition: interest, the money a bank pays on savings or charges on a loan, nearly always used in the plural (der Zins, plural Zinsen)
example: Die Zinsen für den Kredit sind gestiegen. — The interest on the loan has risen.

hindi: ब्याज दर — उधार या जमा पर लगने वाला प्रतिशत
definition: the interest rate, the percentage a bank charges on a loan or pays on savings (der Zinssatz, plural Zinssätze)
example: Der Zinssatz liegt bei drei Prozent. — The interest rate is at three percent.

hindi: उद्धृत करना — किसी के शब्द या स्रोत का हवाला देना
definition: to quote or cite, to repeat someone's words or refer to a source in academic writing (regular, hat zitiert)
example: In der Hausarbeit musst du alle Quellen richtig zitieren. — In the term paper you have to cite all sources correctly.

hindi: नींबू — पीला बहुत खट्टा रसदार फल, पेय और खाने में स्वाद के लिए
definition: a lemon, the yellow citrus fruit with very sour juice used to flavour drinks, salads and cakes (die Zitrone, plural Zitronen)
example: Gib etwas Zitrone in den Tee. — Put some lemon in the tea.

hindi: काँपना — ठंड या डर से शरीर का थरथराना
definition: to tremble or shiver, to shake slightly with the body because of cold, fear or weakness (regular)
example: Meine Hände zittern vor Kälte. — My hands are trembling with cold.

hindi: नागरिक साहस — अन्याय के विरुद्ध खुलकर बोलने की हिम्मत
definition: the nerve to speak up against wrongdoing in public, when silence would be safer and far easier
example: One passenger showed some Zivilcourage and the whole carriage stopped pretending not to see.

hindi: सुबह का नाश्ता — दिन का पहला भोजन, स्विस शब्द
definition: breakfast, the first meal of the morning with bread, butter and coffee, the Swiss word from dialect for in the morning where Germany says Frühstück (der Zmorge, plural Zmorge)
example: Am Sonntag gibt es einen langen Zmorge mit Gipfeli. — On Sunday there is a long breakfast with croissants.

hindi: सुबह नौ बजे का नाश्ता — काम के बीच का छोटा भोजन, स्विस शब्द
definition: the mid-morning snack eaten around nine o'clock at work or school, a light meal of fruit, bread or pastry, from Swiss dialect for at nine (das Znüni, plural Znüni)
example: Zum Znüni nehme ich einen Apfel mit. — I am bringing an apple for my morning snack.

hindi: झगड़ा — तकरार, बोलचाल में
definition: trouble or a row, colloquial for a quarrel or ongoing conflict between people, often in the phrase Zoff haben (der Zoff, no plural)
example: Der Zoff zwischen den Geschwistern hört nie auf. — The row between the siblings never stops.

hindi: सीमा शुल्क — सीमा या हवाई अड्डे पर सामान की जाँच और कर
definition: customs, the border authority that inspects goods and luggage and collects duty on imports (der Zoll, no plural)
example: Beim Zoll musste ich meinen Koffer öffnen. — At customs I had to open my suitcase.

hindi: तहदार पैमाना — कारीगर की लकड़ी की मोड़ने वाली नापने की पटरी
definition: a folding rule, the hinged wooden measuring stick that every German tradesman carries (der Zollstock, plural Zollstöcke)
example: Miss die Wand mit dem Zollstock aus. — Measure the wall with the folding rule.

hindi: रोष — अन्याय पर उठा गहरा, कुछ साहित्यिक गुस्सा
definition: wrath, a strong righteous anger, somewhat literary or formal compared with everyday rage (der Zorn, no plural)
example: Der Zorn über die Ungerechtigkeit war groß. — The anger over the injustice was great.

hindi: की ओर — किसी व्यक्ति, जगह या अवसर की तरफ़
definition: to, towards a person, building, event or place, also at an occasion or for a stated purpose (preposition, + Dativ; also infinitive marker)
example: Ich gehe heute zum Arzt. — I am going to the doctor today.

hindi: घर पर — अपने घर में मौजूद होना
definition: at home, being located inside one's own dwelling; contrast nach Hause, which means going home (adverbial phrase, also written zuhause)
example: Bist du heute Abend zu Hause? — Are you at home this evening?

hindi: तैयार करना — खाने के लिए भोजन बनाकर तैयार रखना
definition: to prepare food or a meal ready for eating, somewhat more formal than kochen (separable: bereitet zu, hat zubereitet)
example: Er bereitet das Abendessen für die Gäste zu. — He prepares dinner for the guests.

hindi: चीनी — मीठा सफ़ेद दानेदार पदार्थ
definition: sugar, the sweet white granulated substance stirred into drinks and used in baking cakes and desserts (der Zucker, no plural)
example: Der Zucker ist leider alle. — The sugar has unfortunately run out.

hindi: इसके अतिरिक्त — तर्क में औपचारिक ढंग से बात जोड़ना
definition: in addition, moreover; a formal written adverb adding a further point to an argument
example: Die Wohnung ist klein, zudem sehr teuer. — The flat is small, in addition very expensive.

hindi: सबसे पहले — किसी क्रम में शुरुआत में
definition: first, at the beginning of a sequence before anything else happens, the everyday word for the opening step
example: Zuerst müssen wir die Zwiebeln schneiden. — First we have to chop the onions.

hindi: संयोग — बिना योजना अचानक घट जाने वाली बात
definition: chance or coincidence, something that happens without any plan or visible cause, the random element that probability tries to measure (der Zufall, plural Zufälle)
example: Das war ein glücklicher Zufall. — That was a lucky coincidence.

hindi: के अनुसार — किसी स्रोत के कहे मुताबिक़, संज्ञा के बाद आता है
definition: according to a source or statement, placed after the noun it refers to, formal or journalistic register (preposition, after the noun + Dativ)
example: Dem Bericht zufolge steigen die Preise weiter. — According to the report prices keep rising.

hindi: संतुष्ट — जो है उससे तृप्त
definition: content or satisfied, pleased with how things are and wanting nothing more from them
example: Wir sind mit dem Hotel sehr zufrieden. — We are very satisfied with the hotel.

hindi: संतोष — जो है उसमें तृप्त रहने का शांत भाव
definition: contentment, the quiet satisfaction of having enough and wanting nothing more right now (die Zufriedenheit, no plural)
example: Die Zufriedenheit der Kunden ist uns sehr wichtig. — Customer satisfaction is very important to us.

hindi: संयोग से — इत्तेफ़ाक़ से, बिना योजना के
definition: by chance, accidentally, coincidentally; something that happened without planning, also softens polite questions
example: Ich habe ihn zufällig im Supermarkt getroffen. — I met him by chance in the supermarket.

hindi: रेलगाड़ी — पटरी पर चलने वाली डिब्बों की गाड़ी
definition: a train, the connected railway carriages that carry passengers along a track between stations (der Zug, plural Züge)
example: Der Zug hat zwanzig Minuten Verspätung. — The train is twenty minutes late.

hindi: स्वीकार करना — अनिच्छा से मान लेना कि गलती हुई
definition: to admit or concede reluctantly and honestly that something unpleasant is true or that you yourself made a mistake or error (separable, irregular: gibt zu, hat zugegeben)
example: Er gab zu, dass er gelogen hatte. — He admitted that he had lied.

hindi: सरकती ठंडी हवा — दरवाज़े-खिड़की की झिरी से आती धार
definition: a thin current of cold air slipping through a room, blamed in German households for many ills
example: His aunt shut the window at once, muttering about Zugluft and stiff necks.

hindi: लपक लेना — भोजन या मौके पर बिना संकोच हाथ बढ़ाना
definition: to help oneself to food on the table or to grab a bargain quickly, often heard as a friendly invitation to eat (separable: greift zu, hat zugegriffen)
example: Greifen Sie ruhig zu, es ist genug da! — Go ahead and help yourself, there is plenty!

hindi: के पक्ष में — किसी के फ़ायदे या समर्थन के लिए
definition: in favour of, for the benefit of a person, group or cause that receives the advantage, formal register (preposition, + Genitiv)
example: Das Konzert findet zugunsten der Kinderhilfe statt. — The concert takes place in aid of the children's charity.

hindi: चाल की मजबूरी — हर चाल नुक़सानदेह, फिर भी चलना अनिवार्य
definition: a position in which every available move damages you, and yet declining to move is not permitted
example: With both bids expiring Friday, the board found itself in Zugzwang.

hindi: ध्यान से सुनना — किसी की बात पर ध्यान देकर सुनना
definition: to listen attentively to a person speaking or to a piece of music, paying full attention (separable: hört zu, hat zugehört; + Dativ)
example: Hör mir doch mal richtig zu! — Just listen to me properly!

hindi: श्रोता — रेडियो या भाषण सुनने वाला व्यक्ति
definition: a listener, the person hearing a radio programme, a talk or a concert in the audience (der Zuhörer, plural Zuhörer)
example: Die Zuhörer konnten im Radio anrufen. — The listeners could phone in to the radio.

hindi: भविष्य — आने वाला समय
definition: the future, the time still to come after the present, also the future tense in German grammar (die Zukunft, no plural)
example: Niemand kennt die Zukunft. — Nobody knows the future.

hindi: अनुमति देना — कुछ होने देना या आधिकारिक रूप से मंज़ूरी देना
definition: to allow or permit something to happen, or to officially approve or register a vehicle or student (separable: lässt zu, hat zugelassen)
example: Das Auto ist noch nicht zugelassen. — The car is not registered yet.

hindi: पंजीकरण-अनुमति — व्यक्ति, वाहन या उत्पाद को क़ानूनी अनुमति देना
definition: official admission or licensing that allows a person, vehicle or product to operate legally (die Zulassung, plural Zulassungen)
example: Die Zulassung für das Auto machen wir morgen. — We will do the registration for the car tomorrow.

hindi: आख़िर में, अंतिम बार — क्रम के सबसे अंत में
definition: last, at the end of a sequence, and also meaning the most recent time something happened
example: Zuletzt haben wir uns vor zwei Jahren gesehen. — We last saw each other two years ago.

hindi: की ख़ातिर — किसी को खुश रखने या भला करने के लिए
definition: for the sake of someone, done to please or protect a person, placed after the noun (preposition, after the noun + Dativ)
example: Den Kindern zuliebe bleiben wir länger. — For the children's sake we are staying longer.

hindi: सौभाग्य से — गनीमत है कि, अच्छा हुआ कि
definition: luckily, fortunately; a relieved everyday remark that something turned out well or that a danger was narrowly avoided
example: Zum Glück hat es nicht geregnet. — Luckily it didn't rain.

hindi: आपके स्वास्थ्य के लिए — औपचारिक शराब-अभिवादन
definition: the more formal toast raised with wine or at dinners, wishing the company good health
example: Zum Wohl, meine Damen und Herren! — To your health, ladies and gentlemen!

hindi: बंद करना — दरवाज़ा, खिड़की या दुकान बंद कर देना
definition: to close or shut a door, window, bag or shop, a common everyday synonym of schließen (separable: macht zu, hat zugemacht)
example: Mach bitte das Fenster zu, es zieht. — Please close the window, there is a draught.

hindi: ख़ासकर इसलिए कि — बात को और पक्का करने वाला अतिरिक्त कारण
definition: especially since, all the more because; a conjunction that adds a strengthening extra reason to a statement
example: Ich nehme den Zug, zumal er billiger ist. — I take the train, especially since it is cheaper.

hindi: कम से कम, कम-से-कम इतना — दावे को सीमित करने वाला शब्द
definition: an adverb meaning at least or at any rate that limits a claim to the part the speaker can vouch for
example: Zumindest hat es nicht geregnet. — At least it didn't rain.

hindi: बढ़ना — वज़न, संख्या या तीव्रता में वृद्धि होना
definition: to increase or grow in amount, number or intensity, and of a person to gain weight and become heavier (separable: nimmt zu, hat zugenommen)
example: Im Winter habe ich drei Kilo zugenommen. — I gained three kilos in winter.

hindi: जीभ — मुँह के अंदर का लचीला अंग जिससे स्वाद लेते और बोलते हैं
definition: the tongue, the movable muscular organ inside the mouth used for tasting food and forming speech (die Zunge, plural Zungen)
example: Ich habe mir auf die Zunge gebissen. — I bit my tongue.

hindi: जीभ तोड़ने वाला वाक्य — बोलने में मुश्किल शब्दों का खेल
definition: a tongue twister, a phrase or word so difficult to pronounce quickly that the speaker stumbles, literally a tongue breaker (der Zungenbrecher, plural Zungenbrecher)
example: Dieser Zungenbrecher ist selbst für Deutsche schwer. — This tongue twister is hard even for Germans.

hindi: सबसे पहले, फ़िलहाल — शुरुआत में या अभी के लिए
definition: first of all, to begin with, at the start of a sequence, also meaning for the time being
example: Zunächst möchte ich mich bedanken. — First of all I would like to say thank you.

hindi: जाम उठाकर शुभकामना देना — किसी की ओर गिलास उठाना
definition: to raise a glass toward someone and toast them with a word or nod before drinking (separable: prostet zu, hat zugeprostet; + Dativ)
example: Er prostet seinen Kollegen fröhlich zu. — He cheerfully raises his glass to his colleagues.

hindi: हाथ बँटाना — किसी की मदद करना, हाथ लगाना
definition: to lend someone a hand, willingly helping them with a practical task or household chore (jemandem zur Hand gehen; ist gegangen)
example: Kannst du mir in der Küche zur Hand gehen? — Can you give me a hand in the kitchen?

hindi: इन दिनों — इस समय, फ़िलहाल
definition: at present, currently, right now during this particular period, in contrast with before or later, written as one word
example: Zurzeit habe ich viel zu tun. — At present I have a lot to do.

hindi: वापस — पहले वाली जगह की ओर लौटते हुए
definition: back, returning toward the place one started from, the little word attached to countless verbs of going and giving
example: Wir müssen zurück zum Bahnhof. — We have to go back to the station.

hindi: वापस लाना — कोई चीज़ या व्यक्ति उसकी जगह पर लौटाना
definition: to bring something or someone back to the place where they came from (separable: bringt zurück, hat zurückgebracht)
example: Ich bringe die Schlüssel heute Abend zurück. — I will bring the keys back this evening.

hindi: गाड़ी से लौटना — वाहन में वापस यात्रा करना
definition: to drive or travel back to your starting place by car, train, bicycle or other vehicle (separable: fährt zurück, ist zurückgefahren)
example: Wir fahren am Sonntag nach Hause zurück. — We are driving back home on Sunday.

hindi: लौटाना — उधार ली या ख़रीदी चीज़ वापस देना
definition: to give something back or return it to its owner or to the shop where it was bought (separable: gibt zurück, hat zurückgegeben, + Dativ)
example: Ich gebe dir das Geld nächste Woche zurück. — I will give you the money back next week.

hindi: वापस जाना — पैदल पहले वाली जगह लौटना, या संख्या और बुख़ार का घटना
definition: to walk back or return to where you came from, also of numbers or fever to decrease (separable: geht zurück, ist zurückgegangen)
example: Es wird kalt, wir gehen lieber ins Haus zurück. — It is getting cold, we had better go back inside.

hindi: संयमित — अपनी बात और भावनाएँ खुलकर न दिखाने वाला
definition: reserved and restrained, holding back one's opinions and feelings rather than pushing oneself forward
example: Er ist im Meeting eher zurückhaltend. — He is rather reserved in meetings.

hindi: वापस ले आना — कहीं गई चीज़ या व्यक्ति को जाकर वापस लाना
definition: to fetch something or someone back, to retrieve what was sent away or taken (separable: holt zurück, hat zurückgeholt)
example: Sie holt das Paket von der Post zurück. — She is fetching the parcel back from the post office.

hindi: लौटना — लंबी अनुपस्थिति के बाद अपने स्थान पर वापस आना
definition: to return to a place or a former state after a long absence, somewhat more formal than zurückkommen (separable: kehrt zurück, ist zurückgekehrt)
example: Nach zehn Jahren kehrte er in seine Heimatstadt zurück. — After ten years he returned to his home town.

hindi: वापस आना — जहाँ से गए थे वहीं लौट आना
definition: to come back or return to a place after being away, or to return to a topic (separable: kommt zurück, ist zurückgekommen)
example: Wann kommst du aus dem Urlaub zurück? — When are you coming back from holiday?

hindi: पलट कर फ़ोन करना — जिसने फ़ोन किया था उसे दोबारा फ़ोन करना
definition: to call someone back on the telephone after a missed call, or to recall a faulty product (separable: ruft zurück, hat zurückgerufen)
example: Ich rufe Sie in einer Stunde zurück. — I will call you back in an hour.

hindi: वापस भेजना — डाक या पार्सल को प्रेषक के पास लौटाना
definition: to send something back by post or courier, especially goods you do not want to keep (separable: schickt zurück, hat zurückgeschickt)
example: Die Schuhe passen nicht, ich schicke sie zurück. — The shoes do not fit, I am sending them back.

hindi: पद से हटना — इस्तीफ़ा देना या एक क़दम पीछे हटना
definition: to resign from an office or position, or literally to step back from something (separable: tritt zurück, ist zurückgetreten; von + Dativ)
example: Der Minister ist gestern von seinem Amt zurückgetreten. — The minister resigned from his office yesterday.

hindi: लौटाना — उधार ली गई रकम वापस चुकाना
definition: to repay borrowed money in full or instalments to the bank or person who lent it (separable: zahlt zurück, hat zurückgezahlt)
example: Ich zahle dir das Geld nächste Woche zurück. — I will pay you the money back next week.

hindi: स्वीकृति — हाँ कहने की पुष्टि, ख़ासकर नौकरी या निमंत्रण पर
definition: an acceptance or firm promise, the positive reply to an invitation, offer or job application (die Zusage, plural Zusagen)
example: Gestern kam endlich die Zusage für die Stelle. — Yesterday the acceptance for the position finally arrived.

hindi: हामी भरना — निमंत्रण या प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करने का वादा करना
definition: to accept an invitation or offer, to promise firmly that you will attend or take part (separable: sagt zu, hat zugesagt)
example: Sie hat für die Hochzeit schon zugesagt. — She has already accepted for the wedding.

hindi: सारांश बनाना — मुख्य बातें संक्षेप में कहना
definition: to summarise or sum up, to state the main points of a longer text or discussion briefly (separable: fasst zusammen, hat zusammengefasst)
example: Fassen Sie den Text in drei Sätzen zusammen. — Summarise the text in three sentences.

hindi: सारांश — मुख्य बातों का संक्षिप्त रूप
definition: a summary or abstract, a short version giving the main points of a longer text or talk (die Zusammenfassung, plural Zusammenfassungen)
example: Schreib bitte eine kurze Zusammenfassung des Artikels. — Please write a short summary of the article.

hindi: संबंध — दो बातों के बीच का जोड़ या संदर्भ
definition: the connection or relationship between things, the context in which a statement or event makes sense (der Zusammenhang, plural Zusammenhänge)
example: Ich verstehe den Zusammenhang zwischen den beiden Ereignissen nicht. — I do not understand the connection between the two events.

hindi: तह करना — धुले कपड़े या तौलिये मोड़कर रखना
